formal.en: The fisherman tied a rope to the grapnel before lowering it into the water.
formal.zh: 渔民先把绳子系在多爪小锚上，再将它放入水中。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaddili l-ankrott, jekk jogħġbok. Mark: Hawn hu; il-ħabel diġà marbut miegħu.
colloquial.en: Maja: Pass me the grapnel, please. Mark: Here it is; the rope is already tied to it.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：请把多爪小锚递给我。马克：给你，绳子已经系在上面了。

messages.speaker: Maja (渔民)
messages.zh: 请把多爪小锚递给我。
messages.en: Pass me the grapnel, please.

messages.speaker: Mark (船上助手)
messages.mt_spoken: Hawn hu; il-ħabel diġà marbut miegħu.
messages.mt_standard: Hawn hu; il-ħabel diġà marbut miegħu.
messages.zh: 给你，绳子已经系在上面了。
messages.en: Here it is; the rope is already tied to it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记 ankrott 时画一根绳子连着几个弯钩：看到多个钩爪，就想到多爪小锚或抓钩。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An additional building attached to or associated with a main building, or a supplementary section attached to a document.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 与主楼相连或配套使用的附楼，也可指附在文件后面的补充材料。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Bini miżjud ma' bini prinċipali jew marbut miegħu, jew taqsima supplimentari mehmuża ma' dokument.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 附楼；文件的附件或附录

formal.mt: It-tabelli bid-dettalji tal-ispejjeż jinsabu fl-anness mar-rapport.
formal.en: The tables detailing the expenses are in the annex to the report.
formal.zh: 列明费用详情的表格见报告附件。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Fejn se ssir il-lezzjoni llum? Mark: Fl-anness tal-iskola, ħdejn il-bitħa.
colloquial.en: Maja: Where will the lesson be held today? Mark: In the school annex, next to the courtyard.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：今天在哪里上课？马克：在学校附楼里，就在院子旁边。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.zh: 今天在哪里上课？
messages.en: Where will the lesson be held today?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.zh: 在学校附楼里，就在院子旁边。
messages.en: In the school annex, next to the courtyard.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把主楼旁加出的小楼和报告后附上的材料放在一起记：anness 都表示主体之外的附加部分。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of taking a territory and incorporating it into another state.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 将某一领土并入另一国家的行为或过程。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att li bih territorju jittieħed u jsir parti minn stat ieħor.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 吞并；将某一领土并入另一国家的行为

formal.mt: L-istudju jeżamina l-effetti tal-annessjoni fuq il-popolazzjoni tat-territorju.
formal.en: The study examines the effects of annexation on the territory's population.
formal.zh: 该研究考察领土兼并对当地人口的影响。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Xi tfisser annessjoni f'dan it-test? Pawlu: Tfisser li territorju jittieħed u jsir parti minn stat ieħor.
colloquial.en: Sara: What does annexation mean in this text? Pawlu: It means that a territory is taken and made part of another state.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：这篇文章里的“吞并”是什么意思？保罗：意思是一片领土被夺取并划入另一个国家。

messages.speaker: Sara (学生)
messages.zh: 这篇文章里的“吞并”是什么意思？
messages.en: What does annexation mean in this text?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (老师)
messages.mt_spoken: Tfisser li territorju jittieħed u jsir parti minn stat ieħor.
messages.mt_standard: Tfisser li territorju jittieħed u jsir parti minn stat ieħor.
messages.zh: 意思是一片领土被夺取并划入另一个国家。
messages.en: It means that a territory is taken and made part of another state.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象地图上一片领土被划进另一个国家的边界，用这个画面记住 annessjoni 的“领土吞并”义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A sum of money that is due to be paid each year.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 按年应当缴付的一笔款项，如每年的会费或其他年度费用。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Somma flus li trid titħallas kull sena.

sense_translations.en_definition: sum of money to be paid annually
sense_translations.zh_definition: 每年应缴付的一笔款项；年度缴款

formal.mt: Il-membri għandhom iħallsu l-annwalità tal-klabb sal-aħħar ta' Jannar.
formal.en: Members must pay the club's annual fee by the end of January.
formal.zh: 会员须于一月底之前缴付俱乐部年度会费。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Kemm hi l-annwalità tal-klabb? Toni: Sittin ewro, u tista' tħallasha llum.
colloquial.en: Lara: How much is the club's annual fee? Toni: Sixty euros, and you can pay it today.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：俱乐部的年费是多少？托尼：六十欧元，今天就可以缴付。

messages.speaker: Lara (会员)
messages.zh: 俱乐部的年费是多少？
messages.en: How much is the club's annual fee?

messages.speaker: Toni (俱乐部职员)
messages.mt_spoken: Sittin ewro, u tista' tħallasha llum.
messages.mt_standard: Sittin ewro, u tista' tħallasha llum.
messages.zh: 六十欧元，今天就可以缴付。
messages.en: Sixty euros, and you can pay it today.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 annwalità 记成日历旁的一张年度缴费单：这个名词指每年要交的那笔钱。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Every year or once in each year.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 每年发生，或以一年一次为周期；用于说明动作的频率。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kull sena jew darba fis-sena.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 每年；一年一次地；按年

formal.mt: Ir-rapport dwar l-attivitajiet tal-għaqda jiġi ppubblikat annwalment.
formal.en: The report on the association's activities is published annually.
formal.zh: 该协会的活动报告每年出版一次。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Dan il-festival isir kull xahar? David: Le, isir annwalment, dejjem f'Mejju.
colloquial.en: Nina: Does this festival take place every month? David: No, it takes place annually, always in May.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：这个节庆每个月都举行吗？戴维：不是，每年举行一次，总是在五月。

messages.speaker: Nina (游客)
messages.zh: 这个节庆每个月都举行吗？
messages.en: Does this festival take place every month?

messages.speaker: David (当地朋友)
messages.zh: 不是，每年举行一次，总是在五月。
messages.en: No, it takes place annually, always in May.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象每翻完一本日历就重复一次同样的活动，用 annwalment 回答“多久一次”：每年一次。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A book published for a particular year that records information, events, or activities, such as a school's annual record.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 记录某一年度资料、事件或活动的书籍，也可指学校的年度纪念册。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ktieb għal sena partikolari li jiġbor tagħrif, ġrajjiet jew attivitajiet ta' dik is-sena.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 年鉴；记录某一年度情况的书；学校年度纪念册

formal.mt: L-annwarju tal-iskola jiġbor ritratti u rapporti dwar l-attivitajiet tas-sena.
formal.en: The school yearbook brings together photographs and reports about the year's activities.
formal.zh: 学校年度纪念册汇集了本年度活动的照片与报道。

colloquial.mt: Emma: Rajt ir-ritratt tagħna fl-annwarju? Luqa: Iva, qiegħed ħdejn ir-rapport dwar il-kunċert.
colloquial.en: Emma: Have you seen our photograph in the yearbook? Luqa: Yes, it is next to the report about the concert.
colloquial.zh: 艾玛：你看到年册里我们的照片了吗？卢卡：看到了，就在音乐会报道旁边。

messages.speaker: Emma (学生)
messages.zh: 你看到年册里我们的照片了吗？
messages.en: Have you seen our photograph in the yearbook?

messages.speaker: Luqa (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, qiegħed ħdejn ir-rapport dwar il-kunċert.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, qiegħed ħdejn ir-rapport dwar il-kunċert.
messages.zh: 看到了，就在音乐会报道旁边。
messages.en: Yes, it is next to the report about the concert.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象把一整年的照片、活动和资料装订成一本书，这本“一年一册”的记录就是 annwarju。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Used with minn to indicate an amount, number, or degree below the one being compared with.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 与 minn 连用，表示数量、数目或程度低于比较对象，即“少于”或“比……更少”。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jintuża ma' minn biex juri kwantità, numru jew grad iżgħar minn dak li jkun qed jitqabbel miegħu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 少于；低于；比……更少

formal.mt: Il-vjaġġ bil-ferrovija jieħu anqas minn siegħa.
formal.en: The train journey takes less than an hour.
formal.zh: 这段火车行程耗时不到一小时。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Kemm swielek dan il-ktieb? Ġanni: Anqas minn għaxar ewro; kien hemm skont.
colloquial.en: Marija: How much did this book cost you? Ġanni: Less than ten euros; there was a discount.
colloquial.zh: 玛丽娅：这本书你花了多少钱？詹尼：不到十欧元，当时有折扣。

messages.speaker: Marija (朋友)
messages.zh: 这本书你花了多少钱？
messages.en: How much did this book cost you?

messages.speaker: Ġanni (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Anqas minn għaxar ewro; kien hemm skont.
messages.mt_standard: Anqas minn għaxar ewro; kien hemm skont.
messages.zh: 不到十欧元，当时有折扣。
messages.en: Less than ten euros; there was a discount.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 anqas minn 和数学符号“小于号”一起记：后面放比较标准，前面的实际数量比它少。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The chemical element antimony.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 化学元素锑的名称，用于化学及材料相关语境。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-isem tal-element kimiku antimonju.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 锑，一种化学元素

formal.mt: Ir-rapport tal-laboratorju jindika li l-kampjun fih l-antimonju.
formal.en: The laboratory report indicates that the sample contains antimony.
formal.zh: 实验室报告表明该样品含有锑。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Xi jfisser antimonju fuq din it-tikketta? Karl: Huwa l-isem ta' element kimiku.
colloquial.en: Rita: What does antimonju mean on this label? Karl: It is the name of a chemical element.
colloquial.zh: 丽塔：这个标签上的 antimonju 是什么意思？卡尔：它是一种化学元素的名称，中文叫“锑”。

messages.speaker: Rita (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Xi jfisser antimonju fuq din it-tikketta?
messages.mt_standard: Xi jfisser antimonju fuq din it-tikketta?
messages.zh: 这个标签上的 antimonju 是什么意思？
messages.en: What does antimonju mean on this label?

messages.speaker: Karl (老师)
messages.zh: 它是一种化学元素的名称，中文叫“锑”。
messages.en: It is the name of a chemical element.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象实验室样品瓶上贴着双语标签“antimonju—锑”，把马耳他语名称与中文元素名成对记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who studies human beings, their societies, cultures, or biological development.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 研究人类及其社会、文化或生物发展的学者。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li tistudja lill-bniedem, lis-soċjetajiet, lill-kulturi jew lill-iżvilupp bijoloġiku tiegħu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 人类学家；从事人类学研究的人。

formal.mt: L-antropologu intervista lill-membri tal-komunità biex jifhem aħjar id-drawwiet tagħhom.
formal.en: The anthropologist interviewed members of the community to understand their customs better.
formal.zh: 这位人类学家访谈了社群成员，以便更好地理解他们的习俗。

colloquial.mt: Sara: X'jagħmel ħuk? Luqa: Jaħdem bħala antropologu u jistudja kif jgħixu n-nies f'komunitajiet differenti.
colloquial.en: Sara: What does your brother do? Luqa: He works as an anthropologist and studies how people live in different communities.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：你哥哥做什么工作？卢卡：他是人类学家，研究不同社群中的人怎样生活。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 你哥哥做什么工作？
messages.en: What does your brother do?

messages.speaker: Luqa (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Jaħdem bħala antropologu u jistudja kif jgħixu n-nies f'komunitajiet differenti.
messages.mt_standard: Jaħdem bħala antropologu u jistudja kif jgħixu n-nies f'komunitajiet differenti.
messages.zh: 他是人类学家，研究不同社群中的人怎样生活。
messages.en: He works as an anthropologist and studies how people live in different communities.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象拿着笔记本访谈社群成员的研究者：学科叫 antropoloġija，从事这门研究的人叫 antropologu。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The study of human beings, including their societies, cultures, and biological development.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 研究人类及其社会、文化和生物发展等方面的学科。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-istudju tal-bniedem, inklużi s-soċjetajiet, il-kulturi u l-iżvilupp bijoloġiku tiegħu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 人类学；研究人类及其社会、文化和生物特征的学科。

formal.mt: Il-kors fl-antropoloġija jintroduċi lill-istudenti għall-istudju tal-kulturi u tas-soċjetajiet umani.
formal.en: The anthropology course introduces students to the study of human cultures and societies.
formal.zh: 这门人类学课程引导学生认识对人类文化和社会的研究。

colloquial.mt: Lara: X'qed tistudja l-università? Mark: L-antropoloġija. Bħalissa qed nitgħallmu dwar il-ħajja f'komunitajiet differenti.
colloquial.en: Lara: What are you studying at university? Mark: Anthropology. At the moment we are learning about life in different communities.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：你在大学学什么？马克：人类学。我们最近在学习不同社群的生活。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 你在大学学什么？
messages.en: What are you studying at university?

messages.speaker: Mark (大学生)
messages.mt_spoken: L-antropoloġija. Bħalissa qed nitgħallmu dwar il-ħajja f'komunitajiet differenti.
messages.mt_standard: L-antropoloġija. Bħalissa qed nitgħallmu dwar il-ħajja f'komunitajiet differenti.
messages.zh: 人类学。我们最近在学习不同社群的生活。
messages.en: Anthropology. At the moment we are learning about life in different communities.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把这词和一本记录人类生活的课堂笔记联系起来：研究人怎样生活、形成社会和文化，就是人类学。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Relating to anthropology or its study of human beings, societies, and cultures.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 与人类学或其对人类、社会和文化的研究有关的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu x'jaqsam mal-antropoloġija jew mal-istudju tal-bniedem, tas-soċjetajiet u tal-kulturi.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 人类学的；与人类学研究有关的。

formal.mt: Dan l-istudju antropoloġiku jeżamina r-rwol tal-ikel fil-ħajja ta' kuljum tal-komunità.
formal.en: This anthropological study examines the role of food in the community's everyday life.
formal.zh: 这项人类学研究考察食物在该社群日常生活中的作用。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Għaliex qed tistaqsi lin-nies dwar id-drawwiet tagħhom? David: Qed nagħmel studju antropoloġiku għall-kors tiegħi.
colloquial.en: Nina: Why are you asking people about their customs? David: I am doing an anthropological study for my course.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：你为什么在问大家的习俗？戴维：我正在为课程做一项人类学研究。

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex qed tistaqsi lin-nies dwar id-drawwiet tagħhom?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex qed tistaqsi lin-nies dwar id-drawwiet tagħhom?
messages.zh: 你为什么在问大家的习俗？
messages.en: Why are you asking people about their customs?

messages.speaker: David (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Qed nagħmel studju antropoloġiku għall-kors tiegħi.
messages.mt_standard: Qed nagħmel studju antropoloġiku għall-kors tiegħi.
messages.zh: 我正在为课程做一项人类学研究。
messages.en: I am doing an anthropological study for my course.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“人类学的研究”整组记忆：antropoloġiku 描述研究的性质；搭配 riċerka 时可见 antropoloġika。

gloss_zh: 人类中心的；以人类为中心的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Treating humans and human interests as the central focus when considering the world.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在认识世界或评价事物时，以人类及人类利益为中心的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jqiegħed lill-bniedem u l-interessi tiegħu fiċ-ċentru tal-mod kif iħares lejn id-dinja.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 以人类为中心的；以人类及其利益作为主要衡量标准的

formal.mt: L-awtur jikkritika approċċ antropoċentriku li jevalwa n-natura biss skont il-benefiċċju tagħha għall-bniedem.
formal.en: The author criticizes an anthropocentric approach that evaluates nature only according to its benefit to humans.
formal.zh: 作者批评一种以人类为中心的方法：它仅根据自然对人类的益处来评价自然。

colloquial.mt: Lea: Għaliex sejjaħt dan l-argument antropoċentriku? Samwel: Għax iqis biss dak li hu tajjeb għall-bnedmin u jinjora l-ħtiġijiet tal-annimali.
colloquial.en: Lea: Why did you call this argument anthropocentric? Samwel: Because it considers only what is good for humans and ignores animals' needs.
colloquial.zh: 莉娅：你为什么说这个论点以人类为中心？萨姆韦尔：因为它只考虑什么对人类有利，却忽略了动物的需要。

messages.speaker: Lea (同学)
messages.zh: 你为什么说这个论点以人类为中心？
messages.en: Why did you call this argument anthropocentric?

messages.speaker: Samwel (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax iqis biss dak li hu tajjeb għall-bnedmin u jinjora l-ħtiġijiet tal-annimali.
messages.mt_standard: Għax iqis biss dak li hu tajjeb għall-bnedmin u jinjora l-ħtiġijiet tal-annimali.
messages.zh: 因为它只考虑什么对人类有利，却忽略了动物的需要。
messages.en: Because it considers only what is good for humans and ignores animals' needs.

cognitive_memory_aid: 画一个圆，把“人类利益”写在圆心，再用 antropoċentriku 描述这种把人类放在中心的看法。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The view that human beings are central and that human interests are the main measure of value.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把人类置于中心，并以人类利益作为主要价值尺度的观点。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-fehma li l-bniedem jinsab fiċ-ċentru u li l-interessi tiegħu huma l-kejl ewlieni tal-valur.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 人类中心主义；以人类及其利益为中心的观点。

collocations.zh: 对人类中心主义的批评
关于人类中心主义的讨论

formal.mt: L-artiklu jeżamina l-antropoċentriżmu u jistaqsi jekk il-valur tan-natura għandux jitkejjel biss skont il-bżonnijiet tal-bniedem.
formal.en: The article examines anthropocentrism and asks whether the value of nature should be measured only according to human needs.
formal.zh: 这篇文章探讨人类中心主义，并追问是否应当仅按人类的需要衡量自然的价值。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'inhu l-antropoċentriżmu? Pawlu: Huwa meta tqiegħed lill-bniedem fiċ-ċentru u tiġġudika kollox skont l-interessi tiegħu.
colloquial.en: Maja: What is anthropocentrism? Pawlu: It is when you put human beings at the centre and judge everything according to their interests.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：什么是人类中心主义？保罗：就是把人类放在中心，按人类的利益来评判一切。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.zh: 什么是人类中心主义？
messages.en: What is anthropocentrism?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Huwa meta tqiegħed lill-bniedem fiċ-ċentru u tiġġudika kollox skont l-interessi tiegħu.
messages.mt_standard: Huwa meta tqiegħed lill-bniedem fiċ-ċentru u tiġġudika kollox skont l-interessi tiegħu.
messages.zh: 就是把人类放在中心，按人类的利益来评判一切。
messages.en: It is when you put human beings at the centre and judge everything according to their interests.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象画面中央站着一个人，周围万物都按他的需要被衡量，用这个画面记住“人类中心主义”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The highest point of something, either physically or in achievement or development.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 某物的最高点，也可指成就或发展所达到的巅峰。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-ogħla punt ta' xi ħaġa, kemm f'sens fiżiku kif ukoll f'dak li jinkiseb jew fl-iżvilupp.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 顶点；最高点；比喻成就或发展的巅峰。

formal.mt: Ir-rebħ ta' dan il-premju mmarka l-apiċi tal-karriera tagħha.
formal.en: Winning this award marked the apex of her career.
formal.zh: 获得这一奖项标志着她的事业达到了巅峰。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Fejn inpoġġi l-ittra A fid-disinn? Ben: Fl-apiċi tat-trijangolu, fil-punt ta' fuq.
colloquial.en: Anna: Where should I put the letter A in the drawing? Ben: At the apex of the triangle, at the top point.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：图里的字母 A 应该放在哪里？本：放在三角形的顶点，就是最上面的那个点。

messages.speaker: Anna (学生)
messages.zh: 图里的字母 A 应该放在哪里？
messages.en: Where should I put the letter A in the drawing?

messages.speaker: Ben (同学)
messages.zh: 放在三角形的顶点，就是最上面的那个点。
messages.en: At the apex of the triangle, at the top point.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把字母 A 想成尖顶的三角形，手指指向最上方，记住 apiċi 是“顶点”，也能表示事业巅峰。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To move oneself away from other people or withdraw from a group or activity.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使自己退到一旁、离开人群，或退出某个群体或活动。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Warrab ruħu minn ħdejn nies oħra jew irtira minn grupp jew attività.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 退开；使自己离开人群或退出某项活动。

formal.mt: Wara l-laqgħa, id-direttur apparta ruħu għal ftit ħin biex jaħseb dwar il-proposta.
formal.en: After the meeting, the director withdrew for a short time to think about the proposal.
formal.zh: 会议结束后，主任暂时独处，思考这项提议。

colloquial.mt: Marta: Fejn mar David? Toni: Apparta ruħu mill-grupp għal ftit. Ried ftit kwiet.
colloquial.en: Marta: Where did David go? Toni: He withdrew from the group for a bit. He wanted some quiet.
colloquial.zh: 玛尔塔：戴维去哪里了？托尼：他暂时离开大家了，想清静一下。

messages.speaker: Marta (朋友)
messages.zh: 戴维去哪里了？
messages.en: Where did David go?

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Apparta ruħu mill-grupp għal ftit. Ried ftit kwiet.
messages.mt_standard: Apparta ruħu mill-grupp għal ftit. Ried ftit kwiet.
messages.zh: 他暂时离开大家了，想清静一下。
messages.en: He withdrew from the group for a bit. He wanted some quiet.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记住一个具体动作：聚会太吵，自己退到安静角落。连着 apparta ruħu 一起记，突出“自己退开”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The position or office of an apostle, together with the religious mission associated with it.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 宗徒或使徒的身份与职分，以及这一职分所承担的宗教使命。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-kariga jew il-pożizzjoni ta' appostlu u l-missjoni reliġjuża marbuta magħha.

sense_translations.en_definition: apostolate, apostleship (the position of an apostle)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 宗徒职分；使徒身份，即担任宗徒或使徒的职位与职责。

collocations.zh: 宗徒职分所承担的使命

formal.mt: Il-lezzjoni tiddiskuti l-appostolat ta' San Pawl u l-missjoni tiegħu li jxandar il-fidi.
formal.en: The lesson discusses Saint Paul's apostleship and his mission to proclaim the faith.
formal.zh: 这堂课讨论圣保禄的宗徒职分及其宣讲信仰的使命。

colloquial.mt: Elena: Xi tfisser il-kelma appostolat f'dan it-test? Pietru: Tfisser il-kariga ta' appostlu u l-missjoni marbuta magħha.
colloquial.en: Elena: What does the word appostolat mean in this text? Pietru: It means the office of an apostle and the mission associated with it.
colloquial.zh: 埃莱娜：这篇文章里的 appostolat 是什么意思？彼得：指宗徒的职分，以及与这个职分相联系的使命。

messages.speaker: Elena (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Xi tfisser il-kelma appostolat f'dan it-test?
messages.mt_standard: Xi tfisser il-kelma appostolat f'dan it-test?
messages.zh: 这篇文章里的 appostolat 是什么意思？
messages.en: What does the word appostolat mean in this text?

messages.speaker: Pietru (宗教课教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Tfisser il-kariga ta' appostlu u l-missjoni marbuta magħha.
messages.mt_standard: Tfisser il-kariga ta' appostlu u l-missjoni marbuta magħha.
messages.zh: 指宗徒的职分，以及与这个职分相联系的使命。
messages.en: It means the office of an apostle and the mission associated with it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把它记作宗教课里的“职分卡”：卡上写着宗徒的身份、职责与使命，帮助区分人物本人和其职分。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To make something Arabic in language or give it an Arabic cultural character.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使某事物在语言上采用阿拉伯语，或在文化特征上变得阿拉伯化。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Għamel xi ħaġa Għarbija fil-lingwa jew taha karattru kulturali Għarbi.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使阿拉伯化；使语言或文化形式采用阿拉伯语或阿拉伯特征。

collocations.zh: 他把这些名字阿拉伯化了
他使这套术语采用了阿拉伯语形式

formal.mt: Għall-edizzjoni bl-Għarbi, l-editur arabizza l-ismijiet tal-karattri biex jaqblu mal-ambjent il-ġdid tal-istorja.
formal.en: For the Arabic edition, the editor Arabized the characters' names to suit the story's new setting.
formal.zh: 为配合故事的新背景，编辑在阿拉伯语版本中把人物名字改成了阿拉伯语形式。

colloquial.mt: Nadia: Għaliex l-ismijiet huma differenti f'din il-verżjoni? Samir: L-editur arabizza l-ismijiet għall-qarrejja li jitkellmu bl-Għarbi.
colloquial.en: Nadia: Why are the names different in this version? Samir: The editor Arabized the names for Arabic-speaking readers.
colloquial.zh: 娜迪娅：为什么这个版本里的名字不一样？萨米尔：编辑为说阿拉伯语的读者把这些名字改成了阿拉伯语形式。

messages.speaker: Nadia (读者)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex l-ismijiet huma differenti f'din il-verżjoni?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex l-ismijiet huma differenti f'din il-verżjoni?
messages.zh: 为什么这个版本里的名字不一样？
messages.en: Why are the names different in this version?

messages.speaker: Samir (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: L-editur arabizza l-ismijiet għall-qarrejja li jitkellmu bl-Għarbi.
messages.mt_standard: L-editur arabizza l-ismijiet għall-qarrejja li jitkellmu bl-Għarbi.
messages.zh: 编辑为说阿拉伯语的读者把这些名字改成了阿拉伯语形式。
messages.en: The editor Arabized the names for Arabic-speaking readers.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象编辑把人物姓名逐个换成阿拉伯语形式，用“让某物变得阿拉伯化”的动作来记这个动词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A woody plant, usually smaller than a tree, with branches growing near the ground.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一种通常比树矮小、枝条从接近地面处生长的木本植物，即灌木。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Pjanta bi friegħi tal-injam li normalment tkun iżgħar minn siġra u tinfirex qrib l-art.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 灌木；灌木丛。

formal.mt: Il-pjan għall-ġnien jinkludi arbuxxell ħdejn id-daħla.
formal.en: The garden plan includes a shrub beside the entrance.
formal.zh: 花园规划包括在入口旁种一株灌木。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Fejn se nħawlu dan l-arbuxxell? Toni: Ħdejn il-ħajt, fejn hemm biżżejjed spazju.
colloquial.en: Maja: Where shall we plant this shrub? Toni: Beside the wall, where there is enough space.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这株灌木我们种在哪里？托尼：种在墙边吧，那里空间足够。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 这株灌木我们种在哪里？
messages.en: Where shall we plant this shrub?

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ħdejn il-ħajt, fejn hemm biżżejjed spazju.
messages.mt_standard: Ħdejn il-ħajt, fejn hemm biżżejjed spazju.
messages.zh: 种在墙边吧，那里空间足够。
messages.en: Beside the wall, where there is enough space.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 arbuxxell 配上一幅矮小、多枝的灌木图，再用“种一株灌木”的短语连着记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The chemical element argon, a colourless, odourless gas with the symbol Ar.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 化学元素氩，符号为 Ar，是一种无色无味的气体。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-element kimiku bis-simbolu Ar, li huwa gass bla kulur u bla riħa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 氩，化学元素名；气态时称氩气，元素符号为 Ar。

formal.mt: Ir-rapport tal-laboratorju jidentifika l-gass fil-kampjun bħala argon.
formal.en: The laboratory report identifies the gas in the sample as argon.
formal.zh: 实验室报告确认样品中的气体为氩气。

colloquial.mt: Sara: X'gass hemm f'dan iċ-ċilindru? David: Fuq it-tikketta hemm miktub argon.
colloquial.en: Sara: What gas is in this cylinder? David: The label says argon.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：这个气瓶里是什么气体？戴维：标签上写着氩气。

messages.speaker: Sara (实验课学生)
messages.zh: 这个气瓶里是什么气体？
messages.en: What gas is in this cylinder?

messages.speaker: David (实验课同学)
messages.zh: 标签上写着氩气。
messages.en: The label says argon.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象气瓶标签同时写着 argon、Ar 和“氩气”，用词形、元素符号和中文名称三项配对记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Inclined to argue, challenge what others say, or turn discussions into disputes.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 容易与人争辩、反驳他人或把讨论变成争执的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu t-tendenza li jargumenta, imieri lil ħaddieħor jew jibdel diskussjoni f'tilwima.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 爱争辩的；好争论的；动辄反驳他人的。

formal.mt: It-ton argumentuż tal-kelliem għamilha diffiċli għall-grupp biex jasal għal ftehim.
formal.en: The speaker's argumentative tone made it difficult for the group to reach an agreement.
formal.zh: 发言者好争辩的语气使小组难以达成共识。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex qed tkun daqshekk argumentuż illum? Mark: Għandek raġun, se nisma' x'għandek xi tgħid qabel inwieġeb.
colloquial.en: Lara: Why are you being so argumentative today? Mark: You are right; I will listen to what you have to say before I reply.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：你今天怎么这么爱争辩？马克：你说得对，我会先听你说完再回答。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex qed tkun daqshekk argumentuż illum?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex qed tkun daqshekk argumentuż illum?
messages.zh: 你今天怎么这么爱争辩？
messages.en: Why are you being so argumentative today?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandek raġun, se nisma' x'għandek xi tgħid qabel inwieġeb.
messages.mt_standard: Għandek raġun, se nisma' x'għandek xi tgħid qabel inwieġeb.
messages.zh: 你说得对，我会先听你说完再回答。

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 argumentuż 配上“别人说一句，他就反驳一句”的对话画面，记住它描述爱争辩的态度。

gloss_zh: 档案管理员；档案工作者

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person whose work is to organize, preserve, and help people access archival records.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 负责整理、保存档案，并协助人们查阅档案的专业人员。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li xogħolha hu li torganizza u tħares id-dokumenti f'arkivju u tgħin lin-nies jikkonsultawhom.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 档案管理员；从事档案整理、保存和查阅服务的人员。

collocations.zh: 档案管理员提供的帮助

formal.mt: L-arkivista ħejja lista tad-dokumenti biex jgħin lir-riċerkaturi jsibu l-materjal meħtieġ.
formal.en: The archivist prepared a list of documents to help researchers find the material they needed.
formal.zh: 档案管理员编制了一份文件清单，以帮助研究人员找到所需资料。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Qed infittex ittri antiki dwar dan ir-raħal. Pawlu: Staqsi lill-arkivista; jista' jgħinek issibhom.
colloquial.en: Nina: I am looking for old letters about this village. Pawlu: Ask the archivist; he can help you find them.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：我在找有关这个村庄的旧信件。保罗：问问档案管理员吧，他能帮你找到。

messages.speaker: Nina (查档者)
messages.mt_spoken: Qed infittex ittri antiki dwar dan ir-raħal.
messages.mt_standard: Qed infittex ittri antiki dwar dan ir-raħal.
messages.zh: 我在找有关这个村庄的旧信件。
messages.en: I am looking for old letters about this village.

messages.speaker: Pawlu (接待员)
messages.zh: 问问档案管理员吧，他能帮你找到。
messages.en: Ask the archivist; he can help you find them.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一位拿着目录、帮你寻找旧信件的工作人员，把 arkivista 与“管理档案的人”这一画面配对。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To place documents, records, or digital material in an archive for organized storage and later reference.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把文件、记录或数字资料归入档案，有序保存以供日后查阅。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Iqiegħed dokumenti, rekords jew materjal diġitali f'arkivju biex jinżammu organizzati u jkunu jistgħu jiġu kkonsultati aktar tard.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 把文件、记录或数字资料归档、存档，保存以供日后查阅。

formal.mt: Wara li tiċċekkja d-dati, arkivja d-dokumenti skont is-sena u s-suġġett.
formal.en: After checking the dates, archive the documents by year and subject.
formal.zh: 核对日期后，请按年份和主题将文件归档。

colloquial.mt: Sara: X'nagħmel b'dawn il-fajls qodma? David: Arkivja l-fajls li għad għandna bżonn, biex insibuhom aktar tard.
colloquial.en: Sara: What should I do with these old files? David: Archive the files we still need so we can find them later.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：这些旧文件该怎么处理？戴维：把我们仍然需要的文件存档，方便以后查找。

messages.speaker: Sara (同事)
messages.zh: 这些旧文件该怎么处理？
messages.en: What should I do with these old files?

messages.speaker: David (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Arkivja l-fajls li għad għandna bżonn, biex insibuhom aktar tard.
messages.mt_standard: Arkivja l-fajls li għad għandna bżonn, biex insibuhom aktar tard.
messages.zh: 把我们仍然需要的文件存档，方便以后查找。
messages.en: Archive the files we still need so we can find them later.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象把文件放进标有年份的档案盒，同时念 arkivja d-dokumenti，将“归档”动作与整句绑定记忆。

gloss_zh: 设备；街道装饰；搭设；武装

teaching_sense.en_definition: Equipment used for a purpose; also street decorations, the process of setting something up, or the act of arming.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用于某种用途的设备；也可指街道装饰、搭设的过程或武装的行为，具体含义由上下文决定。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tagħmir għal xi użu; ukoll tiżjin tat-toroq, ix-xogħol biex titwaqqaf xi ħaġa, jew l-għoti tal-armi.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 设备；装备
街道装饰；街道上的节庆布置
搭设；安装布置的过程
武装；配备武器的行为

collocations.en: the street decorations for the feast
the setting up of the stage

formal.mt: L-armar tal-palk għandu jitlesta qabel ma tibda l-prova.
formal.en: The setting up of the stage must be completed before the rehearsal begins.
formal.zh: 舞台的搭设必须在排练开始前完成。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Rajt l-armar il-ġdid fit-triq? Mark: Iva, it-triq tidher sabiħa għall-festa!
colloquial.en: Maja: Have you seen the new decorations in the street? Mark: Yes, the street looks lovely for the feast!
colloquial.zh: Maja：你看到街上新布置的装饰了吗？Mark：看到了，街道为节庆装扮得真漂亮！

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你看到街上新布置的装饰了吗？
messages.en: Have you seen the new decorations in the street?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 看到了，街道为节庆装扮得真漂亮！
messages.en: Yes, the street looks lovely for the feast!

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 armar 放进四幅画面记忆：仓库里的设备、节庆街道的装饰、正在搭设的舞台、领取武器的士兵；靠上下文选择词义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A keyboard instrument that produces sound by passing air over reeds.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 通过气流使簧片振动发声的键盘乐器，即簧风琴。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Strument mużikali bit-tastiera li jipproduċi l-ħoss meta l-arja tgħaddi minn fuq ilsna tal-metall.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 簧风琴，一种利用气流使簧片发声的键盘乐器

formal.mt: Matul il-kunċert, l-armoniju akkumpanja l-kant tal-kor.
formal.en: During the concert, the harmonium accompanied the choir's singing.
formal.zh: 音乐会上，簧风琴为合唱团的演唱伴奏。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'inhu dak l-istrument ħdejn it-tieqa? Mark: Dak armoniju. Trid tisma' kif idoqq?
colloquial.en: Maja: What is that instrument by the window? Mark: That's a harmonium. Would you like to hear what it sounds like?
colloquial.zh: Maja：窗边那个是什么乐器？Mark：那是簧风琴。你想听听它的声音吗？

messages.speaker: Maja (来访的朋友)
messages.zh: 窗边那个是什么乐器？
messages.en: What is that instrument by the window?

messages.speaker: Mark (乐器主人)
messages.mt_spoken: Dak armoniju. Trid tisma' kif idoqq?
messages.mt_standard: Dak armoniju. Trid tisma' kif idoqq?
messages.zh: 那是簧风琴。你想听听它的声音吗？
messages.en: That's a harmonium. Would you like to hear what it sounds like?

cognitive_memory_aid: 看到 armoniju，就想象双手按键、气流推动簧片的簧风琴；用“弹奏一件乐器”的画面记住它是名词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Pleasantly balanced or blended, especially in sound; melodious.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 各部分协调融合的；尤其指声音和谐、悦耳的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li fih il-partijiet jaqblu tajjeb flimkien, speċjalment fil-ħoss, u li jkun pjaċevoli biex tisimgħu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 和谐的；悦耳的；旋律优美的

formal.mt: Il-kant armonijuż tal-kor ta bidu għall-programm mużikali.
formal.en: The choir's melodious singing opened the musical programme.
formal.zh: 合唱团悦耳的歌声拉开了音乐节目的序幕。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Kemm hu armonijuż dan il-kant! Mark: Veru, l-ilħna jaqblu ħafna flimkien.
colloquial.en: Maja: This singing is so harmonious! Mark: It really is; the voices blend very well.
colloquial.zh: Maja：这歌声真和谐悦耳！Mark：确实，这些声音配合得特别好。

messages.speaker: Maja (听众)
messages.zh: 这歌声真和谐悦耳！
messages.en: This singing is so harmonious!

messages.speaker: Mark (同行的朋友)
messages.zh: 确实，这些声音配合得特别好。
messages.en: It really is; the voices blend very well.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 armonijuż 配在“声音、歌唱”旁边，想象几个声部融合得悦耳动听；记住它回答的是“声音怎么样”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: In terms of musical harmony or through the use of harmony.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 从音乐和声的角度；以运用和声的方式。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Mill-aspett tal-armonija mużikali jew permezz tal-użu tal-armonija.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 在和声上；从和声角度；以和声方式

collocations.zh: 从和声角度分析该乐段

formal.mt: Armonikament, is-silta hija sempliċi, iżda r-ritmu tagħha huwa kumpless.
formal.en: Harmonically, the passage is simple, but its rhythm is complex.
formal.zh: 从和声上看，这个乐段很简单，但它的节奏很复杂。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Kif inhi din is-silta armonikament? Mark: Hija sempliċi; għandha biss ftit kordi.
colloquial.en: Maja: What is this passage like harmonically? Mark: It's simple; it only has a few chords.
colloquial.zh: Maja：这个乐段在和声方面怎么样？Mark：很简单，只有几个和弦。

messages.speaker: Maja (音乐学生)
messages.zh: 这个乐段在和声方面怎么样？
messages.en: What is this passage like harmonically?

messages.speaker: Mark (音乐老师)
messages.mt_spoken: Hija sempliċi; għandha biss ftit kordi.
messages.mt_standard: Hija sempliċi; għandha biss ftit kordi.
messages.zh: 很简单，只有几个和弦。
messages.en: It's simple; it only has a few chords.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 armonikament 配一副“和声分析眼镜”：戴上它就只看和弦怎样配合。记住这是副词，表示分析角度或伴奏方式。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Very soft to the touch or easily yielding when pressed.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 触感非常柔软的，或轻轻按压就会凹下、变形的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jkun artab ħafna meta tmissu jew tagħfas fuqu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 非常柔软的；软绵绵的

formal.mt: Il-kuxxin huwa artab ħaxu u komdu biex tistrieħ fuqu.
formal.en: The cushion is very soft and comfortable to rest on.
formal.zh: 这个靠垫非常柔软，靠着休息很舒服。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Mess dan id-drapp, kemm hu artab ħaxu! Mark: Veru, nixtieq kutra bħalu.
colloquial.en: Maja: Feel this fabric; it's so soft! Mark: It really is; I'd like a blanket like it.
colloquial.zh: Maja：摸摸这块布，真是软绵绵的！Mark：确实，我想要一条这样的毯子。

messages.speaker: Maja (购物的朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Mess dan id-drapp, kemm hu artab ħaxu!
messages.mt_standard: Mess dan id-drapp, kemm hu artab ħaxu!
messages.zh: 摸摸这块布，真是软绵绵的！
messages.en: Feel this fabric; it's so soft!

messages.speaker: Mark (同行的朋友)
messages.zh: 确实，我想要一条这样的毯子。
messages.en: It really is; I'd like a blanket like it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 artab ħaxu 整体记成“手一按就陷下去的软绵绵”：同时联想靠垫、面包和布料，不必拆开逐字猜意思。

gloss_zh: 使动脉化；使具有动脉血性质

teaching_sense.en_definition: To make blood or tissue acquire arterial characteristics, especially by increasing the oxygen content of blood.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使血液或组织获得动脉性的特征，尤指通过增加血液含氧量使其具有动脉血性质。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jagħti lid-demm jew lit-tessut karatteristiċi arterjużi, speċjalment billi jiżdied l-ossiġnu fid-demm.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使动脉化；使血液或组织具有动脉性的特征

formal.mt: Fil-glossarju tal-fiżjoloġija, il-verb 'arterjalizza' jfisser li tagħti lid-demm jew lit-tessut karatteristiċi arterjużi.
formal.en: In the physiology glossary, the verb 'arterjalizza' means to give blood or tissue arterial characteristics.
formal.zh: 在生理学词汇表中，动词 arterjalizza 表示使血液或组织具有动脉性的特征。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Xi jfisser 'arterjalizza' f'dan it-test? Mark: Ifisser li tagħti lid-demm karatteristiċi arterjużi, pereżempju billi jiżdied l-ossiġnu fih.
colloquial.en: Maja: What does 'arterjalizza' mean in this text? Mark: It means to give blood arterial characteristics, for example by increasing its oxygen content.
colloquial.zh: Maja：这篇课文里的 arterjalizza 是什么意思？Mark：意思是使血液具有动脉血的性质，例如增加它的含氧量。

messages.speaker: Maja (生理学学生)
messages.zh: 这篇课文里的 arterjalizza 是什么意思？
messages.en: What does 'arterjalizza' mean in this text?

messages.speaker: Mark (生理学老师)
messages.mt_spoken: Ifisser li tagħti lid-demm karatteristiċi arterjużi, pereżempju billi jiżdied l-ossiġnu fih.
messages.mt_standard: Ifisser li tagħti lid-demm karatteristiċi arterjużi, pereżempju billi jiżdied l-ossiġnu fih.
messages.zh: 意思是使血液具有动脉血的性质，例如增加它的含氧量。
messages.en: It means to give blood arterial characteristics, for example by increasing its oxygen content.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 arterjalizza 记成带箭头的变化过程：“使某物获得动脉性特征”。箭头提醒你它是表示使之变化的动词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Relating to arteries or having the characteristics of arterial blood.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 与动脉有关的，或具有动脉血特征的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu x'jaqsam mal-arterji jew li għandu l-karatteristiċi tad-demm fl-arterji.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 动脉的；与动脉有关的；动脉性的

formal.mt: Id-dijagramma turi l-fluss arterjuż lejn it-tessuti.
formal.en: The diagram shows arterial flow towards the tissues.
formal.zh: 这幅图展示了流向组织的动脉血流。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Xi jfisser 'arterjuż' ħdejn il-kelma 'demm'? Mark: Juri li qed nitkellmu dwar demm fl-arterji.
colloquial.en: Maja: What does 'arterjuż' mean next to the word 'blood'? Mark: It shows that we are talking about blood in the arteries.
colloquial.zh: Maja：demm 这个词旁边的 arterjuż 是什么意思？Mark：它说明我们说的是动脉里的血液。

messages.speaker: Maja (生物课学生)
messages.zh: demm 这个词旁边的 arterjuż 是什么意思？
messages.en: What does 'arterjuż' mean next to the word 'blood'?

messages.speaker: Mark (生物课老师)
messages.mt_spoken: Juri li qed nitkellmu dwar demm fl-arterji.
messages.mt_standard: Juri li qed nitkellmu dwar demm fl-arterji.
messages.zh: 它说明我们说的是动脉里的血液。
messages.en: It shows that we are talking about blood in the arteries.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 arterjuż 当作贴在“血液、血流”旁的“动脉的”标签；标签只描述性质，帮助你记住它是形容词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The Jerusalem artichoke, Helianthus tuberosus, a plant grown for its edible underground tubers; also its tuber.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 菊芋，学名 Helianthus tuberosus，一种以可食用地下块茎为主要利用部分的植物；也指其块茎，俗称洋姜。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Pjanta msejħa Helianthus tuberosus li titkabbar għat-tuberi tagħha li jittieklu; ukoll it-tuberu ta' din il-pjanta.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 菊芋，学名 Helianthus tuberosus，俗称洋姜

formal.mt: Għal din is-soppa jintuża l-artiċokk, Helianthus tuberosus, imqaxxar u mqatta' f'biċċiet żgħar.
formal.en: This soup uses Jerusalem artichoke, Helianthus tuberosus, peeled and cut into small pieces.
formal.zh: 这道汤使用菊芋，即 Helianthus tuberosus，制作时将其去皮并切成小块。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'se nsajru bl-artiċokk illum? Mark: Nagħmlu soppa. Tista' tqaxxru waqt li nqatta' l-basla?
colloquial.en: Maja: What shall we cook with the Jerusalem artichoke today? Mark: Let's make soup. Can you peel it while I chop the onion?
colloquial.zh: Maja：今天我们用菊芋做什么？Mark：做汤吧。我切洋葱的时候，你能给菊芋去皮吗？

messages.speaker: Maja (一起做饭的朋友)
messages.zh: 今天我们用菊芋做什么？
messages.en: What shall we cook with the Jerusalem artichoke today?

messages.speaker: Mark (一起做饭的朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Nagħmlu soppa. Tista' tqaxxru waqt li nqatta' l-basla?
messages.mt_standard: Nagħmlu soppa. Tista' tqaxxru waqt li nqatta' l-basla?
messages.zh: 做汤吧。我切洋葱的时候，你能给菊芋去皮吗？
messages.en: Let's make soup. Can you peel it while I chop the onion?

cognitive_memory_aid: 本词条把 artiċokk 对应到菊芋：想象厨房里一块块洋姜被去皮、切块、煮汤，用食材和动作一起记住词义。

gloss_zh: 人马座（星座）；射手座（黄道星座）

teaching_sense.en_definition: The name Sagittarius, referring either to a constellation or to a zodiac sign.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: Sagittarius 的名称，可指天文学中的人马座，也可指占星术中的射手座。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Isem li jirreferi għall-kostellazzjoni jew għas-sinjal taż-żodijaku msejjaħ l-Arċier.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 人马座，天文学中的星座名称。
射手座，黄道十二星座之一的名称，用于占星语境。

formal.mt: Fit-test tal-astronomija, l-isem Arċier jirreferi għall-kostellazzjoni; fit-test tal-astroloġija, jirreferi għas-sinjal taż-żodijaku.
formal.en: In the astronomy text, the name Sagittarius refers to the constellation; in the astrology text, it refers to the zodiac sign.
formal.zh: 在天文学文本中，Arċier 指人马座；在占星术文本中，它指射手座。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Meta tgħid l-Arċier, qed titkellem dwar is-sinjal taż-żodijaku? Mark: Le, qed infittex il-kostellazzjoni fuq din il-mappa tas-sema.
colloquial.en: Lara: When you say Sagittarius, are you talking about the zodiac sign? Mark: No, I am looking for the constellation on this sky map.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：你说 Arċier，是在说射手座这个黄道星座吗？马克：不是，我正在这张星图上找人马座。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Meta tgħid l-Arċier, qed titkellem dwar is-sinjal taż-żodijaku?
messages.mt_standard: Meta tgħid l-Arċier, qed titkellem dwar is-sinjal taż-żodijaku?
messages.zh: 你说 Arċier，是在说射手座这个黄道星座吗？
messages.en: When you say Sagittarius, are you talking about the zodiac sign?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, qed infittex il-kostellazzjoni fuq din il-mappa tas-sema.
messages.mt_standard: Le, qed infittex il-kostellazzjoni fuq din il-mappa tas-sema.
messages.zh: 不是，我正在这张星图上找人马座。
messages.en: No, I am looking for the constellation on this sky map.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 Arċier 放在两张卡片上：星图卡写“人马座”，星座运势卡写“射手座”，靠语境区分两义。

gloss_zh: 总铎；享有总铎头衔的神父

teaching_sense.en_definition: A priest who holds the ecclesiastical title of archpriest.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 具有总铎这一教会头衔的神父。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Saċerdot li għandu t-titlu ekkleżjastiku ta' arċipriet.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 总铎，具有这一教会头衔的神父。

formal.mt: L-arċipriet indirizza lill-parteċipanti fil-bidu tal-laqgħa tal-parroċċa.
formal.en: The archpriest addressed the participants at the beginning of the parish meeting.
formal.zh: 总铎在堂区会议开始时向与会者致辞。

colloquial.mt: Anna: L-arċipriet se jkun hawn illum? Pawlu: Iva, tista' tkellmu wara l-laqgħa.
colloquial.en: Anna: Will the archpriest be here today? Pawlu: Yes, you can speak to him after the meeting.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：总铎今天会来这里吗？保罗：会，你可以在会议结束后和他谈谈。

messages.speaker: Anna (堂区教友)
messages.zh: 总铎今天会来这里吗？
messages.en: Will the archpriest be here today?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (堂区工作人员)
messages.zh: 会，你可以在会议结束后和他谈谈。
messages.en: Yes, you can speak to him after the meeting.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象堂区会议上写着“总铎”的座位牌，将 arċipriet 与这一神职头衔及会面场景一起记。

gloss_zh: 阿根廷人（通常指男性）；阿根廷的

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person from Argentina or an inhabitant of Argentina, usually a man.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 来自阿根廷或居住在阿根廷的人，通常指男性。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li ġejja mill-Arġentina jew li tgħix fiha, ġeneralment raġel.

sense_translations.en_definition: Argentinian (native or inhabitant of Argentina) (usually male)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 阿根廷人，即阿根廷本地人或居民，通常指男性。

sense_translations.en_definition: Argentinian (of, from or relating to Argentina)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 阿根廷的；来自阿根廷的；与阿根廷有关的。

collocations.en: an Argentinian man living in Malta
collocations.zh: 一名住在马耳他的阿根廷男子

formal.mt: Il-kelliem mistieden huwa Arġentin li qed jippreżenta studju dwar it-teatru arġentin.
formal.en: The guest speaker is an Argentinian man presenting a study of Argentinian theatre.
formal.zh: 受邀讲者是一名阿根廷男子，正在介绍一项关于阿根廷戏剧的研究。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Minn fejn hu l-ħabib tiegħek? Toni: Hu Arġentin, u bħalissa qed jgħix Malta.
colloquial.en: Maja: Where is your friend from? Toni: He is Argentinian, and he is currently living in Malta.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你的朋友是哪里人？托尼：他是阿根廷人，目前住在马耳他。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你的朋友是哪里人？
messages.en: Where is your friend from?

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Hu Arġentin, u bħalissa qed jgħix Malta.
messages.mt_standard: Hu Arġentin, u bħalissa qed jgħix Malta.
messages.zh: 他是阿根廷人，目前住在马耳他。
messages.en: He is Argentinian, and he is currently living in Malta.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两张图记词性：人物卡标 Arġentin“阿根廷人”，书本旁写 kittieb arġentin“阿根廷作家”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To cover a road or another surface with asphalt.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在道路或其他地面上铺设沥青。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kesa triq jew wiċċ ieħor b'saff ta' asfalt.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 给道路或地面铺沥青。

formal.mt: Il-kuntrattur asfalta t-triq wara li tlestew ix-xogħlijiet taħt l-art.
formal.en: The contractor asphalted the road after the underground works were completed.
formal.zh: 地下工程完成后，承包商给道路铺设了沥青。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex it-triq tidher differenti? Mark: Għax il-kuntrattur asfalta t-triq ilbieraħ.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why does the road look different? Mark: Because the contractor asphalted it yesterday.
colloquial.zh: Maja：这条路怎么看起来不一样了？Mark：因为承包商昨天给这条路铺了沥青。

messages.speaker: Maja (居民)
messages.zh: 这条路怎么看起来不一样了？
messages.en: Why does the road look different?

messages.speaker: Mark (邻居)
messages.zh: 因为承包商昨天给这条路铺了沥青。
messages.en: Because the contractor asphalted it yesterday.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象工人把黑色沥青铺在路面上，把 asfalta 与“铺沥青”这个动作一起记。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The work or process of covering a road or another surface with asphalt.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 给道路或其他地面铺设沥青的作业或过程。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ix-xogħol jew il-proċess li bih triq jew wiċċ ieħor jinkesa bl-asfalt.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 沥青铺设作业；给道路或地面铺沥青的过程。

formal.mt: It-triq se tingħalaq għat-traffiku waqt ix-xogħol ta' asfaltatura.
formal.en: The road will be closed to traffic during the asphalting work.
formal.zh: 进行沥青铺设作业期间，这条道路将禁止车辆通行。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex ma nistgħux ngħaddu minn hawn? Pawlu: Hemm xogħol ta' asfaltatura; ejja ngħaddu mit-triq l-oħra.
colloquial.en: Lara: Why can't we go through here? Pawlu: There's asphalting work going on; let's take the other road.
colloquial.zh: Lara：我们为什么不能从这里走？Pawlu：这里正在铺沥青，我们走另一条路吧。

messages.speaker: Lara (行人)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex ma nistgħux ngħaddu minn hawn?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex ma nistgħux ngħaddu minn hawn?
messages.zh: 我们为什么不能从这里走？
messages.en: Why can't we go through here?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Hemm xogħol ta' asfaltatura; ejja ngħaddu mit-triq l-oħra.
messages.mt_standard: Hemm xogħol ta' asfaltatura; ejja ngħaddu mit-triq l-oħra.
messages.zh: 这里正在铺沥青，我们走另一条路吧。
messages.en: There's asphalting work going on; let's take the other road.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 asfaltatura 放进道路施工告示的画面里记：它指“铺沥青这项作业或过程”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To cause someone to be unable to breathe because of a lack of oxygen.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使某人因缺氧而无法呼吸，即使其窒息。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ġiegħel lil xi ħadd jitlef il-ħila li jieħu n-nifs minħabba nuqqas ta' ossiġnu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使窒息；使因缺氧而无法呼吸。

formal.mt: Skont ir-rapport, id-duħħan asfissja lill-ħaddiem li kien fil-kamra.
formal.en: According to the report, the smoke asphyxiated the worker who was in the room.
formal.zh: 据报告，烟雾使当时身处房间内的工人窒息。

colloquial.mt: Sara: X'ġara lill-ħaddiem? David: Id-duħħan asfissja lill-ħaddiem, u ħaduh l-isptar.
colloquial.en: Sara: What happened to the worker? David: The smoke asphyxiated him, and he was taken to hospital.
colloquial.zh: Sara：那个工人怎么了？David：烟雾使他窒息了，后来他被送去了医院。

messages.speaker: Sara (同事)
messages.zh: 那个工人怎么了？
messages.en: What happened to the worker?

messages.speaker: David (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Id-duħħan asfissja lill-ħaddiem, u ħaduh l-isptar.
messages.mt_standard: Id-duħħan asfissja lill-ħaddiem, u ħaduh l-isptar.
messages.zh: 烟雾使他窒息了，后来他被送去了医院。
messages.en: The smoke asphyxiated him, and he was taken to hospital.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记住“烟雾使人无法呼吸”的因果画面：asfissja 在这里是动词，表示“使窒息”。

gloss_zh: 更难的；更痛苦的；更令人不快的

teaching_sense.en_definition: More difficult, more painful, or more unpleasant than something else.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 比较级形容词，表示比另一事物更困难、更痛苦或更令人不快。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Aġġettiv fil-komparattiv li jfisser aktar diffiċli, aktar ta' wġigħ jew aktar spjaċevoli minn ħaġa oħra.

sense_translations.en_definition: comparative. More painful; harder, more difficult, more disagreeable
sense_translations.zh_definition: 比较级：更痛苦的；更艰难、更困难的；更令人不快的。

formal.mt: Dan l-eżerċizzju huwa asgħab minn dak ta' qabel u jeħtieġ aktar ħin.
formal.en: This exercise is harder than the previous one and requires more time.
formal.zh: 这道练习比上一道更难，需要更多时间。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Dan l-eżerċizzju asgħab minn tal-bieraħ! Mark: Iva, imma nistgħu nagħmluh flimkien.
colloquial.en: Nina: This exercise is harder than yesterday's! Mark: Yes, but we can do it together.
colloquial.zh: Nina：这道练习比昨天的更难！Mark：是啊，不过我们可以一起做。

messages.speaker: Nina (同学)
messages.zh: 这道练习比昨天的更难！
messages.en: This exercise is harder than yesterday's!

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.zh: 是啊，不过我们可以一起做。
messages.en: Yes, but we can do it together.

cognitive_memory_aid: 在练习旁画一个向上的难度箭头，提醒自己 asgħab 自带“更”的比较含义，也可形容更痛苦或更不愉快。

gloss_zh: 阿斯马拉（厄立特里亚首都）

teaching_sense.en_definition: Asmara, the capital city of Eritrea.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 阿斯马拉，厄立特里亚的首都；作为城市专名使用。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Asmara, il-belt kapitali tal-Eritrea.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 阿斯马拉，厄立特里亚的首都。

formal.mt: Asmara hija l-belt kapitali tal-Eritrea.
formal.en: Asmara is the capital city of Eritrea.
formal.zh: 阿斯马拉是厄立特里亚的首都。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Fejn sejra għall-vaganza? Maja: Se mmur Asmara, il-kapitali tal-Eritrea.
colloquial.en: Lara: Where are you going on holiday? Maja: I'm going to Asmara, the capital of Eritrea.
colloquial.zh: Lara：你要去哪里度假？Maja：我要去阿斯马拉，厄立特里亚的首都。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 你要去哪里度假？
messages.en: Where are you going on holiday?

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 我要去阿斯马拉，厄立特里亚的首都。
messages.en: I'm going to Asmara, the capital of Eritrea.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 Asmara、阿斯马拉和“厄立特里亚首都”写在同一张地图卡片上，并记住城市名首字母大写。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A task or piece of work given to someone to carry out.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 交给某人执行的任务或工作。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kompitu jew xogħol mogħti lil xi ħadd biex iwettqu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 任务或工作的指派、分派；所指派的任务。

formal.mt: Kull impjegat irċieva assenjament ta' xogħol b'data ċara għat-tlestija.
formal.en: Each employee received a work assignment with a clear completion date.
formal.zh: 每位员工都收到了一项工作任务，并有明确的完成日期。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Lestejt l-assenjament li tak il-maniġer? Sara: Għadni le; se nlestih wara nofsinhar.
colloquial.en: Mark: Have you finished the assignment the manager gave you? Sara: Not yet; I'll finish it this afternoon.
colloquial.zh: Mark：经理交给你的任务完成了吗？Sara：还没有，我今天下午会完成。

messages.speaker: Mark (同事)
messages.zh: 经理交给你的任务完成了吗？
messages.en: Have you finished the assignment the manager gave you?

messages.speaker: Sara (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Għadni le; se nlestih wara nofsinhar.
messages.mt_standard: Għadni le; se nlestih wara nofsinhar.
messages.zh: 还没有，我今天下午会完成。
messages.en: Not yet; I'll finish it this afternoon.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象经理递来一张任务单，上面写着 assenjament：抓住“交给某人去完成的工作”这个核心意思。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act or process of assigning or allocating resources, places, or responsibilities.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把资源、名额或职责分派给特定对象的行为或过程。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att jew il-proċess li bih jitqassmu riżorsi, postijiet jew responsabbiltajiet lil persuni jew gruppi.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 指派、分派；资源、名额等的分配或配给。

formal.mt: Il-kumitat approva l-assenjazzjoni ta' fondi lill-proġetti magħżula.
formal.en: The committee approved the allocation of funds to the selected projects.
formal.zh: 委员会批准了向入选项目分配资金的方案。

colloquial.mt: Pawlu: Diġà saret l-assenjazzjoni tal-postijiet fil-kors? Nina: Iva, u jien sibt post.
colloquial.en: Pawlu: Have the places on the course been allocated yet? Nina: Yes, and I got a place.
colloquial.zh: Pawlu：课程的名额已经分配了吗？Nina：是的，而且我分到了一个名额。

messages.speaker: Pawlu (申请人)
messages.zh: 课程的名额已经分配了吗？
messages.en: Have the places on the course been allocated yet?

messages.speaker: Nina (同学)
messages.zh: 是的，而且我分到了一个名额。
messages.en: Yes, and I got a place.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象把有限的资金或名额分进不同格子：assenjazzjoni 强调“分配这件事”，可用资金分配的画面记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Wormwood, the plant known scientifically as Artemisia absinthium.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 苦艾，学名为 Artemisia absinthium 的植物。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-pjanta magħrufa bl-isem xjentifiku Artemisia absinthium.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 苦艾，学名 Artemisia absinthium。

formal.mt: It-tikketta ħdejn il-pjanta tal-assenzju turi l-isem xjentifiku Artemisia absinthium.
formal.en: The label beside the wormwood plant shows the scientific name Artemisia absinthium.
formal.zh: 苦艾植株旁的标签标示着学名 Artemisia absinthium。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'jisimha din il-pjanta? David: Din pjanta tal-assenzju; isimha hemm fuq it-tikketta.
colloquial.en: Maja: What is this plant called? David: This is a wormwood plant; its name is there on the label.
colloquial.zh: Maja：这株植物叫什么？David：这是苦艾，标签上写着它的名字。

messages.speaker: Maja (游客)
messages.zh: 这株植物叫什么？
messages.en: What is this plant called?

messages.speaker: David (园艺师)
messages.mt_spoken: Din pjanta tal-assenzju; isimha hemm fuq it-tikketta.
messages.mt_standard: Din pjanta tal-assenzju; isimha hemm fuq it-tikketta.
messages.zh: 这是苦艾，标签上写着它的名字。
messages.en: This is a wormwood plant; its name is there on the label.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给苦艾的植物图片配上 assenzju 标签，再把中文“苦艾”和学名一起读，建立词语与植物的直接联系。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Lines used as references for measuring positions or showing values on a graph; plural of axis.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用来确定位置或在图表中表示数值的基准线；这里是“轴”的复数形式。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Linji ta' referenza li jintużaw biex juru pożizzjonijiet jew valuri fuq graff.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 轴；坐标轴（复数）

formal.mt: Qabel ma tpinġi l-graff, ikteb l-ismijiet u l-unitajiet fuq iż-żewġ assi.
formal.en: Before drawing the graph, write the labels and units on both axes.
formal.zh: 绘制图表之前，请在两条坐标轴上标明名称和单位。

colloquial.mt: Lara: X'għandi nikteb fuq l-assi? Pawlu: Ikteb il-ħin fuq l-assi orizzontali u d-distanza fuq l-assi vertikali.
colloquial.en: Lara: What should I write on the axes? Pawlu: Put time on the horizontal axis and distance on the vertical axis.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：坐标轴上应该写什么？保罗：横轴写时间，纵轴写距离。

messages.speaker: Lara (学生)
messages.zh: 坐标轴上应该写什么？
messages.en: What should I write on the axes?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Ikteb il-ħin fuq l-assi orizzontali u d-distanza fuq l-assi vertikali.
messages.mt_standard: Ikteb il-ħin fuq l-assi orizzontali u d-distanza fuq l-assi vertikali.
messages.zh: 横轴写时间，纵轴写距离。
messages.en: Put time on the horizontal axis and distance on the vertical axis.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 assi 放进画图场景：先画横竖两条坐标轴，再标时间和距离，借“两条轴”的画面记住这里的复数义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The process by which something becomes more similar to, or integrated with, something else, as in culture or speech sounds.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 某事物逐渐与另一事物变得相似或融为一体的过程，可用于文化或语音等语境。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Proċess li bih xi ħaġa ssir aktar simili għal oħra jew tingħaqad magħha, bħal fil-kultura jew fil-ħsejjes tad-diskors.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 同化；逐渐趋同或融入的过程

formal.mt: L-istudju jeżamina l-assimilazzjoni kulturali u l-bidliet fid-drawwiet tal-komunità.
formal.en: The study examines cultural assimilation and changes in the community's customs.
formal.zh: 这项研究考察文化同化以及该社群习俗的变化。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'inhi l-assimilazzjoni tal-ħsejjes? Mark: Meta ħoss isir aktar simili għal ħoss ieħor qrib tiegħu.
colloquial.en: Maja: What is assimilation of speech sounds? Mark: It is when a sound becomes more similar to another sound near it.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：什么是语音同化？马克：就是一个音变得更像它附近的另一个音。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.zh: 什么是语音同化？
messages.en: What is assimilation of speech sounds?

messages.speaker: Mark (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Meta ħoss isir aktar simili għal ħoss ieħor qrib tiegħu.
messages.mt_standard: Meta ħoss isir aktar simili għal ħoss ieħor qrib tiegħu.
messages.zh: 就是一个音变得更像它附近的另一个音。
messages.en: It is when a sound becomes more similar to another sound near it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象相邻的两个声音逐渐变得相像，用“靠近以后更相似”的画面记住 assimilazzjoni 的同化义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The formal forgiveness of sins, especially forgiveness pronounced by a priest.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 对罪的正式赦免，尤其指由神父宣告的赦罪。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-maħfra tad-dnubiet, speċjalment dik mogħtija minn saċerdot fil-qrar.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 赦罪；罪的赦免，尤指宗教仪式中的赦免

formal.mt: Wara l-qrar, is-saċerdot ta l-assoluzzjoni lill-persuna li kienet stqarret dnubietha.
formal.en: After the confession, the priest granted absolution to the person who had confessed their sins.
formal.zh: 告解之后，神父赦免了那位告明己罪者的罪。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Xi tfisser assoluzzjoni f'dan it-test? David: Tfisser il-maħfra tad-dnubiet li jagħti s-saċerdot fil-qrar.
colloquial.en: Anna: What does absolution mean in this text? David: It means the forgiveness of sins granted by the priest during confession.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：这篇文章里的 assoluzzjoni 是什么意思？戴维：指神父在告解中给予的罪的赦免。

messages.speaker: Anna (学生)
messages.zh: 这篇文章里的 assoluzzjoni 是什么意思？
messages.en: What does absolution mean in this text?

messages.speaker: David (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Tfisser il-maħfra tad-dnubiet li jagħti s-saċerdot fil-qrar.
messages.mt_standard: Tfisser il-maħfra tad-dnubiet li jagħti s-saċerdot fil-qrar.
messages.zh: 指神父在告解中给予的罪的赦免。
messages.en: It means the forgiveness of sins granted by the priest during confession.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 assoluzzjoni 与“告解之后领受赦罪”的完整场景相连，再用“给予赦罪、领受赦罪”两组搭配巩固记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The process of taking a substance, such as water, into another material or into the body.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 水等物质进入另一种材料或进入身体的过程，即吸收。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-proċess li bih sustanza, bħall-ilma, tidħol f'materjal ieħor jew fil-ġisem.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 吸收；物质被吸入的过程

formal.mt: L-esperiment qabbel ir-rata ta' assorbiment tal-ilma f'żewġ tipi ta' karta.
formal.en: The experiment compared the rate of water absorption in two types of paper.
formal.zh: 该实验比较了两种纸的吸水速率。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għaliex qed tpoġġi l-karta fl-ilma? Luqa: Biex inqabbel l-assorbiment ta' din il-karta ma' dak tal-oħra.
colloquial.en: Sara: Why are you putting the paper in water? Luqa: To compare the absorption of this paper with that of the other one.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：你为什么把纸放进水里？卢卡：为了比较这张纸和另一张纸的吸水情况。

messages.speaker: Sara (同学)
messages.zh: 你为什么把纸放进水里？
messages.en: Why are you putting the paper in water?

messages.speaker: Luqa (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Biex inqabbel l-assorbiment ta' din il-karta ma' dak tal-oħra.
messages.mt_standard: Biex inqabbel l-assorbiment ta' din il-karta ma' dak tal-oħra.
messages.zh: 为了比较这张纸和另一张纸的吸水情况。
messages.en: To compare the absorption of this paper with that of the other one.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象纸巾慢慢吸进一滩水，把整个“吸收过程”标成 assorbiment；这个词是名词，可搭配“速率”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To take a substance, such as water, into a material or into the body.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把水等物质吸入某种材料或身体之中。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jieħu fih sustanza, bħall-ilma, u jdaħħalha fil-materjal jew fil-ġisem.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 吸收；将某种物质吸入内部

formal.mt: Matul l-esperiment, il-materjal assorbixxa l-ilma li tferra' fuqu.
formal.en: During the experiment, the material absorbed the water poured onto it.
formal.zh: 实验过程中，这种材料吸收了倒在其表面的水。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Fejn mar l-ilma li kien fuq il-mejda? Toni: Id-drapp assorbixxa l-ilma kollu.
colloquial.en: Nina: Where did the water on the table go? Toni: The cloth absorbed all the water.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：桌上的水去哪儿了？托尼：布把水全吸收了。

messages.speaker: Nina (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Fejn mar l-ilma li kien fuq il-mejda?
messages.mt_standard: Fejn mar l-ilma li kien fuq il-mejda?
messages.zh: 桌上的水去哪儿了？
messages.en: Where did the water on the table go?

messages.speaker: Toni (室友)
messages.zh: 布把水全吸收了。
messages.en: The cloth absorbed all the water.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“布把水吸收了”记住 assorbixxa 的动作义；再与名词 assorbiment 配对，一个讲吸收动作，一个讲吸收过程。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The chemical element called astatine in English.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 化学元素砹，英语名称为 astatine。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-element kimiku li bl-Ingliż jissejjaħ astatine.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 砹（化学元素）

formal.mt: Għall-preżentazzjoni tax-xjenza, l-istudenta għażlet l-astat u ħejjiet deskrizzjoni tal-proprjetajiet tiegħu.
formal.en: For the science presentation, the student chose astatine and prepared a description of its properties.
formal.zh: 为了科学课展示，这位学生选择了砹，并准备了一份关于其性质的介绍。

colloquial.mt: Emma: Liema element għażilt għall-preżentazzjoni? Adam: Għażilt l-astat. Se nitkellem dwar il-proprjetajiet tiegħu.
colloquial.en: Emma: Which element did you choose for the presentation? Adam: I chose astatine. I will talk about its properties.
colloquial.zh: 艾玛：你选了哪种元素做展示？亚当：我选了砹，准备介绍它的性质。

messages.speaker: Emma (同学)
messages.zh: 你选了哪种元素做展示？
messages.en: Which element did you choose for the presentation?

messages.speaker: Adam (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Għażilt l-astat. Se nitkellem dwar il-proprjetajiet tiegħu.
messages.mt_standard: Għażilt l-astat. Se nitkellem dwar il-proprjetajiet tiegħu.
messages.zh: 我选了砹，准备介绍它的性质。
messages.en: I chose astatine. I will talk about its properties.

cognitive_memory_aid: 制作一张三语元素卡：正面写 astat，背面写“砹、astatine”，用同一张卡把三个名称连起来记。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To deliberately refrain from doing or consuming something, or to choose not to vote.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 有意克制自己，不做某事或不摄入某物；也指在表决时弃权。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jagħżel li ma jagħmilx xi ħaġa, li ma jikkunsmax xi ħaġa, jew li ma jivvotax.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 自愿不做某事；戒除；在表决中弃权

formal.mt: Il-membru tal-kumitat astjena mill-votazzjoni dwar il-proposta.
formal.en: The committee member abstained from voting on the proposal.
formal.zh: 这位委员会成员在该提案的表决中弃权了。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Mark ivvota favur jew kontra? Ġanni: La favur u lanqas kontra; astjena.
colloquial.en: Rita: Did Mark vote for or against? Ġanni: Neither for nor against; he abstained.
colloquial.zh: 丽塔：马克投了赞成票还是反对票？詹尼：都没有，他弃权了。

messages.speaker: Rita (委员会成员)
messages.zh: 马克投了赞成票还是反对票？
messages.en: Did Mark vote for or against?

messages.speaker: Ġanni (委员会成员)
messages.mt_spoken: La favur u lanqas kontra; astjena.
messages.mt_standard: La favur u lanqas kontra; astjena.
messages.zh: 都没有，他弃权了。
messages.en: Neither for nor against; he abstained.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象表决时双手放下，主动选择不投票：astjena；再把“不投票”扩展到“不饮酒”等自愿克制的场景。

teaching_sense.en_definition: In terms of general ideas rather than particular objects, examples, or situations.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 从一般概念或原则出发，而不涉及具体事物、例子或情境地。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: B'mod li jittratta ideat ġenerali aktar milli affarijiet, eżempji jew sitwazzjonijiet konkreti.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 抽象地；在一般概念层面上

formal.mt: L-awtur jiddiskuti l-ġustizzja astrattament, mingħajr ma jirreferi għal każ partikolari.
formal.en: The author discusses justice abstractly, without referring to a particular case.
formal.zh: 作者从抽象层面讨论正义，没有涉及某个具体案例。

colloquial.mt: Marta: Meta titkellem astrattament, insibha diffiċli nifhem. Tista' tagħtini eżempju? Daniel: Żgur. Ejja nieħdu sitwazzjoni mill-ħajja ta' kuljum.
colloquial.en: Marta: When you speak abstractly, I find it hard to understand. Can you give me an example? Daniel: Of course. Let's take a situation from everyday life.
colloquial.zh: 玛尔塔：你抽象地讲时，我不太容易理解。能举个例子吗？丹尼尔：当然，我们拿日常生活中的一个情境来说。

messages.speaker: Marta (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Meta titkellem astrattament, insibha diffiċli nifhem. Tista' tagħtini eżempju?
messages.mt_standard: Meta titkellem astrattament, insibha diffiċli nifhem. Tista' tagħtini eżempju?
messages.zh: 你抽象地讲时，我不太容易理解。能举个例子吗？
messages.en: When you speak abstractly, I find it hard to understand. Can you give me an example?

messages.speaker: Daniel (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Żgur. Ejja nieħdu sitwazzjoni mill-ħajja ta' kuljum.
messages.mt_standard: Żgur. Ejja nieħdu sitwazzjoni mill-ħajja ta' kuljum.
messages.zh: 当然，我们拿日常生活中的一个情境来说。
messages.en: Of course. Let's take a situation from everyday life.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把“只谈一般概念，还没举具体例子”的讲解方式标成 astrattament；它说明思考或说话的方式，记作副词“抽象地”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An approach to art that uses colours, lines and shapes without directly representing recognisable objects.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 主要运用色彩、线条和形状，而不直接描绘可辨认物体的艺术取向或艺术形式。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Stil fl-arti li juża kuluri, linji u forom mingħajr ma jirrappreżenta direttament oġġetti li jintgħarfu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 抽象主义：强调以色彩、线条和形式进行表达的艺术取向。
抽象艺术：不以直接再现具体物体为主要目的的艺术。

formal.mt: Il-wirja tesplora l-astrattiżmu permezz ta' pitturi li jenfasizzaw il-kulur u l-forma.
formal.en: The exhibition explores abstractionism through paintings that emphasise colour and form.
formal.zh: 这场展览通过强调色彩与形式的绘画来探讨抽象主义。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Din il-pittura ma turix oġġett ċar. Mark: Iva, hija eżempju ta' astrattiżmu; ħares lejn il-kuluri u l-forom.
colloquial.en: Maja: This painting doesn't show a clear object. Mark: Yes, it's an example of abstract art; look at the colours and shapes.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这幅画没有画出明确的物体。马克：对，这是抽象艺术的例子；看看那些色彩和形状。

messages.speaker: Maja (参观者)
messages.mt_spoken: Din il-pittura ma turix oġġett ċar.
messages.mt_standard: Din il-pittura ma turix oġġett ċar.
messages.zh: 这幅画没有画出明确的物体。
messages.en: This painting doesn't show a clear object.

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, hija eżempju ta' astrattiżmu; ħares lejn il-kuluri u l-forom.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, hija eżempju ta' astrattiżmu; ħares lejn il-kuluri u l-forom.
messages.zh: 对，这是抽象艺术的例子；看看那些色彩和形状。
messages.en: Yes, it's an example of abstract art; look at the colours and shapes.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一幅只有色块和线条的画，把 astrattiżmu 与“抽象主义、抽象艺术”一起记。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The process of focusing on general or essential features while leaving out particular details, or an idea formed in this way.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 略去具体细节、提取一般或本质特征的过程，也指由此形成的抽象概念。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-proċess li tiffoka fuq il-karatteristiċi ġenerali jew essenzjali u tħalli barra d-dettalji partikolari, jew idea ffurmata b'dan il-mod.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 抽象；抽象化：从具体事物中提取共同或本质特征的过程，也指形成的抽象概念。

formal.mt: Permezz tal-astrazzjoni, l-istudenti jidentifikaw il-karatteristiċi komuni ta' diversi oġġetti.
formal.en: Through abstraction, students identify the features shared by several objects.
formal.zh: 通过抽象化，学生识别出多个物体共有的特征。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex qed inħallu barra dawn id-dettalji? Pawlu: Din hija astrazzjoni: qed inżommu biss dak li hu essenzjali.
colloquial.en: Lara: Why are we leaving out these details? Pawlu: This is abstraction: we're keeping only what is essential.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：我们为什么略去这些细节？保罗：这就是抽象化：我们只保留本质的内容。

messages.speaker: Lara (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex qed inħallu barra dawn id-dettalji?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex qed inħallu barra dawn id-dettalji?
messages.zh: 我们为什么略去这些细节？
messages.en: Why are we leaving out these details?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Din hija astrazzjoni: qed inżommu biss dak li hu essenzjali.
messages.mt_standard: Din hija astrazzjoni: qed inżommu biss dak li hu essenzjali.
messages.zh: 这就是抽象化：我们只保留本质的内容。
messages.en: This is abstraction: we're keeping only what is essential.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把苹果、梨和橙子的细节擦掉，只留下“水果”这个共同概念，用这一步记住 astrazzjoni。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who interprets the positions of stars and planets to make claims about people's personalities or future events.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 解读恒星和行星的位置，并据此对人的性格或未来事件作出判断或预测的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li tinterpreta l-pożizzjonijiet tal-kwiekeb u tal-pjaneti biex tagħmel tbassir jew tiddeskrivi l-karattru tan-nies.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 占星师：根据星体位置解释人的性格或预测未来的人。

formal.mt: L-artiklu jiddeskrivi kif astrologu jinterpreta l-pożizzjonijiet tal-pjaneti biex jagħmel tbassir.
formal.en: The article describes how an astrologer interprets the positions of the planets to make predictions.
formal.zh: 这篇文章描述了占星师如何解读行星位置来作出预测。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Min kiteb dan l-oroskopju? Nina: Astrologu; jien naqrah biss għall-gost.
colloquial.en: Sara: Who wrote this horoscope? Nina: An astrologer; I only read it for fun.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：这段星座运势是谁写的？妮娜：一位占星师；我读它只是为了消遣。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 这段星座运势是谁写的？
messages.en: Who wrote this horoscope?

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.zh: 一位占星师；我读它只是为了消遣。
messages.en: An astrologer; I only read it for fun.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一个人看着星盘讲星座运势，把 astrologu 记作“做占星解读的人”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A mark or sign left by someone or something, especially a footprint showing where a person has stepped.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 人或物留下的痕迹或迹象，尤其指脚踩过后留下的足迹。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Marka jew sinjal li jħalli xi ħadd jew xi ħaġa, speċjalment marka ta' sieq li turi fejn għaddiet persuna.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 痕迹；踪迹：人或物经过、存在或活动后留下的迹象。
足迹；脚印：脚踩过某处后留下的印迹。

formal.mt: L-atar ta' sieq fit-tajn indika li xi ħadd kien għadda minn hemm.
formal.en: The footprint in the mud indicated that someone had passed that way.
formal.zh: 泥地里的脚印表明有人从那里经过。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Ara dan l-atar fir-ramel! Mark: Qisu atar ta' sieq; xi ħadd għadda minn hawn.
colloquial.en: Maja: Look at this mark in the sand! Mark: It looks like a footprint; someone passed through here.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：看沙地上的这个痕迹！马克：像个脚印；有人从这里经过。

messages.speaker: Maja (散步者)
messages.zh: 看沙地上的这个痕迹！
messages.en: Look at this mark in the sand!

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Qisu atar ta' sieq; xi ħadd għadda minn hawn.
messages.mt_standard: Qisu atar ta' sieq; xi ħadd għadda minn hawn.
messages.zh: 像个脚印；有人从这里经过。
messages.en: It looks like a footprint; someone passed through here.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象人已经走远，沙地上还留着一个脚印，用“留下的痕迹”同时串起 atar 的两个义项。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To break a substance, especially a liquid, into very fine particles or droplets.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使某种物质，尤其是液体，分散成极细的颗粒或液滴。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jifred sustanza, speċjalment likwidu, fi frak jew qtar fin ħafna.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使雾化；使分散成极细的微粒或液滴。

formal.mt: Waqt it-test, l-apparat atomizza l-likwidu fi qtar fin ħafna.
formal.en: During the test, the device atomized the liquid into very fine droplets.
formal.zh: 测试期间，设备将液体雾化成了极细的液滴。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Għaliex ħareġ bħal ċpar? Lara: Għax l-apparat atomizza l-ilma fi qtar żgħir ħafna.
colloquial.en: Mark: Why did it come out like mist? Lara: Because the device atomized the water into very small droplets.
colloquial.zh: 马克：为什么喷出来像雾一样？拉拉：因为设备把水雾化成了非常小的液滴。

messages.speaker: Mark (学员)
messages.zh: 为什么喷出来像雾一样？
messages.en: Why did it come out like mist?

messages.speaker: Lara (指导员)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax l-apparat atomizza l-ilma fi qtar żgħir ħafna.
messages.mt_standard: Għax l-apparat atomizza l-ilma fi qtar żgħir ħafna.
messages.zh: 因为设备把水雾化成了非常小的液滴。
messages.en: Because the device atomized the water into very small droplets.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象喷头把一股水变成细雾，用“液体变成小液滴”这个动作记住动词 atomizza。

gloss_zh: 原子性；分子中的原子数

teaching_sense.en_definition: In chemistry, the number of atoms that make up a molecule.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在化学中，指构成一个分子的原子总数。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Fil-kimika, in-numru ta' atomi li jiffurmaw molekula.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 原子性；在化学语境中指一个分子所含的原子总数。

collocations.zh: 确定分子所含的原子数

formal.mt: L-atomiċità tal-molekula tal-ilma hija tlieta, għax fiha żewġ atomi tal-idroġenu u atomu wieħed tal-ossiġnu.
formal.en: The atomicity of a water molecule is three because it contains two hydrogen atoms and one oxygen atom.
formal.zh: 水分子的原子数是三，因为它含有两个氢原子和一个氧原子。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Kif insib l-atomiċità ta' din il-molekula? Pawlu: Għodd l-atomi kollha li hemm fiha.
colloquial.en: Lara: How do I find the atomicity of this molecule? Pawlu: Count all the atoms it contains.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：怎样求这个分子的原子数？保罗：把它含有的所有原子数一遍。

messages.speaker: Lara (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Kif insib l-atomiċità ta' din il-molekula?
messages.mt_standard: Kif insib l-atomiċità ta' din il-molekula?
messages.zh: 怎样求这个分子的原子数？
messages.en: How do I find the atomicity of this molecule?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Għodd l-atomi kollha li hemm fiha.
messages.mt_standard: Għodd l-atomi kollha li hemm fiha.
messages.zh: 把它含有的所有原子数一遍。
messages.en: Count all the atoms it contains.

cognitive_memory_aid: 看到 atomiċità，就在脑中给一个分子里的原子逐个点名；水分子是二加一，共三个。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The philosophical theory that matter consists of tiny indivisible units called atoms.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 认为物质由称为原子的微小、不可分割单位构成的哲学理论。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Teorija filosofika li tgħid li l-materja hija magħmula minn unitajiet żgħar u indiviżibbli msejħa atomi.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 原子论：认为物质由微小、不可分割的基本单位构成的哲学学说。

formal.mt: Il-kapitlu jippreżenta l-atomiżmu bħala teorija filosofika dwar il-kompożizzjoni tal-materja.
formal.en: The chapter presents atomism as a philosophical theory about the composition of matter.
formal.zh: 本章将原子论作为一种探讨物质构成的哲学理论加以介绍。

colloquial.mt: Sara: X'jgħid l-atomiżmu dwar il-materja? Nina: Li hija magħmula minn unitajiet żgħar u indiviżibbli msejħa atomi.
colloquial.en: Sara: What does atomism say about matter? Nina: That it is made of tiny indivisible units called atoms.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：原子论怎样解释物质？妮娜：它认为物质由称为原子的微小、不可分割单位组成。

messages.speaker: Sara (学生)
messages.zh: 原子论怎样解释物质？
messages.en: What does atomism say about matter?

messages.speaker: Nina (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Li hija magħmula minn unitajiet żgħar u indiviżibbli msejħa atomi.
messages.mt_standard: Li hija magħmula minn unitajiet żgħar u indiviżibbli msejħa atomi.
messages.zh: 它认为物质由称为原子的微小、不可分割单位组成。
messages.en: That it is made of tiny indivisible units called atoms.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 atomiżmu 想成写在哲学课黑板上的一种学说：“物质由微小基本单位组成”，用整句记住原子论。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A reduction in the size or substance of a muscle, organ or tissue, often associated with disease or lack of use.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 肌肉、器官或组织的体积或实质减少，常与疾病或缺乏使用有关。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tnaqqis fid-daqs jew fil-massa ta' muskolu, organu jew tessut, spiss marbut ma' mard jew nuqqas ta' użu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 萎缩：肌肉、器官或组织的体积或实质减少。

formal.mt: It-test jispjega li nuqqas fit-tul ta' moviment jista' jwassal għal atrofija tal-muskoli.
formal.en: The text explains that a prolonged lack of movement can lead to muscle atrophy.
formal.zh: 课文解释说，长期缺乏活动可能导致肌肉萎缩。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Xi tfisser atrofija tal-muskoli? Pawlu: Tfisser li l-muskoli jitilfu mill-massa tagħhom u jiċkienu.
colloquial.en: Maja: What does muscle atrophy mean? Pawlu: It means that muscles lose some of their mass and become smaller.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：肌肉萎缩是什么意思？保罗：意思是肌肉的质量减少，体积变小。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.zh: 肌肉萎缩是什么意思？
messages.en: What does muscle atrophy mean?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Tfisser li l-muskoli jitilfu mill-massa tagħhom u jiċkienu.
messages.mt_standard: Tfisser li l-muskoli jitilfu mill-massa tagħhom u jiċkienu.
messages.zh: 意思是肌肉的质量减少，体积变小。
messages.en: It means that muscles lose some of their mass and become smaller.

cognitive_memory_aid: 脑中并排放两幅肌肉示意图，一幅饱满、一幅变细，把“组织变小、质量减少”与 atrofija 相连。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Describing tissue or an organ that has become smaller or wasted through atrophy.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容组织或器官发生萎缩、体积缩小或衰退的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jiddeskrivi tessut jew organu li ċkien jew iddgħajjef minħabba atrofija.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 萎缩的；萎缩性的

formal.mt: Ir-rapport mediku jiddeskrivi t-tessut bħala atrofiku.
formal.en: The medical report describes the tissue as atrophic.
formal.zh: 医疗报告将该组织描述为萎缩性组织。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Xi jfisser 'atrofiku' f'dan ir-rapport? Mark: Hawnhekk ifisser li t-tessut ċkien.
colloquial.en: Maja: What does 'atrophic' mean in this report? Mark: Here it means that the tissue has shrunk.
colloquial.zh: Maja：这份报告里的“萎缩的”是什么意思？Mark：这里指组织已经缩小了。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.zh: 这份报告里的“萎缩的”是什么意思？
messages.en: What does 'atrophic' mean in this report?

messages.speaker: Mark (教师)
messages.zh: 这里指组织已经缩小了。
messages.en: Here it means that the tissue has shrunk.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 atrofiku 放在“萎缩的组织”图片旁记忆：它描述组织的状态，是形容词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To become smaller or waste away, especially through lack of use or disease.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指身体组织等因缺乏使用或疾病等原因而逐渐缩小、衰退。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jiċkien jew jiddgħajjef, speċjalment minħabba nuqqas ta' użu jew mard.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 萎缩；逐渐缩小或衰退

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jindika li l-muskolu atrofizza wara perjodu twil mingħajr moviment.
formal.en: The report indicates that the muscle atrophied after a long period without movement.
formal.zh: 报告指出，该肌肉在长时间不活动后发生了萎缩。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Xi jfisser li l-muskolu atrofizza? Pawlu: Ifisser li ċkien u ddgħajjef.
colloquial.en: Lara: What does it mean that the muscle atrophied? Pawlu: It means that it became smaller and weaker.
colloquial.zh: Lara：肌肉萎缩了是什么意思？Pawlu：意思是它变小、变弱了。

messages.speaker: Lara (学生)
messages.zh: 肌肉萎缩了是什么意思？
messages.en: What does it mean that the muscle atrophied?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (教师)
messages.zh: 意思是它变小、变弱了。
messages.en: It means that it became smaller and weaker.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用一段肌肉逐渐变小的动画记 atrofizza：关注“发生萎缩”的变化过程，它是动词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A family name, written Attard with an initial capital letter.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一个姓氏，写作 Attard，首字母大写，可音译为“阿塔尔德”。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kunjom li jinkiteb Attard, b'ittra kbira fil-bidu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 姓氏：阿塔尔德

formal.mt: Is-Sinjura Attard se tippreżenta r-rapport fil-laqgħa ta' għada.
formal.en: Ms Attard will present the report at tomorrow's meeting.
formal.zh: 阿塔尔德女士将在明天的会议上介绍这份报告。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'kunjom għandek? Daniel: Attard. U inti? Maja: Jien Borg.
colloquial.en: Maja: What's your surname? Daniel: Attard. And yours? Maja: Mine is Borg.
colloquial.zh: Maja：你姓什么？Daniel：阿塔尔德。你呢？Maja：我姓博尔格。

messages.speaker: Maja (新同学)
messages.zh: 你姓什么？
messages.en: What's your surname?

messages.speaker: Daniel (同学)
messages.zh: 阿塔尔德。你呢？
messages.en: Attard. And yours?

messages.speaker: Maja (新同学)
messages.zh: 我姓博尔格。
messages.en: Mine is Borg.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象门牌上写着“Attard 一家”，把它与姓氏联系起来，并记住姓名中的首字母 A 要大写。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An official attached to an embassy, often responsible for a particular field such as culture or military affairs.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在使馆任职、通常负责文化或军事等特定领域事务的外交人员。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Uffiċjal marbut ma' ambaxxata, spiss responsabbli għal qasam partikolari bħall-kultura jew l-affarijiet militari.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使馆专员；外交随员，如文化专员或武官

formal.mt: L-attaxè kulturali tal-ambaxxata fetaħ il-wirja u laqa' lill-artisti.
formal.en: The embassy's cultural attaché opened the exhibition and welcomed the artists.
formal.zh: 使馆文化专员为展览揭幕，并欢迎各位艺术家。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Min hu r-raġel ħdejn l-ambaxxatur? Mark: Dak l-attaxè kulturali. Sara: Mela se jkellimna dwar il-wirja?
colloquial.en: Sara: Who is the man next to the ambassador? Mark: That's the cultural attaché. Sara: So will he talk to us about the exhibition?
colloquial.zh: Sara：大使旁边那位男士是谁？Mark：那是文化专员。Sara：那么，他会给我们介绍展览吗？

messages.speaker: Sara (参观者)
messages.zh: 大使旁边那位男士是谁？
messages.en: Who is the man next to the ambassador?

messages.speaker: Mark (导览员)
messages.zh: 那是文化专员。
messages.en: That's the cultural attaché.

messages.speaker: Sara (参观者)
messages.zh: 那么，他会给我们介绍展览吗？
messages.en: So will he talk to us about the exhibition?

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 attaxè 想成使馆里负责某一领域的专员，再用 kulturali 和 militari 分别联想文化专员与武官。

gloss_zh: 服务员；值勤人员；军官勤务兵

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person whose job is to assist or serve others, or to look after a place or facility.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 负责协助、服务他人或照看某个场所、设施的工作人员。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li xogħolha hu li tassisti jew taqdi lil ħaddieħor, jew tieħu ħsieb post jew faċilità.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 服务员；负责协助他人或照看场所的工作人员
军官的勤务兵；负责军官日常服务事务的军人

formal.mt: Fir-rakkont militari, l-attendent tal-uffiċjal ħejja l-uniformi qabel iċ-ċerimonja.
formal.en: In the military narrative, the officer's orderly prepared the uniform before the ceremony.
formal.zh: 在这篇军事叙事中，军官的勤务兵在仪式开始前备好了制服。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Lil min nista' nistaqsi fejn hi l-ħruġ? Pawlu: Staqsi lill-attendent ħdejn il-bieb.
colloquial.en: Lara: Who can I ask where the exit is? Pawlu: Ask the attendant by the door.
