colloquial.zh: Lara：我可以问谁出口在哪里？Pawlu：问门边的值勤人员吧。

messages.speaker: Lara (游客)
messages.mt_spoken: Lil min nista' nistaqsi fejn hi l-ħruġ?
messages.mt_standard: Lil min nista' nistaqsi fejn hi l-ħruġ?
messages.zh: 我可以问谁出口在哪里？
messages.en: Who can I ask where the exit is?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同行朋友)
messages.zh: 问门边的值勤人员吧。
messages.en: Ask the attendant by the door.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 attendent 配两张人物卡：博物馆里协助游客的工作人员，以及军中照料军官日常事务的勤务兵。

teaching_sense.en_definition: With close attention to what is being heard, read, watched, or done.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 以集中注意力、认真留心的方式听、读、看或做某事。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: B'attenzjoni kbira għal dak li wieħed jisma', jaqra, jara jew jagħmel.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 专心地；认真留意地

formal.mt: Il-parteċipanti għandhom jaqraw attentament l-istruzzjonijiet qabel jimlew il-formola.
formal.en: Participants should read the instructions attentively before completing the form.
formal.zh: 参与者应在填写表格前仔细阅读说明。

colloquial.mt: Omm: Isma' attentament, għax se ngħidlek kif tasal hemm. Ben: Qed nisma'. Liema triq nieħu?
colloquial.en: Mum: Listen carefully, because I'm going to tell you how to get there. Ben: I'm listening. Which road do I take?
colloquial.zh: 妈妈：仔细听，我要告诉你怎么去那里。Ben：我在听。该走哪条路？

messages.speaker: Omm (母亲)
messages.mt_spoken: Isma' attentament, għax se ngħidlek kif tasal hemm.
messages.mt_standard: Isma' attentament, għax se ngħidlek kif tasal hemm.
messages.zh: 仔细听，我要告诉你怎么去那里。
messages.en: Listen carefully, because I'm going to tell you how to get there.

messages.speaker: Ben (儿子)
messages.zh: 我在听。该走哪条路？
messages.en: I'm listening. Which road do I take?

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象听讲时眼睛看着老师、耳朵认真听，用 attentament 标记“专心地”这种动作方式。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The chemical element actinium, a radioactive metal with the symbol Ac.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 化学元素锕，一种具有放射性的金属，元素符号为 Ac。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-element kimiku attinju, metall radjuattiv bis-simbolu Ac.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 锕，一种化学元素

formal.mt: Fit-tabella perjodika, l-attinju huwa rappreżentat bis-simbolu Ac.
formal.en: In the periodic table, actinium is represented by the symbol Ac.
formal.zh: 在元素周期表中，锕用符号 Ac 表示。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'inhu s-simbolu tal-attinju? Mark: Ac, b'A kbira u c żgħira.
colloquial.en: Maja: What is the symbol for actinium? Mark: Ac, with a capital A and a lowercase c.
colloquial.zh: Maja：锕的符号是什么？Mark：Ac，A 大写，c 小写。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.zh: 锕的符号是什么？
messages.en: What is the symbol for actinium?

messages.speaker: Mark (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Ac, b'A kbira u c żgħira.
messages.mt_standard: Ac, b'A kbira u c żgħira.
messages.zh: Ac，A 大写，c 小写。
messages.en: Ac, with a capital A and a lowercase c.

cognitive_memory_aid: 制作一张三面对照卡：attinju、中文“锕”、符号 Ac；翻卡时特别检查 A 大写、c 小写。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act or process of making something active, operational, or ready for use.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使某物进入活动、运行或可使用状态的行为或过程。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att jew il-proċess li bih xi ħaġa ssir attiva, tibda taħdem jew issir lesta għall-użu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 激活；启用；使某物开始运行的过程

formal.mt: Biex titlesta l-attivazzjoni tal-kont, l-utent għandu jdaħħal il-kodiċi mibgħut bl-email.
formal.en: To complete account activation, the user must enter the code sent by email.
formal.zh: 用户须输入通过电子邮件发送的验证码，以完成账户激活。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Wasallek il-kodiċi ta' attivazzjoni? Daniel: Iva, se ndaħħlu issa biex inkun nista' nuża l-kont.
colloquial.en: Sara: Have you received the activation code? Daniel: Yes, I'll enter it now so I can use the account.
colloquial.zh: Sara：你收到激活码了吗？Daniel：收到了，我现在就输入，这样就能使用账户了。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 你收到激活码了吗？
messages.en: Have you received the activation code?

messages.speaker: Daniel (新用户)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, se ndaħħlu issa biex inkun nista' nuża l-kont.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, se ndaħħlu issa biex inkun nista' nuża l-kont.
messages.zh: 收到了，我现在就输入，这样就能使用账户了。
messages.en: Yes, I'll enter it now so I can use the account.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 attivazzjoni 联想成账户按钮从灰色变成可用状态的那一步，记住它表示“激活过程”，是名词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To provide a person, place or activity with the equipment needed for a particular purpose.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 为人、场所或某项活动配备特定用途所需的设备或器材。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ipprovda lil persuna, post jew attività bl-apparat jew bl-għodod meħtieġa għal skop partikolari.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 装备；为某人或某处配备所需的设备、器材。

formal.mt: Il-kulleġġ attrezza l-laboratorju b'apparat ġdid għat-tagħlim tax-xjenza.
formal.en: The college equipped the laboratory with new apparatus for teaching science.
formal.zh: 学院为实验室配备了用于科学教学的新仪器。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Min attrezza l-kċina l-ġdida? Mark: Ħija; xtara l-forn u l-friġġ ukoll.
colloquial.en: Maja: Who fitted out the new kitchen? Mark: My brother; he bought the oven and the fridge too.
colloquial.zh: Maja：新厨房是谁配齐用具的？Mark：我哥哥；烤箱和冰箱也是他买的。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 新厨房是谁配齐用具的？
messages.en: Who fitted out the new kitchen?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ħija; xtara l-forn u l-friġġ ukoll.
messages.mt_standard: Ħija; xtara l-forn u l-friġġ ukoll.
messages.zh: 我哥哥；烤箱和冰箱也是他买的。
messages.en: My brother; he bought the oven and the fridge too.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象空厨房逐件添入烤箱和冰箱：attrezza 就是把所需器材配齐，记住的是动作而非器材本身。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Describing a grammatical use in which an adjective or another modifier directly qualifies a noun within a noun phrase.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指形容词或其他修饰语在名词短语内部直接修饰名词、充当定语的语法用法。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jiddeskrivi użu grammatikali fejn aġġettiv jew modifikatur ieħor jikkwalifika nom direttament fi ħdan frażi nominali.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 定语的；指在名词短语内部直接修饰名词的语法用法。

formal.mt: Fil-frażi 'ktieb interessanti', l-aġġettiv 'interessanti' għandu użu attributtiv għax jikkwalifika n-nom 'ktieb' direttament.
formal.en: In the phrase 'an interesting book', the adjective 'interesting' has an attributive use because it directly qualifies the noun 'book'.
formal.zh: 在短语 ktieb interessanti（一本有趣的书）中，形容词 interessanti 是定语用法，因为它直接修饰名词 ktieb。

colloquial.mt: Lara: F''ktieb ġdid', 'ġdid' huwa aġġettiv attributtiv? Pawlu: Iva, għax jiddeskrivi l-ktieb direttament fil-frażi.
colloquial.en: Lara: In 'a new book', is 'new' an attributive adjective? Pawlu: Yes, because it describes the book directly within the phrase.
colloquial.zh: Lara：在 ktieb ġdid（一本新书）里，ġdid 是作定语的形容词吗？Pawlu：是的，因为它在短语中直接描述这本书。

messages.speaker: Lara (学生)
messages.zh: 在 ktieb ġdid（一本新书）里，ġdid 是作定语的形容词吗？
messages.en: In 'a new book', is 'new' an attributive adjective?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (老师)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, għax jiddeskrivi l-ktieb direttament fil-frażi.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, għax jiddeskrivi l-ktieb direttament fil-frażi.
messages.zh: 是的，因为它在短语中直接描述这本书。
messages.en: Yes, because it describes the book directly within the phrase.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 attributtiv 贴在“新书”的“新”字旁：它说明名词具有什么特点；马耳他语例子 ktieb ġdid 中，修饰语位于名词后面。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of identifying someone or something as the author, source or cause of a work, statement or result.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 将作品、言论或结果认定为出自某人、某个来源或某种原因的行为。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att li wieħed jidentifika persuna jew ħaġa bħala l-awtur, is-sors jew il-kawża ta' xogħol, stqarrija jew riżultat.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 归因；将作品、言论等认定为属于某位作者或出自某个来源。

collocations.en: the attribution of the work to the author
collocations.zh: 将作品认定为该作者所作
错误的归因或归属认定

formal.mt: L-attribuzzjoni tal-pittura lil dan l-artist hija bbażata fuq dokumenti miżmuma fl-arkivju.
formal.en: The attribution of the painting to this artist is based on documents held in the archive.
formal.zh: 将这幅画认定为该艺术家的作品，是以档案中保存的文件为依据的。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Din il-kwotazzjoni hija tassew ta' dak il-kittieb? David: Ma nafx; l-attribuzzjoni fuq din il-paġna ma tagħtix sors.
colloquial.en: Nina: Is this quotation really by that writer? David: I don't know; the attribution on this page gives no source.
colloquial.zh: Nina：这句话真是那位作家说的吗？David：我不知道；这个页面的作者归属说明没有提供来源。

messages.speaker: Nina (读者)
messages.mt_spoken: Din il-kwotazzjoni hija tassew ta' dak il-kittieb?
messages.mt_standard: Din il-kwotazzjoni hija tassew ta' dak il-kittieb?
messages.zh: 这句话真是那位作家说的吗？
messages.en: Is this quotation really by that writer?

messages.speaker: David (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ma nafx; l-attribuzzjoni fuq din il-paġna ma tagħtix sors.
messages.mt_standard: Ma nafx; l-attribuzzjoni fuq din il-paġna ma tagħtix sors.
messages.zh: 我不知道；这个页面的作者归属说明没有提供来源。
messages.en: I don't know; the attribution on this page gives no source.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象给一幅画挂上“某某所作”的标签：attribuzzjoni 是这项归属认定；给结果标上原因时，则可理解为归因。

gloss_zh: 可归因于的；可归属于的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Able to be reasonably identified as caused by, originating from or belonging to a particular person or thing.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 能够合理地认定为由某人或某事物造成、出自某个来源或归属于某人的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jista' jitqies b'raġuni bħala kkawżat minn persuna jew ħaġa partikolari, jew li ġej minnha jew jappartjeni lilha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 可归因于的；可认定为出自或归属于某人、某事物的。

collocations.zh: 可认定为该作者所作的

formal.mt: Skont ir-rapport, id-dewmien huwa attribwibbli għal nuqqas ta' materjal.
formal.en: According to the report, the delay is attributable to a shortage of materials.
formal.zh: 根据报告，延误可归因于材料短缺。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għaliex wasal tard il-pakkett? Mark: Id-dewmien huwa attribwibbli għal żball fl-indirizz; hekk qaluli.
colloquial.en: Sara: Why did the parcel arrive late? Mark: The delay is attributable to an error in the address; that's what they told me.
colloquial.zh: Sara：包裹为什么迟到了？Mark：延误可归因于地址有误；他们是这样告诉我的。

messages.speaker: Sara (顾客)
messages.zh: 包裹为什么迟到了？
messages.en: Why did the parcel arrive late?

messages.speaker: Mark (客服人员)
messages.mt_spoken: Id-dewmien huwa attribwibbli għal żball fl-indirizz; hekk qaluli.
messages.mt_standard: Id-dewmien huwa attribwibbli għal żball fl-indirizz; hekk qaluli.
messages.zh: 延误可归因于地址有误；他们是这样告诉我的。
messages.en: The delay is attributable to an error in the address; that's what they told me.

cognitive_memory_aid: 在结果与原因之间画一支箭头，并写上“可以归到这里”：attribwibbli 描述这种可归因或可归属的性质。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To identify a person or thing as the author, source or cause of something.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 将某事物归因于某种原因，或认定其作者、来源或归属。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Qies persuna jew ħaġa bħala l-awtur, is-sors jew il-kawża ta' xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 把某事归因于；把作品、言论等认定为出自某人或某个来源。

collocations.en: attributed the success to the team's work
collocations.zh: 将成功归功于团队的工作

collocations.en: attributed the painting to the artist
collocations.zh: 认定这幅画出自该艺术家

formal.mt: Ir-riċerkatur attribwixxa d-differenza fir-riżultati għall-metodu użat fil-kejl.
formal.en: The researcher attributed the difference in the results to the method used for measurement.
formal.zh: 研究人员将结果的差异归因于所采用的测量方法。

colloquial.mt: Lara: X'qal il-kowċ wara r-rebħa? Pawlu: Attribwixxa s-suċċess lill-ħidma tat-tim kollu.
colloquial.en: Lara: What did the coach say after the win? Pawlu: He attributed the success to the work of the whole team.
colloquial.zh: Lara：获胜后教练说了什么？Pawlu：他将成功归功于整个团队的努力。

messages.speaker: Lara (球迷)
messages.zh: 获胜后教练说了什么？
messages.en: What did the coach say after the win?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.zh: 他将成功归功于整个团队的努力。
messages.en: He attributed the success to the work of the whole team.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象教练把胜利奖杯指向全队，说“成功归功于大家”：attribwixxa 表示作出归因或归属判断的动作。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To put a plan, decision or measure into practice by taking the necessary action.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 采取必要行动，将计划、决定或措施付诸实践。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Qiegħed pjan, deċiżjoni jew miżura fil-prattika billi ħa l-azzjoni meħtieġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 实施；执行；将计划、决定或措施付诸实践。

formal.mt: Il-kunsill attwa pjan ġdid biex itejjeb is-servizz tat-trasport fil-lokalità.
formal.en: The council implemented a new plan to improve transport services in the locality.
formal.zh: 地方议会实施了一项改善当地交通服务的新计划。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Il-pjan tal-iskola beda jitħaddem? David: Iva, il-kap attwa l-pjan din il-ġimgħa.
colloquial.en: Nina: Has the school's plan been put into practice? David: Yes, the head implemented the plan this week.
colloquial.zh: Nina：学校的计划开始落实了吗？David：是的，校长这周实施了这个计划。

messages.speaker: Nina (家长)
messages.zh: 学校的计划开始落实了吗？
messages.en: Has the school's plan been put into practice?

messages.speaker: David (老师)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, il-kap attwa l-pjan din il-ġimgħa.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, il-kap attwa l-pjan din il-ġimgħa.
messages.zh: 是的，校长这周实施了这个计划。
messages.en: Yes, the head implemented the plan this week.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把纸上的计划想成一张待办表，开始逐项落实时就联想 attwa：重点是把决定变成实际行动。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Possible to carry out successfully with the time, resources and conditions available.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在现有时间、资源和条件下能够成功实施或完成的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jista' jitwettaq b'suċċess bil-ħin, bir-riżorsi u bil-kundizzjonijiet disponibbli.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 可行的；在现有条件下可以实施或完成的。

formal.mt: L-istudju juri li l-proġett huwa attwabbli bil-baġit u bil-persunal disponibbli.
formal.en: The study shows that the project is feasible with the available budget and staff.
formal.zh: 研究表明，利用现有预算和人员可以实施该项目。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Nistgħu nlestu dan kollu sas-Sibt? Mark: Iva, il-pjan huwa attwabbli jekk naħdmu flimkien.
colloquial.en: Maja: Can we finish all this by Saturday? Mark: Yes, the plan is feasible if we work together.
colloquial.zh: Maja：我们能在星期六之前把这些全部做完吗？Mark：能，只要我们一起做，这个计划就可行。

messages.speaker: Maja (同事)
messages.zh: 我们能在星期六之前把这些全部做完吗？
messages.en: Can we finish all this by Saturday?

messages.speaker: Mark (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, il-pjan huwa attwabbli jekk naħdmu flimkien.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, il-pjan huwa attwabbli jekk naħdmu flimkien.
messages.zh: 能，只要我们一起做，这个计划就可行。
messages.en: Yes, the plan is feasible if we work together.

cognitive_memory_aid: 在计划旁核对时间、预算和人手，三项都够就盖上“可实施”的章；用这个画面记住 attwabbli 表示可行。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The reality of what exists or is happening at the present time.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 当前实际存在或正在发生的事情所构成的现实情况。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ir-realtà ta' dak li jeżisti jew li qiegħed iseħħ fil-preżent.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 现实；实际情况，尤指当前存在或正在发生的情况。

formal.mt: Il-programm jiddiskuti temi ta' attwalità li jaffettwaw il-ħajja ta' kuljum.
formal.en: The programme discusses topics of current relevance that affect everyday life.
formal.zh: 这个节目讨论影响日常生活的当前热点话题。

colloquial.mt: Sara: X'taqra filgħodu fuq it-telefon? Pawlu: Naqra artikli dwar l-attwalità biex inkun naf x'qed jiġri.
colloquial.en: Sara: What do you read on your phone in the morning? Pawlu: I read articles about current affairs so I know what's happening.
colloquial.zh: Sara：你早上用手机看什么？Pawlu：我看有关时事的文章，了解现在发生的事情。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 你早上用手机看什么？
messages.en: What do you read on your phone in the morning?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Naqra artikli dwar l-attwalità biex inkun naf x'qed jiġri.
messages.mt_standard: Naqra artikli dwar l-attwalità biex inkun naf x'qed jiġri.
messages.zh: 我看有关时事的文章，了解现在发生的事情。
messages.en: I read articles about current affairs so I know what's happening.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象打开今天的新闻页，看到此刻真实发生的事情：用“当前的现实情况”这个画面记住 attwalità，也能理解时事话题中的用法。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A professional who uses mathematics and statistics to assess financial risks, especially in insurance.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 运用数学和统计方法评估金融风险，尤其是保险风险的专业人员。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Professjonist li juża l-matematika u l-istatistika biex jevalwa r-riskji finanzjarji, speċjalment fl-assigurazzjoni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 精算师；运用数学和统计方法评估风险的专业人员。

formal.mt: Il-kumpanija tal-assigurazzjoni qabbdet attwarju biex jevalwa r-riskji finanzjarji.
formal.en: The insurance company hired an actuary to assess the financial risks.
formal.zh: 保险公司聘请了一名精算师来评估金融风险。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Ħuk x'xogħol jagħmel? Pawlu: Jaħdem bħala attwarju ma' kumpanija tal-assigurazzjoni.
colloquial.en: Marija: What does your brother do? Pawlu: He works as an actuary at an insurance company.
colloquial.zh: 玛丽娅：你哥哥做什么工作？保罗：他在一家保险公司担任精算师。

messages.speaker: 玛丽娅 (朋友)
messages.zh: 你哥哥做什么工作？
messages.en: What does your brother do?

messages.speaker: 保罗 (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Jaħdem bħala attwarju ma' kumpanija tal-assigurazzjoni.
messages.mt_standard: Jaħdem bħala attwarju ma' kumpanija tal-assigurazzjoni.
messages.zh: 他在一家保险公司担任精算师。
messages.en: He works as an actuary at an insurance company.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 attwarju 和精算师桌上的概率表、保险数字联系起来：看到这个词，就想起用数学估算风险的人。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The name of the prayer known in English as the Hail Mary, also called Sliema in Maltese.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 祷文《圣母经》的名称，英语称 Hail Mary，马耳他语也称 Sliema。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-isem tat-talba magħrufa wkoll bħala s-Sliema.

sense_translations.zh_definition: Sliema 的同义名称，指《圣母经》，也称《万福玛利亚》。

collocations.en: the words of the Hail Mary

formal.mt: Waqt il-laqgħa ta' talb, il-grupp qal l-Ave Marija flimkien.
formal.en: During the prayer meeting, the group recited the Hail Mary together.
formal.zh: 在祈祷聚会上，大家一起诵念了《圣母经》。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Taf il-kliem tal-Ave Marija? Luqa: Iva, nistgħu ngħiduha flimkien.
colloquial.en: Anna: Do you know the words of the Hail Mary? Luqa: Yes, we can recite it together.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：你会念《圣母经》吗？卢卡：会，我们可以一起念。

messages.speaker: 安娜 (朋友)
messages.zh: 你会念《圣母经》吗？
messages.en: Do you know the words of the Hail Mary?

messages.speaker: 卢卡 (朋友)
messages.zh: 会，我们可以一起念。
messages.en: Yes, we can recite it together.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 Ave Marija 整体记成一张写着《圣母经》的祷文卡片；再把 Sliema 写在旁边，提醒自己两者可指同一篇祷文。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A large bird of prey that feeds mainly on dead animals.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 主要以动物尸体为食的大型猛禽，即兀鹫。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Għasfur tal-priża kbir li jiekol l-aktar annimali mejta.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 兀鹫；主要以动物尸体为食的大型猛禽。

formal.mt: Ir-ritratt juri avultun bil-ġwienaħ miftuħa fuq blata.
formal.en: The photograph shows a vulture with its wings spread on a rock.
formal.zh: 照片中，一只兀鹫站在岩石上，展开双翅。

colloquial.mt: Sara: X'inhu dak l-għasfur kbir? Mark: Dak avultun. Ħares lejn il-ġwienaħ tiegħu!
colloquial.en: Sara: What is that big bird? Mark: That's a vulture. Look at its wings!
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：那只大鸟是什么？马克：那是兀鹫。看看它的翅膀！

messages.speaker: 萨拉 (游客)
messages.zh: 那只大鸟是什么？
messages.en: What is that big bird?

messages.speaker: 马克 (导游)
messages.mt_spoken: Dak avultun. Ħares lejn il-ġwienaħ tiegħu!
messages.mt_standard: Dak avultun. Ħares lejn il-ġwienaħ tiegħu!
messages.zh: 那是兀鹫。看看它的翅膀！
messages.en: That's a vulture. Look at its wings!

cognitive_memory_aid: 看到 avultun，就想象天空中一只展开大翅膀的兀鹫；用这幅画面把词形和鸟名牢牢连在一起。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The vulture species Neophron percnopterus, known in English as the Egyptian vulture.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指学名为 Neophron percnopterus 的白兀鹫，英语称 Egyptian vulture。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Speċi ta' avultun bl-isem xjentifiku Neophron percnopterus.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 白兀鹫，又称埃及兀鹫，学名为 Neophron percnopterus。

collocations.en: a photograph of an Egyptian vulture

formal.mt: Il-gwida tidentifika l-avultun abjad bl-isem xjentifiku Neophron percnopterus.
formal.en: The guide identifies the Egyptian vulture by the scientific name Neophron percnopterus.
formal.zh: 这本指南用学名 Neophron percnopterus 标明白兀鹫这一物种。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Dan avultun abjad? David: Iva, hekk hemm miktub taħt ir-ritratt.
colloquial.en: Nina: Is this an Egyptian vulture? David: Yes, that's what it says below the photograph.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：这是白兀鹫吗？戴维：是的，照片下方是这样写的。

messages.speaker: 妮娜 (学生)
messages.zh: 这是白兀鹫吗？
messages.en: Is this an Egyptian vulture?

messages.speaker: 戴维 (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, hekk hemm miktub taħt ir-ritratt.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, hekk hemm miktub taħt ir-ritratt.
messages.zh: 是的，照片下方是这样写的。
messages.en: Yes, that's what it says below the photograph.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 avultun abjad 做一张完整的物种卡，正面写马耳他语，背面配对白兀鹫、Egyptian vulture 和学名，避免只记住泛称兀鹫。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The vulture species Gyps fulvus, known in English as the griffon vulture.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指学名为 Gyps fulvus 的西域兀鹫，英语称 griffon vulture。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Speċi ta' avultun bl-isem xjentifiku Gyps fulvus.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 西域兀鹫，也称格里芬兀鹫，学名为 Gyps fulvus。

collocations.en: a photograph of a griffon vulture

formal.mt: Fit-tabella, l-isem avultun prim jidher ħdejn l-isem xjentifiku Gyps fulvus.
formal.en: In the table, the name avultun prim appears beside the scientific name Gyps fulvus.
formal.zh: 表格中，马耳他语名称 avultun prim 列在学名 Gyps fulvus 旁边。

colloquial.mt: Elena: Kif ngħid griffon vulture bil-Malti? Ġużeppi: Avultun prim. Tista' tikteb l-isem ħdejn ir-ritratt.
colloquial.en: Elena: How do I say griffon vulture in Maltese? Ġużeppi: Avultun prim. You can write the name beside the photograph.
colloquial.zh: 埃莱娜：西域兀鹫用马耳他语怎么说？朱塞佩：Avultun prim。你可以把名称写在照片旁边。

messages.speaker: 埃莱娜 (学生)
messages.zh: 西域兀鹫用马耳他语怎么说？
messages.en: How do I say griffon vulture in Maltese?

messages.speaker: 朱塞佩 (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Avultun prim. Tista' tikteb l-isem ħdejn ir-ritratt.
messages.mt_standard: Avultun prim. Tista' tikteb l-isem ħdejn ir-ritratt.
messages.zh: Avultun prim。你可以把名称写在照片旁边。
messages.en: Avultun prim. You can write the name beside the photograph.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 avultun prim、griffon vulture 和 Gyps fulvus 写在同一张卡片上，整组配对记忆；再与 avultun abjad 的卡片分开放置，练习区分物种。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To humiliate someone or bring disgrace upon them.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 羞辱某人，使其感到受辱或蒙受羞耻。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Umilja lil xi ħadd jew ġab mistħija fuqu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使蒙羞；羞辱，使某人感到尊严受损。

collocations.en: humiliated the employee in front of everyone

formal.mt: Fir-rapport, l-impjegat stqarr li l-kap avvelixxa lilu quddiem il-kollegi.
formal.en: In the report, the employee stated that the manager had humiliated him in front of his colleagues.
formal.zh: 该员工在报告中表示，主管曾在同事面前羞辱他。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Għaliex telaq Mark? Toni: Għax Pawlu avvelixxa lilu quddiem kulħadd.
colloquial.en: Rita: Why did Mark leave? Toni: Because Pawlu humiliated him in front of everyone.
colloquial.zh: 丽塔：马克为什么走了？托尼：因为保罗当众羞辱了他。

messages.speaker: 丽塔 (朋友)
messages.zh: 马克为什么走了？
messages.en: Why did Mark leave?

messages.speaker: 托尼 (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax Pawlu avvelixxa lilu quddiem kulħadd.
messages.mt_standard: Għax Pawlu avvelixxa lilu quddiem kulħadd.
messages.zh: 因为保罗当众羞辱了他。
messages.en: Because Pawlu humiliated him in front of everyone.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 avvelixxa 配上一个当众受辱、低头离开的场景，记住它涉及羞辱和尊严受损，比普通批评更强烈。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who seeks adventures or takes part in exciting and sometimes risky experiences.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 寻求冒险，或参与刺激且有时带有风险的经历的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li tfittex l-avventuri jew tieħu sehem f'esperjenzi eċċitanti u kultant riskjużi.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 冒险者；探险者，喜欢或从事冒险活动的人。

formal.mt: Ir-rumanz jirrakkonta l-vjaġġ ta' avventurier li jaqsam deżert biex isib belt mitlufa.
formal.en: The novel recounts the journey of an adventurer who crosses a desert to find a lost city.
formal.zh: 这部小说讲述了一名冒险者穿越沙漠、寻找失落城市的旅程。

colloquial.mt: Marta: Min hu l-karattru prinċipali tal-ktieb? Daniel: Avventurier li dejjem ifittex postijiet ġodda.
colloquial.en: Marta: Who is the main character in the book? Daniel: An adventurer who is always looking for new places.
colloquial.zh: 玛尔塔：这本书的主角是谁？丹尼尔：一个总在寻找新地方的冒险者。

messages.speaker: 玛尔塔 (读书会成员)
messages.zh: 这本书的主角是谁？
messages.en: Who is the main character in the book?

messages.speaker: 丹尼尔 (读书会成员)
messages.mt_spoken: Avventurier li dejjem ifittex postijiet ġodda.
messages.mt_standard: Avventurier li dejjem ifittex postijiet ġodda.
messages.zh: 一个总在寻找新地方的冒险者。
messages.en: An adventurer who is always looking for new places.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一个背着行囊出发的人，在人物卡上写 avventurier：这个名词回答的是谁在冒险，记成冒险者这个人。

gloss_zh: 爱冒险的；富有冒险精神的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Willing to try new, exciting, or risky experiences.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 愿意尝试新鲜、刺激或带有风险的经历的；富有冒险精神的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jħobb jipprova esperjenzi ġodda, eċċitanti jew riskjużi.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 爱冒险的；富有冒险精神的，愿意尝试新鲜或刺激的事物的。

formal.mt: Il-protagonist huwa żagħżugħ avventuruż li jfittex esperjenzi ġodda matul il-vjaġġ.
formal.en: The protagonist is an adventurous young man who seeks new experiences during the journey.
formal.zh: 主角是一个富有冒险精神的年轻人，在旅途中不断寻求新的体验。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Trid tipprova tixxabbat mal-blat? Mark: Iva, illum inħossni avventuruż!
colloquial.en: Lara: Do you want to try rock climbing? Mark: Yes, I'm feeling adventurous today!
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：你想试试攀岩吗？马克：想，我今天很想冒险一试！

messages.speaker: 拉拉 (朋友)
messages.zh: 你想试试攀岩吗？
messages.en: Do you want to try rock climbing?

messages.speaker: 马克 (朋友)
messages.zh: 想，我今天很想冒险一试！
messages.en: Yes, I'm feeling adventurous today!

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 avventuruż 写在人物的性格标签上，表示爱冒险的；与表示冒险者这个人的 avventurier 对照，练习区分形容词和名词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To become real or actually happen, as a dream, wish, or prediction.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指梦想、愿望或预言成为现实；表达此义时可见 avvera ruħu 等形式。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Isir realtà jew iseħħ tassew, bħal ħolma, xewqa jew tbassir.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 成真；成为现实。

formal.mt: Wara snin ta' taħriġ, il-ħolma tagħha li ssir atleta professjonali avverat ruħha.
formal.en: After years of training, her dream of becoming a professional athlete came true.
formal.zh: 经过多年的训练，她成为职业运动员的梦想实现了。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Fl-aħħar, il-ħolma tiegħi li nkanta fuq palk avverat ruħha! Nina: Kif ħassejtek meta bdejt tkanta?
colloquial.en: Lara: At last, my dream of singing on a stage came true! Nina: How did you feel when you started singing?
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：我登台唱歌的梦想终于实现了！妮娜：开始唱的时候，你是什么感觉？

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Fl-aħħar, il-ħolma tiegħi li nkanta fuq palk avverat ruħha!
messages.mt_standard: Fl-aħħar, il-ħolma tiegħi li nkanta fuq palk avverat ruħha!
messages.zh: 我登台唱歌的梦想终于实现了！
messages.en: At last, my dream of singing on a stage came true!

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.zh: 开始唱的时候，你是什么感觉？
messages.en: How did you feel when you started singing?

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 avvera 和梦想清单上终于打下的勾联系起来：原先只在心里，如今成为现实。连同 ħolma li avverat ruħha 一起记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To tell someone about a danger or problem, or firmly advise them to avoid an action.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 向某人指出危险或问题，提醒其小心，或郑重告诫其避免某种行为。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jiġbed l-attenzjoni ta' xi ħadd għal periklu jew problema, jew iwissih biex jevita ċerta azzjoni.

sense_translations.en_definition: to warn, to caution, to advert, to admonish
sense_translations.zh_definition: 警告；提醒注意；劝诫；告诫。

formal.mt: Il-gwardjan avverta lill-viżitaturi biex ma jersqux lejn it-tarf tal-irdum.
formal.en: The guard warned the visitors not to approach the edge of the cliff.
formal.zh: 警卫告诫游客不要靠近悬崖边缘。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Għaliex ma nistgħux ngħaddu minn hawn? Rita: Il-pulizija avverta lil kulħadd li t-triq hija magħluqa.
colloquial.en: Mark: Why can't we go through here? Rita: The police officer warned everyone that the road is closed.
colloquial.zh: 马克：我们为什么不能从这里过去？丽塔：警察已经提醒所有人，这条路封闭了。

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex ma nistgħux ngħaddu minn hawn?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex ma nistgħux ngħaddu minn hawn?
messages.zh: 我们为什么不能从这里过去？
messages.en: Why can't we go through here?

messages.speaker: Rita (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-pulizija avverta lil kulħadd li t-triq hija magħluqa.
messages.mt_standard: Il-pulizija avverta lil kulħadd li t-triq hija magħluqa.
messages.zh: 警察已经提醒所有人，这条路封闭了。
messages.en: The police officer warned everyone that the road is closed.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象有人伸手拦住你并提醒前方危险，把 avverta 记成“开口警告别人”的动作，重点是提醒或告诫。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A warning or firm caution intended to prevent danger, mistakes, or unacceptable behaviour.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 为防止危险、错误或不当行为而作出的警告或郑重告诫。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Twissija jew ċanfira maħsuba biex tevita periklu, żball jew imġiba mhux aċċettabbli.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 告诫；警告；提醒小心的话。

formal.mt: Id-direttur ta avvertiment ċar lill-impjegati dwar ir-riskji ta' xogħol mingħajr tagħmir protettiv.
formal.en: The director gave the employees a clear warning about the risks of working without protective equipment.
formal.zh: 主管明确警告员工，不使用防护装备作业存在风险。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għaliex qiegħed timxi daqshekk bil-mod? Pawlu: Hemm avvertiment dwar l-art tiżloq, u ma rridx naqa'.
colloquial.en: Sara: Why are you walking so slowly? Pawlu: There's a warning about the slippery floor, and I don't want to fall.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：你为什么走得这么慢？保罗：这里有地面湿滑的警告，我可不想摔倒。

messages.speaker: Sara (同事)
messages.zh: 你为什么走得这么慢？
messages.en: Why are you walking so slowly?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Hemm avvertiment dwar l-art tiżloq, u ma rridx naqa'.
messages.mt_standard: Hemm avvertiment dwar l-art tiżloq, u ma rridx naqa'.
messages.zh: 这里有地面湿滑的警告，我可不想摔倒。
messages.en: There's a warning about the slippery floor, and I don't want to fall.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 avvertiment 想成一句需要认真听取的“小心！”：avverta 是警告的动作，avvertiment 是那条警告或告诫。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To move nearer to a person, place, or thing.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 向某人、某处或某物移动，使彼此距离缩短。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jersaq aktar qrib ta' persuna, post jew ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 靠近；接近；走近。

formal.mt: Ir-riċerkatur avviċina lejn l-għasfur bil-mod biex ma jbeżżgħux.
formal.en: The researcher approached the bird slowly so as not to frighten it.
formal.zh: 研究人员慢慢靠近那只鸟，以免惊吓它。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Il-qattus għadu jibża' minni. Toni: Meta avviċina lejja lbieraħ, bqajt kwiet u ħallejtu jersaq waħdu.
colloquial.en: Maja: The cat is still afraid of me. Toni: When it approached me yesterday, I stayed quiet and let it come closer on its own.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：那只猫还是怕我。托尼：昨天它靠近我时，我保持安静，让它自己走过来。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 那只猫还是怕我。
messages.en: The cat is still afraid of me.

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Meta avviċina lejja lbieraħ, bqajt kwiet u ħallejtu jersaq waħdu.
messages.mt_standard: Meta avviċina lejja lbieraħ, bqajt kwiet u ħallejtu jersaq waħdu.
messages.zh: 昨天它靠近我时，我保持安静，让它自己走过来。
messages.en: When it approached me yesterday, I stayed quiet and let it come closer on its own.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象地图上的两个点逐渐靠拢，把 avviċina 和“距离越来越近”的画面绑定；记忆重点是移动方向朝向目标。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A notice giving information, or a poster displayed for people to read.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 向人们传达信息的通知或告示，也可指张贴出来供人阅读的招贴。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Messaġġ li jagħti informazzjoni, jew kartellun imwaħħal biex jinqara min-nies.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 通知；告示；用于向人们传达信息的文字消息。
招贴；张贴在公共位置供人观看或阅读的告示。

collocations.en: a poster attached to the wall

formal.mt: Skont l-avviż maħruġ mill-iskola, il-laqgħa tal-ġenituri se ssir nhar il-Ħamis.
formal.en: According to the notice issued by the school, the parents' meeting will take place on Thursday.
formal.zh: 根据学校发布的通知，家长会将于星期四举行。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Rajt l-avviż fuq il-ħajt ħdejn il-ħanut? Mark: Iva, dak dwar il-kunċert tas-Sibt. Trid immorru?
colloquial.en: Nina: Did you see the poster on the wall beside the shop? Mark: Yes, the one about Saturday's concert. Shall we go?
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：你看到商店旁边墙上的招贴了吗？马克：看到了，就是介绍星期六音乐会的那张。我们去吗？

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Rajt l-avviż fuq il-ħajt ħdejn il-ħanut?
messages.mt_standard: Rajt l-avviż fuq il-ħajt ħdejn il-ħanut?
messages.zh: 你看到商店旁边墙上的招贴了吗？
messages.en: Did you see the poster on the wall beside the shop?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, dak dwar il-kunċert tas-Sibt. Trid immorru?
messages.mt_standard: Iva, dak dwar il-kunċert tas-Sibt. Trid immorru?
messages.zh: 看到了，就是介绍星期六音乐会的那张。我们去吗？
messages.en: Yes, the one about Saturday's concert. Shall we go?

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 avviż 想成一张写着消息的纸：作为信息是“通知”，贴到墙上供人看时可理解为“告示或招贴”。

gloss_zh: 传信人；报信人；提醒演员候场的人

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who carries messages or brings news; in a theatre, a person who tells actors to prepare to go onstage.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 负责传递消息或带来消息的人；在剧院中，也指通知演员准备上台的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li twassal messaġġi jew aħbarijiet; fit-teatru, persuna li tavża lill-atturi biex iħejju ruħhom biex joħorġu fuq il-palk.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 传信人；负责把消息从一方传给另一方的人。
报信人；带来消息的人。

sense_translations.en_definition: person who notifies actors to prepare to come onstage
sense_translations.zh_definition: 在剧院中通知演员准备上台的人。

collocations.zh: 剧院里提醒演员准备上台的人

formal.mt: Qabel it-tieni att, l-avviżatur għarraf lill-atturi li kellhom iħejju ruħhom biex joħorġu fuq il-palk.
formal.en: Before the second act, the actor caller informed the actors that they should prepare to go onstage.
formal.zh: 第二幕开始前，负责提醒候场的工作人员通知演员准备上台。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Min se jgħidilna meta jkun imissna noħorġu fuq il-palk? Pawlu: L-avviżatur jiġi jgħidilna ftit qabel. Ejja nistennew hawn.
colloquial.en: Lara: Who will tell us when it's our turn to go onstage? Pawlu: The actor caller will come and tell us shortly beforehand. Let's wait here.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：轮到我们上台时，谁来通知我们？保罗：负责提醒候场的人会提前一会儿来告诉我们。我们在这里等吧。

messages.speaker: Lara (演员)
messages.mt_spoken: Min se jgħidilna meta jkun imissna noħorġu fuq il-palk?
messages.mt_standard: Min se jgħidilna meta jkun imissna noħorġu fuq il-palk?
messages.zh: 轮到我们上台时，谁来通知我们？
messages.en: Who will tell us when it's our turn to go onstage?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (演员)
messages.mt_spoken: L-avviżatur jiġi jgħidilna ftit qabel. Ejja nistennew hawn.
messages.mt_standard: L-avviżatur jiġi jgħidilna ftit qabel. Ejja nistennew hawn.
messages.zh: 负责提醒候场的人会提前一会儿来告诉我们。我们在这里等吧。
messages.en: The actor caller will come and tell us shortly beforehand. Let's wait here.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“把消息带到的人”串起 avviżatur 的三个义项：传口信、带新闻，以及到后台通知演员准备上台。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A board on which notices are displayed for people to read.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 供人张贴通知、告示等信息并让大家阅读的板面或布告栏。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Bord li fuqu jitwaħħlu avviżi biex ikunu jistgħu jinqraw min-nies.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 布告栏；公告板；用于集中张贴通知的板面。

collocations.en: to put a notice on the noticeboard

formal.mt: L-iskeda tal-eżamijiet se titwaħħal fuq l-avviżiera tal-iskola nhar it-Tnejn.
formal.en: The examination timetable will be posted on the school noticeboard on Monday.
formal.zh: 考试时间表将于星期一张贴在学校布告栏上。

colloquial.mt: Toni: Fejn nista' nara l-ħinijiet tal-lezzjonijiet? Sara: Ħares lejn l-avviżiera ħdejn il-bieb. L-iskeda qiegħda hemm.
colloquial.en: Toni: Where can I see the lesson times? Sara: Look at the noticeboard beside the door. The timetable is there.
colloquial.zh: 托尼：我在哪里能看到上课时间？萨拉：看看门旁边的布告栏，课表就在那里。

messages.speaker: Toni (学生)
messages.zh: 我在哪里能看到上课时间？
messages.en: Where can I see the lesson times?

messages.speaker: Sara (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Ħares lejn l-avviżiera ħdejn il-bieb. L-iskeda qiegħda hemm.
messages.mt_standard: Ħares lejn l-avviżiera ħdejn il-bieb. L-iskeda qiegħda hemm.
messages.zh: 看看门旁边的布告栏，课表就在那里。
messages.en: Look at the noticeboard beside the door. The timetable is there.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用场景区分两个词：avviż 是一则通知，avviżiera 是贴着许多通知的公告板。想象校门口那块贴满纸张的板。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A brief response when someone calls you or seeks your attention, meaning 'yes?' or 'what is it?'
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 别人叫你或引起你的注意时使用的简短回应，相当于“嗯？”“什么事？”。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tweġiba qasira meta xi ħadd isejjaħlek jew jiġbidlek l-attenzjoni, fis-sens ta' 'iva?' jew 'x'hemm?'.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 嗯？；什么事？用于回应别人的呼唤或询问对方有何事。

formal.mt: Fid-djalogu, meta persuna tissejjaħ b'isimha, tista' twieġeb 'Aw?' biex tistaqsi x'hemm.
formal.en: In a dialogue, when someone is called by name, they can reply 'Aw?' to ask what is wanted.
formal.zh: 在对话中，一个人听到别人叫自己的名字时，可以回答“Aw?”，询问对方有什么事。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Mark! Mark: Aw? X'hemm? Maja: Tista' tgħinni nġorr din il-kaxxa?
colloquial.en: Maja: Mark! Mark: Yes? What is it? Maja: Can you help me carry this box?
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：马克！马克：嗯？什么事？玛雅：你能帮我搬这个箱子吗？

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 马克！
messages.en: Mark!

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 嗯？什么事？
messages.en: Yes? What is it?

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你能帮我搬这个箱子吗？
messages.en: Can you help me carry this box?

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象有人喊你的名字，你抬头回应“嗯？什么事？”把这个短促的回应场景与 aw 绑定，练习时带上询问语气。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An increase in an amount, level, price, or payment.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 数量、水平、价格或报酬的增加，也可指增加的幅度。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Żieda fl-ammont, fil-livell, fil-prezz jew fil-ħlas.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 增加；上升；上涨。

formal.mt: Il-kumpanija ħabbret awment ta' ħamsa fil-mija fil-pagi.
formal.en: The company announced a five percent increase in wages.
formal.zh: 公司宣布工资上涨百分之五。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Smajt li se jkollkom awment fil-paga? Mark: Iva, se nibdew nieħdu aktar mix-xahar id-dieħel.
colloquial.en: Maja: I heard you're getting a pay rise? Mark: Yes, we'll start earning more next month.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：听说你们要加薪了？马克：是啊，从下个月开始我们就能多拿一些了。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Smajt li se jkollkom awment fil-paga?
messages.mt_standard: Smajt li se jkollkom awment fil-paga?
messages.zh: 听说你们要加薪了？
messages.en: I heard you're getting a pay rise?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, se nibdew nieħdu aktar mix-xahar id-dieħel.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, se nibdew nieħdu aktar mix-xahar id-dieħel.
messages.zh: 是啊，从下个月开始我们就能多拿一些了。
messages.en: Yes, we'll start earning more next month.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把工资单上向上的箭头与 awment 配在一起记：它是名词，表示一次增加或上涨。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To make an amount, level, price, or payment greater.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使数量、水平、价格或报酬增加或提高。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jagħmel ammont, livell, prezz jew ħlas akbar jew ogħla.

sense_translations.en_definition: to increase, to raise, to augment
sense_translations.zh_definition: 增加；提高；扩大。

formal.mt: Is-sid awmenta l-pagi tal-ħaddiema wara li rreveda l-baġit.
formal.en: The owner increased the workers' wages after reviewing the budget.
formal.zh: 业主审核预算后提高了工人的工资。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex il-kafè jiswa aktar illum? Pawlu: Is-sid awmenta l-prezz ilbieraħ.
colloquial.en: Lara: Why does the coffee cost more today? Pawlu: The owner raised the price yesterday.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：今天咖啡怎么更贵了？保罗：老板昨天提价了。

messages.speaker: Lara (顾客)
messages.zh: 今天咖啡怎么更贵了？
messages.en: Why does the coffee cost more today?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (店员)
messages.zh: 老板昨天提价了。
messages.en: The owner raised the price yesterday.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用动作画面记 awmenta：老板把价签上的数字改大。与名词 awment 对照，记住这里表达增加的动作。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The tree species Araucaria araucana, commonly called the monkey puzzle tree.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指智利南洋杉，学名为 Araucaria araucana，英语常称 monkey puzzle tree。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Siġra tal-ispeċi Araucaria araucana, magħrufa bl-Ingliż bħala monkey puzzle tree.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 智利南洋杉（Araucaria araucana）。

formal.mt: Fil-katalgu tal-ġnien botaniku, din l-awrikarja hija mniżżla bl-isem xjentifiku Araucaria araucana.
formal.en: In the botanical garden's catalogue, this monkey puzzle tree is listed under the scientific name Araucaria araucana.
formal.zh: 在植物园的目录中，这棵智利南洋杉以学名 Araucaria araucana 登记。

colloquial.mt: Nina: X'jisimha din is-siġra? Toni: Din awrikarja; fuq it-tikketta hemm Araucaria araucana.
colloquial.en: Nina: What's this tree called? Toni: It's a monkey puzzle tree; the label says Araucaria araucana.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：这棵树叫什么？托尼：这是智利南洋杉，标签上写着 Araucaria araucana。

messages.speaker: Nina (游客)
messages.zh: 这棵树叫什么？
messages.en: What's this tree called?

messages.speaker: Toni (导游)
messages.mt_spoken: Din awrikarja; fuq it-tikketta hemm Araucaria araucana.
messages.mt_standard: Din awrikarja; fuq it-tikketta hemm Araucaria araucana.
messages.zh: 这是智利南洋杉，标签上写着 Araucaria araucana。
messages.en: It's a monkey puzzle tree; the label says Araucaria araucana.

cognitive_memory_aid: 做一张植物标签卡，把 awrikarja、智利南洋杉和 Araucaria araucana 三项并排记，避免混淆相近树名。

gloss_zh: 异叶南洋杉；诺福克岛南洋杉

teaching_sense.en_definition: The tree species Araucaria heterophylla, commonly called the Norfolk Island pine.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指异叶南洋杉，又称诺福克岛南洋杉，学名为 Araucaria heterophylla。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Siġra tal-ispeċi Araucaria heterophylla, magħrufa bl-Ingliż bħala Norfolk Island pine.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 异叶南洋杉，又称诺福克岛南洋杉（Araucaria heterophylla）。

formal.mt: It-tikketta tal-awrikarja kbira turi l-isem xjentifiku Araucaria heterophylla.
formal.en: The Norfolk Island pine's label displays the scientific name Araucaria heterophylla.
formal.zh: 这棵异叶南洋杉的标签标有学名 Araucaria heterophylla。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Din ukoll jisimha awrikarja? David: Iva, iżda l-isem sħiħ hawn hu awrikarja kbira, Araucaria heterophylla.
colloquial.en: Sara: Is this one also called an awrikarja? David: Yes, but its full name here is awrikarja kbira, the Norfolk Island pine, Araucaria heterophylla.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：这棵也叫 awrikarja 吗？戴维：是的，不过这里的完整名称是 awrikarja kbira，也就是异叶南洋杉，学名 Araucaria heterophylla。

messages.speaker: Sara (学生)
messages.zh: 这棵也叫 awrikarja 吗？
messages.en: Is this one also called an awrikarja?

messages.speaker: David (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, iżda l-isem sħiħ hawn hu awrikarja kbira, Araucaria heterophylla.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, iżda l-isem sħiħ hawn hu awrikarja kbira, Araucaria heterophylla.
messages.zh: 是的，不过这里的完整名称是 awrikarja kbira，也就是异叶南洋杉，学名 Araucaria heterophylla。
messages.en: Yes, but its full name here is awrikarja kbira, the Norfolk Island pine, Araucaria heterophylla.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 awrikarja kbira 整体写在异叶南洋杉的图片下，并配上 heterophylla；学习时完整朗读，记住这是一个树种名称。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The tree species Araucaria bidwillii, commonly called the Bunya pine.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指大叶南洋杉，又称邦亚松，学名为 Araucaria bidwillii。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Siġra tal-ispeċi Araucaria bidwillii, magħrufa bl-Ingliż bħala Bunya pine.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 大叶南洋杉，又称邦亚松（Araucaria bidwillii）。

formal.mt: Il-katalgu jidentifika l-awrikarja ta' Bidwill bl-isem xjentifiku Araucaria bidwillii.
formal.en: The catalogue identifies the Bunya pine by the scientific name Araucaria bidwillii.
formal.zh: 目录以学名 Araucaria bidwillii 标识大叶南洋杉。

colloquial.mt: Lina: Kif insib l-awrikarja ta' Bidwill fil-katalgu? Mark: Fittex Araucaria bidwillii; hemmhekk issibha.
colloquial.en: Lina: How do I find the Bunya pine in the catalogue? Mark: Look for Araucaria bidwillii; you'll find it there.
colloquial.zh: 莉娜：我怎么在目录里找到大叶南洋杉？马克：查 Araucaria bidwillii，就能找到它。

messages.speaker: Lina (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Kif insib l-awrikarja ta' Bidwill fil-katalgu?
messages.mt_standard: Kif insib l-awrikarja ta' Bidwill fil-katalgu?
messages.zh: 我怎么在目录里找到大叶南洋杉？
messages.en: How do I find the Bunya pine in the catalogue?

messages.speaker: Mark (教师)
messages.zh: 查 Araucaria bidwillii，就能找到它。
messages.en: Look for Araucaria bidwillii; you'll find it there.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用拼写配对记忆：把名称里的 Bidwill 与学名 bidwillii 连线，再配上中文大叶南洋杉，形成三项对应卡。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To verify that an object, document, or signature is genuine.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 核实物品、文件或签名是否真实，确认其为真品或真迹。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jivverifika li oġġett, dokument jew firma huwa ġenwin.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 鉴定真伪；核实并确认真实性。

formal.mt: L-espert awtentika l-firma wara li qabbel id-dokument ma' kampjuni oħra.
formal.en: The expert authenticated the signature after comparing the document with other samples.
formal.zh: 专家将文件与其他样本进行比较后，确认了签名的真实性。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Min ikkonferma li l-firma hija ġenwina? David: L-espert awtentika l-firma dalgħodu.

gloss_zh: 真实地；原汁原味地；忠实于原貌地

teaching_sense.en_definition: In a genuine way or in a way faithful to the original character or tradition.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 以真实、自然的方式，或忠实于原有特色、传统的方式。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: B'mod ġenwin jew b'mod fidil lejn il-karattru oriġinali jew it-tradizzjoni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 真实地；原汁原味地；忠实于原貌或传统地。

formal.mt: L-awtur jirrappreżenta awtentikament il-ħajja ta' kuljum permezz tad-djalogi bejn il-karattri.
formal.en: The author authentically portrays everyday life through the dialogues between the characters.
formal.zh: 作者通过人物之间的对话，真实地呈现日常生活。

colloquial.zh: 莉娜：怎样才能把对话写得更好？马克：听听人们怎么说话，再真实地呈现他们的语言。

messages.speaker: Lina (写作学生)

messages.en: How can I write better dialogue?

messages.en: Listen to how people speak and represent their words authentically.

teaching_sense.en_definition: The process of checking that a person's identity, a document, or an item is genuine.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 核实某人的身份，或确认文件、物品真实可信的过程。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-proċess li bih jiġi vverifikat li l-identità ta' persuna, dokument jew oġġett hija ġenwina.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 身份验证；对文件或物品真实性的核验。

formal.mt: L-utenti jridu jlestu l-proċess ta' awtentikazzjoni qabel ma jidħlu fil-kont tagħhom.
formal.en: Users must complete the authentication process before accessing their account.
formal.zh: 用户必须完成身份验证流程，才能进入自己的账户。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex qed jitlobni kodiċi ieħor? Pawlu: Għall-awtentikazzjoni. Daħħal il-kodiċi li rċevejt fuq il-mowbajl.
colloquial.en: Lara: Why is it asking me for another code? Pawlu: For authentication. Enter the code you received on your mobile.
colloquial.zh: Lara：为什么还要我输入另一个验证码？Pawlu：这是为了验证身份。输入你手机收到的验证码。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The quality of being genuine or of truly being what something is claimed to be.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 确为真实事物或真品、与所声称的身份或来源相符的性质。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-kwalità ta' xi ħaġa li hija ġenwina u tassew dak li jingħad li hi.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 真实性；真确性；确为真品的性质。

formal.mt: Il-mużew talab ċertifikat ta' awtentiċità qabel ma xtara l-pittura.
formal.en: The museum requested a certificate of authenticity before buying the painting.
formal.zh: 博物馆在购买这幅画之前要求提供真品证书。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Kif nista' nkun naf li din il-pittura hija ġenwina? Toni: Itlob ċertifikat ta' awtentiċità.
colloquial.en: Maja: How can I know that this painting is genuine? Toni: Ask for a certificate of authenticity.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：我怎么知道这幅画是真品？托尼：要求对方提供真品证书。

messages.zh: 我怎么知道这幅画是真品？

messages.en: Ask for a certificate of authenticity.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象画作旁边放着一张真品证书，用 awtentiċità 给真实性这个抽象概念贴标签，记住它是名词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The freedom or power of a person, group, or institution to make its own decisions.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 个人、团体或机构自行作出决定、管理自身事务的自由或权力。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-libertà jew is-setgħa ta' persuna, grupp jew istituzzjoni li jieħdu d-deċiżjonijiet tagħhom stess.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 自主权；自治，即自行决定并管理自身事务的权力或状态。

formal.mt: L-istituzzjoni għandha awtonomija finanzjarja u tiddeċiedi kif tqassam il-baġit tagħha.
formal.en: The institution has financial autonomy and decides how to allocate its budget.
formal.zh: 该机构拥有财务自主权，可以决定如何分配自己的预算。

colloquial.mt: Maja: It-tim tagħkom irid jitlob permess għal kull deċiżjoni? Mark: Le, għandna biżżejjed awtonomija biex norganizzaw ix-xogħol tagħna.
colloquial.en: Maja: Does your team have to ask permission for every decision? Mark: No, we have enough autonomy to organize our work.
colloquial.zh: Maja：你们团队每作一个决定都得请示吗？Mark：不用，我们有足够的自主权来安排自己的工作。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: It-tim tagħkom irid jitlob permess għal kull deċiżjoni?
messages.mt_standard: It-tim tagħkom irid jitlob permess għal kull deċiżjoni?
messages.zh: 你们团队每作一个决定都得请示吗？

messages.speaker: Mark (团队成员)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, għandna biżżejjed awtonomija biex norganizzaw ix-xogħol tagħna.
messages.mt_standard: Le, għandna biżżejjed awtonomija biex norganizzaw ix-xogħol tagħna.
messages.zh: 不用，我们有足够的自主权来安排自己的工作。
messages.en: No, we have enough autonomy to organize our work.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象团队自己安排预算和日程：awtonomija 指拥有“自己作主”的权利或空间，是名词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Able or entitled to govern itself or make decisions independently.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 能够或有权自行管理、自主作出决定的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jista' jew għandu d-dritt imexxi lilu nnifsu jew jieħu deċiżjonijiet b'mod indipendenti.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 自主的；自治的；能够独立管理或作出决定的。

formal.mt: Il-korp awtonomu għandu s-setgħa jieħu deċiżjonijiet dwar l-amministrazzjoni interna tiegħu.
formal.en: The autonomous body has the power to make decisions about its internal administration.
formal.zh: 该自治机构有权就其内部行政事务作出决定。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Min jiddeċiedi kif jaħdem dan iċ-ċentru? Ġanni: Iċ-ċentru huwa awtonomu; il-bord tiegħu jieħu d-deċiżjonijiet.
colloquial.en: Sara: Who decides how this centre operates? Ġanni: The centre is autonomous; its board makes the decisions.
colloquial.zh: Sara：谁来决定这个中心如何运作？Ġanni：这个中心是自主运作的，由它自己的董事会作决定。

messages.speaker: Sara (访客)
messages.mt_spoken: Min jiddeċiedi kif jaħdem dan iċ-ċentru?
messages.mt_standard: Min jiddeċiedi kif jaħdem dan iċ-ċentru?

teaching_sense.en_definition: In a knowledgeable, confident manner that carries authority.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 以显得有专业知识、有把握且具有权威性的方式。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: B'mod li juri għarfien, kunfidenza u awtorità.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 权威地；以有知识、有把握、令人信服的方式。

collocations.zh: 以专业而有把握的方式解释

formal.mt: Fir-rapport tagħha, ir-riċerkatriċi tiddiskuti awtorevolment il-metodi użati fl-istudju.

messages.mt_standard: Iva, tkellmet awtorevolment u wieġbet il-mistoqsijiet kollha b'mod ċar.
messages.zh: 是的，她讲得专业而有把握，也清楚地回答了所有问题。

cognitive_memory_aid: 联想专家熟悉材料、从容回答的场景：这个副词说明“怎样说或解释”，重在专业且有权威感。

gloss_zh: 专制的；独断的；威权主义的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Demanding obedience and allowing little freedom to question decisions or act independently.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 要求他人服从，极少允许质疑决定或独立行动的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jitlob ubbidjenza u jħalli ftit libertà biex wieħed jikkontesta d-deċiżjonijiet jew jaġixxi b'mod indipendenti.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 专制的；独断的；强调服从并限制自主与异议的。

messages.mt_standard: Rari. Huwa awtoritarju ħafna u jrid li kulħadd jagħmel kif jgħid hu.
messages.zh: 很少。他很独断，希望所有人都照他说的做。
messages.en: Rarely. He is very authoritarian and wants everyone to do as he says.

teaching_sense.en_definition: To give official permission for an action or allow someone to do something.

teaching_sense.en_definition: Official permission to do something, or the act of granting that permission.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 做某事所需的正式许可，或授予这种许可的行为。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Permess uffiċjali biex issir xi ħaġa, jew l-att li bih jingħata dak il-permess.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 授权；许可；正式批准，或作出批准的行为。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A surname used as a person's family name.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 一个姓氏，写作 Axiak。

formal.zh: Axiak 先生将作为学校代表出席会议。

messages.speaker: Mark (学徒)

messages.speaker: Rita (车间师傅)

formal.mt: Matul il-laqgħa, l-istudent azzarda jipproponi soluzzjoni differenti.
formal.en: During the meeting, the student dared to propose a different solution.
formal.zh: 会议期间，那名学生鼓起勇气提出了不同的解决办法。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Ħadd ma staqsa għaliex? Toni: Pawlu azzarda jistaqsi, u l-għalliem spjega kollox.
colloquial.en: Maja: Didn't anyone ask why? Toni: Pawlu dared to ask, and the teacher explained everything.
colloquial.zh: Maja：没有人问为什么吗？Toni：Pawlu 鼓起勇气问了，老师就把事情都解释清楚了。

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.zh: 没有人问为什么吗？
messages.en: Didn't anyone ask why?

messages.speaker: Toni (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Pawlu azzarda jistaqsi, u l-għalliem spjega kollox.
messages.mt_standard: Pawlu azzarda jistaqsi, u l-għalliem spjega kollox.
messages.zh: Pawlu 鼓起勇气问了，老师就把事情都解释清楚了。
messages.en: Pawlu dared to ask, and the teacher explained everything.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象全班安静时有人终于举手提问，把 azzarda 连到“鼓起勇气跨出一步”，也可帮助记住冒险尝试的意味。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Resembling steel in appearance or quality.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在外观或性质上像钢的；具有钢一般特征的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu dehra jew kwalità bħall-azzar.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 似钢的；钢一般的。

formal.mt: Il-pannell għandu lewn azzari li jidher ċar taħt id-dawl abjad.
formal.en: The panel has a steely hue that is clearly visible under white light.
formal.zh: 这块面板具有钢一般的色泽，在白光下清晰可见。

colloquial.mt: Lara: X'lewn trid għall-qafas? Ben: Nixtieq lewn azzari, bħal dak tal-kampjun.
colloquial.en: Lara: What shade do you want for the frame? Ben: I'd like a steely shade, like the sample.
colloquial.zh: Lara：你想给框架选什么色调？Ben：我想要像样品那样的钢色。

messages.speaker: Lara (店员)
messages.zh: 你想给框架选什么色调？
messages.en: What shade do you want for the frame?

messages.speaker: Ben (顾客)
messages.mt_spoken: Nixtieq lewn azzari, bħal dak tal-kampjun.
messages.mt_standard: Nixtieq lewn azzari, bħal dak tal-kampjun.
messages.zh: 我想要像样品那样的钢色。
messages.en: I'd like a steely shade, like the sample.

cognitive_memory_aid: 看一张带有冷灰金属光泽的色卡，练习说 lewn azzari；把“像钢的外观”作为形容词的记忆画面。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Relating to stocks or shares in a company.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 与公司股票或股份有关的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu x'jaqsam mal-azzjonijiet f'kumpanija.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 股票的；股份的。

formal.mt: Ir-rapport annwali jinkludi taqsima dwar il-kapital azzjonarju tal-kumpanija.
formal.en: The annual report includes a section on the company's share capital.
formal.zh: 年度报告中有一节介绍公司的股本。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Fejn insib l-informazzjoni dwar il-kapital azzjonarju? Mark: Fir-rapport annwali, fit-taqsima dwar il-kumpanija.
colloquial.en: Nina: Where can I find the information about share capital? Mark: In the annual report, in the section about the company.
colloquial.zh: Nina：我在哪里能找到股本信息？Mark：在年度报告介绍公司的那一节里。

messages.speaker: Nina (实习生)
messages.mt_spoken: Fejn insib l-informazzjoni dwar il-kapital azzjonarju?
messages.mt_standard: Fejn insib l-informazzjoni dwar il-kapital azzjonarju?
messages.zh: 我在哪里能找到股本信息？
messages.en: Where can I find the information about share capital?

messages.speaker: Mark (同事)
messages.zh: 在年度报告介绍公司的那一节里。
messages.en: In the annual report, in the section about the company.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 azzjonarju 放在 kapital 后面记成“股份有关的资本＝股本”；它负责说明名词与股票、股份的关系。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person or organisation that owns shares in a company.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 持有公司股份的个人或组织。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna jew organizzazzjoni li għandha azzjonijiet f'kumpanija.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 股东；持有公司股份的个人或组织。

formal.mt: Waqt il-laqgħa, azzjonista tal-kumpanija talab spjegazzjoni dwar ir-riżultati annwali.
formal.en: During the meeting, a shareholder in the company requested an explanation of the annual results.
formal.zh: 会议期间，公司的一名股东要求对年度业绩作出说明。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Int taħdem ma' dik il-kumpanija? Pawlu: Le, jien azzjonista; għandi xi azzjonijiet fiha.
colloquial.en: Sara: Do you work for that company? Pawlu: No, I'm a shareholder; I own some shares in it.
colloquial.zh: Sara：你在那家公司工作吗？Pawlu：不是，我是股东，持有它的一些股份。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 你在那家公司工作吗？
messages.en: Do you work for that company?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (股东)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, jien azzjonista; għandi xi azzjonijiet fiha.
messages.mt_standard: Le, jien azzjonista; għandi xi azzjonijiet fiha.
messages.zh: 不是，我是股东，持有它的一些股份。
messages.en: No, I'm a shareholder; I own some shares in it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一个人手里拿着公司的股份凭证，给人物贴上 azzjonista 标签；抓住“持有股份的人或组织”来记股东。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A surname used to identify a person or family.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一个姓氏，用来标识个人或家族，中文可音译为“阿佐帕尔迪”。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kunjom li jidentifika persuna jew familja.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 姓氏；阿佐帕尔迪。

formal.mt: Is-Sur Azzopardi se jattendi l-laqgħa bħala rappreżentant tal-iskola.
formal.en: Mr Azzopardi will attend the meeting as the school's representative.
formal.zh: 阿佐帕尔迪先生将作为学校代表出席会议。

colloquial.mt: Marija: X'kunjom għandek? Pawlu: Azzopardi. Marija: Tajjeb, nikteb Pawlu Azzopardi.
colloquial.en: Marija: What's your surname? Pawlu: Azzopardi. Marija: All right, I'll write Pawlu Azzopardi.
colloquial.zh: 玛丽娅：你姓什么？保罗：阿佐帕尔迪。玛丽娅：好的，我写“保罗·阿佐帕尔迪”。

messages.speaker: Marija (接待员)
messages.zh: 你姓什么？
messages.en: What's your surname?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (访客)
messages.zh: 阿佐帕尔迪。
messages.en: Azzopardi.

messages.speaker: Marija (接待员)
messages.zh: 好的，我写“保罗·阿佐帕尔迪”。
messages.en: All right, I'll write Pawlu Azzopardi.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 Azzopardi 放进“姓名登记表”的姓氏栏，与完整姓名 Pawlu Azzopardi 一起记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The degree to which a substance is acidic, or its acidic quality.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 物质呈酸性的程度，或其所具有的酸性。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-grad ta' kemm sustanza hija aċiduża, jew il-kwalità aċiduża tagħha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 酸度；酸性；物质的酸性程度。

formal.mt: L-istudenti qabblu l-aċidità ta' żewġ kampjuni tal-ilma waqt l-esperiment.
formal.en: The students compared the acidity of two water samples during the experiment.
formal.zh: 学生们在实验中比较了两份水样的酸度。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Kif sibt dan il-meraq? Pawlu: Għandu aċidità għolja wisq għalija. Marija: Tippreferi meraq inqas qares? Pawlu: Iva, hekk nieħu aktar gost bih.
colloquial.en: Marija: How did you find this juice? Pawlu: Its acidity is too high for me. Marija: Do you prefer less sour juice? Pawlu: Yes, I enjoy it more that way.
colloquial.zh: 玛丽娅：你觉得这果汁怎么样？保罗：对我来说，它的酸度太高了。玛丽娅：你更喜欢不那么酸的果汁吗？保罗：对，那样我喝着更喜欢。

messages.speaker: Marija (朋友)
messages.zh: 你觉得这果汁怎么样？
messages.en: How did you find this juice?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.zh: 对我来说，它的酸度太高了。
messages.en: Its acidity is too high for me.

messages.speaker: Marija (朋友)
messages.zh: 你更喜欢不那么酸的果汁吗？
messages.en: Do you prefer less sour juice?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, hekk nieħu aktar gost bih.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, hekk nieħu aktar gost bih.
messages.zh: 对，那样我喝着更喜欢。
messages.en: Yes, I enjoy it more that way.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象给两杯果汁贴上“酸度高”和“酸度低”的标签，记住 aċidità 表示酸的程度；词尾 à 的重音符号也要保留。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A chemical substance classified as an acid, such as the acid found in lemons.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 酸，一类化学物质，例如柠檬中含有的柠檬酸。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Sustanza kimika tat-tip li jinkludi l-aċidu li jinsab fil-lumi.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 酸；酸性物质

formal.mt: Il-lumi fih l-aċidu ċitriku, li jagħtih it-togħma qarsa tiegħu.
formal.en: Lemons contain citric acid, which gives them their sour taste.
formal.zh: 柠檬含有柠檬酸，因此带有酸味。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex il-lumi għandu togħma qarsa? Pawlu: Għax fih l-aċidu ċitriku.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why do lemons taste sour? Pawlu: Because they contain citric acid.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：柠檬为什么是酸的？保罗：因为里面含有柠檬酸。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.zh: 柠檬为什么是酸的？
messages.en: Why do lemons taste sour?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (老师)
messages.zh: 因为里面含有柠檬酸。
messages.en: Because they contain citric acid.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 aċidu 与“柠檬里的酸这种物质”一起记，注意它是名词，不是单纯描述酸味的形容词。

gloss_zh: 经加酸处理的；调成微酸的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Made slightly acidic or sour by adding an acid or an acidic ingredient.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 通过加入酸或酸性配料而变得略带酸性的、微酸的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li sar kemxejn aċiduż biż-żieda ta' aċidu jew ta' ingredjent qares.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 经加酸处理的；通过加入酸性成分而调成微酸的

collocations.zh: 加酸处理的水；调成微酸的水

formal.mt: Ir-riċetta titlob ilma aċidulat bi ftit meraq tal-lumi.
formal.en: The recipe calls for water acidulated with a little lemon juice.
formal.zh: 这份食谱要求使用加入少量柠檬汁调成微酸的水。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Dan l-ilma għaliex hu ftit qares? Toni: Huwa aċidulat; żidtlu ftit meraq tal-lumi.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why is this water a little sour? Toni: It is acidulated; I added a little lemon juice.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这水为什么有点酸？托尼：这是调成微酸的水，我加了一点柠檬汁。

messages.speaker: Maja (烹饪学员)
messages.mt_spoken: Dan l-ilma għaliex hu ftit qares?
messages.mt_standard: Dan l-ilma għaliex hu ftit qares?
messages.zh: 这水为什么有点酸？
messages.en: Why is this water a little sour?

messages.speaker: Toni (厨师)
messages.mt_spoken: Huwa aċidulat; żidtlu ftit meraq tal-lumi.
messages.mt_standard: Huwa aċidulat; żidtlu ftit meraq tal-lumi.
messages.zh: 这是调成微酸的水，我加了一点柠檬汁。
messages.en: It is acidulated; I added a little lemon juice.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象往一杯水里加几滴柠檬汁：aċidulat 强调“经过加酸而变微酸”的状态。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Having an acidic character or a sour taste.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 具有酸性或带有酸味的，用来描述物质的性质或食物的味道。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu natura aċida jew togħma qarsa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 酸性的；酸的；带酸味的

formal.mt: Il-meraq għandu togħma aċiduża li tinħass mill-ewwel.
formal.en: The juice has a sour taste that is immediately noticeable.
formal.zh: 这种果汁带有一入口就能察觉的酸味。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Kif sibtu l-meraq? Mark: Ftit aċiduż għalija, imma jogħġobni.
colloquial.en: Lara: How did you find the juice? Mark: A little sour for me, but I like it.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：你觉得这果汁怎么样？马克：对我来说有点酸，不过我喜欢。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 你觉得这果汁怎么样？
messages.en: How did you find the juice?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 对我来说有点酸，不过我喜欢。
messages.en: A little sour for me, but I like it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 喝果汁后说“有点酸”，就联想 aċiduż；它描述酸的性质或味道，本身不说明是否加过酸。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To increase speed or make something happen more quickly.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 提高速度，或使某个过程进行得更快。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Iżid il-veloċità jew jagħmel proċess jimxi aktar malajr.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 加速；使速度提高或进程加快。

formal.mt: It-tim aċċelera l-proċess ta' verifika biex itemm ix-xogħol fil-ħin.
formal.en: The team accelerated the verification process to finish the work on time.
formal.zh: 团队加快了核查进程，以按时完成工作。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Għaliex il-karozza mxiet aktar malajr? Pawlu: Ix-xufier aċċelera ftit. Marija: Issa se jnaqqas il-veloċità? Pawlu: Iva, qed noqorbu lejn id-dawra.
colloquial.en: Marija: Why did the car go faster? Pawlu: The driver accelerated a little. Marija: Is he going to slow down now? Pawlu: Yes, we're approaching the bend.
colloquial.zh: 玛丽娅：车为什么开快了？保罗：司机稍微加了速。玛丽娅：他现在要减速了吗？保罗：对，我们快到弯道了。

messages.speaker: Marija (乘客)
messages.zh: 车为什么开快了？
messages.en: Why did the car go faster?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同行乘客)
messages.zh: 司机稍微加了速。
messages.en: The driver accelerated a little.

messages.speaker: Marija (乘客)
messages.zh: 他现在要减速了吗？
messages.en: Is he going to slow down now?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同行乘客)
messages.zh: 对，我们快到弯道了。
messages.en: Yes, we're approaching the bend.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 aċċelera 配上速度表指针上升的画面；车速可以加快，工作进程也可以加快，核心都是“更快”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A device that increases speed, especially the accelerator pedal in a vehicle.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用来提高速度的装置，日常驾驶语境中常指汽车的油门踏板。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Apparat li jżid il-veloċità, speċjalment il-pedala f'vettura li tintuża biex iżżid il-veloċità.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 加速器；在汽车语境中指油门或油门踏板。

formal.mt: Il-manwal jispjega kif il-pedala tal-aċċeleratur tintuża biex tiżdied il-veloċità tal-vettura.
formal.en: The manual explains how the accelerator pedal is used to increase the vehicle's speed.
formal.zh: 手册说明了如何使用油门踏板提高车速。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Liema pedala hi l-aċċeleratur? Pawlu: Dik fuq il-lemin. Marija: U dik fin-nofs? Pawlu: Dik hi l-brejk.
colloquial.en: Marija: Which pedal is the accelerator? Pawlu: The one on the right. Marija: And the one in the middle? Pawlu: That's the brake.
colloquial.zh: 玛丽娅：哪个踏板是油门？保罗：右边那个。玛丽娅：中间那个呢？保罗：那个是刹车。

messages.speaker: Marija (学车学员)
messages.zh: 哪个踏板是油门？
messages.en: Which pedal is the accelerator?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (驾驶教练)
messages.zh: 右边那个。
messages.en: The one on the right.

messages.speaker: Marija (学车学员)
messages.zh: 中间那个呢？
messages.en: And the one in the middle?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (驾驶教练)
messages.zh: 那个是刹车。
messages.en: That's the brake.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 aċċeleratur 写在油门踏板图片旁边，记作“帮助加速的装置”；与表示加速动作的 aċċelera 对照学习。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The process of increasing speed; in physics, the rate at which velocity changes over time.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 速度提高的过程；在物理学中也指速度随时间变化的快慢，即加速度。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-proċess ta' żieda fil-veloċità; fil-fiżika, ir-rata li biha l-veloċità tinbidel maż-żmien.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 加速；加速度，即速度随时间的变化率。

formal.mt: Fl-esperiment, il-karrettun mexa b'aċċelerazzjoni kostanti tul il-binarju.
formal.en: In the experiment, the trolley moved along the track with constant acceleration.
formal.zh: 实验中，小车以恒定加速度沿轨道运动。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Kif sibtha l-karozza l-ġdida? Pawlu: Għandha aċċelerazzjoni tajba. Marija: Jiġifieri taqbad il-veloċità malajr? Pawlu: Iva, hekk hu.
colloquial.en: Marija: How did you find the new car? Pawlu: It has good acceleration. Marija: You mean it picks up speed quickly? Pawlu: Yes, that's right.
colloquial.zh: 玛丽娅：你觉得新车怎么样？保罗：它的加速性能很好。玛丽娅：你是说它提速很快？保罗：对，就是这个意思。

messages.speaker: Marija (朋友)
messages.zh: 你觉得新车怎么样？
messages.en: How did you find the new car?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (车主)
messages.zh: 它的加速性能很好。
messages.en: It has good acceleration.

messages.speaker: Marija (朋友)
messages.zh: 你是说它提速很快？
messages.en: You mean it picks up speed quickly?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (车主)
messages.zh: 对，就是这个意思。
messages.en: Yes, that's right.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“几秒内车速变化多少”的画面记 aċċelerazzjoni；它关注速度的变化，区别于某一时刻的车速。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To make a feature, difference, or point more noticeable or prominent.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使某个特点、差异或观点更加明显、突出。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jagħmel karatteristika, differenza jew punt aktar ċar jew aktar prominenti.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 强调；突出；使某种特点或差异更加明显。

formal.mt: L-użu ta' sfond skur aċċentwa l-kuntrast bejn il-kuluri fil-pittura.
formal.en: The use of a dark background accentuated the contrast between the colours in the painting.
formal.zh: 深色背景的使用加强了画中色彩之间的对比。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Għaliex għażilt dan il-qafas? Pawlu: Meta ppruvajtu, aċċentwa l-kuluri tar-ritratt. Marija: Iva, issa jidhru aktar ċari. Pawlu: Għalhekk għoġobni.
colloquial.en: Marija: Why did you choose this frame? Pawlu: When I tried it, it accentuated the colours in the photo. Marija: Yes, they look clearer now. Pawlu: That's why I liked it.
colloquial.zh: 玛丽娅：你为什么选这个相框？保罗：试用时，它让照片的色彩更突出了。玛丽娅：是啊，现在颜色看起来更清晰。保罗：所以我喜欢它。

messages.speaker: Marija (朋友)
messages.zh: 你为什么选这个相框？
messages.en: Why did you choose this frame?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.zh: 试用时，它让照片的色彩更突出了。
messages.en: When I tried it, it accentuated the colours in the photo.

messages.speaker: Marija (朋友)
messages.zh: 是啊，现在颜色看起来更清晰。
messages.en: Yes, they look clearer now.

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.zh: 所以我喜欢它。
messages.en: That's why I liked it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象用荧光笔把一个特点标得更醒目，以此记住 aċċentwa 的“突出”含义；色彩和差异都可以被突出。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Payment received for work; also charity given to someone in need or an act of kindness.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 因工作而获得的工资或报酬；也可表示给予有需要者的施舍，或待人的善意与善举。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ħlas mogħti għal xogħol; ukoll għajnuna mogħtija lil min hu fil-bżonn jew att ta' tjubija.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 工资、薪水、劳动报酬或雇用所付的费用。
给予贫困者或有需要者的施舍、救济。
善意、仁慈或善待他人的举动。

formal.mt: Il-kuntratt jispeċifika l-aġar li għandu jitħallas lill-ħaddiem kull xahar.
formal.en: The contract specifies the pay to be given to the worker each month.
formal.zh: 合同明确规定了每月应向工人支付的报酬。

colloquial.mt: Pawlu: L-aġar ta' dan ix-xogħol jitħallas kull ġimgħa? Lara: Le, jitħallas fl-aħħar ta' kull xahar.
colloquial.en: Pawlu: Is the pay for this job paid weekly? Lara: No, it is paid at the end of each month.
colloquial.zh: 保罗：这份工作的报酬每周发一次吗？拉拉：不是，是每个月月底发。

messages.speaker: Pawlu (求职者)
messages.mt_spoken: L-aġar ta' dan ix-xogħol jitħallas kull ġimgħa?
messages.mt_standard: L-aġar ta' dan ix-xogħol jitħallas kull ġimgħa?
messages.zh: 这份工作的报酬每周发一次吗？
messages.en: Is the pay for this job paid weekly?

messages.speaker: Lara (招聘人员)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, jitħallas fl-aħħar ta' kull xahar.
messages.mt_standard: Le, jitħallas fl-aħħar ta' kull xahar.
messages.zh: 不是，是每个月月底发。
messages.en: No, it is paid at the end of each month.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把三个义项配成三幅图：工作后领工资、向困者作施舍、对他人行善举；再用上下文判断是哪一种。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To make an action or process easier by helping it proceed or removing difficulties.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 通过提供帮助或减少困难，使某项行动或过程更容易进行。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jagħmel azzjoni jew proċess aktar faċli billi jgħin jew inaqqas id-diffikultajiet.

sense_translations.en_definition: to make something easy, to facilitate
sense_translations.zh_definition: 使某事更容易进行；为某事提供便利或促进其开展。

formal.mt: L-użu ta' formola waħda aġevola l-proċess tal-applikazzjoni u naqqas iż-żmien meħtieġ.
formal.en: Using a single form facilitated the application process and reduced the time required.
formal.zh: 使用一张统一表格使申请流程更便捷，并缩短了所需时间。

colloquial.mt: Maja: It-tabella l-ġdida aġevolat ix-xogħol tiegħek? Mark: Iva, issa nsib l-informazzjoni kollha f'post wieħed.
colloquial.en: Maja: Did the new table make your work easier? Mark: Yes, now I can find all the information in one place.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：新表格让你的工作更方便了吗？马克：是的，现在我在一个地方就能找到所有信息。

messages.speaker: Maja (同事)
messages.zh: 新表格让你的工作更方便了吗？
messages.en: Did the new table make your work easier?

messages.speaker: Mark (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, issa nsib l-informazzjoni kollha f'post wieħed.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, issa nsib l-informazzjoni kollha f'post wieħed.
messages.zh: 是的，现在我在一个地方就能找到所有信息。
messages.en: Yes, now I can find all the information in one place.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象有人把复杂手续整理成一张表：事情因此更容易做，便是这个动词所表达的意思。

gloss_zh: 便利；促进；使事情更易进行的帮助

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act or process of making an activity easier to carry out.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使一项活动更容易开展的行为或过程，即提供便利或促进。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att jew il-proċess li bih attività ssir aktar faċli biex titwettaq.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 提供便利；使活动或过程更容易进行的促进作用。

collocations.zh: 为进入或使用提供便利

formal.mt: Il-proġett għandu bħala għan l-aġevolment tal-aċċess għas-servizzi pubbliċi.
formal.en: The project aims to facilitate access to public services.
formal.zh: 该项目旨在让人们更便捷地使用公共服务。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Xi jfisser 'aġevolment' f'dan l-avviż? Toni: Ifisser li jagħmlu l-affarijiet aktar faċli; hawn qed jitkellmu dwar l-aċċess għas-servizz.
colloquial.en: Sara: What does 'aġevolment' mean in this notice? Toni: It means making things easier; here they are talking about access to the service.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：这则通知里的“aġevolment”是什么意思？托尼：就是让事情更容易；这里说的是让人更方便地使用这项服务。

messages.speaker: Sara (居民)
messages.zh: 这则通知里的“aġevolment”是什么意思？
messages.en: What does 'aġevolment' mean in this notice?

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ifisser li jagħmlu l-affarijiet aktar faċli; hawn qed jitkellmu dwar l-aċċess għas-servizz.
messages.mt_standard: Ifisser li jagħmlu l-affarijiet aktar faċli; hawn qed jitkellmu dwar l-aċċess għas-servizz.
messages.zh: 就是让事情更容易；这里说的是让人更方便地使用这项服务。
messages.en: It means making things easier; here they are talking about access to the service.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把它放进“提供便利这件事”的名词框里记：例如简化手续、方便进入，都可体现这种促进作用。

gloss_zh: 现代的；跟上时代的；最新的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Modern or up to date, reflecting current information, practices, or developments.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 现代的或与时俱进的；反映当前信息、做法或发展情况的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Modern jew li jirrifletti l-aħħar informazzjoni, prattiki jew żviluppi.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 现代的；符合当前情况或包含最新信息的。

formal.mt: Il-kumitat jeħtieġ rapport aġġorn dwar l-ispejjeż qabel jieħu deċiżjoni.
formal.en: The committee needs an up-to-date report on costs before making a decision.
formal.zh: 委员会在作出决定前，需要一份反映最新费用情况的报告。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Dan ir-rapport aġġorn? Pawlu: Iva, fih ukoll iċ-ċifri ta' din il-ġimgħa.
colloquial.en: Lara: Is this report up to date? Pawlu: Yes, it also includes this week's figures.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：这份报告是最新的吗？保罗：是的，里面也包括了这周的数据。

messages.speaker: Lara (同事)
messages.zh: 这份报告是最新的吗？
messages.en: Is this report up to date?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, fih ukoll iċ-ċifri ta' din il-ġimgħa.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, fih ukoll iċ-ċifri ta' din il-ġimgħa.
messages.zh: 是的，里面也包括了这周的数据。
messages.en: Yes, it also includes this week's figures.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象报告的日期刚刚更新、内容跟得上今天：用“最新、跟上时代”的画面记住这个形容词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: In a better way or to a better degree than before or than something else.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 比先前或另一种情况做得更好，或在程度、状态上有所改善。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: B'mod jew fi grad aqwa minn qabel jew minn xi ħaġa oħra.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 更好地；用于表示行为表现或身体等状态比之前或另一种情况有所改善。

formal.mt: L-istudenti jifhmu aħjar il-kunċett meta l-ispjegazzjoni tkun akkumpanjata minn eżempji ċari.
formal.en: Students understand the concept better when the explanation is accompanied by clear examples.
formal.zh: 讲解配有清楚的例子时，学生能更好地理解这个概念。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Kif qed tħossok illum? Mark: Inħossni aħjar minn ieri; irnexxieli norqod sew.
colloquial.en: Maja: How are you feeling today? Mark: I feel better than yesterday; I managed to sleep well.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你今天感觉怎么样？马克：我感觉比昨天好多了，昨晚总算睡了个好觉。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你今天感觉怎么样？
messages.en: How are you feeling today?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Inħossni aħjar minn ieri; irnexxieli norqod sew.
messages.mt_standard: Inħossni aħjar minn ieri; irnexxieli norqod sew.
messages.zh: 我感觉比昨天好多了，昨晚总算睡了个好觉。
messages.en: I feel better than yesterday; I managed to sleep well.

cognitive_memory_aid: 在“昨天”和“今天”之间画一支向上的箭头，配着“感觉好些、理解更好”记住比较和改善的意思。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The Azerbaijani language.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 阿塞拜疆语这一语言的名称。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-isem tal-lingwa Ażerbajġana.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 阿塞拜疆语。

formal.mt: Dan il-kors joffri introduzzjoni għall-Ażerbajġani permezz ta' djalogi qosra.
formal.en: This course offers an introduction to Azerbaijani through short dialogues.
formal.zh: 本课程通过简短对话介绍阿塞拜疆语。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Liema lingwa qed titgħallem? Mark: Qed nitgħallem l-Ażerbajġani. Maja: Tista' tgħid xi ħaġa biha?
colloquial.en: Maja: Which language are you learning? Mark: I'm learning Azerbaijani. Maja: Can you say something in it?
colloquial.zh: Maja：你在学哪种语言？Mark：我在学阿塞拜疆语。Maja：你能用它说点什么吗？

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你在学哪种语言？
messages.en: Which language are you learning?

messages.speaker: Mark (语言学习者)
messages.zh: 我在学阿塞拜疆语。
messages.en: I'm learning Azerbaijani.

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你能用它说点什么吗？
messages.en: Can you say something in it?

cognitive_memory_aid: 把它放进“我在学某种语言”的句框中记忆；本词条专指阿塞拜疆语，看到语言课本就联想这个名称。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Protection granted by a country to a foreign person, or a safe place where someone can take refuge.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一国给予外国人的庇护身份；也指可供人躲避危险的安全处所。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Protezzjoni li pajjiż jagħti lil persuna barranija, jew post sigur fejn persuna tista' ssib kenn.

sense_translations.en_definition: asylum (status granted by a country to foreigners)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 庇护，指一国给予外国人的保护身份。
避难处；庇护所；可供躲避危险的安全场所。

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi l-każ ta' familja li ngħatat ażil fil-pajjiż.
formal.en: The report describes the case of a family that was granted asylum in the country.
formal.zh: 报告描述了一个家庭在该国获准庇护的案例。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Fejn sabet ażil il-familja waqt il-maltempata? Pawlu: Fid-dar tal-ġirien; hemmhekk kienu siguri.
colloquial.en: Sara: Where did the family find refuge during the storm? Pawlu: In the neighbours' house; they were safe there.
colloquial.zh: Sara：暴风雨期间，那家人在哪里避难？Pawlu：在邻居家；他们在那里很安全。

messages.speaker: Sara (邻居)
messages.mt_spoken: Fejn sabet ażil il-familja waqt il-maltempata?
messages.mt_standard: Fejn sabet ażil il-familja waqt il-maltempata?
messages.zh: 暴风雨期间，那家人在哪里避难？
messages.en: Where did the family find refuge during the storm?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (邻居)
messages.zh: 在邻居家；他们在那里很安全。
messages.en: In the neighbours' house; they were safe there.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两个画面区分义项：国家批给的庇护身份，以及风雨中能躲进去的安全房屋；两者都围绕获得保护。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Nitrogen; another word for nitroġenu.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 化学元素氮，与马耳他语 nitroġenu 同义。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-element kimiku magħruf ukoll bħala nitroġenu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 氮；nitroġenu 的同义词。

formal.mt: Fit-tabella tal-elementi, l-ażotu huwa indikat bis-simbolu N.
formal.en: In the table of elements, nitrogen is represented by the symbol N.
formal.zh: 在元素表中，氮用符号 N 表示。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Ażotu u nitroġenu huma l-istess ħaġa? David: Iva, huma żewġ ismijiet għall-istess element.
colloquial.en: Lara: Are ażotu and nitroġenu the same thing? David: Yes, they are two names for the same element.
colloquial.zh: Lara：ażotu 和 nitroġenu 是同一种东西吗？David：是的，它们是同一种元素的两个名称。

messages.speaker: Lara (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Ażotu u nitroġenu huma l-istess ħaġa?
messages.mt_standard: Ażotu u nitroġenu huma l-istess ħaġa?
messages.zh: ażotu 和 nitroġenu 是同一种东西吗？
messages.en: Are ażotu and nitroġenu the same thing?

messages.speaker: David (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, huma żewġ ismijiet għall-istess element.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, huma żewġ ismijiet għall-istess element.
messages.zh: 是的，它们是同一种元素的两个名称。
messages.en: Yes, they are two names for the same element.

cognitive_memory_aid: 在记忆卡上把 ażotu、nitroġenu 和中文“氮”并排写下，再配上符号 N，把两个名称连到同一个概念。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A preposition expressing an ingredient, means, accompanying feature, or quality; also used for multiplication.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 介词，表示所含配料、使用的工具或手段、伴随的特征及性质，也用于表示乘法中的“乘以”。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Prepożizzjoni li tindika ingredjent, mezz, ħaġa li takkumpanja jew kwalità; tintuża wkoll fil-multiplikazzjoni.

sense_translations.en_definition: with (chiefly an ingredient, means, concomitant, quality)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 用；带有；具有，主要用于引出配料、手段、伴随事物或性质。
乘以；用于说明乘法运算。

formal.mt: Aqra l-mistoqsija b'attenzjoni, imbagħad ikkalkula kemm jagħmlu tlieta b'erbgħa.
formal.en: Read the question carefully, then calculate three times four.
formal.zh: 仔细阅读题目，然后计算三乘以四。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Trid ħobż b'żejt taż-żebbuġa? Mark: Iva, u b'naqra melħ ukoll, jekk jogħġbok.
colloquial.en: Lara: Would you like bread with olive oil? Mark: Yes, and with a little salt too, please.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：你要配橄榄油的面包吗？马克：要，也请加一点盐。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 你要配橄榄油的面包吗？
messages.en: Would you like bread with olive oil?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, u b'naqra melħ ukoll, jekk jogħġbok.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, u b'naqra melħ ukoll, jekk jogħġbok.
messages.zh: 要，也请加一点盐。
messages.en: Yes, and with a little salt too, please.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 b' 想成连接后面内容的小钩子：面包“带着”油，动作“带着”小心；遇到数字则联想乘号。

teaching_sense.en_definition: With strong interest, enthusiasm, or a keen desire for something to happen.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 带着强烈的兴趣、热情或期待，用来说明做某事或等待某事时的心情。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: B'interess u entużjażmu kbir, jew b'xewqa qawwija li jiġri xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 热切地；急切而满怀期待地。

formal.mt: L-istudenti stennew b'ħerqa l-bidu tal-workshop.
formal.en: The students eagerly awaited the start of the workshop.
formal.zh: 学生们热切地等待工作坊开始。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Qed tistenna l-vjaġġ b'ħerqa? Mark: Iva, ma nistax nistenna sa nhar is-Sibt!
colloquial.en: Sara: Are you eagerly looking forward to the trip? Mark: Yes, I can't wait until Saturday!
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：你很期待这次旅行吗？马克：是啊，我都等不及到星期六了！

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 你很期待这次旅行吗？
messages.en: Are you eagerly looking forward to the trip?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, ma nistax nistenna sa nhar is-Sibt!
messages.mt_standard: Iva, ma nistax nistenna sa nhar is-Sibt!
messages.zh: 是啊，我都等不及到星期六了！
messages.en: Yes, I can't wait until Saturday!

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象出发前抱着背包、满脸期待的自己，把 b'ħerqa 与“热切地等待”整组记住；它强调期待和热情。

gloss_zh: 好色的；热衷频繁性活动的
