teaching_sense.en_definition: Describing someone as lecherous or inclined to frequent sexual activity.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容某人好色，或有频繁进行性活动的倾向；用于评价他人时，措辞可能带有贬义。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu xewqa sesswali qawwija jew tendenza għal attività sesswali frekwenti.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 好色的；表现出强烈而令人反感的性欲的。
有频繁进行性活动的倾向的；热衷性活动的。

formal.mt: Fir-rumanz, l-awtur jiddeskrivi lill-protagonist bħala raġel badbiedi.
formal.en: In the novel, the author describes the protagonist as a lecherous man.
formal.zh: 在小说中，作者把主人公描写成一个好色的男人。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għoġbok il-protagonist tal-film? Mark: Le, kien badbiedi u l-kummenti tiegħu kienu jdejquni.
colloquial.en: Lara: Did you like the film's protagonist? Mark: No, he was lecherous, and his comments bothered me.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：你喜欢这部电影的主人公吗？马克：不喜欢，他很好色，说的话也让我反感。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 你喜欢这部电影的主人公吗？
messages.en: Did you like the film's protagonist?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, kien badbiedi u l-kummenti tiegħu kienu jdejquni.
messages.mt_standard: Le, kien badbiedi u l-kummenti tiegħu kienu jdejquni.
messages.zh: 不喜欢，他很好色，说的话也让我反感。
messages.en: No, he was lecherous, and his comments bothered me.

cognitive_memory_aid: 借小说人物评价记 badbiedi：人物总围着性话题打转，可联想“好色”；另一义强调性活动频繁。

gloss_zh: 抛光工具；抛光机；抛光者

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person or tool that buffs a surface to make it smooth or shiny.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 通过擦磨使表面光滑或发亮的人或工具，例如抛光者、抛光工具或抛光机。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna jew għodda li tagħti l-lostru lil wiċċ biex isir lixx jew ileqq.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 抛光者；用于擦亮、磨光表面的工具或机器。

formal.mt: It-tekniku uża bafer elettriku biex jagħti l-lostru lill-wiċċ tal-metall.
formal.en: The technician used an electric buffer to polish the metal surface.
formal.zh: 技术人员使用电动抛光机对金属表面进行抛光。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Għandek bafer għall-karozza? Ġanni: Iva, qiegħed fuq l-ixkaffa. Trid tagħtiha l-lostru? Mark: Iva, illum għandi ftit ħin.
colloquial.en: Mark: Do you have a car buffer? Ġanni: Yes, it's on the shelf. Are you going to polish it? Mark: Yes, I've got some time today.
colloquial.zh: 马克：你有汽车抛光机吗？詹尼：有，在架子上。你想给车抛光吗？马克：是的，我今天有点时间。

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 你有汽车抛光机吗？
messages.en: Do you have a car buffer?

messages.speaker: Ġanni (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, qiegħed fuq l-ixkaffa. Trid tagħtiha l-lostru?
messages.mt_standard: Iva, qiegħed fuq l-ixkaffa. Trid tagħtiha l-lostru?
messages.zh: 有，在架子上。你想给车抛光吗？
messages.en: Yes, it's on the shelf. Are you going to polish it?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 是的，我今天有点时间。
messages.en: Yes, I've got some time today.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 bafer 与“车身越擦越亮”的画面绑定，记住本词条里 buffer 指执行抛光的人或工具。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The European nettle tree, the tree species scientifically named Celtis australis.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 欧洲朴树，学名 Celtis australis，是一种树木。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Siġra tal-ispeċi magħrufa bl-isem xjentifiku Celtis australis.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 欧洲朴树，学名 Celtis australis。

collocations.en: leaves of the European nettle tree

formal.mt: L-istudenti osservaw siġra tal-bagular u niżżlu l-isem xjentifiku tagħha, Celtis australis, fin-noti tagħhom.
formal.en: The students observed a European nettle tree and recorded its scientific name, Celtis australis, in their notes.
formal.zh: 学生们观察了一棵欧洲朴树，并在笔记中记下它的学名 Celtis australis。

colloquial.mt: Anna: X'jisimha dik is-siġra? Pawlu: Dik siġra tal-bagular. Anna: Ejja noqogħdu ftit taħtha.
colloquial.en: Anna: What's that tree called? Pawlu: That's a European nettle tree. Anna: Let's sit under it for a bit.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：那棵树叫什么？保罗：那是欧洲朴树。安娜：我们去树下坐一会儿吧。

messages.speaker: Anna (朋友)
messages.zh: 那棵树叫什么？
messages.en: What's that tree called?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.zh: 那是欧洲朴树。
messages.en: That's a European nettle tree.

messages.speaker: Anna (朋友)
messages.zh: 我们去树下坐一会儿吧。
messages.en: Let's sit under it for a bit.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象给树挂上一块三语名牌：bagular、欧洲朴树、European nettle tree，再用学名 Celtis australis 核对对应关系。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A strong feeling of hatred or intense dislike toward someone or something.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 对某人或某事怀有的仇恨或强烈厌恶。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Sentiment qawwi ta' mibegħda jew stmerrija lejn xi ħadd jew xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 仇恨；对人或事物怀有的敌意。
强烈的厌恶；非常不喜欢的感受。

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jispjega kif il-kliem ta' bagħda jista' jagħmel ħsara lir-relazzjonijiet bejn in-nies.
formal.en: The report explains how words of hatred can harm relationships between people.
formal.zh: 报告解释了充满仇恨的话语如何损害人与人之间的关系。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex hemm daqshekk bagħda bejniethom? Toni: Għadhom irrabjati minħabba l-ġlieda tal-bieraħ.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why is there so much hatred between them? Toni: They are still angry about yesterday's argument.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：他们之间为什么有这么深的仇恨？托尼：他们还在为昨天的争吵生气。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 他们之间为什么有这么深的仇恨？
messages.en: Why is there so much hatred between them?

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.zh: 他们还在为昨天的争吵生气。
messages.en: They are still angry about yesterday's argument.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 bagħda 放进两人争吵后互相敌视的画面中，记住它比普通的“不喜欢”更强烈。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The bird species called the pallid harrier, with the scientific name Circus macrourus.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 鸟类名称，指草原鹞，学名为 Circus macrourus。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Speċi ta' għasfur magħrufa bl-isem xjentifiku Circus macrourus.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 草原鹞（Circus macrourus）。

collocations.en: a photograph of a pallid harrier
a sighting of a pallid harrier

formal.mt: Fir-reġistru tal-osservazzjonijiet, l-istudent kiteb l-isem bagħdan abjad u l-isem xjentifiku Circus macrourus.
formal.en: In the observation log, the student wrote the name bagħdan abjad and the scientific name Circus macrourus.
formal.zh: 学生在观察记录中写下了马耳他语名称 bagħdan abjad，以及学名 Circus macrourus。

colloquial.mt: Lara: X'jismu l-għasfur f'dan ir-ritratt? Mark: Bagħdan abjad; fil-ktieb hemm ukoll l-isem Circus macrourus.
colloquial.en: Lara: What is the bird in this photograph called? Mark: A pallid harrier; the book also gives the name Circus macrourus.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：这张照片里的鸟叫什么？马克：草原鹞；书里还列出了学名 Circus macrourus。

messages.speaker: Lara (观鸟初学者)
messages.zh: 这张照片里的鸟叫什么？
messages.en: What is the bird in this photograph called?

messages.speaker: Mark (观鸟伙伴)
messages.mt_spoken: Bagħdan abjad; fil-ktieb hemm ukoll l-isem Circus macrourus.
messages.mt_standard: Bagħdan abjad; fil-ktieb hemm ukoll l-isem Circus macrourus.
messages.zh: 草原鹞；书里还列出了学名 Circus macrourus。
messages.en: A pallid harrier; the book also gives the name Circus macrourus.

cognitive_memory_aid: 制作一张三语卡片，把 bagħdan abjad、草原鹞和 pallid harrier 放在同一面，再用 Circus macrourus 核对物种。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The bird species called Montagu's harrier, with the scientific name Circus pygargus.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 鸟类名称，指乌灰鹞，学名为 Circus pygargus。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Speċi ta' għasfur magħrufa bl-isem xjentifiku Circus pygargus.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 乌灰鹞（Circus pygargus）。

collocations.en: a photograph of a Montagu's harrier
a sighting of a Montagu's harrier

formal.mt: Il-paġna tal-gwida tagħti l-isem bagħdan griż flimkien mal-isem xjentifiku Circus pygargus.
formal.en: The guidebook page gives the name bagħdan griż together with the scientific name Circus pygargus.
formal.zh: 指南的这一页同时列出了马耳他语名称 bagħdan griż 和学名 Circus pygargus。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Kif ngħid Montagu's harrier bil-Malti? Pawlu: Bagħdan griż; tista' ssibu taħt Circus pygargus fil-gwida.
colloquial.en: Nina: How do I say Montagu's harrier in Maltese? Pawlu: Bagħdan griż; you can find it under Circus pygargus in the guide.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：Montagu's harrier 用马耳他语怎么说？保罗：Bagħdan griż；你可以在指南中按学名 Circus pygargus 找到它。

messages.speaker: Nina (语言学习者)
messages.zh: Montagu's harrier 用马耳他语怎么说？
messages.en: How do I say Montagu's harrier in Maltese?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (学习伙伴)
messages.mt_spoken: Bagħdan griż; tista' ssibu taħt Circus pygargus fil-gwida.
messages.mt_standard: Bagħdan griż; tista' ssibu taħt Circus pygargus fil-gwida.
messages.zh: Bagħdan griż；你可以在指南中按学名 Circus pygargus 找到它。
messages.en: Bagħdan griż; you can find it under Circus pygargus in the guide.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 bagħdan griż 与“乌灰鹞”成对朗读，再翻卡说出 Montagu's harrier，最后用 Circus pygargus 检查是否记混。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The bird species called the hen harrier, with the scientific name Circus cyaneus.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 鸟类名称，指白尾鹞，学名为 Circus cyaneus。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Speċi ta' għasfur magħrufa bl-isem xjentifiku Circus cyaneus.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 白尾鹞（Circus cyaneus）。

collocations.en: a photograph of a hen harrier
a sighting of a hen harrier

formal.mt: Fit-tabella tal-ismijiet, bagħdan ikħal jikkorrispondi għall-isem Ingliż hen harrier u għall-isem xjentifiku Circus cyaneus.
formal.en: In the table of names, bagħdan ikħal corresponds to the English name hen harrier and the scientific name Circus cyaneus.
formal.zh: 在名称对照表中，bagħdan ikħal 对应英语名称 hen harrier 和学名 Circus cyaneus。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Dan hu r-ritratt tal-bagħdan ikħal? Ġanni: Iva, u taħtu hemm miktub Circus cyaneus.
colloquial.en: Sara: Is this the photograph of the hen harrier? Ġanni: Yes, and Circus cyaneus is written underneath it.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：这是白尾鹞的照片吗？詹尼：是的，下面还写着 Circus cyaneus。

messages.speaker: Sara (观鸟初学者)
messages.zh: 这是白尾鹞的照片吗？
messages.en: Is this the photograph of the hen harrier?

messages.speaker: Ġanni (观鸟伙伴)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, u taħtu hemm miktub Circus cyaneus.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, u taħtu hemm miktub Circus cyaneus.
messages.zh: 是的，下面还写着 Circus cyaneus。
messages.en: Yes, and Circus cyaneus is written underneath it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 bagħdan ikħal、白尾鹞、hen harrier 写成一组三语标签，复习时用 Circus cyaneus 确认对应关系。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To cause someone to feel hatred or to create hatred between people.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使人产生仇恨，或在人与人之间引起敌意。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Iqajjem il-mibegħda f'xi ħadd jew bejn in-nies.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 引起仇恨；使人产生憎恨或敌意。

formal.mt: L-awtur juri kif id-diskors tal-karattru bagħgħad lin-nies kontra xulxin.
formal.en: The author shows how the character's speech made people hate one another.
formal.zh: 作者展示了这个人物的言论如何使人们彼此仇视。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'għamel dak il-kliem? Toni: Bagħgħad lill-ġirien; issa lanqas isellmu lil xulxin.
colloquial.en: Maja: What did those words do? Toni: They caused hatred among the neighbours; now they do not even greet one another.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：那些话造成了什么后果？托尼：它们使邻居之间产生了仇恨；现在他们连招呼都不打了。

messages.speaker: Maja (邻居)
messages.zh: 那些话造成了什么后果？
messages.en: What did those words do?

messages.speaker: Toni (邻居)
messages.mt_spoken: Bagħgħad lill-ġirien; issa lanqas isellmu lil xulxin.
messages.mt_standard: Bagħgħad lill-ġirien; issa lanqas isellmu lil xulxin.
messages.zh: 它们使邻居之间产生了仇恨；现在他们连招呼都不打了。
messages.en: They caused hatred among the neighbours; now they do not even greet one another.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“恶言使邻居反目”的因果画面记 bagħgħad：重点是造成仇恨这一动作，而 bagħda 表示仇恨这种感受。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To cause animals from different breeds or groups to breed with one another.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使不同品种或群体的动物相互交配繁殖。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Iġiegħel annimali ta' razez jew gruppi differenti jitgħammru bejniethom.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使杂交；促使不同品种或群体的动物相互交配繁殖。

collocations.en: caused animals from different groups to interbreed
collocations.zh: 使不同群体的动物相互交配繁殖

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi kif il-bidwi bagħgħal annimali ta' żewġ razez differenti.
formal.en: The report describes how the farmer caused animals of two different breeds to interbreed.
formal.zh: 报告描述了农民如何使两个不同品种的动物杂交。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Il-bidwi żamm iż-żewġ razez separati? Mark: Le, bagħgħal annimali miż-żewġ razez.
colloquial.en: Lara: Did the farmer keep the two breeds separate? Mark: No, he crossbred animals from the two breeds.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：农民把这两个品种分开饲养了吗？马克：没有，他让这两个品种的动物进行了杂交。

messages.speaker: Lara (农场访客)
messages.zh: 农民把这两个品种分开饲养了吗？
messages.en: Did the farmer keep the two breeds separate?

messages.speaker: Mark (农场工作人员)
messages.zh: 没有，他让这两个品种的动物进行了杂交。
messages.en: No, he crossbred animals from the two breeds.

cognitive_memory_aid: 画两个标着不同品种的动物圈，再用箭头连到“杂交繁殖”，把 bagħgħal 记成促成这一过程的动作。

gloss_zh: 似粪的；具有粪便般特征的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Resembling dung in appearance or another noticeable quality.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在外观或其他明显性质上像粪便的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jixbah id-demel fid-dehra jew f'xi kwalità oħra li tinħass.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 似粪的；在外观或性质上像粪便的。

formal.mt: Fin-noti tal-osservazzjoni, il-kampjun huwa deskritt bħala materjal b'aspett bagħri.
formal.en: In the observation notes, the sample is described as material with a dunglike appearance.
formal.zh: 在观察笔记中，该样本被描述为具有粪便般外观的材料。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Kif tiddeskrivi l-lewn ta' dan it-taħlit? Pawlu: Għandu lewn bagħri; hekk niddeskrivih fin-noti.
colloquial.en: Nina: How would you describe the colour of this mixture? Pawlu: It has a dunglike colour; that is how I would describe it in the notes.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：你会怎样描述这份混合物的颜色？保罗：它的颜色像粪便；我会在笔记里这样描述。

messages.speaker: Nina (实验课学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Kif tiddeskrivi l-lewn ta' dan it-taħlit?
messages.mt_standard: Kif tiddeskrivi l-lewn ta' dan it-taħlit?
messages.zh: 你会怎样描述这份混合物的颜色？
messages.en: How would you describe the colour of this mixture?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (实验课同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandu lewn bagħri; hekk niddeskrivih fin-noti.
messages.mt_standard: Għandu lewn bagħri; hekk niddeskrivih fin-noti.
messages.zh: 它的颜色像粪便；我会在笔记里这样描述。
messages.en: It has a dunglike colour; that is how I would describe it in the notes.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 bagħri 写在“像粪便的颜色或外观”旁边，记住它是描述相似性质的形容词，不是粪便这个名词。

gloss_zh: 任务；探求之旅；解雇；遣退

teaching_sense.en_definition: A mission or quest that someone undertakes to achieve a particular purpose.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 为实现特定目的而承担的任务，或为寻找某物而进行的探求。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Missjoni jew tfittxija li xi ħadd iwettaq biex jilħaq għan partikolari.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 一项任务或使命；一次为达到目标而进行的探求。
一次解雇、免职或打发离开。
一次遣退或解除职务、责任。

collocations.zh: 一项艰难的任务或探求

formal.mt: Ir-rakkont isegwi l-bagħta ta' żagħżugħ li jfittex dokument mitluf.
formal.en: The story follows a young man's quest to find a lost document.
formal.zh: 故事讲述了一名年轻人为寻找遗失文件而展开的探求。

colloquial.mt: Sara: X'inhi l-bagħta tiegħek illum? Ġanni: Irrid insib ir-ritratt il-qadim tan-nannu.
colloquial.en: Sara: What is your mission today? Ġanni: I need to find Grandad's old photograph.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：你今天的任务是什么？詹尼：我要找到爷爷的那张老照片。

messages.speaker: Sara (姐姐)
messages.zh: 你今天的任务是什么？
messages.en: What is your mission today?

messages.speaker: Ġanni (弟弟)
messages.zh: 我要找到爷爷的那张老照片。
messages.en: I need to find Grandad's old photograph.

cognitive_memory_aid: 先用“寻找爷爷老照片的任务”记住 bagħta 的任务义，再另列“解雇”和“遣退”两张义项卡，阅读时依据语境选择。

gloss_zh: 喧闹活跃的；吵吵闹闹的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Noisy, lively, and full of energy, especially when describing a person or group.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容人或群体精力旺盛、活动热烈，同时比较喧闹。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jagħmel ħafna storbju u juri ħafna enerġija, speċjalment meta jingħad dwar persuna jew grupp.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 喧闹活跃的；精力旺盛而吵吵闹闹的

formal.mt: Il-karattru ewlieni tar-rakkont huwa tifel bahradi li jħobb jilgħab u jgħajjat ma' sħabu.
formal.en: The main character in the story is a boisterous boy who likes playing and shouting with his friends.
formal.zh: 故事的主人公是一个喧闹活跃的男孩，喜欢和朋友一起玩耍、大声叫喊。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex hemm daqshekk storbju fil-bitħa? Mark: Hemm grupp bahradi qed jilgħab bil-ballun.
colloquial.en: Lara: Why is there so much noise in the yard? Mark: There's a boisterous group playing ball.
colloquial.zh: Lara：院子里怎么这么吵？Mark：有一群吵吵闹闹的人正在玩球。

messages.speaker: Lara (邻居)
messages.zh: 院子里怎么这么吵？
messages.en: Why is there so much noise in the yard?

messages.speaker: Mark (邻居)
messages.mt_spoken: Hemm grupp bahradi qed jilgħab bil-ballun.
messages.mt_standard: Hemm grupp bahradi qed jilgħab bil-ballun.
messages.zh: 有一群吵吵闹闹的人正在玩球。
messages.en: There's a boisterous group playing ball.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 bahradi 配上院子里边跑边喊的男孩画面：既有旺盛精力，也有明显喧闹，不能只记成开心。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Mockery: words or behaviour that ridicule someone or something.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 嘲弄或嘲笑某人、某事的言语或行为。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kliem jew imġiba li bihom wieħed iwaqqa' lil xi ħadd jew lil xi ħaġa għaċ-ċajt.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 嘲弄；嘲笑。

formal.mt: L-għalliem spjega li l-baja tista' tweġġa' lil min ikun qed jitgħallem.
formal.en: The teacher explained that mockery can hurt someone who is learning.
formal.zh: 老师解释说，嘲弄会伤害正在学习的人。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex tlaqt minn ħdejn il-grupp? Nina: Għax il-baja tagħhom weġġgħetni.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why did you leave the group? Nina: Because their mockery hurt me.
colloquial.zh: Maja：你为什么离开那群人？Nina：因为他们的嘲弄伤害了我。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你为什么离开那群人？
messages.en: Why did you leave the group?

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.zh: 因为他们的嘲弄伤害了我。
messages.en: Because their mockery hurt me.

cognitive_memory_aid: 画一幅有人被嘲笑后难过的场景，在笑声气泡里写 baja，把这个名词与嘲弄的言语和行为联系起来。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A surname used as a family name.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 姓氏 Bajada，用作个人姓名中的家族姓。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kunjom li jintuża bħala isem tal-familja.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 一个姓氏：Bajada。

formal.mt: Is-Sinjura Bajada talbet kopja tad-dokument.
formal.en: Ms Bajada requested a copy of the document.
formal.zh: Bajada 女士要求提供一份文件副本。

colloquial.mt: Rita: X'inhu kunjomok, jekk jogħġbok? Mark: Bajada. Tridni niktbu għalik?
colloquial.en: Rita: What's your surname, please? Mark: Bajada. Would you like me to write it down for you?
colloquial.zh: Rita：请问你姓什么？Mark：Bajada。需要我写给你吗？

messages.speaker: Rita (接待员)
messages.zh: 请问你姓什么？
messages.en: What's your surname, please?

messages.speaker: Mark (访客)
messages.zh: Bajada。需要我写给你吗？
messages.en: Bajada. Would you like me to write it down for you?

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象填写登记表，在姓氏一栏写 Bajada，再连读 is-Sur Bajada，把这个名称与称谓加姓氏的用法一起记住。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Somewhat white or pale in colour.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 颜色略带白色、显得发白的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu lewn xi ftit abjad.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 略白的；带白色的；发白的。

formal.mt: Il-kampjun għandu lewn bajdani li jidher aktar ċar fid-dawl naturali.
formal.en: The sample has a whitish hue that is more apparent in natural light.
formal.zh: 样品略带白色，这种色调在自然光下更明显。

colloquial.mt: Lara: X'lewn hu dan id-drapp? Maja: Bajdani. Ejja narawh ħdejn it-tieqa.
colloquial.en: Lara: What colour is this fabric? Maja: Whitish. Let's look at it by the window.
colloquial.zh: Lara：这块布是什么颜色的？Maja：有点发白。我们拿到窗边看看吧。

messages.speaker: Lara (顾客)
messages.zh: 这块布是什么颜色的？
messages.en: What colour is this fabric?

messages.speaker: Maja (店员)
messages.zh: 有点发白。我们拿到窗边看看吧。
messages.en: Whitish. Let's look at it by the window.

cognitive_memory_aid: 在色卡上选一格略带白色的颜色并写上 bajdani，配合 lewn bajdani 朗读，记住它表示颜色有些发白。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The white root of cape sorrel, the plant known in Maltese as Ħaxixa Ngliża.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指马耳他语称为 Ħaxixa Ngliża 的酢浆草的白色根。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-għerq abjad tal-pjanta magħrufa bħala l-Ħaxixa Ngliża.

sense_translations.en_definition: root of the cape sorrel (known as the Ħaxixa Ngliża), which is white in colour
sense_translations.zh_definition: 酢浆草（称为 Ħaxixa Ngliża）的根，颜色为白色。

collocations.en: the white root of cape sorrel
the white colour of the cape sorrel root

formal.mt: Fit-tpinġija tal-pjanta, il-bajdu jidher taħt il-weraq tal-Ħaxixa Ngliża.
formal.en: In the drawing of the plant, the white root appears below the leaves of the cape sorrel.
formal.zh: 在这幅植物图中，酢浆草的白色根画在叶子下方。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'inhu dan l-għerq abjad? Pawlu: Dan huwa l-bajdu tal-Ħaxixa Ngliża.
colloquial.en: Maja: What is this white root? Pawlu: This is the white root of cape sorrel, called bajdu.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这是什么白色的根？保罗：这是酢浆草的白色根，叫作 bajdu。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.zh: 这是什么白色的根？
messages.en: What is this white root?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (教师)
messages.zh: 这是酢浆草的白色根，叫作 bajdu。
messages.en: This is the white root of cape sorrel, called bajdu.

cognitive_memory_aid: 画一张酢浆草图，把白色根部圈出来并标上 bajdu，用“特定植物的白根”这个画面记忆词义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A pen used for writing.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用于书写的笔。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Pinna li tintuża għall-kitba.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 笔，指用于书写的工具。

formal.mt: L-istudent kiteb ismu fuq il-formola b'bajrow blu.
formal.en: The student wrote his name on the form with a blue pen.
formal.zh: 这名学生用一支蓝色的笔在表格上写下了自己的名字。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Tista' ssellifni bajrow? Mark: Iva, ħu dan il-bajrow blu.
colloquial.en: Maja: Can you lend me a pen? Mark: Yes, take this blue pen.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你能借我一支笔吗？马克：可以，拿这支蓝色的笔吧。

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.zh: 你能借我一支笔吗？
messages.en: Can you lend me a pen?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.zh: 可以，拿这支蓝色的笔吧。
messages.en: Yes, take this blue pen.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 bajrow 写在笔盒标签上，每次借笔时默念“Tista' ssellifni bajrow?”，让词语和拿笔的动作相连。

gloss_zh: 像熟无花果的；极软的；熟透的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Resembling ripe figs, very soft, or very ripe.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容像成熟无花果的，也可表示非常柔软或已经熟透。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jixbah it-tin misjur, jew li jkun artab ħafna jew misjur ħafna.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 像成熟无花果的。
非常柔软的；极软的。
非常成熟的；熟透的。

formal.mt: Il-frott kien bajtri, misjur ħafna u artab, u għalhekk ġie mmaniġġjat b'attenzjoni.
formal.en: The fruit was very ripe and soft, so it was handled carefully.
formal.zh: 这些水果已经熟透，质地柔软，因此搬放时十分小心。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Dan il-ħawħ bajtri? Mark: Iva, misjur ħafna u artab; żommu bil-mod.
colloquial.en: Maja: Are these peaches very ripe? Mark: Yes, they are very ripe and soft; hold them gently.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这些桃子熟透了吗？马克：对，熟透了，也很软；拿的时候轻一点。

messages.speaker: Maja (顾客)
messages.zh: 这些桃子熟透了吗？
messages.en: Are these peaches very ripe?

messages.speaker: Mark (水果摊主)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, misjur ħafna u artab; żommu bil-mod.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, misjur ħafna u artab; żommu bil-mod.
messages.zh: 对，熟透了，也很软；拿的时候轻一点。
messages.en: Yes, they are very ripe and soft; hold them gently.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用一颗熟软的无花果作记忆图：外观像熟无花果、触感极软、成熟程度很高，分别对应 bajtri 的三个义项。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A fig tree.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 无花果树，指这种树本身。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Siġra tat-tin.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 一棵无花果树；无花果树。

formal.mt: Il-pjanta tal-ġnien turi bajtrija ħdejn il-ħajt tat-tramuntana.
formal.en: The garden plan shows a fig tree beside the northern wall.
formal.zh: 花园平面图上标出，北侧围墙旁有一棵无花果树。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Fejn se niltaqgħu? Pawlu: Ħdejn il-bajtrija fil-ġnien.
colloquial.en: Maja: Where shall we meet? Pawlu: Beside the fig tree in the garden.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：我们在哪里碰面？保罗：在花园里的无花果树旁。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 我们在哪里碰面？
messages.en: Where shall we meet?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.zh: 在花园里的无花果树旁。
messages.en: Beside the fig tree in the garden.

cognitive_memory_aid: 在花园示意图上画一整棵无花果树，标注 bajtrija，再用“树下”和“树旁”两个位置短语巩固记忆。

gloss_zh: 懒散的；行动迟缓的（形容人）

teaching_sense.en_definition: Describing a person who is slothful or slow in acting.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容人懒散、做事拖沓或行动迟缓。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jingħad għal persuna għażżiena jew li ddum biex taġixxi.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 懒散的或迟缓的，用于形容人。

collocations.zh: 一个做事拖沓或懒散的工人

formal.mt: Fil-ġrajja, ir-raġel huwa deskritt bħala bajtru għax idum biex jibda kull biċċa xogħol.
formal.en: In the story, the man is described as sluggish because he takes a long time to start every task.
formal.zh: 故事把这个男人描写得十分拖沓，因为他开始做每件事都要磨蹭很久。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex għadna ma tlaqniex? Mark: Pawlu għadu qed ilesti; illum tassew bajtru.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why haven't we left yet? Mark: Pawlu is still getting ready; he is really slow today.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：我们怎么还没出发？马克：保罗还在收拾；他今天真是慢吞吞的。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 我们怎么还没出发？
messages.en: Why haven't we left yet?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Pawlu għadu qed ilesti; illum tassew bajtru.
messages.mt_standard: Pawlu għadu qed ilesti; illum tassew bajtru.
messages.zh: 保罗还在收拾；他今天真是慢吞吞的。
messages.en: Pawlu is still getting ready; he is really slow today.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象大家准备出门，一个人仍慢吞吞地收拾，把 bajtru 贴在这个人物旁，记住它形容人的懒散或迟缓。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To swallow something, to eat food greedily, or figuratively to believe what one is told too readily.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把东西吞下，也可表示狼吞虎咽地吃，或比喻轻易相信别人所说的话。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jgħaddi xi ħaġa mill-ħalq għall-istonku; jiekol bil-għaġla u bir-regħba; jew, figurattivament, jemmen malajr dak li jgħidulu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 吞咽；吞下。
狼吞虎咽地吃东西。

sense_translations.en_definition: to believe believe what one is told (suggesting gullibility)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 轻易相信别人告诉自己的话，含有轻信、容易受骗的意味。

collocations.zh: 他狼吞虎咽地吃下了食物
他把整套说辞都信以为真

formal.mt: Il-pazjent bala' l-pillola ma' ftit ilma.
formal.en: The patient swallowed the tablet with a little water.
formal.zh: 患者就着少量水吞下了药片。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Pawlu bala' l-istorja kollha? Mark: Iva, emmen kull kelma mingħajr ma staqsa xejn.
colloquial.en: Maja: Did Pawlu swallow the whole story? Mark: Yes, he believed every word without asking anything.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：保罗把整套说辞都信了？马克：对，他一句也没问，就相信了每一个字。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 保罗把整套说辞都信了？
messages.en: Did Pawlu swallow the whole story?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, emmen kull kelma mingħajr ma staqsa xejn.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, emmen kull kelma mingħajr ma staqsa xejn.
messages.zh: 对，他一句也没问，就相信了每一个字。
messages.en: Yes, he believed every word without asking anything.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“吞”串联三个画面：吞药片、快速吞食物、把别人的话整个吞进去；最后一个画面帮助记住“轻信”的比喻义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who talks a lot; a chatterbox.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指爱说个不停的人，类似汉语中的“话匣子”。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li titkellem ħafna u ma tieqafx tpaċpaċ.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 话匣子；喋喋不休的人。

formal.mt: Fir-rakkont, Pawlu huwa balbiel li dejjem isib xi ħaġa x'jgħid.
formal.en: In the story, Pawlu is a chatterbox who always finds something to say.
formal.zh: 在故事中，保罗是个话匣子，总能找到话说。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Pawlu għadu jitkellem? Mark: Iva, dak balbiel kbir; dejjem għandu xi ħaġa x'jgħid.
colloquial.en: Maja: Is Pawlu still talking? Mark: Yes, he's a real chatterbox; he always has something to say.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：保罗还在说啊？马克：对，他可是个十足的话匣子，总有话说。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 保罗还在说啊？
messages.en: Is Pawlu still talking?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, dak balbiel kbir; dejjem għandu xi ħaġa x'jgħid.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, dak balbiel kbir; dejjem għandu xi ħaġa x'jgħid.
messages.zh: 对，他可是个十足的话匣子，总有话说。
messages.en: Yes, he's a real chatterbox; he always has something to say.

cognitive_memory_aid: 画一个人物，身边冒出一串接一串的对话气泡，在人物下写 balbiel；记住这是给“话多的人”起的名词称呼。

gloss_zh: 喋喋不休却言之无物的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Describing someone who chatters senselessly, saying a lot without sensible content.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容一个人说个不停，但所说的话缺乏意义或条理。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jingħad għal xi ħadd li jpaċpaċ ħafna bla sens.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 形容某人喋喋不休、说话缺乏意义。

collocations.zh: 一个喋喋不休却言之无物的男人

collocations.en: to be given to senseless chatter
collocations.zh: 说起话来喋喋不休而缺乏意义

formal.mt: Fil-ġrajja, il-ġar huwa deskritt bħala balbieli għax jitkellem fit-tul mingħajr ma jgħid xejn ta' sens.
formal.en: In the story, the neighbour is described as given to senseless chatter because he talks at length without saying anything sensible.
formal.zh: 故事把这位邻居描写成喋喋不休却言之无物的人，因为他说了很久，也没说出什么有意义的话。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'ried jgħid Pawlu? Mark: Ma nafx; illum kien balbieli u ma qal xejn ta' sens.
colloquial.en: Maja: What was Pawlu trying to say? Mark: I don't know; today he kept chattering without saying anything sensible.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：保罗到底想说什么？马克：我不知道；他今天一直絮絮叨叨，也没说出什么有意义的话。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 保罗到底想说什么？
messages.en: What was Pawlu trying to say?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ma nafx; illum kien balbieli u ma qal xejn ta' sens.
messages.mt_standard: Ma nafx; illum kien balbieli u ma qal xejn ta' sens.
messages.zh: 我不知道；他今天一直絮絮叨叨，也没说出什么有意义的话。
messages.en: I don't know; today he kept chattering without saying anything sensible.

cognitive_memory_aid: 在说话者身旁画很多气泡，气泡里却只有杂乱线条，用这个画面记住 balbieli 既强调说个不停，也强调内容缺乏意义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To become weaker or less intense, or to die down.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 力量或强度变小；逐渐减弱或平息。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jonqos fil-qawwa jew fl-intensità; jikkalma.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 减弱；变得较无力。
逐渐平息；强度逐渐降低。

formal.mt: Ir-riħ balka matul il-lejl, u filgħodu l-baħar kien aktar kalm.
formal.en: The wind died down during the night, and in the morning the sea was calmer.
formal.zh: 夜间风势减弱，早上海面更加平静。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Ir-riħ balka? Nistgħu noħorġu? Mark: Iva, issa hu ħafna aktar kalm.
colloquial.en: Maja: Has the wind died down? Can we go out? Mark: Yes, it's much calmer now.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：风小了吗？我们能出去了吗？马克：能，现在平静多了。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 风小了吗？我们能出去了吗？
messages.en: Has the wind died down? Can we go out?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, issa hu ħafna aktar kalm.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, issa hu ħafna aktar kalm.
messages.zh: 能，现在平静多了。
messages.en: Yes, it's much calmer now.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 balka 配上风声渐轻的画面：从呼呼作响到轻轻吹动，记住“减弱、平息”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To force someone to swallow something, or figuratively to make someone believe a falsehood.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 强使某人吞下某物；也比喻让某人相信虚假的说法。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Iġiegħel lil xi ħadd jibla' xi ħaġa, jew, b'mod figurattiv, jemmen gidba.

sense_translations.en_definition: to force sb. to swallow sth.
sense_translations.zh_definition: 强使某人吞下某物。

sense_translations.en_definition: to make sb. believe a falsehood
sense_translations.zh_definition: 使某人相信谎言；把虚假说法灌输给某人。

collocations.en: forced someone to swallow the food

collocations.zh: 使某人相信了一个谎言

formal.mt: Il-qarrieq balla' storja falza lill-vittma biex jikseb il-flus tagħha.
formal.en: The fraudster made the victim believe a false story in order to obtain her money.
formal.zh: 骗子让受害者相信了一套虚假的说辞，以骗取她的钱。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex Paul ħallas? Mark: Xi ħadd balla' gidba lilu, u ħaseb li l-biljetti kienu veri.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why did Paul pay? Mark: Someone made him believe a lie, and he thought the tickets were real.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：保罗为什么付钱了？马克：有人让他信了谎话，他以为那些票是真的。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 保罗为什么付钱了？
messages.en: Why did Paul pay?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Xi ħadd balla' gidba lilu, u ħaseb li l-biljetti kienu veri.
messages.mt_standard: Xi ħadd balla' gidba lilu, u ħaseb li l-biljetti kienu veri.
messages.zh: 有人让他信了谎话，他以为那些票是真的。
messages.en: Someone made him believe a lie, and he thought the tickets were real.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用中文“硬让人吞下”串联两个意思：可以吞下食物，也可以比喻吞下谎言、信以为真。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A wooden implement used to crush material or ram it down.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用于捣碎材料或将材料夯实的一种木制工具。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Għodda tal-injam li tintuża biex tfarrak materjal jew trossu bid-daqqiet.

sense_translations.en_definition: a beetle, a type of wooden tool for crushing or ramming
sense_translations.zh_definition: 木夯或重型木槌，一种用于捣碎或夯实材料的木制工具。

collocations.en: to compact the material with a wooden rammer

formal.mt: Il-ħaddiem uża ballata tal-injam biex iross il-materjal bid-daqqiet.
formal.en: The worker used a wooden rammer to compact the material with repeated blows.
formal.zh: 工人用木夯反复敲击，将材料夯实。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Fejn hi l-ballata? Għandi bżonn inross dan il-materjal. Pawlu: Ħdejn il-bank tax-xogħol; dik il-kbira tal-injam.
colloquial.en: Mark: Where's the rammer? I need to compact this material. Pawlu: Beside the workbench; the big wooden one.
colloquial.zh: 马克：木夯在哪儿？我得把这些材料夯实。保罗：在工作台旁边，就是那个大的木制工具。

messages.speaker: Mark (工人)
messages.mt_spoken: Fejn hi l-ballata? Għandi bżonn inross dan il-materjal.
messages.mt_standard: Fejn hi l-ballata? Għandi bżonn inross dan il-materjal.
messages.zh: 木夯在哪儿？我得把这些材料夯实。
messages.en: Where's the rammer? I need to compact this material.

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Ħdejn il-bank tax-xogħol; dik il-kbira tal-injam.
messages.mt_standard: Ħdejn il-bank tax-xogħol; dik il-kbira tal-injam.
messages.zh: 在工作台旁边，就是那个大的木制工具。
messages.en: Beside the workbench; the big wooden one.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一把沉重木槌不断捣压材料，记住 ballata 是工具；英文释义中的 beetle 在这里也指工具。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Used for ramming material or involving its compaction by repeated blows.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用于夯压材料的，或涉及通过反复撞击将材料夯实的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jintuża biex iross il-materjal bid-daqqiet, jew li jinvolvi dan ix-xogħol.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 夯压的；用于撞压、夯实材料的。

formal.mt: It-tagħmir ballati jintuża biex il-materjal isir aktar kompatt permezz ta' daqqiet ripetuti.
formal.en: Ramming equipment is used to make material more compact through repeated blows.
formal.zh: 夯压设备通过反复撞击，使材料更加密实。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Xi jfisser tagħmir ballati? Pawlu: Tagħmir biex tross il-materjal bid-daqqiet.
colloquial.en: Maja: What does ramming equipment mean? Pawlu: Equipment for compacting material with repeated blows.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：“夯压设备”是什么意思？保罗：就是通过反复撞击把材料夯实的设备。

messages.speaker: Maja (学徒)
messages.zh: “夯压设备”是什么意思？
messages.en: What does ramming equipment mean?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (师傅)
messages.zh: 就是通过反复撞击把材料夯实的设备。
messages.en: Equipment for compacting material with repeated blows.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 ballati 放在设备或作业旁记忆：它描述“用于夯压的”，学习时把形容词与具体工具名分开。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A hot-air balloon; also a disparaging expression for a fat person.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 热气球；也可用作对胖人的贬称，称呼他人时可能具有侮辱性。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ballun kbir li jitla' fl-arja bl-arja sħuna; ukoll espressjoni dispreġjattiva għal persuna ħoxna.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 热气球。
胖子；用于指人时带有贬损意味。

collocations.en: a hot-air balloon in the sky

formal.mt: Ir-ritratt juri ballun baraxx fl-ajru fuq l-għelieqi.
formal.en: The photograph shows a hot-air balloon in the sky above the fields.
formal.zh: 照片中，一个热气球飘浮在田野上空。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Ara dak il-ballun baraxx fuq l-għelieqi! Mark: Rajtu! Nixtieq nagħmel titjira fih xi darba.
colloquial.en: Maja: Look at that hot-air balloon above the fields! Mark: I see it! I'd like to take a flight in one someday.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：看田野上空那个热气球！马克：看到了！我希望哪天也能坐一次。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ara dak il-ballun baraxx fuq l-għelieqi!
messages.mt_standard: Ara dak il-ballun baraxx fuq l-għelieqi!
messages.zh: 看田野上空那个热气球！
messages.en: Look at that hot-air balloon above the fields!

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Rajtu! Nixtieq nagħmel titjira fih xi darba.
messages.mt_standard: Rajtu! Nixtieq nagħmel titjira fih xi darba.
messages.zh: 看到了！我希望哪天也能坐一次。
messages.en: I see it! I'd like to take a flight in one someday.

cognitive_memory_aid: 先用田野上空的大热气球记住本义，再把指人的意思标上“贬称”，理解时辨认，称呼人时避免使用。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The English oak, the tree species with the scientific name Quercus robur.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 夏栎，又称英国栎，学名为 Quercus robur 的树种。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Is-siġra tal-ballut magħrufa bl-isem xjentifiku Quercus robur.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 夏栎，又称英国栎，学名 Quercus robur。

formal.mt: Fil-katalgu tal-ġnien botaniku, il-ballut Ingliż huwa elenkat bl-isem xjentifiku Quercus robur.
formal.en: In the botanical garden's catalogue, the English oak is listed under the scientific name Quercus robur.
formal.zh: 在植物园的名录中，夏栎以学名 Quercus robur 列出。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'siġra hi din? Mark: Ballut Ingliż. Fuq it-tabella hemm miktub Quercus robur.
colloquial.en: Maja: What tree is this? Mark: An English oak. The sign says Quercus robur.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这是什么树？马克：夏栎。标牌上写着 Quercus robur。

messages.speaker: Maja (游客)
messages.zh: 这是什么树？
messages.en: What tree is this?

messages.speaker: Mark (导览员)
messages.mt_spoken: Ballut Ingliż. Fuq it-tabella hemm miktub Quercus robur.
messages.mt_standard: Ballut Ingliż. Fuq it-tabella hemm miktub Quercus robur.
messages.zh: 夏栎。标牌上写着 Quercus robur。
messages.en: An English oak. The sign says Quercus robur.

cognitive_memory_aid: 制作一张树木名牌，把 ballut Ingliż、English oak、夏栎和 Quercus robur 写在一起，整组对应记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Another name for balzmuwa, the balsam apple plant, Momordica balsamina.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 胶苦瓜，学名 Momordica balsamina；与马耳他语 balzmuwa 指同一种植物。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Isem ieħor għall-balzmuwa, il-pjanta magħrufa bl-isem xjentifiku Momordica balsamina.

sense_translations.en_definition: synonym of balzmuwa: balsam apple (Momordica balsamina)
sense_translations.zh_definition: balzmuwa 的同义词：胶苦瓜，学名 Momordica balsamina。

formal.mt: Il-katalgu jelenka l-balzmina, magħrufa wkoll bħala balzmuwa, bl-isem xjentifiku Momordica balsamina.
formal.en: The catalogue lists balzmina, also known as balzmuwa, under the scientific name Momordica balsamina.
formal.zh: 名录将 balzmina，也称 balzmuwa，列在学名 Momordica balsamina 之下。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Balzmina u balzmuwa huma l-istess pjanta? Mark: Iva, iż-żewġ ismijiet jirreferu għal Momordica balsamina.
colloquial.en: Maja: Are balzmina and balzmuwa the same plant? Mark: Yes, both names refer to Momordica balsamina.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：balzmina 和 balzmuwa 是同一种植物吗？马克：是的，这两个名称都指胶苦瓜 Momordica balsamina。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Balzmina u balzmuwa huma l-istess pjanta?
messages.mt_standard: Balzmina u balzmuwa huma l-istess pjanta?
messages.zh: balzmina 和 balzmuwa 是同一种植物吗？
messages.en: Are balzmina and balzmuwa the same plant?

messages.speaker: Mark (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, iż-żewġ ismijiet jirreferu għal Momordica balsamina.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, iż-żewġ ismijiet jirreferu għal Momordica balsamina.
messages.zh: 是的，这两个名称都指胶苦瓜 Momordica balsamina。
messages.en: Yes, both names refer to Momordica balsamina.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 balzmina 与 balzmuwa 画成两块指向同一株植物的名牌；再写上胶苦瓜，记住两名一物。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The balsam apple plant, known scientifically as Momordica balsamina.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 胶苦瓜，学名为 Momordica balsamina 的植物。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-pjanta magħrufa bl-isem xjentifiku Momordica balsamina, imsejħa wkoll balzmina.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 胶苦瓜，学名 Momordica balsamina。

formal.mt: It-tabella ħdejn il-pjanta tagħti l-isem Malti balzmuwa u l-isem xjentifiku Momordica balsamina.
formal.en: The sign beside the plant gives the Maltese name balzmuwa and the scientific name Momordica balsamina.
formal.zh: 植物旁的标牌列出了马耳他语名称 balzmuwa 和学名 Momordica balsamina。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Kif jisimha din il-pjanta bil-Malti? Mark: Balzmuwa. Tista' ssibha wkoll bl-isem balzmina.
colloquial.en: Maja: What is this plant called in Maltese? Mark: Balzmuwa. You can also find it under the name balzmina.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这种植物用马耳他语怎么说？马克：balzmuwa。你也会看到它叫 balzmina。

messages.speaker: Maja (游客)
messages.zh: 这种植物用马耳他语怎么说？
messages.en: What is this plant called in Maltese?

messages.speaker: Mark (导览员)
messages.mt_spoken: Balzmuwa. Tista' ssibha wkoll bl-isem balzmina.
messages.mt_standard: Balzmuwa. Tista' ssibha wkoll bl-isem balzmina.
messages.zh: balzmuwa。你也会看到它叫 balzmina。
messages.en: Balzmuwa. You can also find it under the name balzmina.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给胶苦瓜做双面词卡：正面写 balzmuwa，背面写 balsam apple 和学名，并在角落补上同义名 balzmina。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To hit someone repeatedly or punish them, especially by beating them.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 反复打某人，或对某人施加惩罚，尤其指以殴打方式惩罚。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jolqot lil xi ħadd kemm-il darba jew jikkastigah, speċjalment bis-swat.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 反复打某人；接连击打某人。
惩罚；处罚。
连续猛击；狠揍。

formal.mt: Skont ix-xhud, ir-raġel bambal lill-vittma qabel ma waslet il-pulizija.
formal.en: According to the witness, the man repeatedly hit the victim before the police arrived.
formal.zh: 据目击者所述，那名男子在警察到达前反复殴打受害者。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex ġiet il-pulizija? Mark: Għax raġel bambal lil ieħor barra l-ħanut.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why did the police come? Mark: Because a man repeatedly hit another man outside the shop.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：警察为什么来了？马克：因为有个男子在商店外反复打另一个男子。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 警察为什么来了？
messages.en: Why did the police come?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax raġel bambal lil ieħor barra l-ħanut.
messages.mt_standard: Għax raġel bambal lil ieħor barra l-ħanut.
messages.zh: 因为有个男子在商店外反复打另一个男子。
messages.en: Because a man repeatedly hit another man outside the shop.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把这个词配上连续挥拳的画面，记住重点是反复击打，并联记惩罚义。

gloss_zh: 婴幼儿；几乎专指圣婴耶稣

teaching_sense.en_definition: A baby or toddler; used almost exclusively for the infant Jesus, often written il-Bambin.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 婴儿或幼儿；实际使用中几乎专指幼年的耶稣，常写作 il-Bambin。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tarbija jew tifel żgħir ħafna; il-kelma tintuża kważi dejjem għal Ġesù tarbija, spiss miktuba il-Bambin.

sense_translations.en_definition: baby, toddler; almost exclusively used referring to Baby Jesus and therefore often capitalized as il-Bambin (Ġesù)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 婴儿、幼儿；几乎只用于指圣婴耶稣，因此常以大写形式写作 il-Bambin (Ġesù)。

formal.mt: Fiċ-ċentru tal-presepju hemm statwa żgħira tal-Bambin Ġesù.
formal.en: At the centre of the nativity scene is a small statue of Baby Jesus.
formal.zh: 耶稣诞生场景模型的中央放着一尊圣婴耶稣的小塑像。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Fejn inpoġġi l-Bambin? Marija: Poġġih fil-maxtura, ħdejn Marija u Ġużeppi.
colloquial.en: Lara: Where shall I put Baby Jesus? Marija: Put him in the manger, beside Mary and Joseph.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：我把圣婴放在哪里？玛丽娅：放在马槽里，在玛利亚和约瑟旁边。

messages.speaker: Lara (女儿)
messages.zh: 我把圣婴放在哪里？
messages.en: Where shall I put Baby Jesus?

messages.speaker: Marija (母亲)
messages.mt_spoken: Poġġih fil-maxtura, ħdejn Marija u Ġużeppi.
messages.mt_standard: Poġġih fil-maxtura, ħdejn Marija u Ġużeppi.
messages.zh: 放在马槽里，在玛利亚和约瑟旁边。
messages.en: Put him in the manger, beside Mary and Joseph.

cognitive_memory_aid: 看到大写的 il-Bambin，就想象马槽中的圣婴耶稣，避免只记成普通宝宝。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person regarded as foolish or easily deceived; a simpleton.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 被认为愚笨、缺乏判断力或容易受骗的人，带有贬义。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna meqjusa iblah jew li titqarraq malajr; kelma ta' tmaqdir.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 傻瓜；呆子；头脑简单、容易受骗的人。

collocations.mt: ħa lil xi ħadd għal bamboċċ
collocations.en: to take someone for a fool

formal.mt: Fir-rakkont, il-bejjiegħ ħa lill-klijent għal bamboċċ u pprova jbigħlu oġġett bla valur.
formal.en: In the story, the seller took the customer for a fool and tried to sell him a worthless object.
formal.zh: 故事中，卖家把顾客当成傻瓜，试图卖给他一件毫无价值的东西。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Ħassejtni bamboċċ meta skoprejt li kienet ċajta. Maja: Tinkwetax, jien ukoll emmintha!
colloquial.en: Mark: I felt like a fool when I discovered it was a joke. Maja: Don't worry, I believed it too!
colloquial.zh: 马克：发现那是个玩笑时，我觉得自己像个傻瓜。玛雅：别在意，我也信了！

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ħassejtni bamboċċ meta skoprejt li kienet ċajta.
messages.mt_standard: Ħassejtni bamboċċ meta skoprejt li kienet ċajta.
messages.zh: 发现那是个玩笑时，我觉得自己像个傻瓜。
messages.en: I felt like a fool when I discovered it was a joke.

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 别在意，我也信了！
messages.en: Don't worry, I believed it too!

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象轻信玩笑后自称傻瓜的场景，记住此词指人，称呼别人时带贬义。

gloss_zh: 幼稚行为；孩子气的举动

teaching_sense.en_definition: Childish or immature behaviour, especially an action considered silly or inappropriate.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 幼稚、不成熟的行为，尤其指被认为愚蠢或不合时宜的举动。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Imġiba infantili jew mhux matura, speċjalment għemil iblah jew mhux xieraq.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 幼稚行为；孩子气的举动。

formal.mt: Il-kap tal-laqgħa ddeskriva l-ħabi tad-dokumenti bħala bamboċċata li ħliet il-ħin ta' kulħadd.
formal.en: The chair of the meeting described hiding the documents as a childish act that wasted everyone's time.
formal.zh: 会议主持人将藏起文件的行为形容为浪费大家时间的幼稚举动。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Ħbejt iċ-ċwievet ta' ħija biex niċċajta. Nina: Dik bamboċċata! Agħtihomlu lura.
colloquial.en: Lara: I hid my brother's keys as a joke. Nina: That's childish! Give them back to him.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：我把哥哥的钥匙藏起来开玩笑。妮娜：这也太幼稚了！把钥匙还给他。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ħbejt iċ-ċwievet ta' ħija biex niċċajta.
messages.mt_standard: Ħbejt iċ-ċwievet ta' ħija biex niċċajta.
messages.zh: 我把哥哥的钥匙藏起来开玩笑。
messages.en: I hid my brother's keys as a joke.

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.zh: 这也太幼稚了！把钥匙还给他。
messages.en: That's childish! Give them back to him.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把藏钥匙恶作剧当作记忆画面：评价的是幼稚行为，而不是行为者的年龄。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who spends time idling and avoids work; a loafer.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把时间花在闲逛或无所事事上、不愿工作的人；游手好闲者。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li tqatta' ħinha titgħażżen jew tiġġerra u tevita x-xogħol.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 游手好闲者；懒汉；闲荡的人。

formal.mt: Fil-komponiment, l-istudent iddeskriva lill-karattru bħala bamer li jevita kull xogħol.
formal.en: In the composition, the student described the character as a loafer who avoids all work.
formal.zh: 作文中，学生把这个人物描写成一个逃避一切工作的懒汉。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex sejjaħtlu bamer? Mark: Għax ilu l-ġurnata kollha fuq is-sufan u ma ried jgħin b'xejn.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why did you call him a loafer? Mark: Because he's been on the sofa all day and refused to help with anything.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你为什么叫他懒汉？马克：因为他整天躺在沙发上，什么忙都不肯帮。

messages.speaker: Maja (室友)
messages.zh: 你为什么叫他懒汉？
messages.en: Why did you call him a loafer?

messages.speaker: Mark (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax ilu l-ġurnata kollha fuq is-sufan u ma ried jgħin b'xejn.
messages.mt_standard: Għax ilu l-ġurnata kollha fuq is-sufan u ma ried jgħin b'xejn.
messages.zh: 因为他整天躺在沙发上，什么忙都不肯帮。
messages.en: Because he's been on the sofa all day and refused to help with anything.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一个整天占着沙发、不肯帮忙的人，用这个场景记住闲汉义及贬义语气。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The movement of swinging or swaying back and forth or from side to side.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 来回或左右摆动、摇晃的动作或状态。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-moviment ta' xi ħaġa li titbandal 'il quddiem u lura jew minn naħa għal oħra.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 摆动；来回摇摆的动作。
摇晃；左右摇摆的状态。

formal.mt: L-istudenti osservaw il-bandil tal-pendlu u kejlu l-ħin ta' kull ċiklu.
formal.en: The students observed the swinging of the pendulum and measured the time of each cycle.
formal.zh: 学生们观察钟摆的摆动，并测量每个周期所需的时间。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Qed tħossok tajjeb fuq id-dgħajsa? Pawlu: Mhux wisq; il-bandil qed iġegħelni nħossni ma niflaħx.
colloquial.en: Nina: Are you feeling all right on the boat? Pawlu: Not really; the swaying is making me feel sick.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：你在船上感觉还好吗？保罗：不太好，船摇得我有点恶心。

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.zh: 你在船上感觉还好吗？
messages.en: Are you feeling all right on the boat?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Mhux wisq; il-bandil qed iġegħelni nħossni ma niflaħx.
messages.mt_standard: Mhux wisq; il-bandil qed iġegħelni nħossni ma niflaħx.
messages.zh: 不太好，船摇得我有点恶心。
messages.en: Not really; the swaying is making me feel sick.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把钟摆来回摆和小船左右晃放在一起记：这个名词表示摆动本身。

gloss_zh: 城镇传告员；沿街宣告公告的人

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person whose role is to announce official news or proclamations aloud in a town.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 负责在城镇中高声宣读官方消息或公告的传告员。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li xogħolha hu li tħabbar b'leħen għoli aħbarijiet jew avviżi uffiċjali f'belt jew raħal.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 城镇传告员；在城镇公共场所高声宣读公告的人。

formal.mt: Fix-xena tad-dramm, il-banditur qara l-avviż b'leħen għoli quddiem in-nies fil-pjazza.
formal.en: In the scene from the play, the town crier read the notice aloud before the people in the square.
formal.zh: 在这幕戏中，传告员面对广场上的人群高声宣读公告。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Min hu dak li qed jgħajjat fil-pjazza? Mark: Hu l-banditur fid-dramm; qed iħabbar l-aħbar lin-nies.
colloquial.en: Lara: Who is that shouting in the square? Mark: He's the town crier in the play; he's announcing the news to the people.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：那个在广场上高声喊话的人是谁？马克：他是戏里的传告员，正在向大家宣布消息。

messages.speaker: Lara (观众)
messages.mt_spoken: Min hu dak li qed jgħajjat fil-pjazza?
messages.mt_standard: Min hu dak li qed jgħajjat fil-pjazza?
messages.zh: 那个在广场上高声喊话的人是谁？
messages.en: Who is that shouting in the square?

messages.speaker: Mark (同行观众)
messages.mt_spoken: Hu l-banditur fid-dramm; qed iħabbar l-aħbar lin-nies.
messages.mt_standard: Hu l-banditur fid-dramm; qed iħabbar l-aħbar lin-nies.
messages.zh: 他是戏里的传告员，正在向大家宣布消息。
messages.en: He's the town crier in the play; he's announcing the news to the people.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象广场上高声宣读公告的人，把 banditur 牢牢记成负责传告的人。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An official public proclamation; also a public announcement of an intended marriage, called banns.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 向公众发布的正式公告或宣告；也指预告某对男女即将结婚的婚事公告。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Avviż jew dikjarazzjoni uffiċjali lill-pubbliku; ukoll avviż li żewġ persuni biħsiebhom jiżżewġu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 公告；向公众发布的正式宣告。
婚事预告；公开宣布某对男女拟结婚的公告。

formal.mt: Fir-rakkont, il-banditur qara bandu uffiċjali li ħabbar il-ftuħ tas-suq.
formal.en: In the story, the town crier read an official proclamation announcing the opening of the market.
formal.zh: 故事中，传告员宣读了一份宣布市场开市的正式公告。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Rajt il-bandu taż-żwieġ ta' Lara u Mark? Pawlu: Iva, rajtu ħdejn il-bieb tal-knisja.
colloquial.en: Nina: Did you see Lara and Mark's marriage banns? Pawlu: Yes, I saw them beside the church door.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：你看到拉拉和马克的婚事预告了吗？保罗：看到了，就在教堂门旁。

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Rajt il-bandu taż-żwieġ ta' Lara u Mark?
messages.mt_standard: Rajt il-bandu taż-żwieġ ta' Lara u Mark?
messages.zh: 你看到拉拉和马克的婚事预告了吗？
messages.en: Did you see Lara and Mark's marriage banns?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.zh: 看到了，就在教堂门旁。
messages.en: Yes, I saw them beside the church door.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一份公开宣读或张贴的公告，再用婚礼场景联记婚事预告这个专门义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A cooking arrangement in which a container is placed in hot water to heat its contents gently.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 将盛有食物的容器放入热水中，使食物温和受热的烹饪装置。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Arranġament għat-tisjir li fih reċipjent jitqiegħed f'ilma sħun biex il-kontenut tiegħu jissaħħan bil-mod.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 隔水加热器；用于温和加热食物的水浴装置。

collocations.en: to melt chocolate in a bain-marie

formal.mt: Poġġi r-reċipjent biċ-ċikkulata f'banjumarija u ħawwad sakemm iċ-ċikkulata tinħall.
formal.en: Place the container of chocolate in a bain-marie and stir until the chocolate melts.
formal.zh: 将盛有巧克力的容器放入水浴锅中，搅拌至巧克力融化。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Kif se ndewweb iċ-ċikkulata? Rita: Uża banjumarija u ħawwad bil-mod.
colloquial.en: Maja: How shall I melt the chocolate? Rita: Use a bain-marie and stir gently.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：我要怎么融化巧克力？丽塔：用水浴锅，轻轻搅拌。

messages.speaker: Maja (女儿)
messages.zh: 我要怎么融化巧克力？
messages.en: How shall I melt the chocolate?

messages.speaker: Rita (母亲)
messages.zh: 用水浴锅，轻轻搅拌。
messages.en: Use a bain-marie and stir gently.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把这个词和“小碗坐在热水锅里融化巧克力”的画面绑定，记住隔水温和加热的用途。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A small stall or stand where goods are displayed and sold, especially in a market.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 陈列并出售商品的小摊位，尤其指市场里的货摊。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Post żgħir fejn jintwerew u jinbiegħu prodotti, speċjalment f'suq.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 摊位；货摊，尤指市场等场所用于摆卖商品的摊位。

formal.mt: Il-bankarella tal-ħaxix tinsab ħdejn id-daħla tas-suq u tiftaħ kull filgħodu.
formal.en: The vegetable stall is beside the market entrance and opens every morning.
formal.zh: 蔬菜摊位于市场入口旁，每天早晨营业。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Minn fejn xtrajt dan it-tadam? Lara: Mill-bankarella ħdejn id-daħla tas-suq.
colloquial.en: Mark: Where did you buy these tomatoes? Lara: From the stall beside the market entrance.
colloquial.zh: 马克：这些番茄你在哪里买的？拉拉：在市场入口旁的摊位买的。

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 这些番茄你在哪里买的？
messages.en: Where did you buy these tomatoes?

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 在市场入口旁的摊位买的。
messages.en: From the stall beside the market entrance.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象市场入口旁摆满番茄的小摊，把整个词当作那块摊位招牌来记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Used to emphasize that something is truly the case or cannot reasonably be denied.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用于强调某事确实如此，或其真实性无可否认。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jintuża biex jenfasizza li xi ħaġa hija tassew hekk jew li ma tistax tiġi miċħuda.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 确实；的确；无可否认地，用于加强对事实或判断的肯定。

formal.mt: Dan l-eżempju juri li l-qari regolari huwa bans utli għat-tagħlim ta' lingwa.
formal.en: This example shows that regular reading is truly useful for learning a language.
formal.zh: 这个例子表明，经常阅读对于学习语言确实有用。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Dan il-ktieb għenek? Pawlu: Iva, huwa bans utli, speċjalment għall-eżempji tiegħu.
colloquial.en: Maja: Did this book help you? Pawlu: Yes, it is truly useful, especially because of its examples.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这本书对你有帮助吗？保罗：有，它确实有用，尤其是里面的例子。

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.zh: 这本书对你有帮助吗？
messages.en: Did this book help you?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, huwa bans utli, speċjalment għall-eżempji tiegħu.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, huwa bans utli, speċjalment għall-eżempji tiegħu.
messages.zh: 有，它确实有用，尤其是里面的例子。
messages.en: Yes, it is truly useful, especially because of its examples.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 bans 想成说话时郑重的一次点头：在评价前加上它，就强调“确实如此”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Something that produces a soft cooing sound.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 能够发出轻柔咕咕声的东西。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Xi ħaġa li tagħmel ħoss artab bħal dak ta' ħamiema.

sense_translations.en_definition: sth. that produces a cooing sound
sense_translations.zh_definition: 发出咕咕声的东西；指声音的发出者。

collocations.en: the sound of the thing that coos
collocations.zh: 那个发出咕咕声的东西的声音

formal.mt: F'dan l-eżempju, l-għasfur jissejjaħ baqbieq għax jagħmel ħoss artab bħal dak ta' ħamiema.
formal.en: In this example, the bird is called a baqbieq because it makes a soft sound like a dove's.
formal.zh: 在这个例子中，这只鸟因发出像鸽子一样轻柔的咕咕声而被称为 baqbieq。

colloquial.mt: Lara: X'inhu dak il-baqbieq ħdejn it-tieqa? Mark: Huwa għasfur żgħir; isma' l-ħoss tiegħu.
colloquial.en: Lara: What is that cooing thing beside the window? Mark: It is a little bird; listen to its sound.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：窗边那个咕咕叫的东西是什么？马克：是一只小鸟，你听它的声音。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 窗边那个咕咕叫的东西是什么？
messages.en: What is that cooing thing beside the window?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Huwa għasfur żgħir; isma' l-ħoss tiegħu.
messages.mt_standard: Huwa għasfur żgħir; isma' l-ħoss tiegħu.
messages.zh: 是一只小鸟，你听它的声音。
messages.en: It is a little bird; listen to its sound.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记忆时指向窗边咕咕叫的小鸟：baqbieq 指发声的东西，注意把它与声音本身区分。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Able to produce a soft cooing sound.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 具有发出轻柔咕咕声的能力的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu l-ħila jagħmel ħoss artab bħal dak ta' ħamiema.

sense_translations.en_definition: having the ability to produce a cooing sound
sense_translations.zh_definition: 能够发出咕咕声的；具有这种发声能力的。

formal.mt: L-aġġettiv baqbieqi jiddeskrivi għasfur jew annimal li għandu l-ħila jagħmel ħoss bħal dak ta' ħamiema.
formal.en: The adjective baqbieqi describes a bird or animal capable of making a sound like a dove's.
formal.zh: 形容词 baqbieqi 描述能够发出类似鸽子咕咕声的鸟或动物。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Dan l-għasfur baqbieqi? Pawlu: Iva, imma bħalissa qiegħed sieket.
colloquial.en: Maja: Can this bird coo? Pawlu: Yes, but it is quiet at the moment.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这只鸟会咕咕叫吗？保罗：会，不过它现在很安静。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 这只鸟会咕咕叫吗？
messages.en: Can this bird coo?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.zh: 会，不过它现在很安静。
messages.en: Yes, but it is quiet at the moment.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给小鸟贴一张“会咕咕叫”的能力标签来记 baqbieqi；它描述能力，不要求此刻正在叫。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act or process of producing a cooing sound.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 发出咕咕声的行为或过程。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-għemil ta' ħoss artab bħal dak li tagħmel ħamiema.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 发出咕咕声；咕咕叫这一发声行为。

formal.mt: Waqt l-osservazzjoni fil-ġnien, l-istudenti semgħu l-baqbiq tal-ħamiem.
formal.en: During their observation in the garden, the students heard the pigeons cooing.
formal.zh: 在花园里进行观察时，学生们听到了鸽子的咕咕叫声。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Qed tisma' l-baqbiq? Lara: Iva, ġej mill-ħamiem fuq il-bejt.
colloquial.en: Mark: Can you hear the cooing? Lara: Yes, it is coming from the pigeons on the roof.
colloquial.zh: 马克：你听到咕咕叫声了吗？拉拉：听到了，是屋顶上的鸽子发出的。

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 你听到咕咕叫声了吗？
messages.en: Can you hear the cooing?

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 听到了，是屋顶上的鸽子发出的。
messages.en: Yes, it is coming from the pigeons on the roof.

cognitive_memory_aid: 闭眼想象只听见鸽子咕咕叫，用 baqbiq 记这段发声活动；把注意力放在“叫”这件事上。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A jug for holding water that has a narrow neck; also, a bubble on the surface of water.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用于盛水、颈部狭窄的壶；也指水面上的气泡。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Buqar għall-ilma b'għonq dejjaq; il-kelma tfisser ukoll bużżieqa fuq wiċċ l-ilma.

sense_translations.en_definition: a water jug with a narrow neck
sense_translations.zh_definition: 细颈水壶；颈部狭窄、用来盛水的壶。

sense_translations.en_definition: a bubble on the water's surface
sense_translations.zh_definition: 水面上的气泡。

collocations.en: a narrow-necked jug full of water
a bubble on the surface of the water

formal.mt: L-istampa turi baqbuqa mimlija ilma, b'għonq dejjaq u korp wiesa'.
formal.en: The picture shows a narrow-necked water jug filled with water, with a narrow neck and a wide body.
formal.zh: 图片展示了一只装满水的细颈水壶，壶颈狭窄，壶身宽大。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Ara dik il-baqbuqa fuq wiċċ l-ilma! Pawlu: Rajtha; għadha kemm faqqgħet.
colloquial.en: Maja: Look at that bubble on the water! Pawlu: I saw it; it has just burst.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：看水面上的那个气泡！保罗：我看到了，它刚刚破了。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ara dik il-baqbuqa fuq wiċċ l-ilma!
messages.mt_standard: Ara dik il-baqbuqa fuq wiċċ l-ilma!
messages.zh: 看水面上的那个气泡！
messages.en: Look at that bubble on the water!

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.zh: 我看到了，它刚刚破了。
messages.en: I saw it; it has just burst.

cognitive_memory_aid: 画两格记忆卡：一格是细颈盛水壶，一格是水面气泡；同写 baqbuqa，靠语境选择词义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Inclined to talk a lot or to engage readily in conversation.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 喜欢说话、容易与人交谈的；健谈或话多的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jħobb jitkellem ħafna jew jidħol malajr f'konversazzjoni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 健谈的；爱说话的；话多的。

formal.mt: L-istudent huwa baqbuqi u jieħu sehem ta' spiss fid-diskussjonijiet tal-klassi.
formal.en: The student is talkative and frequently takes part in class discussions.
formal.zh: 这名学生很健谈，经常参与课堂讨论。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Kif inhu l-ġar il-ġdid? Mark: Baqbuqi ħafna! Dejjem għandu xi ħaġa x'jirrakkonta.
colloquial.en: Lara: What is the new neighbour like? Mark: Very talkative! He always has something to tell.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：新邻居怎么样？马克：特别健谈！他总有事情可讲。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 新邻居怎么样？
messages.en: What is the new neighbour like?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Baqbuqi ħafna! Dejjem għandu xi ħaġa x'jirrakkonta.
messages.mt_standard: Baqbuqi ħafna! Dejjem għandu xi ħaġa x'jirrakkonta.
messages.zh: 特别健谈！他总有事情可讲。
messages.en: Very talkative! He always has something to tell.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一位总有故事可讲的邻居，用 baqbuqi 给他贴上“健谈”的标签；注意与形近的“会咕咕叫”区分。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Eczema: a skin condition that causes irritation, itching, and inflamed patches.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 湿疹，一种可引起皮肤刺激、瘙痒和局部发炎的皮肤病。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kundizzjoni tal-ġilda li tista' tikkawża ħakk, irritazzjoni u żoni infjammati.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 湿疹。

formal.mt: Il-pazjenta rrappurtat baqla fuq idejha u ħakk li kien qed ifixkilha waqt ix-xogħol.
formal.en: The patient reported eczema on her hands and itching that was disturbing her while she worked.
formal.zh: 这位女患者报告说，她的手部有湿疹，瘙痒已经影响工作。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Għandi l-baqla fuq idejja u qed idejjaqni l-ħakk. | Pawlu: Tridni ngħinek inġorr il-basktijiet?
colloquial.en: Marija: I have eczema on my hands, and the itching is bothering me. | Pawlu: Would you like me to help you carry the bags?
colloquial.zh: 玛丽娅：我的手上有湿疹，痒得难受。｜保罗：要我帮你提袋子吗？

messages.speaker: Marija (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandi l-baqla fuq idejja u qed idejjaqni l-ħakk.
messages.mt_standard: Għandi l-baqla fuq idejja u qed idejjaqni l-ħakk.
messages.zh: 我的手上有湿疹，痒得难受。
messages.en: I have eczema on my hands, and the itching is bothering me.

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.zh: 要我帮你提袋子吗？
messages.en: Would you like me to help you carry the bags?

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 baqla 与“手上湿疹发痒”的画面一起记忆，并用“手部湿疹”这一搭配复习词义。

gloss_zh: 使滋生害虫；使染上跳蚤或虱子等

teaching_sense.en_definition: To cause a person, animal, or place to become infested with vermin such as fleas or lice.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使人、动物或某个地方染上或滋生跳蚤、虱子等害虫。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Iġiegħel persuna, annimal jew post jimtela b'parassiti bħall-briegħed jew il-qamel.

sense_translations.en_definition: to infest with vermin (such as fleas or lice)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 使染上或滋生跳蚤、虱子等害虫。

collocations.en: he or it infested the room with fleas
collocations.zh: 他或它使房间染上了跳蚤

collocations.en: he or it infested the bedding with vermin
collocations.zh: 他或它使铺盖滋生了害虫

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jindika li l-friex infestat baqqaq il-kamra kollha bil-briegħed.
formal.en: The report indicates that the infested bedding caused fleas to infest the entire room.
formal.zh: 报告指出，带虫的铺盖使整个房间都染上了跳蚤。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Minn fejn ġew dawn il-briegħed kollha? | Mark: Naħseb li dak il-friex il-qadim baqqaq il-kamra.
colloquial.en: Lara: Where did all these fleas come from? | Mark: I think that old bedding infested the room.
colloquial.zh: 劳拉：这么多跳蚤是从哪里来的？｜马克：我想是那套旧铺盖使房间染上了跳蚤。

messages.speaker: Lara (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Minn fejn ġew dawn il-briegħed kollha?
messages.mt_standard: Minn fejn ġew dawn il-briegħed kollha?
messages.zh: 这么多跳蚤是从哪里来的？
messages.en: Where did all these fleas come from?

messages.speaker: Mark (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Naħseb li dak il-friex il-qadim baqqaq il-kamra.
messages.mt_standard: Naħseb li dak il-friex il-qadim baqqaq il-kamra.
messages.zh: 我想是那套旧铺盖使房间染上了跳蚤。
messages.en: I think that old bedding infested the room.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 baqqaq 记成一个动作：旧铺盖把跳蚤带进房间，强调“使某处染上害虫”的结果。

gloss_zh: 饲养牲畜，尤指牛；养牛者

teaching_sense.en_definition: To raise and care for livestock, especially cattle.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 饲养并照料牲畜，尤其指牛。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Rabbi l-bhejjem u ħu ħsiebhom, speċjalment il-baqar.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 饲养、照料牲畜，尤指牛。
养牛者；从事牛的饲养或繁育的人。

collocations.en: he raised and cared for livestock

formal.mt: Għal ħafna snin, Ġużeppi baqqar il-bhejjem fir-razzett tal-familja u kiseb esperjenza fil-kura tal-baqar.
formal.en: For many years, Ġużeppi raised livestock on the family farm and gained experience in caring for cattle.
formal.zh: 多年来，朱塞佩在家庭农场饲养牲畜，积累了照料牛的经验。

colloquial.mt: Anna: X'xogħol jagħmel ħuk? | Toni: Hu baqqar; irabbi l-baqar fir-razzett tagħna.
colloquial.en: Anna: What does your brother do? | Toni: He is a cattle breeder; he raises cattle on our farm.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：你哥哥做什么工作？｜托尼：他是养牛的，在我们农场饲养牛。

messages.speaker: Anna (朋友)
messages.zh: 你哥哥做什么工作？
messages.en: What does your brother do?

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Hu baqqar; irabbi l-baqar fir-razzett tagħna.
messages.mt_standard: Hu baqqar; irabbi l-baqar fir-razzett tagħna.
messages.zh: 他是养牛的，在我们农场饲养牛。
messages.en: He is a cattle breeder; he raises cattle on our farm.

cognitive_memory_aid: 为 baqqar 画两张学习卡：动作卡写“饲养牲畜”，人物卡写“养牛者”，用句子区分两个词性。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who forces someone else to remain in a place instead of allowing them to leave.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 强迫别人留在某处、不让其离开的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li ġġiegħel lil xi ħadd ieħor jibqa' f'post minflok tħallih jitlaq.

sense_translations.en_definition: sb. who forces sb. else to stay
sense_translations.zh_definition: 强迫他人留下、不让他人离开的人。

collocations.en: a person who forces you to stay and will not let you leave
collocations.zh: 强迫你留下、不让你离开的人

collocations.en: to act like someone who forces others to stay
collocations.zh: 表现得像个强迫别人留下的人

formal.mt: Fir-rakkont, il-baqqiegħ iġiegħel lill-mistieden jibqa' fid-dar minkejja li dan irid jitlaq.
formal.en: In the story, the person who forces others to stay makes the guest remain in the house even though the guest wants to leave.
formal.zh: 故事中，这个强迫别人留下的人逼客人留在屋里，尽管客人想要离开。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Kull darba li rrid nitlaq, tgħidli li għandi nibqa' hawn. | Mark: Għandek raġun; qed naġixxi ta' baqqiegħ. Tista' titlaq meta trid.
colloquial.en: Nina: Every time I want to leave, you tell me I have to stay here. | Mark: You are right; I am acting like someone who forces others to stay. You can leave whenever you want.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：每次我想走，你都说我得留在这里。｜马克：你说得对，我这样是在强迫你留下。你想什么时候走都可以。

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Kull darba li rrid nitlaq, tgħidli li għandi nibqa' hawn.
messages.mt_standard: Kull darba li rrid nitlaq, tgħidli li għandi nibqa' hawn.
messages.zh: 每次我想走，你都说我得留在这里。
messages.en: Every time I want to leave, you tell me I have to stay here.

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandek raġun; qed naġixxi ta' baqqiegħ. Tista' titlaq meta trid.
messages.mt_standard: Għandek raġun; qed naġixxi ta' baqqiegħ. Tista' titlaq meta trid.
messages.zh: 你说得对，我这样是在强迫你留下。你想什么时候走都可以。
messages.en: You are right; I am acting like someone who forces others to stay. You can leave whenever you want.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 baqqiegħ 配上“有人要走，却被另一个人强行留下”的场景；这个词指强迫留下的那个人。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A hollow or depression in the ground where water collects.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 地面上能够聚集水的凹处或洼地。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ħofra jew parti baxxa fl-art fejn jinġabar l-ilma.

sense_translations.en_definition: a hollow in which water collects
sense_translations.zh_definition: 能够聚集水的凹处；积水的洼地。

formal.mt: Wara x-xita, l-ilma nġabar fil-baqqiegħa ħdejn il-mogħdija u baqa' hemm għal diversi sigħat.
formal.en: After the rain, water collected in the hollow beside the path and remained there for several hours.
formal.zh: 雨后，水聚集在小路旁的洼地里，过了好几个小时仍未消退。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għaliex għad hemm l-ilma hawn? | Luqa: Hemm baqqiegħa, u l-ilma tax-xita jinġabar fiha.
colloquial.en: Sara: Why is there still water here? | Luqa: There is a hollow, and rainwater collects in it.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：这里怎么还有水？｜卢卡：这里有个洼地，雨水会积在里面。

messages.speaker: Sara (同行朋友)
messages.zh: 这里怎么还有水？
messages.en: Why is there still water here?

messages.speaker: Luqa (同行朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Hemm baqqiegħa, u l-ilma tax-xita jinġabar fiha.
messages.mt_standard: Hemm baqqiegħa, u l-ilma tax-xita jinġabar fiha.
messages.zh: 这里有个洼地，雨水会积在里面。
messages.en: There is a hollow, and rainwater collects in it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 看见 baqqiegħa 就想象雨水流进地面的小凹处；记住它指积水的地形，而不只是里面的水。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A nest or concentrated gathering of lice in one place.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 虱子集中聚集的一处，称为虱窝。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Bejta jew ġemgħa ta' qamel miġbur f'post wieħed.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 虱窝；虱子聚集的一处。

collocations.en: a nest of lice in the hair
to find a nest of lice

formal.mt: Waqt l-eżami tax-xagħar, l-infermiera sabet baqqija u spjegat lill-ġenitur dak li kienet osservat.
formal.en: During the hair examination, the nurse found a nest of lice and explained to the parent what she had observed.
formal.zh: 检查头发时，护士发现了一处虱窝，并向家长说明了观察到的情况。

colloquial.mt: Elena: X'sibt waqt li kont qed tiċċekkja xagħri? | Rita: Sibt baqqija hawn; ejja nurik fejn hi.
colloquial.en: Elena: What did you find while checking my hair? | Rita: I found a nest of lice here; let me show you where it is.
colloquial.zh: 埃琳娜：你检查我的头发时发现了什么？｜丽塔：我在这里发现了一处虱窝，让我指给你看。

messages.speaker: Elena (女儿)
messages.mt_spoken: X'sibt waqt li kont qed tiċċekkja xagħri?
messages.mt_standard: X'sibt waqt li kont qed tiċċekkja xagħri?
messages.zh: 你检查我的头发时发现了什么？
messages.en: What did you find while checking my hair?

messages.speaker: Rita (母亲)
messages.mt_spoken: Sibt baqqija hawn; ejja nurik fejn hi.
messages.mt_standard: Sibt baqqija hawn; ejja nurik fejn hi.
messages.zh: 我在这里发现了一处虱窝，让我指给你看。
messages.en: I found a nest of lice here; let me show you where it is.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 baqqija 配一幅放大镜下虱子聚在一起的示意图，记成“一处虱窝”，突出聚集的意思。

gloss_zh: 石工行业中使用镐的工人

teaching_sense.en_definition: A labourer who works with a pickaxe in stone masonry.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在石工作业中使用镐进行劳动的工人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ħaddiem li juża baqqun fix-xogħol tal-ġebel.

sense_translations.en_definition: a labourer who uses a pickaxe (in the context of stone masonry)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 石工行业中使用镐作业的工人。

collocations.en: an experienced pickaxe labourer in stonework
the stonework labourer uses the pickaxe

formal.mt: Il-baqqunier ħadem bil-baqqun fuq il-ġebel skont l-istruzzjonijiet tal-imgħallem.
formal.en: The pickaxe labourer worked on the stone with his pickaxe according to the foreman's instructions.
formal.zh: 这名石工镐手按照工头的指示，用镐处理石料。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Min hu dak li qed jaħdem bil-baqqun fuq il-ġebel? | Toni: Dak hu l-baqqunier; illum qed jaħdem magħna.
colloquial.en: Marija: Who is that working on the stone with a pickaxe? | Toni: That is the pickaxe labourer; he is working with us today.
colloquial.zh: 玛丽娅：那个用镐处理石料的人是谁？｜托尼：那是石工镐手，他今天和我们一起干活。

messages.speaker: Marija (新同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Min hu dak li qed jaħdem bil-baqqun fuq il-ġebel?
messages.mt_standard: Min hu dak li qed jaħdem bil-baqqun fuq il-ġebel?
messages.zh: 那个用镐处理石料的人是谁？
messages.en: Who is that working on the stone with a pickaxe?

messages.speaker: Toni (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Dak hu l-baqqunier; illum qed jaħdem magħna.
messages.mt_standard: Dak hu l-baqqunier; illum qed jaħdem magħna.
messages.zh: 那是石工镐手，他今天和我们一起干活。
messages.en: That is the pickaxe labourer; he is working with us today.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 baqqunier 放进石工作业的画面：工人双手握镐处理石料，同时记住“工人、镐、石料”三个要点。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A sea cow, a plant-eating aquatic mammal.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 海牛，一类以植物为食的水生哺乳动物。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Mammiferu akkwatiku li jiekol il-pjanti u huwa magħruf bħala baqra tal-baħar.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 海牛。

collocations.en: a photograph of a sea cow

formal.mt: Fil-lezzjoni dwar il-mammiferi akkwatiċi, l-għalliema wriet filmat ta' baqra tal-baħar tiekol il-pjanti taħt l-ilma.
formal.en: In the lesson about aquatic mammals, the teacher showed a video of a sea cow eating plants underwater.
formal.zh: 在介绍水生哺乳动物的课堂上，老师播放了一段海牛在水下吃植物的视频。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'inhu dak l-annimal fil-filmat? | Pawlu: Dik baqra tal-baħar. Ara kif qed tiekol il-pjanti!
colloquial.en: Maja: What is that animal in the video? | Pawlu: That is a sea cow. Look at how it is eating the plants!
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：视频里那个是什么动物？｜保罗：那是海牛。看它正在吃植物！

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.zh: 视频里那个是什么动物？
messages.en: What is that animal in the video?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Dik baqra tal-baħar. Ara kif qed tiekol il-pjanti!
messages.mt_standard: Dik baqra tal-baħar. Ara kif qed tiekol il-pjanti!
messages.zh: 那是海牛。看它正在吃植物！
messages.en: That is a sea cow. Look at how it is eating the plants!

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 baqra tal-baħar 整组写在海牛图片旁，再想象它在水下吃植物；按完整动物名称反复练习。

gloss_zh: 发出嗡嗡声；含糊地说话；说话含糊的人

teaching_sense.en_definition: To make a whirring sound, or to speak in a way that is difficult to understand.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 发出连续的嗡嗡声，或含糊地说话，使人难以听懂。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tagħmel ħoss kontinwu ta' tidwir, jew titkellem b'mod li diffiċli tifhmu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 发出连续的嗡嗡声。
含混不清地说话或发出难以理解的话语。
说话含糊不清、让人难以听懂的人。

collocations.en: He babbled words I did not understand.
collocations.zh: 他含糊地说了些我听不懂的话。

formal.mt: Waqt il-prova, il-mutur barbar għal ftit sekondi qabel waqaf.
formal.en: During the test, the motor whirred for a few seconds before stopping.
formal.zh: 测试时，马达嗡嗡运转了几秒钟，然后停了下来。

colloquial.mt: Marta: X'għamel il-mutur meta xgħeltu? Pawlu: Barbar ftit, imbagħad waqaf.
colloquial.en: Marta: What did the motor do when you switched it on? Pawlu: It whirred for a bit, then stopped.
colloquial.zh: Marta：你打开马达时，它怎么样了？Pawlu：它嗡嗡响了一会儿，然后停了。

messages.speaker: Marta (同事)
messages.zh: 你打开马达时，它怎么样了？
messages.en: What did the motor do when you switched it on?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (维修员)
messages.zh: 它嗡嗡响了一会儿，然后停了。
messages.en: It whirred for a bit, then stopped.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 barbar 想成练习时给马达配的重复声音：机器嗡嗡响，人也可能含糊地说话；这是声音联想，不是词源解释。

gloss_zh: 嗡嗡作响的；说话含糊不清的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Describing something that whirs, or someone whose speech is difficult to understand.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容物体嗡嗡作响，或形容人说话含糊不清、难以听懂。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jiddeskrivi xi ħaġa li tagħmel ħoss kontinwu ta' tidwir, jew persuna li kliemha diffiċli tifhmu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 形容会发出嗡嗡声的东西。
形容说话含糊不清、表达难以听懂的人。

collocations.zh: 说话含糊不清的发言者

formal.mt: Il-mutur barbari fixkel lill-istudenti waqt il-lezzjoni.
formal.en: The whirring motor disturbed the students during the lesson.
formal.zh: 嗡嗡作响的马达在上课时干扰了学生。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Għaliex għalaqt il-bieb? Mark: Hemm mutur barbari barra u ma nistax nisma' sew.
colloquial.en: Nina: Why did you close the door? Mark: There is a whirring motor outside, and I cannot hear properly.
colloquial.zh: Nina：你为什么把门关上了？Mark：外面有台马达嗡嗡响，我听不清。

messages.speaker: Nina (同学)
messages.zh: 你为什么把门关上了？
messages.en: Why did you close the door?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Hemm mutur barbari barra u ma nistax nisma' sew.
messages.mt_standard: Hemm mutur barbari barra u ma nistax nisma' sew.
messages.zh: 外面有台马达嗡嗡响，我听不清。
messages.en: There is a whirring motor outside, and I cannot hear properly.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两个搭配区分形容对象：mutur barbari 是马达嗡嗡响，kelliem barbari 是人说话含糊；共同记住听觉上的不清晰感。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To become infested with fleas.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 开始生跳蚤，或变得有许多跳蚤寄生。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jimtela bil-briegħed.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 生了跳蚤，变得受到跳蚤侵扰。

collocations.en: The dog became infested with fleas.
The cat became infested with fleas.

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jgħid li l-kelb bargħad u kien qed jinħakk ta' spiss.
formal.en: The report states that the dog became infested with fleas and was scratching frequently.
formal.zh: 报告指出，这只狗生了跳蚤，并且经常抓痒。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex il-qattus qed jinħakk daqshekk? Toni: Bargħad; sibt il-briegħed fil-pil tiegħu.
colloquial.en: Lara: Why is the cat scratching so much? Toni: He has become infested with fleas; I found fleas in his fur.
colloquial.zh: Lara：猫为什么抓痒抓得这么厉害？Toni：它生跳蚤了；我在它的毛里发现了跳蚤。

messages.speaker: Lara (宠物主人)
messages.zh: 猫为什么抓痒抓得这么厉害？
messages.en: Why is the cat scratching so much?

messages.speaker: Toni (家人)
messages.zh: 它生跳蚤了；我在它的毛里发现了跳蚤。
messages.en: He has become infested with fleas; I found fleas in his fur.

cognitive_memory_aid: 看到 bargħad，就在脑中放一段宠物不停抓痒的小动画，并配上“生跳蚤了”；重点记住这是发生变化的动词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The chemical element barium.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 化学元素钡的名称。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-element kimiku magħruf bl-Ingliż bħala barium.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 钡，一种化学元素。

formal.mt: Fir-rapport, l-istudent semma l-barju bħala eżempju ta' element kimiku.
formal.en: In the report, the student mentioned barium as an example of a chemical element.
formal.zh: 学生在报告中以钡为例介绍了化学元素。

colloquial.mt: Sara: X'inhu barju bl-Ingliż? David: Barium. Qed nikteb dwar dan l-element kimiku.
colloquial.en: Sara: What is barju in English? David: Barium. I am writing about this chemical element.
colloquial.zh: Sara：barju 用英语怎么说？David：Barium，就是钡。我正在写关于这个化学元素的内容。

messages.speaker: Sara (学生)
messages.zh: barju 用英语怎么说？
messages.en: What is barju in English?

messages.speaker: David (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Barium. Qed nikteb dwar dan l-element kimiku.
messages.mt_standard: Barium. Qed nikteb dwar dan l-element kimiku.
messages.zh: Barium，就是钡。我正在写关于这个化学元素的内容。
messages.en: Barium. I am writing about this chemical element.

cognitive_memory_aid: 制作一张三语元素卡：barju—barium—钡；把三个名称放在同一个方框中，借助英语词形帮助记住马耳他语名称。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A very large amount or a state of great abundance.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 表示数量很多、供应丰盛或收获极其丰富。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kwantità kbira ħafna ta' xi ħaġa; abbundanza kbira.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 极其丰富；大量而丰盛的状态。

formal.mt: Din is-sena l-ġnien tana barka t'Alla ta' frott, u qassamna parti minnu lill-ġirien.
formal.en: This year the garden gave us a great abundance of fruit, and we shared some of it with the neighbours.
formal.zh: 今年果园的水果收获极其丰富，我们把其中一部分分给了邻居。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Hemm biżżejjed ikel għal kulħadd? Ġużi: Iva, hemm barka t'Alla ta' ikel fuq il-mejda!
colloquial.en: Marija: Is there enough food for everyone? Ġużi: Yes, there is a great abundance of food on the table!
colloquial.zh: Marija：食物够大家吃吗？Ġużi：够，桌上的食物可丰盛了！

messages.speaker: Marija (客人)
messages.zh: 食物够大家吃吗？
messages.en: Is there enough food for everyone?

messages.speaker: Ġużi (主人)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, hemm barka t'Alla ta' ikel fuq il-mejda!
messages.mt_standard: Iva, hemm barka t'Alla ta' ikel fuq il-mejda!
messages.zh: 够，桌上的食物可丰盛了！
messages.en: Yes, there is a great abundance of food on the table!

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 barka t'Alla 整体贴在一幅水果堆满篮子的画面上，记成“多得很、极丰盛”；先整体掌握这个表达的数量意义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To wear a hood or a cowl over the head.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把兜帽或修士风帽戴在头上。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jilbes barnuża jew għata tar-ras bħal dik ta' patri.

sense_translations.en_definition: to wear a hood, a cowl
sense_translations.zh_definition: 戴兜帽或修士风帽。

collocations.en: He put on his hood before going out.

formal.mt: Qabel ħareġ fil-bitħa, il-patri barnaż biex jgħatti rasu.
formal.en: Before going out into the courtyard, the friar put on his cowl to cover his head.
formal.zh: 修士走到庭院前，戴上风帽遮住了头。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Għaliex ma nistax nara ras Pawlu sew? Rita: Barnaż għax hemm ir-riħ.
colloquial.en: Anna: Why can I not see Pawlu's head clearly? Rita: He has put on his hood because it is windy.
colloquial.zh: Anna：我怎么不太看得清 Pawlu 的头？Rita：风大，他把兜帽戴上了。

messages.speaker: Anna (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex ma nistax nara ras Pawlu sew?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex ma nistax nara ras Pawlu sew?
messages.zh: 我怎么不太看得清 Pawlu 的头？
messages.en: Why can I not see Pawlu's head clearly?

messages.speaker: Rita (朋友)
messages.zh: 风大，他把兜帽戴上了。
messages.en: He has put on his hood because it is windy.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记 barnaż 时做一个把兜帽拉到头上的动作，让词和动作同时出现；它表示戴帽这个动作，不是帽子本身的名称。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To make the soft cooing sound of a pigeon.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指鸽子发出轻柔的咕咕叫声。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jagħmel il-ħoss artab tipiku tal-ħamiem.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 咕咕叫，用于描述鸽子的叫声。

formal.mt: Filgħodu, il-ħamiem barqam fuq il-bejt tal-bini.
formal.en: In the morning, the pigeons cooed on the roof of the building.
formal.zh: 早晨，鸽子在楼顶上咕咕叫。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'kien dak il-ħoss ħdejn it-tieqa? Luqa: Il-ħamiem barqam fuq il-bejt.
colloquial.en: Maja: What was that sound near the window? Luqa: The pigeons cooed on the roof.
colloquial.zh: Maja：刚才窗边是什么声音？Luqa：是屋顶上的鸽子在咕咕叫。

messages.speaker: Maja (室友)
messages.zh: 刚才窗边是什么声音？
messages.en: What was that sound near the window?

messages.speaker: Luqa (室友)
messages.zh: 是屋顶上的鸽子在咕咕叫。
messages.en: The pigeons cooed on the roof.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 barqam 配上一只屋顶鸽子和轻柔的“咕咕”声，每次读词就回想这幅画面；本词条要和鸽子的叫声一起记。

gloss_zh: 用力锉；反复抛光；锉工；抛光者
