teaching_sense.en_definition: To file something vigorously, or to polish it repeatedly.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用锉刀用力加工物体，或反复擦磨物体，使其表面光亮。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jaħdem xi ħaġa bil-lima bis-saħħa, jew jillustraha ripetutament.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 用锉刀用力锉削物体。
反复抛光或擦亮物体表面。
用锉刀加工物体的人；锉工。
从事抛光或擦亮工作的人。

collocations.en: polished the surface repeatedly to make it shine
collocations.zh: 反复抛光表面，使其光亮

formal.mt: Il-ħaddiem barrad it-tarf tal-metall bil-lima sakemm sar lixx.
formal.en: The worker filed the metal edge vigorously until it became smooth.
formal.zh: 工人用锉刀用力锉削金属边缘，直到边缘变得光滑。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Kif sar daqshekk lixx dan it-tarf? Ġorġ: Pawlu barrad it-tarf bil-lima għal ftit ħin.
colloquial.en: Mark: How did this edge become so smooth? Ġorġ: Pawlu filed it vigorously for a while.
colloquial.zh: Mark：这个边缘怎么变得这么光滑了？Ġorġ：Pawlu 用锉刀用力锉了一会儿。

messages.speaker: Mark (学徒)
messages.mt_spoken: Kif sar daqshekk lixx dan it-tarf?
messages.mt_standard: Kif sar daqshekk lixx dan it-tarf?
messages.zh: 这个边缘怎么变得这么光滑了？
messages.en: How did this edge become so smooth?

messages.speaker: Ġorġ (工匠)
messages.mt_spoken: Pawlu barrad it-tarf bil-lima għal ftit ħin.
messages.mt_standard: Pawlu barrad it-tarf bil-lima għal ftit ħin.
messages.zh: Pawlu 用锉刀用力锉了一会儿。
messages.en: Pawlu filed it vigorously for a while.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象工匠反复推动锉刀，再反复擦亮表面，把 barrad 记成“用力锉、反复磨”；作名词时则指做这些工作的人。

gloss_zh: 用于抛光的；与抛光有关的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Used for polishing, or connected with the process of polishing.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用于使物体表面光滑、发亮的，或与这种抛光过程有关的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jintuża għall-illustrar jew li għandu x'jaqsam mal-proċess tal-illustrar.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 可用于抛光的；有助于使表面光滑、发亮的。
与抛光工序或抛光工作有关的。

formal.mt: Il-materjal barradi għandu jintgħażel skont it-tip ta' wiċċ li jkun se jiġi illustrat.
formal.en: The polishing material should be selected according to the type of surface that will be polished.
formal.zh: 应根据待抛光表面的类型选择抛光材料。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Dan il-materjal barradi tajjeb għall-metall? Rita: Iva, imma ppruvah fuq parti żgħira l-ewwel.
colloquial.en: Mark: Is this polishing material suitable for metal? Rita: Yes, but try it on a small area first.
colloquial.zh: Mark：这种抛光材料适合金属吗？Rita：适合，不过先在一小块地方试试。

messages.speaker: Mark (顾客)
messages.zh: 这种抛光材料适合金属吗？
messages.en: Is this polishing material suitable for metal?

messages.speaker: Rita (店员)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, imma ppruvah fuq parti żgħira l-ewwel.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, imma ppruvah fuq parti żgħira l-ewwel.
messages.zh: 适合，不过先在一小块地方试试。
messages.en: Yes, but try it on a small area first.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象把金属表面擦得发亮：barradi 给材料或工序贴上“抛光用、与抛光有关”的标签。

gloss_zh: 用力扭绞；以捻纤维制作绳索等物的人

teaching_sense.en_definition: To twist something strongly and vigorously.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用较大的力气扭转或绞拧某物。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Idawwar u jgħawweġ xi ħaġa fuqha nnifisha bis-saħħa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 用力扭绞；使劲拧转。

sense_translations.en_definition: sb. who makes ropes etc. by twisting fibres
sense_translations.zh_definition: 通过捻合纤维来制作绳索等物的人。

formal.mt: Waqt id-dimostrazzjoni, l-artiġjan barram il-fibri bis-saħħa biex juri kif jinħadem ħabel.
formal.en: During the demonstration, the craftsperson vigorously twisted the fibres to show how rope is made.
formal.zh: 演示时，工匠用力捻绞纤维，展示绳子的制作方法。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex il-ħabel sar daqshekk issikkat? Toni: Għax Mark barram il-ħabel bis-saħħa.
colloquial.en: Lara: Why has the rope become so tightly twisted? Toni: Because Mark twisted the rope vigorously.
colloquial.zh: Lara：绳子怎么绞得这么紧？Toni：因为 Mark 刚才使劲扭绞了绳子。

messages.speaker: Lara (手工课学员)
messages.zh: 绳子怎么绞得这么紧？
messages.en: Why has the rope become so tightly twisted?

messages.speaker: Toni (手工课学员)
messages.zh: 因为 Mark 刚才使劲扭绞了绳子。
messages.en: Because Mark twisted the rope vigorously.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象双手反向使劲拧绳：动词强调用力扭绞；名词则指捻纤维制绳的人，靠动作与人物区分。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Causing something to twist or become twisted.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 具有使某物扭转、扭绞或发生扭曲作用的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jġiegħel xi ħaġa ddur jew titgħawweġ fuqha nnifisha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 会使物体扭转或扭绞的；具有致扭作用的。

formal.mt: Il-mekkaniżmu barrami jġiegħel il-fibri jduru fuqhom infushom waqt it-tħaddim.
formal.en: The twisting mechanism causes the fibres to twist around themselves during operation.
formal.zh: 运行时，这个致扭机构使纤维绕自身扭绞。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Dan il-mekkaniżmu barrami x'jagħmel? Ġużeppi: Iġiegħel il-fibri jduru fuqhom infushom.
colloquial.en: Nina: What does this twisting mechanism do? Ġużeppi: It makes the fibres twist around themselves.
colloquial.zh: Nina：这个致扭机构是做什么的？Ġużeppi：它让纤维绕自身扭绞。

messages.speaker: Nina (学徒)
messages.zh: 这个致扭机构是做什么的？
messages.en: What does this twisting mechanism do?

messages.speaker: Ġużeppi (师傅)
messages.zh: 它让纤维绕自身扭绞。
messages.en: It makes the fibres twist around themselves.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给会把纤维拧起来的机构贴上 barrami 标签，记住它描述“使别的东西扭绞”的性质。

gloss_zh: 反复抓刮或刮擦；刮刀；刮具

teaching_sense.en_definition: To scratch or scrape a surface repeatedly or frequently.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 多次或经常抓刮、刮擦某个表面。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jigref jew jobrox wiċċ kemm-il darba jew ta' spiss.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 经常或反复抓刮、刮擦。
用于刮除表面物质的工具；刮刀；刮具。

collocations.en: he scraped the surface several times
collocations.zh: 他把表面反复刮了几遍

formal.mt: Il-ħaddiem barrax il-wiċċ diversi drabi biex ineħħi ż-żebgħa l-qadima.
formal.en: The worker scraped the surface several times to remove the old paint.
formal.zh: 工人反复刮擦表面，以除去旧漆。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Fejn poġġejt il-barrax? Rita: Fuq il-bank, ħdejn il-bott taż-żebgħa.
colloquial.en: Mark: Where did you put the scraper? Rita: On the workbench, next to the paint tin.
colloquial.zh: Mark：你把刮刀放哪儿了？Rita：在工作台上，油漆罐旁边。

messages.speaker: Mark (修缮工)
messages.zh: 你把刮刀放哪儿了？
messages.en: Where did you put the scraper?

messages.speaker: Rita (同事)
messages.zh: 在工作台上，油漆罐旁边。
messages.en: On the workbench, next to the paint tin.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把“反复刮表面”的动作和“手里的刮刀”并排记忆：同一拼写有动词与工具名词两种用法。

gloss_zh: 容易造成抓痕或刮擦的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Having a tendency to scratch or scrape surfaces.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 具有容易划伤、抓刮或刮擦其他表面的性质。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu tendenza jigref jew jobrox l-uċuħ li jmiss magħhom.

sense_translations.en_definition: with a tendency to cause scratching or scraping
sense_translations.zh_definition: 容易造成抓痕、划伤或刮擦的。

collocations.en: material that tends to scratch or scrape
a surface that tends to scratch
collocations.zh: 容易刮伤其他物体的表面

formal.mt: Il-materjal barraxi jista' jħalli marki fuq il-ħġieġ jekk jingħorok miegħu.
formal.en: The scratch-causing material may leave marks on glass if rubbed against it.
formal.zh: 这种容易造成刮擦的材料若与玻璃摩擦，可能留下痕迹。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Dan il-materjal barraxi? Toni: Iva, jista' jobrox il-ħġieġ.
colloquial.en: Lara: Does this material tend to scratch? Toni: Yes, it can scratch glass.
colloquial.zh: Lara：这种材料容易刮伤东西吗？Toni：是的，它会刮伤玻璃。

messages.speaker: Lara (顾客)
messages.zh: 这种材料容易刮伤东西吗？
messages.en: Does this material tend to scratch?

messages.speaker: Toni (店员)
messages.zh: 是的，它会刮伤玻璃。
messages.en: Yes, it can scratch glass.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象粗糙材料碰过玻璃后留下细痕：barraxi 描述容易造成刮擦的性质，不是那道刮痕本身。

gloss_zh: 堆起；堆成一堆；堆积者；积聚者；量小麦的人

teaching_sense.en_definition: To put things together in a pile or form them into a heap.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把东西集中堆放，使其形成一堆。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Iqiegħed affarijiet fuq xulxin jew flimkien biex jagħmel munzell.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 把某物堆起来；把东西堆积在一起。
堆成一堆；形成一个堆。
把东西堆成堆的人；堆放者。
不断积聚东西的人；积聚者。
量取小麦的人；负责计量小麦的人。

formal.mt: Il-ħaddiem barraġ il-ġebel ħdejn il-ħajt sabiex il-mogħdija tibqa' ħielsa.
formal.en: The worker piled up the stones beside the wall so that the path would remain clear.
formal.zh: 工人把石头堆在墙边，以保持通道畅通。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Min barraġ dan il-ġebel hawn? Pawlu: Jien, biex inneħħih min-nofs il-mogħdija.
colloquial.en: Maja: Who piled up these stones here? Pawlu: I did, to get them out of the middle of the path.
colloquial.zh: Maja：谁把这些石头堆在这里了？Pawlu：是我，为了把它们从路中间移开。

messages.speaker: Maja (邻居)
messages.zh: 谁把这些石头堆在这里了？
messages.en: Who piled up these stones here?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (邻居)
messages.zh: 是我，为了把它们从路中间移开。
messages.en: I did, to get them out of the middle of the path.

cognitive_memory_aid: 先记“石头堆成一堆”的动作画面；作名词时分别记堆放者、积聚者和量小麦的人，勿混淆词性。

gloss_zh: 笨拙地做；缝得粗劣；缝纫拙劣者；一种帽子；膝部很宽的老式裤子

teaching_sense.en_definition: To do something clumsily, especially to sew or stitch in a clumsy way.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 笨手笨脚地做某事，尤其指把针线活缝得粗劣、不整齐。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jagħmel xi ħaġa mingħajr sengħa jew reqqa, speċjalment meta jħit.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 笨拙地做某事；把事情做得粗手粗脚。

sense_translations.en_definition: to stitch in a clumsy fashion
sense_translations.zh_definition: 笨拙地缝纫；把针脚缝得粗劣、不整齐。

sense_translations.en_definition: one who sews or stitches badly
sense_translations.zh_definition: 缝纫手艺差的人；针线活做得粗劣的人。
一种帽子。

sense_translations.en_definition: old-fashioned trousers which are very wide at the knees
sense_translations.zh_definition: 一种膝部特别宽大的老式裤子。

formal.mt: L-apprendist barważ il-ħjata, u l-għalliem urieh kif jagħmel il-punti b'mod aktar regolari.
formal.en: The apprentice stitched the seam clumsily, and the teacher showed him how to make the stitches more even.
formal.zh: 学徒把接缝缝得不整齐，老师便示范如何使针脚更加均匀。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Min barważ il-ħjata tal-borża? Pawlu: Jien; kont qed nitgħallem inħit.
colloquial.en: Maja: Who stitched the bag's seam so clumsily? Pawlu: I did; I was learning to sew.
colloquial.zh: Maja：谁把袋子的接缝缝得这么不整齐？Pawlu：是我，我当时正在学缝纫。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 谁把袋子的接缝缝得这么不整齐？
messages.en: Who stitched the bag's seam so clumsily?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.zh: 是我，我当时正在学缝纫。
messages.en: I did; I was learning to sew.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用歪歪扭扭的针脚记动作义和手艺差的人；帽子、膝部宽大的老式裤子两项名词义另做图卡记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A mark or shallow injury made by scratching a surface or the skin.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 物体表面或皮肤被抓、划、刮后留下的痕迹或浅表损伤。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Marka jew ferita ħafifa li titħalla meta xi ħaġa tobrox wiċċ jew il-ġilda.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 一道抓痕、划痕或刮痕；也可指皮肤上的浅表划伤。

formal.mt: Waqt l-ispezzjoni ġiet innutata barxa fuq il-wiċċ tal-mejda.
formal.en: During the inspection, a scratch was noticed on the surface of the table.
formal.zh: 检查时，发现桌面上有一道划痕。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Kif ġiet dik il-barxa fuq idek? Mark: Il-qattus grifni waqt li kont qed nilgħab miegħu.
colloquial.en: Nina: How did you get that scratch on your hand? Mark: The cat scratched me while I was playing with it.
colloquial.zh: Nina：你手上那道抓痕是怎么弄的？Mark：我跟猫玩的时候被它抓了一下。

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Kif ġiet dik il-barxa fuq idek?
messages.mt_standard: Kif ġiet dik il-barxa fuq idek?
messages.zh: 你手上那道抓痕是怎么弄的？
messages.en: How did you get that scratch on your hand?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-qattus grifni waqt li kont qed nilgħab miegħu.
messages.mt_standard: Il-qattus grifni waqt li kont qed nilgħab miegħu.
messages.zh: 我跟猫玩的时候被它抓了一下。
messages.en: The cat scratched me while I was playing with it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 看见桌面或手上的一道细痕，就联想 barxa；它是刮擦留下的痕迹，也可指浅浅的划伤。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A peptic ulcer, a sore in the lining of the stomach or the first part of the small intestine.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 消化性溃疡，指胃或小肠起始部位内壁出现的溃疡。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ulċera fil-kisja tal-istonku jew tal-ewwel parti tal-musrana ż-żgħira.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 消化性溃疡

collocations.en: a diagnosis of a peptic ulcer

formal.mt: Ir-rapport mediku jindika li l-pazjent għandu barxa fl-istonku.
formal.en: The medical report indicates that the patient has a peptic ulcer.
formal.zh: 医疗报告指出，该患者患有消化性溃疡。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'qallek it-tabib? Mark: Qalli li għandi barxa fl-istonku, u spjegali l-kura.
colloquial.en: Maja: What did the doctor tell you? Mark: He told me I have a peptic ulcer and explained the treatment.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：医生怎么说？马克：他说我有消化性溃疡，还向我解释了治疗方案。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 医生怎么说？
messages.en: What did the doctor tell you?

messages.speaker: Mark (患者)
messages.mt_spoken: Qalli li għandi barxa fl-istonku, u spjegali l-kura.
messages.mt_standard: Qalli li għandi barxa fl-istonku, u spjegali l-kura.
messages.zh: 他说我有消化性溃疡，还向我解释了治疗方案。
messages.en: He told me I have a peptic ulcer and explained the treatment.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把整个短语放进“医生解释胃部溃疡”的场景记忆；用完整词组对应消化性溃疡，避免只记其中一个词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To cook something until it is browned, or to burn it during cooking.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把食物烹调至表面焦黄，也可指烹调时把食物烧焦。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Sajjar xi ħaġa sakemm ħadet kulur kannella, jew ħaraqha waqt it-tisjir.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 烘烤至表面焦黄
在烹调过程中烧焦食物

formal.mt: Il-furnar baskat il-ħobż sakemm il-qoxra ħadet kulur kannella dehbi.
formal.en: The baker baked the bread until its crust turned golden brown.
formal.zh: 面包师把面包烤至外皮呈金黄色。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex il-gallettini huma suwed? Mark: Ħallejthom fil-forn wisq; il-forn baskat il-gallettini.
colloquial.en: Lara: Why are the biscuits black? Mark: I left them in the oven too long; the oven burned the biscuits.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：饼干怎么黑了？马克：我把它们放在烤箱里太久了，烤箱把饼干烤焦了。

messages.speaker: Lara (室友)
messages.zh: 饼干怎么黑了？
messages.en: Why are the biscuits black?

messages.speaker: Mark (做饭的室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ħallejthom fil-forn wisq; il-forn baskat il-gallettini.
messages.mt_standard: Ħallejthom fil-forn wisq; il-forn baskat il-gallettini.
messages.zh: 我把它们放在烤箱里太久了，烤箱把饼干烤焦了。
messages.en: I left them in the oven too long; the oven burned the biscuits.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象烤盘上的两块饼干：一块金黄，一块焦黑。用这幅对照图同时记住“烤黄”和“烧焦”两个义项。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Bulbous; rounded and swollen in shape like an onion or a bulb.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形状像洋葱或球茎一样圆鼓、膨大的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu forma tonda u minfuħa bħal basla jew bulbu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 球茎状的；圆鼓膨大的

sense_translations.en_definition: having the shape of an onion or bulb
sense_translations.zh_definition: 具有洋葱或球茎形状的

formal.mt: Il-vażun għandu għonq dejjaq u ġisem basli.
formal.en: The vase has a narrow neck and a bulbous body.
formal.zh: 这个花瓶有细长的瓶颈和球茎状的瓶身。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Kif tiddeskrivi dan il-vażun? Lara: Għandu ġisem basli, qisu basla kbira.
colloquial.en: Maja: How would you describe this vase? Lara: It has a bulbous body, like a large onion.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你会怎么描述这个花瓶？拉拉：它的瓶身圆鼓鼓的，像一颗大洋葱。

messages.speaker: Maja (美术学生)
messages.zh: 你会怎么描述这个花瓶？
messages.en: How would you describe this vase?

messages.speaker: Lara (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandu ġisem basli, qisu basla kbira.
messages.mt_standard: Għandu ġisem basli, qisu basla kbira.
messages.zh: 它的瓶身圆鼓鼓的，像一颗大洋葱。
messages.en: It has a bulbous body, like a large onion.

cognitive_memory_aid: 画一个细颈、大肚的花瓶，再在旁边画一颗洋葱；把 basli 贴在两者圆鼓的轮廓上，记住它描述形状。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A statement about what someone thinks will happen in the future.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 对未来可能发生的事情所作的预测或预言。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Dikjarazzjoni dwar dak li wieħed jaħseb li se jiġri fil-futur.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 预测；对未来情况的预言

formal.mt: Il-basra dwar ir-riżultat tal-logħba kienet korretta.
formal.en: The prediction about the result of the match was correct.
formal.zh: 对比赛结果的预测是准确的。

colloquial.mt: Mark: X'inhi l-basra tiegħek għal-logħba? Lara: Naħseb li se nirbħu tnejn b'wieħed.
colloquial.en: Mark: What's your prediction for the match? Lara: I think we'll win two to one.
colloquial.zh: 马克：你预测这场比赛会是什么结果？拉拉：我觉得我们会以二比一获胜。

messages.speaker: Mark (球迷朋友)
messages.zh: 你预测这场比赛会是什么结果？
messages.en: What's your prediction for the match?

messages.speaker: Lara (球迷朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Naħseb li se nirbħu tnejn b'wieħed.
messages.mt_standard: Naħseb li se nirbħu tnejn b'wieħed.
messages.zh: 我觉得我们会以二比一获胜。
messages.en: I think we'll win two to one.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 basra 想成赛前写在纸上的一个比分：它是“一项预测”这个名词，比赛结束后才能检查是否准确。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A fart; also, in a separate sense, a person who interferes in other people's affairs.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 屁；另一个独立义项指喜欢干涉别人事务、爱管闲事的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ħruġ ta' gass mill-imsaren; f'tifsira oħra, persuna li tindaħal fl-affarijiet ta' ħaddieħor.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 一个屁；肠道排出的气体
爱管闲事的人；喜欢干涉别人事务的人

collocations.en: a meddler who interferes in everything

formal.mt: Fil-lingwaġġ ta' kuljum, il-kelma 'bassa' tista' tirreferi għall-ħruġ ta' gass mill-imsaren.
formal.en: In everyday language, the word 'bassa' can refer to the release of gas from the intestines.
formal.zh: 在日常语言中，bassa 一词可以指肠道排气，也就是屁。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex qed jistaqsi dwar kull deċiżjoni tagħna? Lara: Dak bassa; dejjem jindaħal f'kollox.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why is he asking about every decision we make? Lara: He's a meddler; he always interferes in everything.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：他为什么对我们的每个决定都要问个不停？拉拉：他就是个爱管闲事的人，什么事都要插手。

messages.speaker: Maja (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex qed jistaqsi dwar kull deċiżjoni tagħna?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex qed jistaqsi dwar kull deċiżjoni tagħna?
messages.zh: 他为什么对我们的每个决定都要问个不停？
messages.en: Why is he asking about every decision we make?

messages.speaker: Lara (同事)
messages.zh: 他就是个爱管闲事的人，什么事都要插手。
messages.en: He's a meddler; he always interferes in everything.

cognitive_memory_aid: 制作两张分开的场景卡：一张画排气声，一张画插手别人事务的人。同写 bassa，靠语境区分两个名词义项。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To remove the outer skin from onions.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 剥去洋葱外层的皮。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Neħħa l-qoxra ta' barra tal-basal.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 剥洋葱皮

collocations.zh: 为准备饭菜剥了洋葱皮

formal.mt: L-assistent bassal qabel ma l-kok beda jipprepara s-soppa.
formal.en: The assistant peeled onions before the chef began preparing the soup.
formal.zh: 助手在厨师开始准备汤之前剥好了洋葱皮。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Min bassal għall-ikla? Mark: Jien; il-basal lest biex tqattgħu.
colloquial.en: Maja: Who peeled onions for the meal? Mark: I did; the onions are ready for you to chop.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这顿饭要用的洋葱是谁剥的？马克：我剥的，洋葱已经可以切了。

messages.speaker: Maja (一起做饭的朋友)
messages.zh: 这顿饭要用的洋葱是谁剥的？
messages.en: Who peeled onions for the meal?

messages.speaker: Mark (一起做饭的朋友)
messages.zh: 我剥的，洋葱已经可以切了。
messages.en: I did; the onions are ready for you to chop.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“先剥皮，再切块”的厨房动作记住 bassal，把注意力放在剥去洋葱外皮这一步，避免泛记成处理蔬菜。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To say in advance what is expected to happen in the future.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 预先说出预计将发生的事情，即预测或预报。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Qal minn qabel dak li kien mistenni li jiġri fil-futur.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 预测；预言将来会发生的事情
预报；对未来情况作出预测
占卜者；算命的人
预言未来的人

formal.mt: Il-meteorologu bassar xita qawwija għall-għada.
formal.en: The meteorologist forecast heavy rain for the following day.
formal.zh: 气象学家预报次日将有大雨。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Min hu dak il-karattru fl-istorja? Mark: Hu bassar li jgħid li jaf x'se jiġri fil-futur.
colloquial.en: Lara: Who is that character in the story? Mark: He's a fortune teller who says he knows what will happen in the future.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：故事里的那个人物是谁？马克：他是个占卜者，声称知道将来会发生什么。

messages.speaker: Lara (读书的朋友)
messages.zh: 故事里的那个人物是谁？
messages.en: Who is that character in the story?

messages.speaker: Mark (读书的朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Hu bassar li jgħid li jaf x'se jiġri fil-futur.
messages.mt_standard: Hu bassar li jgħid li jaf x'se jiġri fil-futur.
messages.zh: 他是个占卜者，声称知道将来会发生什么。
messages.en: He's a fortune teller who says he knows what will happen in the future.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 bassar 配两幅图：气象员“作出预报”表示动词，故事中的“占卜者”表示名词；同一拼写要连同句中角色一起记。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Prophetic or oracular; expressing a prediction or sounding like a pronouncement about the future.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 带有预言性质的，或像神谕一样宣告未来情况的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jbassar il-futur jew li jinstema' bħal oraklu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 预言性的；具有预示未来性质的
神谕般的；带有神谕口吻的

formal.mt: Il-kliem bassari tal-karattru fil-bidu tar-rumanz jindika dak li jiġri fl-aħħar.
formal.en: The character's prophetic words at the beginning of the novel point to what happens at the end.
formal.zh: 小说开头人物所说的预言性话语，预示了结尾发生的事情。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex qed jitkellem b'dak it-ton bassari? Lara: Qisu jaf minn issa kif se tispiċċa l-istorja!
colloquial.en: Maja: Why is he speaking in that oracular tone? Lara: It's as if he already knows how the story will end!
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：他为什么用那种神谕般的语气说话？拉拉：好像他现在就知道故事会怎么结束似的！

messages.speaker: Maja (戏剧观众)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex qed jitkellem b'dak it-ton bassari?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex qed jitkellem b'dak it-ton bassari?
messages.zh: 他为什么用那种神谕般的语气说话？
messages.en: Why is he speaking in that oracular tone?

messages.speaker: Lara (同行朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Qisu jaf minn issa kif se tispiċċa l-istorja!
messages.mt_standard: Qisu jaf minn issa kif se tispiċċa l-istorja!
messages.zh: 好像他现在就知道故事会怎么结束似的！
messages.en: It's as if he already knows how the story will end!

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象演员用庄重神秘的语气说出未来情节，把 bassari 标在“话语”和“语气”旁，记住它是描述预言性质的形容词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To pass intestinal gas frequently.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 频繁地排出肠道气体，即经常放屁。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li wieħed joħroġ il-gass minn imsarnu ta' spiss.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 频繁放屁。
经常放屁的人。
菱鲷，一种海鱼。

formal.mt: Wara l-ikla, ir-raġel bassas ta' spiss u ħassu skomdu.
formal.en: After the meal, the man broke wind frequently and felt uncomfortable.
formal.zh: 饭后，那名男子频繁放屁，感到不舒服。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex Pawlu ħareġ mill-kamra? Rita: Wara l-ikel bassas diversi drabi u staħa.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why did Pawlu leave the room? Rita: He broke wind several times after eating and felt embarrassed.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：保罗为什么离开房间了？丽塔：他吃完饭接连放了几个屁，觉得不好意思。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 保罗为什么离开房间了？
messages.en: Why did Pawlu leave the room?

messages.speaker: Rita (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Wara l-ikel bassas diversi drabi u staħa.
messages.mt_standard: Wara l-ikel bassas diversi drabi u staħa.
messages.zh: 他吃完饭接连放了几个屁，觉得不好意思。
messages.en: He broke wind several times after eating and felt embarrassed.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把这个词放进“饭后接连放屁”的小场景来记；再分别用“动作、人、鱼”三张卡片区分三个词义，避免把鱼名与人的行为混淆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A hollyhock, Alcea rosea, a flowering plant with tall stems.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 蜀葵，学名 Alcea rosea，一种花茎高挑的开花植物。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Pjanta tal-fjuri, Alcea rosea, bi zkuk twal.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 蜀葵，学名 Alcea rosea。

formal.mt: Fil-ġnien tal-iskola hemm bastun ta' San Ġuzepp ħdejn il-ħajt.
formal.en: There is a hollyhock beside the wall in the school garden.
formal.zh: 学校花园的墙边有一株蜀葵。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Kif jisimha din il-pjanta? Rita: Dan huwa bastun ta' San Ġuzepp. Inħawluh ħdejn il-ħajt?
colloquial.en: Maja: What is this plant called? Rita: This is a hollyhock. Shall we plant it beside the wall?
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这种植物叫什么？丽塔：这是蜀葵。我们把它种在墙边好吗？

messages.speaker: Maja (园艺爱好者)
messages.zh: 这种植物叫什么？
messages.en: What is this plant called?

messages.speaker: Rita (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Dan huwa bastun ta' San Ġuzepp. Inħawluh ħdejn il-ħajt?
messages.mt_standard: Dan huwa bastun ta' San Ġuzepp. Inħawluh ħdejn il-ħajt?
messages.zh: 这是蜀葵。我们把它种在墙边好吗？
messages.en: This is a hollyhock. Shall we plant it beside the wall?

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象墙边一株高高开花的蜀葵，把整段名称当作植物标签一起记；这只是画面联想，不是名称来源的解释。

gloss_zh: 话多；喋喋不休；吹奏簧管

teaching_sense.en_definition: To talk a great deal or chatter, often for a long time.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 说很多话，或长时间喋喋不休地闲聊。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li wieħed jitkellem ħafna jew jibqa' jitkellem għal ħin twil.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 话很多，非常健谈。
喋喋不休地说话；叽叽喳喳地闲聊。
吹奏名为 betbut 的簧管乐器。

formal.mt: Matul il-vjaġġ, Pawlu batbat mal-passiġġieri l-oħra dwar il-familja tiegħu.
formal.en: During the journey, Pawlu chattered with the other passengers about his family.
formal.zh: 旅途中，保罗和其他乘客聊自己的家人，聊个不停。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Kif marret il-laqgħa ma' Pawlu? Rita: Batbat il-ħin kollu! Bilkemm stajt ngħid kelma.
colloquial.en: Maja: How did your meeting with Pawlu go? Rita: He chattered the whole time! I could barely get a word in.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你和保罗见面聊得怎么样？丽塔：他一直说个不停！我几乎插不上一句话。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你和保罗见面聊得怎么样？
messages.en: How did your meeting with Pawlu go?

messages.speaker: Rita (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Batbat il-ħin kollu! Bilkemm stajt ngħid kelma.
messages.mt_standard: Batbat il-ħin kollu! Bilkemm stajt ngħid kelma.
messages.zh: 他一直说个不停！我几乎插不上一句话。
messages.en: He chattered the whole time! I could barely get a word in.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 batbat 看作两段重复的节拍，联想话语一句接一句停不下来；吹奏簧管的词义另配一幅乐器图来记，不把联想当作词源。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Light or slight in degree, or slow in movement, depending on the context.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 表示程度轻、强度小，或动作缓慢；具体含义取决于所修饰的事物。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ħafif jew żgħir fl-intensità, jew bil-mod fil-moviment, skont il-kuntest.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 轻的；轻微的；缓慢的。

formal.mt: Il-grupp mexa b'pass bati sabiex il-parteċipanti kollha setgħu jibqgħu flimkien.
formal.en: The group walked at a slow pace so that all the participants could stay together.
formal.zh: 队伍以缓慢的步伐前行，让所有参与者都能跟在一起。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex qed nimxu b'pass bati? Rita: Biex inżommu l-grupp flimkien.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why are we walking at a slow pace? Rita: To keep the group together.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：我们为什么走得这么慢？丽塔：为了让大家保持在一起。

messages.speaker: Maja (徒步参与者)
messages.zh: 我们为什么走得这么慢？
messages.en: Why are we walking at a slow pace?

messages.speaker: Rita (领队)
messages.zh: 为了让大家保持在一起。
messages.en: To keep the group together.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“风轻轻、程度小、脚步慢”三个画面记住这个形容词；看到 riħ 想强度，看到 pass 想速度。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Suitable for use as a plastering material.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容材料可以用于墙面等表面的抹灰施工。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jista' jintuża bħala materjal għat-tikħil.

sense_translations.en_definition: a material that can be used for plastering
sense_translations.zh_definition: 指材料可用于抹灰的；适合用作抹灰材料的。

collocations.en: to choose material suitable for plastering

formal.mt: Il-ħaddiem għażel materjal battami biex jikħel il-ħajt ta' ġewwa.
formal.en: The worker selected material suitable for plastering the interior wall.
formal.zh: 工人选择了适合给内墙抹灰的材料。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Dan il-materjal tajjeb biex nikħlu l-ħajt? Rita: Iva, huwa materjal battami.
colloquial.en: Mark: Is this material suitable for plastering the wall? Rita: Yes, it is suitable for plastering.
colloquial.zh: 马克：这种材料适合给墙抹灰吗？丽塔：适合，这是可以用来抹灰的材料。

messages.speaker: Mark (顾客)
messages.mt_spoken: Dan il-materjal tajjeb biex nikħlu l-ħajt?
messages.mt_standard: Dan il-materjal tajjeb biex nikħlu l-ħajt?
messages.zh: 这种材料适合给墙抹灰吗？
messages.en: Is this material suitable for plastering the wall?

messages.speaker: Rita (建材店员)
messages.zh: 适合，这是可以用来抹灰的材料。
messages.en: Yes, it is suitable for plastering.

cognitive_memory_aid: 在脑中给一袋材料贴上“可以抹墙”的用途标签，再连读 materjal battami；用“材料是否适用”来记住它的形容词功能。

gloss_zh: 给马系肚带；给牲畜系肚带的人

teaching_sense.en_definition: To fasten a girth around a horse.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 给马系上环绕腹部的肚带。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li wieħed jorbot ħزام madwar żaqq żiemel.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 给马系上肚带。

sense_translations.en_definition: sb. who girds horses and other animals
sense_translations.zh_definition: 给马及其他牲畜系肚带的人。

collocations.en: fastened the girth around the horse

formal.mt: Qabel ir-rikba, il-ħaddiem battan iż-żiemel u ċċekkja li ċ-ċinga kienet marbuta sew.
formal.en: Before the ride, the worker fastened the horse's girth and checked that the strap was secure.
formal.zh: 骑乘前，工作人员给马系上肚带，并检查带子是否系牢。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Min battan iż-żiemel? Mark: Pawlu. Issa qed jiċċekkja ċ-ċinga.
colloquial.en: Maja: Who fastened the horse's girth? Mark: Pawlu did. He is checking the strap now.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：谁给马系的肚带？马克：保罗。他现在正在检查带子。

messages.speaker: Maja (骑马学员)
messages.zh: 谁给马系的肚带？
messages.en: Who fastened the horse's girth?

messages.speaker: Mark (马厩工作人员)
messages.zh: 保罗。他现在正在检查带子。
messages.en: Pawlu did. He is checking the strap now.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象骑马前有人绕着马腹系紧一条带子：动作卡写“系肚带”，人物卡写“系带的人”，分别记住动词与名词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A sound produced by beating or striking.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 拍打、敲击或撞击时产生的声响。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ħoss li jsir meta xi ħaġa tħabbat jew tolqot xi ħaġa oħra.

sense_translations.en_definition: a beating sound (originally used for the sounds made during fencing)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 拍击声或敲击声，原用于指击剑时发出的声响。

formal.mt: Meta x-xabla laqtet ix-xabla l-oħra, instema' battitu qawwi fis-sala.
formal.en: When the sword struck the other sword, a loud striking sound was heard in the hall.
formal.zh: 一把剑击中另一把剑时，大厅里响起了响亮的撞击声。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Smajt dak il-battitu? Mark: Iva, kien il-ħoss tax-xwabel waqt it-taħriġ.
colloquial.en: Maja: Did you hear that striking sound? Mark: Yes, it was the sound of the swords during training.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你听到那声撞击声了吗？马克：听到了，那是训练时剑相击的声音。

messages.speaker: Maja (观众)
messages.zh: 你听到那声撞击声了吗？
messages.en: Did you hear that striking sound?

messages.speaker: Mark (击剑学员)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, kien il-ħoss tax-xwabel waqt it-taħriġ.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, kien il-ħoss tax-xwabel waqt it-taħriġ.
messages.zh: 听到了，那是训练时剑相击的声音。
messages.en: Yes, it was the sound of the swords during training.

cognitive_memory_aid: 闭眼想象两件物体相击后传来一声“当”，把 battitu 贴在这段声音上；重点记它指声响，而不是发出声音的人。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The application of plaster to a surface, or an instance of this work.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在墙面等表面涂抹灰料的作业，或一次这样的施工。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ix-xogħol li fih jitqiegħed it-tikħil fuq wiċċ bħal ħajt.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 抹灰作业；一次抹灰施工。

formal.mt: Il-battmatura tal-ħajt tlestiet qabel ma beda x-xogħol taż-żebgħa.
formal.en: The plastering of the wall was completed before the painting work began.
formal.zh: 墙面的抹灰作业在油漆施工开始前完成了。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Lestiet il-battmatura tal-ħajt? Rita: Iva, il-ħaddiem temmha dalgħodu.
colloquial.en: Mark: Is the plastering of the wall finished? Rita: Yes, the worker finished it this morning.
colloquial.zh: 马克：墙面抹灰做好了吗？丽塔：做好了，工人今天上午完成的。

messages.speaker: Mark (房主)
messages.zh: 墙面抹灰做好了吗？
messages.en: Is the plastering of the wall finished?

messages.speaker: Rita (施工负责人)
messages.zh: 做好了，工人今天上午完成的。
messages.en: Yes, the worker finished it this morning.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象施工进度表上“墙面抹灰”这一项被打勾，把 battmatura 记成整项作业的名称；再用“完成抹灰”这个搭配巩固名词用法。

gloss_zh: 屋面用碎陶片、沙和石灰混合料

teaching_sense.en_definition: A mixture used for roofing, usually made from crushed potsherds, sand and lime.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 铺设或修补屋面所用的混合材料，通常由碎陶片、沙和石灰组成。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Taħlita użata għall-bjut, ġeneralment magħmula minn frak tal-fuħħar, ramel u ġir.

sense_translations.en_definition: a mixture used for roofing, usually consisting of crushed potsherds, sand and lime
sense_translations.zh_definition: 屋面用混合料，通常由碎陶片、沙和石灰组成。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Taħlita għall-bjut li ġeneralment tikkonsisti fi frak tal-fuħħar, ramel u ġir.

collocations.zh: 铺有这种混合料的屋面

formal.mt: Għat-tiswija tas-saqaf intuża battumi magħmul minn frak tal-fuħħar, ramel u ġir.
formal.en: Battumi made from crushed potsherds, sand and lime was used to repair the roof.
formal.zh: 修补屋面时使用了由碎陶片、沙和石灰制成的混合料。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'se tuża għas-saqaf? Mark: Se nuża battumi, taħlita ta' frak tal-fuħħar, ramel u ġir.
colloquial.en: Maja: What will you use for the roof? Mark: I'll use battumi, a mixture of crushed potsherds, sand and lime.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你打算用什么材料铺屋面？马克：我会用 battumi，就是碎陶片、沙和石灰混成的材料。

messages.speaker: Maja (房主)
messages.zh: 你打算用什么材料铺屋面？
messages.en: What will you use for the roof?

messages.speaker: Mark (建筑工人)
messages.mt_spoken: Se nuża battumi, taħlita ta' frak tal-fuħħar, ramel u ġir.
messages.mt_standard: Se nuża battumi, taħlita ta' frak tal-fuħħar, ramel u ġir.
messages.zh: 我会用 battumi，就是碎陶片、沙和石灰混成的材料。
messages.en: I'll use battumi, a mixture of crushed potsherds, sand and lime.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 battumi 配成一张屋顶材料图：碎陶片、沙、石灰三样混合，再铺到屋面上；用画面记住它是材料名。

gloss_zh: 身体不适的；不健康的；需求低迷的

teaching_sense.en_definition: In poor health, or experiencing weak demand in business, services or sales.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容身体不适或健康状况不佳；也形容商业、服务或销售方面需求不足、行情低迷。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jiddeskrivi lil min ma jkunx f'saħħtu, jew suq jew negozju fejn id-domanda tkun baxxa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 身体不适的；患病而虚弱的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li jkun marid jew ma jħossux f'saħħtu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 不健康的；健康状况不佳的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li ma jkunx f'kundizzjoni tajba ta' saħħa.

sense_translations.en_definition: not in demand (especially in the context of business, services or sales)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 需求不足的；不受市场欢迎的，尤指商业、服务或销售方面。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li ma jkunx hemm wisq domanda għalih, speċjalment fil-kummerċ, fis-servizzi jew fil-bejgħ.

collocations.en: a sluggish market with weak demand

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi suq batut, b'domanda baxxa għas-servizzi.
formal.en: The report describes a sluggish market with low demand for services.
formal.zh: 报告指出，市场行情低迷，对服务的需求较低。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Kif inhu missierek? Mark: Għadu batut u qed jistrieħ id-dar.
colloquial.en: Maja: How is your father? Mark: He's still unwell and is resting at home.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你爸爸怎么样了？马克：他身体还不舒服，正在家里休息。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你爸爸怎么样了？
messages.en: How is your father?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għadu batut u qed jistrieħ id-dar.
messages.mt_standard: Għadu batut u qed jistrieħ id-dar.
messages.zh: 他身体还不舒服，正在家里休息。
messages.en: He's still unwell and is resting at home.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 batut 画两幅并排的小图：一边是身体不舒服的人，一边是顾客稀少的市场；分别联想健康欠佳和需求低迷。

gloss_zh: 把土地划作放牧用地；任耕地荒芜的人

teaching_sense.en_definition: To allocate land for animals to graze on.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把一块土地划出或安排为供牲畜吃草的放牧用地。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jalloka biċċa art biex il-bhejjem jirgħu fiha.

sense_translations.en_definition: to allocate land for animal grazing
sense_translations.zh_definition: 把土地划作牲畜放牧用地。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Jalloka art għall-mergħa tal-bhejjem.

sense_translations.en_definition: sb. who allows arable land to grow wild and uncultivated
sense_translations.zh_definition: 任由可耕地荒芜、不加耕种的人。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Persuna li tħalli art li tista' tinħadem tikber selvaġġa u tibqa' bla kultivazzjoni.

collocations.en: allocated a field for livestock to graze
collocations.zh: 划出一块田地供牲畜吃草

collocations.mt: bawwar li jħalli l-art bla kultivazzjoni
collocations.en: a person who leaves the land uncultivated
collocations.zh: 任由土地荒着、不加耕种的人

formal.mt: Il-bidwi bawwar parti mill-art tiegħu sabiex il-bhejjem ikollhom fejn jirgħu.
formal.en: The farmer allocated part of his land for grazing so that the livestock would have somewhere to feed.
formal.zh: 这位农民把自己的一部分土地划作牧地，让牲畜有地方吃草。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex hemm in-nagħaġ f'dik l-għalqa? Mark: Il-bidwi bawwar dik l-art għall-mergħa.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why are there sheep in that field? Mark: The farmer allocated that land for grazing.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：那块田里为什么有羊？马克：农民把那块地划作放牧用地了。

messages.speaker: Maja (邻居)
messages.zh: 那块田里为什么有羊？
messages.en: Why are there sheep in that field?

messages.speaker: Mark (农民)
messages.zh: 农民把那块地划作放牧用地了。
messages.en: The farmer allocated that land for grazing.

cognitive_memory_aid: 为 bawwar 分开做两张词性卡：动词卡画划出的牧地，名词卡画任田地荒芜的人；同一拼写也要分别记义。

gloss_zh: 因疏于照管而荒芜的，形容田地

teaching_sense.en_definition: Describing fields that become overgrown and wild because they are neglected.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容田地因无人照管或疏于管理而杂草丛生、变得荒芜。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jiddeskrivi għelieqi li jitħallew mingħajr kura u jimtlew b'ħaxix selvaġġ.

sense_translations.en_definition: fields which go wild due to neglect
sense_translations.zh_definition: 形容因疏于照管而变得荒芜、杂草丛生的田地。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Jingħad għal għelieqi li jsiru selvaġġi minħabba n-nuqqas ta' kura.

collocations.zh: 疏于照管而荒芜的田地

collocations.en: tracts of land gone wild through neglect

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi għelieqi bawwari, mimlija ħaxix selvaġġ minħabba n-nuqqas ta' kura.
formal.en: The report describes neglected fields that have become overgrown with wild vegetation.
formal.zh: 报告描述了一些因疏于照管而杂草丛生的荒芜田地。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex dawk l-għelieqi mimlija ħaxix? Mark: Huma għelieqi bawwari; ħadd ma ilu jieħu ħsiebhom.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why are those fields full of weeds? Mark: They've gone wild through neglect; nobody has been looking after them.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：那些田里为什么长满杂草？马克：那是疏于照管的荒田，已经有一段时间没人打理了。

messages.speaker: Maja (游客)
messages.zh: 那些田里为什么长满杂草？
messages.en: Why are those fields full of weeds?

messages.speaker: Mark (当地居民)
messages.mt_spoken: Huma għelieqi bawwari; ħadd ma ilu jieħu ħsiebhom.
messages.mt_standard: Huma għelieqi bawwari; ħadd ma ilu jieħu ħsiebhom.
messages.zh: 那是疏于照管的荒田，已经有一段时间没人打理了。
messages.en: They've gone wild through neglect; nobody has been looking after them.

cognitive_memory_aid: 看到 bawwari，就想象田埂被杂草盖住、工具久未使用的画面；记住重点是田地因缺少照管而荒芜。

gloss_zh: 悄悄溜走；从某处脱身离开

teaching_sense.en_definition: To slip away from a place quietly or without attracting attention.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 从某个地方悄悄离开，通常不引人注意。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jitlaq minn xi mkien bil-kwiet jew mingħajr ma jiġbed l-attenzjoni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 从某处悄悄溜走。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Jitlaq bil-kwiet minn xi mkien.

formal.mt: Wara l-laqgħa, Mark bawwax mill-kamra mingħajr ma ġibed l-attenzjoni.
formal.en: After the meeting, Mark slipped out of the room without attracting attention.
formal.zh: 会议结束后，马克没有引起旁人注意，悄悄溜出了房间。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Fejn mar Mark? Lara: Bawwax minn hawn qabel ma spiċċat il-laqgħa.
colloquial.en: Maja: Where did Mark go? Lara: He slipped away from here before the meeting ended.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：马克去哪儿了？拉拉：会议还没结束，他就从这里悄悄溜走了。

messages.speaker: Maja (同事)
messages.zh: 马克去哪儿了？
messages.en: Where did Mark go?

messages.speaker: Lara (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Bawwax minn hawn qabel ma spiċċat il-laqgħa.
messages.mt_standard: Bawwax minn hawn qabel ma spiċċat il-laqgħa.
messages.zh: 会议还没结束，他就从这里悄悄溜走了。
messages.en: He slipped away from here before the meeting ended.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 bawwax 配一个轻轻关门、身影消失的画面；把它和普通离开区分开，重点记住悄悄溜走的感觉。

gloss_zh: tbaxraq 的假设第一式动词形式

teaching_sense.en_definition: A hypothetical Form I verb corresponding to 'tbaxraq', with no independent action meaning specified here.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 作为 tbaxraq 所对应的假设第一式动词形式列出；此处未提供它独立表示的具体动作义。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Forma I ipotetika tal-verb 'tbaxraq'; hawn ma tingħatax tifsira indipendenti ta' azzjoni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: tbaxraq 的假设第一式形式。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-Forma I ipotetika ta' 'tbaxraq'.

collocations.zh: 作为第一式形式的 baxraq

formal.mt: F'din in-nota, 'baxraq' huwa elenkat bħala l-Forma I ipotetika ta' 'tbaxraq'.
formal.en: In this note, 'baxraq' is listed as the hypothetical Form I of 'tbaxraq'.
formal.zh: 本注释把 baxraq 列为 tbaxraq 的假设第一式形式。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Xi tfisser in-nota ħdejn 'baxraq'? Mark: Tgħid li huwa l-Forma I ipotetika ta' 'tbaxraq'; ma tagħtix tifsira oħra.
colloquial.en: Maja: What does the note beside 'baxraq' mean? Mark: It says that it is the hypothetical Form I of 'tbaxraq'; it gives no other meaning.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：baxraq 旁边的注释是什么意思？马克：注释说它是 tbaxraq 的假设第一式形式，没有给出其他词义。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.zh: baxraq 旁边的注释是什么意思？
messages.en: What does the note beside 'baxraq' mean?

messages.speaker: Mark (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Tgħid li huwa l-Forma I ipotetika ta' 'tbaxraq'; ma tagħtix tifsira oħra.
messages.mt_standard: Tgħid li huwa l-Forma I ipotetika ta' 'tbaxraq'; ma tagħtix tifsira oħra.
messages.zh: 注释说它是 tbaxraq 的假设第一式形式，没有给出其他词义。
messages.en: It says that it is the hypothetical Form I of 'tbaxraq'; it gives no other meaning.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 baxraq 放进标有“假设第一式”的词卡，并在旁边写 tbaxraq；只记资料给出的对应说明，不自行补出动作词义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act or process of lowering something, reducing its intensity, or degrading its dignity or status.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使某物降低、使强度减弱，或使尊严、地位受到贬低的行为或过程。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att jew il-proċess li xi ħaġa titniżżel, tonqos fil-qawwa, jew titbaxxa fid-dinjità jew fl-istatus.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 降低；使位置、水平或程度下降的行为或过程。
sense_translations.mt_definition: L-att jew il-proċess tat-tniżżil ta' xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 减弱；强度或程度减轻的过程。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-proċess ta' tnaqqis fil-qawwa jew fl-intensità.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 贬低；使尊严或地位降低的行为或过程。
sense_translations.mt_definition: L-att li titbaxxa d-dinjità jew l-istatus ta' xi ħadd.

collocations.en: an abating of the wind's strength

formal.mt: F'dan ir-rapport, 'baxxej' jirreferi għat-tniżżil tal-livell tal-ilma.
formal.en: In this report, 'baxxej' refers to the lowering of the water level.
formal.zh: 在这份报告中，baxxej 指水位降低这一过程。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Xi jfisser 'baxxej' f'din is-sentenza dwar ir-riħ? Mark: Hawn ifisser tnaqqis fil-qawwa tar-riħ.
colloquial.en: Maja: What does 'baxxej' mean in this sentence about the wind? Mark: Here it means an abating of the wind's strength.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这句谈风的话里，baxxej 是什么意思？马克：这里指风力减弱。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Xi jfisser 'baxxej' f'din is-sentenza dwar ir-riħ?
messages.mt_standard: Xi jfisser 'baxxej' f'din is-sentenza dwar ir-riħ?
messages.zh: 这句谈风的话里，baxxej 是什么意思？
messages.en: What does 'baxxej' mean in this sentence about the wind?

messages.speaker: Mark (教师)
messages.zh: 这里指风力减弱。
messages.en: Here it means an abating of the wind's strength.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用三个向下箭头记 baxxej：水位下降、风力减弱、尊严受贬低；把三种意义都记成行为或过程的名词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Bent forward at the waist or holding the body in a stooping position.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 身体向前弯曲、弯着腰或保持俯身姿势的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu ġismu milwi 'l quddiem jew jinsab f'qagħda milwija.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 弯着腰的；身体向前俯下的。
躬着身子的；保持弯腰姿势的。

formal.mt: Ir-restawratur baqa' baxxut fuq il-mejda waqt li eżamina d-dokument.
formal.en: The restorer remained bent over the table while examining the document.
formal.zh: 修复师检查文件时一直俯身在桌子上方。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex qiegħed baxxut ħdejn il-bieb? Mark: Qed infittex iċ-ċavetta taħt is-siġġu.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why are you bent over by the door? Mark: I'm looking for the key under the chair.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你为什么在门边弯着腰？马克：我在找椅子下面的钥匙。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你为什么在门边弯着腰？
messages.en: Why are you bent over by the door?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 我在找椅子下面的钥匙。
messages.en: I'm looking for the key under the chair.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象弯腰在椅子下面找钥匙，把 baxxut 和身体前俯的姿势一起记住。

gloss_zh: 帕夏；容易被人取悦的人

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person bearing the title of pasha; also, a person whom others can easily please.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 拥有“帕夏”头衔的人；也指很容易被他人取悦、很容易感到满意的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna bit-titlu ta' baxà; ukoll, persuna li ħaddieħor jista' jogħġobha faċilment.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 帕夏，指拥有这一头衔的人。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Persuna li għandha t-titlu ta' baxà.

sense_translations.en_definition: one who is often easily pleased by others
sense_translations.zh_definition: 常常很容易被他人取悦的人。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Persuna li spiss ikun faċli għal ħaddieħor li jogħġobha.

collocations.en: a person who is easy to please

formal.mt: Fit-test, il-persuna msemmija għandha t-titlu ta' baxà.
formal.en: In the text, the person mentioned bears the title of pasha.
formal.zh: 文中提到的那个人拥有帕夏的头衔。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Biċċa kejk żgħira biżżejjed biex tkun kuntent? Mark: Iva, jien baxà; b'ħaġa żgħira nkun kuntent.
colloquial.en: Maja: Is a small piece of cake enough to make you happy? Mark: Yes, I'm easy to please; a little thing makes me happy.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：一小块蛋糕就能让你开心吗？马克：是啊，我很容易满足，一点小东西就能让我开心。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Biċċa kejk żgħira biżżejjed biex tkun kuntent?
messages.mt_standard: Biċċa kejk żgħira biżżejjed biex tkun kuntent?
messages.zh: 一小块蛋糕就能让你开心吗？
messages.en: Is a small piece of cake enough to make you happy?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, jien baxà; b'ħaġa żgħira nkun kuntent.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, jien baxà; b'ħaġa żgħira nkun kuntent.
messages.zh: 是啊，我很容易满足，一点小东西就能让我开心。
messages.en: Yes, I'm easy to please; a little thing makes me happy.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 baxà 写在双面卡片上：正面记头衔“帕夏”，背面画收到一小块蛋糕就开心的人；两义分开记，保留末尾重音符号。

gloss_zh: 马耳他式贝齐克纸牌游戏

teaching_sense.en_definition: A Maltese variant of the card game bezique.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 贝齐克纸牌游戏的一种马耳他变体。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Logħba tal-karti li hija varjant Malti tal-bezique.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 贝齐克纸牌游戏的一种马耳他变体。

collocations.zh: 一局马耳他式贝齐克纸牌游戏
马耳他式贝齐克纸牌游戏的规则
玩马耳他式贝齐克纸牌游戏

formal.mt: Il-klabb organizza laqgħa biex il-parteċipanti jitgħallmu r-regoli tal-bazzika u jilagħbu flimkien.
formal.en: The club organized a meeting for participants to learn the rules of Maltese bezique and play together.
formal.zh: 俱乐部组织了一次活动，让参与者学习马耳他式贝齐克纸牌游戏的规则，并一起打牌。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Trid tilgħab logħba bazzika? Toni: Iva, imma l-ewwel spjegali r-regoli, għax qatt ma lgħabtha.
colloquial.en: Rita: Do you want to play a game of Maltese bezique? Toni: Yes, but explain the rules first, because I've never played it.
colloquial.zh: 丽塔：想玩一局马耳他式贝齐克吗？托尼：想，不过先给我讲讲规则吧，我还没玩过。

messages.speaker: Rita (朋友)
messages.zh: 想玩一局马耳他式贝齐克吗？
messages.en: Do you want to play a game of Maltese bezique?

messages.speaker: Toni (初学牌友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, imma l-ewwel spjegali r-regoli, għax qatt ma lgħabtha.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, imma l-ewwel spjegali r-regoli, għax qatt ma lgħabtha.
messages.zh: 想，不过先给我讲讲规则吧，我还没玩过。
messages.en: Yes, but explain the rules first, because I've never played it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 bazzika 写在一副纸牌旁，再加上“马耳他版本”的标签，记住它是一种具体牌戏的名称，并用“玩一局、学规则”两个场景复习。

gloss_zh: 学士；取得学士学位的人

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who has earned a bachelor's degree.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 已经取得学士学位的人；这里指学历身份，不表示婚姻状况。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li kisbet grad ta' baċellerat.

sense_translations.en_definition: bachelor (person who has achieved bachelor's degree)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 学士；已取得学士学位的人。

formal.mt: Pawlu huwa baċellier fl-arti u jixtieq ikompli l-istudji tiegħu.
formal.en: Pawlu holds a Bachelor of Arts degree and wishes to continue his studies.
formal.zh: 保罗拥有文学学士学位，并希望继续深造。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Prosit tal-gradwazzjoni! Issa int baċellier! Pawlu: Grazzi! Is-sena d-dieħla nixtieq nibda l-masters.
colloquial.en: Anna: Congratulations on graduating! Now you have your bachelor's degree! Pawlu: Thanks! Next year I'd like to start a master's.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：恭喜毕业！你现在是学士了！保罗：谢谢！我想明年开始读硕士。

messages.speaker: Anna (朋友)
messages.zh: 恭喜毕业！你现在是学士了！
messages.en: Congratulations on graduating! Now you have your bachelor's degree!

messages.speaker: Pawlu (毕业生)
messages.mt_spoken: Grazzi! Is-sena d-dieħla nixtieq nibda l-masters.
messages.mt_standard: Grazzi! Is-sena d-dieħla nixtieq nibda l-masters.
messages.zh: 谢谢！我想明年开始读硕士。
messages.en: Thanks! Next year I'd like to start a master's.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 baċellier 与毕业帽、学位证和“学士”一起记忆；本词条中的英文 bachelor 指取得学位的人。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To cause a person or animal to become fatter or plumper.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使人或动物变胖、变丰满；谈到饲养动物时，常指把动物养肥。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ġiegħel persuna jew annimal jiżdied fil-piż u jsir aktar smin.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使变肥；把人或动物养胖、养肥。
使变得丰满、圆润。

formal.mt: Il-bidwi baċċan il-ħanżir qabel ma biegħu.
formal.en: The farmer fattened the pig before selling it.
formal.zh: 农夫先把猪养肥，然后才卖掉。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Dan l-għoġol sar smin! Ġużeppi: Iva, missieri baċċan l-għoġol matul dawn l-aħħar xhur.
colloquial.en: Marija: This calf has got fat! Ġużeppi: Yes, my father fattened the calf over the past few months.
colloquial.zh: 玛丽娅：这头小牛长胖了！朱塞佩：是啊，我爸爸这几个月把它养肥了。

messages.speaker: Marija (邻居)
messages.zh: 这头小牛长胖了！
messages.en: This calf has got fat!

messages.speaker: Ġużeppi (农户之子)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, missieri baċċan l-għoġol matul dawn l-aħħar xhur.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, missieri baċċan l-għoġol matul dawn l-aħħar xhur.
messages.zh: 是啊，我爸爸这几个月把它养肥了。
messages.en: Yes, my father fattened the calf over the past few months.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“农夫把小牛养得圆滚滚”的画面记 baċċan，重点记住它表达“使对象变胖”的动作。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A plan for income and spending, or the amount of money available for a particular purpose.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 对收入和支出的安排，或为某一用途准备、限定的可用金额。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Pjan tad-dħul u l-infiq, jew l-ammont ta' flus disponibbli għal għan partikolari.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 预算；对收支的计划或某项用途的可用金额。

formal.mt: Il-kumitat approva baġit annwali ta' għaxart elef ewro għall-proġett.
formal.en: The committee approved an annual budget of ten thousand euros for the project.
formal.zh: 委员会批准了该项目一万欧元的年度预算。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Kemm nistgħu nonfqu fuq ir-rigal? Mark: Il-baġit tagħna hu tletin ewro. Sara: Mela nfittxu xi ħaġa taħt dak il-prezz.
colloquial.en: Sara: How much can we spend on the gift? Mark: Our budget is thirty euros. Sara: Then let's look for something below that price.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：我们买礼物能花多少钱？马克：我们的预算是三十欧元。萨拉：那就找一件低于这个价格的吧。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 我们买礼物能花多少钱？
messages.en: How much can we spend on the gift?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 我们的预算是三十欧元。
messages.en: Our budget is thirty euros.

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Mela nfittxu xi ħaġa taħt dak il-prezz.
messages.mt_standard: Mela nfittxu xi ħaġa taħt dak il-prezz.
messages.zh: 那就找一件低于这个价格的吧。
messages.en: Then let's look for something below that price.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 baġit 写在购物清单顶端，旁边标上“最多三十欧元”，用花钱前设定额度的场景记住“预算”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The proper name of the Bahamas, an archipelago and country in the Caribbean.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 巴哈马的专名，指加勒比地区的一个群岛及国家。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-isem proprju ta' arċipelagu u pajjiż fir-reġjun tal-Karibew.

sense_translations.en_definition: Bahamas (an archipelago and country in the Caribbean)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 巴哈马，加勒比地区的一个群岛及国家

formal.mt: L-istudenti ħejjew preżentazzjoni dwar il-Baħamas bħala arċipelagu u pajjiż fir-reġjun tal-Karibew.
formal.en: The students prepared a presentation about the Bahamas as an archipelago and country in the Caribbean.
formal.zh: 学生们准备了一份介绍巴哈马的报告，说明它是加勒比地区的一个群岛及国家。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Fejn tixtieq tqatta' l-vaganza? Pawlu: Fil-Baħamas; nixtieq inżur xi gżejjer hemmhekk.
colloquial.en: Maja: Where would you like to spend your holiday? Pawlu: In the Bahamas; I'd like to visit some islands there.
colloquial.zh: Maja：你想去哪里度假？Pawlu：巴哈马，我想去那里的一些岛屿看看。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你想去哪里度假？
messages.en: Where would you like to spend your holiday?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Fil-Baħamas; nixtieq inżur xi gżejjer hemmhekk.
messages.mt_standard: Fil-Baħamas; nixtieq inżur xi gżejjer hemmhekk.
messages.zh: 巴哈马，我想去那里的一些岛屿看看。
messages.en: In the Bahamas; I'd like to visit some islands there.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 Baħamas、Bahamas 和巴哈马放在同一张群岛卡片上，并连着记 fil-Baħamas，表示在巴哈马。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The geographical proper name for the Adriatic Sea, used on maps and in descriptions of places or journeys.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 亚得里亚海的地理专名，用于地图以及地点或行程的描述。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-isem proprju tal-baħar imsejjaħ Adriatic Sea bl-Ingliż, użat fil-mapep u fid-deskrizzjonijiet ta' postijiet jew vjaġġi.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 亚得里亚海

collocations.en: the coast of the Adriatic Sea
a journey on the Adriatic Sea

formal.mt: Fir-rapport tal-vjaġġ, l-awtriċi tiddeskrivi l-kosta tal-Baħar Adrijatiku u tinkludi mappa tar-rotta.
formal.en: In the travel report, the author describes the coast of the Adriatic Sea and includes a map of the route.
formal.zh: 在旅行报告中，作者描述了亚得里亚海沿岸，并附上了路线图。

colloquial.mt: Lara: X'jismu dan il-baħar fuq il-mappa? Mark: Il-Baħar Adrijatiku. Ejja nfittxu ritratt tiegħu wkoll.
colloquial.en: Lara: What's this sea on the map called? Mark: The Adriatic Sea. Let's find a photo of it too.
colloquial.zh: Lara：地图上这片海叫什么？Mark：亚得里亚海。我们也找张它的照片吧。

messages.speaker: Lara (学生)
messages.zh: 地图上这片海叫什么？
messages.en: What's this sea on the map called?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-Baħar Adrijatiku. Ejja nfittxu ritratt tiegħu wkoll.
messages.mt_standard: Il-Baħar Adrijatiku. Ejja nfittxu ritratt tiegħu wkoll.
messages.zh: 亚得里亚海。我们也找张它的照片吧。
messages.en: The Adriatic Sea. Let's find a photo of it too.

cognitive_memory_aid: 分两块记：Baħar 对应海，Adrijatiku 对应亚得里亚；再用完整短语指着地图读，巩固专名。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The geographical proper name for the Ionian Sea, used on maps and in descriptions of places or journeys.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 爱奥尼亚海的地理专名，用于地图以及地点或行程的描述。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-isem proprju tal-baħar imsejjaħ Ionian Sea bl-Ingliż, użat fil-mapep u fid-deskrizzjonijiet ta' postijiet jew vjaġġi.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 爱奥尼亚海

collocations.en: the coast of the Ionian Sea

formal.mt: Il-programm tal-vjaġġ jinkludi tbaħħir fil-Baħar Jonju u waqfiet tul il-kosta.
formal.en: The travel itinerary includes sailing in the Ionian Sea and stops along the coast.
formal.zh: 旅行行程包括在爱奥尼亚海航行，以及沿岸停靠。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Fejn se tmorru bid-dgħajsa? Toni: Se nbaħħru fil-Baħar Jonju; għad irridu nagħżlu r-rotta.
colloquial.en: Nina: Where are you going by boat? Toni: We're going to sail in the Ionian Sea; we still need to choose the route.
colloquial.zh: Nina：你们准备坐船去哪里？Toni：我们准备在爱奥尼亚海航行，路线还得选一选。

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.zh: 你们准备坐船去哪里？
messages.en: Where are you going by boat?

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Se nbaħħru fil-Baħar Jonju; għad irridu nagħżlu r-rotta.
messages.mt_standard: Se nbaħħru fil-Baħar Jonju; għad irridu nagħżlu r-rotta.
messages.zh: 我们准备在爱奥尼亚海航行，路线还得选一选。
messages.en: We're going to sail in the Ionian Sea; we still need to choose the route.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 Jonju 与英语 Ionian、中文爱奥尼亚并排记忆；看到 Baħar Jonju，就想起地图上完整的一片海。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The geographical proper name for the Caribbean Sea, used on maps and in descriptions of places or journeys.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 加勒比海的地理专名，用于地图以及地点或行程的描述。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-isem proprju tal-baħar imsejjaħ Caribbean Sea bl-Ingliż, użat fil-mapep u fid-deskrizzjonijiet ta' postijiet jew vjaġġi.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 加勒比海

collocations.en: a cruise in the Caribbean Sea
a map of the Caribbean Sea

formal.mt: Il-fuljett jippreżenta kruċiera fil-Baħar Karibew u jagħti d-dettalji tar-rotta proposta.
formal.en: The brochure presents a cruise in the Caribbean Sea and gives details of the proposed route.
formal.zh: 宣传册介绍了一次加勒比海邮轮之旅，并列出了拟定路线的详细信息。

colloquial.mt: Sara: X'qed tħares lejha? David: Mappa tal-Baħar Karibew. Qed infittex ir-rotta tal-kruċiera tagħna.
colloquial.en: Sara: What are you looking at? David: A map of the Caribbean Sea. I'm looking for our cruise route.
colloquial.zh: Sara：你在看什么？David：加勒比海地图。我在找我们这次邮轮旅行的路线。

messages.speaker: Sara (旅伴)
messages.zh: 你在看什么？
messages.en: What are you looking at?

messages.speaker: David (旅伴)
messages.mt_spoken: Mappa tal-Baħar Karibew. Qed infittex ir-rotta tal-kruċiera tagħna.
messages.mt_standard: Mappa tal-Baħar Karibew. Qed infittex ir-rotta tal-kruċiera tagħna.
messages.zh: 加勒比海地图。我在找我们这次邮轮旅行的路线。
messages.en: A map of the Caribbean Sea. I'm looking for our cruise route.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 Karibew、Caribbean 和加勒比做成三语配对卡，再加上表示海的 Baħar，整体记住加勒比海这个专名。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The geographical proper name for the Red Sea, used on maps and in descriptions of places or journeys.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 红海的地理专名，用于地图以及地点或行程的描述。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-isem proprju tal-baħar imsejjaħ Red Sea bl-Ingliż, użat fil-mapep u fid-deskrizzjonijiet ta' postijiet jew vjaġġi.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 红海

collocations.en: the coast of the Red Sea

formal.mt: Il-programm tal-vaganza jinkludi żjara mal-kosta tal-Baħar l-Aħmar u attività ta' għadis.
formal.en: The holiday programme includes a visit to the coast of the Red Sea and a diving activity.
formal.zh: 度假安排包括游览红海沿岸和参加一次潜水活动。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Fejn tixtieq tmur tgħaddas? Mark: Fil-Baħar l-Aħmar. Qed infittex kors għall-bidu.
colloquial.en: Maja: Where would you like to go diving? Mark: In the Red Sea. I'm looking for a beginner's course.
colloquial.zh: Maja：你想去哪里潜水？Mark：红海。我正在找入门课程。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你想去哪里潜水？
messages.en: Where would you like to go diving?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Fil-Baħar l-Aħmar. Qed infittex kors għall-bidu.
messages.mt_standard: Fil-Baħar l-Aħmar. Qed infittex kors għall-bidu.
messages.zh: 红海。我正在找入门课程。
messages.en: In the Red Sea. I'm looking for a beginner's course.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 Baħar l-Aħmar 整体对应红海，在记忆卡上给这个名称加红色边框；这是记词提示，不是对海水颜色的说明。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who uses a large amount of water when washing themselves.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指洗澡或清洗身体时使用大量水的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li tuża ħafna ilma meta tinħasel.

sense_translations.en_definition: a person who washes using a lot of water
sense_translations.zh_definition: 洗浴或清洗身体时用水很多的人

collocations.en: he is someone who uses a lot of water when washing
collocations.zh: 他是个洗浴时用水很多的人

collocations.en: a person who uses plenty of water to wash themselves
collocations.zh: 一个清洗身体时用水很多的人

formal.mt: Fir-rakkont, Pawlu huwa deskritt bħala baħbieħ għax juża ħafna ilma kull darba li jinħasel.
formal.en: In the story, Pawlu is described as someone who uses a lot of water whenever he washes himself.
formal.zh: 故事把 Pawlu 描写成一个洗浴时用水很多的人，因为他每次清洗身体都会用大量的水。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex tuża daqshekk ilma meta tinħasel? Pawlu: Jien baħbieħ; inħobb ninħasel b'ħafna ilma.
colloquial.en: Lara: Why do you use so much water when you wash? Pawlu: I'm someone who uses lots of water to wash; I like washing with plenty of water.
colloquial.zh: Lara：你洗澡时为什么用这么多水？Pawlu：我就是个洗澡用水很多的人，我喜欢用足量的水洗。

messages.speaker: Lara (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex tuża daqshekk ilma meta tinħasel?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex tuża daqshekk ilma meta tinħasel?
messages.zh: 你洗澡时为什么用这么多水？
messages.en: Why do you use so much water when you wash?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Jien baħbieħ; inħobb ninħasel b'ħafna ilma.
messages.mt_standard: Jien baħbieħ; inħobb ninħasel b'ħafna ilma.
messages.zh: 我就是个洗澡用水很多的人，我喜欢用足量的水洗。
messages.en: I'm someone who uses lots of water to wash; I like washing with plenty of water.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一个洗澡时反复放水冲洗的人，把 baħbieħ 当作这个人的标签；重点同时记住人和用水很多。

gloss_zh: 洗涤或冲洗时用水很多的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Describing someone who uses a large amount of water when washing or rinsing.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容一个人在洗涤或冲洗时使用大量的水。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li juża ħafna ilma meta jaħsel jew ilaħlaħ.

sense_translations.en_definition: sb who washes or rinses in a lot of water
sense_translations.zh_definition: 形容洗涤或冲洗时用水很多的人

collocations.en: a man who uses a lot of water when washing or rinsing
collocations.zh: 一个洗涤或冲洗时用水很多的男人

collocations.en: to use a lot of water when washing

formal.mt: L-awtur jiddeskrivi lil Toni bħala raġel baħbieħi, għax juża ħafna ilma meta jaħsel jew ilaħlaħ.
formal.en: The author describes Toni as a man who uses a lot of water when washing or rinsing.
formal.zh: 作者把 Toni 描写成一个洗涤或冲洗时用水很多的男人。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Għaliex tuża daqshekk ilma biex tlaħlaħ it-tazza? Toni: Jien baħbieħi meta naħsel; dejjem nuża ħafna ilma.
colloquial.en: Nina: Why do you use so much water to rinse the cup? Toni: I use lots of water when I wash things; I always use plenty of water.
colloquial.zh: Nina：你冲这个杯子为什么用这么多水？Toni：我洗东西就是用水多，总要用足量的水。

messages.speaker: Nina (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex tuża daqshekk ilma biex tlaħlaħ it-tazza?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex tuża daqshekk ilma biex tlaħlaħ it-tazza?
messages.zh: 你冲这个杯子为什么用这么多水？
messages.en: Why do you use so much water to rinse the cup?

messages.speaker: Toni (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Jien baħbieħi meta naħsel; dejjem nuża ħafna ilma.
messages.mt_standard: Jien baħbieħi meta naħsel; dejjem nuża ħafna ilma.
messages.zh: 我洗东西就是用水多，总要用足量的水。
messages.en: I use lots of water when I wash things; I always use plenty of water.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用成对卡片区分：baħbieħ 给人贴名词标签，baħbieħi 用形容词描述他洗涤时用水很多；这只是本组词的记忆对照。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A seashell, including a cowrie shell.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 海洋贝类的贝壳，也可指宝螺的贝壳。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Qoxra tal-baħar, inkluża dik magħrufa bħala cowrie.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 海贝壳；海洋贝类的外壳。
宝螺贝壳。

formal.mt: L-istudent pinġa baħbuħa u ddeskriva l-forma tagħha.
formal.en: The student drew a seashell and described its shape.
formal.zh: 学生画了一枚海贝壳，并描述了它的形状。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Ara din il-baħbuħa fuq ir-ramel! Pawlu: Kemm hi sabiħa! Ejja nieħdu ritratt tagħha.
colloquial.en: Maja: Look at this seashell on the sand! Pawlu: It's so beautiful! Let's take a photo of it.
colloquial.zh: Maja：看沙地上的这枚海贝壳！Pawlu：真漂亮！我们给它拍张照吧。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 看沙地上的这枚海贝壳！
messages.en: Look at this seashell on the sand!

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Kemm hi sabiħa! Ejja nieħdu ritratt tagħha.
messages.mt_standard: Kemm hi sabiħa! Ejja nieħdu ritratt tagħha.
messages.zh: 真漂亮！我们给它拍张照吧。
messages.en: It's so beautiful! Let's take a photo of it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 baħbuħa 写在海贝壳图片下，再给宝螺贝壳画一个小圈，联记一般海贝壳和宝螺贝壳两个义项。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Having a shape like a seashell.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形状像海贝壳的；呈贝壳形的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu forma bħal dik ta' qoxra tal-baħar.

sense_translations.en_definition: having the shape of a sea shell
sense_translations.zh_definition: 具有海贝壳形状的；贝壳形的。

formal.mt: L-artist għażel disinn baħbuħi għall-ornament il-ġdid.
formal.en: The artist chose a seashell-shaped design for the new ornament.
formal.zh: 艺术家为新装饰物选择了贝壳形设计。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Jogħġbok dan l-ornament baħbuħi? Mark: Iva, il-forma tiegħu tfakkarni fil-baħar.
colloquial.en: Lara: Do you like this seashell-shaped ornament? Mark: Yes, its shape reminds me of the sea.
colloquial.zh: Lara：你喜欢这个贝壳形装饰物吗？Mark：喜欢，它的形状让我想起大海。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 你喜欢这个贝壳形装饰物吗？
messages.en: Do you like this seashell-shaped ornament?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 喜欢，它的形状让我想起大海。
messages.en: Yes, its shape reminds me of the sea.

cognitive_memory_aid: 画一个贝壳形装饰物，在旁边标注 baħbuħi；看到这个词就问自己：它的形状像不像贝壳？

gloss_zh: 与 baħnanata 同义的名词

teaching_sense.en_definition: A noun with the same meaning as baħnanata.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一个与马耳他语名词 baħnanata 意义相同的名词，可将两词作为同义词配对学习。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Nom li għandu l-istess tifsira bħal baħnanata.

sense_translations.zh_definition: baħnanata 的同义词。

formal.mt: F'dan l-eżerċizzju, l-istudenti jqabblu l-kelma baħnunija mas-sinonimu tagħha baħnanata.
formal.en: In this exercise, students compare the word baħnunija with its synonym baħnanata.
formal.zh: 在这项练习中，学生将 baħnunija 与其同义词 baħnanata 进行比较。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Ma' liema kelma nista' nqabbad baħnunija fil-lista tas-sinonimi? Lara: Ma' baħnanata; għandhom l-istess tifsira.
colloquial.en: Nina: Which word can I pair baħnunija with in the synonym list? Lara: With baħnanata; they have the same meaning.
colloquial.zh: Nina：在同义词表中，我可以把 baħnunija 和哪个词配对？Lara：和 baħnanata 配对，它们意思相同。

messages.speaker: Nina (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Ma' liema kelma nista' nqabbad baħnunija fil-lista tas-sinonimi?
messages.mt_standard: Ma' liema kelma nista' nqabbad baħnunija fil-lista tas-sinonimi?
messages.zh: 在同义词表中，我可以把 baħnunija 和哪个词配对？
messages.en: Which word can I pair baħnunija with in the synonym list?

messages.speaker: Lara (同学)
messages.zh: 和 baħnanata 配对，它们意思相同。
messages.en: With baħnanata; they have the same meaning.

cognitive_memory_aid: 制作一张双面同义词卡，一面写 baħnunija，另一面写 baħnanata；翻卡时说出另一词，记牢已提供的同义关系。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Bahrain, a name referring to an archipelago, an island, and a country in the Persian Gulf in West Asia.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 巴林，指位于西亚波斯湾的群岛、岛屿及国家。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Isem ta' arċipelagu, gżira u pajjiż fil-Golf Persjan, fl-Asja tal-Punent.

sense_translations.en_definition: Bahrain (an archipelago, island, and country in West Asia in the Persian Gulf)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 巴林，位于西亚波斯湾的群岛、岛屿及国家。

formal.mt: Il-Baħrejn jinsab fil-Golf Persjan, fl-Asja tal-Punent.
formal.en: Bahrain is located in the Persian Gulf, in West Asia.
formal.zh: 巴林位于西亚的波斯湾。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Fejn sejjer għall-vaganza? Mark: Se mmur il-Baħrejn, u qed inħares lejn il-mappa qabel il-vjaġġ.
colloquial.en: Sara: Where are you going on holiday? Mark: I'm going to Bahrain, and I'm looking at the map before the trip.
colloquial.zh: Sara：你要去哪里度假？Mark：我要去巴林，正在出发前看看地图。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 你要去哪里度假？
messages.en: Where are you going on holiday?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Se mmur il-Baħrejn, u qed inħares lejn il-mappa qabel il-vjaġġ.
messages.mt_standard: Se mmur il-Baħrejn, u qed inħares lejn il-mappa qabel il-vjaġġ.
messages.zh: 我要去巴林，正在出发前看看地图。
messages.en: I'm going to Bahrain, and I'm looking at the map before the trip.

cognitive_memory_aid: 在波斯湾地图上标注 Baħrejn 和巴林，再画群岛、单个岛屿及国家边界三个小图标，联记名称的三个指称。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Describing someone who habitually slanders other people.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容一个人惯于诽谤他人、说损害他人名誉的话。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu d-drawwa li jxerred malafama dwar ħaddieħor.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 形容惯于诽谤他人的人。

collocations.en: a person given to slandering others
collocations.zh: 一个惯于诽谤他人的人

collocations.en: comments from a man who habitually slanders others
collocations.zh: 一个惯于诽谤他人的男子所说的话

formal.mt: Fir-rakkont, il-karattru baħħati jxerred akkużi foloz dwar il-ġirien tiegħu.
formal.en: In the story, the character who habitually slanders others spreads false accusations about his neighbours.
formal.zh: 故事中，那个惯于诽谤他人的角色散布针对邻居的虚假指控。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Għaliex ma tafdax lil dak ir-raġel? Toni: Għax hu baħħati; spiss jgħid affarijiet foloz dwar ħaddieħor.
colloquial.en: Rita: Why don't you trust that man? Toni: Because he habitually slanders people; he often says false things about others.
colloquial.zh: Rita：你为什么不信任那个男人？Toni：因为他惯于诽谤别人，经常说些关于别人的假话。

messages.speaker: Rita (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex ma tafdax lil dak ir-raġel?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex ma tafdax lil dak ir-raġel?
messages.zh: 你为什么不信任那个男人？
messages.en: Why don't you trust that man?

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax hu baħħati; spiss jgħid affarijiet foloz dwar ħaddieħor.
messages.mt_standard: Għax hu baħħati; spiss jgħid affarijiet foloz dwar ħaddieħor.
messages.zh: 因为他惯于诽谤别人，经常说些关于别人的假话。
messages.en: Because he habitually slanders people; he often says false things about others.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象故事里一个总散布虚假指控的人，在人物卡上写 baħħati，把这个形容词与惯于诽谤他人的行为相连。

gloss_zh: 频繁放屁；腹泻；频繁带孩子就医；也可指频繁放屁的人

teaching_sense.en_definition: To pass wind frequently; in other senses, to have diarrhoea or to have to take a child to a doctor very often.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 频繁放屁；其他动词义包括腹泻，以及不得不经常带孩子去看医生。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Joħroġ il-gass mill-imsaren ta' spiss; f'tifsiriet oħra, ikollu dijarea jew ikollu jieħu tifel għand it-tabib ta' spiss.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 频繁放屁；经常排出肠道气体。
腹泻；拉肚子。

sense_translations.en_definition: to have to take a child to a doctor very often
sense_translations.zh_definition: 不得不频繁带孩子去看医生。
经常放屁的人。

collocations.en: passed wind frequently during the night

formal.mt: Pawlu qal li wara l-ikla bażbaż għal diversi sigħat.
formal.en: Paul said that after the meal he passed wind frequently for several hours.
formal.zh: 保罗说，饭后有好几个小时他都在频繁放屁。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Ilbieraħ bażbażt ħafna wara l-ikla. Sara: Kellek uġigħ ukoll? Mark: Le, gass biss.
colloquial.en: Mark: Yesterday I passed wind a lot after the meal. Sara: Did you have any pain too? Mark: No, just gas.
colloquial.zh: 马克：昨天吃完饭后我老是放屁。萨拉：你还疼吗？马克：不疼，就是有气。

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 昨天吃完饭后我老是放屁。
messages.en: Yesterday I passed wind a lot after the meal.

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 你还疼吗？
messages.en: Did you have any pain too?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 不疼，就是有气。
messages.en: No, just gas.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用四张情景卡分别记忆：频繁放屁、腹泻、频繁带孩子就医，以及名词所指的人；不要把四义混成一种。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Describing someone who passes wind frequently.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容一个人经常放屁的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li joħroġ il-gass mill-imsaren ta' spiss.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 经常放屁的，用于形容人。

collocations.en: a man who frequently passes wind
a person who frequently passes wind

formal.mt: Fil-kitba umoristika, il-karattru huwa deskritt bħala raġel bażbażi.
formal.en: In the humorous piece, the character is described as a man who frequently passes wind.
formal.zh: 这篇幽默作品把该角色描写成一个经常放屁的男人。

colloquial.mt: Mark: F'din l-istorja, Toni hu bażbażi. Maja: Jiġifieri joħroġ ħafna gass? Mark: Iva, dik hi ċ-ċajta.
colloquial.en: Mark: In this story, Toni frequently passes wind. Maja: You mean he passes a lot of gas? Mark: Yes, that's the joke.
colloquial.zh: 马克：这个故事里的托尼经常放屁。玛雅：你是说他老是排气？马克：对，笑点就在这里。

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.zh: 这个故事里的托尼经常放屁。
messages.en: In this story, Toni frequently passes wind.

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.zh: 你是说他老是排气？
messages.en: You mean he passes a lot of gas?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.zh: 对，笑点就在这里。
messages.en: Yes, that's the joke.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 bażbażi 放进人物描述卡，记作“这个人经常放屁的”；此条按形容词学习。

gloss_zh: 身体不适的；不健康的；容易生病的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Ailing, in poor health, or prone to becoming ill.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 身体不舒服、健康状况不佳，或容易生病的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li ma jkunx f'saħħtu, ikun marid jew jimrad ta' spiss.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 身体抱恙的；正在受病痛困扰的。
身体不健康的；健康状况不佳的。
容易生病的；体质较弱的。

formal.mt: It-tifel kien bażbuż u kien jitlef diversi jiem tal-iskola minħabba l-mard.
formal.en: The boy was prone to illness and would miss several days of school because of sickness.
formal.zh: 这个男孩容易生病，常因病缺课好几天。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Illum Toni jidher bażbuż. Mark: Iva, qal li ma jħossux tajjeb u se jibqa' d-dar.
colloquial.en: Maja: Toni looks unwell today. Mark: Yes, he said he doesn't feel well and will stay home.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：托尼今天看起来不太舒服。马克：是的，他说身体不舒服，要待在家里。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 托尼今天看起来不太舒服。
messages.en: Toni looks unwell today.

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, qal li ma jħossux tajjeb u se jibqa' d-dar.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, qal li ma jħossux tajjeb u se jibqa' d-dar.
messages.zh: 是的，他说身体不舒服，要待在家里。
messages.en: Yes, he said he doesn't feel well and will stay home.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象健康记录上的三个标签：正在不适、身体欠佳、容易生病；bażbuż 可对应这三个意思。

gloss_zh: 偏执；排斥异己的顽固偏见

teaching_sense.en_definition: Stubborn prejudice and intolerance towards people with different beliefs or identities.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 对信仰或身份不同的人抱有顽固偏见，并表现出不宽容的态度。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Preġudizzju riġidu u nuqqas ta' tolleranza lejn nies bi twemmin jew identità differenti.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 偏执；对持不同信仰或具有不同身份者的顽固偏见与不宽容。

formal.mt: L-awtur jikkundanna l-bażokkerija u jitlob rispett lejn persuni ta' kull twemmin.
formal.en: The author condemns bigotry and calls for respect towards people of every belief.
formal.zh: 作者谴责偏执，呼吁尊重持各种信仰的人。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Ma jridux jistiednu lil Lina għax għandha twemmin differenti. Mark: Dik bażokkerija. Għandhom jirrispettawha.
colloquial.en: Sara: They don't want to invite Lina because she has different beliefs. Mark: That's bigotry. They should respect her.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：他们因为莉娜信仰不同，就不想邀请她。马克：那是偏执。他们应该尊重她。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ma jridux jistiednu lil Lina għax għandha twemmin differenti.
messages.mt_standard: Ma jridux jistiednu lil Lina għax għandha twemmin differenti.
messages.zh: 他们因为莉娜信仰不同，就不想邀请她。
messages.en: They don't want to invite Lina because she has different beliefs.

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 那是偏执。他们应该尊重她。
messages.en: That's bigotry. They should respect her.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一扇因别人信仰不同就关上的门，用这幅画面记住 bażokkerija 的顽固偏见与不宽容。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A small amount of pepper, such as the amount held between the fingertips.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 少量胡椒粉，通常指指尖可以捏起的一撮。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ammont żgħir ta' bżar, daqs kemm tista' taqbad bejn ponot subgħajk.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 一撮胡椒粉；指尖捏取的一点胡椒粉。

collocations.en: a pinch of pepper in the soup

formal.mt: Qabel isservi s-soppa, żid bażra u ħawwad sew.
formal.en: Before serving the soup, add a pinch of pepper and stir well.
formal.zh: 上汤前，加一撮胡椒粉并充分搅拌。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Kemm inżid bżar? Mark: Bażra biss; imbagħad nduqu s-soppa.
colloquial.en: Maja: How much pepper should I add? Mark: Just a pinch; then we'll taste the soup.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：我要加多少胡椒粉？马克：一撮就够，然后我们尝尝汤。

messages.speaker: Maja (一起做饭的朋友)
messages.zh: 我要加多少胡椒粉？
messages.en: How much pepper should I add?

messages.speaker: Mark (一起做饭的朋友)
messages.zh: 一撮就够，然后我们尝尝汤。
messages.en: Just a pinch; then we'll taste the soup.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用拇指和食指做出捏胡椒粉的动作，把 bażra 记成指尖之间的一小撮胡椒。

gloss_zh: 滑稽逗弄；小丑式的玩笑

teaching_sense.en_definition: A clownish joke or playful act intended to make people laugh.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 以滑稽、逗趣的言语或举动引人发笑的玩笑。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ċajta jew għemil buffu biex idaħħaq lin-nies.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 小丑式的滑稽玩笑；逗人发笑的滑稽举动。

formal.mt: L-attur għamel bażuffjata waqt ix-xena u l-udjenza daħket.
formal.en: The actor made a clownish joke during the scene, and the audience laughed.
formal.zh: 演员在那场戏中做了个滑稽逗趣的举动，观众都笑了。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għaliex poġġejt il-kappell fuq il-kitla? Mark: Kienet bażuffjata biex indaħħkek! Sara: U rnexxielek!
colloquial.en: Sara: Why did you put the hat on the kettle? Mark: It was a silly joke to make you laugh! Sara: And you succeeded!
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：你为什么把帽子放在水壶上？马克：就是搞个滑稽玩笑逗你笑！萨拉：还真让你逗笑了！

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 你为什么把帽子放在水壶上？
messages.en: Why did you put the hat on the kettle?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 就是搞个滑稽玩笑逗你笑！
messages.en: It was a silly joke to make you laugh!

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 还真让你逗笑了！
messages.en: And you succeeded!

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象给水壶戴帽子逗朋友笑，把 bażuffjata 与这种小丑式的滑稽玩笑联系起来。

gloss_zh: 做事常笨手笨脚的；工作常做不好的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Inclined to carry out one's work clumsily or badly.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 做自己的工作时往往笨手笨脚，或经常把工作做不好的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu t-tendenza jagħmel xogħlu b'mod goff jew ħażin.

sense_translations.en_definition: having the tendency to perform one's work clumsily or badly
sense_translations.zh_definition: 做事常显得笨拙、不得要领，或倾向于把自己的工作做不好的。

collocations.en: a worker who tends to do the job clumsily or badly
collocations.zh: 做工作常笨手笨脚的工人

collocations.en: clumsy or inept in one's work
collocations.zh: 工作时笨拙、不得要领的

formal.mt: Fir-rakkont, il-ħaddiem bażwari kien spiss iħalli l-ixkafef mgħawġin wara li jwaħħalhom.
formal.en: In the story, the clumsy worker would often leave the shelves crooked after putting them up.
formal.zh: 故事中，那个做事笨拙的工人装好架子后，经常让它们歪歪斜斜。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Toni reġa' waħħal l-ixkaffa mgħawġa. Mark: Hu ftit bażwari f'dan ix-xogħol. Ejja nuruh kif jagħmilha.
colloquial.en: Maja: Toni has put the shelf up crooked again. Mark: He's a bit clumsy at this kind of work. Let's show him how to do it.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：托尼又把架子装歪了。马克：他做这类活有点笨手笨脚。我们教教他怎么做吧。

messages.speaker: Maja (同事)
messages.zh: 托尼又把架子装歪了。
messages.en: Toni has put the shelf up crooked again.

messages.speaker: Mark (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Hu ftit bażwari f'dan ix-xogħol. Ejja nuruh kif jagħmilha.
messages.mt_standard: Hu ftit bażwari f'dan ix-xogħol. Ejja nuruh kif jagħmilha.
messages.zh: 他做这类活有点笨手笨脚。我们教教他怎么做吧。
messages.en: He's a bit clumsy at this kind of work. Let's show him how to do it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一个人装架子总装歪，用反复出现的笨拙工作表现记住 bażwari，突出做事的倾向。

gloss_zh: 疝气的；患疝气的；无精打采的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Related to hernia, affected by hernia, or lacking energy.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容与疝气有关、患有疝气，或缺乏精神和活力。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu x'jaqsam mal-ftuq, li jbati bil-ftuq, jew li ma tantx għandu enerġija.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 疝的；与疝气有关的。
患疝气的。
缺乏活力的；无精打采的。

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi lill-pazjent bħala bażwi u jagħti dettalji dwar il-kundizzjoni tiegħu.
formal.en: The report describes the patient as suffering from hernia and gives details about his condition.
formal.zh: 报告将该病人描述为患有疝气，并详细说明了他的病情。

colloquial.mt: Marta: Illum tidher bażwi, Pawlu. Għajjien? Pawlu: Iva, ma rqadtx biżżejjed u m'għandix enerġija.
colloquial.en: Marta: You seem low on energy today, Pawlu. Are you tired? Pawlu: Yes, I didn't sleep enough and I have no energy.
colloquial.zh: 玛尔塔：保罗，你今天看起来无精打采的。累了吗？保罗：是啊，我没睡够，一点精神也没有。

messages.speaker: Marta (朋友)
messages.zh: 保罗，你今天看起来无精打采的。累了吗？
messages.en: You seem low on energy today, Pawlu. Are you tired?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, ma rqadtx biżżejjed u m'għandix enerġija.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, ma rqadtx biżżejjed u m'għandix enerġija.
messages.zh: 是啊，我没睡够，一点精神也没有。
messages.en: Yes, I didn't sleep enough and I have no energy.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把这个形容词分成两张情境卡：病历旁记“疝气相关或患疝气”，困倦人物旁记“无精打采”；靠语境区分，不把疲倦直接理解成患病。

gloss_zh: 给食物加胡椒；胡椒撒瓶

teaching_sense.en_definition: To add pepper to food as a seasoning.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把胡椒加入或撒到食物上以调味。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Żied il-bżar mal-ikel biex jagħtih it-togħma.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 给食物加胡椒；往食物上撒胡椒。
盛装并供人撒出胡椒的容器；胡椒撒瓶。

collocations.en: the pepper dispenser on the table

formal.mt: Il-kok bażżar is-soppa qabel ma qassamha fl-iskutelli.
formal.en: The cook added pepper to the soup before serving it in bowls.
formal.zh: 厨师先给汤加了胡椒，再将汤分盛到碗里。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Tista' tgħaddili l-bażżar, jekk jogħġbok? Mark: Żgur, hawn hu. Trid il-melħ ukoll?
colloquial.en: Anna: Could you pass me the pepper dispenser, please? Mark: Of course, here it is. Do you want the salt too?
colloquial.zh: 安娜：请把胡椒撒瓶递给我，好吗？马克：当然，给你。你也要盐吗？

messages.speaker: Anna (用餐者)
messages.zh: 请把胡椒撒瓶递给我，好吗？
messages.en: Could you pass me the pepper dispenser, please?

messages.speaker: Mark (同桌用餐者)
messages.mt_spoken: Żgur, hawn hu. Trid il-melħ ukoll?
messages.mt_standard: Żgur, hawn hu. Trid il-melħ ukoll?
messages.zh: 当然，给你。你也要盐吗？
messages.en: Of course, here it is. Do you want the salt too?

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象餐桌上的两个画面：厨师“给汤撒胡椒”是动词，伸手递来的“胡椒撒瓶”是名词；同一拼写要连同词性一起记。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be unwilling or reluctant to do something.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 对做某事缺乏意愿，表现得不情愿或不愿意。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ma tantx ried jagħmel xi ħaġa jew wera nuqqas ta' ħeġġa biex jagħmilha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 不情愿；不愿意做某事。

formal.mt: Il-kandidat bbada milli jaċċetta l-offerta minħabba l-ħinijiet twal tax-xogħol.
formal.en: The candidate was reluctant to accept the offer because of the long working hours.
formal.zh: 由于工作时间很长，应聘者不太愿意接受这份录用邀约。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex Mark ma ġiex magħna? Toni: Bbada milli joħroġ għax kien għajjien.
colloquial.en: Lara: Why didn't Mark come with us? Toni: He was reluctant to go out because he was tired.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：马克怎么没跟我们来？托尼：他累了，不太想出门。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 马克怎么没跟我们来？
messages.en: Why didn't Mark come with us?

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Bbada milli joħroġ għax kien għajjien.
messages.mt_standard: Bbada milli joħroġ għax kien għajjien.
messages.zh: 他累了，不太想出门。
messages.en: He was reluctant to go out because he was tired.
