cognitive_memory_aid: 想象朋友收到邀请却迟迟不动身，心里想着“我不太想去”；用这个不情愿的画面记 bbada，并练习接上具体动作。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To mock someone or treat someone unfairly.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 嘲笑、戏弄某人，或对某人做出不公正的事。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Għadda lil xi ħadd biż-żmien jew għamillu inġustizzja.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 嘲弄、戏弄某人；不公正地对待某人。

collocations.zh: 不公正地对待了那名工人

formal.mt: Is-sid bbajja lill-ħaddiem meta ċaħħdu mill-ħlas miftiehem.
formal.en: The employer wronged the worker by denying him the agreed payment.
formal.zh: 雇主拒绝支付约定的报酬，对那名工人做出了不公正的事。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għaliex Pawlu telaq hekk kmieni? Rita: Mark bbajja lil Pawlu quddiem kulħadd, u Pawlu rrabja.
colloquial.en: Sara: Why did Pawlu leave so early? Rita: Mark mocked Pawlu in front of everyone, and Pawlu got angry.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：保罗怎么这么早就走了？丽塔：马克当着大家的面嘲弄保罗，保罗生气了。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 保罗怎么这么早就走了？
messages.en: Why did Pawlu leave so early?

messages.speaker: Rita (在场的朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Mark bbajja lil Pawlu quddiem kulħadd, u Pawlu rrabja.
messages.mt_standard: Mark bbajja lil Pawlu quddiem kulħadd, u Pawlu rrabja.
messages.zh: 马克当着大家的面嘲弄保罗，保罗生气了。
messages.en: Mark mocked Pawlu in front of everyone, and Pawlu got angry.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 bbajja 配上两个受委屈的场景：被人当众嘲弄、被人不公正地对待；记住具体语境才能判断这里强调哪一种伤害。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To fasten a book's pages together and attach them to a cover.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把书页固定在一起并配上封面，装订成册。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Għaqqad il-paġni ta' ktieb u waħħalhom ma' qoxra.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 装订书籍；将书页装订成册。

collocations.en: bound the volume in a hard cover
collocations.zh: 为该卷书作了精装装订

formal.mt: Il-legatur bbajndja l-volum b'qoxra iebsa qabel ma ntbagħat lill-librerija.
formal.en: The bookbinder bound the volume in a hard cover before it was sent to the library.
formal.zh: 装订师将该卷书精装成册后，书才被送往图书馆。

colloquial.mt: Marta: It-teżi tiegħek lesta biex tissottomettiha? Pawlu: Iva, il-legatur bbajndja t-teżi lbieraħ, u se niġborha llum.
colloquial.en: Marta: Is your thesis ready to submit? Pawlu: Yes, the bookbinder bound it yesterday, and I'm picking it up today.
colloquial.zh: 玛尔塔：你的论文准备好提交了吗？保罗：准备好了，装订师昨天把论文装订好了，我今天去取。

messages.speaker: Marta (同学)
messages.zh: 你的论文准备好提交了吗？
messages.en: Is your thesis ready to submit?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (准备提交论文的学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, il-legatur bbajndja t-teżi lbieraħ, u se niġborha llum.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, il-legatur bbajndja t-teżi lbieraħ, u se niġborha llum.
messages.zh: 准备好了，装订师昨天把论文装订好了，我今天去取。
messages.en: Yes, the bookbinder bound it yesterday, and I'm picking it up today.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一叠散页经过固定、加封面，变成一本完整的书；把 bbajndja 和“散页变成册”的动作连在一起，再用书籍与论文两个例子复习。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To sway or oscillate, or to be unsteady.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 来回摇摆，或处于不稳定、容易晃动的状态。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jitbandal minn naħa għal oħra jew ma jkunx stabbli.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 来回摆动；晃动不稳。

collocations.en: The boat swayed with the waves.

formal.mt: Waqt l-ispezzjoni, it-tekniku nnota li s-siġġu bbalija meta poġġa fuqu.
formal.en: During the inspection, the technician noticed that the chair wobbled when he sat on it.
formal.zh: 检查时，技术员发现自己一坐上去，椅子就晃动。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex qomt minn fuq dak is-siġġu? Mark: Bbalija malli poġġejt fuqu. Se nieħu ieħor.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why did you get up from that chair? Mark: It wobbled as soon as I sat on it. I'll get another one.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你为什么从那把椅子上站起来了？马克：我刚坐上去，它就晃。我换一把。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex qomt minn fuq dak is-siġġu?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex qomt minn fuq dak is-siġġu?
messages.zh: 你为什么从那把椅子上站起来了？
messages.en: Why did you get up from that chair?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Bbalija malli poġġejt fuqu. Se nieħu ieħor.
messages.mt_standard: Bbalija malli poġġejt fuqu. Se nieħu ieħor.
messages.zh: 我刚坐上去，它就晃。我换一把。
messages.en: It wobbled as soon as I sat on it. I'll get another one.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象坐上椅子便左右晃动，把这个词和“摇摆不稳”的身体感觉一起记。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To become less intense or to calm down.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 强度减小，或由激烈、躁动的状态逐渐平静下来。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jonqos fl-intensità jew isir aktar kalm.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 减弱；缓和；平静下来。

formal.mt: Wara nofsinhar, ir-riħ bbalka u l-baħar sar aktar kalm.
formal.en: In the afternoon, the wind abated and the sea became calmer.
formal.zh: 下午，风势减弱，海面也变得更加平静。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għadu jonfoħ ħafna barra? Pawlu: Le, ir-riħ bbalka. Nistgħu noħorġu nimxu.
colloquial.en: Sara: Is it still very windy outside? Pawlu: No, the wind has died down. We can go out for a walk.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：外面的风还很大吗？保罗：不大了，风已经弱下来了。我们可以出去散步。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 外面的风还很大吗？
messages.en: Is it still very windy outside?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, ir-riħ bbalka. Nistgħu noħorġu nimxu.
messages.mt_standard: Le, ir-riħ bbalka. Nistgħu noħorġu nimxu.
messages.zh: 不大了，风已经弱下来了。我们可以出去散步。
messages.en: No, the wind has died down. We can go out for a walk.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“刚才风大，现在风小”的前后画面，记住这个词表示减弱和平息。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To predict the weather by observing signs in the surroundings.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 通过观察云、风等周围迹象来判断接下来的天气。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jbassar it-temp billi josserva sħab, riħ jew sinjali oħra madwaru.

sense_translations.en_definition: to forecast the weather by observation
sense_translations.zh_definition: 通过观察自然迹象预测天气。

collocations.en: predicted the weather by observing the clouds
collocations.zh: 通过观察云层预测了天气

collocations.en: predicted the weather by observation before going fishing
collocations.zh: 出海捕鱼前通过观察判断了天气

formal.mt: Is-sajjied bballastra billi osserva s-sħab u d-direzzjoni tar-riħ qabel ħareġ bil-baħar.
formal.en: The fisherman predicted the weather by observing the clouds and wind direction before going out to sea.
formal.zh: 渔民出海前，通过观察云层和风向预测了天气。

colloquial.mt: Lina: Kif kien jaf in-nannu li kienet ġejja x-xita? Toni: Bballastra billi ħares lejn is-sħab.
colloquial.en: Lina: How did Grandpa know rain was coming? Toni: He predicted the weather by looking at the clouds.
colloquial.zh: 莉娜：爷爷怎么知道要下雨了？托尼：他观察云层，判断出了天气变化。

messages.speaker: Lina (孙女)
messages.mt_spoken: Kif kien jaf in-nannu li kienet ġejja x-xita?
messages.mt_standard: Kif kien jaf in-nannu li kienet ġejja x-xita?
messages.zh: 爷爷怎么知道要下雨了？
messages.en: How did Grandpa know rain was coming?

messages.speaker: Toni (孙子)
messages.zh: 他观察云层，判断出了天气变化。
messages.en: He predicted the weather by looking at the clouds.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象渔民先抬头看云，再判断晴雨，把“观察后预测天气”整幅画面记下来。

gloss_zh: 暂留好牌；留强牌待后用

teaching_sense.en_definition: To hold back a better card during play so that it can be used strategically later.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 打牌时暂时不出较好的牌，留到后面更有利的时机使用。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li ma jilgħabx karta aħjar minnufih, iżda jżommha għal mument aktar xieraq fil-logħba.

sense_translations.en_definition: to restrain from playing a better card for a later strategy
sense_translations.zh_definition: 为后续战术而暂不打出较好的牌，把强牌留待以后使用。

collocations.en: held back a better card during a card game
collocations.zh: 在牌局中暂时留住了好牌

collocations.mt: bballottra biex iżomm l-ass għal wara
collocations.en: held back his better card to save the ace for later
collocations.zh: 暂不出强牌，把王牌留到了后面

formal.mt: Il-plejer bballottra: minflok lagħab l-ass minnufih, żammu għal mument aktar favorevoli.
formal.en: The player held back his better card: instead of playing the ace immediately, he saved it for a more favorable moment.
formal.zh: 这位牌手选择暂留强牌：他没有立即打出王牌，而是将它留到更有利的时机。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex Mark ma lagħabx l-ass? Pawlu: Bballottra. Ried iżommu għal wara.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why didn't Mark play the ace? Pawlu: He held back his better card. He wanted to save it for later.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：马克为什么没出王牌？保罗：他在留好牌，想把它留到后面用。

messages.speaker: Maja (牌友)
messages.zh: 马克为什么没出王牌？
messages.en: Why didn't Mark play the ace?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (牌友)
messages.zh: 他在留好牌，想把它留到后面用。
messages.en: He held back his better card. He wanted to save it for later.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象手里有张强牌却先不出，用“好牌留到关键时刻”记住这个打牌动作。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To treat a dead body in order to preserve it and slow decomposition.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 对遗体进行保存处理，以延缓腐败。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jittratta ġisem ta' persuna mejta biex jippreservah u jdewwem it-taħsir.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 给遗体作防腐保存处理。

collocations.en: embalmed the corpse before the funeral
collocations.zh: 在葬礼前对遗体作了防腐处理

formal.mt: L-ispeċjalista bbalzma l-ġisem biex jippreservah qabel il-funeral.
formal.en: The specialist embalmed the body to preserve it before the funeral.
formal.zh: 专业人员在葬礼前对遗体进行了防腐保存处理。

colloquial.mt: Sara: X'għamel l-ispeċjalista qabel il-funeral? Mark: Bbalzma l-ġisem biex jibqa' ppreservat.
colloquial.en: Sara: What did the specialist do before the funeral? Mark: He embalmed the body to keep it preserved.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：专业人员在葬礼前做了什么？马克：他对遗体作了防腐处理，以便保存。

messages.speaker: Sara (学生)
messages.zh: 专业人员在葬礼前做了什么？
messages.en: What did the specialist do before the funeral?

messages.speaker: Mark (教师)
messages.zh: 他对遗体作了防腐处理，以便保存。
messages.en: He embalmed the body to keep it preserved.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把这个词与“遗体保存、防止腐败”连在一起记，抓住防腐处理这一核心动作。

gloss_zh: 表现幼稚；把人当小孩对待

teaching_sense.en_definition: To behave childishly, or to treat another person as though they were a child.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 自己的行为显得幼稚，或把别人当作小孩子来对待。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jġib ruħu ta' tifel żgħir, jew jittratta lil xi ħadd bħallikieku kien tifel żgħir.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 行为幼稚；表现得像小孩子。

sense_translations.en_definition: to treat someone as a child
sense_translations.zh_definition: 把某人当作小孩子来对待。

collocations.en: treated his colleague like a child
collocations.zh: 把同事当作小孩子对待

formal.mt: Matul il-laqgħa, il-kap bbamboċċa lill-impjegat billi spjegalu kull pass bħallikieku kien tifel żgħir.
formal.en: During the meeting, the manager treated the employee like a child by explaining every step as though he were a small boy.
formal.zh: 会议中，主管把员工当作小孩子，仿佛对方是个小男孩一样逐步解释每一步。

colloquial.mt: Lina: Għaliex spiċċat il-logħba daqshekk malajr? Toni: Pawlu bbamboċċa meta tilef u ma riedx ikompli.
colloquial.en: Lina: Why did the game end so quickly? Toni: Pawlu acted childishly when he lost and refused to continue.
colloquial.zh: 莉娜：游戏怎么这么快就结束了？托尼：保罗输了以后耍小孩子脾气，不肯继续玩。

messages.speaker: Lina (朋友)
messages.zh: 游戏怎么这么快就结束了？
messages.en: Why did the game end so quickly?

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Pawlu bbamboċċa meta tilef u ma riedx ikompli.
messages.mt_standard: Pawlu bbamboċċa meta tilef u ma riedx ikompli.
messages.zh: 保罗输了以后耍小孩子脾气，不肯继续玩。
messages.en: Pawlu acted childishly when he lost and refused to continue.

cognitive_memory_aid: 围绕“小孩子”记两个方向：自己像小孩一样幼稚，或把别人当小孩对待。

gloss_zh: 游手好闲；靠别人养活；蹭吃蹭喝

teaching_sense.en_definition: To loaf around or live off other people's support without contributing.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 无所事事、游手好闲，或自己不付出而依靠他人供养。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jqatta' l-ħin bla xogħol jew jgħix minn fuq ħaddieħor mingħajr ma jagħti sehmu.

sense_translations.en_definition: to bum, to loaf, to sponge
sense_translations.zh_definition: 游手好闲；闲混；靠别人供养或占别人的便宜。

formal.mt: Għal diversi xhur, ir-raġel bbammja minn fuq il-ħbieb tiegħu mingħajr ma kkontribwixxa għall-ispejjeż tad-dar.
formal.en: For several months, the man sponged off his friends without contributing to household expenses.
formal.zh: 几个月来，这名男子一直靠朋友养活，没有分担家里的开销。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Toni għenkom tnaddfu d-dar? Mark: Le, bbammja l-ġurnata kollha fuq is-sufan.
colloquial.en: Maja: Did Toni help you clean the house? Mark: No, he loafed around on the sofa all day.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：托尼帮你们打扫屋子了吗？马克：没有，他整天窝在沙发上，什么也没干。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 托尼帮你们打扫屋子了吗？
messages.en: Did Toni help you clean the house?

messages.speaker: Mark (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, bbammja l-ġurnata kollha fuq is-sufan.
messages.mt_standard: Le, bbammja l-ġurnata kollha fuq is-sufan.
messages.zh: 没有，他整天窝在沙发上，什么也没干。
messages.en: No, he loafed around on the sofa all day.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一个人整天躺在沙发上，还让朋友付饭钱，串起“闲混”和“靠别人养活”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To feast or take part in a banquet.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 参加宴席，与其他宾客一起享用丰盛的饭菜。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jieħu sehem f'ikla kbira jew f'banquet u jiekol mal-mistednin l-oħra.

sense_translations.en_definition: to banquet, to take part in a banquet
sense_translations.zh_definition: 参加宴会；赴宴；在宴席上用餐。

collocations.en: took part in a banquet after the ceremony

formal.mt: Wara ċ-ċerimonja, ir-rappreżentant bbanketta mal-mistednin fis-sala prinċipali.
formal.en: After the ceremony, the representative took part in a banquet with the guests in the main hall.
formal.zh: 仪式结束后，代表在主厅与宾客一起参加了宴席。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Pawlu ġie biss għaċ-ċerimonja? Maja: Le, baqa' magħna u bbanketta sal-aħħar tas-serata.
colloquial.en: Sara: Did Pawlu come just for the ceremony? Maja: No, he stayed with us and feasted until the end of the evening.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：保罗只是来参加仪式的吗？玛雅：不是，他留下来和我们一起赴宴，一直待到晚会结束。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 保罗只是来参加仪式的吗？
messages.en: Did Pawlu come just for the ceremony?

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, baqa' magħna u bbanketta sal-aħħar tas-serata.
messages.mt_standard: Le, baqa' magħna u bbanketta sal-aħħar tas-serata.
messages.zh: 不是，他留下来和我们一起赴宴，一直待到晚会结束。
messages.en: No, he stayed with us and feasted until the end of the evening.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象仪式结束后宾客围坐长桌享用大餐，把这个词记成“赴宴、同席吃盛宴”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To deposit money in a bank.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把钱存入银行。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tpoġġi flus f'bank.

sense_translations.en_definition: to bank; to put into a bank
sense_translations.zh_definition: 存入银行；把钱存进银行。

collocations.en: deposited the money in the bank

collocations.zh: 把商店的营业收入存入了银行

formal.mt: It-teżorier bbankja l-flus miġbura wara l-attività.
formal.en: The treasurer deposited the money collected after the event in the bank.
formal.zh: 活动结束后，财务负责人把募集到的钱存入了银行。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Fejn huma l-flus tal-ħanut? Mark: Pawlu bbankja l-flus dalgħodu.
colloquial.en: Sara: Where is the shop's money? Mark: Pawlu deposited it in the bank this morning.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：店里的钱在哪里？马克：保罗今天早上把钱存进银行了。

messages.speaker: Sara (店主)
messages.zh: 店里的钱在哪里？
messages.en: Where is the shop's money?

messages.speaker: Mark (店员)
messages.zh: 保罗今天早上把钱存进银行了。
messages.en: Pawlu deposited the money in the bank this morning.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象把当天营业款交到银行柜台，用“钱进入银行”的画面记住这个动词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be enough for a particular need or purpose.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 数量或程度足以满足某种需要。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tkun biżżejjed għal ħtieġa jew għal skop partikolari.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 足够；够用；足以满足需要。

collocations.zh: 足够所有人使用或享用

collocations.en: was enough for us to pay

formal.mt: L-ammont miġbur bbasta biex jitħallsu l-ispejjeż kollha tal-attività.
formal.en: The amount collected was enough to cover all the event's expenses.
formal.zh: 募集到的金额足以支付活动的全部费用。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Kien hemm biżżejjed ikel għall-mistednin? Pawlu: Iva, l-ikel bbasta għal kulħadd.
colloquial.en: Marija: Was there enough food for the guests? Pawlu: Yes, there was enough for everyone.
colloquial.zh: 玛丽娅：给客人的食物够吗？保罗：够，食物足够大家吃。

messages.speaker: Marija (女主人)
messages.zh: 给客人的食物够吗？
messages.en: Was there enough food for the guests?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (男主人)
messages.zh: 够，食物足够大家吃。
messages.en: Yes, the food was enough for everyone.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象分饭时每个人都分到一份，最后确认“够了”，把这个动词和满足需要联系起来。

gloss_zh: 玩 bazzika；可疑地厮混；插手

teaching_sense.en_definition: To play bazzika; also, to associate with people in a suspicious manner or meddle with something.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 玩名为 bazzika 的游戏；也可指与人可疑地厮混，或插手某事。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tilgħab il-bazzika; ukoll, tagħmilha ma' nies b'mod suspettuż jew tindaħal f'xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 玩名为 bazzika 的游戏。

sense_translations.en_definition: to hang out, to frequent with (people) in a suspicious manner
sense_translations.zh_definition: 以可疑的方式与人来往；与人厮混。
插手；干涉；擅自摆弄。

formal.mt: Fir-rakkont, il-protagonist bbazzika fl-affarijiet tal-ġirien mingħajr ma talbuh jagħmel dan.
formal.en: In the story, the protagonist meddled in the neighbours' affairs without being asked.
formal.zh: 故事中，主人公未经请求就插手了邻居的事情。

colloquial.mt: Lara: X'għamel in-nannu lbieraħ filgħaxija? Pawlu: Bbazzika mal-ħbieb tiegħu.
colloquial.en: Lara: What did Grandpa do yesterday evening? Pawlu: He played bazzika with his friends.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：爷爷昨天晚上做什么了？保罗：他和朋友们玩 bazzika 了。

messages.speaker: Lara (孙女)
messages.zh: 爷爷昨天晚上做什么了？
messages.en: What did Grandpa do yesterday evening?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (父亲)
messages.zh: 他和朋友们玩 bazzika 了。
messages.en: He played bazzika with his friends.

cognitive_memory_aid: 分成三张情景卡记忆：玩名叫 bazzika 的游戏、与人可疑地厮混、插手别人的事；靠上下文区分。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To obtain a Bachelor's degree after completing the required studies.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 完成相应学业并取得学士学位。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kiseb grad ta' baċellerat wara li temm l-istudji meħtieġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 取得学士学位。

collocations.en: obtained a Bachelor's degree in history
collocations.zh: 取得了历史学学士学位

collocations.en: obtained a Bachelor's degree from the university
collocations.zh: 取得了该大学的学士学位

formal.mt: Pawlu bbaċella fl-istorja u mbagħad kompla l-istudji tiegħu f'livell ogħla.
formal.en: Pawlu obtained a Bachelor's degree in history and then continued his studies at a higher level.
formal.zh: 保罗取得历史学学士学位后，继续攻读更高层次的学位。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Ħuk għadu jistudja l-università? Mark: Le, bbaċella din is-sena u issa qed ifittex xogħol.
colloquial.en: Sara: Is your brother still studying at university? Mark: No, he obtained his Bachelor's degree this year and is now looking for work.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：你哥哥还在上大学吗？马克：没有了，他今年拿到了学士学位，现在正在找工作。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 你哥哥还在上大学吗？
messages.en: Is your brother still studying at university?

messages.speaker: Mark (毕业生的弟弟)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, bbaċella din is-sena u issa qed ifittex xogħol.
messages.mt_standard: Le, bbaċella din is-sena u issa qed ifittex xogħol.
messages.zh: 没有了，他今年拿到了学士学位，现在正在找工作。
messages.en: No, he obtained his Bachelor's degree this year and is now looking for work.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象毕业生接过写着“学士”的学位证，把 bbaċella 与“取得学士学位”整个动作绑定，再用专业和毕业年份扩展句子。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To plan how money will be allocated or spent.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 预先规划资金如何分配或使用；编制预算。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ippjana kif se jitqassmu jew jintefqu l-flus.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 编制预算；规划资金的分配和支出。

collocations.en: budgeted one thousand euros for equipment
collocations.zh: 为设备编列了一千欧元的预算

formal.mt: Il-kumitat bbaġittja elf ewro għat-tagħmir meħtieġ għall-proġett.
formal.en: The committee budgeted one thousand euros for the equipment needed for the project.
formal.zh: 委员会为项目所需设备编列了一千欧元的预算。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Mark bbaġittja għall-vjaġġ? Rita: Iva, ħaseb għall-ispiża tal-lukanda, tal-ikel u tat-trasport.
colloquial.en: Anna: Did Mark budget for the trip? Rita: Yes, he allowed for the cost of the hotel, food and transport.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：马克为这次旅行做预算了吗？丽塔：做了，他把酒店、餐饮和交通的费用都考虑进去了。

messages.speaker: Anna (旅伴)
messages.zh: 马克为这次旅行做预算了吗？
messages.en: Did Mark budget for the trip?

messages.speaker: Rita (旅伴)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, ħaseb għall-ispiża tal-lukanda, tal-ikel u tat-trasport.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, ħaseb għall-ispiża tal-lukanda, tal-ikel u tat-trasport.
messages.zh: 做了，他把酒店、餐饮和交通的费用都考虑进去了。
messages.en: Yes, he allowed for the cost of the hotel, food and transport.

cognitive_memory_aid: 在脑中画出旅行费用表，把酒店、餐饮、交通逐项填入金额；每填一项就联想 bbaġittja，记住它表示事先安排钱怎么花。

gloss_zh: 表现得虔诚而自鸣得意

teaching_sense.en_definition: To behave in a pious manner while showing smug satisfaction with one's own goodness.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 表现出虔诚的姿态，同时流露对自身品德的自满。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Iġġib ruħek b'devozzjoni u b'sens ta' superjorità morali.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 表现得虔诚而自鸣得意；以自满的态度显示自己的虔诚。

collocations.en: behaved piously and smugly in front of people
collocations.zh: 在人前摆出虔诚而自满的姿态

collocations.en: behaved piously and smugly during the meeting
collocations.zh: 在会议中表现得虔诚而自鸣得意

formal.mt: Fir-rakkont, il-karattru bbażokkja quddiem il-ġirien u tkellem bħallikieku kien aħjar minn kulħadd.
formal.en: In the story, the character behaved piously and smugly before the neighbours and spoke as though he were better than everyone else.
formal.zh: 故事中，这个人物在邻居面前表现得虔诚而自满，说话仿佛自己比所有人都高尚。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex iddejjaqt b'dak li qal Toni? Nina: Għax bbażokkja quddiem kulħadd, bħallikieku hu biss jagħmel it-tajjeb.
colloquial.en: Lara: Why were you annoyed by what Toni said? Nina: Because he acted piously and smugly in front of everyone, as if he were the only one who did good.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：托尼的话为什么让你不舒服？妮娜：因为他在大家面前摆出虔诚又自满的样子，好像只有他才做好事。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex iddejjaqt b'dak li qal Toni?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex iddejjaqt b'dak li qal Toni?
messages.zh: 托尼的话为什么让你不舒服？
messages.en: Why were you annoyed by what Toni said?

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax bbażokkja quddiem kulħadd, bħallikieku hu biss jagħmel it-tajjeb.
messages.mt_standard: Għax bbażokkja quddiem kulħadd, bħallikieku hu biss jagħmel it-tajjeb.
messages.zh: 因为他在大家面前摆出虔诚又自满的样子，好像只有他才做好事。
messages.en: Because he acted piously and smugly in front of everyone, as if he were the only one who did good.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记住“虔诚姿态加自满神情”这两个部分，想象一个人做好事后摆出自认高尚的表情。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To joke or act like a clown to amuse others.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 说笑或做出滑稽举动来逗别人开心。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tiċċajta jew tagħmel il-buffu biex iddaħħak lil ħaddieħor.

sense_translations.en_definition: to jest, to play the clown
sense_translations.zh_definition: 开玩笑；扮丑逗乐；做出滑稽举动。

collocations.zh: 和孩子们一起耍宝逗乐

collocations.en: played the clown to make people laugh

formal.mt: Waqt il-wirja, l-attur bbażuffja biex idaħħak lit-tfal fl-udjenza.
formal.en: During the performance, the actor played the clown to make the children in the audience laugh.
formal.zh: 演出时，演员做出滑稽举动，逗观众席上的孩子们发笑。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għaliex it-tfal kienu qed jidħku daqshekk? Mark: Għax Toni bbażuffja magħhom u għamel ħafna uċuħ tad-daħk.
colloquial.en: Sara: Why were the children laughing so much? Mark: Because Toni clowned around with them and made lots of funny faces.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：孩子们为什么笑得那么开心？马克：因为托尼和他们一起耍宝，还做了好多鬼脸。

messages.speaker: Sara (母亲)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex it-tfal kienu qed jidħku daqshekk?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex it-tfal kienu qed jidħku daqshekk?
messages.zh: 孩子们为什么笑得那么开心？
messages.en: Why were the children laughing so much?

messages.speaker: Mark (父亲)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax Toni bbażuffja magħhom u għamel ħafna uċuħ tad-daħk.
messages.mt_standard: Għax Toni bbażuffja magħhom u għamel ħafna uċuħ tad-daħk.
messages.zh: 因为托尼和他们一起耍宝，还做了好多鬼脸。
messages.en: Because Toni clowned around with them and made lots of funny faces.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象聚会上有人做鬼脸把孩子逗笑，用“开玩笑、扮丑角”的动作画面记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To declare a person blessed as a step towards declaring that person a saint.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 宣布某人为真福，作为将其宣布为圣人的一个步骤。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tiddikjara persuna beata bħala pass lejn li tiġi ddikjarata qaddisa.

sense_translations.en_definition: to beatify (to take step in declaring a person a saint)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 为某人宣福，即宣布其为真福，作为封圣过程中的一个步骤。

formal.mt: It-test jiddeskrivi ċerimonja li fiha l-Papa bbeatifika lil saċerdot.
formal.en: The text describes a ceremony in which the Pope beatified a priest.
formal.zh: 课文描述了一场教宗宣布一位神父为真福的仪式。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Xi jfisser li l-Papa bbeatifika lil dik is-soru? Mark: Ifisser li ddikjaraha beata; dan hu pass lejn il-kanonizzazzjoni.
colloquial.en: Anna: What does it mean that the Pope beatified that nun? Mark: It means he declared her blessed; this is a step towards canonization.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：教宗为那位修女宣福是什么意思？马克：意思是宣布她为真福，这是迈向封圣的一个步骤。

messages.speaker: Anna (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Xi jfisser li l-Papa bbeatifika lil dik is-soru?
messages.mt_standard: Xi jfisser li l-Papa bbeatifika lil dik is-soru?
messages.zh: 教宗为那位修女宣福是什么意思？
messages.en: What does it mean that the Pope beatified that nun?

messages.speaker: Mark (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Ifisser li ddikjaraha beata; dan hu pass lejn il-kanonizzazzjoni.
messages.mt_standard: Ifisser li ddikjaraha beata; dan hu pass lejn il-kanonizzazzjoni.
messages.zh: 意思是宣布她为真福，这是迈向封圣的一个步骤。
messages.en: It means he declared her blessed; this is a step towards canonization.

cognitive_memory_aid: 画一条通向封圣的台阶，把“宣布为真福”放在其中一级，用台阶画面记住宣福的含义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To give support to a person, proposal, or cause.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 给予某人、某项提议或某项事业支持。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tagħti appoġġ lil persuna, proposta jew kawża.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 支持；为……撑腰；给予赞助或声援。

formal.mt: Il-kumitat bbekkja l-proposta biex il-librerija tibqa' miftuħa għal aktar sigħat.
formal.en: The committee backed the proposal to keep the library open for longer hours.
formal.zh: 委员会支持了延长图书馆开放时间的提议。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Xi ħadd appoġġja l-idea tiegħek fil-laqgħa? Nina: Iva, Mark bbekkja l-proposta tiegħi.
colloquial.en: Lara: Did anyone support your idea at the meeting? Nina: Yes, Mark backed my proposal.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：会上有人支持你的想法吗？妮娜：有，马克支持了我的提议。

messages.speaker: Lara (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Xi ħadd appoġġja l-idea tiegħek fil-laqgħa?
messages.mt_standard: Xi ħadd appoġġja l-idea tiegħek fil-laqgħa?
messages.zh: 会上有人支持你的想法吗？
messages.en: Did anyone support your idea at the meeting?

messages.speaker: Nina (同事)
messages.zh: 有，马克支持了我的提议。
messages.en: Yes, Mark backed my proposal.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象你提出建议时，一位同事站到身旁举手赞成，把这个动词记作“支持、撑腰”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To receive an advantage or a positive result from something.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 从某事中得到好处或获得积极的结果。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tikseb vantaġġ jew ġid minn xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 受益；得到好处；获得益处。

formal.mt: L-istudent bbenefika mill-lezzjonijiet addizzjonali u tejjeb il-ħiliet tiegħu fil-qari.
formal.en: The student benefited from the additional lessons and improved his reading skills.
formal.zh: 这名学生从额外课程中受益，提高了阅读能力。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Il-kors għen lil Mark? Pawlu: Iva, bbenefika ħafna minnu u issa jħossu aktar kunfidenti.
colloquial.en: Sara: Did the course help Mark? Pawlu: Yes, he benefited a lot from it and now feels more confident.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：这门课对马克有帮助吗？保罗：有，他从中受益很多，现在更有信心了。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 这门课对马克有帮助吗？
messages.en: Did the course help Mark?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, bbenefika ħafna minnu u issa jħossu aktar kunfidenti.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, bbenefika ħafna minnu u issa jħossu aktar kunfidenti.
messages.zh: 有，他从中受益很多，现在更有信心了。
messages.en: Yes, he benefited a lot from it and now feels more confident.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象上完课程后能力提高，给自己贴上“我受益了”的标签，并把受益来源一起记住。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To offer a price for an item being sold at an auction.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在拍卖会上为某件物品提出愿意支付的价格，参与竞买。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tagħmel offerta ta' prezz għal oġġett li jkun qed jinbiegħ f'irkant.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 在拍卖会上出价竞买。

formal.mt: Matul l-irkant, ix-xerrej bbiddja elf ewro għall-pittura.
formal.en: During the auction, the buyer bid one thousand euros for the painting.
formal.zh: 拍卖期间，买家为那幅画出价一千欧元。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Mark bbiddja għall-mejda? Lara: Iva, offra mitt ewro, imma xi ħadd offra aktar.
colloquial.en: Maja: Did Mark bid for the table? Lara: Yes, he offered a hundred euros, but someone offered more.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：马克出价竞买那张桌子了吗？拉拉：出了，他出了一百欧元，但有人出得更高。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 马克出价竞买那张桌子了吗？
messages.en: Did Mark bid for the table?

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, offra mitt ewro, imma xi ħadd offra aktar.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, offra mitt ewro, imma xi ħadd offra aktar.
messages.zh: 出了，他出了一百欧元，但有人出得更高。
messages.en: Yes, he offered a hundred euros, but someone offered more.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 bbiddja 配上拍卖举牌的画面：报出愿付价格就是竞价，出价后还可能有人加价。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To become hard or stiff instead of remaining soft or flexible.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 由柔软或灵活的状态变得坚硬、僵硬或不易弯曲。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Issir iebes wara li tkun artab jew flessibbli.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 变硬；变得僵硬、不灵活。

formal.mt: Wara li tħalla fix-xemx, it-tafal bbies u ma baqax faċli biex jingħata forma.
formal.en: After being left in the sun, the clay hardened and was no longer easy to shape.
formal.zh: 黏土在太阳下放置后变硬了，不再容易塑形。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Għaliex mhux qed taqta' dan il-ħobż? Pawlu: Għax bbies wisq; se nużah għas-soppa.
colloquial.en: Nina: Why aren't you cutting this bread? Pawlu: Because it has become too hard; I'll use it for soup.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：你怎么不切这个面包？保罗：因为它变得太硬了，我打算拿它做汤。

messages.speaker: Nina (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex mhux qed taqta' dan il-ħobż?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex mhux qed taqta' dan il-ħobż?
messages.zh: 你怎么不切这个面包？
messages.en: Why aren't you cutting this bread?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax bbies wisq; se nużah għas-soppa.
messages.mt_standard: Għax bbies wisq; se nużah għas-soppa.
messages.zh: 因为它变得太硬了，我打算拿它做汤。
messages.en: Because it has become too hard; I'll use it for soup.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记住 bbies 的状态变化：昨天面包还软，今天已经切不动；重点是“变硬了”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To keep something steady or bring different amounts, forces, or needs into balance.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使物体保持稳定，或使不同的数量、力量、需求达到平衡。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Iżżomm xi ħaġa stabbli jew iġġib bilanċ bejn ammonti, forzi jew ħtiġijiet differenti.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使保持平衡；平衡不同的数量、力量或需求。

formal.mt: Il-kunsill bbilanċja l-baġit billi naqqas l-ispejjeż u żied id-dħul.
formal.en: The council balanced the budget by reducing expenditure and increasing revenue.
formal.zh: 委员会通过减少支出和增加收入，使预算达到收支平衡。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Kif ġarr it-tazzi kollha mingħajr ma waqgħu? Mark: Bbilanċja t-trej b'id waħda u mexa bil-mod.
colloquial.en: Sara: How did he carry all the cups without them falling? Mark: He balanced the tray with one hand and walked slowly.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：他怎么端着所有杯子还没让它们掉下来？马克：他用一只手稳住托盘，慢慢地走。

messages.speaker: Sara (顾客)
messages.mt_spoken: Kif ġarr it-tazzi kollha mingħajr ma waqgħu?
messages.mt_standard: Kif ġarr it-tazzi kollha mingħajr ma waqgħu?
messages.zh: 他怎么端着所有杯子还没让它们掉下来？
messages.en: How did he carry all the cups without them falling?

messages.speaker: Mark (顾客)
messages.mt_spoken: Bbilanċja t-trej b'id waħda u mexa bil-mod.
messages.mt_standard: Bbilanċja t-trej b'id waħda u mexa bil-mod.
messages.zh: 他用一只手稳住托盘，慢慢地走。
messages.en: He balanced the tray with one hand and walked slowly.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 bbilanċja 连到两幅平衡画面：托盘不倾斜，预算不失衡；都要把两边调稳。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To perform a piece again as an encore in response to an audience's request.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 应观众的要求再次表演某个节目或曲目，作为加演。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Terġa' tesegwixxi biċċa mużika jew numru ieħor fuq talba tal-udjenza.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 应观众要求加演或再次表演。

collocations.en: performed the song again as an encore
gave an encore at the audience's request

formal.mt: Fi tmiem il-kunċert, il-kantant bbissja l-aħħar kanzunetta fuq talba tal-udjenza.
formal.en: At the end of the concert, the singer performed the final song again as an encore at the audience's request.
formal.zh: 音乐会结束时，歌手应观众要求，把最后一首歌又演唱了一遍作为加演。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Il-kantant reġa' kanta l-kanzunetta favorita tiegħek? Toni: Iva, bbissja dik il-kanzunetta wara ħafna ċapċip!
colloquial.en: Lara: Did the singer sing your favourite song again? Toni: Yes, he performed that song as an encore after lots of applause!
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：歌手又唱了一遍你最喜欢的歌吗？托尼：对，大家热烈鼓掌后，他加演了那首歌！

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-kantant reġa' kanta l-kanzunetta favorita tiegħek?
messages.mt_standard: Il-kantant reġa' kanta l-kanzunetta favorita tiegħek?
messages.zh: 歌手又唱了一遍你最喜欢的歌吗？
messages.en: Did the singer sing your favourite song again?

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, bbissja dik il-kanzunetta wara ħafna ċapċip!
messages.mt_standard: Iva, bbissja dik il-kanzunetta wara ħafna ċapċip!
messages.zh: 对，大家热烈鼓掌后，他加演了那首歌！
messages.en: Yes, he performed that song as an encore after lots of applause!

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 bbissja 放进演出结束后的掌声里：观众喊再来一次，演员便把节目加演一遍。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To spend the night outdoors in a temporary camp or shelter.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在户外的临时营地或简易遮蔽处过夜。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tgħaddi l-lejl barra f'kamp temporanju jew f'kenn sempliċi.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 在户外临时扎营过夜；露宿。

formal.mt: Il-grupp bbivakka f'post protett mir-riħ qabel kompla l-mixja l-għada filgħodu.
formal.en: The group bivouacked in a spot sheltered from the wind before continuing the hike the following morning.
formal.zh: 队伍在一处避风的地方临时扎营过夜，第二天早晨继续徒步。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Fejn raqad Pawlu waqt il-mixja? Karl: Bbivakka ħdejn ix-xmara; kellu sleeping bag miegħu.
colloquial.en: Maja: Where did Pawlu sleep during the hike? Karl: He bivouacked beside the river; he had a sleeping bag with him.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：保罗徒步时在哪里睡的？卡尔：他在河边露宿，随身带着睡袋。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 保罗徒步时在哪里睡的？
messages.en: Where did Pawlu sleep during the hike?

messages.speaker: Karl (徒步伙伴)
messages.mt_spoken: Bbivakka ħdejn ix-xmara; kellu sleeping bag miegħu.
messages.mt_standard: Bbivakka ħdejn ix-xmara; kellu sleeping bag miegħu.
messages.zh: 他在河边露宿，随身带着睡袋。
messages.en: He bivouacked beside the river; he had a sleeping bag with him.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记 bbivakka 时想象徒步者停下脚步，铺开睡袋，在户外临时过上一夜。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To behave foolishly or act the fool, often to amuse other people.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 举止傻气或胡闹，常指为了逗别人发笑而做出滑稽、不认真的行为。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Iġġib ruħek b'mod iblah jew tagħmel ħmerijiet, spiss biex iddaħħaq lil ħaddieħor.

sense_translations.en_definition: to play the fool (behave in a foolish manner)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 胡闹；做出傻气、滑稽或不认真的举动。

collocations.en: played the fool during the lesson
played the fool to make his friends laugh

formal.mt: L-istudent bbiżletta waqt il-preżentazzjoni u fixkel lill-kelliema.
formal.en: The student played the fool during the presentation and disrupted the speakers.
formal.zh: 那名学生在展示过程中胡闹，干扰了发言者。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għaliex kulħadd daħaq waqt il-logħba? Nina: Għax Toni bbiżletta u għamel wiċċ tad-daħk.
colloquial.en: Sara: Why did everyone laugh during the game? Nina: Because Toni played the fool and pulled a funny face.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：玩游戏时大家为什么都笑了？妮娜：因为托尼胡闹，做了个鬼脸。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 玩游戏时大家为什么都笑了？
messages.en: Why did everyone laugh during the game?

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax Toni bbiżletta u għamel wiċċ tad-daħk.
messages.mt_standard: Għax Toni bbiżletta u għamel wiċċ tad-daħk.
messages.zh: 因为托尼胡闹，做了个鬼脸。
messages.en: Because Toni played the fool and pulled a funny face.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用做鬼脸逗笑的场景记 bbiżletta：关注的是胡闹的行为，不是判断一个人聪不聪明。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To hold someone or something responsible for a mistake, problem, or bad result.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 认为某人或某事应为错误、问题或不良结果负责，并加以责怪或归咎。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tqis lil xi ħadd jew lil xi ħaġa responsabbli għal żball, problema jew riżultat ħażin.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 责怪；把错误或不良结果归咎于某人或某事。

formal.mt: Il-maniġer bbjażma lill-fornitur għad-dewmien fil-kunsinna.
formal.en: The manager blamed the supplier for the delay in delivery.
formal.zh: 经理把交货延误归咎于供应商。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex Mark irrabja ma' Toni? Pawlu: Għax Toni bbjażma lil Mark għat-tazza miksura, imma Mark lanqas messha.
colloquial.en: Lara: Why did Mark get angry with Toni? Pawlu: Because Toni blamed Mark for the broken cup, but Mark hadn't even touched it.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：马克为什么生托尼的气？保罗：因为托尼怪马克打破了杯子，可马克连碰都没碰过。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 马克为什么生托尼的气？
messages.en: Why did Mark get angry with Toni?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax Toni bbjażma lil Mark għat-tazza miksura, imma Mark lanqas messha.
messages.mt_standard: Għax Toni bbjażma lil Mark għat-tazza miksura, imma Mark lanqas messha.
messages.zh: 因为托尼怪马克打破了杯子，可马克连碰都没碰过。
messages.en: Because Toni blamed Mark for the broken cup, but Mark hadn't even touched it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 bbjażma 想成把责任指向某人：说“都怪他”就是责怪，但被责怪不等于确实有错。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To mislead others by pretending to have greater strength, knowledge, or confidence than one actually has.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 假装拥有比实际更多的实力、知识或把握，以此唬住或误导别人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tipprova tqarraq b'ħaddieħor billi tippretendi li għandek aktar saħħa, għarfien jew ċertezza milli għandek tassew.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 虚张声势；假装有实力或把握来唬人。

formal.mt: Waqt in-negozjati, ix-xerrej bblaffja billi qal li kellu offerta aħjar, għalkemm ma kellux.
formal.en: During the negotiations, the buyer bluffed by saying he had a better offer, although he did not.
formal.zh: 谈判时，买家虚张声势，声称自己有更好的报价，实际上并没有。

colloquial.mt: Karl: Toni kellu karti tajbin? Maja: Le, bblaffja biss, u aħna emminnieh!
colloquial.en: Karl: Did Toni have good cards? Maja: No, he was only bluffing, and we believed him!
colloquial.zh: 卡尔：托尼手里的牌很好吗？玛雅：没有，他只是诈唬，我们还真信了！

messages.speaker: Karl (牌友)
messages.zh: 托尼手里的牌很好吗？
messages.en: Did Toni have good cards?

messages.speaker: Maja (牌友)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, bblaffja biss, u aħna emminnieh!
messages.mt_standard: Le, bblaffja biss, u aħna emminnieh!
messages.zh: 没有，他只是诈唬，我们还真信了！
messages.en: No, he was only bluffing, and we believed him!

cognitive_memory_aid: 用弱牌却装出胜券在握的画面记 bblaffja：表面气势很强，实际底牌未必够强。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To apply black polish to shoes to darken them and make them shine.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 给鞋子涂黑鞋油并擦拭，使鞋面颜色更黑、更有光泽。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jiksi ż-żraben bil-lostru iswed u jillustrahom biex jissewdu u jleqqu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 给鞋子涂黑鞋油；把鞋子擦黑、擦亮。

collocations.en: polished the shoes with black polish
polished the boots with black polish

formal.mt: Qabel iċ-ċerimonja, l-uffiċjal bblakka ż-żraben biex ikunu nodfa u jleqqu.
formal.en: Before the ceremony, the officer polished his shoes with black polish so that they would be clean and shiny.
formal.zh: 典礼前，军官用黑鞋油擦了鞋，使鞋子干净发亮。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Kemm qed jleqqu ż-żraben tiegħek! Mark: Missieri bblakka ż-żraben dalgħodu.
colloquial.en: Maja: Your shoes are so shiny! Mark: My father polished them with black polish this morning.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你的鞋真亮！马克：我爸爸今天早上用黑鞋油擦过。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你的鞋真亮！
messages.en: Your shoes are so shiny!

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 我爸爸今天早上用黑鞋油擦过。
messages.en: My father polished them with black polish this morning.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把黑鞋油、鞋刷和发亮的皮鞋连成一个画面，记住这里是给鞋擦黑擦亮。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To cook food briefly in boiling water and then put it directly into cold water.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把食物短暂放入沸水中烫煮，随后立即转入冷水中冷却。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jgħaddas l-ikel għal ftit ħin fl-ilma jagħli u mbagħad iqiegħdu minnufih fl-ilma kiesaħ.

sense_translations.en_definition: to blanch (to cook by dipping briefly into boiling water, then directly into cold water)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 焯水：将食物短暂浸入沸水烫煮，随后直接放入冷水中冷却。

formal.mt: Il-kok bblanxja l-ħaxix billi għaddsu għal ftit ħin fl-ilma jagħli u mbagħad qiegħdu minnufih fl-ilma kiesaħ.
formal.en: The cook blanched the vegetables by dipping them briefly into boiling water and then placing them directly into cold water.
formal.zh: 厨师给蔬菜焯水：先短暂浸入沸水，再立即放入冷水。

colloquial.mt: Mark: It-tadam lest biex inqaxxruh? Maja: Iva, il-kok bblanxja t-tadam u issa nistgħu nneħħu l-qoxra.
colloquial.en: Mark: Are the tomatoes ready for us to peel? Maja: Yes, the cook blanched them, and now we can remove the skins.
colloquial.zh: 马克：番茄可以剥皮了吗？玛雅：可以，厨师已经给番茄焯水并过了冷水，现在可以去皮了。

messages.speaker: Mark (厨房助手)
messages.zh: 番茄可以剥皮了吗？
messages.en: Are the tomatoes ready for us to peel?

messages.speaker: Maja (厨房助手)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, il-kok bblanxja t-tadam u issa nistgħu nneħħu l-qoxra.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, il-kok bblanxja t-tadam u issa nistgħu nneħħu l-qoxra.
messages.zh: 可以，厨师已经给番茄焯水并过了冷水，现在可以去皮了。
messages.en: Yes, the cook blanched them, and now we can remove the skins.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记住两个连续动作：先短暂进沸水，再立即进冷水；完整画面才是本词的烹饪义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To make or produce a very loud noise.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 发出很响的声音，或使声音以很大的音量响起。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jagħmel ħoss qawwi ħafna jew idoqq xi ħaġa b'volum għoli ħafna.

sense_translations.en_definition: to blast (to make a loud noise)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 发出巨响；大声鸣响。

formal.mt: Ix-xufier bblastja bil-ħorn biex iwissi lin-nies li kienu quddiem il-vettura.
formal.en: The driver blasted the horn to warn the people who were in front of the vehicle.
formal.zh: 司机大声按响喇叭，提醒车辆前方的人。

colloquial.mt: Sara: X'kien dak il-ħoss qawwi? Mark: Ix-xufier bblastja bil-ħorn eżatt taħt it-tieqa.
colloquial.en: Sara: What was that loud noise? Mark: The driver blasted the horn right below the window.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：刚才那声巨响是什么？马克：司机就在窗户下面大声按了喇叭。

messages.speaker: Sara (邻居)
messages.zh: 刚才那声巨响是什么？
messages.en: What was that loud noise?

messages.speaker: Mark (邻居)
messages.mt_spoken: Ix-xufier bblastja bil-ħorn eżatt taħt it-tieqa.
messages.mt_standard: Ix-xufier bblastja bil-ħorn eżatt taħt it-tieqa.
messages.zh: 司机就在窗户下面大声按了喇叭。
messages.en: The driver blasted the horn right below the window.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象窗下喇叭突然震耳鸣响，抓住“声音很大”这个核心来记忆。

gloss_zh: 脸红；因害羞、激动或尴尬而面红

teaching_sense.en_definition: To become red in the face because of shame, excitement, or embarrassment.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 因为羞愧、激动或尴尬而脸部发红。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Wiċċu jiħmar minħabba mistħija, eċċitament jew imbarazzament.

sense_translations.en_definition: to blush (to redden in the face from shame, excitement or embarrassment)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 脸红：因羞愧、激动或尴尬而面部发红。

formal.mt: L-istudent bblaxxja meta l-għalliema faħħret ix-xogħol tiegħu quddiem il-klassi.
formal.en: The student blushed when the teacher praised his work in front of the class.
formal.zh: 老师当着全班表扬他的作业时，这名学生脸红了。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Rajt lil Pawlu meta faħħruh? Sara: Iva, bblaxxja u tbissem.
colloquial.en: Maja: Did you see Pawlu when they praised him? Sara: Yes, he blushed and smiled.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：他们表扬保罗时，你看到他的样子了吗？萨拉：看到了，他脸红了，还笑了笑。

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.zh: 他们表扬保罗时，你看到他的样子了吗？
messages.en: Did you see Pawlu when they praised him?

messages.speaker: Sara (同学)
messages.zh: 看到了，他脸红了，还笑了笑。
messages.en: Yes, he blushed and smiled.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把“当众被夸奖，脸颊一下变红”的场景与本词绑定，记住情绪引起的脸红。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be lazy or spend time idling instead of doing the work expected.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 该做事时却闲着或偷懒，不付出应有的劳动。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jitgħażżen jew jgħaddi l-ħin bla ma jagħmel ix-xogħol mistenni minnu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 偷懒；闲混；该工作时却不肯出力。

formal.mt: Waqt li l-oħrajn lestew ix-xogħol, Pawlu bblaġġja u ma ta ebda għajnuna.
formal.en: While the others finished the work, Pawlu idled and gave no help.
formal.zh: 其他人完成工作时，保罗却在偷懒，一点忙也没帮。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Luke għen fit-tindif? Sara: Le, bblaġġja l-ħin kollu u ħalla kollox għalina.
colloquial.en: Maja: Did Luke help with the cleaning? Sara: No, he was lazy the whole time and left everything to us.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：卢克帮忙打扫了吗？萨拉：没有，他一直偷懒，把所有事情都留给我们。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 卢克帮忙打扫了吗？
messages.en: Did Luke help with the cleaning?

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, bblaġġja l-ħin kollu u ħalla kollox għalina.
messages.mt_standard: Le, bblaġġja l-ħin kollu u ħalla kollox għalina.
messages.zh: 没有，他一直偷懒，把所有事情都留给我们。
messages.en: No, he was lazy the whole time and left everything to us.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象大家忙着打扫，只有一个人闲坐不动，把这个画面与“偷懒”一起记住。

gloss_zh: 发动闪电式猛攻；猛烈突袭

teaching_sense.en_definition: To attack a target quickly and with great force.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 以迅速而猛烈的方式攻击目标，发动集中突袭。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jattakka mira malajr u b'qawwa kbira.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 发动闪电式攻击；迅速而猛烈地突袭或轰击。

collocations.zh: 对敌方阵地发动了闪电式猛攻

formal.mt: Fir-rakkont, l-eżerċitu bblizzja l-pożizzjonijiet tal-għadu qabel ma dawn setgħu jorganizzaw id-difiża.
formal.en: In the account, the army blitzed the enemy positions before they could organise their defence.
formal.zh: 记述中，军队在敌方来得及组织防御之前，对其阵地发动了闪电式猛攻。

colloquial.mt: Mark: X'ġara fil-film ilbieraħ? Sara: L-eżerċitu bblizzja l-belt u kulħadd fittex kenn.
colloquial.en: Mark: What happened in the film yesterday? Sara: The army blitzed the city, and everyone sought shelter.
colloquial.zh: 马克：昨天那部电影里发生了什么？萨拉：军队猛烈突袭了城市，大家都去找地方躲避。

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 昨天那部电影里发生了什么？
messages.en: What happened in the film yesterday?

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: L-eżerċitu bblizzja l-belt u kulħadd fittex kenn.
messages.mt_standard: L-eżerċitu bblizzja l-belt u kulħadd fittex kenn.
messages.zh: 军队猛烈突袭了城市，大家都去找地方躲避。
messages.en: The army blitzed the city, and everyone sought shelter.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用电影中突然展开的猛烈进攻作画面，同时抓住“速度快”和“攻势猛”两个记忆点。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To make something white or lighter in colour by bleaching it.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 通过漂白处理去除颜色，使物品变白或颜色变浅。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ineħħi l-kulur minn xi ħaġa jew jagħmilha aktar bajda jew ċara permezz tal-ibbliċjar.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 漂白；使褪色或颜色变浅。

formal.mt: Il-ħaddiem bbliċja d-drapp skont l-istruzzjonijiet tal-prodott biex il-kulur isir aktar ċar.
formal.en: The worker bleached the fabric according to the product instructions to make its colour lighter.
formal.zh: 工人按照产品说明漂白布料，使颜色变浅。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għaliex xagħar Luke sar daqshekk ċar? Maja: Il-parrukkier bbliċja xagħru lbieraħ.
colloquial.en: Sara: Why has Luke's hair become so light? Maja: The hairdresser bleached it yesterday.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：卢克的头发怎么变得这么浅了？玛雅：理发师昨天给他漂了头发。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex xagħar Luke sar daqshekk ċar?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex xagħar Luke sar daqshekk ċar?
messages.zh: 卢克的头发怎么变得这么浅了？
messages.en: Why has Luke's hair become so light?

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 理发师昨天给他漂了头发。
messages.en: The hairdresser bleached it yesterday.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象同一块布料处理前后颜色逐渐变浅，用“去色、变白”的视觉变化记住漂白。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To stop passage or movement by putting something in the way, or to close a hole with something.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 通过设置障碍阻止通行或移动，也可指用东西堵住孔洞。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Iwaqqaf il-passaġġ jew il-moviment billi jpoġġi ostaklu, jew jagħlaq toqba b'xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 阻挡；阻塞，使人或物无法通过或移动。
用东西塞住或堵住孔洞。

formal.mt: It-trakk bblokka t-triq għal diversi minuti, u l-karozzi ma setgħux jgħaddu.
formal.en: The truck blocked the road for several minutes, and cars could not pass.
formal.zh: 卡车把道路堵了好几分钟，汽车无法通过。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għadu ħiereġ l-ilma minn dik it-toqba? Mark: Le, il-plamer bblokka t-toqba b'tapp.
colloquial.en: Maja: Is water still coming out of that hole? Mark: No, the plumber plugged the hole with a stopper.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：那个孔还在往外流水吗？马克：没有了，水管工用塞子把孔堵住了。

messages.speaker: Maja (住户)
messages.mt_spoken: Għadu ħiereġ l-ilma minn dik it-toqba?
messages.mt_standard: Għadu ħiereġ l-ilma minn dik it-toqba?
messages.zh: 那个孔还在往外流水吗？
messages.en: Is water still coming out of that hole?

messages.speaker: Mark (住户)
messages.zh: 没有了，水管工用塞子把孔堵住了。
messages.en: No, the plumber plugged the hole with a stopper.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把大路被卡车挡住、小孔被塞子堵住并排想象；两个义项都围绕“让通道不再畅通”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To obstruct a passage or prevent someone or something from moving or continuing.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 挡住通道，或使某人、某物无法移动或继续进行。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tagħlaq passaġġ jew twaqqaf lil xi ħadd jew xi ħaġa milli timxi jew tkompli.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 阻挡；堵住；阻止。

formal.mt: Vettura wieqfa quddiem il-bini bblokkja l-aċċess għall-garaxx.
formal.en: A vehicle parked in front of the building blocked access to the garage.
formal.zh: 停在楼前的一辆车挡住了进入车库的通道。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex ma nistgħux ngħaddu minn hawn? Mark: Xi ħadd bblokkja t-triq bil-karozza tiegħu. Maja: Mela ngħaddu mit-triq l-oħra.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why can't we get through here? Mark: Someone blocked the road with his car. Maja: Then let's take the other road.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：我们为什么不能从这里过去？马克：有人把车停在路上，把路堵住了。玛雅：那我们走另一条路吧。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex ma nistgħux ngħaddu minn hawn?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex ma nistgħux ngħaddu minn hawn?
messages.zh: 我们为什么不能从这里过去？
messages.en: Why can't we get through here?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Xi ħadd bblokkja t-triq bil-karozza tiegħu.
messages.mt_standard: Xi ħadd bblokkja t-triq bil-karozza tiegħu.
messages.zh: 有人把车停在路上，把路堵住了。
messages.en: Someone blocked the road with his car.

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 那我们走另一条路吧。
messages.en: Then let's take the other road.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把这个词与汽车横在路口的画面绑定：路被挡住，行动也就被阻止了。

teaching_sense.en_definition: For the weather to become fine after rain or other unsettled conditions.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指天气在下雨或阴晴不定之后转好、放晴。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Meta t-temp jaqleb għall-bnazzi wara x-xita jew temp ikrah.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 天气转好；天气放晴。

collocations.en: it cleared up after the rain

formal.mt: Wara x-xita ta' filgħodu, it-temp bbnazza u l-attivitajiet fil-beraħ komplew.
formal.en: After the morning rain, the weather turned fine and the outdoor activities continued.
formal.zh: 早晨的雨停后，天气转晴，户外活动继续进行。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għadna sejrin nimxu llum? Pawlu: Iva, it-temp bbnazza u issa hemm ix-xemx. Lara: Tajjeb, nieħu ż-żraben u nitilqu.
colloquial.en: Lara: Are we still going for a walk today? Pawlu: Yes, the weather has cleared up and it's sunny now. Lara: Good, I'll get my shoes and we'll leave.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：我们今天还去散步吗？保罗：去，天气已经转晴，现在有太阳了。拉拉：好，我去拿鞋，然后我们就出发。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 我们今天还去散步吗？
messages.en: Are we still going for a walk today?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, it-temp bbnazza u issa hemm ix-xemx.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, it-temp bbnazza u issa hemm ix-xemx.
messages.zh: 去，天气已经转晴，现在有太阳了。
messages.en: Yes, the weather has cleared up and it's sunny now.

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 好，我去拿鞋，然后我们就出发。
messages.en: Good, I'll get my shoes and we'll leave.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象雨伞收起、太阳露出的连续画面，把这个词记成天气由坏转好的变化。

gloss_zh: 抵制；以拒绝购买或参与表示抗议

teaching_sense.en_definition: To deliberately refuse to buy from, deal with, or participate in something as a protest.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 为表示抗议而有意拒绝购买、往来或参与。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tirrifjuta apposta li tixtri, tinnegozja jew tieħu sehem f'xi ħaġa bħala protesta.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 抵制；为抗议而拒绝购买、往来或参加。

collocations.zh: 以拒绝出席的方式抵制了会议

formal.mt: Il-grupp bbojkottja l-prodotti tal-kumpanija biex jipprotesta kontra l-kundizzjonijiet tax-xogħol.
formal.en: The group boycotted the company's products to protest against the working conditions.
formal.zh: 该团体抵制了这家公司的产品，以抗议其工作条件。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għaliex Toni ma ġiex għal-laqgħa? Ben: Bbojkottja l-laqgħa għax ma qabilx mar-regoli l-ġodda. Sara: Allura n-nuqqas tiegħu kien forma ta' protesta.
colloquial.en: Sara: Why didn't Toni come to the meeting? Ben: He boycotted the meeting because he disagreed with the new rules. Sara: So his absence was a form of protest.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：托尼为什么没来开会？本：他不同意新规则，所以拒绝出席会议以示抵制。萨拉：所以他缺席是在表示抗议。

messages.speaker: Sara (同事)
messages.zh: 托尼为什么没来开会？
messages.en: Why didn't Toni come to the meeting?

messages.speaker: Ben (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Bbojkottja l-laqgħa għax ma qabilx mar-regoli l-ġodda.
messages.mt_standard: Bbojkottja l-laqgħa għax ma qabilx mar-regoli l-ġodda.
messages.zh: 他不同意新规则，所以拒绝出席会议以示抵制。
messages.en: He boycotted the meeting because he disagreed with the new rules.

messages.speaker: Sara (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Allura n-nuqqas tiegħu kien forma ta' protesta.
messages.mt_standard: Allura n-nuqqas tiegħu kien forma ta' protesta.
messages.zh: 所以他缺席是在表示抗议。
messages.en: So his absence was a form of protest.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“不买、不去，表示抗议”来记忆；关键是有意拒绝参与，而不只是碰巧缺席。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To fasten or secure something, especially by closing a buckle.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把物品扣上或固定牢，尤其指扣紧搭扣。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tagħlaq bokkla biex torbot jew twaħħal xi ħaġa sew.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 扣上；扣紧；系牢。

formal.mt: Qabel beda jsuq, ix-xufier bbokkla ċ-ċinturin tas-sigurtà.
formal.en: Before he started driving, the driver fastened his seat belt.
formal.zh: 开始驾驶之前，司机扣好了安全带。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Leo lest biex nitilqu? Mark: Iva, bbokkla ċ-ċinturin tas-sigurtà u qiegħed jistenna fil-karozza. Nina: Tajjeb, ġejja issa.
colloquial.en: Nina: Is Leo ready for us to leave? Mark: Yes, he has fastened his seat belt and is waiting in the car. Nina: Good, I'm coming now.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：利奥准备好出发了吗？马克：好了，他已经扣上安全带，正在车里等。妮娜：好，我这就来。

messages.speaker: Nina (母亲)
messages.zh: 利奥准备好出发了吗？
messages.en: Is Leo ready for us to leave?

messages.speaker: Mark (父亲)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, bbokkla ċ-ċinturin tas-sigurtà u qiegħed jistenna fil-karozza.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, bbokkla ċ-ċinturin tas-sigurtà u qiegħed jistenna fil-karozza.
messages.zh: 好了，他已经扣上安全带，正在车里等。
messages.en: Yes, he has fastened his seat belt and is waiting in the car.

messages.speaker: Nina (母亲)
messages.zh: 好，我这就来。
messages.en: Good, I'm coming now.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象安全带插入扣座时“咔哒”一声，把这个动作与“扣上、扣牢”一起记住。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To fight or compete using the fists, especially in the sport of boxing.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用拳头击打或较量，尤其指进行拳击运动。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tiġġieled bid-daqqiet tal-ponn, speċjalment fl-isport tal-boksing.

sense_translations.en_definition: to box (to strike with the fists)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 打拳；用拳头击打；进行拳击。

collocations.zh: 与强劲的对手进行了拳击较量

formal.mt: L-atleta bboksja għal tliet rawnds waqt il-kompetizzjoni tal-klabb.
formal.en: The athlete boxed for three rounds during the club competition.
formal.zh: 这名运动员在俱乐部比赛中打了三个回合的拳击。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Rajtu lil Daniel fil-kompetizzjoni? Pawlu: Iva, bboksja tajjeb ħafna kontra avversarju b'saħħtu. Maja: Kemm damet il-ġlieda?
colloquial.en: Maja: Did you see Daniel in the competition? Pawlu: Yes, he boxed very well against a strong opponent. Maja: How long did the fight last?
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你看丹尼尔参加比赛了吗？保罗：看了，面对强劲的对手，他打得很好。玛雅：比赛持续了多久？

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你看丹尼尔参加比赛了吗？
messages.en: Did you see Daniel in the competition?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, bboksja tajjeb ħafna kontra avversarju b'saħħtu.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, bboksja tajjeb ħafna kontra avversarju b'saħħtu.
messages.zh: 看了，面对强劲的对手，他打得很好。
messages.en: Yes, he boxed very well against a strong opponent.

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 比赛持续了多久？
messages.en: How long did the fight last?

cognitive_memory_aid: 脑中放一场戴拳套的比赛，看到选手挥拳，就把这个词与“打拳、拳击”连接起来。

gloss_zh: 盖章；给动物打烙印；给人贴标签或污名化

teaching_sense.en_definition: To mark something with a stamp, brand an animal, or figuratively attach a label or stigma to someone.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在物品上盖章，给动物打烙印，或比喻给某人贴上标签、加以污名化。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Timmarka xi ħaġa b'timbru, tagħmel marka fuq annimal b'ħadida sħuna, jew tagħti tikketta lil xi ħadd, speċjalment waħda negattiva.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 盖章；用印章在物品或文件上留下印记。
给动物打烙印，留下用于识别的标记。

sense_translations.en_definition: to brand, to label, to stigmatize
sense_translations.zh_definition: 给人贴标签；把人定性为某一类，尤其指作负面评价或污名化。

collocations.zh: 给同伴贴上了骗子的标签

formal.mt: L-impjegat bbolla d-dokument wara li ċċekkja d-dettalji tal-applikazzjoni.
formal.en: The employee stamped the document after checking the application details.
formal.zh: 工作人员核对申请资料后，在文件上盖了章。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex Toni rrabja ma' Mark? Ben: Mark bbolla lil Toni bħala giddieb quddiem kulħadd. Lara: Dik akkuża serja; messu sema' x'kellu xi jgħid Toni.
colloquial.en: Lara: Why did Toni get angry with Mark? Ben: Mark branded Toni a liar in front of everyone. Lara: That's a serious accusation; he should have listened to what Toni had to say.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：托尼为什么生马克的气？本：马克当着大家的面说托尼是骗子。拉拉：这可是严重的指控；他应该先听听托尼怎么说。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 托尼为什么生马克的气？
messages.en: Why did Toni get angry with Mark?

messages.speaker: Ben (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Mark bbolla lil Toni bħala giddieb quddiem kulħadd.
messages.mt_standard: Mark bbolla lil Toni bħala giddieb quddiem kulħadd.
messages.zh: 马克当着大家的面说托尼是骗子。
messages.en: Mark branded Toni a liar in front of everyone.

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Dik akkuża serja; messu sema' x'kellu xi jgħid Toni.
messages.mt_standard: Dik akkuża serja; messu sema' x'kellu xi jgħid Toni.
messages.zh: 这可是严重的指控；他应该先听听托尼怎么说。
messages.en: That's a serious accusation; he should have listened to what Toni had to say.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用三张学习图卡分别记忆：文件上的章、动物身上的烙印、人物旁的负面标签；借画面区分三个义项。

gloss_zh: 用插销闩住；用螺栓固定

teaching_sense.en_definition: To secure something with a bolt, such as fastening a door or fixing parts together.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用插销或螺栓固定物品，例如闩住门或把部件连接牢。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tagħlaq jew twaħħal xi ħaġa b'bolt, bħal bieb jew biċċiet ta' struttura.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 用插销闩住；用螺栓固定。

collocations.en: bolted the frame to the wall
collocations.zh: 用螺栓把框架固定在墙上

formal.mt: It-tekniku bboltja l-qafas mal-ħajt biex jibqa' mwaħħal sew.
formal.en: The technician bolted the frame to the wall so that it would remain securely attached.
formal.zh: 技术人员用螺栓把框架固定在墙上，使其保持牢固。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għalaq sew il-bieb ta' wara? Mark: Iva, Pawlu bboltja l-bieb qabel telaq. Sara: Tajjeb, mela nistgħu nitilqu wkoll.
colloquial.en: Sara: Was the back door properly secured? Mark: Yes, Pawlu bolted the door before he left. Sara: Good, then we can leave too.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：后门关牢了吗？马克：关牢了，保罗走之前把门闩上了。萨拉：好，那我们也可以走了。

messages.speaker: Sara (同事)
messages.zh: 后门关牢了吗？
messages.en: Was the back door properly secured?

messages.speaker: Mark (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, Pawlu bboltja l-bieb qabel telaq.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, Pawlu bboltja l-bieb qabel telaq.
messages.zh: 关牢了，保罗走之前把门闩上了。
messages.en: Yes, Pawlu bolted the door before he left.

messages.speaker: Sara (同事)
messages.zh: 好，那我们也可以走了。
messages.en: Good, then we can leave too.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一根金属插销滑进门框，再联想到螺栓固定框架；两幅画面都强调固定牢靠。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To attack a place or target with bombs.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使用炸弹攻击某个地方或目标。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tattakka post jew mira bil-bombi.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 轰炸；用炸弹袭击。

formal.mt: Ir-rakkont jiddeskrivi kif l-għadu bbombja l-belt u ġiegħel lir-residenti jitilqu minn djarhom.
formal.en: The account describes how the enemy bombed the city and forced the residents to leave their homes.
formal.zh: 这篇记述描述了敌军如何轰炸城市，迫使居民离开家园。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'ġara mill-pont fl-istorja li qrajna? Ben: L-għadu bbombja l-pont, u n-nies ma setgħux jaqsmu x-xmara. Maja: Issa nifhem għaliex kellhom jibdlu t-triq.
colloquial.en: Maja: What happened to the bridge in the story we read? Ben: The enemy bombed the bridge, and people couldn't cross the river. Maja: Now I understand why they had to change their route.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：我们读的故事里，那座桥怎么了？本：敌军轰炸了桥，人们没法过河。玛雅：现在我明白他们为什么得改道了。

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.zh: 我们读的故事里，那座桥怎么了？
messages.en: What happened to the bridge in the story we read?

messages.speaker: Ben (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: L-għadu bbombja l-pont, u n-nies ma setgħux jaqsmu x-xmara.
messages.mt_standard: L-għadu bbombja l-pont, u n-nies ma setgħux jaqsmu x-xmara.
messages.zh: 敌军轰炸了桥，人们没法过河。
messages.en: The enemy bombed the bridge, and people couldn't cross the river.

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Issa nifhem għaliex kellhom jibdlu t-triq.
messages.mt_standard: Issa nifhem għaliex kellhom jibdlu t-triq.
messages.zh: 现在我明白他们为什么得改道了。
messages.en: Now I understand why they had to change their route.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把这个词放进故事画面：桥梁遭到炸弹攻击，人物因此改道；用事件结果帮助记住“轰炸”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To travel on water in a boat or ship.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 乘船在水上行进或航行。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jivvjaġġa fuq l-ilma b'dgħajsa jew b'bastiment.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 在外寄宿，由他人提供食宿。
乘船航行。

formal.mt: Il-kaptan bbordja tul il-kosta qabel ma daħal fil-port.
formal.en: The captain sailed along the coast before entering the harbour.
formal.zh: 船长沿海岸航行，随后驶入港口。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Mark bbordja lbieraħ? Lara: Iva, bbordja tul il-kosta ma' sħabu.
colloquial.en: Maja: Did Mark go sailing yesterday? Lara: Yes, he sailed along the coast with his friends.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：马克昨天出海了吗？拉拉：是的，他和朋友们沿海岸航行了。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 马克昨天出海了吗？
messages.en: Did Mark go sailing yesterday?

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, bbordja tul il-kosta ma' sħabu.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, bbordja tul il-kosta ma' sħabu.
messages.zh: 是的，他和朋友们沿海岸航行了。
messages.en: Yes, he sailed along the coast with his friends.

cognitive_memory_aid: 画两张学习卡：一张是外宿时的床和餐桌，一张是航行中的船；分别记住两个义项，避免混用。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To become thick or dense, as when plants grow closely together.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 变得浓密或稠密，例如植物生长得密集。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Isir folt jew dens, bħal meta l-pjanti jikbru qrib ħafna ta' xulxin.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 变得浓密、茂密或稠密。

formal.mt: Wara x-xita tar-rebbiegħa, il-ħaxix bboskja u għatta l-mogħdija.
formal.en: After the spring rain, the grass grew thick and covered the path.
formal.zh: 春雨过后，草长得浓密，覆盖了小路。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Il-ġnien bboskja ħafna, hux? Mark: Iva, bilkemm tidher il-mogħdija!
colloquial.en: Maja: The garden has become really overgrown, hasn't it? Mark: Yes, you can barely see the path!
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：花园已经长得很茂密了，对吧？马克：是啊，小路都快看不见了！

messages.speaker: Maja (邻居)
messages.zh: 花园已经长得很茂密了，对吧？
messages.en: The garden has become really overgrown, hasn't it?

messages.speaker: Mark (园主)
messages.zh: 是啊，小路都快看不见了！
messages.en: Yes, you can barely see the path!

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象小路两旁的草越长越密，最后遮住路面；用这幅变化图记住它表示“变得茂密”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To behave in a bossy way by telling other people what to do.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 以爱管人、爱发号施令的态度要求别人照自己的意思做事。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Iġib ruħu b'mod awtoritarju billi joqgħod jgħid lill-oħrajn x'għandhom jagħmlu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 表现得专横，爱支使别人或发号施令。

collocations.zh: 在游戏中摆出指挥别人的架势

formal.mt: Waqt ix-xogħol fi grupp, Mark bbossja ma' sħabu u ma semax il-proposti tagħhom.
formal.en: During the group work, Mark bossed his classmates around and did not listen to their suggestions.
formal.zh: 小组合作时，马克对同学们发号施令，没有听取他们的建议。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex Lara ma tridx tilgħab ma' Mark? Nina: Għax ilbieraħ bbossja ħafna u ried jiddeċiedi kollox hu.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why doesn't Lara want to play with Mark? Nina: Because yesterday he was very bossy and wanted to decide everything himself.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：拉拉为什么不想和马克一起玩？妮娜：因为他昨天总是发号施令，什么都想自己决定。

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex Lara ma tridx tilgħab ma' Mark?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex Lara ma tridx tilgħab ma' Mark?
messages.zh: 拉拉为什么不想和马克一起玩？
messages.en: Why doesn't Lara want to play with Mark?

messages.speaker: Nina (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax ilbieraħ bbossja ħafna u ried jiddeċiedi kollox hu.
messages.mt_standard: Għax ilbieraħ bbossja ħafna u ried jiddeċiedi kollox hu.
messages.zh: 因为他昨天总是发号施令，什么都想自己决定。
messages.en: Because yesterday he was very bossy and wanted to decide everything himself.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象小组里有人不停说“都听我的”；把这种爱支使人的行为与词形一起记住，注意它表示行为。

gloss_zh: 说冒犯人的话；出言不逊

teaching_sense.en_definition: To make remarks that offend or insult other people.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 说出冒犯、侮辱或伤害别人感受的话。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jgħid kummenti li joffendu jew jinsultaw lil ħaddieħor.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 发表冒犯他人的言论，或说出侮辱人的话。

collocations.en: made offensive remarks during the meeting
collocations.zh: 在会议中出言冒犯他人

collocations.en: made offensive remarks about the neighbours

formal.mt: Matul id-diskussjoni, parteċipant bbottja dwar il-kollegi tiegħu, u l-moderatur talbu jitkellem b'rispett.
formal.en: During the discussion, a participant made offensive remarks about his colleagues, and the moderator asked him to speak respectfully.
formal.zh: 讨论过程中，一名参与者说了冒犯同事的话，主持人请他尊重他人。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex tlaqt minn ħdejn Mark? Lara: Għax bbottja dwar ħabibti, u ma għoġobnix dak li qal.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why did you walk away from Mark? Lara: Because he made offensive remarks about my friend, and I didn't like what he said.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你为什么从马克身边走开了？拉拉：因为他说了冒犯我朋友的话，我不喜欢他那样说。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你为什么从马克身边走开了？
messages.en: Why did you walk away from Mark?

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax bbottja dwar ħabibti, u ma għoġobnix dak li qal.
messages.mt_standard: Għax bbottja dwar ħabibti, u ma għoġobnix dak li qal.
messages.zh: 因为他说了冒犯我朋友的话，我不喜欢他那样说。
messages.en: Because he made offensive remarks about my friend, and I didn't like what he said.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一句伤人的话让交谈突然冷场；把“说话冒犯人”的场景贴在词卡上，突出言语行为。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To give or indicate a direction by using a compass.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 依据指南针的指示确定并指出方向。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jagħti jew jindika direzzjoni skont il-boxxla.

sense_translations.en_definition: to give or indicate the direction according to a compass
sense_translations.zh_definition: 根据指南针给出或指示方向。

collocations.en: gave the group directions using a compass
collocations.zh: 用指南针为团队指示方向

formal.mt: Qabel ma l-grupp beda l-mixja, il-gwida bboxxla lejn it-tramuntana u spjega r-rotta fuq il-mappa.
formal.en: Before the group began the walk, the guide indicated north using a compass and explained the route on the map.
formal.zh: 团队开始徒步前，向导用指南针指出北方，并在地图上讲解路线。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Fejn hi t-tramuntana? Mark: Stenna ftit, ħa nara l-boxxla. Maja: Bboxxla lejn it-tramuntana, imbagħad nurik il-mogħdija fuq il-mappa.
colloquial.en: Maja: Which way is north? Mark: Wait a moment, let me check the compass. Maja: Indicate north using the compass, then I'll show you the path on the map.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：北方在哪边？马克：等一下，我看看指南针。玛雅：用指南针指出北方，然后我在地图上给你看那条小路。

messages.speaker: Maja (徒步同伴)
messages.zh: 北方在哪边？
messages.en: Which way is north?

messages.speaker: Mark (徒步同伴)
messages.zh: 等一下，我看看指南针。
messages.en: Wait a moment, let me check the compass.

messages.speaker: Maja (徒步同伴)
messages.mt_spoken: Bboxxla lejn it-tramuntana, imbagħad nurik il-mogħdija fuq il-mappa.
messages.mt_standard: Bboxxla lejn it-tramuntana, imbagħad nurik il-mogħdija fuq il-mappa.
messages.zh: 用指南针指出北方，然后我在地图上给你看那条小路。
messages.en: Indicate north using the compass, then I'll show you the path on the map.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象先看指南针，再伸手指出北方的两个动作；整套动作帮助记住“依据指南针指方向”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To move a brush over something to clean, smooth, or arrange it.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用刷子刷过物体表面，以清洁、理顺或整理。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jgħaddi xkupilja fuq xi ħaġa biex inaddafha, iwittiha jew jirranġaha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 刷；用刷子清洁、刷理或整理。

formal.mt: Qabel il-laqgħa, Mark bbraxxja l-kowt biex ineħħi t-trab minn fuqu.
formal.en: Before the meeting, Mark brushed his coat to remove the dust from it.
formal.zh: 开会前，马克刷了刷外套，除去上面的灰尘。

colloquial.mt: Omm: Bbraxxja xagħrek qabel toħroġ. Mark: Tajjeb, fejn hi x-xkupilja?
colloquial.en: Mother: Brush your hair before you go out. Mark: Okay, where's the brush?
colloquial.zh: 妈妈：出门前用发刷梳一下头发。马克：好的，发刷在哪儿？

messages.speaker: Omm (母亲)
messages.zh: 出门前用发刷梳一下头发。
messages.en: Brush your hair before you go out.

messages.speaker: Mark (儿子)
messages.zh: 好的，发刷在哪儿？
messages.en: Okay, where's the brush?

cognitive_memory_aid: 用手模拟刷子来回刷的动作，同时读词；把刷头发、刷外套两个场景放在同一张词卡上。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To support or strengthen an iron part or structure with a brace.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用撑件支撑或加固铁制部件或结构，使其更加稳固。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Isaħħaħ jew isostni parti jew struttura tal-ħadid permezz ta' rinforz.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 对铁件进行支撑或加固。

formal.mt: Il-ħaddiem bbrazzja l-qafas tal-ħadid biex jibqa' stabbli taħt it-tagħbija.
formal.en: The worker braced the iron frame so that it would remain stable under the load.
formal.zh: 工人加固了铁框架，使其承重时保持稳定。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Dan il-qafas tal-ħadid għadu jiċċaqlaq. Pawlu: Bbrazzja l-qafas qabel tpoġġi xi piż fuqu.
colloquial.en: Mark: This iron frame is still moving. Pawlu: Brace the frame before putting any weight on it.
colloquial.zh: 马克：这个铁框架还在晃动。保罗：先把框架加固，再往上放重物。

messages.speaker: Mark (学徒)
messages.zh: 这个铁框架还在晃动。
messages.en: This iron frame is still moving.

messages.speaker: Pawlu (师傅)
messages.mt_spoken: Bbrazzja l-qafas qabel tpoġġi xi piż fuqu.
messages.mt_standard: Bbrazzja l-qafas qabel tpoġġi xi piż fuqu.
messages.zh: 先把框架加固，再往上放重物。
messages.en: Brace the frame before putting any weight on it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 画一个会晃动的铁框架，再加上一根斜撑；用“加撑以后更稳”的画面记住加固铁件的意思。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To use the brakes to slow down or stop a vehicle.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使用刹车使车辆减速或停止。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Juża l-brejkijiet biex inaqqas il-veloċità ta' vettura jew iwaqqafha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 刹车，使用制动装置减速或停车。

formal.mt: Is-sewwieq bbrejkja bil-mod u waqqaf il-vettura qabel il-linja bajda.
formal.en: The driver braked gently and stopped the vehicle before the white line.
formal.zh: 司机轻缓地刹车，把车辆停在白线前。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex bbrejkjajt f'daqqa? Mark: Għax qattus qasam it-triq quddiemi.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why did you brake suddenly? Mark: Because a cat crossed the road in front of me.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你为什么突然刹车？马克：因为一只猫从我前面横穿马路。

messages.speaker: Maja (乘客)
messages.zh: 你为什么突然刹车？
messages.en: Why did you brake suddenly?

messages.speaker: Mark (司机)
messages.zh: 因为一只猫从我前面横穿马路。
messages.en: Because a cat crossed the road in front of me.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象脚踩刹车后车速下降，最后停在白线前；把“踩刹车—减速—停下”的动作连起来记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To shine brightly or to stand out because of an impressive quality or performance.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 发出明亮的光；也指因品质或表现出色而引人注目。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tagħti dawl qawwi jew tispikka minħabba kwalità jew prestazzjoni eċċellenti.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 闪耀，发光；表现突出，出类拔萃。

formal.mt: L-istudent bbrilla fil-kompetizzjoni grazzi għall-preżentazzjoni ċara u oriġinali tiegħu.
formal.en: The student stood out in the competition thanks to his clear and original presentation.
formal.zh: 这名学生凭借清晰且有创意的展示，在比赛中表现出众。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Kif mar ħuk fil-kunċert? Mark: Bbrilla! Kulħadd ċapċap wara li kanta.
colloquial.en: Sara: How did your brother do at the concert? Mark: He shone! Everyone applauded after he sang.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：你哥哥在音乐会上表现怎么样？马克：他表现太出色了！他唱完后，大家都鼓掌了。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 你哥哥在音乐会上表现怎么样？
messages.en: How did your brother do at the concert?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Bbrilla! Kulħadd ċapċap wara li kanta.
messages.mt_standard: Bbrilla! Kulħadd ċapċap wara li kanta.
messages.zh: 他表现太出色了！他唱完后，大家都鼓掌了。
messages.en: He shone! Everyone applauded after he sang.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把物体闪光与人物出彩连成一幅图：宝石在阳光下闪耀，优秀表演也让人眼前一亮。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To raise a drink and express good wishes in someone's honour or to celebrate an occasion.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 为向某人致意或庆祝某个场合而举杯，并表达祝愿。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tgħolli t-tazza u tesprimi xewqat tajba f'ġieħ xi ħadd jew biex tiċċelebra okkażjoni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 祝酒；举杯向某人致意或表达庆祝和祝愿。

collocations.en: made a toast to the guests' health
made a toast to the team's success
collocations.zh: 为团队的成功举杯祝酒

formal.mt: Fi tmiem l-ikla, id-direttur bbrinda għas-suċċess tat-tim u rringrazzja lill-ħaddiema kollha.
formal.en: At the end of the meal, the director made a toast to the team's success and thanked all the employees.
formal.zh: 用餐结束时，主管为团队的成功举杯祝酒，并感谢了全体员工。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għal min bbrinda Pawlu? Nina: Bbrinda għas-saħħa tan-nanna, għax illum għeluq sninha.
colloquial.en: Lara: Who did Pawlu make a toast to? Nina: He made a toast to Grandma's health because it's her birthday today.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：保罗刚才为谁祝酒？妮娜：他举杯祝奶奶身体健康，因为今天是她的生日。

messages.speaker: Lara (孙女)
messages.zh: 保罗刚才为谁祝酒？
messages.en: Who did Pawlu make a toast to?

messages.speaker: Nina (孙女)
messages.mt_spoken: Bbrinda għas-saħħa tan-nanna, għax illum għeluq sninha.
messages.mt_standard: Bbrinda għas-saħħa tan-nanna, għax illum għeluq sninha.
messages.zh: 他举杯祝奶奶身体健康，因为今天是她的生日。
messages.en: He made a toast to Grandma's health because it's her birthday today.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记住生日聚餐中的动作顺序：举杯、说祝福、大家回应；整个祝酒动作就是这个词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To connect two sides of a gap, valley, or waterway by means of a bridge.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 通过架设桥梁，把间隔、山谷或水道的两侧连接起来。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tgħaqqad żewġ naħat ta' vojt, wied jew passaġġ tal-ilma permezz ta' pont.

sense_translations.en_definition: to bridge (to connect with a bridge)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 架桥；用桥把两侧连接起来。

formal.mt: Il-kuntrattur bbriġġja l-wied biex jgħaqqad iż-żewġ irħula.
formal.en: The contractor bridged the valley to connect the two villages.
formal.zh: 承包商在山谷上架桥，把两个村庄连接起来。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Kif għaqqdu ż-żewġ naħat tal-wied? Toni: Il-kuntrattur bbriġġja l-wied, u issa nistgħu naqsmu bil-mixi.
colloquial.en: Maja: How did they connect the two sides of the valley? Toni: The contractor bridged the valley, and now we can cross on foot.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：他们是怎么把山谷两侧连起来的？托尼：承包商在山谷上架了桥，现在我们可以步行过去了。

messages.speaker: Maja (居民)
messages.zh: 他们是怎么把山谷两侧连起来的？
messages.en: How did they connect the two sides of the valley?

messages.speaker: Toni (邻居)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-kuntrattur bbriġġja l-wied, u issa nistgħu naqsmu bil-mixi.
messages.mt_standard: Il-kuntrattur bbriġġja l-wied, u issa nistgħu naqsmu bil-mixi.
messages.zh: 承包商在山谷上架了桥，现在我们可以步行过去了。
messages.en: The contractor bridged the valley, and now we can cross on foot.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象山谷两边原本不通，中间架起一座桥；把这个动作与“架桥连接”一起记。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To give an object a bronze coating or a bronze-coloured finish.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 给物体覆上青铜层，或使其表面呈现青铜色。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tik  si oġġett bil-bronż jew tagħtih finitura b'lewn il-bronż.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 给物体镀上青铜，或使其呈青铜色。

collocations.en: gave the statue a bronze finish
collocations.zh: 给雕像做青铜色表面处理

collocations.en: gave the frame a bronze finish
collocations.zh: 给框架做青铜色表面处理

formal.mt: L-artist bbronża l-istatwa biex jagħtiha dehra metallika.
formal.en: The artist gave the statue a bronze finish to give it a metallic appearance.
formal.zh: 艺术家给雕像做了青铜色表面处理，使其呈现金属质感。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Dan il-qafas dejjem kien b'dan il-kulur? Toni: Le, missieri bbronża l-qafas ilbieraħ.
colloquial.en: Maja: Was this frame always this colour? Toni: No, my father gave the frame a bronze finish yesterday.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这个框一直是这种颜色吗？托尼：不是，我爸爸昨天给这个框做了青铜色表面处理。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Dan il-qafas dejjem kien b'dan il-kulur?
messages.mt_standard: Dan il-qafas dejjem kien b'dan il-kulur?
messages.zh: 这个框一直是这种颜色吗？
messages.en: Was this frame always this colour?

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.zh: 不是，我爸爸昨天给这个框做了青铜色表面处理。
messages.en: No, my father gave the frame a bronze finish yesterday.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一个普通画框经过表面处理，变成青铜色；用处理前后的颜色变化记住这个动作。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To behave in a deliberately silly or clownish way, often to make other people laugh.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 故意做出滑稽或傻乎乎的举动，常用于逗别人发笑。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Iġġib ruħek b'mod iblah jew bħal buffu, spiss biex iddaħħaq lil ħaddieħor.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 耍宝，装傻逗乐；做出滑稽可笑的举动。

collocations.en: played the fool in front of his friends
played the fool during the lesson

formal.mt: L-istudent bbuffunja waqt il-lezzjoni u fixkel lill-bqija tal-klassi.
formal.en: The student played the fool during the lesson and disrupted the rest of the class.
formal.zh: 这名学生上课时耍宝，干扰了班上其他同学。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għaliex kulħadd daħak waqt l-ikla? Mark: Pawlu bbuffunja u għamel wiċċ tad-daħk.
colloquial.en: Sara: Why did everyone laugh during the meal? Mark: Pawlu played the fool and made a funny face.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：吃饭时大家为什么都笑了？马克：保罗在耍宝，做了个鬼脸。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 吃饭时大家为什么都笑了？
messages.en: Why did everyone laugh during the meal?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Pawlu bbuffunja u għamel wiċċ tad-daħk.
messages.mt_standard: Pawlu bbuffunja u għamel wiċċ tad-daħk.
messages.zh: 保罗在耍宝，做了个鬼脸。
messages.en: Pawlu played the fool and made a funny face.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象朋友故意做鬼脸逗大家笑，把“装傻、耍宝、引人发笑”三个画面连起来记。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To arrange in advance for a room, seat, service, or appointment to be reserved.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 事先安排保留房间、座位、服务或会面时段。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tirriżerva minn qabel kamra, post, servizz jew appuntament.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 预订，预约；事先保留房间、座位或服务等。

formal.mt: Il-klijent bbukkja kamra għal żewġt iljieli u talab konferma bil-miktub.
formal.en: The customer booked a room for two nights and requested written confirmation.
formal.zh: 顾客预订了两晚的客房，并要求提供书面确认。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għandna mejda għal-lejla? Mark: Iva, Pawlu bbukkja mejda għal tnejn fit-tmienja.
colloquial.en: Lara: Do we have a table for tonight? Mark: Yes, Pawlu reserved a table for two at eight.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：我们今晚订好餐桌了吗？马克：订好了，保罗预订了八点的一张双人餐桌。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 我们今晚订好餐桌了吗？
messages.en: Do we have a table for tonight?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, Pawlu bbukkja mejda għal tnejn fit-tmienja.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, Pawlu bbukkja mejda għal tnejn fit-tmienja.
messages.zh: 订好了，保罗预订了八点的一张双人餐桌。
messages.en: Yes, Pawlu reserved a table for two at eight.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记住订位的三个信息：订什么、给几个人、几点使用；把这个词放进自己的订餐情景里练习。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To intimidate, hurt, or humiliate someone through an abuse of power, often repeatedly.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 利用力量或地位上的优势恐吓、伤害或羞辱他人，常带有反复性。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tbeżża', tweġġa' jew tumilja lil xi ħadd billi tabbuża mis-saħħa jew mill-poter tiegħek, spiss ripetutament.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 欺凌，霸凌；利用优势恐吓、伤害或羞辱他人。

collocations.zh: 欺凌了自己的同班同学

formal.mt: Skont ir-rapport, l-istudent bbulja lil sieħbu tal-klassi diversi drabi matul ix-xahar.
formal.en: According to the report, the student bullied his classmate several times during the month.
formal.zh: 报告指出，这名学生在该月内多次欺凌自己的同班同学。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Għaliex Toni ma jridx jidħol fil-klassi? Sara: Tifel bbulja lil Toni lbieraħ. Se nitkellmu mal-għalliema.
colloquial.en: Nina: Why doesn't Toni want to go into the classroom? Sara: A boy bullied Toni yesterday. We're going to talk to the teacher.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：托尼为什么不想进教室？萨拉：昨天有个男孩欺凌了托尼。我们要去和老师谈谈。

messages.speaker: Nina (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex Toni ma jridx jidħol fil-klassi?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex Toni ma jridx jidħol fil-klassi?
messages.zh: 托尼为什么不想进教室？
messages.en: Why doesn't Toni want to go into the classroom?

messages.speaker: Sara (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Tifel bbulja lil Toni lbieraħ. Se nitkellmu mal-għalliema.
messages.mt_standard: Tifel bbulja lil Toni lbieraħ. Se nitkellmu mal-għalliema.
messages.zh: 昨天有个男孩欺凌了托尼。我们要去和老师谈谈。
messages.en: A boy bullied Toni yesterday. We're going to talk to the teacher.
