cognitive_memory_aid: 用“仗着优势欺负别人”的情景记忆：有人受到恐吓或羞辱时，就能联想到这个词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To attack a place with bombs or artillery shells.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使用炸弹或炮弹攻击某个地点。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tattakka post bil-bombi jew bil-qxur tal-artillerija.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 轰炸，连续轰击；用炮弹炮击。

formal.mt: Fir-rumanz, l-għadu bbumbardja l-port matul il-lejl u għamel ħsara kbira lill-imħażen.
formal.en: In the novel, the enemy bombarded the harbour during the night and caused extensive damage to the warehouses.
formal.zh: 小说中，敌军在夜间轰击了港口，造成仓库严重损毁。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'ġara lill-port f'dan il-kapitlu? Toni: L-għadu bbumbardja l-port billejl, u n-nies ħarbu.
colloquial.en: Maja: What happened to the harbour in this chapter? Toni: The enemy bombarded the harbour at night, and the people fled.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这一章里港口发生了什么事？托尼：敌军在夜间轰击了港口，人们逃走了。

messages.speaker: Maja (读书会成员)
messages.zh: 这一章里港口发生了什么事？
messages.en: What happened to the harbour in this chapter?

messages.speaker: Toni (读书会成员)
messages.mt_spoken: L-għadu bbumbardja l-port billejl, u n-nies ħarbu.
messages.mt_standard: L-għadu bbumbardja l-port billejl, u n-nies ħarbu.
messages.zh: 敌军在夜间轰击了港口，人们逃走了。
messages.en: The enemy bombarded the harbour at night, and the people fled.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把阅读中的港口遇袭画面与“轰炸、轰击、炮击”并列记忆，抓住使用炸弹或炮弹攻击的共同意思。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To enjoy oneself freely and enthusiastically, especially at a lively celebration.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 尽情享乐、欢乐，尤指在热闹的庆祝活动中玩得十分尽兴。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jiddeverti ħafna u jieħu gost, speċjalment waqt festa jew ċelebrazzjoni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 狂欢；尽情欢乐；玩得尽兴

formal.mt: Wara ċ-ċerimonja, il-grupp bburdella sal-lejl biex jiċċelebra s-suċċess tiegħu.
formal.en: After the ceremony, the group revelled until nightfall to celebrate its success.
formal.zh: 仪式结束后，一行人尽情欢乐直到夜晚，庆祝他们取得的成功。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Kif marret il-festa lbieraħ? Mark: Tajjeb ħafna! Pawlu bburdella mal-ħbieb sal-aħħar.
colloquial.en: Maja: How was the party yesterday? Mark: Really good! Pawlu had a great time with his friends right until the end.
colloquial.zh: Maja：昨天的聚会怎么样？Mark：特别好！Pawlu和朋友们一直玩到最后，十分尽兴。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 昨天的聚会怎么样？
messages.en: How was the party yesterday?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Tajjeb ħafna! Pawlu bburdella mal-ħbieb sal-aħħar.
messages.mt_standard: Tajjeb ħafna! Pawlu bburdella mal-ħbieb sal-aħħar.
messages.zh: 特别好！Pawlu和朋友们一直玩到最后，十分尽兴。
messages.en: Really good! Pawlu had a great time with his friends right until the end.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把这个词配上庆功聚会的画面：大家开怀欢乐，一直玩到最后，用场景记住“尽情享乐”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To make a booing sound to express disapproval of a person, performance, or decision.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 通过发出嘘声表达对某人、表演或决定的不满。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jagħmel ħoss ta' diżapprovazzjoni lejn persuna, wirja jew deċiżjoni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 发出嘘声；喝倒彩，以表示不满或反对

formal.mt: Wara li tħabbar ir-riżultat, parti mill-pubbliku bbuwja d-deċiżjoni tal-ġurija.
formal.en: After the result was announced, part of the audience booed the jury's decision.
formal.zh: 结果公布后，部分观众对评审团的决定发出了嘘声。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex dak ir-raġel bbuwja lill-kantant? Toni: Ma għoġbitux il-wirja, imma jien ħadt gost.
colloquial.en: Lara: Why did that man boo the singer? Toni: He didn't like the performance, but I enjoyed it.
colloquial.zh: Lara：那个男人为什么向歌手喝倒彩？Toni：他不喜欢这场表演，不过我看得很开心。

messages.speaker: Lara (观众)
messages.zh: 那个男人为什么向歌手喝倒彩？
messages.en: Why did that man boo the singer?

messages.speaker: Toni (同行朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ma għoġbitux il-wirja, imma jien ħadt gost.
messages.mt_standard: Ma għoġbitux il-wirja, imma jien ħadt gost.
messages.zh: 他不喜欢这场表演，不过我看得很开心。
messages.en: He didn't like the performance, but I enjoyed it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象观众朝舞台发出“嘘——”声，把这个词与“用声音表达不满”的动作一起记住。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A change, or the act of replacing or exchanging one thing with another.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 某种改变，或将一物替换、调换为另一物的行为。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Bidla, jew l-att li ħaġa titqiegħed minflok oħra jew tiġi skambjata magħha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 改变；变更
调换；互换
交换；以一物换另一物

formal.mt: L-organizzaturi ħabbru bdil fil-programm u bagħtu l-ħinijiet il-ġodda lill-parteċipanti.
formal.en: The organisers announced a change to the programme and sent the new times to the participants.
formal.zh: 组织者宣布活动安排有所变更，并将新的时间通知了参与者。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Nagħmlu bdil tal-postijiet? Minn hawn ma narax sew. Mark: Iva, ejja oqgħod hawn u jien noqgħod hemm.
colloquial.en: Maja: Shall we swap places? I can't see well from here. Mark: Yes, come and sit here, and I'll sit there.
colloquial.zh: Maja：我们换个位置好吗？我从这里看不清。Mark：好，你过来坐这里，我坐那边。

messages.speaker: Maja (观众)
messages.mt_spoken: Nagħmlu bdil tal-postijiet? Minn hawn ma narax sew.
messages.mt_standard: Nagħmlu bdil tal-postijiet? Minn hawn ma narax sew.
messages.zh: 我们换个位置好吗？我从这里看不清。
messages.en: Shall we swap places? I can't see well from here.

messages.speaker: Mark (同行朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, ejja oqgħod hawn u jien noqgħod hemm.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, ejja oqgħod hawn u jien noqgħod hemm.
messages.zh: 好，你过来坐这里，我坐那边。
messages.en: Yes, come and sit here, and I'll sit there.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“换”串起三个义项：换安排是变更，换座位是调换，拿书换书是交换；注意这个词是名词。

gloss_zh: 幸福安详的；显露至福的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Showing deep, serene happiness or heavenly bliss, especially in a face or expression.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 表现出深切、宁静的幸福或天国般至福的，常用于描述面容或神情。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li juri hena profond u seren, bħal hena tas-sema, speċjalment fil-wiċċ jew fl-espressjoni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 幸福安详的；显露宁静喜悦或天国般至福的

formal.mt: Il-pittura turi raġel b'wiċċ beatifiku u b'għajnejh magħluqa fit-talb.
formal.en: The painting depicts a man with a beatific face and his eyes closed in prayer.
formal.zh: 这幅画描绘了一名男子，他面容幸福安详，闭着双眼祈祷。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Ara lil Ninu fir-ritratt, b'dak il-wiċċ beatifiku! Toni: Iva, kien għadu kif sema' l-aħbar it-tajba.
colloquial.en: Lara: Look at Ninu in the photo, with that beatific face! Toni: Yes, he had just heard the good news.
colloquial.zh: Lara：看看照片里的Ninu，那副幸福安详的表情！Toni：是啊，他那时刚听到好消息。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ara lil Ninu fir-ritratt, b'dak il-wiċċ beatifiku!
messages.mt_standard: Ara lil Ninu fir-ritratt, b'dak il-wiċċ beatifiku!
messages.zh: 看看照片里的Ninu，那副幸福安详的表情！
messages.en: Look at Ninu in the photo, with that beatific face!

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, kien għadu kif sema' l-aħbar it-tajba.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, kien għadu kif sema' l-aħbar it-tajba.
messages.zh: 是啊，他那时刚听到好消息。
messages.en: Yes, he had just heard the good news.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一个听到好消息后安静微笑的人：幸福写在脸上，神情平和，用这张脸记住这个形容词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A state of supreme happiness or blessedness, especially heavenly or spiritual bliss.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 极度幸福、蒙福的状态，尤指天国或精神层面的至福。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Stat ta' hena sħiħ u profond, speċjalment hena spiritwali jew tas-sema.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 至福；极乐；尤指精神上或天国中的圆满幸福

formal.mt: Fit-test reliġjuż, il-beatitudni eterna hija deskritta bħala hena sħiħ fil-preżenza ta' Alla.
formal.en: In the religious text, eternal beatitude is described as complete happiness in the presence of God.
formal.zh: 在这篇宗教文本中，永恒的至福被描述为与上帝同在时的圆满幸福。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Kif tħossok hawn ħdejn il-baħar? Sam: Fi stat ta' beatitudni! Il-kwiet u l-ħoss tal-mewġ huma kulma għandi bżonn.
colloquial.en: Nina: How do you feel here by the sea? Sam: In a state of bliss! The peace and the sound of the waves are all I need.
colloquial.zh: Nina：在海边这里，你感觉怎么样？Sam：简直幸福极了！有这份宁静和海浪声，我就满足了。

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.zh: 在海边这里，你感觉怎么样？
messages.en: How do you feel here by the sea?

messages.speaker: Sam (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Fi stat ta' beatitudni! Il-kwiet u l-ħoss tal-mewġ huma kulma għandi bżonn.
messages.mt_standard: Fi stat ta' beatitudni! Il-kwiet u l-ħoss tal-mewġ huma kulma għandi bżonn.
messages.zh: 简直幸福极了！有这份宁静和海浪声，我就满足了。
messages.en: In a state of bliss! The peace and the sound of the waves are all I need.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把“至福”想成内心充满宁静幸福的一种状态；用“处于至福之中”记住它是表示状态的名词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The main page of a website, from which visitors can access its principal sections.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 网站的主要页面，访问者可从这里进入网站的各个主要栏目。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-paġna ewlenija ta' sit elettroniku, minn fejn wieħed jista' jidħol fit-taqsimiet prinċipali tiegħu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 网站的首页；网站主页

collocations.en: a link to the home page
go back to the home page

formal.mt: Il-bedu tas-sit jinkludi l-aħħar aħbarijiet, il-ħinijiet tal-ftuħ u ħolqa għall-formola ta' kuntatt.
formal.en: The website's home page includes the latest news, opening hours, and a link to the contact form.
formal.zh: 网站首页包含最新消息、开放时间，以及联系表单的链接。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Fejn insib il-ħinijiet tal-ftuħ fuq is-sit? Toni: Mur fil-bedu; hemm ħolqa bit-titlu 'Ħinijiet'.
colloquial.en: Lara: Where can I find the opening hours on the website? Toni: Go to the home page; there's a link called 'Hours'.
colloquial.zh: Lara：网站上的开放时间在哪里看？Toni：到首页去，那里有个叫“开放时间”的链接。

messages.speaker: Lara (网站访客)
messages.mt_spoken: Fejn insib il-ħinijiet tal-ftuħ fuq is-sit?
messages.mt_standard: Fejn insib il-ħinijiet tal-ftuħ fuq is-sit?
messages.zh: 网站上的开放时间在哪里看？
messages.en: Where can I find the opening hours on the website?

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.zh: 到首页去，那里有个叫“开放时间”的链接。
messages.en: Go to the home page; there's a link called 'Hours'.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把网站首页想成大楼的入口大厅：先到这里，再沿链接进入各个栏目，用“网站入口页”记住这个词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The thumb: the short, thick digit at the side of the hand.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 拇指，位于手掌一侧、较短而粗的手指。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Is-saba' l-kbir li jinsab fuq il-ġenb tal-id.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 拇指；大拇指。

collocations.en: the thumb of the right hand

formal.mt: Il-pazjent irrapporta uġigħ fil-behem tal-id il-leminija wara li waqa'.
formal.en: The patient reported pain in the thumb of his right hand after a fall.
formal.zh: 患者报告称，跌倒后右手拇指疼痛。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex ma tistax tiftaħ il-vażett? Mark: Għax weġġajt il-behem u ma nistax naqbad sew.
colloquial.en: Lara: Why can't you open the jar? Mark: Because I hurt my thumb and can't get a good grip.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：你为什么打不开罐子？马克：因为我伤了拇指，抓不牢。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 你为什么打不开罐子？
messages.en: Why can't you open the jar?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax weġġajt il-behem u ma nistax naqbad sew.
messages.mt_standard: Għax weġġajt il-behem u ma nistax naqbad sew.
messages.zh: 因为我伤了拇指，抓不牢。
messages.en: Because I hurt my thumb and can't get a good grip.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记忆时想象拇指顶住罐盖：把 behem 和拧盖时用力的大拇指联系起来。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who carries messages or helps communication between two people or groups.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在两个人或两个群体之间传递消息、帮助双方沟通的中间人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li twassal messaġġi jew tgħin fil-komunikazzjoni bejn żewġ persuni jew gruppi.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 中间人；替双方传话或居间联络的人。

collocations.en: a go-between for the two sides

formal.mt: Il-kumitat ħatar lil Mark bħala bejjien biex iwassal il-proposti minn naħa għall-oħra.
formal.en: The committee appointed Mark as a go-between to convey proposals from one side to the other.
formal.zh: 委员会指定马克担任中间人，负责在双方之间传递提议。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Tista' tkun il-bejjien bejnietna u twassallu l-messaġġ? Mark: Iva, inwassallu dak li għedt u mbagħad ngħidlek x'wieġeb.
colloquial.en: Anna: Can you be the go-between for us and pass him the message? Mark: Yes, I'll tell him what you said and then let you know his reply.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：你能做我们之间的联络人，把话传给他吗？马克：可以，我会转告你的话，再告诉你他怎么回答。

messages.speaker: Anna (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Tista' tkun il-bejjien bejnietna u twassallu l-messaġġ?
messages.mt_standard: Tista' tkun il-bejjien bejnietna u twassallu l-messaġġ?
messages.zh: 你能做我们之间的联络人，把话传给他吗？
messages.en: Can you be the go-between for us and pass him the message?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, inwassallu dak li għedt u mbagħad ngħidlek x'wieġeb.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, inwassallu dak li għedt u mbagħad ngħidlek x'wieġeb.
messages.zh: 可以，我会转告你的话，再告诉你他怎么回答。
messages.en: Yes, I'll tell him what you said and then let you know his reply.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象两个人中间站着一位传话者：bejjien 指这位居间联络的人。

gloss_zh: 中间的；介于两极之间的；一般水平的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Intermediate or between extremes; also average in level or quality.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 处于中间阶段或两个极端之间的；也可指水平或质量一般的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jinsab f'livell intermedju jew bejn żewġ estremi; jista' wkoll jindika livell jew kwalità medja.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 中间阶段的；中级的。
介于两个极端之间的；居中的。
一般水平的；中等的。

collocations.en: a middle point between two extremes
collocations.zh: 两个极端之间的中间点

formal.mt: Il-kors huwa maħsub għal studenti f'livell bejjieni, li diġà jafu l-elementi bażiċi iżda għadhom mhumiex f'livell avvanzat.
formal.en: The course is intended for students at an intermediate level who already know the basics but are not yet advanced.
formal.zh: 本课程面向中级学生：他们已掌握基础知识，但尚未达到高级水平。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għandi nagħżel il-kors għall-bidu jew dak avvanzat? Toni: Agħżel kors ta' livell bejjieni; taf il-bażi, imma għad għandek bżonn il-prattika.
colloquial.en: Sara: Should I choose the beginner course or the advanced one? Toni: Choose an intermediate course; you know the basics, but you still need practice.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：我该选入门课还是高级课？托尼：选中级课吧；你知道基础知识，但还需要练习。

messages.speaker: Sara (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandi nagħżel il-kors għall-bidu jew dak avvanzat?
messages.mt_standard: Għandi nagħżel il-kors għall-bidu jew dak avvanzat?
messages.zh: 我该选入门课还是高级课？
messages.en: Should I choose the beginner course or the advanced one?

messages.speaker: Toni (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Agħżel kors ta' livell bejjieni; taf il-bażi, imma għad għandek bżonn il-prattika.
messages.mt_standard: Agħżel kors ta' livell bejjieni; taf il-bażi, imma għad għandek bżonn il-prattika.
messages.zh: 选中级课吧；你知道基础知识，但还需要练习。
messages.en: Choose an intermediate course; you know the basics, but you still need practice.

cognitive_memory_aid: 画一条从低到高的刻度，把 bejjieni 放在中段：可记中级、两极之间和一般水平。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Interposition: the act of placing something between other things, or its position between them.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 将某物置于其他事物之间的行为，或某物介于其间的状态。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att li titqiegħed xi ħaġa bejn affarijiet oħra, jew il-pożizzjoni tagħha bejniethom.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 插入；置于其间；介于其间的状态。

collocations.mt: il-bejjina ta' oġġett bejn tnejn oħra
collocations.en: the interposition of an object between two others
collocations.zh: 将一个物体置于另外两个物体之间

formal.mt: Id-dijagramma turi l-bejjina ta' saff irqiq bejn żewġ pjanċi, biex il-pjanċi ma jmissux ma' xulxin.
formal.en: The diagram shows the interposition of a thin layer between two plates so that the plates do not touch each other.
formal.zh: 图中展示了在两块板之间置入薄层的情况，使两块板不相互接触。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Kif nista' niftakar il-kelma 'bejjina'? Pawlu: Immaġina karta bejn żewġ kotba; il-karta qiegħda bejniethom.
colloquial.en: Maja: How can I remember the word 'bejjina'? Pawlu: Imagine a sheet of paper between two books; the paper is positioned between them.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：我怎样才能记住 bejjina 这个词？保罗：想象两本书之间放着一张纸；纸就处于它们之间。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.zh: 我怎样才能记住 bejjina 这个词？
messages.en: How can I remember the word 'bejjina'?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Immaġina karta bejn żewġ kotba; il-karta qiegħda bejniethom.
messages.mt_standard: Immaġina karta bejn żewġ kotba; il-karta qiegħda bejniethom.
messages.zh: 想象两本书之间放着一张纸；纸就处于它们之间。
messages.en: Imagine a sheet of paper between two books; the paper is positioned between them.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“两本书夹一张纸”的画面记 bejjina：重点是把东西放入中间这一行为或状态。

gloss_zh: 犹豫不决的；拿不定主意的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Undecided or irresolute, especially when unable to choose between alternatives.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 尚未作出决定、拿不定主意的，尤其指面对不同选择时犹豫不决。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għadu ma ddeċidiex jew li ma jistax jagħżel bejn għażliet differenti.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 犹豫不决的；缺乏决断、拿不定主意的。

collocations.zh: 对这份提议拿不定主意

formal.mt: Wara li qara ż-żewġ proposti, id-direttur baqa' bejn ħalltejn u talab aktar informazzjoni qabel jiddeċiedi.
formal.en: After reading both proposals, the director remained undecided and requested more information before making a decision.
formal.zh: 读完两份提案后，主管仍拿不定主意，要求获得更多信息后再作决定。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Se taċċetta l-offerta tax-xogħol? Mark: Għadni bejn ħalltejn; il-paga hija aħjar, imma l-post huwa 'l bogħod.
colloquial.en: Lara: Are you going to accept the job offer? Mark: I'm still undecided; the pay is better, but the workplace is far away.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：你会接受这份工作邀请吗？马克：我还拿不定主意；工资更高，但工作地点很远。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 你会接受这份工作邀请吗？
messages.en: Are you going to accept the job offer?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għadni bejn ħalltejn; il-paga hija aħjar, imma l-post huwa 'l bogħod.
messages.mt_standard: Għadni bejn ħalltejn; il-paga hija aħjar, imma l-post huwa 'l bogħod.
messages.zh: 我还拿不定主意；工资更高，但工作地点很远。
messages.en: I'm still undecided; the pay is better, but the workplace is far away.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把整句想成站在两张选择卡之间迟迟不动：bejn ħalltejn 表示拿不定主意，宜整块记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To drink, especially alcoholic drink; also to indulge in excessive drinking.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 饮用，尤其指饮酒；也指纵酒或过量饮酒，具体轻重由语境决定。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li wieħed jixrob, speċjalment xorb alkoħoliku; jista' wkoll ifisser li jixrob iżżejjed.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 饮用；饮酒。
纵酒；沉溺于过量饮酒。

formal.mt: Matul il-festa, ir-raġel bekbek iżżejjed u ħabibu wasslu d-dar.
formal.en: During the celebration, the man drank excessively and his friend took him home.
formal.zh: 庆祝活动期间，这名男子饮酒过量，朋友把他送回了家。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Għaliex Toni telaq daqshekk kmieni? Mark: Bekbek iżżejjed waqt il-festa, u ħuh ħadu d-dar.
colloquial.en: Anna: Why did Toni leave so early? Mark: He drank too much at the party, and his brother took him home.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：托尼为什么那么早就走了？马克：他在聚会上喝多了，他兄弟把他接回家了。

messages.speaker: Anna (朋友)
messages.zh: 托尼为什么那么早就走了？
messages.en: Why did Toni leave so early?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Bekbek iżżejjed waqt il-festa, u ħuh ħadu d-dar.
messages.mt_standard: Bekbek iżżejjed waqt il-festa, u ħuh ħadu d-dar.
messages.zh: 他在聚会上喝多了，他兄弟把他接回家了。
messages.en: He drank too much at the party, and his brother took him home.

cognitive_memory_aid: 看着 bekbek 的重复字形，想象接连举杯的动作；这是记忆画面，词义要区分饮酒与过量饮酒。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who drinks, particularly alcohol; in the stronger sense, someone who guzzles or drinks excessively.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 饮酒的人；较强的意思指大口豪饮或饮酒过量的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li tixrob, speċjalment xorb alkoħoliku; fis-sens aktar qawwi, persuna li tixrob bil-kotra jew iżżejjed.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 豪饮者；大口猛喝或喝得很多的人。
饮酒者；喝酒的人。

formal.mt: Fil-kitba, il-kelma 'bekbiek' tista' tindika persuna li tixrob, iżda l-kuntest jista' jagħtiha wkoll is-sens ta' persuna li tixrob iżżejjed.
formal.en: In writing, the word 'bekbiek' can denote a drinker, but the context can also give it the sense of someone who drinks excessively.
formal.zh: 在书面语中，bekbiek 可以指饮酒者，但语境也可能使它带有饮酒过量者的意思。

colloquial.mt: Maja: 'Bekbiek' bilfors ifisser xi ħadd li jixrob iżżejjed? Pawlu: Mhux bilfors; jista' jfisser ukoll persuna li tixrob. Ara l-kuntest.
colloquial.en: Maja: Does 'bekbiek' necessarily mean someone who drinks too much? Pawlu: Not necessarily; it can also mean a drinker. Look at the context.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：bekbiek 一定指喝酒过量的人吗？保罗：不一定；它也可以指饮酒者。要看语境。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: 'Bekbiek' bilfors ifisser xi ħadd li jixrob iżżejjed?
messages.mt_standard: 'Bekbiek' bilfors ifisser xi ħadd li jixrob iżżejjed?
messages.zh: bekbiek 一定指喝酒过量的人吗？
messages.en: Does 'bekbiek' necessarily mean someone who drinks too much?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Mhux bilfors; jista' jfisser ukoll persuna li tixrob. Ara l-kuntest.
messages.mt_standard: Mhux bilfors; jista' jfisser ukoll persuna li tixrob. Ara l-kuntest.
messages.zh: 不一定；它也可以指饮酒者。要看语境。
messages.en: Not necessarily; it can also mean a drinker. Look at the context.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 bekbiek 配一张举杯者的人物卡，记住它指“人”；再用语境区分普通饮酒者与豪饮者。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Describing someone who drinks alcohol, especially someone who drinks excessively.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容爱喝酒的人，尤其指饮酒过量、嗜酒的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jiddeskrivi lil xi ħadd li jħobb jixrob l-alkoħol, speċjalment jekk jixrob iżżejjed.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 喝酒的；爱喝酒的，用来形容饮酒者。

sense_translations.en_definition: an alcoholic (traditionally, one who over-indulges with wine)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 酗酒的；嗜酒的，传统上尤指过量饮用葡萄酒的人。

formal.mt: Fir-rakkont, ir-raġel bekbieki jonfoq ħafna flus fuq l-inbid.
formal.en: In the story, the heavy-drinking man spends a lot of money on wine.
formal.zh: 在这个故事里，那个嗜酒的男人花很多钱买葡萄酒。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Il-karattru f'dan il-ktieb huwa bekbieki? Mark: Iva, jixrob ħafna nbid kuljum.
colloquial.en: Maja: Is the character in this book a heavy drinker? Mark: Yes, he drinks a lot of wine every day.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这本书里的那个人物嗜酒吗？马克：是的，他每天都喝很多葡萄酒。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 这本书里的那个人物嗜酒吗？
messages.en: Is the character in this book a heavy drinker?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 是的，他每天都喝很多葡萄酒。
messages.en: Yes, he drinks a lot of wine every day.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把它放进“嗜酒的男人”这一人物描写中记忆：重点是形容人的饮酒习惯，程度较重时可译为“酗酒的”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of drinking greedily or in large, rapid gulps.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 贪饮或连续大口猛喝的行为。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att li wieħed jixrob bil-għaġla u b'ħafna għafsiet kbar.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 豪饮；咕咚咕咚地大口猛喝。

formal.mt: L-awtur juża l-kelma 'bekbik' biex jiddeskrivi kif il-karattru jixrob il-birra bil-għaġla.
formal.en: The author uses the word 'bekbik' to describe how the character guzzles beer.
formal.zh: 作者用 bekbik 一词描写那个人物大口猛喝啤酒的样子。

colloquial.mt: Sara: X'inhu dan il-bekbik kollu? Pawlu: Kont bil-għatx ħafna; issa nixrob aktar bil-mod.
colloquial.en: Sara: What's all this guzzling? Pawlu: I was really thirsty; I'll drink more slowly now.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：怎么这样一个劲儿地猛喝？保罗：我刚才太渴了；现在我会喝慢一点。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 怎么这样一个劲儿地猛喝？
messages.en: What's all this guzzling?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Kont bil-għatx ħafna; issa nixrob aktar bil-mod.
messages.mt_standard: Kont bil-għatx ħafna; issa nixrob aktar bil-mod.
messages.zh: 我刚才太渴了；现在我会喝慢一点。
messages.en: I was really thirsty; I'll drink more slowly now.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象杯子接连举起、饮料咕咚下肚的画面，把 bekbik 记成“大口猛喝这一行为”的名词。

gloss_zh: 假设的第一式动词形式，意为“打”

teaching_sense.en_definition: A hypothetical first-form verb corresponding to 'bekket', with the proposed meaning 'to beat'.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 与 bekket 对应的假设性第一式动词形式，拟定意义为“打、击打”；学习时应保留其假设性质。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Forma ipotetika tal-ewwel forma tal-verb, marbuta ma' 'bekket', bit-tifsira proposta ta' 'isawwat'.

sense_translations.en_definition: hypothetical first form of 'bekket' meaning 'to beat'
sense_translations.zh_definition: bekket 的假设性第一式形式，意为“打、击打”。

formal.mt: F'din in-nota lingwistika, 'beket' huwa ppreżentat bħala forma ipotetika bit-tifsira ta' 'isawwat'.
formal.en: In this linguistic note, 'beket' is presented as a hypothetical form meaning 'to beat'.
formal.zh: 在这则语言学说明中，beket 被列为意为“打”的假设形式。

colloquial.mt: Lina: Nista' nuża 'beket' f'sentenza ta' kuljum? Toni: Hawnhekk huwa forma ipotetika; żomm dik in-nota miegħu.
colloquial.en: Lina: Can I use 'beket' in an everyday sentence? Toni: Here it is a hypothetical form; keep that note with it.
colloquial.zh: 莉娜：我可以把 beket 用在日常句子里吗？托尼：这里列的是假设形式；记这个词时要保留这条说明。

messages.speaker: Lina (学生)
messages.zh: 我可以把 beket 用在日常句子里吗？
messages.en: Can I use 'beket' in an everyday sentence?

messages.speaker: Toni (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Hawnhekk huwa forma ipotetika; żomm dik in-nota miegħu.
messages.mt_standard: Hawnhekk huwa forma ipotetika; żomm dik in-nota miegħu.
messages.zh: 这里列的是假设形式；记这个词时要保留这条说明。
messages.en: Here it is a hypothetical form; keep that note with it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 beket 的词卡加上“假设形式”标签，再联记“打”；不要把词义记忆误当成已经确认的日常用法。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Support given to a person, proposal, or activity that helps it proceed or succeed.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 给予某人、提议或活动的支持，帮助其推进或取得成功。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Appoġġ mogħti lil persuna, proposta jew attività biex tkun tista' timxi 'l quddiem jew tirnexxi.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 支持；扶持；作为后盾的援助。

formal.mt: Il-proġett kiseb beking finanzjarju mill-assoċjazzjoni lokali.
formal.en: The project secured financial backing from the local association.
formal.zh: 该项目获得了当地协会的资金支持。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Għandek il-beking tat-tim għal din l-idea? Rita: Iva, kulħadd lest jgħin.
colloquial.en: Mark: Do you have the team's backing for this idea? Rita: Yes, everyone is ready to help.
colloquial.zh: 马克：你这个想法得到团队支持了吗？丽塔：得到了，大家都愿意帮忙。

messages.speaker: Mark (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandek il-beking tat-tim għal din l-idea?
messages.mt_standard: Għandek il-beking tat-tim għal din l-idea?
messages.zh: 你这个想法得到团队支持了吗？
messages.en: Do you have the team's backing for this idea?

messages.speaker: Rita (项目负责人)
messages.zh: 得到了，大家都愿意帮忙。
messages.en: Yes, everyone is ready to help.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 beking 和英语 backing 对照记忆，想象有人站在身后提供帮助；搭配“资金”和“政治”时都表示支持。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To make someone weep; also, to mistreat someone.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使某人哭泣；也可指虐待或恶劣地对待某人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Iġiegħel lil xi ħadd jibki; jista' jfisser ukoll li jittratta lil xi ħadd ħażin.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使某人哭泣；把某人惹哭。
虐待某人；恶劣地对待某人。

formal.mt: Il-film bekka lill-udjenza bix-xena tat-tislima finali.
formal.en: The film made the audience weep with its final farewell scene.
formal.zh: 电影中最后告别的场景使观众落泪。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Dak il-film bekka lil ħija. Ben: Lili wkoll; it-tmiem kien tassew imdejjaq.
colloquial.en: Anna: That film made my brother cry. Ben: Me too; the ending was really sad.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：那部电影把我哥哥看哭了。本：我也哭了；结局实在太伤感了。

messages.speaker: Anna (朋友)
messages.zh: 那部电影把我哥哥看哭了。
messages.en: That film made my brother cry.

messages.speaker: Ben (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Lili wkoll; it-tmiem kien tassew imdejjaq.
messages.mt_standard: Lili wkoll; it-tmiem kien tassew imdejjaq.
messages.zh: 我也哭了；结局实在太伤感了。
messages.en: Me too; the ending was really sad.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“电影使观众落泪”记住使人哭的意义，再单列“虐待某人”一义；感动落泪的场景不应自动理解为虐待。

gloss_zh: 抬棺者；面相阴森的人；穿着过分隆重的人

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who carries a coffin; also, a sinister-looking person or someone who is overdressed.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 抬棺材的人；也可指面相阴森的人，或穿着过分隆重的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li ġġorr tebut; jista' jirreferi wkoll għal persuna b'dehra ta' biża' jew għal xi ħadd liebes iżżejjed għall-okkażjoni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 抬棺者；在葬礼中承担抬棺工作的人。
面相阴森、外表令人不安的人。
穿着过分隆重、衣着正式程度超过场合需要的人。

collocations.en: dressed like someone who is overdressed

formal.mt: Il-bekkamort ġarr it-tebut flimkien mal-oħrajn waqt il-funeral.
formal.en: The pallbearer carried the coffin together with the others during the funeral.
formal.zh: 葬礼期间，这名抬棺者与其他人一起抬着棺材。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex ġejt bil-libsa u l-ingravata għal piknik? Qisek bekkamort! David: Ħsibt li konna sejrin għal ikla formali.
colloquial.en: Lara: Why did you come to a picnic in a suit and tie? You're so overdressed! David: I thought we were going to a formal dinner.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：你怎么穿着西装、打着领带来野餐？穿得也太隆重了！戴维：我以为我们要去吃正式晚宴。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex ġejt bil-libsa u l-ingravata għal piknik? Qisek bekkamort!
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex ġejt bil-libsa u l-ingravata għal piknik? Qisek bekkamort!
messages.zh: 你怎么穿着西装、打着领带来野餐？穿得也太隆重了！
messages.en: Why did you come to a picnic in a suit and tie? You're so overdressed!

messages.speaker: David (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ħsibt li konna sejrin għal ikla formali.
messages.mt_standard: Ħsibt li konna sejrin għal ikla formali.
messages.zh: 我以为我们要去吃正式晚宴。
messages.en: I thought we were going to a formal dinner.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给这个词画三张独立词义卡：抬棺的人、面相阴森的人、野餐却穿得过分隆重的人；用场景选择对应译义。

gloss_zh: 爱哭的人；动不动就哭的人

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who tends to weep even at the slightest provocation.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 稍受刺激或遇到一点小事就容易哭泣的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li għandha t-tendenza tibki anki mal-iċken ħaġa.

sense_translations.en_definition: inclined to weep at the slightest provocation
sense_translations.zh_definition: 动不动就哭的人；稍受刺激就容易落泪的人。

formal.mt: Fir-rakkont, it-tifel jissejjaħ bekkej għax jibki mal-iċken ħaġa.
formal.en: In the story, the boy is called a crybaby because he cries at the slightest thing.
formal.zh: 在故事里，这个男孩因为一点小事就哭，被叫作爱哭鬼。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Għaliex issejjaħlu bekkej? Sam: Għax jibki malajr, imma għandek raġun, aħjar ma nsejjaħlux hekk.
colloquial.en: Nina: Why do you call him a crybaby? Sam: Because he cries easily, but you're right, I'd better not call him that.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：你为什么叫他爱哭鬼？萨姆：因为他很容易哭，不过你说得对，我还是别这样叫他了。

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.zh: 你为什么叫他爱哭鬼？
messages.en: Why do you call him a crybaby?

messages.speaker: Sam (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax jibki malajr, imma għandek raġun, aħjar ma nsejjaħlux hekk.
messages.mt_standard: Għax jibki malajr, imma għandek raġun, aħjar ma nsejjaħlux hekk.
messages.zh: 因为他很容易哭，不过你说得对，我还是别这样叫他了。
messages.en: Because he cries easily, but you're right, I'd better not call him that.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一个遇到小事就眼泪汪汪的人，把 bekkej 作为“人的称呼”记住；它强调容易哭，不只描述一次哭泣。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A weeping willow: a tree with long, slender branches that hang down.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 垂柳，一种枝条细长、向下垂落的树。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Siġra bi friegħi twal u rqaq li jiddendlu 'l isfel.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 一棵垂柳；垂柳这种树。

collocations.en: the branches of the weeping willow

formal.mt: Fil-ġnien hemm bekkejja bi friegħi twal li jiddendlu lejn l-art.
formal.en: In the garden there is a weeping willow with long branches hanging down toward the ground.
formal.zh: 花园里有一棵垂柳，长长的枝条向地面垂落。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Fejn se niltaqgħu fil-ġnien? Karl: Taħt il-bekkejja, ħdejn il-bank.
colloquial.en: Maja: Where shall we meet in the garden? Karl: Under the weeping willow, next to the bench.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：我们在花园哪里见面？卡尔：在垂柳下，长椅旁边。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 我们在花园哪里见面？
messages.en: Where shall we meet in the garden?

messages.speaker: Karl (朋友)
messages.zh: 在垂柳下，长椅旁边。
messages.en: Under the weeping willow, next to the bench.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象细长柳枝像低垂的泪线，用这幅画面记住 bekkejja 是“垂柳”；这只是学习联想，不是词源解释。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To hit someone or something, or to strike someone repeatedly.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 击打某人或某物，也可指反复击打、殴打某人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jolqot lil xi ħadd jew xi ħaġa, jew jagħti diversi daqqiet lil xi ħadd.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 击打；打中某人或某物。
殴打；连续或反复击打。

formal.mt: Skont ix-xhud, ir-raġel bekket lill-vittma diversi drabi.
formal.en: According to the witness, the man struck the victim several times.
formal.zh: 据证人所述，那名男子击打了受害者数次。

colloquial.mt: Marta: Għaliex qed jibki t-tifel? Pawlu: Ħuh bekket lilu waqt li kienu qed jilagħbu.
colloquial.en: Marta: Why is the boy crying? Pawlu: His brother hit him while they were playing.
colloquial.zh: Marta：那个男孩为什么在哭？Pawlu：他们玩耍时，他兄弟打了他。

messages.speaker: Marta (邻居)
messages.zh: 那个男孩为什么在哭？
messages.en: Why is the boy crying?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (邻居)
messages.mt_spoken: Ħuh bekket lilu waqt li kienu qed jilagħbu.
messages.mt_standard: Ħuh bekket lilu waqt li kienu qed jilagħbu.
messages.zh: 他们玩耍时，他兄弟打了他。
messages.en: His brother hit him while they were playing.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用动作画面记忆：手击中球对应“击打”，连续打人对应“殴打”；把 bekket 和这两种动作一起记。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who hits another person.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 击打他人的人；强调实施打人动作的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li tagħti daqqa jew daqqiet lil persuna oħra.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 打别人的人；击打他人的人。

collocations.en: a violent person who hits others
the person who hit the victim

formal.mt: Ix-xhud identifika lill-bekkiet u ddeskriva l-inċident lill-pulizija.
formal.en: The witness identified the person who had hit someone and described the incident to the police.
formal.zh: 证人指认了打人者，并向警方描述了事件经过。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Min kien il-bekkiet? Mark: Ir-raġel bil-ġakketta blu; rajtu jagħti daqqa lil Toni.
colloquial.en: Lara: Who was the person who hit someone? Mark: The man in the blue jacket; I saw him hit Toni.
colloquial.zh: Lara：打人的是谁？Mark：穿蓝夹克的那个男人；我看见他打了 Toni 一下。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 打人的是谁？
messages.en: Who was the person who hit someone?

messages.speaker: Mark (目击者)
messages.mt_spoken: Ir-raġel bil-ġakketta blu; rajtu jagħti daqqa lil Toni.
messages.mt_standard: Ir-raġel bil-ġakketta blu; rajtu jagħti daqqa lil Toni.
messages.zh: 穿蓝夹克的那个男人；我看见他打了 Toni 一下。
messages.en: The man in the blue jacket; I saw him hit Toni.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 bekkiet 放在“谁打了人？”的答案位置记忆：它指实施动作的人，是名词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To swallow something; figuratively, to believe something too readily.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把东西吞咽下去；比喻不加怀疑地相信某种说法。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Iniżżel xi ħaġa mill-ħalq għall-istonku; f'sens figurattiv, jemmen xi ħaġa malajr wisq.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 吞下；将口中的东西咽下去。
轻信；容易相信别人的话或受骗。

collocations.zh: 对每一句话都信以为真

formal.mt: Il-pazjent bela' l-pillola ma' tazza ilma.
formal.en: The patient swallowed the pill with a glass of water.
formal.zh: 病人用一杯水送服了药片。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Toni emmen dik l-istorja? Samwel: Iva, bela' kull kelma, avolja kienet ċajta.
colloquial.en: Nina: Did Toni believe that story? Samwel: Yes, he believed every word, even though it was a joke.
colloquial.zh: Nina：Toni 相信那个故事了？Samwel：是啊，虽然那是个玩笑，他还是句句都信了。

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.zh: Toni 相信那个故事了？
messages.en: Did Toni believe that story?

messages.speaker: Samwel (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, bela' kull kelma, avolja kienet ċajta.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, bela' kull kelma, avolja kienet ċajta.
messages.zh: 是啊，虽然那是个玩笑，他还是句句都信了。
messages.en: Yes, he believed every word, even though it was a joke.

cognitive_memory_aid: 先想“吞下药片”，再想把别人的话也“全吞下去”，由此连记“吞咽”和“轻信”两个义项。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Belarus, a country in Eastern Europe; another name for Belarussja.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 白俄罗斯，东欧国家；与 Belarussja 指同一个国家。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Pajjiż fl-Ewropa tal-Lvant, magħruf ukoll bħala l-Belarussja.

sense_translations.en_definition: synonym of Belarussja: Belarus (a country in Eastern Europe)
sense_translations.zh_definition: Belarussja 的同义名称：白俄罗斯，东欧的一个国家。

formal.mt: L-istudenti ħejjew rapport dwar Belarus, pajjiż fl-Ewropa tal-Lvant.
formal.en: The students prepared a report about Belarus, a country in Eastern Europe.
formal.zh: 学生们准备了一份关于东欧国家白俄罗斯的报告。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Fejn hu Belarus fuq il-mappa? Luka: Fl-Ewropa tal-Lvant; ejja nfittxuh flimkien.
colloquial.en: Maja: Where is Belarus on the map? Luka: In Eastern Europe; let's look for it together.
colloquial.zh: Maja：白俄罗斯在地图上的哪里？Luka：在东欧；我们一起找找吧。

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.zh: 白俄罗斯在地图上的哪里？
messages.en: Where is Belarus on the map?

messages.speaker: Luka (同学)
messages.zh: 在东欧；我们一起找找吧。
messages.en: In Eastern Europe; let's look for it together.

cognitive_memory_aid: 在东欧地图上给白俄罗斯贴上 Belarus 标签，再旁注 Belarussja，记住两个名称指同一国家。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Belarus, a country in Eastern Europe.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 白俄罗斯，位于东欧的国家。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Pajjiż fl-Ewropa tal-Lvant.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 白俄罗斯，东欧的一个国家。

formal.mt: Il-kapitlu jippreżenta l-ġeografija tal-Belarussja permezz ta' mapep u testi qosra.
formal.en: The chapter presents the geography of Belarus through maps and short texts.
formal.zh: 本章通过地图和短文介绍白俄罗斯的地理。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Dwar liema pajjiż se tikteb? Ben: Dwar il-Belarussja; għandi mappa tajba tagħha.
colloquial.en: Sara: Which country are you going to write about? Ben: Belarus; I have a good map of it.
colloquial.zh: Sara：你打算写哪个国家？Ben：白俄罗斯；我有一张很好的白俄罗斯地图。

messages.speaker: Sara (同学)
messages.zh: 你打算写哪个国家？
messages.en: Which country are you going to write about?

messages.speaker: Ben (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Dwar il-Belarussja; għandi mappa tajba tagħha.
messages.mt_standard: Dwar il-Belarussja; għandi mappa tajba tagħha.
messages.zh: 白俄罗斯；我有一张很好的白俄罗斯地图。
messages.en: Belarus; I have a good map of it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 Belarussja 与“国家地图”配对记忆，并整组朗读 il-Belarussja、tal-Belarussja，熟悉句中的形式。

gloss_zh: 白俄罗斯的；白俄罗斯人；白俄罗斯语

teaching_sense.en_definition: Relating to Belarus, its people, or its language.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 与白俄罗斯、白俄罗斯人或白俄罗斯语有关的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu x'jaqsam mal-Belarussja, man-nies tagħha jew mal-lingwa tagħhom.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 白俄罗斯的；白俄罗斯人的；白俄罗斯语的。
白俄罗斯人。
白俄罗斯语。

collocations.zh: 一位来自明斯克的白俄罗斯人

formal.mt: Il-kittieb Belarussu qara silta mill-ktieb tiegħu bil-Belarussu.
formal.en: The Belarusian writer read a passage from his book in Belarusian.
formal.zh: 这位白俄罗斯作家用白俄罗斯语朗读了自己书中的一个片段。

colloquial.mt: Elena: Dak ir-raġel huwa Belarussu? Mark: Iva, u jitkellem bil-Belarussu ma' familtu.
colloquial.en: Elena: Is that man Belarusian? Mark: Yes, and he speaks Belarusian with his family.
colloquial.zh: Elena：那个男人是白俄罗斯人吗？Mark：是的，而且他和家人说白俄罗斯语。

messages.speaker: Elena (朋友)
messages.zh: 那个男人是白俄罗斯人吗？
messages.en: Is that man Belarusian?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, u jitkellem bil-Belarussu ma' familtu.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, u jitkellem bil-Belarussu ma' familtu.
messages.zh: 是的，而且他和家人说白俄罗斯语。
messages.en: Yes, and he speaks Belarusian with his family.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用三张卡片分开记：作家前后的修饰语表示“白俄罗斯的”，人物卡表示“白俄罗斯人”，语言卡表示“白俄罗斯语”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To flutter, moving lightly and repeatedly in the air.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在空中轻轻、反复地摆动或拍动，例如布料随风飘动。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jiċċaqlaq fl-arja b'movimenti ħfief u ripetuti, bħal drapp fir-riħ.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 飘动；轻轻地反复摆动或拍动。

formal.mt: L-istendard belbel fir-riħ waqt iċ-ċerimonja.
formal.en: The banner fluttered in the wind during the ceremony.
formal.zh: 仪式进行时，旗帜在风中飘动。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Rajt il-maktur fuq il-ħabel? Toni: Iva, belbel fir-riħ, imma ma waqax.
colloquial.en: Rita: Did you see the handkerchief on the line? Toni: Yes, it fluttered in the wind, but it didn't fall.
colloquial.zh: Rita：你看见绳子上的手帕了吗？Toni：看见了，它在风中飘动，不过没掉下来。

messages.speaker: Rita (家人)
messages.zh: 你看见绳子上的手帕了吗？
messages.en: Did you see the handkerchief on the line?

messages.speaker: Toni (家人)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, belbel fir-riħ, imma ma waqax.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, belbel fir-riħ, imma ma waqax.
messages.zh: 看见了，它在风中飘动，不过没掉下来。
messages.en: Yes, it fluttered in the wind, but it didn't fall.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 belbel 的重复声音当作课堂节拍，一拍想手帕扬起，一拍想手帕落下，记住轻轻反复飘动的画面。

gloss_zh: 挥动物品的人；摇动物品的人

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who flaps or waves something, such as a flag or a handkerchief.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 挥动或反复摇动某件物品的人，例如挥舞旗帜或手帕的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li tħarrek jew ixxejjer xi ħaġa, bħal bandiera jew maktur.

sense_translations.en_definition: sb. who flaps or waves sth.
sense_translations.zh_definition: 挥动、摇动或使某物反复拍动的人。

collocations.en: a person who waves a handkerchief

formal.mt: Waqt il-parata, il-belbiel tal-bnadar mexa quddiem il-grupp.
formal.en: During the parade, the person waving the flags walked in front of the group.
formal.zh: 游行时，挥旗的人走在队伍前面。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Min hu dak il-belbiel tal-bnadar? Pawlu: Dak hu Toni; qed ixejjer bandiera ħamra.
colloquial.en: Maja: Who is that person waving the flags? Pawlu: That's Toni; he's waving a red flag.
colloquial.zh: Maja：那个挥旗的人是谁？Pawlu：那是 Toni；他正挥着一面红旗。

messages.speaker: Maja (观众)
messages.zh: 那个挥旗的人是谁？
messages.en: Who is that person waving the flags?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Dak hu Toni; qed ixejjer bandiera ħamra.
messages.mt_standard: Dak hu Toni; qed ixejjer bandiera ħamra.
messages.zh: 那是 Toni；他正挥着一面红旗。
messages.en: That's Toni; he's waving a red flag.

cognitive_memory_aid: 在脑海里画一个挥旗的人，把 belbiel 标签贴在人身上；再换成挥手帕的人，巩固它指人的名词义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Moving with light, quick motions, as cloth does in a breeze.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容像布料在微风中那样轻快、连续地飘动或扑动的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jiċċaqlaq b'movimenti ħfief u mgħaġġla, bħal drapp fir-riħ.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 飘动的；轻轻扑动的。

collocations.en: a ribbon fluttering in the wind

formal.mt: Il-pittur pinġa żigarell belbieli fir-riħ biex jagħti sens ta' moviment lix-xena.
formal.en: The painter depicted a ribbon fluttering in the wind to give the scene a sense of movement.
formal.zh: 画家画了一条随风飘动的丝带，为画面增添动感。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Qed tara dak iż-żigarell belbieli mat-tieqa? Lara: Iva, ir-riħ qed iċaqalqu.
colloquial.en: Maja: Do you see that fluttering ribbon by the window? Lara: Yes, the wind is moving it.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你看到窗边那条飘动的丝带了吗？拉拉：看到了，是风在吹动它。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Qed tara dak iż-żigarell belbieli mat-tieqa?
messages.mt_standard: Qed tara dak iż-żigarell belbieli mat-tieqa?
messages.zh: 你看到窗边那条飘动的丝带了吗？
messages.en: Do you see that fluttering ribbon by the window?

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 看到了，是风在吹动它。
messages.en: Yes, the wind is moving it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 belbieli 和窗边丝带轻轻扑动的画面配对，记住它描述的是飘动的状态。

gloss_zh: 男性生殖器的委婉称呼

teaching_sense.en_definition: A euphemistic word used to refer to male genitalia.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用来委婉指称男性生殖器的名词。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kelma li tintuża biex tirreferi għall-ġenitali maskili b'mod ewfemistiku.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 男性生殖器的委婉称呼。

collocations.zh: 用 belbula 作委婉称呼

formal.mt: F'dan id-djalogu, il-kelma 'belbula' tintuża bħala ewfemiżmu għall-ġenitali maskili.
formal.en: In this dialogue, the word 'belbula' is used as a euphemism for male genitalia.
formal.zh: 在这段对话中，belbula 被用作男性生殖器的委婉称呼。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Xi tfisser 'belbula' f'din is-sentenza? Mark: Hija kelma li tirreferi għall-ġenitali maskili b'mod ewfemistiku.
colloquial.en: Lara: What does 'belbula' mean in this sentence? Mark: It is a word that refers to male genitalia euphemistically.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：这句话里的 belbula 是什么意思？马克：它是委婉指称男性生殖器的词。

messages.speaker: Lara (学生)
messages.zh: 这句话里的 belbula 是什么意思？
messages.en: What does 'belbula' mean in this sentence?

messages.speaker: Mark (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Hija kelma li tirreferi għall-ġenitali maskili b'mod ewfemistiku.
messages.mt_standard: Hija kelma li tirreferi għall-ġenitali maskili b'mod ewfemistiku.
messages.zh: 它是委婉指称男性生殖器的词。
messages.en: It is a word that refers to male genitalia euphemistically.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 belbula 的词卡画一个委婉表达的对话气泡，同时标注男性生殖器，连同语气一起记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The name of the capital and largest city of Northern Ireland.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 北爱尔兰首府及最大城市贝尔法斯特的名称。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-isem tal-belt kapitali u l-akbar belt tal-Irlanda ta' Fuq.

sense_translations.en_definition: Belfast (the capital and largest city of Northern Ireland)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 贝尔法斯特，北爱尔兰的首府及最大城市。

collocations.zh: 前往贝尔法斯特的旅行

formal.mt: Belfast hija l-belt kapitali u l-akbar belt tal-Irlanda ta' Fuq.
formal.en: Belfast is the capital and largest city of Northern Ireland.
formal.zh: 贝尔法斯特是北爱尔兰的首府及最大城市。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Fejn sejjer għal tmiem il-ġimgħa? Mark: Se mmur Belfast u nqatta' ftit ħin fiċ-ċentru.
colloquial.en: Maja: Where are you going for the weekend? Mark: I am going to Belfast and spending some time in the city centre.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你周末打算去哪里？马克：我要去贝尔法斯特，在市中心逛一逛。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你周末打算去哪里？
messages.en: Where are you going for the weekend?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Se mmur Belfast u nqatta' ftit ħin fiċ-ċentru.
messages.mt_standard: Se mmur Belfast u nqatta' ftit ħin fiċ-ċentru.
messages.zh: 我要去贝尔法斯特，在市中心逛一逛。
messages.en: I am going to Belfast and spending some time in the city centre.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 Belfast、贝尔法斯特和北爱尔兰首府写在同一张地图词卡上，三个信息一起记。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The Maltese name for Belgrade, the capital city of Serbia.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 塞尔维亚首都贝尔格莱德的马耳他语名称。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-isem bil-Malti tal-belt kapitali tas-Serbja.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 贝尔格莱德，塞尔维亚的首都。

collocations.zh: 前往贝尔格莱德的旅行

formal.mt: Belgrad hija l-belt kapitali tas-Serbja.
formal.en: Belgrade is the capital city of Serbia.
formal.zh: 贝尔格莱德是塞尔维亚的首都。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Fejn se niltaqgħu meta naslu Belgrad? Mark: Quddiem il-lukanda fiċ-ċentru.
colloquial.en: Lara: Where shall we meet when we arrive in Belgrade? Mark: In front of the hotel in the city centre.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：我们到贝尔格莱德后在哪里碰面？马克：在市中心的酒店门口。

messages.speaker: Lara (旅伴)
messages.mt_spoken: Fejn se niltaqgħu meta naslu Belgrad?
messages.mt_standard: Fejn se niltaqgħu meta naslu Belgrad?
messages.zh: 我们到贝尔格莱德后在哪里碰面？
messages.en: Where shall we meet when we arrive in Belgrade?

messages.speaker: Mark (旅伴)
messages.zh: 在市中心的酒店门口。
messages.en: In front of the hotel in the city centre.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把马耳他语 Belgrad、英语 Belgrade、中文贝尔格莱德并排写，再用箭头连到塞尔维亚首都。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Thick mucus in the respiratory passages that can be coughed up.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 呼吸道中可通过咳嗽咳出的黏液，即痰。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Mukus oħxon fil-passaġġi tan-nifs li jista' joħroġ bis-sogħla.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 痰；呼吸道中的黏液。

formal.mt: Il-pazjent qal li kellu sogħla bil-belgħun għal diversi jiem.
formal.en: The patient said that he had had a cough with phlegm for several days.
formal.zh: 患者说，他有痰的咳嗽已经持续了好几天。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Għad għandek is-sogħla? Lara: Iva, u għandi l-belgħun ukoll.
colloquial.en: Mark: Do you still have a cough? Lara: Yes, and I have phlegm too.
colloquial.zh: 马克：你还在咳嗽吗？拉拉：是的，而且还有痰。

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 你还在咳嗽吗？
messages.en: Do you still have a cough?

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 是的，而且还有痰。
messages.en: Yes, and I have phlegm too.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用咳嗽后把痰咳到纸巾上的画面记 belgħun，并把它与英语 phlegm 配对复习。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To cause someone to swallow something, or figuratively to make someone believe something.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使某人吞下某物；也可用于比喻，表示使某人相信某种说法。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li ġġiegħel lil xi ħadd jibla' xi ħaġa, jew, b'mod figurattiv, jemmen xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.en_definition: to make or cause to swallow
sense_translations.zh_definition: 使某人吞下；促使某人咽下某物。
使某人相信某种说法；把说法灌输给某人，使其信以为真。

collocations.en: made the boy swallow the pill
made people believe a false story
collocations.zh: 使人们相信一个虚假的故事

formal.mt: Il-qarrieq bella' storja falza lin-nies biex jieħu flushom.
formal.en: The fraudster made people believe a false story in order to take their money.
formal.zh: 骗子让人们相信一个虚假的故事，以骗取他们的钱财。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Kif bella' l-pillola lit-tifel? Mark: Tah ftit ilma u qallu biex jibla' bil-mod.
colloquial.en: Lara: How did he get the boy to swallow the pill? Mark: He gave him some water and told him to swallow slowly.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：他是怎么让男孩吞下药片的？马克：他给了男孩一点水，叫他慢慢咽下去。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 他是怎么让男孩吞下药片的？
messages.en: How did he get the boy to swallow the pill?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Tah ftit ilma u qallu biex jibla' bil-mod.
messages.mt_standard: Tah ftit ilma u qallu biex jibla' bil-mod.
messages.zh: 他给了男孩一点水，叫他慢慢咽下去。
messages.en: He gave him some water and told him to swallow slowly.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 bella' 记成让别人吞下去：实物是吞药片，比喻是把一个说法也吞进心里、信以为真。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To dip something into a liquid frequently or repeatedly.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把某物频繁或反复地蘸入、浸入液体中。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li tgħaddas xi ħaġa f'likwidu ta' spiss jew għal darba wara oħra.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 频繁地蘸入；反复浸入。

collocations.en: repeatedly dipped the brush in water
repeatedly dipped the bread in the sauce

formal.mt: Matul l-eżerċizzju, l-istudent bellel il-pinzell fl-ilma għal darba wara oħra.
formal.en: During the exercise, the student dipped the brush in water again and again.
formal.zh: 练习过程中，学生一次又一次地把画笔蘸入水中。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex il-ħobż kollu mxarrab? Mark: Pawlu bellel il-ħobż fiz-zalza għal darba wara oħra.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why is the bread all wet? Mark: Pawlu dipped the bread in the sauce again and again.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：面包怎么全湿了？马克：保罗一次又一次地拿面包蘸酱汁。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 面包怎么全湿了？
messages.en: Why is the bread all wet?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Pawlu bellel il-ħobż fiz-zalza għal darba wara oħra.
messages.mt_standard: Pawlu bellel il-ħobż fiz-zalza għal darba wara oħra.
messages.zh: 保罗一次又一次地拿面包蘸酱汁。
messages.en: Pawlu dipped the bread in the sauce again and again.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象画笔蘸水、提起、再蘸水的循环动作，用这个反复动作记住 bellel 的频繁蘸入义。

gloss_zh: 用天鹅绒覆盖；使具有天鹅绒般的质感

teaching_sense.en_definition: To cover something with velvet or give its surface the texture of velvet.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用天鹅绒包覆某物，或使其表面具有天鹅绒般的质感。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li tgħatti xi ħaġa bil-bellus jew tagħti lill-wiċċ tagħha nisġa bħal dik tal-bellus.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 用天鹅绒覆盖或包覆。

sense_translations.en_definition: to give sth. the texture of velvet
sense_translations.zh_definition: 使某物具有天鹅绒般的质感。

collocations.en: gave the fabric's surface a velvet-like texture
collocations.zh: 使布料表面具有天鹅绒般的质感

formal.mt: L-artiġjan belles il-kaxxa bil-bellus blu biex jagħtiha dehra eleganti.
formal.en: The craftsperson covered the box with blue velvet to give it an elegant appearance.
formal.zh: 工匠用蓝色天鹅绒包覆盒子，使它显得雅致。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Kif sar daqshekk artab il-wiċċ ta' dan id-drapp? Mark: L-artiġjan belles il-wiċċ tiegħu; issa jinħass bħall-bellus.
colloquial.en: Lara: How did the surface of this fabric become so soft? Mark: The craftsperson gave its surface a velvet-like texture; now it feels like velvet.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：这块布的表面怎么变得这么柔软？马克：工匠把它的表面处理成了天鹅绒般的质感，现在摸起来像天鹅绒。

messages.speaker: Lara (顾客)
messages.mt_spoken: Kif sar daqshekk artab il-wiċċ ta' dan id-drapp?
messages.mt_standard: Kif sar daqshekk artab il-wiċċ ta' dan id-drapp?
messages.zh: 这块布的表面怎么变得这么柔软？
messages.en: How did the surface of this fabric become so soft?

messages.speaker: Mark (店员)
messages.mt_spoken: L-artiġjan belles il-wiċċ tiegħu; issa jinħass bħall-bellus.
messages.mt_standard: L-artiġjan belles il-wiċċ tiegħu; issa jinħass bħall-bellus.
messages.zh: 工匠把它的表面处理成了天鹅绒般的质感，现在摸起来像天鹅绒。
messages.en: The craftsperson gave its surface a velvet-like texture; now it feels like velvet.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 belles 配两幅图：一幅给盒子包天鹅绒，一幅把表面做出绒感，同时记住覆盖材料和改变质感两个义项。

gloss_zh: 建造城市；授予某地城市地位

teaching_sense.en_definition: To build a city, or to grant a place the status of a city.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 建造一座城市，或授予某个地方城市地位；须根据上下文区分实际建设与地位授予。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jibni belt jew jagħti lil post l-istatus ta' belt.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 建造一座城市。

sense_translations.en_definition: to confer the status of a city on some location
sense_translations.zh_definition: 授予某个地方城市地位。

collocations.zh: 授予了该村庄城市地位

formal.mt: F'dan ir-rakkont, il-ħakkiem bellet ir-raħal, jiġifieri tah l-istatus ta' belt.
formal.en: In this account, the ruler granted the village city status.
formal.zh: 在这篇记述中，统治者授予了该村庄城市地位。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Xi jfisser 'bellet' f'din is-sentenza? Mark: Hawn ifisser li bena belt; f'sentenza oħra jista' jfisser li ta lil post l-istatus ta' belt.
colloquial.en: Rita: What does 'bellet' mean in this sentence? Mark: Here it means that he built a city; in another sentence it can mean that he granted a place city status.
colloquial.zh: 丽塔：这句话里的 bellet 是什么意思？马克：这里是说他建造了一座城市；在别的句子里，也可以表示他授予某地城市地位。

messages.speaker: Rita (学生)
messages.zh: 这句话里的 bellet 是什么意思？
messages.en: What does 'bellet' mean in this sentence?

messages.speaker: Mark (老师)
messages.mt_spoken: Hawn ifisser li bena belt; f'sentenza oħra jista' jfisser li ta lil post l-istatus ta' belt.
messages.mt_standard: Hawn ifisser li bena belt; f'sentenza oħra jista' jfisser li ta lil post l-istatus ta' belt.
messages.zh: 这里是说他建造了一座城市；在别的句子里，也可以表示他授予某地城市地位。
messages.en: Here it means that he built a city; in another sentence it can mean that he granted a place city status.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两幅画记忆：一幅画工人建城，另一幅画给村庄颁发城市地位证书；两幅分别对应两个义项。

gloss_zh: 吞咽者；把东西咽下去的人

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who swallows something.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把食物、药片等东西咽下去的人，侧重吞咽这一动作的实施者。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li tibla' xi ħaġa, bħal ikel jew pilloli.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 吞咽东西的人；吞咽者。

formal.mt: Fl-eżempju tal-lezzjoni, il-belliegħ bela' l-pillola ma' ftit ilma.
formal.en: In the lesson's example, the swallower swallowed the pill with a little water.
formal.zh: 在课程的例句中，吞咽者用少量水把药片咽了下去。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Kif tibla' daqshekk malajr? Int belliegħ mgħaġġel! Pawlu: Veru, imma llum se niekol bil-mod.
colloquial.en: Lara: How do you swallow so quickly? You're a fast swallower! Pawlu: True, but today I'm going to eat slowly.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：你怎么咽得这么快？你吞咽可真快！保罗：确实，不过今天我会慢慢吃。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Kif tibla' daqshekk malajr? Int belliegħ mgħaġġel!
messages.mt_standard: Kif tibla' daqshekk malajr? Int belliegħ mgħaġġel!
messages.zh: 你怎么咽得这么快？你吞咽可真快！
messages.en: How do you swallow so quickly? You're a fast swallower!

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Veru, imma llum se niekol bil-mod.
messages.mt_standard: Veru, imma llum se niekol bil-mod.
messages.zh: 确实，不过今天我会慢慢吃。
messages.en: True, but today I'm going to eat slowly.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把画面定格在一个人把食物咽下去的瞬间：belliegħ 指画面里的吞咽者，而不是食物。

gloss_zh: 使别人困惑的人；把别人弄糊涂的人

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who confounds or confuses other people.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使别人感到困惑、迷惑或摸不着头脑的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li tħawwad lil ħaddieħor jew iġġiegħlu ma jifhimx.

sense_translations.en_definition: sb. who confounds or confuses others
sense_translations.zh_definition: 使他人困惑或把他人弄糊涂的人。

collocations.en: someone who confuses others with his words
collocations.zh: 用言语把别人弄糊涂的人

formal.mt: Fir-rakkont, il-bellieh ta spjegazzjonijiet li jikkontradixxu lil xulxin u ħawwad lis-semmiegħa.
formal.en: In the story, the person who confused others gave contradictory explanations and left the listeners puzzled.
formal.zh: 在故事中，这个把别人弄糊涂的人给出了相互矛盾的解释，让听众感到困惑。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Darba jgħid ħaġa u darba jgħid oħra. X'bellieh! Karl: Iva, ejja nitolbuh jispjega mill-ġdid.
colloquial.en: Nina: First he says one thing, then another. He really confuses people! Karl: Yes, let's ask him to explain again.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：他一会儿这么说，一会儿又那么说，真把人弄糊涂了！卡尔：是啊，我们请他再解释一遍吧。

messages.speaker: Nina (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Darba jgħid ħaġa u darba jgħid oħra. X'bellieh!
messages.mt_standard: Darba jgħid ħaġa u darba jgħid oħra. X'bellieh!
messages.zh: 他一会儿这么说，一会儿又那么说，真把人弄糊涂了！
messages.en: First he says one thing, then another. He really confuses people!

messages.speaker: Karl (同学)
messages.zh: 是啊，我们请他再解释一遍吧。
messages.en: Yes, let's ask him to explain again.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一个人越解释，听众头上的问号越多；bellieh 就是让别人产生这些问号的人。

gloss_zh: 浸蘸者；把东西弄湿的人

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who dunks something in liquid or makes something wet.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把某物浸入液体的人，或把某物弄湿的人；这是指人的名词。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li tbill xi ħaġa f'likwidu jew ixxarrabha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 把某物浸入液体的人；浸蘸者。
把某物弄湿的人。

collocations.zh: 把饼干浸蘸到液体里的人

collocations.en: a person who makes clothes wet

formal.mt: Fl-eżempju, il-belliel tal-gallettini bill kull gallettina fit-te qabel kielha.
formal.en: In the example, the biscuit dunker dipped each biscuit in tea before eating it.
formal.zh: 在例句中，这个浸蘸饼干的人吃每块饼干前，都先把它放进茶里蘸一下。

colloquial.mt: Marta: Int il-belliel tal-gallettini f'din id-dar! David: Iva, inħobbhom mgħaddsa fit-te.
colloquial.en: Marta: You're the biscuit dunker in this house! David: Yes, I like them dipped in tea.
colloquial.zh: 玛尔塔：你就是咱家那个爱蘸饼干的人！戴维：是啊，我喜欢把饼干蘸进茶里吃。

messages.speaker: Marta (姐姐)
messages.zh: 你就是咱家那个爱蘸饼干的人！
messages.en: You're the biscuit dunker in this house!

messages.speaker: David (弟弟)
messages.zh: 是啊，我喜欢把饼干蘸进茶里吃。
messages.en: Yes, I like them dipped in tea.

cognitive_memory_aid: 画一个人把饼干蘸进茶杯，再把水洒到衣服上；belliel 指做这两类动作的人，记住它是名词。

gloss_zh: 浸蘸东西的；把东西弄湿的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Describing someone who dunks something in liquid or makes something wet.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容把某物浸入液体、或把某物弄湿的人；本词条按形容词学习。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jiddeskrivi lil min ibill xi ħaġa f'likwidu jew ixxarrabha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 形容把某物浸入液体的人；浸蘸东西的。
形容把某物弄湿的人；使东西变湿的。

collocations.en: a boy who dunks things or makes them wet
collocations.zh: 浸蘸东西或把东西弄湿的男孩

collocations.en: a man who dunks things or makes them wet
collocations.zh: 浸蘸东西或把东西弄湿的男子

formal.mt: Fl-istorja, it-tifel bellieli xarrab il-kmiem waqt li kien jilgħab bl-ilma.
formal.en: In the story, the boy who made things wet soaked his sleeves while playing with water.
formal.zh: 在故事中，那个会把东西弄湿的男孩玩水时弄湿了袖子。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għaliex sejjaħtlu 'tifel bellieli'? Toni: Għax waqt il-logħob bl-ilma jxarrab kull ħaġa li jkollu ħdejh!
colloquial.en: Sara: Why did you call him a 'tifel bellieli'? Toni: Because when he plays with water, he gets everything around him wet!
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：你为什么用 tifel bellieli 来形容他？托尼：因为他一玩水，就会把身边的东西全弄湿！

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 你为什么用 tifel bellieli 来形容他？
messages.en: Why did you call him a 'tifel bellieli'?

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax waqt il-logħob bl-ilma jxarrab kull ħaġa li jkollu ħdejh!
messages.mt_standard: Għax waqt il-logħob bl-ilma jxarrab kull ħaġa li jkollu ħdejh!
messages.zh: 因为他一玩水，就会把身边的东西全弄湿！
messages.en: Because when he plays with water, he gets everything around him wet!

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 bellieli 写在人物旁边作为描述标签，联想“浸蘸东西的、弄湿东西的”；与指人的名词 belliel 对照记忆。

gloss_zh: 使游戏分数超过规定点数的人

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who causes the score in a game to exceed the specified number of points.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在游戏中，使分数超过规定点数的人；具体点数须由游戏规则或上下文确定。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li ġġiegħel il-punteġġ f'logħba jaqbeż in-numru ta' punti stabbilit.

sense_translations.en_definition: sb. who causes the number of points in a game to be exceeded
sense_translations.zh_definition: 在游戏中使分数超过规定点数的人。

collocations.en: the person who causes the game's point total to be exceeded
collocations.zh: 使该局游戏超过规定点数的人

collocations.en: a person who went over the point limit
collocations.zh: 使分数超过点数上限的人

formal.mt: F'dan l-eżempju, il-limitu kien għoxrin punt; il-bellieq wassal il-punteġġ għal tnejn u għoxrin.
formal.en: In this example, the limit was twenty points; the person who exceeded it brought the score to twenty-two.
formal.zh: 在这个例子中，点数上限为二十分；使分数超限的人把分数推到了二十二分。

colloquial.mt: Luca: Il-limitu kien għoxrin u jien wasalt għal tnejn u għoxrin. Anna: Mela int il-bellieq f'din il-logħba!
colloquial.en: Luca: The limit was twenty, and I reached twenty-two. Anna: Then you're the one who exceeded the point limit in this game!
colloquial.zh: 卢卡：上限是二十分，我却到了二十二分。安娜：那你就是这局游戏里使分数超限的人啦！

messages.speaker: Luca (玩家)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-limitu kien għoxrin u jien wasalt għal tnejn u għoxrin.
messages.mt_standard: Il-limitu kien għoxrin u jien wasalt għal tnejn u għoxrin.
messages.zh: 上限是二十分，我却到了二十二分。
messages.en: The limit was twenty, and I reached twenty-two.

messages.speaker: Anna (同局玩家)
messages.zh: 那你就是这局游戏里使分数超限的人啦！
messages.en: Then you're the one who exceeded the point limit in this game!

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象计分牌标着上限二十，有人把分数推到二十二；把 bellieq 贴在这个人身上，记住核心是使点数超限。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Showing signs of becoming ripe.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 显露出成熟迹象的，例如果实开始呈现成熟时的颜色或气味；不必理解为已经完全成熟。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li juri sinjali li qed isir misjur.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 显出成熟迹象的；开始呈现成熟特征的。

collocations.en: a melon showing signs of ripeness

formal.mt: Il-bettieħ bellieqi beda jibdel il-kulur u joħroġ riħa ħafifa.
formal.en: The melon showing signs of ripeness had begun to change colour and give off a faint scent.
formal.zh: 这个显出成熟迹象的甜瓜开始变色，并散发出淡淡的香味。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Dan il-bettieħ bellieqi? Pawlu: Iva, beda jibdel il-kulur, imma għadu mhux misjur għalkollox.
colloquial.en: Maja: Is this melon showing signs of ripeness? Pawlu: Yes, it's started to change colour, but it isn't fully ripe yet.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这个甜瓜开始显出成熟迹象了吗？保罗：是啊，已经开始变色了，不过还没完全成熟。

messages.speaker: Maja (顾客)
messages.zh: 这个甜瓜开始显出成熟迹象了吗？
messages.en: Is this melon showing signs of ripeness?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (水果摊主)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, beda jibdel il-kulur, imma għadu mhux misjur għalkollox.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, beda jibdel il-kulur, imma għadu mhux misjur għalkollox.
messages.zh: 是啊，已经开始变色了，不过还没完全成熟。
messages.en: Yes, it's started to change colour, but it isn't fully ripe yet.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象甜瓜刚开始变色、飘出淡香，把 bellieqi 记成“成熟信号已经出现”；重点观察迹象，不把它直接等同于完全成熟。

gloss_zh: 城市建造者；城市地位授予者

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who builds a city or grants a place the status of a city.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 建造城市的人，或授予某地城市地位的人；两个义项分别涉及建设行为与地位授予。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li tibni belt jew tagħti lil post l-istatus ta' belt.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 建造城市的人；城市建造者。

sense_translations.en_definition: sb. who confers the status of a city
sense_translations.zh_definition: 授予城市地位的人。

collocations.en: the ruler as the person granting city status
collocations.zh: 作为城市地位授予者的统治者

formal.mt: F'dan it-test, il-ħakkiem jissejjaħ il-belliet għax ta lir-raħal l-istatus ta' belt.
formal.en: In this text, the ruler is called the person who conferred city status because he granted that status to the village.
formal.zh: 在这篇文章中，统治者被称为城市地位授予者，因为他授予了该村庄城市地位。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Min hu l-belliet f'dan ir-rakkont? Mark: Hu r-raġel li bena l-belt; hawn il-kelma tirreferi għall-bini tagħha.
colloquial.en: Rita: Who is the 'belliet' in this story? Mark: He's the man who built the city; here the word refers to its construction.
colloquial.zh: 丽塔：这个故事里的 belliet 是谁？马克：就是建造这座城市的那个人；这里这个词指的是城市的建造者。

messages.speaker: Rita (学生)
messages.zh: 这个故事里的 belliet 是谁？
messages.en: Who is the 'belliet' in this story?

messages.speaker: Mark (老师)
messages.mt_spoken: Hu r-raġel li bena l-belt; hawn il-kelma tirreferi għall-bini tagħha.
messages.mt_standard: Hu r-raġel li bena l-belt; hawn il-kelma tirreferi għall-bini tagħha.
messages.zh: 就是建造这座城市的那个人；这里这个词指的是城市的建造者。
messages.en: He's the man who built the city; here the word refers to its construction.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 belliet 记在两个人物画像下：一位负责建城，一位授予城市地位；再与动词 bellet 对照，区分做事的人和所做的事。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A band made of velvet, used as a decorative strip or accessory.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用天鹅绒制成的带子，可用作装饰或配饰。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Faxxa magħmula mill-bellus, użata bħala tiżjin jew aċċessorju.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 一条天鹅绒带

collocations.en: a velvet band around the neck

formal.mt: Il-kostum jinkludi bellusa sewda li tintlibes madwar l-għonq.
formal.en: The costume includes a black velvet band worn around the neck.
formal.zh: 这套服装配有一条戴在颈部的黑色天鹅绒带。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Fejn hi l-bellusa sewda tiegħi? Rita: Qiegħda fil-kaxxa tal-aċċessorji.
colloquial.en: Maja: Where is my black velvet band? Rita: It's in the accessories box.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：我的黑色天鹅绒带在哪里？丽塔：在配饰盒里。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 我的黑色天鹅绒带在哪里？
messages.en: Where is my black velvet band?

messages.speaker: Rita (朋友)
messages.zh: 在配饰盒里。
messages.en: It's in the accessories box.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 bellusa 想成颈间一条柔软的天鹅绒带，用具体配饰画面记住这个名词。

gloss_zh: 天鹅绒般的；触感柔软舒适的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Having a velvet-like texture, or feeling soft and pleasant when touched.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 质地像天鹅绒的，或摸起来柔软、舒适的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu mess bħal tal-bellus, jew li hu artab u pjaċevoli meta tmissu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 天鹅绒般的；具有天鹅绒质感的

sense_translations.en_definition: soft and pleasant to the touch
sense_translations.zh_definition: 摸起来柔软而舒适的

collocations.zh: 具有天鹅绒质感的布料

formal.mt: Dan id-drapp għandu mess bellusi u huwa adattat għall-kisi tal-kuxxini.
formal.en: This fabric has a velvety feel and is suitable for cushion covers.
formal.zh: 这种布料具有天鹅绒般的触感，适合制作靠垫套。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Miss dan id-drapp. Kemm hu bellusi! Lara: Veru, artab ħafna.
colloquial.en: Mark: Feel this fabric. It's so velvety! Lara: It really is, very soft.
colloquial.zh: 马克：摸摸这块布，真有天鹅绒般的触感！拉拉：确实，非常柔软。

messages.speaker: Mark (顾客)
messages.mt_spoken: Miss dan id-drapp. Kemm hu bellusi!
messages.mt_standard: Miss dan id-drapp. Kemm hu bellusi!
messages.zh: 摸摸这块布，真有天鹅绒般的触感！
messages.en: Feel this fabric. It's so velvety!

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 确实，非常柔软。
messages.en: It really is, very soft.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记 bellusi 时想象指尖滑过柔软布面；它形容触感，可译为天鹅绒般的或柔软舒适的。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A flower made of velvet, used as a decoration.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用天鹅绒制成、用于装饰的花。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Fjura magħmula mill-bellus li tintuża bħala tiżjin.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 一朵天鹅绒花

collocations.en: a velvet flower on a hat

formal.mt: Il-kappell huwa mżejjen b'bellusija ħamra fuq il-ġenb.
formal.en: The hat is decorated with a red velvet flower on the side.
formal.zh: 这顶帽子的侧面装饰着一朵红色天鹅绒花。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Din il-bellusija tmur mal-kappell tiegħi? Sara: Iva, il-kulur jaqbel ħafna.
colloquial.en: Nina: Does this velvet flower go with my hat? Sara: Yes, the color matches very well.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：这朵天鹅绒花配我的帽子吗？萨拉：配，颜色很合适。

messages.speaker: Nina (顾客)
messages.zh: 这朵天鹅绒花配我的帽子吗？
messages.en: Does this velvet flower go with my hat?

messages.speaker: Sara (店员)
messages.zh: 配，颜色很合适。
messages.en: Yes, the color matches very well.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 bellusija 记成帽侧的一朵天鹅绒花；用花朵形状和柔软材质一起建立记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Monaco, the capital city of the country of Monaco.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 摩纳哥城，指摩纳哥这个国家的首都。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-belt kapitali tal-pajjiż ta' Monako.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 摩纳哥城（摩纳哥的首都）

formal.mt: Il-programm tal-vjaġġ jinkludi żjara fil-Belt ta' Monako.
formal.en: The travel itinerary includes a visit to Monaco City.
formal.zh: 旅行行程包括游览摩纳哥城。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Se nżuru l-Belt ta' Monako għada? Pawlu: Iva, għandna mappa biex insibu t-triq.
colloquial.en: Lara: Are we visiting Monaco City tomorrow? Pawlu: Yes, we have a map to find our way.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：我们明天去游览摩纳哥城吗？保罗：是的，我们有地图可以找路。

messages.speaker: Lara (旅伴)
messages.mt_spoken: Se nżuru l-Belt ta' Monako għada?
messages.mt_standard: Se nżuru l-Belt ta' Monako għada?
messages.zh: 我们明天去游览摩纳哥城吗？
messages.en: Are we visiting Monaco City tomorrow?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (旅伴)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, għandna mappa biex insibu t-triq.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, għandna mappa biex insibu t-triq.
messages.zh: 是的，我们有地图可以找路。
messages.en: Yes, we have a map to find our way.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把整组 Belt ta' Monako 和地图上的摩纳哥城相连；本条记的是城市名称。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Doing good or giving help to people in need, especially through charitable activities.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 向有需要的人提供帮助的善行，尤其指慈善活动。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Għemil ta' ġid u għajnuna lil min hu fil-bżonn, speċjalment permezz ta' attivitajiet ta' karità.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 行善；慈善；对有需要者的帮助

formal.mt: L-iskola organizzat kunċert ta' benefiċenza biex tiġbor fondi għall-familji fil-bżonn.
formal.en: The school organized a charity concert to raise funds for families in need.
formal.zh: 学校举办了一场慈善音乐会，为有需要的家庭筹款。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Trid tiġi għall-kunċert ta' benefiċenza nhar is-Sibt? Karl: Iva, nixtri biljett u ngħin ukoll.
colloquial.en: Maja: Do you want to come to the charity concert on Saturday? Karl: Yes, I'll buy a ticket and help out too.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你想来参加星期六的慈善音乐会吗？卡尔：想，我会买张票，也来帮忙。

messages.speaker: Maja (志愿者)
messages.mt_spoken: Trid tiġi għall-kunċert ta' benefiċenza nhar is-Sibt?
messages.mt_standard: Trid tiġi għall-kunċert ta' benefiċenza nhar is-Sibt?
messages.zh: 你想来参加星期六的慈善音乐会吗？
messages.en: Do you want to come to the charity concert on Saturday?

messages.speaker: Karl (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, nixtri biljett u ngħin ukoll.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, nixtri biljett u ngħin ukoll.
messages.zh: 想，我会买张票，也来帮忙。
messages.en: Yes, I'll buy a ticket and help out too.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 benefiċenza 放进慈善音乐会的场景：买票、筹款、帮助有需要的人，记住它表示慈善行善。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who receives a benefit from a distribution of money or property, especially from an estate.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 从金钱或财产分配中获得利益的人，尤其指遗产分配中的受益人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li tirċievi sehem jew benefiċċju minn tqassim ta' flus jew proprjetà, speċjalment minn wirt.

sense_translations.en_definition: beneficiary (one who benefits from the distribution, especially of an estate)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 受益人（从分配中获益的人，尤指遗产分配中的受益人）

collocations.en: a beneficiary named in the will

formal.mt: It-testment isemmi lil Pawlu bħala benefiċjarju ta' sehem mill-wirt.
formal.en: The will names Pawlu as the beneficiary of a share of the estate.
formal.zh: 遗嘱将保罗列为部分遗产的受益人。

colloquial.mt: Pawlu: Xi jfisser li jien benefiċjarju f'dan it-testment? Rita: Ifisser li t-testment jagħtik sehem mill-wirt.
colloquial.en: Pawlu: What does it mean that I'm a beneficiary in this will? Rita: It means the will gives you a share of the estate.
colloquial.zh: 保罗：我是这份遗嘱的受益人，这是什么意思？丽塔：意思是这份遗嘱给你一部分遗产。

messages.speaker: Pawlu (受益人)
messages.mt_spoken: Xi jfisser li jien benefiċjarju f'dan it-testment?
messages.mt_standard: Xi jfisser li jien benefiċjarju f'dan it-testment?
messages.zh: 我是这份遗嘱的受益人，这是什么意思？
messages.en: What does it mean that I'm a beneficiary in this will?

messages.speaker: Rita (姐姐)
messages.mt_spoken: Ifisser li t-testment jagħtik sehem mill-wirt.
messages.mt_standard: Ifisser li t-testment jagħtik sehem mill-wirt.
messages.zh: 意思是这份遗嘱给你一部分遗产。
messages.en: It means the will gives you a share of the estate.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象分配清单上写着一个人的名字，箭头把财产指向他；benefiċjarju 就是获得分配利益的受益人。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A country in West Africa, officially called the Republic of Benin and formerly known as Dahomey.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 西非国家贝宁，正式名称为贝宁共和国，旧称达荷美。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Pajjiż fl-Afrika tal-Punent, bl-isem uffiċjali Repubblika tal-Benin, li qabel kien magħruf bħala Dahomey.

sense_translations.en_definition: Benin (a country in West Africa, formerly Dahomey; official name: Repubblika tal-Benin)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 贝宁，西非国家，旧称达荷美；正式名称为贝宁共和国。

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi żjara fir-Repubblika tal-Benin, pajjiż fl-Afrika tal-Punent.
formal.en: The report describes a visit to the Republic of Benin, a country in West Africa.
formal.zh: 报告描述了一次对西非国家贝宁共和国的访问。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Fejn jinsab il-Benin? Mark: Fl-Afrika tal-Punent. Nistgħu nsibuh fuq il-mappa.
colloquial.en: Maja: Where is Benin? Mark: In West Africa. We can find it on the map.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：贝宁在哪里？马克：在西非。我们可以在地图上找到它。

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.zh: 贝宁在哪里？
messages.en: Where is Benin?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Fl-Afrika tal-Punent. Nistgħu nsibuh fuq il-mappa.
messages.mt_standard: Fl-Afrika tal-Punent. Nistgħu nsibuh fuq il-mappa.
messages.zh: 在西非。我们可以在地图上找到它。
messages.en: In West Africa. We can find it on the map.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 Benin 与“贝宁—西非—共和国”连成三点记忆；国家名称在马耳他语中用大写字母开头。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who gently rocks a child in a cradle or in their arms.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在摇篮中或怀里轻轻摇哄孩子的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li tbandal tarbija bil-mod f'benniena jew f'dirgħajha.

sense_translations.en_definition: sb. who rocks a child in a cradle or in one's arms
sense_translations.zh_definition: 在摇篮中或怀里摇哄孩子的人。

collocations.en: a patient person who rocks a child

formal.mt: Il-missier kien il-bennien tat-tarbija waqt li l-omm kienet qed tistrieħ.
formal.en: The father was the person rocking the baby while the mother rested.
formal.zh: 母亲休息时，父亲负责摇哄婴儿。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Min se jbandal it-tarbija sakemm niekol? Pawlu: Jien. Illum jien il-bennien tagħha!
colloquial.en: Sara: Who will rock the baby while I eat? Pawlu: I will. Today I am her baby rocker!
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：我吃饭的时候谁来摇哄宝宝？保罗：我来。今天我就是负责摇哄她的人！

messages.speaker: Sara (母亲)
messages.mt_spoken: Min se jbandal it-tarbija sakemm niekol?
messages.mt_standard: Min se jbandal it-tarbija sakemm niekol?
messages.zh: 我吃饭的时候谁来摇哄宝宝？
messages.en: Who will rock the baby while I eat?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (父亲)
messages.zh: 我来。今天我就是负责摇哄她的人！
messages.en: I will. Today I am her baby rocker!

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一个人抱着宝宝轻轻左右摇动；这个词指画面中的摇哄者，记忆重点落在“人”上。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A hidden place where domestic fowls lay their eggs.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 鸡等家禽躲起来产蛋的隐蔽地点。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Post moħbi fejn it-tjur ibidu l-bajd tagħhom.

sense_translations.en_definition: a hidden place where fowls lay their eggs
sense_translations.zh_definition: 家禽产蛋的隐蔽地点。

collocations.en: a hidden egg-laying place behind the wall
to find a hidden egg-laying place

formal.mt: Il-bidwi sab bennija wara l-ħajt u ġabar il-bajd li kien hemm.
formal.en: The farmer found a hidden egg-laying place behind the wall and collected the eggs there.
formal.zh: 农夫在墙后发现了一处隐蔽的产蛋处，并收起了那里的蛋。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Fejn qed tbid din it-tiġieġa? Ġanni: Sibt il-bennija tagħha wara l-kaxxi. Hemm tliet bajdiet.
colloquial.en: Rita: Where is this hen laying her eggs? Ġanni: I found her hidden laying place behind the boxes. There are three eggs.
colloquial.zh: 丽塔：这只母鸡在哪里下蛋？詹尼：我在箱子后面找到了它隐蔽的产蛋处。那里有三个蛋。

messages.speaker: Rita (农场主)
messages.zh: 这只母鸡在哪里下蛋？
messages.en: Where is this hen laying her eggs?

messages.speaker: Ġanni (农场帮工)
messages.mt_spoken: Sibt il-bennija tagħha wara l-kaxxi. Hemm tliet bajdiet.
messages.mt_standard: Sibt il-bennija tagħha wara l-kaxxi. Hemm tliet bajdiet.
messages.zh: 我在箱子后面找到了它隐蔽的产蛋处。那里有三个蛋。
messages.en: I found her hidden laying place behind the boxes. There are three eggs.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象母鸡绕到箱子后面偷偷下蛋，把“隐蔽地点”和“里面有蛋”一起记住，就是 bennija 的场景。

gloss_zh: 在手指间转动；用手指捻转

teaching_sense.en_definition: To turn or twirl an object between one's fingers.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把物体夹在手指之间转动或捻转。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Idawwar oġġett bejn subgħajh.

sense_translations.en_definition: to rotate or twirl between one's fingers
sense_translations.zh_definition: 在手指之间旋转或捻转某物

collocations.en: twirl a pencil between your fingers
turn a coin between your fingers

formal.mt: Waqt li kien qed jaħseb, Mark benċel il-lapes bejn subgħajh.
formal.en: While thinking, Mark twirled the pencil between his fingers.
formal.zh: 马克思考时，在手指间转动着铅笔。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Benċel il-lapes bejn subgħajk, bil-mod. Mark: Hekk? Qed nipprova ma nwaqqgħux.
colloquial.en: Rita: Twirl the pencil between your fingers slowly. Mark: Like this? I'm trying not to drop it.
colloquial.zh: 丽塔：慢慢地在手指间转动铅笔。马克：像这样吗？我正尽量不让它掉下去。

messages.speaker: Rita (朋友)
messages.zh: 慢慢地在手指间转动铅笔。
messages.en: Twirl the pencil between your fingers slowly.

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 像这样吗？我正尽量不让它掉下去。
messages.en: Like this? I'm trying not to drop it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记 benċel 时做一个手指转笔的动作，把词义固定在指间旋转这个具体动作上。

gloss_zh: 起缓解作用的人；减轻者

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who makes a difficulty, burden, or harmful effect less severe.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使困难、负担或不良影响减轻的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li ttaffi diffikultà, piż jew effett ħażin.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 起减轻或缓解作用的人

formal.mt: Fir-rapport, Mark huwa deskritt bħala benġiel tat-tensjoni bejn iż-żewġ gruppi.
formal.en: In the report, Mark is described as someone who eases tension between the two groups.
formal.zh: 报告将马克描述为缓解两个群体之间紧张关系的人。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Mark kien benġiel tat-tensjoni llum. Nina: Veru, meta tkellem hu, kulħadd ikkalma.
colloquial.en: Lara: Mark helped ease the tension today. Nina: True, when he spoke, everyone calmed down.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：马克今天起到了缓解紧张气氛的作用。妮娜：确实，他一开口，大家就平静下来了。

messages.speaker: Lara (同事)
messages.zh: 马克今天起到了缓解紧张气氛的作用。
messages.en: Mark helped ease the tension today.

messages.speaker: Nina (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Veru, meta tkellem hu, kulħadd ikkalma.
messages.mt_standard: Veru, meta tkellem hu, kulħadd ikkalma.
messages.zh: 确实，他一开口，大家就平静下来了。
messages.en: True, when he spoke, everyone calmed down.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 benġiel 想成走进紧张场面后让大家松一口气的人；重点记住这是表示缓解者的名词。

gloss_zh: 起缓解作用的；为减轻影响而做的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Done to lessen the severity or effects of something.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容为减轻某事的严重程度或不良影响而做的事情。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Magħmul biex inaqqas il-gravità jew l-effetti ħżiena ta' xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 为减轻严重程度或缓解不良影响而做的。

collocations.en: a gesture intended to lessen the impact
a step taken to mitigate the situation
collocations.zh: 为缓解局面而采取的步骤

formal.mt: Il-ħlas lura kien ġest benġieli biex jitnaqqas it-telf tal-familja.
formal.en: The reimbursement was a gesture intended to reduce the family's loss.
formal.zh: 退款是为了减轻这个家庭损失而采取的缓解举措。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Dan il-ħlas isolvi kollox? Toni: Le, imma huwa pass benġieli biex inaqqas it-telf tiegħek.
colloquial.en: Lara: Does this payment solve everything? Toni: No, but it is a mitigating step to reduce your loss.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：这笔钱能解决所有问题吗？托尼：不能，但这是一个缓解措施，可以减少你的损失。

messages.speaker: Lara (受影响的顾客)
messages.zh: 这笔钱能解决所有问题吗？
messages.en: Does this payment solve everything?

messages.speaker: Toni (客服人员)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, imma huwa pass benġieli biex inaqqas it-telf tiegħek.
messages.mt_standard: Le, imma huwa pass benġieli biex inaqqas it-telf tiegħek.
messages.zh: 不能，但这是一个缓解措施，可以减少你的损失。
messages.en: No, but it is a mitigating step to reduce your loss.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把它放进“减轻损失的一步”这个场景中记忆：重点是起缓解作用，不一定彻底解决问题。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A goat or a sheep, with the intended animal identified from context.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 可指山羊，也可指绵羊，具体所指需要结合上下文判断。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Mogħża jew nagħġa; il-kuntest juri għal liema annimal tirreferi l-kelma.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 山羊。
绵羊。

collocations.en: a goat or sheep in the field
to feed the goat or sheep

formal.mt: F'dan ir-rakkont, il-kelma 'beqqi' tirreferi għall-mogħża li tgħix fir-razzett.
formal.en: In this story, the word 'beqqi' refers to the goat that lives on the farm.
formal.zh: 在这个故事中，beqqi 一词指住在农场里的那只山羊。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Meta tgħid 'beqqi', qed tirreferi għal mogħża jew għal nagħġa? Luqa: Għan-nagħġa ħdejn iċ-ċint. Se nitmagħha.
colloquial.en: Nina: When you say 'beqqi', do you mean a goat or a sheep? Luqa: The sheep beside the fence. I am going to feed her.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：你说 beqqi 时，指的是山羊还是绵羊？卢卡：围栏旁边的那只绵羊。我准备去喂它。

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Meta tgħid 'beqqi', qed tirreferi għal mogħża jew għal nagħġa?
messages.mt_standard: Meta tgħid 'beqqi', qed tirreferi għal mogħża jew għal nagħġa?
messages.zh: 你说 beqqi 时，指的是山羊还是绵羊？
messages.en: When you say 'beqqi', do you mean a goat or a sheep?

messages.speaker: Luqa (养羊人)
messages.zh: 围栏旁边的那只绵羊。我准备去喂它。
messages.en: The sheep beside the fence. I am going to feed her.

cognitive_memory_aid: 制作一张双面词卡，一面画山羊，一面画绵羊，两面都写 beqqi；阅读时再用上下文确定是哪一种。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To open something wide.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把门、窗等大大打开。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jiftaħ xi ħaġa, bħal bieb jew tieqa, beraħ.
