sense_translations.zh_definition: 大大打开；敞开。
开阔的地方；空旷地带。
露天；户外的开放环境。

collocations.en: the open space between the trees

formal.mt: Il-ħaddiem beraħ il-bieb tas-sala biex il-parteċipanti jkunu jistgħu joħorġu fil-beraħ.
formal.en: The worker opened the hall door wide so that the participants could go out into the open air.
formal.zh: 工作人员把大厅的门大大打开，让参加者可以走到户外。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Min beraħ il-bieb? David: Jien. Trid toqgħod fil-beraħ għal ftit? Anna: Iva, ejja noħorġu.
colloquial.en: Anna: Who opened the door wide? David: I did. Would you like to sit outside for a while? Anna: Yes, let's go out.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：谁把门大大打开了？戴维：我开的。你想在户外坐一会儿吗？安娜：想，我们出去吧。

messages.speaker: Anna (朋友)
messages.zh: 谁把门大大打开了？
messages.en: Who opened the door wide?

messages.speaker: David (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Jien. Trid toqgħod fil-beraħ għal ftit?
messages.mt_standard: Jien. Trid toqgħod fil-beraħ għal ftit?
messages.zh: 我开的。你想在户外坐一会儿吗？
messages.en: I did. Would you like to sit outside for a while?

messages.speaker: Anna (朋友)
messages.zh: 想，我们出去吧。
messages.en: Yes, let's go out.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用连续画面串记三个义项：把门大大打开，走向开阔地，在露天坐下；分别对应动作、空间和户外环境。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who spends money wastefully or without restraint.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 花钱缺乏节制、随意挥霍钱财的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li taħli l-flus jew tonfoqhom bla rażan.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 挥霍钱财的人；花钱无度的人。

formal.mt: Il-karattru ewlieni tar-rumanz huwa berbieq li jonfoq il-paga kollha tiegħu fuq affarijiet li ma jeħtieġx.
formal.en: The novel's main character is a spendthrift who spends his entire salary on things he does not need.
formal.zh: 小说的主人公是个挥霍者，把全部工资都花在不需要的东西上。

colloquial.mt: Marta: Għadek kemm xtrajt żewġ arloġġi oħra? Simon: Iva, u issa ma fadallix flus. Marta: Qed tkun berbieq; aħseb qabel tixtri.
colloquial.en: Marta: Have you just bought two more watches? Simon: Yes, and now I have no money left. Marta: You are being a spendthrift; think before you buy.
colloquial.zh: 玛尔塔：你刚刚又买了两块手表？西蒙：是啊，现在我没钱了。玛尔塔：你这样太挥霍了，买之前先想一想。

messages.speaker: Marta (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għadek kemm xtrajt żewġ arloġġi oħra?
messages.mt_standard: Għadek kemm xtrajt żewġ arloġġi oħra?
messages.zh: 你刚刚又买了两块手表？
messages.en: Have you just bought two more watches?

messages.speaker: Simon (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, u issa ma fadallix flus.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, u issa ma fadallix flus.
messages.zh: 是啊，现在我没钱了。
messages.en: Yes, and now I have no money left.

messages.speaker: Marta (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Qed tkun berbieq; aħseb qabel tixtri.
messages.mt_standard: Qed tkun berbieq; aħseb qabel tixtri.
messages.zh: 你这样太挥霍了，买之前先想一想。
messages.en: You are being a spendthrift; think before you buy.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象工资刚到账就被一个人全部花光，把 berbieq 贴在这个人物旁边，牢牢记住它是指挥霍者的名词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Extravagant or wasteful in spending money.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容花钱奢侈浪费、缺乏节制的人或行为。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jaħli l-flus jew jonfoqhom b'mod eċċessiv u bla rażan.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 奢侈浪费的；花费过度的。
挥霍无度的；肆意浪费钱财的。
形容人挥霍钱财、花钱没有节制的。

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi l-infiq bħala berbieqi għax intefqu ħafna flus fuq affarijiet mhux meħtieġa.
formal.en: The report describes the spending as extravagant because a great deal of money was spent on unnecessary things.
formal.zh: 报告将这笔开支描述为挥霍性支出，因为大量资金花在了不必要的东西上。

colloquial.mt: Elena: Għaliex xtrajt tant affarijiet li ma tużax? Karl: Kont berbieqi dan ix-xahar. Ix-xahar id-dieħel se nonfoq inqas.
colloquial.en: Elena: Why did you buy so many things you do not use? Karl: I was extravagant this month. Next month I will spend less.
colloquial.zh: 埃莱娜：你为什么买这么多用不上的东西？卡尔：我这个月太挥霍了。下个月我要少花一些。

messages.speaker: Elena (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex xtrajt tant affarijiet li ma tużax?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex xtrajt tant affarijiet li ma tużax?
messages.zh: 你为什么买这么多用不上的东西？
messages.en: Why did you buy so many things you do not use?

messages.speaker: Karl (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Kont berbieqi dan ix-xahar. Ix-xahar id-dieħel se nonfoq inqas.
messages.mt_standard: Kont berbieqi dan ix-xahar. Ix-xahar id-dieħel se nonfoq inqas.
messages.zh: 我这个月太挥霍了。下个月我要少花一些。
messages.en: I was extravagant this month. Next month I will spend less.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 berbieq 记成“挥霍者”，把 berbieqi 放进“挥霍的开支”里对照练习，用句中功能区分名词和形容词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who steals small things or things of little value.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 偷取小件物品或低价值东西的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li tisraq affarijiet żgħar jew ta' ftit valur.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 偷取小件物品或少量财物的小偷。
偷偷拿走小件物品、顺手牵羊的人。

collocations.en: a petty thief in the shop

formal.mt: Is-sid tal-ħanut qabad berbiex li kien qed jisraq oġġetti żgħar minn fuq l-ixkaffa.
formal.en: The shop owner caught a petty thief who was stealing small items from the shelf.
formal.zh: 店主抓住了一个正在从货架上偷小件物品的小偷。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex qed iżżomm għajnejk fuq dak ir-raġel? Toni: Għax ilbieraħ qbadtu jisraq pakkett ħelu; hu berbiex.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why are you keeping an eye on that man? Toni: Because yesterday I caught him stealing a packet of sweets; he's a petty thief.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你为什么一直盯着那个男人？托尼：因为昨天我抓到他偷一包糖；他是个小偷。

messages.speaker: Maja (店员)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex qed iżżomm għajnejk fuq dak ir-raġel?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex qed iżżomm għajnejk fuq dak ir-raġel?
messages.zh: 你为什么一直盯着那个男人？
messages.en: Why are you keeping an eye on that man?

messages.speaker: Toni (店主)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax ilbieraħ qbadtu jisraq pakkett ħelu; hu berbiex.
messages.mt_standard: Għax ilbieraħ qbadtu jisraq pakkett ħelu; hu berbiex.
messages.zh: 因为昨天我抓到他偷一包糖；他是个小偷。
messages.en: Because yesterday I caught him stealing a packet of sweets; he's a petty thief.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象有人从货架偷偷拿走一包糖，用这个小偷小摸的画面记住 berbiex 指人。

gloss_zh: 惯于小偷小摸的；有偷窃癖的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Describing someone who habitually steals small things or has a compulsion to steal.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容一个人惯于偷取小东西，或有难以克制的偷窃冲动。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu d-drawwa li jisraq affarijiet żgħar jew iħoss ġibda qawwija biex jisraq.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 惯于小偷小摸的，用来形容经常偷拿小东西的人。
有偷窃癖的，用来形容有难以克制的偷窃冲动的人。

collocations.zh: 一个惯于小偷小摸的男人

formal.mt: Fir-rumanz, il-karattru prinċipali huwa berbiexi u ta' spiss jieħu oġġetti żgħar li mhumiex tiegħu.
formal.en: In the novel, the main character habitually pilfers and often takes small objects that do not belong to him.
formal.zh: 在小说中，主人公惯于小偷小摸，经常拿走不属于自己的小物件。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex tgħid li dak il-karattru hu berbiexi? Pawlu: Għax f'kull kapitlu jisraq xi ħaġa żgħira.
colloquial.en: Lara: Why do you say that character is a habitual pilferer? Pawlu: Because in every chapter he steals some small thing.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：你为什么说那个角色惯于小偷小摸？保罗：因为每一章里他都会偷点小东西。

messages.speaker: Lara (读书会成员)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex tgħid li dak il-karattru hu berbiexi?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex tgħid li dak il-karattru hu berbiexi?
messages.zh: 你为什么说那个角色惯于小偷小摸？
messages.en: Why do you say that character is a habitual pilferer?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (读书会成员)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax f'kull kapitlu jisraq xi ħaġa żgħira.
messages.mt_standard: Għax f'kull kapitlu jisraq xi ħaġa żgħira.
messages.zh: 因为每一章里他都会偷点小东西。
messages.en: Because in every chapter he steals some small thing.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 berbiexi 放在人物描述卡上，旁边画反复偷拿小物的动作，记住它描述人的习惯或冲动。

gloss_zh: 不值几个钱的硬币；小钱

teaching_sense.en_definition: A coin that has very little monetary value.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 货币价值很低、不值几个钱的一枚硬币。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Munita li għandha valur żgħir ħafna.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 一枚价值很低、不值几个钱的硬币。

collocations.en: a coin of very little value
collocations.zh: 一枚不值几个钱的硬币

collocations.en: a low-value coin in the pocket

formal.mt: Fil-kaxxa kien hemm biss berbuqa, munita ta' valur żgħir ħafna.
formal.en: There was only a berbuqa in the box, a coin of very little value.
formal.zh: 盒子里只有一枚不值几个钱的硬币。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Sibt xi flus fil-but tal-kowt? Mark: Berbuqa biss; ma nistax nixtri wisq biha.
colloquial.en: Nina: Did you find any money in the coat pocket? Mark: Just a low-value coin; I can't buy much with it.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：你在外套口袋里找到钱了吗？马克：只有一枚小钱；用它买不了多少东西。

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.zh: 你在外套口袋里找到钱了吗？
messages.en: Did you find any money in the coat pocket?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Berbuqa biss; ma nistax nixtri wisq biha.
messages.mt_standard: Berbuqa biss; ma nistax nixtri wisq biha.
messages.zh: 只有一枚小钱；用它买不了多少东西。
messages.en: Just a low-value coin; I can't buy much with it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象翻遍口袋只找到一枚买不了多少东西的硬币，把 berbuqa 与小钱的画面联系起来。

gloss_zh: 爱开玩笑地轻顶别人的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Describing someone who often nudges other people playfully.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容一个人经常为了逗趣而轻轻顶碰别人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li spiss jagħti daqqiet ħfief lil ħaddieħor bil-minkeb jew bl-ispalla biex jiċċajta.

sense_translations.en_definition: sb. who frequently nudges others playfully
sense_translations.zh_definition: 爱开玩笑地轻顶别人的，用来形容经常以轻轻顶碰他人来逗趣的人。

collocations.en: a boy who often nudges others playfully
collocations.zh: 一个爱轻顶别人逗趣的男孩

collocations.en: a friend who often nudges others playfully
collocations.zh: 一个爱轻顶别人开玩笑的朋友

formal.mt: Fir-rakkont, it-tifel huwa berbux u spiss jagħti daqqa ħafifa bil-minkeb lil sieħbu biex jiċċajta.
formal.en: In the story, the boy often nudges others playfully and frequently gives his friend a gentle elbow nudge as a joke.
formal.zh: 在故事中，那个男孩爱轻顶别人逗趣，经常用胳膊肘轻碰朋友来开玩笑。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Kemm int berbux! Erġajt tajtni daqqa bil-minkeb. Ben: Kont qed niċċajta; issa nieqaf.
colloquial.en: Sara: You do love nudging people! You nudged me with your elbow again. Ben: I was joking; I'll stop now.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：你真爱轻顶别人逗趣！你又用胳膊肘碰我了。本：我是在开玩笑；我现在就停。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Kemm int berbux! Erġajt tajtni daqqa bil-minkeb.
messages.mt_standard: Kemm int berbux! Erġajt tajtni daqqa bil-minkeb.
messages.zh: 你真爱轻顶别人逗趣！你又用胳膊肘碰我了。
messages.en: You do love nudging people! You nudged me with your elbow again.

messages.speaker: Ben (朋友)
messages.zh: 我是在开玩笑；我现在就停。
messages.en: I was joking; I'll stop now.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象朋友笑着用胳膊肘轻顶你一下，以这个逗趣动作记住 berbux 描述人的行为习惯。

gloss_zh: 灰色的；灰烬色的，尤指猫

teaching_sense.en_definition: Grey or ash-grey in colour, especially when describing a cat.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 颜色呈灰色或灰烬般的灰色，尤其用于描述猫。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ta' lewn griż jew griż bħall-irmied, speċjalment meta jingħad dwar qattus.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 灰色的。
灰烬色的，尤其用于形容猫的毛色。

formal.mt: Ir-ritratt juri qattus berbuxi bilqiegħda ħdejn it-tieqa.
formal.en: The photograph shows an ash-grey cat sitting beside the window.
formal.zh: 照片中，一只灰烬色的猫坐在窗边。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Liema wieħed hu l-qattus tiegħek? Luqa: Dak il-qattus berbuxi ħdejn il-bieb.
colloquial.en: Maja: Which one is your cat? Luqa: That ash-grey cat beside the door.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：哪一只是你的猫？卢卡：门旁边那只灰烬色的猫。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 哪一只是你的猫？
messages.en: Which one is your cat?

messages.speaker: Luqa (猫主人)
messages.zh: 门旁边那只灰烬色的猫。
messages.en: That ash-grey cat beside the door.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给想象中的灰猫挂上 berbuxi 标签，把毛色与灰烬色联系起来，记住这是颜色形容词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An informal name for the devil.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在口语中用来称呼魔鬼的名词。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Isem kollokjali għax-xitan.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 魔鬼的口语称呼。

collocations.en: to be afraid of the devil

formal.mt: F'dan id-djalogu, il-kelliem juża l-kelma 'berbuxu' bħala isem kollokjali għax-xitan.
formal.en: In this dialogue, the speaker uses the word 'berbuxu' as an informal name for the devil.
formal.zh: 在这段对话中，说话人用 berbuxu 作为魔鬼的口语称呼。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Min hu l-berbuxu f'din l-istorja? Nannu: Hu x-xitan; hawn qed jużaw isem kollokjali.
colloquial.en: Anna: Who is the berbuxu in this story? Grandfather: It's the devil; they're using an informal name here.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：这个故事里的 berbuxu 是谁？爷爷：就是魔鬼；这里用的是口语称呼。

messages.speaker: Anna (孙女)
messages.zh: 这个故事里的 berbuxu 是谁？
messages.en: Who is the berbuxu in this story?

messages.speaker: Nannu (爷爷)
messages.mt_spoken: Hu x-xitan; hawn qed jużaw isem kollokjali.
messages.mt_standard: Hu x-xitan; hawn qed jużaw isem kollokjali.
messages.zh: 就是魔鬼；这里用的是口语称呼。
messages.en: It's the devil; they're using an informal name here.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 berbuxu 写进故事人物的对话气泡，旁边画魔鬼，记住它是魔鬼的口语叫法。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A saddle placed on a pack animal to support and secure a load.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 放在驮畜背上，用于承托和固定货物的鞍具。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Sarġ li jitqiegħed fuq dahar annimal biex iżomm u jsostni t-tagħbija.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 驮鞍，放在驮畜背上以承托和固定货物的鞍具。

formal.mt: Il-bidwi poġġa l-berdgħa fuq dahar il-ħmar qabel għabba l-boroż.
formal.en: The farmer placed the packsaddle on the donkey's back before loading the sacks.
formal.zh: 农夫先把驮鞍放到驴背上，然后才装上袋子。

colloquial.mt: Ġużeppi: Ġib il-berdgħa, jekk jogħġbok. Marija: Hawn hi. Se npoġġiha fuq dahar il-ħmar?
colloquial.en: Ġużeppi: Bring the packsaddle, please. Marija: Here it is. Shall I put it on the donkey's back?
colloquial.zh: 朱塞佩：请把驮鞍拿来。玛丽亚：在这里。要我把它放到驴背上吗？

messages.speaker: Ġużeppi (农夫)
messages.zh: 请把驮鞍拿来。
messages.en: Bring the packsaddle, please.

messages.speaker: Marija (农场助手)
messages.mt_spoken: Hawn hi. Se npoġġiha fuq dahar il-ħmar?
messages.mt_standard: Hawn hi. Se npoġġiha fuq dahar il-ħmar?
messages.zh: 在这里。要我把它放到驴背上吗？
messages.en: Here it is. Shall I put it on the donkey's back?

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象驴背上的鞍具承托着两袋货物，把 berdgħa 与驮运货物的具体画面一起记忆。

gloss_zh: 使布边磨散、起毛；给布料缝边

teaching_sense.en_definition: To make a fabric edge fray, or to hem fabric by folding and sewing its edge.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使布料边缘的线头磨散、起毛；也指折起布边并缝好。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Iġiegħel tarf ta' drapp jinħall f'ħjut, jew jitwi u jħit it-tarf tad-drapp.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使布料边缘磨散、起毛或散出线头。
给布料缝边，将边缘折起后缝好。

formal.mt: Il-ħakk kontinwu berfel it-tarf tad-drapp, u ħalla ħjut maħlula.
formal.en: The constant rubbing frayed the edge of the fabric, leaving loose threads.
formal.zh: 持续摩擦使布料边缘磨散，留下了松散的线头。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Il-ħajjat berfel id-drapp? Mark: Iva, it-tarf issa mitwi u meħjut sew.
colloquial.en: Lara: Did the tailor hem the fabric? Mark: Yes, the edge is now folded and neatly sewn.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：裁缝给布料缝边了吗？马克：缝了，边缘现在已经折好并缝整齐了。

messages.speaker: Lara (顾客)
messages.zh: 裁缝给布料缝边了吗？
messages.en: Did the tailor hem the fabric?

messages.speaker: Mark (裁缝店店员)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, it-tarf issa mitwi u meħjut sew.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, it-tarf issa mitwi u meħjut sew.
messages.zh: 缝了，边缘现在已经折好并缝整齐了。
messages.en: Yes, the edge is now folded and neatly sewn.

cognitive_memory_aid: 画两块布边，一块摩擦后散线，一块折起后缝好；用这对画面分别记住 berfel 的两个义项。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who hems fabric or trims its edges with ribbon.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 给布料缝制折边，或用饰带装饰边缘的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li tagħmel il-keffa fid-drapp jew iżżejjen it-truf biż-żigarella.

sense_translations.en_definition: sb. who hems or trims with ribbon
sense_translations.zh_definition: 给布料缝边或用饰带镶边的人。

collocations.en: a skilled worker who hems or trims fabric

formal.mt: Il-berfiel lesta l-keffa tal-purtiera u żejjen it-tarf biż-żigarella.
formal.en: The hemming worker finished the curtain's hem and decorated the edge with ribbon.
formal.zh: 缝边工完成了窗帘的折边，并用饰带装饰了边缘。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Min jista' jagħmel il-keffa ta' din il-purtiera? Pawlu: Il-berfiel tal-ħanut; nista' nieħdok għandu.
colloquial.en: Maja: Who can hem this curtain? Pawlu: The hemming worker at the shop; I can take you to him.
colloquial.zh: Maja：谁能给这幅窗帘缝边？Pawlu：店里的缝边工可以，我可以带你去找他。

messages.speaker: Maja (顾客)
messages.mt_spoken: Min jista' jagħmel il-keffa ta' din il-purtiera?
messages.mt_standard: Min jista' jagħmel il-keffa ta' din il-purtiera?
messages.zh: 谁能给这幅窗帘缝边？
messages.en: Who can hem this curtain?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (店员)
messages.zh: 店里的缝边工可以，我可以带你去找他。
messages.en: The hemming worker at the shop; I can take you to him.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一位工人沿着窗帘边缘缝上饰带，用这个人物画面记住 berfiel 指做缝边工作的人。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Able to have a hem made along its edge.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 边缘能够缝制折边的，用来描述适合做缝边处理的材料或物件。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jista' jsirlu keffa mat-tarf.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 能够缝边或做折边的。

collocations.en: an edge that can be hemmed

formal.mt: Għal dan il-proġett intgħażel drapp berfieli biex tkun tista' ssir keffa pulita.
formal.en: Fabric that can be hemmed was selected for this project so that a neat hem could be made.
formal.zh: 这个项目选用了可以缝边的布料，以便缝出整齐的折边。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Dan id-drapp berfieli? Rita: Iva, tista' tagħmillu keffa pulita.
colloquial.en: Lara: Can this fabric be hemmed? Rita: Yes, you can make a neat hem on it.
colloquial.zh: Lara：这块布可以缝边吗？Rita：可以，你能给它缝出整齐的折边。

messages.speaker: Lara (缝纫学员)
messages.zh: 这块布可以缝边吗？
messages.en: Can this fabric be hemmed?

messages.speaker: Rita (缝纫老师)
messages.zh: 可以，你能给它缝出整齐的折边。
messages.en: Yes, you can make a neat hem on it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 berfieli 写在一块能够折起边缘再缝合的布料旁，记住它描述的是物件可以缝边的性质。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act or process of making a hem along the edge of fabric.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 沿布料边缘制作并缝合折边的动作或工序。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ix-xogħol li bih issir keffa mat-tarf tad-drapp.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 一次缝边操作；制作折边的工序。

formal.mt: Il-berfila bl-idejn saret b'attenzjoni biex il-keffa tkun dritta u pulita.
formal.en: The hand hemming was done carefully so that the hem would be straight and neat.
formal.zh: 手工缝边时操作得很仔细，以确保折边平直整齐。

colloquial.mt: Nina: X'għad fadal biex id-dublett ikun lest? Rita: Berfila biss, u mbagħad tista' tilbsu.
colloquial.en: Nina: What is left before the skirt is ready? Rita: Just the hemming, and then you can wear it.
colloquial.zh: Nina：裙子还差什么才做好？Rita：只差缝边，完成后你就可以穿了。

messages.speaker: Nina (顾客)
messages.mt_spoken: X'għad fadal biex id-dublett ikun lest?
messages.mt_standard: X'għad fadal biex id-dublett ikun lest?
messages.zh: 裙子还差什么才做好？
messages.en: What is left before the skirt is ready?

messages.speaker: Rita (裁缝)
messages.mt_spoken: Berfila biss, u mbagħad tista' tilbsu.
messages.mt_standard: Berfila biss, u mbagħad tista' tilbsu.
messages.zh: 只差缝边，完成后你就可以穿了。
messages.en: Just the hemming, and then you can wear it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象裙子完工前最后一道缝边工序，把 berfila 与正在折边、下针的动作联系起来。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A hamburger: a bun containing a cooked patty, often served with other fillings.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 汉堡包，通常是在圆面包中夹入煎熟的肉饼，并可搭配其他配料的食物。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ħobża tonda b'pulpetta tal-laħam imsajra fin-nofs, li jista' jkollha wkoll ingredjenti oħra.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 汉堡包。

formal.mt: Il-menu jinkludi berger bil-ġobon, servut ma' insalata u patata moqlija.
formal.en: The menu includes a burger with cheese, served with salad and chips.
formal.zh: 菜单上有芝士汉堡包，配沙拉和薯条。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Nixtieq berger bil-ġobon, jekk jogħġbok. Sara: Trid il-patata miegħu?
colloquial.en: Mark: I'd like a burger with cheese, please. Sara: Would you like chips with it?
colloquial.zh: Mark：请给我一个芝士汉堡包。Sara：要配薯条吗？

messages.speaker: Mark (顾客)
messages.zh: 请给我一个芝士汉堡包。
messages.en: I'd like a burger with cheese, please.

messages.speaker: Sara (服务员)
messages.zh: 要配薯条吗？
messages.en: Would you like chips with it?

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 berger 和英语 burger 对照着记，再想象点餐时说 berger bil-ġobon，意思是芝士汉堡包。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To think something over carefully; also, to cause someone to become angry.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 仔细反复思考某件事；也可表示使某人生气，须根据上下文区分。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jaħseb fit-tul dwar xi ħaġa; jista' jfisser ukoll li jġiegħel lil xi ħadd jirrabja.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 反复思量某事；仔细考虑某事。
使某人生气；惹怒某人。

formal.mt: Pawlu bergħen il-proposta qabel ma ta t-tweġiba tiegħu.
formal.en: Pawlu mulled over the proposal before giving his answer.
formal.zh: Pawlu 在答复之前仔细考虑了这项提议。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex Mark irrabja? Sara: Dak il-kumment bergħen lil Mark; ħaseb li kienu qed jidħku bih.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why did Mark get angry? Sara: That comment made Mark angry; he thought they were making fun of him.
colloquial.zh: Maja：Mark 为什么生气了？Sara：那句话惹恼了 Mark，他以为大家在取笑他。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: Mark 为什么生气了？
messages.en: Why did Mark get angry?

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Dak il-kumment bergħen lil Mark; ħaseb li kienu qed jidħku bih.
messages.mt_standard: Dak il-kumment bergħen lil Mark; ħaseb li kienu qed jidħku bih.
messages.zh: 那句话惹恼了 Mark，他以为大家在取笑他。
messages.en: That comment made Mark angry; he thought they were making fun of him.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两个独立画面记忆：面对提议沉思表示反复思量，一句评论让人冒火表示惹怒；不要把两个义项混成一个意思。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Feeling angry, sometimes intensely or to the point of being enraged.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 感到生气或愤怒的；也可描述愤怒程度很强、十分恼怒的状态。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jkun irrabjat, kultant b'rabja qawwija ħafna.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 生气的；愤怒的。
极其愤怒的；勃然大怒的。

formal.mt: Ir-raġel kien bergħieni ħafna wara li sema' l-kumment, iżda wieġeb mingħajr ma għolla leħnu.
formal.en: The man was very angry after hearing the comment, but he replied without raising his voice.
formal.zh: 那个男人听到这句话后非常愤怒，但回答时没有提高嗓门。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għadek bergħieni, Mark? Mark: Iva, imma għandi bżonn ftit ħin biex nikkalma.
colloquial.en: Lara: Are you still angry, Mark? Mark: Yes, but I need a little time to calm down.
colloquial.zh: Lara：Mark，你还在生气吗？Mark：是的，不过我需要一点时间冷静下来。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: Mark，你还在生气吗？
messages.en: Are you still angry, Mark?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, imma għandi bżonn ftit ħin biex nikkalma.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, imma għandi bżonn ftit ħin biex nikkalma.
messages.zh: 是的，不过我需要一点时间冷静下来。
messages.en: Yes, but I need a little time to calm down.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一个皱眉握拳的人，在旁边标上 bergħieni；再加 ħafna，把画面中的怒气调强，帮助记住程度变化。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A plant known in English as fleawort.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一种植物，英语称为 fleawort，中文可称蚤草。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tip ta' pjanta magħrufa bl-Ingliż bħala fleawort.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 蚤草，一种英语称为 fleawort 的植物。

formal.mt: Fl-eżerċizzju tal-botanika, l-istudenti qabblu ritratt tal-bergħudija ma' ritratti ta' pjanti oħra.
formal.en: In the botany exercise, the students compared a photograph of fleawort with photographs of other plants.
formal.zh: 在植物学练习中，学生们把蚤草的照片与其他植物的照片进行了比较。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Din il-pjanta hi bergħudija? Pawlu: Ejja nqabbluha mar-ritratt fil-ktieb biex inkunu ċerti.
colloquial.en: Nina: Is this plant fleawort? Pawlu: Let's compare it with the photograph in the book to make sure.
colloquial.zh: Nina：这株植物是蚤草吗？Pawlu：我们对照一下书里的照片，确认一下吧。

messages.speaker: Nina (学生)
messages.zh: 这株植物是蚤草吗？
messages.en: Is this plant fleawort?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Ejja nqabbluha mar-ritratt fil-ktieb biex inkunu ċerti.
messages.mt_standard: Ejja nqabbluha mar-ritratt fil-ktieb biex inkunu ċerti.
messages.zh: 我们对照一下书里的照片，确认一下吧。
messages.en: Let's compare it with the photograph in the book to make sure.

cognitive_memory_aid: 制作一张植物识别卡，正面写 bergħudija，背面写蚤草和 fleawort，用三语对应记住植物名称。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The chemical element called beryllium.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 化学元素铍，英语名称为 beryllium。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-element kimiku magħruf bl-Ingliż bħala beryllium.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 铍，一种化学元素。

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi l-proprjetajiet tal-berillju u jqabbilhom ma' dawk ta' elementi oħra.
formal.en: The report describes the properties of beryllium and compares them with those of other elements.
formal.zh: 报告描述了铍的性质，并将其与其他元素的性质进行了比较。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Kif ngħid beryllium bil-Malti? Rita: Berillju; ikteb l-isem ħdejn it-traduzzjoni Ċiniża fin-noti tiegħek.
colloquial.en: Maja: How do I say beryllium in Maltese? Rita: Berillju; write the name beside the Chinese translation in your notes.
colloquial.zh: Maja：beryllium 用马耳他语怎么说？Rita：Berillju，把这个名称写在笔记里的中文译名旁边。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.zh: beryllium 用马耳他语怎么说？
messages.en: How do I say beryllium in Maltese?

messages.speaker: Rita (老师)
messages.mt_spoken: Berillju; ikteb l-isem ħdejn it-traduzzjoni Ċiniża fin-noti tiegħek.
messages.mt_standard: Berillju; ikteb l-isem ħdejn it-traduzzjoni Ċiniża fin-noti tiegħek.
messages.zh: Berillju，把这个名称写在笔记里的中文译名旁边。
messages.en: Berillju; write the name beside the Chinese translation in your notes.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 berillju、beryllium、铍并排写成一张三语元素卡，借助前两个词相近的字母排列记住对应关系。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To produce or open flowers; to blossom.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指植物长出或展开花朵，即开花、绽放。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Joħroġ il-fjuri jew jiftaħ il-fjuri tiegħu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 开花；绽放。

formal.mt: Din is-sena, il-lewż berkel kmieni fil-ġnien tal-iskola.
formal.en: This year, the almond tree blossomed early in the school garden.
formal.zh: 今年，学校花园里的杏树很早就开花了。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Rajt il-lewż fil-ġnien? Berkel! Pawlu: Iva, il-fjuri tiegħu sbieħ ħafna.
colloquial.en: Lara: Have you seen the almond tree in the garden? It has blossomed! Pawlu: Yes, its flowers are very beautiful.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：你看到花园里的杏树了吗？它开花了！保罗：看到了，它的花很漂亮。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 你看到花园里的杏树了吗？它开花了！
messages.en: Have you seen the almond tree in the garden? It has blossomed!

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.zh: 看到了，它的花很漂亮。
messages.en: Yes, its flowers are very beautiful.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 berkel 配上花苞打开的连续画面，记住它表示“开花”这个动作；再用 berkil 记开花这一过程。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The chemical element called berkelium.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 化学元素锫的名称，英语为 berkelium。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-element kimiku magħruf bl-isem berkelju.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 锫，一种化学元素。

formal.mt: Fir-rapport, l-isem tal-element inkiteb bħala berkelju.
formal.en: In the report, the element's name was written as berkelju.
formal.zh: 报告中，这种元素的名称写作 berkelju，即锫。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Kif ngħid berkelium bil-Malti? Mark: Berkelju. Huwa isem ta' element kimiku.
colloquial.en: Maja: How do I say berkelium in Maltese? Mark: Berkelju. It is the name of a chemical element.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：berkelium 用马耳他语怎么说？马克：Ber kelju，写作 berkelju。它是一种化学元素的名称。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.zh: berkelium 用马耳他语怎么说？
messages.en: How do I say berkelium in Maltese?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Berkelju. Huwa isem ta' element kimiku.
messages.mt_standard: Berkelju. Huwa isem ta' element kimiku.
messages.zh: Berkelju。它是一种化学元素的名称。
messages.en: Berkelju. It is the name of a chemical element.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 berkelju、berkelium 和“锫”写在同一张元素词卡上，用三语对应记忆，并注意不要与表示开花的 berkel 混淆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The process or occurrence of blossoming.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 植物开花这一过程或现象，作名词使用。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-proċess jew il-fenomenu li fih pjanta toħroġ il-fjuri.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 开花这一过程或现象；花朵的绽放。

collocations.en: the blossoming of the almond tree

formal.mt: L-istudenti osservaw il-berkil tal-lewż fil-ġnien tal-iskola.
formal.en: The students observed the blossoming of the almond tree in the school garden.
formal.zh: 学生们观察了学校花园里杏树开花的过程。

colloquial.mt: Nina: X'qed tieħu ritratti tiegħu? Toni: Tal-berkil tal-lewż; irrid nara kif jinbidel minn jum għal ieħor.
colloquial.en: Nina: What are you taking photos of? Toni: The almond tree's blossoming; I want to see how it changes from day to day.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：你在拍什么？托尼：杏树开花的过程；我想看看它每天有什么变化。

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.zh: 你在拍什么？
messages.en: What are you taking photos of?

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Tal-berkil tal-lewż; irrid nara kif jinbidel minn jum għal ieħor.
messages.mt_standard: Tal-berkil tal-lewż; irrid nara kif jinbidel minn jum għal ieħor.
messages.zh: 杏树开花的过程；我想看看它每天有什么变化。
messages.en: The almond tree's blossoming; I want to see how it changes from day to day.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 berkil 想成一本记录花开过程的相册：它给“开花这件事”命名，是名词；与动作词 berkel 对照着记。

gloss_zh: 用手指搓捻；抓挠后留在指甲下的污屑

teaching_sense.en_definition: To roll or twist something between one's fingers, especially paper or dough.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把东西夹在手指之间搓动或捻卷，尤其指纸张、面团等材料。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Idawwar jew jgerbeb xi ħaġa bejn subgħajh, speċjalment karta jew għaġina.

sense_translations.en_definition: to roll between one's fingers (especially used of materials such as paper or dough)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 在手指之间搓动、捻卷某物，尤其用于纸张或面团等材料。

sense_translations.en_definition: the residue left under nails after scratching one's scalp or skin
sense_translations.zh_definition: 抓挠头皮或皮肤后留在指甲下面的污屑。

collocations.en: rolled a piece of paper between his fingers
rolled the dough between his fingers
collocations.zh: 把面团放在手指之间搓动

collocations.en: residue under the nails after scratching
collocations.zh: 抓挠后留在指甲下的污屑

formal.mt: Waqt l-eżerċizzju, l-istudent bermeċ biċċa karta bejn subgħajh biex jagħmilha rqiqa u twila.
formal.en: During the exercise, the student rolled a piece of paper between his fingers to make it thin and long.
formal.zh: 练习时，学生用手指搓卷一张纸，把它搓成细长条。

colloquial.mt: Luca: Għandi ftit bermeċ taħt id-dwiefer wara li grift rasi. Sara: Aħsel idejk u naddaf taħt id-dwiefer.
colloquial.en: Luca: I have a little residue under my nails after scratching my head. Sara: Wash your hands and clean under your nails.
colloquial.zh: 卢卡：我挠了头，指甲下面留了点污屑。萨拉：洗洗手，再清洁一下指甲下面。

messages.speaker: Luca (孩子)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandi ftit bermeċ taħt id-dwiefer wara li grift rasi.
messages.mt_standard: Għandi ftit bermeċ taħt id-dwiefer wara li grift rasi.
messages.zh: 我挠了头，指甲下面留了点污屑。
messages.en: I have a little residue under my nails after scratching my head.

messages.speaker: Sara (母亲)
messages.mt_spoken: Aħsel idejk u naddaf taħt id-dwiefer.
messages.mt_standard: Aħsel idejk u naddaf taħt id-dwiefer.
messages.zh: 洗洗手，再清洁一下指甲下面。
messages.en: Wash your hands and clean under your nails.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 bermeċ 分设两张图卡：一张画手指搓纸，记动词；另一张画抓挠后指甲下的污屑，记名词，按词性分别掌握。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who twists thread.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把线捻转起来的人，指捻线这一动作的操作者。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li tgħawweġ il-ħajt billi ddawru.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 捻线的人；把线捻转起来的人。

formal.mt: Waqt id-dimostrazzjoni, il-bermieċ wera lill-istudenti kif idawwar il-ħajt.
formal.en: During the demonstration, the thread twister showed the students how he twists the thread.
formal.zh: 示范时，捻线者向学生展示了他如何捻线。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Min hu dak li qed idawwar il-ħajt? Ġanni: Dak il-bermieċ; ejja naraw kif jaħdem.
colloquial.en: Maja: Who is that person twisting the thread? Ġanni: That is the thread twister; let's watch how he works.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：那个正在捻线的人是谁？詹尼：那是捻线者；我们去看看他怎么操作吧。

messages.speaker: Maja (参观者)
messages.mt_spoken: Min hu dak li qed idawwar il-ħajt?
messages.mt_standard: Min hu dak li qed idawwar il-ħajt?
messages.zh: 那个正在捻线的人是谁？
messages.en: Who is that person twisting the thread?

messages.speaker: Ġanni (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Dak il-bermieċ; ejja naraw kif jaħdem.
messages.mt_standard: Dak il-bermieċ; ejja naraw kif jaħdem.
messages.zh: 那是捻线者；我们去看看他怎么操作吧。
messages.en: That is the thread twister; let's watch how he works.

cognitive_memory_aid: 看到 bermieċ，就想象一位双手正在捻线的人，把“人”放在画面中央，提醒自己这个名词指操作者。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Describing a movement that turns around or twists.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容动作带有旋转或扭转的性质。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jiddeskrivi moviment ta' tidwir jew ta' tgħawwiġ.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 旋转的；打转的。
扭转的；捻转的。

formal.mt: L-għalliem wera moviment bermieċi bil-polz waqt id-dimostrazzjoni.
formal.en: The teacher demonstrated a twisting movement of the wrist.
formal.zh: 老师在示范时展示了手腕的扭转动作。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Kif nagħmel dan il-moviment bermieċi? Mark: Dawwar il-polz bil-mod, hekk.
colloquial.en: Rita: How do I make this twisting movement? Mark: Turn your wrist slowly, like this.
colloquial.zh: 丽塔：这个扭转动作怎么做？马克：慢慢转动手腕，像这样。

messages.speaker: Rita (学生)
messages.zh: 这个扭转动作怎么做？
messages.en: How do I make this twisting movement?

messages.speaker: Mark (老师)
messages.zh: 慢慢转动手腕，像这样。
messages.en: Turn your wrist slowly, like this.

cognitive_memory_aid: 读 bermieċi 时用手腕画一个转圈动作，再做一次轻轻扭转；用这两个动作分别记住“旋转的”和“扭转的”。

gloss_zh: 在手指间搓卷成的东西

teaching_sense.en_definition: Something that has been rolled between one's fingers.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 经过手指搓动或捻卷而成的东西，如搓成的小纸卷或面团块。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Xi ħaġa li tkun ġiet imdawra jew imgerbba bejn is-swaba'.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 在手指之间搓动或捻卷而成的东西。
经手指搓卷形成的东西。

collocations.en: a piece of paper rolled between the fingers
a piece of dough rolled between the fingers

formal.mt: Wara li dawwar il-karta bejn subgħajh, l-istudent poġġa l-bermuċ fuq il-mejda.
formal.en: After rolling the paper between his fingers, the student placed the rolled piece on the table.
formal.zh: 学生用手指搓卷纸张后，把搓成的小纸卷放在桌上。

colloquial.mt: Anna: X'inhu dak il-bermuċ f'idek? Ben: Biċċa karta li dawwart bejn subgħajja.
colloquial.en: Anna: What is that rolled thing in your hand? Ben: A piece of paper I rolled between my fingers.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：你手里那个搓成的小东西是什么？本：是我用手指搓卷的一张纸。

messages.speaker: Anna (朋友)
messages.zh: 你手里那个搓成的小东西是什么？
messages.en: What is that rolled thing in your hand?

messages.speaker: Ben (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Biċċa karta li dawwart bejn subgħajja.
messages.mt_standard: Biċċa karta li dawwart bejn subgħajja.
messages.zh: 是我用手指搓卷的一张纸。
messages.en: A piece of paper I rolled between my fingers.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 bermuċ 记成手指搓完后留在掌心的小东西：重点看搓成的物件，再与表示搓卷动作的 bermeċ 对照。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Like lightning in speed; very quick.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容速度像闪电一样快，即迅速、极快的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Mgħaġġel ħafna, bħal berqa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 如闪电般的。
非常快的；极其迅速的。

formal.mt: B'moviment berqi, il-plejer qabad il-ballun qabel ma mess l-art.
formal.en: With a lightning-fast movement, the player caught the ball before it touched the ground.
formal.zh: 球员以闪电般迅速的动作，在球落地之前接住了它。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Rajt dak il-moviment berqi? Toni: Iva! Qabad il-ballun qabel ma stajt inċaqlaq idi.
colloquial.en: Lara: Did you see that lightning-fast movement? Toni: Yes! He caught the ball before I could move my hand.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：你看到那个快如闪电的动作了吗？托尼：看到了！我还没来得及动手，他就接住球了。

messages.speaker: Lara (观众)
messages.zh: 你看到那个快如闪电的动作了吗？
messages.en: Did you see that lightning-fast movement?

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva! Qabad il-ballun qabel ma stajt inċaqlaq idi.
messages.mt_standard: Iva! Qabad il-ballun qabel ma stajt inċaqlaq idi.
messages.zh: 看到了！我还没来得及动手，他就接住球了。
messages.en: Yes! He caught the ball before I could move my hand.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 berqi 配上一道闪电和瞬间接球的画面，记住它是形容词，用“闪电般的”帮助理解“极快的”。

gloss_zh: 闪电闪耀；瞪大眼睛盯着看

teaching_sense.en_definition: To flash as lightning does, or to stare at something with wide-open eyes.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指闪电发出闪光，也可指瞪大眼睛盯着某物看。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jagħmel dawl ta' sajjetta, jew iħares lejn xi ħaġa b'għajnejh miftuħin beraħ.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 闪光，指闪电闪耀。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Jagħmel dawl ta' sajjetta fis-sema.

sense_translations.en_definition: to stare at sth. with wide-open eyes
sense_translations.zh_definition: 瞪大眼睛盯着某物看。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Iħares lejn xi ħaġa b'għajnejh miftuħin beraħ.

collocations.en: he opened his eyes wide and stared

formal.mt: Matul il-maltemp berraq fis-sema, u ftit wara nstema' r-ragħad.
formal.en: During the storm, lightning flashed in the sky, and shortly afterwards thunder was heard.
formal.zh: 暴风雨期间，天空中闪电闪耀，不久后传来了雷声。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Rajtu lil Pawlu meta fetaħ ir-rigal? Lara: Iva, berraq għajnejh u baqa' jħares lejh!
colloquial.en: Maja: Did you see Pawlu when he opened the present? Lara: Yes, he opened his eyes wide and kept staring at it!
colloquial.zh: Maja：你看到Pawlu拆礼物时的样子了吗？Lara：看到了，他瞪大眼睛，一直盯着礼物看！

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Rajtu lil Pawlu meta fetaħ ir-rigal?
messages.mt_standard: Rajtu lil Pawlu meta fetaħ ir-rigal?
messages.zh: 你看到Pawlu拆礼物时的样子了吗？
messages.en: Did you see Pawlu when he opened the present?

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, berraq għajnejh u baqa' jħares lejh!
messages.mt_standard: Iva, berraq għajnejh u baqa' jħares lejh!
messages.zh: 看到了，他瞪大眼睛，一直盯着礼物看！
messages.en: Yes, he opened his eyes wide and kept staring at it!

cognitive_memory_aid: 把两个画面连起来记：天空忽然一闪，人也惊得瞪大双眼；分别对应闪电和瞪视。

gloss_zh: 钻孔；反复琢磨；闷闷不乐或生闷气

teaching_sense.en_definition: To drill a hole, think something over repeatedly, or dwell unhappily on something and sulk.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用工具钻孔；也指反复琢磨某事，或因心事而闷闷不乐、生闷气。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jagħmel toqba b'għodda, jaħseb fit-tul fuq xi ħaġa, jew jibqa' mdejjaq u magħluq fih innifsu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 用钻具钻出一个孔。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Jagħmel toqba permezz ta' għodda għat-tħaffir.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 反复思考、仔细琢磨某事。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Jaħseb fit-tul u għal aktar minn darba fuq xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 因心事而闷闷不乐，或独自生闷气。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Jibqa' jaħseb fuq dak li jdejqu jew iżomm il-geddum.

formal.mt: Il-ħaddiem berren toqba fl-injam biex ikun jista' jwaħħal il-manku.
formal.en: The worker drilled a hole in the wood so that he could attach the handle.
formal.zh: 工人在木头上钻了一个孔，以便安装把手。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għadek taħseb fuq dik l-offerta? Pawlu: Iva, ilni nberren fuqha minn filgħodu u għadni ma ddeċidejtx.
colloquial.en: Maja: Are you still thinking about that offer? Pawlu: Yes, I've been mulling it over since this morning and still haven't decided.
colloquial.zh: Maja：你还在考虑那个提议吗？Pawlu：是啊，我从早上就一直在琢磨，到现在还没决定。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你还在考虑那个提议吗？
messages.en: Are you still thinking about that offer?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, ilni nberren fuqha minn filgħodu u għadni ma ddeċidejtx.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, ilni nberren fuqha minn filgħodu u għadni ma ddeċidejtx.
messages.zh: 是啊，我从早上就一直在琢磨，到现在还没决定。
messages.en: Yes, I've been mulling it over since this morning and still haven't decided.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用钻孔作联想：钻头在木头上反复转，念头也能在脑中反复转；越想越难受时就是闷想或生闷气。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To cause dust to fill a place or cover a person or thing.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使某处充满灰尘，或使人、物的表面蒙上一层灰尘。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jimla post bit-trab jew jgħatti persuna jew ħaġa bit-trab.

sense_translations.en_definition: to fill or coat with dust
sense_translations.zh_definition: 使充满灰尘，或使表面覆盖灰尘。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Jimla jew jgħatti xi ħaġa bit-trab.

formal.mt: Ir-riħ qawwi berrex l-għamara bit-trab li daħal mit-tieqa miftuħa.
formal.en: The strong wind covered the furniture with dust that entered through the open window.
formal.zh: 强风把灰尘从敞开的窗户吹进来，使家具蒙上了一层灰。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex għalaqt it-tieqa? Mark: Ir-riħ berrex il-mejda bit-trab; irrid nerġa' nimsaħha.
colloquial.en: Lara: Why did you close the window? Mark: The wind covered the table with dust; I need to wipe it again.
colloquial.zh: Lara：你为什么把窗户关上了？Mark：风把桌子吹得都是灰，我得再擦一遍。

messages.speaker: Lara (室友)
messages.zh: 你为什么把窗户关上了？
messages.en: Why did you close the window?

messages.speaker: Mark (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ir-riħ berrex il-mejda bit-trab; irrid nerġa' nimsaħha.
messages.mt_standard: Ir-riħ berrex il-mejda bit-trab; irrid nerġa' nimsaħha.
messages.zh: 风把桌子吹得都是灰，我得再擦一遍。
messages.en: The wind covered the table with dust; I need to wipe it again.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象开窗后一阵风，把桌面和家具都铺上薄灰；这个词记的是使东西蒙尘的动作。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A device or container used to cool something or keep it cool.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用于使物品降温或保持凉爽的设备、器具或容器。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Apparat jew reċipjent li jintuża biex ikessaħ xi ħaġa jew iżommha friska.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 冷却器；用于降温或保持低温的器具。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Apparat jew reċipjent għat-tkessiħ.

formal.mt: Fl-uffiċċju tqiegħed berried tal-ilma biex il-ħaddiema jkollhom ilma frisk matul il-ġurnata.
formal.en: A water cooler was installed in the office so that workers would have cool water throughout the day.
formal.zh: 办公室安装了一台饮水冷却器，让员工全天都能喝到凉水。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Fejn nista' nimla l-flixkun bl-ilma frisk? Mark: Hemm berried ħdejn il-bieb; tista' timlieh minn hemm.
colloquial.en: Maja: Where can I fill my bottle with cool water? Mark: There's a cooler by the door; you can fill it there.
colloquial.zh: Maja：我在哪里能给水瓶装点凉水？Mark：门旁边有台饮水冷却器，你可以去那里装。

messages.speaker: Maja (新员工)
messages.mt_spoken: Fejn nista' nimla l-flixkun bl-ilma frisk?
messages.mt_standard: Fejn nista' nimla l-flixkun bl-ilma frisk?
messages.zh: 我在哪里能给水瓶装点凉水？
messages.en: Where can I fill my bottle with cool water?

messages.speaker: Mark (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Hemm berried ħdejn il-bieb; tista' timlieh minn hemm.
messages.mt_standard: Hemm berried ħdejn il-bieb; tista' timlieh minn hemm.
messages.zh: 门旁边有台饮水冷却器，你可以去那里装。
messages.en: There's a cooler by the door; you can fill it there.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 berried 记成办公室里提供凉水的那台设备：这是一个东西的名称，重点是冷却器。

gloss_zh: 有降温作用的；清凉提神的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Having an effect that cools or refreshes someone or something.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 能够带来降温、清凉或提神效果的，用来描述事物产生的作用。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jkollu effett li jkessaħ jew jagħti sens ta' freskezza.

sense_translations.en_definition: having a cooling or refreshing effect
sense_translations.zh_definition: 具有降温作用或令人感到清凉舒爽的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li jkessaħ jew jagħti sens ta' freskezza.

formal.mt: Wara l-mixja fix-xemx, l-ilma frisk kellu effett berriedi fuq il-parteċipanti.
formal.en: After the walk in the sun, the cool water had a refreshing effect on the participants.
formal.zh: 在阳光下步行后，凉水让参加者感到清凉舒爽。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Trid noqogħdu ftit ħdejn it-tieqa? Maja: Iva, minn hemm dieħel riħ berriedi. Nieħu ftit arja!
colloquial.en: Lara: Shall we sit by the window for a while? Maja: Yes, a refreshing breeze is coming in there. I'll get some air!
colloquial.zh: Lara：我们去窗边坐一会儿好吗？Maja：好啊，那里吹进来的风很清爽。我透口气！

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 我们去窗边坐一会儿好吗？
messages.en: Shall we sit by the window for a while?

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, minn hemm dieħel riħ berriedi. Nieħu ftit arja!
messages.mt_standard: Iva, minn hemm dieħel riħ berriedi. Nieħu ftit arja!
messages.zh: 好啊，那里吹进来的风很清爽。我透口气！
messages.en: Yes, a refreshing breeze is coming in there. I'll get some air!

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象热天喝凉水、吹微风后的清爽感觉；berriedi 描述这种降温或提神的效果，是形容词。

gloss_zh: 使动物蹲伏或卧下的人或物，常指使母鸡蹲伏的公鸡

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person or thing that makes an animal squat or lie down, often a cockerel in relation to a hen.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使动物蹲伏或卧下的人或物；常用于指使母鸡蹲伏的公鸡。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna jew ħaġa li ġġiegħel annimal joqgħod kokka jew jimtedd; spiss jingħad għal serduk fir-rigward tat-tiġieġa.

sense_translations.en_definition: sb. or sth. that causes an animal to squat or lie down (often used of a cockerel in relation to the hen)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 使动物蹲伏或卧下的人或物，常用于指相对于母鸡而言、使母鸡蹲伏的公鸡。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Xi ħadd jew xi ħaġa li ġġiegħel annimal joqgħod kokka jew jimtedd, spiss serduk li jġiegħel tiġieġa toqgħod kokka.

collocations.en: the cockerel as the one that makes the hen squat
collocations.zh: 作为使母鸡蹲伏者的公鸡

formal.mt: F'din id-deskrizzjoni, is-serduk jissejjaħ berriek għax iġiegħel lit-tiġieġa toqgħod kokka.
formal.en: In this description, the cockerel is called a berriek because it makes the hen squat.
formal.zh: 在这段描述中，公鸡被称为 berriek，因为它使母鸡蹲伏。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex sejjaħtlu berriek lil dak is-serduk? Pawlu: Għax iġiegħel lit-tiġieġa toqgħod kokka.
colloquial.en: Lara: Why did you call that cockerel a berriek? Pawlu: Because it makes the hen squat.
colloquial.zh: Lara：你为什么把那只公鸡叫作 berriek？Pawlu：因为它会使母鸡蹲伏。

messages.speaker: Lara (农场访客)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex sejjaħtlu berriek lil dak is-serduk?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex sejjaħtlu berriek lil dak is-serduk?
messages.zh: 你为什么把那只公鸡叫作 berriek？
messages.en: Why did you call that cockerel a berriek?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (养鸡人)
messages.zh: 因为它会使母鸡蹲伏。
messages.en: Because it makes the hen squat.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记住一幅公鸡使母鸡蹲伏的画面：这个名词指促成蹲卧动作的一方，也可泛指使动物蹲卧的人或物。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who drills holes, or a person who broods over troubling thoughts.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 钻孔的人；也指总是围着烦心事反复思量、闷闷不乐的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li tagħmel it-toqob b'għodda, jew persuna li tibqa' taħseb fuq dak li jdejjaqha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 钻孔的人；使用钻具打孔者。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Xi ħadd li jagħmel it-toqob permezz ta' għodda.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 因烦心事而反复闷想、闷闷不乐的人。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Xi ħadd li jibqa' jaħseb fuq dak li jdejqu.

collocations.mt: berrien li jibqa' jaħseb fuq l-inkwiet
collocations.en: a brooder who keeps dwelling on worries
collocations.zh: 总是围着烦恼闷想的人

formal.mt: Il-berrien kejjel il-biċċa tal-injam u mmarka l-postijiet tat-toqob qabel ma beda x-xogħol.
formal.en: The hole driller measured the piece of wood and marked the positions of the holes before starting work.
formal.zh: 钻孔者在开始工作前量好了木料，并标出了各个钻孔的位置。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Pawlu baqa' waħdu jaħseb fuq dak li ġara? Lara: Iva, huwa berrien; spiss jibqa' jaħseb fuq dak li jdejqu.
colloquial.en: Maja: Did Pawlu stay on his own thinking about what happened? Lara: Yes, he's a brooder; he often keeps dwelling on what upsets him.
colloquial.zh: Maja：Pawlu一直独自想着发生的事吗？Lara：是啊，他是个爱闷想的人，常常反复想着让他难受的事。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Pawlu baqa' waħdu jaħseb fuq dak li ġara?
messages.mt_standard: Pawlu baqa' waħdu jaħseb fuq dak li ġara?
messages.zh: Pawlu一直独自想着发生的事吗？
messages.en: Did Pawlu stay on his own thinking about what happened?

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, huwa berrien; spiss jibqa' jaħseb fuq dak li jdejqu.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, huwa berrien; spiss jibqa' jaħseb fuq dak li jdejqu.
messages.zh: 是啊，他是个爱闷想的人，常常反复想着让他难受的事。
messages.en: Yes, he's a brooder; he often keeps dwelling on what upsets him.

cognitive_memory_aid: 并排想象两个人：一个拿钻头钻孔，一个低头反复想心事；berrien 的两个义项都指人。

gloss_zh: 闷闷不乐、反复忧思的；萦绕心头、挥之不去的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Dwelling unhappily on troubles, or remaining in the mind in a troubling, persistent way.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容人因烦恼而沉浸在忧思中，或形容某种念头、记忆令人不安而久久难忘。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jibqa' jaħseb fid-dwejjaq tiegħu, jew li jibqa' jħabbat il-moħħ u ma jitwarrabx malajr.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 因烦恼等而闷闷不乐、反复忧思的
令人难以忘怀、持续萦绕心头的，常带有不安感

formal.mt: Fir-rakkont, il-protagonist huwa bniedem berrieni li jibqa' jaħseb fit-telfa tiegħu.
formal.en: In the story, the protagonist is a brooding person who keeps thinking about his loss.
formal.zh: 在故事中，主人公沉浸在忧思里，不断回想自己的损失。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex illum daqshekk berrieni? Pawlu: Għadni naħseb fl-argument tal-bieraħ.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why are you brooding so much today? Pawlu: I'm still thinking about yesterday's argument.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你今天怎么一直闷闷不乐？保罗：我还在想昨天的争吵。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你今天怎么一直闷闷不乐？
messages.en: Why are you brooding so much today?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.zh: 我还在想昨天的争吵。
messages.en: I'm still thinking about yesterday's argument.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 berrieni 配上一幅低头沉思的画面：人困在忧思里，念头则久久萦绕心头，用同一画面串联两个义项。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who looks fixedly at someone or something.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 目光长时间停留在某人或某物上、直盯着看的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li tħares fit-tul u b'għajnejha fissi lejn xi ħadd jew xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 直盯着某人或某物看的人

collocations.en: a person staring at the window

formal.mt: L-awtur jiddeskrivi lir-raġel bħala berrieq li jħares fit-tul lejn kull min jgħaddi.
formal.en: The author describes the man as someone who stares for a long time at everyone who passes.
formal.zh: 作者把这个男人描写成一个会长时间盯着每个过路人看的人。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Dak ir-raġel ilu jħares lejna. Mark: Iva, qisu berrieq; forsi qed jipprova jagħrafna.
colloquial.en: Lara: That man has been staring at us. Mark: Yes, he seems to be quite a starer; perhaps he's trying to recognize us.
colloquial.zh: 劳拉：那个男人一直盯着我们看。马克：是啊，他真爱盯着看；也许他在辨认我们是谁。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 那个男人一直盯着我们看。
messages.en: That man has been staring at us.

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, qisu berrieq; forsi qed jipprova jagħrafna.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, qisu berrieq; forsi qed jipprova jagħrafna.
messages.zh: 是啊，他真爱盯着看；也许他在辨认我们是谁。
messages.en: Yes, he seems to be quite a starer; perhaps he's trying to recognize us.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记 berrieq 时想象一个目光始终不移开的人，并在画面旁写上“盯着看的人”，提醒自己这是指人的名词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who opens doors and windows.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 打开门和窗户的人，可用于说明某人在具体情境中承担的动作或职责。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li tiftaħ il-bibien u t-twieqi.

sense_translations.en_definition: sb. who opens doors and windows
sense_translations.zh_definition: 打开门窗的人。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Xi ħadd li jiftaħ il-bibien u t-twieqi.

formal.mt: F'din l-attività, il-berrieħ huwa l-parteċipant li jiftaħ il-bibien u t-twieqi qabel ma jidħol il-grupp.
formal.en: In this activity, the berrieħ is the participant who opens the doors and windows before the group enters.
formal.zh: 在这项活动中，berrieħ 指在小组进入前打开门窗的那位参加者。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Illum int il-berrieħ tagħna: tiftaħ il-bibien u t-twieqi? Mark: Iva, niftaħhom jien qabel ma jibda l-laqgħa.
colloquial.en: Maja: Today you're our door-and-window opener: will you open them? Mark: Yes, I'll open them before the meeting starts.
colloquial.zh: Maja：今天你来当我们开门窗的人：你把门窗打开好吗？Mark：好，我会在会议开始前打开。

messages.speaker: Maja (活动组织者)
messages.mt_spoken: Illum int il-berrieħ tagħna: tiftaħ il-bibien u t-twieqi?
messages.mt_standard: Illum int il-berrieħ tagħna: tiftaħ il-bibien u t-twieqi?
messages.zh: 今天你来当我们开门窗的人：你把门窗打开好吗？
messages.en: Today you're our door-and-window opener: will you open them?

messages.speaker: Mark (活动志愿者)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, niftaħhom jien qabel ma jibda l-laqgħa.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, niftaħhom jien qabel ma jibda l-laqgħa.
messages.zh: 好，我会在会议开始前打开。
messages.en: Yes, I'll open them before the meeting starts.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把画面定格在伸手打开门窗的那个人身上；berrieħ 指动作的执行者，记住人而不是门窗。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To sing or produce a song-like call, said of certain kinds of birds.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指某些鸟发出鸣唱声或带有歌唱特点的叫声。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kanta jew għamel għanja, kif jingħad għal ċerti tipi ta' għasafar.

sense_translations.en_definition: to sing (used of certain types of birds)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 鸣唱、啼鸣，专用于某些种类的鸟

collocations.en: sang at dawn, of a bird

formal.mt: Mas-sebħ, l-għasfur berwen għal ftit minuti fuq fergħa qrib it-tieqa.
formal.en: At dawn, the bird sang for a few minutes on a branch near the window.
formal.zh: 黎明时，那只鸟在窗边的一根树枝上鸣唱了几分钟。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Smajt lill-għasfur dalgħodu? Ġużeppi: Iva, berwen eżatt ħdejn it-tieqa tiegħi.
colloquial.en: Nina: Did you hear the bird this morning? Ġużeppi: Yes, it sang right beside my window.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：你今天早上听见那只鸟了吗？朱塞佩：听见了，它就在我窗边鸣唱。

messages.speaker: Nina (邻居)
messages.zh: 你今天早上听见那只鸟了吗？
messages.en: Did you hear the bird this morning?

messages.speaker: Ġużeppi (邻居)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, berwen eżatt ħdejn it-tieqa tiegħi.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, berwen eżatt ħdejn it-tieqa tiegħi.
messages.zh: 听见了，它就在我窗边鸣唱。
messages.en: Yes, it sang right beside my window.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 berwen 记成窗边小鸟发出的旋律，联想“鸟儿唱起来”；同时记住这个义项用于某些鸟，不能随意套在人身上。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An asphodel plant.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一种称为阿福花或日光兰的植物。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Pjanta magħrufa bħala asphodel.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 阿福花；日光兰属植物

formal.mt: Waqt il-lezzjoni, l-għalliema wriet ritratt tal-berwieq u talbet lill-istudenti jiddeskrivu l-fjuri u l-weraq tiegħu.
formal.en: During the lesson, the teacher showed a photograph of asphodel and asked the students to describe its flowers and leaves.
formal.zh: 课堂上，老师展示了一张阿福花的照片，请学生描述它的花和叶子。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'jisimha din il-pjanta fir-ritratt? Lara: Berwieq. Ara l-fjuri u l-weraq tagħha.
colloquial.en: Maja: What's this plant in the photograph called? Lara: Asphodel. Look at its flowers and leaves.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：照片里的这种植物叫什么？劳拉：阿福花。你看它的花和叶子。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.zh: 照片里的这种植物叫什么？
messages.en: What's this plant in the photograph called?

messages.speaker: Lara (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Berwieq. Ara l-fjuri u l-weraq tagħha.
messages.mt_standard: Berwieq. Ara l-fjuri u l-weraq tagħha.
messages.zh: 阿福花。你看它的花和叶子。
messages.en: Asphodel. Look at its flowers and leaves.

cognitive_memory_aid: 制作一张植物图片卡，正面写 berwieq，背面写“阿福花／asphodel”，再用“花”和“叶子”两个搭配帮助巩固名称。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To play music on a reed-pipe.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用苇管笛吹奏乐曲或声音。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Daqq fuq betbut, jiġifieri strument tan-nifs magħmul mill-qasab.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 吹奏苇管笛

collocations.en: played a reed-pipe for a few minutes
played a reed-pipe in front of the children
collocations.zh: 在孩子们面前吹奏苇管笛

formal.mt: Matul il-wirja tal-istrumenti, il-mużiċist betbet għal ftit minuti biex juri l-ħoss tal-betbut.
formal.en: During the instrument demonstration, the musician played a reed-pipe for a few minutes to demonstrate its sound.
formal.zh: 在乐器展示中，音乐家吹了几分钟苇管笛，让大家听听这种乐器的声音。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Min daqq dak l-istrument tal-qasab? Mark: Pawlu betbet għalina wara l-ikla.
colloquial.en: Nina: Who played that reed instrument? Mark: Pawlu played the reed-pipe for us after the meal.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：是谁吹了那件苇管乐器？马克：保罗饭后给我们吹了苇管笛。

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.zh: 是谁吹了那件苇管乐器？
messages.en: Who played that reed instrument?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 保罗饭后给我们吹了苇管笛。
messages.en: Pawlu played the reed-pipe for us after the meal.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 betbet 的重复音节想象成两小段笛声，配上“吹奏”的动作；再与指乐器的 betbut 对照，分清动作和物件。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A small wind instrument referred to as a reed-pipe or a fife, according to the sense.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一种吹奏乐器名称，可指苇管笛，也可指横吹小笛。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Strument tan-nifs: pajp tal-qasab jew flawt żgħir li jindaqq mill-ġenb, skont it-tifsira.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 苇管笛，一种用苇管制成的吹奏乐器
横吹小笛，一种小型横吹管乐器

collocations.en: to play the reed-pipe or fife
collocations.zh: 吹奏苇管笛或横吹小笛

collocations.en: the sound of the reed-pipe or fife
collocations.zh: 苇管笛或横吹小笛的声音

formal.mt: Fil-lezzjoni tal-mużika, l-għalliem spjega li l-kelma betbut tista' tirreferi għal pajp tal-qasab jew għal flawt żgħir li jindaqq mill-ġenb.
formal.en: In the music lesson, the teacher explained that the word betbut can refer to a reed-pipe or to a small flute played sideways.
formal.zh: 音乐课上，老师解释说，betbut 一词可以指苇管笛，也可以指横吹的小笛。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Xi strument se ddoqq illum? Pawlu: Il-betbut. Trid tisma' melodija qasira?
colloquial.en: Lara: What instrument are you going to play today? Pawlu: The reed-pipe. Would you like to hear a short tune?
colloquial.zh: 劳拉：你今天要演奏什么乐器？保罗：苇管笛。你想听一小段曲子吗？

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 你今天要演奏什么乐器？
messages.en: What instrument are you going to play today?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (乐手)
messages.zh: 苇管笛。你想听一小段曲子吗？
messages.en: The reed-pipe. Would you like to hear a short tune?

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象手中拿着一支小笛，在实物标签上写 betbut；把它与表示吹奏动作的 betbet 配对记忆，并保留两种乐器义项。

gloss_zh: 把某物弄平、压扁；使变得丰腴或松垂（尤指脸）

teaching_sense.en_definition: To make something flat, or to make something, especially a face, become fleshy or droopy.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使某物变平或变扁；也可指使某物，尤其是脸，变得丰腴或松垂。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Għamel xi ħaġa ċatta, jew ġiegħel xi ħaġa, speċjalment wiċċ, issir imlaħħma jew imdendla.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 把某物弄平、压平或压扁

sense_translations.en_definition: to make sth. grow fleshy or droopy (especially a face)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 使某物变得丰腴或松垂，尤其指使脸部变得肉多或下垂

collocations.en: made the face fleshy or droopy
collocations.zh: 使脸部变得丰腴或松垂

formal.mt: Fil-ħrafa, is-seħer bettaħ wiċċ ir-re: wiċċu sar imlaħħam u ħaddejh niżlu 'l isfel.
formal.en: In the fairy tale, the spell made the king's face fleshy and droopy: his face grew full and his cheeks sagged.
formal.zh: 在童话中，魔法使国王的脸变得丰腴松垂：他的脸长得肥厚，双颊也耷拉下来。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Min bettaħ l-għaġina? Mark: Pawlu, bil-lembuba. Issa nistgħu naqtgħuha.
colloquial.en: Nina: Who flattened the dough? Mark: Pawlu, with the rolling pin. Now we can cut it.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：谁把面团擀平了？马克：保罗，用擀面杖擀的。现在可以切了。

messages.speaker: Nina (家人)
messages.zh: 谁把面团擀平了？
messages.en: Who flattened the dough?

messages.speaker: Mark (家人)
messages.zh: 保罗，用擀面杖擀的。现在可以切了。
messages.en: Pawlu, with the rolling pin. Now we can cut it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 bettaħ 画两张学习卡：一张是面团被压平，一张是童话人物的脸变得肉多松垂；用两种外形变化分别记住两个义项。

gloss_zh: 喷瓜（Ecballium elaterium），与 faqqus il-ħmir 同义

teaching_sense.en_definition: The squirting cucumber, Ecballium elaterium; another name for faqqus il-ħmir.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 植物喷瓜，学名 Ecballium elaterium；也是 faqqus il-ħmir 的另一名称。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-pjanta Ecballium elaterium, magħrufa wkoll bħala faqqus il-ħmir.

sense_translations.en_definition: synonym of faqqus il-ħmir: squirting cucumber (Ecballium elaterium)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 与 faqqus il-ħmir 同义：喷瓜（Ecballium elaterium）

collocations.en: the fruit of the squirting cucumber

formal.mt: Fl-elenku tal-pjanti, l-isem bettieħ il-ħmir jidher flimkien mal-isem xjentifiku Ecballium elaterium u mas-sinonimu faqqus il-ħmir.
formal.en: In the plant list, the name bettieħ il-ħmir appears alongside the scientific name Ecballium elaterium and the synonym faqqus il-ħmir.
formal.zh: 在植物名录中，bettieħ il-ħmir 与学名 Ecballium elaterium 以及同义名称 faqqus il-ħmir 一同列出。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Fuq din it-tikketta hemm bettieħ il-ħmir. Huwa l-istess bħall-faqqus il-ħmir? Lara: Iva, huma żewġ ismijiet għall-istess pjanta.
colloquial.en: Maja: This label says bettieħ il-ħmir. Is that the same as faqqus il-ħmir? Lara: Yes, they are two names for the same plant.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这个标签上写着 bettieħ il-ħmir。它和 faqqus il-ħmir 是同一种植物吗？劳拉：是的，这是同一种植物的两个名称。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Fuq din it-tikketta hemm bettieħ il-ħmir. Huwa l-istess bħall-faqqus il-ħmir?
messages.mt_standard: Fuq din it-tikketta hemm bettieħ il-ħmir. Huwa l-istess bħall-faqqus il-ħmir?
messages.zh: 这个标签上写着 bettieħ il-ħmir。它和 faqqus il-ħmir 是同一种植物吗？
messages.en: This label says bettieħ il-ħmir. Is that the same as faqqus il-ħmir?

messages.speaker: Lara (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, huma żewġ ismijiet għall-istess pjanta.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, huma żewġ ismijiet għall-istess pjanta.
messages.zh: 是的，这是同一种植物的两个名称。
messages.en: Yes, they are two names for the same plant.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 bettieħ il-ħmir 作为完整植物名记忆，在同一张卡上并列写“喷瓜”和 faqqus il-ħmir，用“一种植物、两个名称”帮助回想。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Melons, considered as fruit to eat or sell.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 甜瓜，指供食用或出售的瓜果。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Frott li jissejjaħ bettiħ, li jinbiegħ u jittiekel.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 甜瓜；甜瓜类瓜果。
驴的睾丸。

formal.mt: Fis-suq jinbiegħ bettiħ frisk għall-konsum.
formal.en: Fresh melons are sold at the market for consumption.
formal.zh: 市场出售供食用的新鲜甜瓜。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Trid ftit bettiħ? Pawlu: Iva, jekk jogħġbok. Biċċa żgħira biżżejjed.
colloquial.en: Marija: Would you like some melon? Pawlu: Yes, please. A small piece is enough.
colloquial.zh: Marija：你想吃点甜瓜吗？Pawlu：好的，谢谢。一小块就够了。

messages.speaker: Marija (朋友)
messages.zh: 你想吃点甜瓜吗？
messages.en: Would you like some melon?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, jekk jogħġbok. Biċċa żgħira biżżejjed.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, jekk jogħġbok. Biċċa żgħira biżżejjed.
messages.zh: 好的，谢谢。一小块就够了。
messages.en: Yes, please. A small piece is enough.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 bettiħ 放进水果摊的画面中，连着记“新鲜甜瓜”和“一块甜瓜”；另一个义项须结合驴的身体语境识别。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Kissing as an activity, or kisses exchanged as a sign of affection.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 亲吻这一行为，或表达亲昵时给予的吻。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att li wieħed ibus, jew il-bews li jingħata bħala sinjal ta' affezzjoni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 亲吻这一行为。
多个吻；亲吻。
吻；一次亲吻。

formal.mt: Il-familja laqgħet lit-tfal b'tgħanniq u bews wara l-vjaġġ twil.
formal.en: The family welcomed the children with hugs and kisses after the long journey.
formal.zh: 漫长的旅程结束后，家人用拥抱和亲吻迎接孩子们。

colloquial.mt: Anna: X'nikteb fl-aħħar tal-kartolina lin-nanna? Marija: Ikteb: 'Ħafna bews mingħandna lkoll!'
colloquial.en: Anna: What should I write at the end of the postcard to Grandma? Marija: Write: 'Lots of kisses from all of us!'
colloquial.zh: Anna：给奶奶的明信片末尾写什么好？Marija：写：“我们大家送上许多亲吻！”

messages.speaker: Anna (女儿)
messages.zh: 给奶奶的明信片末尾写什么好？
messages.en: What should I write at the end of the postcard to Grandma?

messages.speaker: Marija (母亲)
messages.zh: 写：“我们大家送上许多亲吻！”
messages.en: Write: 'Lots of kisses from all of us!'

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 bews 记在明信片结尾“送上许多吻”中；它既能表示亲吻行为，也能表示吻，数量须看语境。

teaching_sense.en_definition: One kiss: a single instance of kissing someone or something.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一个吻，即亲吻某人或某物的一次动作。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Att wieħed ta' meta wieħed ibus lil xi ħadd jew xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 一个吻，即一次亲吻。

formal.mt: Qabel it-tluq, it-tifla tat bewsa fuq il-ħaddejn lil ommha.
formal.en: Before leaving, the girl gave her mother a kiss on the cheek.
formal.zh: 离开前，女孩在母亲的脸颊上亲了一下。

colloquial.mt: Nanna Rita: Tagħtini bewsa qabel tmur? Lara: Żgur, nanna! Narak għada.
colloquial.en: Grandma Rita: Will you give me a kiss before you go? Lara: Of course, Grandma! See you tomorrow.
colloquial.zh: Rita奶奶：走之前给我一个吻好吗？Lara：当然，奶奶！明天见。

messages.speaker: Rita (奶奶)
messages.zh: 走之前给我一个吻好吗？
messages.en: Will you give me a kiss before you go?

messages.speaker: Lara (孙女)
messages.zh: 当然，奶奶！明天见。
messages.en: Of course, Grandma! See you tomorrow.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象离别前在脸颊上轻亲一下，把 bewsa 与明确的“一个吻、亲一下”绑定记忆。

gloss_zh: 犹大之吻；假意示好而实际背叛的行为

teaching_sense.en_definition: An act of betrayal disguised as kindness or affection.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 表面上表示友善或亲近，实际上却实施背叛的行为。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Att ta' tradiment moħbi taħt dehra ta' tjubija jew affezzjoni.

sense_translations.en_definition: Judas kiss (act of treachery under the guise of kindness)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 犹大之吻，即假借善意而实施背叛的行为。

collocations.zh: 属于伪装成善意的背叛

formal.mt: L-offerta ta' għajnuna kienet bewsa ta' Ġuda: min għamilha mbagħad kixef l-informazzjoni kunfidenzjali.
formal.en: The offer of help was a Judas kiss: the person who made it later disclosed the confidential information.
formal.zh: 那次主动提供帮助是一个犹大之吻：提出帮助的人随后泄露了机密信息。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Qalli li kien se jgħinni, imbagħad qal is-sigriet tiegħi lil kulħadd. Mark: Dik kienet bewsa ta' Ġuda.
colloquial.en: Lara: He told me he would help me, then told everyone my secret. Mark: That was a Judas kiss.
colloquial.zh: Lara：他说会帮我，接着却把我的秘密告诉了所有人。Mark：那就是假意示好、实际背叛的犹大之吻。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Qalli li kien se jgħinni, imbagħad qal is-sigriet tiegħi lil kulħadd.
messages.mt_standard: Qalli li kien se jgħinni, imbagħad qal is-sigriet tiegħi lil kulħadd.
messages.zh: 他说会帮我，接着却把我的秘密告诉了所有人。
messages.en: He told me he would help me, then told everyone my secret.

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 那就是假意示好、实际背叛的犹大之吻。
messages.en: That was a Judas kiss.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把整个短语记成“脸上送吻，行动背叛”：关键是善意的外表包着背叛，不必理解为真的亲吻。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To loosen something, make it gape open, or make it hollow inside.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使某物松开、张开口，或使其内部形成空腔。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jagħmel xi ħaġa inqas issikkata, iġiegħelha tinfetaħ beraħ, jew jagħmilha vojta minn ġewwa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 弄松；使不再紧绷或紧固。
使张开；使裂口或开口敞开。
使中空；使内部形成空腔。

formal.mt: L-artiġjan bewwaq iz-zokk biex jagħmel skutella tal-injam.
formal.en: The craftsman hollowed out the trunk to make a wooden bowl.
formal.zh: 工匠掏空树干，制作了一个木碗。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex bewwaqt il-ħjata? Pawlu: Għax il-libsa kienet issikkata wisq; hekk tkun aktar komda.
colloquial.en: Lara: Why did you loosen the seam? Pawlu: Because the dress was too tight; this way it will be more comfortable.
colloquial.zh: Lara：你为什么把接缝放松了？Pawlu：因为这条裙子太紧了，这样穿起来会更舒服。

messages.speaker: Lara (顾客)
messages.zh: 你为什么把接缝放松了？
messages.en: Why did you loosen the seam?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (裁缝)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax il-libsa kienet issikkata wisq; hekk tkun aktar komda.
messages.mt_standard: Għax il-libsa kienet issikkata wisq; hekk tkun aktar komda.
messages.zh: 因为这条裙子太紧了，这样穿起来会更舒服。
messages.en: Because the dress was too tight; this way it will be more comfortable.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 bewwaq 配三个动作画面：放松接缝、撑开口子、挖出空腔；用动作区分三个义项，别只记一个“空”字。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To empty something by removing what is inside it.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 移走某物里面的内容物，使其变空。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ineħħi dak li hemm ġewwa xi ħaġa u jagħmilha vojta.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 倒空；清空；使内部变空。

formal.mt: Il-ħaddiem bewwaħ il-barmil qabel ma ħaslu.
formal.en: The worker emptied the bucket before washing it.
formal.zh: 工人在清洗桶之前先把它倒空了。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Min bewwaħ il-barmil? Pawlu: Jien. Issa nistgħu nimlewh bl-ilma nadif.
colloquial.en: Marija: Who emptied the bucket? Pawlu: I did. Now we can fill it with clean water.
colloquial.zh: Marija：谁把桶倒空了？Pawlu：是我。现在我们可以往里面装干净的水了。

messages.speaker: Marija (同事)
messages.zh: 谁把桶倒空了？
messages.en: Who emptied the bucket?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Jien. Issa nistgħu nimlewh bl-ilma nadif.
messages.mt_standard: Jien. Issa nistgħu nimlewh bl-ilma nadif.
messages.zh: 是我。现在我们可以往里面装干净的水了。
messages.en: I did. Now we can fill it with clean water.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象把桶里的水全部倒出去，桶内变空；用“移走内容物”的动作记 bewwaħ。

gloss_zh: 逐门走访；挨家挨户地走

teaching_sense.en_definition: To go from one door or house to another, visiting them in succession.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 从一扇门或一户人家走到下一处，逐门逐户地走访。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Imur minn bieb għal ieħor jew minn dar għal oħra, wieħed wara l-ieħor.

sense_translations.en_definition: to go from one door or house to another
sense_translations.zh_definition: 从一扇门走到另一扇门，或从一户人家走到另一户；挨家挨户地走。

collocations.en: went from door to door to distribute notices
went from house to house to collect aid
collocations.zh: 挨家挨户走访，募集援助

formal.mt: Il-voluntier bewweb biex iqassam l-avviżi dwar il-laqgħa lir-residenti.
formal.en: The volunteer went from door to door to distribute notices about the meeting to residents.
formal.zh: 志愿者逐门走访，向居民分发会议通知。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Għaliex Mario għadu barra? Rita: Illum bewweb biex jistieden lill-ġirien għal-laqgħa; għad fadallu żewġt idjar.
colloquial.en: Anna: Why is Mario still out? Rita: Today he has been going from house to house to invite the neighbours to the meeting; he still has two houses left.
colloquial.zh: Anna：Mario怎么还在外面？Rita：他今天挨家挨户邀请邻居参加会议，还剩两户没走到。

messages.speaker: Anna (邻居)
messages.zh: Mario怎么还在外面？
messages.en: Why is Mario still out?

messages.speaker: Rita (邻居)
messages.mt_spoken: Illum bewweb biex jistieden lill-ġirien għal-laqgħa; għad fadallu żewġt idjar.
messages.mt_standard: Illum bewweb biex jistieden lill-ġirien għal-laqgħa; għad fadallu żewġt idjar.
messages.zh: 他今天挨家挨户邀请邻居参加会议，还剩两户没走到。
messages.en: Today he has been going from house to house to invite the neighbours to the meeting; he still has two houses left.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 bewwеб 的动作想成沿街依次走到第一户、第二户、第三户；重点是连续逐户走访，不只是去某一户。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To urinate copiously; also, to cause someone to urinate or to cry a lot.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 大量排尿；也可表示使某人排尿，或哭得很多。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jagħmel ħafna awrina; jista' jfisser ukoll iġiegħel lil xi ħadd jagħmel l-awrina jew jibki ħafna.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 大量排尿。
使某人或某动物排尿。
大哭；哭得很多。

formal.mt: Skont in-nota ta' osservazzjoni, il-kelb bewwel ħafna wara li xorob l-ilma.
formal.en: According to the observation note, the dog urinated copiously after drinking water.
formal.zh: 根据观察记录，这只狗喝水后排了很多尿。

colloquial.mt: Marta: Għaliex waqaft bil-kelb? Pawlu: Għax bewwel ħafna fil-ħaxix.
colloquial.en: Marta: Why did you stop with the dog? Pawlu: Because he urinated a lot in the grass.
colloquial.zh: 玛尔塔：你怎么带着狗停下来了？保罗：因为它在草地上排了很多尿。

messages.speaker: Marta (朋友)
messages.zh: 你怎么带着狗停下来了？
messages.en: Why did you stop with the dog?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (养狗人)
messages.zh: 因为它在草地上排了很多尿。
messages.en: Because he urinated a lot in the grass.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把这个词放进“小狗停在草地上排了很多尿”的画面中记忆；另外单独记住“使排尿”和“大哭”两个义项，遇到句子时靠上下文判断。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To kiss someone repeatedly, giving several kisses.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 接连亲吻某人，表示亲了多次。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jagħti ħafna bews lil xi ħadd, wieħed wara l-ieħor.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 反复亲吻；接连亲上好几次。

collocations.en: kissed his mother repeatedly on her cheeks
collocations.zh: 在母亲脸颊上亲了又亲

formal.mt: Meta reġa' ltaqa' ma' ommu wara żmien twil, binha bewwes lil ommu fuq ħaddejha.
formal.en: When he was reunited with his mother after a long time, her son kissed her repeatedly on her cheeks.
formal.zh: 久别重逢时，儿子在母亲的脸颊上亲了又亲。

colloquial.mt: Lara: X'għamel in-nannu meta ra lit-tarbija? Nina: Bewwes lit-tarbija u beda jidħak.
colloquial.en: Lara: What did Grandpa do when he saw the baby? Nina: He kissed the baby repeatedly and started laughing.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：爷爷看到宝宝后做了什么？妮娜：他亲了宝宝好几下，然后笑了起来。

messages.speaker: Lara (家人)
messages.zh: 爷爷看到宝宝后做了什么？
messages.en: What did Grandpa do when he saw the baby?

messages.speaker: Nina (家人)
messages.zh: 他亲了宝宝好几下，然后笑了起来。
messages.en: He kissed the baby repeatedly and started laughing.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象爷爷见到宝宝，左边亲一下、右边再亲一下；用“亲了又亲”的连续动作记住这个词，突出反复亲吻的意思。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To put something into one's pocket.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把某物装进自己的口袋。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Idaħħal xi ħaġa fil-but tiegħu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 把某物放进口袋；将某物揣进口袋。

formal.mt: Wara li għalaq il-bieb tal-uffiċċju, il-ħaddiem bewwet iċ-ċavetta u telaq.
formal.en: After closing the office door, the worker pocketed the key and left.
formal.zh: 关上办公室的门后，工作人员把钥匙揣进口袋，离开了。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Fejn marret iċ-ċavetta? Toni: Pawlu bewwet iċ-ċavetta qabel ħareġ.
colloquial.en: Marija: Where did the key go? Toni: Pawlu pocketed the key before he went out.
colloquial.zh: 玛丽亚：钥匙去哪儿了？托尼：保罗出门前把钥匙揣进口袋了。

messages.speaker: Marija (室友)
messages.zh: 钥匙去哪儿了？
messages.en: Where did the key go?

messages.speaker: Toni (室友)
messages.zh: 保罗出门前把钥匙揣进口袋了。
messages.en: Pawlu pocketed the key before he went out.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“关门、拿钥匙、揣进口袋、出门”这一串动作记忆；读到这个词，就想象手把钥匙送进口袋的瞬间。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who urinates frequently.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 经常排尿、排尿次数较多的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li tagħmel l-awrina ta' spiss.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 排尿频繁的人；经常需要小便的人。

collocations.mt: bewwiel li jmur ta' spiss it-tojlit
collocations.en: a frequent urinator who often goes to the toilet
a frequent urinator who gets up at night
collocations.zh: 夜里起床小便的尿频者

formal.mt: Fir-rakkont, il-bewwiel jitlob diversi waqfiet matul il-vjaġġ għax ikollu bżonn imur it-tojlit ta' spiss.
formal.en: In the story, the frequent urinator asks for several stops during the journey because he often needs to go to the toilet.
formal.zh: 故事中，这名排尿频繁的人在旅途中多次要求停车，因为他经常需要上厕所。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Xi jfisser bewwiel? Ben: Xi ħadd li jagħmel l-awrina ta' spiss.
colloquial.en: Maja: What does bewwiel mean? Ben: Someone who urinates frequently.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：bewwiel 是什么意思？本：指经常排尿的人。

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.zh: bewwiel 是什么意思？
messages.en: What does bewwiel mean?

messages.speaker: Ben (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Xi ħadd li jagħmel l-awrina ta' spiss.
messages.mt_standard: Xi ħadd li jagħmel l-awrina ta' spiss.
messages.zh: 指经常排尿的人。
messages.en: Someone who urinates frequently.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象旅途中一个人反复请求停车上厕所，把这个词记成“排尿频繁的那个人”；注意这里强调次数多，记忆重点放在“人”和“频繁”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A public toilet available for people to use.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 供公众使用的厕所。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tojlit pubbliku li jista' jintuża min-nies.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 公共厕所；公厕。

collocations.en: a public toilet near the square

formal.mt: Il-pjanta tal-park turi bewwiela ħdejn id-daħla prinċipali għall-użu tal-viżitaturi.
formal.en: The park map shows a public toilet near the main entrance for visitors to use.
formal.zh: 公园平面图标出了主入口附近供游客使用的公共厕所。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Skużani, hemm bewwiela hawn viċin? Rita: Iva, hemm waħda ħdejn il-pjazza.
colloquial.en: Mark: Excuse me, is there a public toilet nearby? Rita: Yes, there's one near the square.
colloquial.zh: 马克：打扰一下，这附近有公共厕所吗？丽塔：有，广场旁边就有一个。

messages.speaker: Mark (游客)
messages.zh: 打扰一下，这附近有公共厕所吗？
messages.en: Excuse me, is there a public toilet nearby?

messages.speaker: Rita (当地居民)
messages.zh: 有，广场旁边就有一个。
messages.en: Yes, there's one near the square.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把这个词写在脑海中的公园地图上，位置就在公共厕所图标旁；与 bewwiel 对照记忆：本词条表示一个公共场所。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Promoting or causing urination; diuretic.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 具有促进排尿或引起排尿作用的，即利尿的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jżid il-ħruġ tal-awrina jew iġiegħel lil xi ħadd jagħmel l-awrina.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 利尿的；促进尿液排出的。
引起排尿的；促使排尿的。

collocations.zh: 利尿剂；促使排尿的物质

formal.mt: Fil-glossarju, it-terminu bewwieli jiddeskrivi effett li jżid il-ħruġ tal-awrina jew jikkawża l-awrina.
formal.en: In the glossary, the term bewwieli describes an effect that increases urine output or causes urination.
formal.zh: 在词汇表中，bewwieli 描述增加尿液排出或引起排尿的作用。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Xi jfisser effett bewwieli? Luqa: Ifisser li xi ħaġa żżid il-ħruġ tal-awrina jew iġġiegħlek tagħmel l-awrina.
colloquial.en: Anna: What does a diuretic effect mean? Luqa: It means that something increases urine output or causes you to urinate.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：利尿作用是什么意思？卢卡：意思是某种东西增加尿液排出，或使你排尿。

messages.speaker: Anna (同学)
messages.zh: 利尿作用是什么意思？
messages.en: What does a diuretic effect mean?

messages.speaker: Luqa (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Ifisser li xi ħaġa żżid il-ħruġ tal-awrina jew iġġiegħlek tagħmel l-awrina.
messages.mt_standard: Ifisser li xi ħaġa żżid il-ħruġ tal-awrina jew iġġiegħlek tagħmel l-awrina.
messages.zh: 意思是某种东西增加尿液排出，或使你排尿。
messages.en: It means that something increases urine output or causes you to urinate.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用 effett bewwieli“利尿作用”整组记忆，想象课本上“某物→促进排尿”的箭头；本词是形容词，重点记它描述促使排尿的作用。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who removes material from inside an object to make it hollow.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 从物件内部去除材料、使其形成空腔的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li tneħħi materjal minn ġewwa oġġett biex tagħmlu vojt minn ġewwa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 将某物内部挖空或掏空的人。

collocations.en: a person who hollows out wood
a skilled worker who hollows things out

formal.mt: Il-bewwieq neħħa l-materjal minn ġewwa l-biċċa tal-injam biex joħloq spazju vojt fiha.
formal.en: The worker removed material from inside the piece of wood to create a hollow space.
formal.zh: 掏空工去除了这块木料内部的材料，使其中形成空腔。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Min se jagħmel il-biċċa tal-injam vojta minn ġewwa? Pawlu: Il-bewwieq; hu jaf kif ineħħi l-materjal mingħajr ma jkisser il-biċċa.
colloquial.en: Mark: Who will hollow out the piece of wood? Pawlu: The hollowing worker; he knows how to remove the material without breaking the piece.
colloquial.zh: 马克：谁来把这块木料内部挖空？保罗：掏空工来做；他知道怎样去除内部材料而不把木料弄破。

messages.speaker: Mark (学徒)
messages.mt_spoken: Min se jagħmel il-biċċa tal-injam vojta minn ġewwa?
messages.mt_standard: Min se jagħmel il-biċċa tal-injam vojta minn ġewwa?
messages.zh: 谁来把这块木料内部挖空？
messages.en: Who will hollow out the piece of wood?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (师傅)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-bewwieq; hu jaf kif ineħħi l-materjal mingħajr ma jkisser il-biċċa.
messages.mt_standard: Il-bewwieq; hu jaf kif ineħħi l-materjal mingħajr ma jkisser il-biċċa.
messages.zh: 掏空工来做；他知道怎样去除内部材料而不把木料弄破。
messages.en: The hollowing worker; he knows how to remove the material without breaking the piece.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 bewwieq 配上一幅工人掏空木块的图，记住它指执行挖空工作的人。

gloss_zh: 能使物件中空的；具有挖空能力的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Able to remove material from inside something and make it hollow.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 具有去除物件内部材料、使其变得中空的能力的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu l-ħila jneħħi materjal minn ġewwa xi ħaġa u jagħmilha vojta minn ġewwa.

sense_translations.en_definition: having the ability to make sth. hollow
sense_translations.zh_definition: 具有将某物挖空或使其中空的能力的。

collocations.en: a tool capable of hollowing something out
equipment capable of making something hollow

formal.mt: Għal dan ix-xogħol intgħażel strument bewwieqi li jista' jneħħi materjal minn ġewwa l-oġġett.
formal.en: A tool capable of hollowing was selected for this task to remove material from inside the object.
formal.zh: 这项工作选用了能够掏空物件的工具，以去除物件内部的材料。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Dan l-istrument bewwieqi? Pawlu: Iva, jista' jagħmel il-biċċa vojta minn ġewwa.
colloquial.en: Maja: Can this tool hollow things out? Pawlu: Yes, it can make the piece hollow inside.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这个工具能掏空物件吗？保罗：能，它可以把这块材料内部掏空。

messages.speaker: Maja (学徒)
messages.zh: 这个工具能掏空物件吗？
messages.en: Can this tool hollow things out?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (师傅)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, jista' jagħmel il-biċċa vojta minn ġewwa.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, jista' jagħmel il-biċċa vojta minn ġewwa.
messages.zh: 能，它可以把这块材料内部掏空。
messages.en: Yes, it can make the piece hollow inside.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 bewwieqi 配上标有“能掏空”的工具图，重点记住它描述能力，是形容词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who enjoys kissing others.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 喜欢亲吻别人、乐于用亲吻表达感情的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li tħobb tbus lil ħaddieħor.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 喜欢亲吻的人。

collocations.en: to be someone who likes kissing

formal.mt: Fil-ġrajja, in-nannu huwa deskritt bħala bewwies li juri mħabbtu lejn il-familja bil-bews.
formal.en: In the story, the grandfather is described as someone who likes kissing and expresses his love for his family through kisses.
formal.zh: 故事将祖父描写成一个喜欢亲吻的人，他通过亲吻表达对家人的爱。

colloquial.mt: Maja: In-nannu dejjem jagħtina bewsa meta naslu. Lara: Veru, hu bewwies kbir!
colloquial.en: Maja: Grandpa always gives us a kiss when we arrive. Lara: True, he really loves giving kisses!
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：我们一到，爷爷总会亲我们一下。拉拉：是呀，他可喜欢亲吻了！

messages.speaker: Maja (孙女)
messages.mt_spoken: In-nannu dejjem jagħtina bewsa meta naslu.
messages.mt_standard: In-nannu dejjem jagħtina bewsa meta naslu.
messages.zh: 我们一到，爷爷总会亲我们一下。
messages.en: Grandpa always gives us a kiss when we arrive.

messages.speaker: Lara (孙女)
messages.zh: 是呀，他可喜欢亲吻了！
messages.en: True, he really loves giving kisses!

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一位爱给家人亲吻的爷爷，把 bewwies 记成“爱亲吻的那个人”，突出名词身份。

gloss_zh: 天主教仪式中供人亲吻的圣物

teaching_sense.en_definition: A sacred relic that worshippers kiss during ceremonies in the Roman Catholic Church.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 罗马天主教会宗教仪式中，供信众亲吻的圣物。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Relikwa sagra li l-fidili jbusu waqt ċerimonji fil-Knisja Kattolika Rumana.

sense_translations.en_definition: a sacred relic which is kissed during religious ceremonies in the R.C. Church
sense_translations.zh_definition: 罗马天主教会宗教仪式中供人亲吻的圣物。

collocations.en: the church's sacred relic for kissing
collocations.zh: 教堂中供人亲吻的圣物

formal.mt: Waqt iċ-ċerimonja fil-knisja Kattolika, il-fidili resqu biex ibusu l-bewwiesa.
formal.en: During the ceremony in the Catholic church, the worshippers approached to kiss the sacred relic.
formal.zh: 在天主教堂举行仪式时，信众上前亲吻圣物。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Din il-bewwiesa għal xiex tintuża? Anna: Il-fidili jbusuha waqt iċ-ċerimonja.
