colloquial.en: Mark: What is this sacred relic used for? Anna: Worshippers kiss it during the ceremony.
colloquial.zh: 马克：这件圣物是做什么用的？安娜：信众会在仪式中亲吻它。

messages.speaker: Mark (访客)
messages.zh: 这件圣物是做什么用的？
messages.en: What is this sacred relic used for?

messages.speaker: Anna (教堂志愿者)
messages.zh: 信众会在仪式中亲吻它。
messages.en: Worshippers kiss it during the ceremony.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“信众在仪式中亲吻圣物”的画面记 bewwiesa，卡片上标明它指圣物这一物件。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Fond of kissing other people.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 喜欢亲吻别人的，用来描述人的喜好或习惯。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jħobb ibus lil ħaddieħor.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 喜欢亲吻的；爱接吻的。

collocations.en: a man who is fond of kissing
a father who is fond of giving kisses
collocations.zh: 喜欢用亲吻表达感情的父亲

formal.mt: L-awtur jiddeskrivi lill-karattru bħala raġel bewwiesi li spiss isellem lill-familja tiegħu b'bewsa.
formal.en: The author describes the character as a man fond of kissing who often greets his family with a kiss.
formal.zh: 作者将这个人物描写成一名喜欢亲吻的男子，他经常用亲吻向家人问候。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Missierek bewwiesi? Maja: Iva, dejjem jagħtina bewsa qabel joħroġ.
colloquial.en: Lara: Is your dad fond of giving kisses? Maja: Yes, he always gives us a kiss before going out.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：你爸爸喜欢亲吻家人吗？玛雅：喜欢，他出门前总会亲我们一下。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 你爸爸喜欢亲吻家人吗？
messages.en: Is your dad fond of giving kisses?

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, dejjem jagħtina bewsa qabel joħroġ.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, dejjem jagħtina bewsa qabel joħroġ.
messages.zh: 喜欢，他出门前总会亲我们一下。
messages.en: Yes, he always gives us a kiss before going out.

cognitive_memory_aid: 在“爱亲吻的爸爸”图片旁写 bewwiesi，练习用它描述人的习惯，并记住形容词词性。

gloss_zh: 把钱收入自己口袋的人；制作口袋的人

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who pockets money; also, a person who makes pockets in clothing.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指把钱收入自己口袋的人；也指为衣物制作口袋的人，须依上下文区分。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li ddaħħal il-flus fil-but tagħha; jew persuna li tagħmel il-bwiet fil-ħwejjeġ, skont il-kuntest.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 把钱收入自己口袋、留给自己的人。
制作口袋的人，尤指为衣物制作口袋的人。

collocations.zh: 把钱收入自己口袋的人

collocations.en: a pocket maker in the sewing shop
collocations.zh: 缝纫店里制作口袋的人

formal.mt: Fir-rapport, ir-raġel ġie deskritt bħala bewwiet għax kien iżomm għalih parti mill-flus miġbura.
formal.en: In the report, the man was described as someone who pocketed money because he kept part of the collected funds for himself.
formal.zh: 报告称这名男子是个把钱收入自己口袋的人，因为他将收取的部分款项留给了自己。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Min se jagħmel il-bwiet ta' dan il-ġakkett? Rita: Il-bewwiet li jaħdem magħna; hu jagħmel il-bwiet, u jien inħit il-kmiem.
colloquial.en: Mark: Who will make the pockets for this jacket? Rita: The pocket maker who works with us; he makes the pockets, and I sew the sleeves.
colloquial.zh: 马克：这件夹克的口袋由谁来做？丽塔：和我们一起工作的口袋制作工；他做口袋，我缝袖子。

messages.speaker: Mark (顾客)
messages.mt_spoken: Min se jagħmel il-bwiet ta' dan il-ġakkett?
messages.mt_standard: Min se jagħmel il-bwiet ta' dan il-ġakkett?
messages.zh: 这件夹克的口袋由谁来做？
messages.en: Who will make the pockets for this jacket?

messages.speaker: Rita (裁缝)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-bewwiet li jaħdem magħna; hu jagħmel il-bwiet, u jien inħit il-kmiem.
messages.mt_standard: Il-bewwiet li jaħdem magħna; hu jagħmel il-bwiet, u jien inħit il-kmiem.
messages.zh: 和我们一起工作的口袋制作工；他做口袋，我缝袖子。
messages.en: The pocket maker who works with us; he makes the pockets, and I sew the sleeves.

cognitive_memory_aid: 为 bewwiet 画两张情境卡：一人把钱放进自己口袋，另一人缝制衣袋；用上下文辨别两个名词义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who takes part in intrigues or secret schemes.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 参与阴谋、暗中谋划或勾心斗角的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li tinvolvi ruħha f'intriċċi u manuvri sigrieti.

sense_translations.en_definition: sb. who involves themself in intrigues
sense_translations.zh_definition: 参与阴谋诡计或勾心斗角的人。

collocations.en: a person involved in political intrigues

formal.mt: Fir-rumanz, il-bewwieġ jorganizza laqgħat sigrieti biex idgħajjef lill-avversarji tiegħu.
formal.en: In the novel, the intriguer organizes secret meetings to weaken his opponents.
formal.zh: 小说中，这名参与阴谋的人组织秘密会议，以削弱自己的对手。

colloquial.mt: Sara: X'tip ta' karattru hu dak fir-rumanz? Mark: Hu bewwieġ; dejjem jinvolvi ruħu f'intriċċi.
colloquial.en: Sara: What kind of character is that in the novel? Mark: He's an intriguer; he's always getting involved in secret schemes.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：小说里的那个人物是什么样的人？马克：他是个参与阴谋的人，总是卷入各种暗中谋划。

messages.speaker: Sara (读书会成员)
messages.mt_spoken: X'tip ta' karattru hu dak fir-rumanz?
messages.mt_standard: X'tip ta' karattru hu dak fir-rumanz?
messages.zh: 小说里的那个人物是什么样的人？
messages.en: What kind of character is that in the novel?

messages.speaker: Mark (读书会成员)
messages.mt_spoken: Hu bewwieġ; dejjem jinvolvi ruħu f'intriċċi.
messages.mt_standard: Hu bewwieġ; dejjem jinvolvi ruħu f'intriċċi.
messages.zh: 他是个参与阴谋的人，总是卷入各种暗中谋划。
messages.en: He's an intriguer; he's always getting involved in secret schemes.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象小说里总在秘密会议中出现的人，把这个名词记成“那个参与阴谋的人”；与形容词 bewwieġi 配对辨认，先记清这里指的是人。

gloss_zh: 参与暗中勾当的；惯于暗中交易的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Describing someone who gets involved in underhand dealings.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容参与暗中勾当、不光明交易或秘密算计的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jinvolvi ruħu f'affarijiet moħbija u f'negozjati diżonesti.

sense_translations.en_definition: sb. who gets involved in underhand dealings
sense_translations.zh_definition: 形容会参与暗中勾当或不光明交易的人。

collocations.en: a man involved in underhand dealings
a businessman involved in underhand dealings
collocations.zh: 从事不光明交易的商人

formal.mt: Fir-rakkont, negozjant bewwieġi jagħmel ftehimiet sigrieti biex jikseb vantaġġ fuq il-kompetituri tiegħu.
formal.en: In the story, a businessman involved in underhand dealings makes secret agreements to gain an advantage over his competitors.
formal.zh: 故事中，一名惯于暗中交易的商人订立秘密协议，以取得对竞争者的优势。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex ma tafdax lil dak il-karattru? Ninu: Għax hu bewwieġi u dejjem jagħmel ftehimiet minn wara dahar ħaddieħor.
colloquial.en: Lara: Why don't you trust that character? Ninu: Because he's underhanded and always makes deals behind other people's backs.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：你为什么不信任那个人物？尼努：因为他惯于搞暗中勾当，总是背着别人做交易。

messages.speaker: Lara (读书会成员)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex ma tafdax lil dak il-karattru?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex ma tafdax lil dak il-karattru?
messages.zh: 你为什么不信任那个人物？
messages.en: Why don't you trust that character?

messages.speaker: Ninu (读书会成员)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax hu bewwieġi u dejjem jagħmel ftehimiet minn wara dahar ħaddieħor.
messages.mt_standard: Għax hu bewwieġi u dejjem jagħmel ftehimiet minn wara dahar ħaddieħor.
messages.zh: 因为他惯于搞暗中勾当，总是背着别人做交易。
messages.en: Because he's underhanded and always makes deals behind other people's backs.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 bewwieġi 放在“商人”后面，记成“参与暗中交易的商人”；通过完整名词短语记住它在这里是形容词，描述人的行事特点。

gloss_zh: 冒险胡闹之举；暗中耍诈的活动

teaching_sense.en_definition: An escapade, or an activity carried out in an underhand way.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一次冒险或胡闹的行动；也可指暗中耍诈、不光明的活动。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Avventura jew praspura, jew attività li ssir bil-moħbi u bil-qerq.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 一次冒险胡闹之举；一次越轨的冒险活动。
暗中耍诈的活动；不光明的勾当。

collocations.en: an underhand activity to hide the money
collocations.zh: 为藏匿钱款而进行的暗中勾当

formal.mt: L-investigazzjoni kixfet bewġa marbuta mal-użu ħażin tal-fondi.
formal.en: The investigation uncovered an underhand activity connected with the misuse of funds.
formal.zh: 调查揭露了一项与滥用资金有关的暗中勾当。

colloquial.mt: Lara: X'kienet dik il-bewġa tal-bieraħ? Mark: Ħriġna bil-lejl biex nesploraw il-bajja u tlifna l-aħħar karozza tal-linja.
colloquial.en: Lara: What was that escapade yesterday? Mark: We went out at night to explore the bay and missed the last bus.
colloquial.zh: Lara：昨天你们那番冒险胡闹是怎么回事？Mark：我们晚上出去探索海湾，结果错过了末班公交车。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 昨天你们那番冒险胡闹是怎么回事？
messages.en: What was that escapade yesterday?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ħriġna bil-lejl biex nesploraw il-bajja u tlifna l-aħħar karozza tal-linja.
messages.mt_standard: Ħriġna bil-lejl biex nesploraw il-bajja u tlifna l-aħħar karozza tal-linja.
messages.zh: 我们晚上出去探索海湾，结果错过了末班公交车。
messages.en: We went out at night to explore the bay and missed the last bus.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两幅情境记 bewġa：朋友夜里冒险胡闹，以及有人暗中耍诈；先看上下文，再判断是哪一种行动。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Having a pale, light brown colour, called beige.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 呈浅淡棕色的，即米色的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu kulur kannella ċar u pallidu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 米色的，指浅淡的棕色。

formal.mt: Il-perit għażel kulur bex għall-ħitan tal-kamra biex joħloq dehra kalma.
formal.en: The architect chose beige for the room's walls to create a calm appearance.
formal.zh: 建筑师为房间墙壁选择了米色，以营造宁静的视觉效果。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Liema kowt jogħġbok l-aktar? Lara: Il-kowt bex; imur tajjeb mal-qalziet kannella tiegħi.
colloquial.en: Maja: Which coat do you like best? Lara: The beige coat; it goes well with my brown trousers.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你最喜欢哪件外套？拉拉：那件米色的；它和我的棕色裤子很搭。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你最喜欢哪件外套？
messages.en: Which coat do you like best?

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-kowt bex; imur tajjeb mal-qalziet kannella tiegħi.
messages.mt_standard: Il-kowt bex; imur tajjeb mal-qalziet kannella tiegħi.
messages.zh: 那件米色的；它和我的棕色裤子很搭。
messages.en: The beige coat; it goes well with my brown trousers.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 bex 写在米色色卡上，再配一件米色外套，反复连读 kowt bex 来记颜色搭配。

teaching_sense.en_definition: For daylight to begin appearing; also, for very light rain to fall.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指天开始亮、破晓；也指下细小而轻微的雨，即下毛毛雨。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jibda jidher l-ewwel dawl tal-jum; jew tinżel xita ħafifa ħafna.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 破晓；天开始亮。
下毛毛雨；下细雨。

collocations.en: it drizzled a little during the night

formal.mt: Malli bexbex, it-tim telaq mill-kamp u beda l-mixja lejn il-wied.
formal.en: As soon as dawn broke, the team left the camp and began the walk towards the valley.
formal.zh: 天一破晓，队伍便离开营地，开始步行前往山谷。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Diġà bexbex? Maja: Iva, diġà jidher l-ewwel dawl. Mark: U t-triq għaliex hi mxarrba? Maja: Bexbex ftit matul il-lejl.
colloquial.en: Mark: Has dawn broken already? Maja: Yes, the first light is already showing. Mark: And why is the road wet? Maja: It drizzled a little during the night.
colloquial.zh: 马克：天已经亮了吗？玛雅：是呀，已经能看到晨光了。马克：那路面怎么是湿的？玛雅：夜里下了一点毛毛雨。

messages.speaker: Mark (旅伴)
messages.zh: 天已经亮了吗？
messages.en: Has dawn broken already?

messages.speaker: Maja (旅伴)
messages.zh: 是呀，已经能看到晨光了。
messages.en: Yes, the first light is already showing.

messages.speaker: Mark (旅伴)
messages.zh: 那路面怎么是湿的？
messages.en: And why is the road wet?

messages.speaker: Maja (旅伴)
messages.zh: 夜里下了一点毛毛雨。
messages.en: It drizzled a little during the night.

cognitive_memory_aid: 为 bexbex 并排画晨光与细雨两幅图，分别练习“天破晓”和“下毛毛雨”，靠场景区分词义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A device that sprays water over an area, for example to water a garden.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把水喷洒到一定范围内的装置，例如用于给花园浇水的洒水器。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Apparat li jxerred l-ilma fi qtar fuq medda ta' art, pereżempju biex isaqqi ġnien.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 洒水器；喷水装置

formal.mt: Il-ġardinar uża bexbiex biex iqassam l-ilma b'mod uniformi fuq il-ħaxix.
formal.en: The gardener used a sprinkler to distribute water evenly over the grass.
formal.zh: 园丁用洒水器把水均匀地喷洒在草地上。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Fejn hu l-bexbiex? Il-ħaxix niexef. Pawlu: Ħdejn il-vit. Issa nixegħlu.
colloquial.en: Maja: Where is the sprinkler? The grass is dry. Pawlu: Next to the tap. I'll turn it on now.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：洒水器在哪里？草地都干了。保罗：在水龙头旁边。我现在就打开。

messages.speaker: Maja (家人)
messages.zh: 洒水器在哪里？草地都干了。
messages.en: Where is the sprinkler? The grass is dry.

messages.speaker: Pawlu (家人)
messages.zh: 在水龙头旁边。我现在就打开。
messages.en: Next to the tap. I'll turn it on now.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 bexbiex 和草坪上旋转喷水的装置配成一张记忆图：这个名词指洒水器本身。

gloss_zh: 能洒水的；具有喷水能力的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Able to spray or sprinkle water.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 具有把水喷出或洒开的能力的，用来描述装置等的功能。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu l-ħila jxerred l-ilma fi qtar.

sense_translations.en_definition: having the ability to sprinkle water
sense_translations.zh_definition: 具有洒水或喷水能力的

collocations.en: a device capable of sprinkling water
a mechanism capable of spraying water

formal.mt: L-apparat bexbiexi jqassam l-ilma fuq il-pjanti mingħajr ma jkun hemm bżonn tisqija bl-idejn.
formal.en: The device capable of sprinkling water distributes water over the plants without the need for hand watering.
formal.zh: 这种能洒水的装置把水喷洒到植物上，无需人工浇水。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Dan l-apparat bexbiexi jaħdem bil-batteriji? Mark: Iva, u jista' jsaqqi dawn il-pjanti kollha.
colloquial.en: Sara: Does this water-spraying device run on batteries? Mark: Yes, and it can water all these plants.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：这个能喷水的装置用电池吗？马克：是的，而且这些植物它都能浇到。

messages.speaker: Sara (顾客)
messages.zh: 这个能喷水的装置用电池吗？
messages.en: Does this water-spraying device run on batteries?

messages.speaker: Mark (店员)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, u jista' jsaqqi dawn il-pjanti kollha.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, u jista' jsaqqi dawn il-pjanti kollha.
messages.zh: 是的，而且这些植物它都能浇到。
messages.en: Yes, and it can water all these plants.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两个标签对照记忆：bexbiex 标在洒水器上，bexbiexi 写在功能栏里，表示具有洒水能力。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To make baskets by weaving wicker.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用柳条等可弯曲的枝条交织编成篮子。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jagħmel qfief billi jinseġ friegħi rqaq u flessibbli.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 编制柳条篮；用枝条编篮子

collocations.en: he made wicker baskets by hand

formal.mt: Matul il-wirja tas-snajja', l-artiġjan bexkel quddiem il-viżitaturi u spjega kif jinseġ il-friegħi.
formal.en: During the craft exhibition, the artisan made wicker baskets in front of the visitors and explained how he wove the branches.
formal.zh: 在手工艺展览期间，工匠当着参观者的面编篮子，并讲解如何交织枝条。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Min għamel dawn il-qfief? Toni: In-nannu. Ilbieraħ bexkel wara l-ikel.
colloquial.en: Lara: Who made these baskets? Toni: Grandpa. He made wicker baskets after lunch yesterday.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：这些篮子是谁做的？托尼：爷爷。他昨天午饭后编了篮子。

messages.speaker: Lara (孙女)
messages.zh: 这些篮子是谁做的？
messages.en: Who made these baskets?

messages.speaker: Toni (孙子)
messages.zh: 爷爷。他昨天午饭后编了篮子。
messages.en: Grandpa. He made wicker baskets after lunch yesterday.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 bexkel 配上双手交叉编枝条的动作，再看到成形的篮子；用制作过程记住这个动词。

gloss_zh: 使人卷入难堪处境的人；设局牵连他人的人

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who draws someone into a situation that may damage that person's reputation or put them in a difficult position.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使别人卷入可能损害名誉、使其难以自处的局面的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li ddaħħal lil ħaddieħor f'sitwazzjoni li tista' tagħmillu ħsara lir-reputazzjoni jew tqiegħdu f'pożizzjoni diffiċli.

sense_translations.en_definition: sb. who causes a person to become involved in a compromising situation
sense_translations.zh_definition: 使某人卷入有损名誉或难以自处的处境的人

collocations.en: a cunning person who draws others into compromising situations
an unscrupulous person who draws others into compromising situations
collocations.zh: 不择手段地使别人陷入难堪处境的人

formal.mt: Fir-rakkont, il-bexkiel iħajjar liż-żagħżugħ jiffirma dikjarazzjoni falza, u b'hekk iqiegħdu f'pożizzjoni diffiċli.
formal.en: In the story, the schemer persuades the young man to sign a false statement, thereby putting him in a compromising position.
formal.zh: 故事中，设局者诱使年轻人签署虚假声明，从而使他陷入难以自处的境地。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Għaliex ma tafdax lil dak il-karattru fl-istorja? Ġanni: Għax hu bexkiel; idaħħal lil sħabu fl-inkwiet biex isalva lilu nnifsu.
colloquial.en: Nina: Why don't you trust that character in the story? Ġanni: Because he draws others into compromising situations; he gets his friends into trouble to save himself.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：你为什么不信任故事里的那个人物？詹尼：因为他会把别人拖入难堪的处境；他为了保全自己，让朋友惹上麻烦。

messages.speaker: Nina (读书会成员)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex ma tafdax lil dak il-karattru fl-istorja?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex ma tafdax lil dak il-karattru fl-istorja?
messages.zh: 你为什么不信任故事里的那个人物？
messages.en: Why don't you trust that character in the story?

messages.speaker: Ġanni (读书会成员)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax hu bexkiel; idaħħal lil sħabu fl-inkwiet biex isalva lilu nnifsu.
messages.mt_standard: Għax hu bexkiel; idaħħal lil sħabu fl-inkwiet biex isalva lilu nnifsu.
messages.zh: 因为他会把别人拖入难堪的处境；他为了保全自己，让朋友惹上麻烦。
messages.en: Because he draws others into compromising situations; he gets his friends into trouble to save himself.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一个人递来虚假声明，诱使别人签字：bexkiel 指把人牵进难堪局面的那个人。

gloss_zh: 使人卷入难堪处境的；诱人入圈套的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Drawing someone into a compromising situation or ensnaring them.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 会使人卷入有损名誉或难以自处的局面，或把人诱入圈套的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jdaħħal lil xi ħadd f'sitwazzjoni kompromettenti jew jiġbdu f'nassa.

sense_translations.en_definition: causing involvement in a compromising situation
sense_translations.zh_definition: 使人卷入有损名誉或难以自处的处境的
诱人入圈套的；使人落入陷阱的

collocations.en: words that draw someone into a compromising situation
collocations.zh: 使人陷入难堪处境的话语

formal.mt: Fir-rumanz, il-pjan bexkieli jwassal lill-protagonist biex jidher responsabbli għal żball li ma għamilx.
formal.en: In the novel, the ensnaring plan makes the protagonist appear responsible for a mistake he did not make.
formal.zh: 小说中，这个设局害人的计划使主人公看起来要为一个并非他所犯的错误负责。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Dan il-pjan fl-istorja jidher bexkieli. David: Hekk hu. Jekk jaċċetta, jidher li kien jaf bil-gidba.
colloquial.en: Marija: This plan in the story seems designed to trap him. David: Exactly. If he accepts, it will look as though he knew about the lie.
colloquial.zh: 玛丽亚：故事里的这个计划看起来会把他套进去。戴维：就是。如果他接受，就会显得他早就知道那个谎言。

messages.speaker: Marija (同学)
messages.zh: 故事里的这个计划看起来会把他套进去。
messages.en: This plan in the story seems designed to trap him.

messages.speaker: David (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Hekk hu. Jekk jaċċetta, jidher li kien jaf bil-gidba.
messages.mt_standard: Hekk hu. Jekk jaċċetta, jidher li kien jaf bil-gidba.
messages.zh: 就是。如果他接受，就会显得他早就知道那个谎言。
messages.en: Exactly. If he accepts, it will look as though he knew about the lie.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 bexkieli 写在一份暗藏圈套的计划旁：它描述计划会使人陷入困境的性质，也可描述诱人的话语。

gloss_zh: 使自己的心思忙于某事；把心思放在某事上

teaching_sense.en_definition: To occupy one's mind with a particular subject, problem, or activity.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 让自己的心思集中在某个话题、问题或活动上，持续想着或琢磨它。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Iżomm moħħu okkupat b'xi suġġett, problema jew attività.

sense_translations.en_definition: to occupy one's mind with sth.
sense_translations.zh_definition: 让自己的心思忙于某事；把心思放在某事上

collocations.en: he occupied his mind with the problem
collocations.zh: 他把心思放在那个问题上

collocations.en: he occupied his mind with the plan

formal.mt: Qabel il-laqgħa, ir-riċerkatur bexlek moħħu bil-problema u kiteb diversi soluzzjonijiet possibbli.
formal.en: Before the meeting, the researcher occupied his mind with the problem and wrote down several possible solutions.
formal.zh: 开会前，研究员专心琢磨那个问题，并写下了几种可能的解决办法。

colloquial.mt: Anna: X'għamel Pawlu matul il-vjaġġ? Rita: Bexlek moħħu b'logħba tal-kliem u nesa l-ħin.
colloquial.en: Anna: What did Pawlu do during the journey? Rita: He occupied his mind with a word game and lost track of time.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：保罗在旅途中做了什么？丽塔：他专心玩文字游戏，连时间都忘了。

messages.speaker: Anna (朋友)
messages.zh: 保罗在旅途中做了什么？
messages.en: What did Pawlu do during the journey?

messages.speaker: Rita (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Bexlek moħħu b'logħba tal-kliem u nesa l-ħin.
messages.mt_standard: Bexlek moħħu b'logħba tal-kliem u nesa l-ħin.
messages.zh: 他专心玩文字游戏，连时间都忘了。
messages.en: He occupied his mind with a word game and lost track of time.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象脑海里的一张桌子被一道题占满：bexlek 表示让心思忙着琢磨某事，可搭配 moħħu 一起记。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who opens a door or window.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 执行开门或开窗动作的人；该词本身不限定其职业。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li tiftaħ bieb jew tieqa.

sense_translations.en_definition: sb. who opens a door or window
sense_translations.zh_definition: 开门或开窗的人

collocations.en: the person who opens the door
the person who opens the window

formal.mt: Fix-xena tad-dramm, il-bexxieq tal-bieb jibqa' ħdejn id-daħla waqt li jidħlu l-mistednin.
formal.en: In the scene of the play, the person who opens the door remains beside the entrance as the guests come in.
formal.zh: 在这幕戏中，开门的人留在入口旁，让客人们进来。

colloquial.mt: Elena: Min hu l-bexxieq tal-bieb f'din ix-xena? Luqa: Jien. Meta tħabbat, niftaħlek.
colloquial.en: Elena: Who opens the door in this scene? Luqa: I do. When you knock, I'll open it for you.
colloquial.zh: 埃莱娜：这场戏里谁负责开门？卢卡：我。你敲门时，我就给你开。

messages.speaker: Elena (演员)
messages.mt_spoken: Min hu l-bexxieq tal-bieb f'din ix-xena?
messages.mt_standard: Min hu l-bexxieq tal-bieb f'din ix-xena?
messages.zh: 这场戏里谁负责开门？
messages.en: Who opens the door in this scene?

messages.speaker: Luqa (演员)
messages.zh: 我。你敲门时，我就给你开。
messages.en: I do. When you knock, I'll open it for you.

cognitive_memory_aid: 看一幅有人推开门窗的画，把 bexxieq 标签贴在人身上；记忆重点是执行开门窗动作的人。

gloss_zh: 促使开放的；使花朵等张开的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Causing something, such as a blossom, to open.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 能促使某物张开或开放的，例如促使花朵绽放的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jġiegħel xi ħaġa tinfetaħ, pereżempju fjura.

sense_translations.en_definition: sth. that causes the opening (of blossoms etc)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 促使花朵等开放或张开的

formal.mt: Fl-esperiment, ġie osservat effett bexxieqi meta l-blanzuni magħluqa bdew jinfetħu wara l-espożizzjoni għad-dawl.
formal.en: In the experiment, an opening-inducing effect was observed when the closed flower buds began to open after exposure to light.
formal.zh: 实验中，闭合的花蕾在接受光照后开始开放，呈现出促使花朵开放的作用。

colloquial.mt: Marta: X'jiġifieri effett bexxieqi hawn? Simon: Effett li jgħin lill-fjuri jinfetħu. Ara dawn il-blanzuni kif infetħu.
colloquial.en: Marta: What does an opening-inducing effect mean here? Simon: An effect that helps flowers open. Look at how these buds have opened.
colloquial.zh: 玛尔塔：这里说的促使开放的作用是什么意思？西蒙：就是帮助花朵开放的作用。看，这些花蕾已经打开了。

messages.speaker: Marta (学生)
messages.zh: 这里说的促使开放的作用是什么意思？
messages.en: What does an opening-inducing effect mean here?

messages.speaker: Simon (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Effett li jgħin lill-fjuri jinfetħu. Ara dawn il-blanzuni kif infetħu.
messages.mt_standard: Effett li jgħin lill-fjuri jinfetħu. Ara dawn il-blanzuni kif infetħu.
messages.zh: 就是帮助花朵开放的作用。看，这些花蕾已经打开了。
messages.en: An effect that helps flowers open. Look at how these buds have opened.

cognitive_memory_aid: 画出闭合花蕾到开放花朵的箭头，把 bexxieqi 写在箭头旁，记住它描述促成开放的作用或因素。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who sprinkles water, for example over plants or the ground.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把水洒在植物、地面等处的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li tbexxex l-ilma, pereżempju fuq il-pjanti jew mal-art.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 洒水的人。

collocations.en: the person who sprinkles water in the garden
a person sprinkling water with a bucket

formal.mt: Il-bexxiex xerred ftit ilma mal-art qabel bdew ix-xogħlijiet, biex inaqqas it-trab.
formal.en: The person sprinkling water scattered a little water over the ground before work began, to reduce the dust.
formal.zh: 开工前，洒水的人往地面洒了些水，以减少扬尘。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Min hu dak il-bexxiex ħdejn il-fjuri? Pawlu: Hu ħija; qed ibexxex ftit ilma fuqhom.
colloquial.en: Maja: Who is that person sprinkling water beside the flowers? Pawlu: He is my brother; he is sprinkling a little water over them.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：花旁边那个洒水的人是谁？保罗：他是我哥哥，正在往花上洒一点水。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Min hu dak il-bexxiex ħdejn il-fjuri?
messages.mt_standard: Min hu dak il-bexxiex ħdejn il-fjuri?
messages.zh: 花旁边那个洒水的人是谁？
messages.en: Who is that person sprinkling water beside the flowers?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Hu ħija; qed ibexxex ftit ilma fuqhom.
messages.mt_standard: Hu ħija; qed ibexxex ftit ilma fuqhom.
messages.zh: 他是我哥哥，正在往花上洒一点水。
messages.en: He is my brother; he is sprinkling a little water over them.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一个人提着水桶轻轻洒水，把 bexxiex 与“洒水的人”这一完整画面配对记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Describing water or rain falling in small, scattered drops.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容水或雨以细小、分散的水滴洒落的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jinżel jew jinfirex fi qtar żgħir, bħall-ilma jew ix-xita.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 洒落的；像细小水滴一样零星飘洒的。

formal.mt: Matul il-mixja niżlet xita bexxiexi li xarrbet ftit il-weraq tas-siġar.
formal.en: During the walk, light, sprinkling rain fell and slightly wet the leaves of the trees.
formal.zh: 步行途中飘起了细雨，把树叶稍稍打湿了。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Hemm xita bexxiexi barra; nieħu l-umbrella? Pawlu: Ħudha, għax il-mixja hi twila.
colloquial.en: Maja: There is light, sprinkling rain outside; shall I take the umbrella? Pawlu: Take it, because it is a long walk.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：外面飘着细雨，我带伞吗？保罗：带上吧，要走很长一段路呢。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Hemm xita bexxiexi barra; nieħu l-umbrella?
messages.mt_standard: Hemm xita bexxiexi barra; nieħu l-umbrella?
messages.zh: 外面飘着细雨，我带伞吗？
messages.en: There is light, sprinkling rain outside; shall I take the umbrella?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.zh: 带上吧，要走很长一段路呢。
messages.en: Take it, because it is a long walk.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 bexxiexi 放进“细雨轻轻洒落”的画面，记住它描述洒落的状态；与表示洒水人的 bexxiex 对照学习。

gloss_zh: 制作小面包的人；小面包师傅

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who makes bread rolls.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 制作小面包的人，指从事这种面包制作的师傅。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li tagħmel ħobżiet żgħar.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 制作小面包的人。

collocations.zh: 手艺熟练的小面包师傅
店里制作小面包的师傅

formal.mt: Il-bezzien iħejji ħobżiet żgħar friski kull filgħodu.
formal.en: The bread roll maker prepares fresh rolls every morning.
formal.zh: 小面包师傅每天早晨制作新鲜的小面包。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Min jagħmel dawn il-ħobżiet żgħar? Mark: Il-bezzien tal-ħanut; jagħmilhom kull filgħodu.
colloquial.en: Maja: Who makes these bread rolls? Mark: The shop's bread roll maker; he makes them every morning.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这些小面包是谁做的？马克：店里的小面包师傅；他每天早晨都会做。

messages.speaker: Maja (顾客)
messages.zh: 这些小面包是谁做的？
messages.en: Who makes these bread rolls?

messages.speaker: Mark (店员)
messages.zh: 店里的小面包师傅；他每天早晨都会做。
messages.en: The shop's bread roll maker; he makes them every morning.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 bezzien 和清晨揉面、烤出一盘小面包的师傅联系起来，记住它指做面包的人。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A surname used to identify a person's family.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一种姓氏，用于表示一个人的家族姓。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kunjom li jidentifika l-familja ta' persuna.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 一个姓氏：Bezzina。

formal.mt: Is-Sinjura Bezzina bagħtet it-talba tagħha bil-miktub.
formal.en: Ms Bezzina submitted her request in writing.
formal.zh: Bezzina 女士以书面形式提交了申请。

colloquial.mt: Lara: X'inhu kunjomok? Anna: Bezzina. Jisimni Anna Bezzina.
colloquial.en: Lara: What is your surname? Anna: Bezzina. My name is Anna Bezzina.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：你姓什么？安娜：Bezzina。我的全名是 Anna Bezzina。

messages.speaker: Lara (接待员)
messages.zh: 你姓什么？
messages.en: What is your surname?

messages.speaker: Anna (访客)
messages.zh: Bezzina。我的全名是 Anna Bezzina。
messages.en: Bezzina. My name is Anna Bezzina.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象姓名表上 Anna 是名字、Bezzina 填在姓氏栏；用完整姓名帮助记住它的用途。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To make a person or animal fatter, especially by feeding them.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使人或动物长肥，尤指通过喂养使其体重增加。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Isemmen persuna jew annimal, speċjalment billi jagħtih aktar ikel.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使长肥；把动物养肥、育肥

formal.mt: Il-bidwi beċċen l-għoġol matul ix-xhur tax-xitwa u żamm rekord taż-żieda fil-piż tiegħu.
formal.en: The farmer fattened the calf during the winter months and kept a record of its weight gain.
formal.zh: 农民在冬季的几个月里给小牛育肥，并记录了它的体重增长情况。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Dan l-għoġol kiber ħafna minn meta rajtu l-aħħar! Pawlu: Iva, missieri beċċen l-għoġol matul ix-xitwa.
colloquial.en: Maja: This calf has grown a lot since I last saw it! Pawlu: Yes, my father fattened the calf over the winter.
colloquial.zh: Maja：这头小牛比我上次见到时长大了好多！Pawlu：是啊，我父亲整个冬天都在给它育肥。

messages.speaker: Maja (来访朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Dan l-għoġol kiber ħafna minn meta rajtu l-aħħar!
messages.mt_standard: Dan l-għoġol kiber ħafna minn meta rajtu l-aħħar!
messages.zh: 这头小牛比我上次见到时长大了好多！
messages.en: This calf has grown a lot since I last saw it!

messages.speaker: Pawlu (农场主的儿子)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, missieri beċċen l-għoġol matul ix-xitwa.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, missieri beċċen l-għoġol matul ix-xitwa.
messages.zh: 是啊，我父亲整个冬天都在给它育肥。
messages.en: Yes, my father fattened the calf over the winter.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象农民喂养小牛，前后照片中小牛明显长肥；记住这个动作强调“使它变肥、把它养肥”。

gloss_zh: 侦察、探察（暂释，确切词义未定）

teaching_sense.en_definition: Tentatively, to reconnoitre or scout; the supplied entry explicitly states that the meaning is indeterminate.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 暂可理解为侦察或探察；所给词条明确指出其确切含义未定，学习时须保留这一限制。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: B'mod tentattiv, ifisser li wieħed jistħarreġ post; madankollu, it-tifsira preċiża mhijiex stabbilita.

sense_translations.en_definition: to reconnoitre (According to Aquilina, this word is only attested in the novel Ineż Farruġ by Anton Manwel Caruana, and is of indeterminate meaning)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 侦察、探察（据 Aquilina，此词仅见于 Anton Manwel Caruana 的小说《Ineż Farruġ》，确切含义未定）。

formal.mt: Fl-istudju tal-vokabularju, 'beħħen' għandu jiġi ppreżentat b'kawtela: it-tifsira proposta hija 'li wieħed jistħarreġ post', iżda mhijiex ċerta.
formal.en: In vocabulary study, 'beħħen' should be presented cautiously: the proposed meaning is 'to reconnoitre a place', but it is uncertain.
formal.zh: 在词汇学习中，应谨慎介绍 beħħen：其暂拟释义为“侦察某地”，但这一词义尚不确定。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Nista' nitgħallem 'beħħen' bħala verb li jfisser 'jistħarreġ'? Pawlu: Biss bħala tifsira tentattiva; it-tifsira preċiża għadha mhix ċerta.
colloquial.en: Maja: Can I learn 'beħħen' as a verb meaning 'to reconnoitre'? Pawlu: Only as a tentative meaning; the precise meaning is still uncertain.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：我可以把 beħħen 当作表示“侦察”的动词来学吗？保罗：只能当作暂定释义；它的确切含义仍不确定。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Nista' nitgħallem 'beħħen' bħala verb li jfisser 'jistħarreġ'?
messages.mt_standard: Nista' nitgħallem 'beħħen' bħala verb li jfisser 'jistħarreġ'?
messages.zh: 我可以把 beħħen 当作表示“侦察”的动词来学吗？
messages.en: Can I learn 'beħħen' as a verb meaning 'to reconnoitre'?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Biss bħala tifsira tentattiva; it-tifsira preċiża għadha mhix ċerta.
messages.mt_standard: Biss bħala tifsira tentattiva; it-tifsira preċiża għadha mhix ċerta.
messages.zh: 只能当作暂定释义；它的确切含义仍不确定。
messages.en: Only as a tentative meaning; the precise meaning is still uncertain.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 beħħen 写在带问号的侦察地图旁：记住“暂释侦察”，同时保留词义未定的问号。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To reprimand someone; in another sense, to seize someone by the hair, especially the fringe.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 训斥或责骂某人；另一个义项是揪住某人的头发，尤其是额前的刘海。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Iċanfar lil xi ħadd; f'tifsira oħra, jaqbad lil xi ħadd minn xagħru, speċjalment minn quddiem.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 训斥；责骂；严厉指出某人的过错。

sense_translations.en_definition: to seize sb. by the hair (especially their fringe)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 揪住某人的头发，尤其是额前的刘海。

collocations.mt: beżbeż lil xi ħadd minn xagħru

formal.mt: Id-direttur beżbeż lill-impjegat talli kiser ir-regoli tas-sigurtà.
formal.en: The director reprimanded the employee for breaking the safety rules.
formal.zh: 主管因那名员工违反安全规定而训斥了他。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex l-għalliem beżbeż lil Mark? Pawlu: Għax baqa' jitkellem waqt il-lezzjoni.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why did the teacher reprimand Mark? Pawlu: Because he kept talking during the lesson.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：老师为什么训斥马克？保罗：因为他上课时一直说话。

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.zh: 老师为什么训斥马克？
messages.en: Why did the teacher reprimand Mark?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同学)
messages.zh: 因为他上课时一直说话。
messages.en: Because he kept talking during the lesson.

cognitive_memory_aid: 为 beżbeż 做两张动作卡：一张是开口训斥，一张是揪住额前头发；分开记住两个义项，避免混为同一动作。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who reprimands or reproaches someone.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 训斥、责备或指责别人的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li ċċanfar jew iċċanfar bil-kliem lil ħaddieħor minħabba xi nuqqas.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 训斥或责备别人的人。

formal.mt: Fir-rakkont, il-kap jidher bħala beżbież aħrax li jsib difett f'kull xogħol.
formal.en: In the story, the boss appears as a harsh reproacher who finds fault with every piece of work.
formal.zh: 在故事中，这位上司是个严厉的责备者，对每一项工作都要挑毛病。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex issejjaħlu beżbież? Pawlu: Għax dejjem iċanfar lil xi ħadd, anki fuq affarijiet żgħar.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why do you call him a reproacher? Pawlu: Because he is always reprimanding someone, even over small things.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你为什么说他是个爱责备人的人？保罗：因为他总在训人，连小事也要训。

messages.speaker: Maja (同事)
messages.zh: 你为什么说他是个爱责备人的人？
messages.en: Why do you call him a reproacher?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax dejjem iċanfar lil xi ħadd, anki fuq affarijiet żgħar.
messages.mt_standard: Għax dejjem iċanfar lil xi ħadd, anki fuq affarijiet żgħar.
messages.zh: 因为他总在训人，连小事也要训。
messages.en: Because he is always reprimanding someone, even over small things.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 beżbież 写在人物卡上，画一个正在责备别人的人；与动作词 beżbeż 对照，牢记这里指“人”。

gloss_zh: 责备的；带有指责意味的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Expressing blame, criticism, or disappointment about someone's behaviour.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 表达对某人行为的责备、批评或不满的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li juri ċanfir jew nuqqas ta' sodisfazzjon bl-imġiba ta' xi ħadd.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 责备的；流露出指责或不满的。

formal.mt: Fl-ittra, l-awtur uża ton beżbieżi biex jesprimi d-diżappunt tiegħu bl-imġiba tal-kumitat.
formal.en: In the letter, the writer used a reproachful tone to express his disappointment with the committee's behaviour.
formal.zh: 作者在信中用了责备的语气，表达他对委员会行为的失望。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex qed tkellimni b'dak it-ton beżbieżi? Pawlu: Għax wegħedtni li tasal fil-ħin, u erġajt ġejt tard.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why are you speaking to me in that reproachful tone? Pawlu: Because you promised me you would arrive on time, and you were late again.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你为什么用那种责备的语气跟我说话？保罗：因为你答应过我会准时到，结果又迟到了。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex qed tkellimni b'dak it-ton beżbieżi?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex qed tkellimni b'dak it-ton beżbieżi?
messages.zh: 你为什么用那种责备的语气跟我说话？
messages.en: Why are you speaking to me in that reproachful tone?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax wegħedtni li tasal fil-ħin, u erġajt ġejt tard.
messages.mt_standard: Għax wegħedtni li tasal fil-ħin, u erġajt ġejt tard.
messages.zh: 因为你答应过我会准时到，结果又迟到了。
messages.en: Because you promised me you would arrive on time, and you were late again.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一句“你怎么又迟到了”，听见其中责备的语气，用 ton beżbieżi 整组记忆这个形容词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A strand of hair, considered separately from the rest of the hair.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 从其余头发中单独辨认出来的一缕头发。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ftit xagħar flimkien li jingħaraf mill-bqija tax-xagħar.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 一缕头发。

collocations.en: a strand of hair on the forehead

formal.mt: Fir-ritratt tidher beżbuża twila nieżla fuq moħħ it-tifla.
formal.en: In the photograph, a long strand of hair can be seen falling over the girl's forehead.
formal.zh: 照片中可以看到，一缕长发垂在女孩的额头上。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għandi beżbuża quddiem għajnejja; tagħtini pinna tax-xagħar? Sara: Iva, ħu din biex iżżommha f'postha.
colloquial.en: Maja: I have a strand of hair in front of my eyes; can you give me a hairpin? Sara: Yes, take this one to hold it in place.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：有一缕头发挡在我眼前，能给我一个发夹吗？萨拉：可以，拿这个把它固定好。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandi beżbuża quddiem għajnejja; tagħtini pinna tax-xagħar?
messages.mt_standard: Għandi beżbuża quddiem għajnejja; tagħtini pinna tax-xagħar?
messages.zh: 有一缕头发挡在我眼前，能给我一个发夹吗？
messages.en: I have a strand of hair in front of my eyes; can you give me a hairpin?

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, ħu din biex iżżommha f'postha.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, ħu din biex iżżommha f'postha.
messages.zh: 可以，拿这个把它固定好。
messages.en: Yes, take this one to hold it in place.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象额前垂下一缕头发，需要用发夹夹好；把 beżbuża 与这一小缕头发的画面绑定记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To regard someone with contempt or consider them unworthy of respect.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 以轻蔑的态度看待某人，认为对方不值得尊重。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Iħares lejn xi ħadd b'disprezz jew iqisu bħala persuna li ma jistħoqqilhiex rispett.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 鄙视；蔑视；看不起。

sense_translations.en_definition: sb. who brings another person low
sense_translations.zh_definition: 使另一个人受辱或陷入卑微处境的人。

formal.mt: Fir-rumanz, ir-raġel għani beżlaħ lill-fqir minħabba l-ħwejjeġ qodma tiegħu.
formal.en: In the novel, the rich man despised the poor man because of his old clothes.
formal.zh: 在小说中，那个富人因为穷人衣着破旧而看不起他。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex Pawlu beżlaħ lil dak ir-raġel? Sara: Għax kien liebes ħwejjeġ qodma, iżda dan ma jgħid xejn fuq il-karattru tiegħu.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why did Pawlu despise that man? Sara: Because he was wearing old clothes, but that says nothing about his character.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：保罗为什么看不起那个男人？萨拉：因为他穿着旧衣服，可这并不能说明他的人品。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex Pawlu beżlaħ lil dak ir-raġel?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex Pawlu beżlaħ lil dak ir-raġel?
messages.zh: 保罗为什么看不起那个男人？
messages.en: Why did Pawlu despise that man?

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax kien liebes ħwejjeġ qodma, iżda dan ma jgħid xejn fuq il-karattru tiegħu.
messages.mt_standard: Għax kien liebes ħwejjeġ qodma, iżda dan ma jgħid xejn fuq il-karattru tiegħu.
messages.zh: 因为他穿着旧衣服，可这并不能说明他的人品。
messages.en: Because he was wearing old clothes, but that says nothing about his character.

cognitive_memory_aid: 先用“因衣着而看不起别人”的场景记住 beżlaħ 的鄙视义，再另做一张“使别人受辱的人”义项卡，分别复习。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who slobbers, letting saliva run out of the mouth.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 唾液从嘴里流出来的人，即流口水的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li joħroġilha l-bżieq minn ħalqha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 流口水的人；唾液从嘴里流出来的人。

formal.mt: Fir-rakkont, it-tarbija tissejjaħ beżliek żgħir għax il-bżieq ta' spiss ixarrbilha l-geddum.
formal.en: In the story, the baby is called a little slobberer because saliva often wets the baby's chin.
formal.zh: 在故事中，这个婴儿被叫作流口水的小家伙，因为口水常常把他的下巴弄湿。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Ara dan il-beżliek żgħir; reġa' xarrab il-bavalor! Sara: Nagħtih wieħed nadif u nimsaħlu l-geddum.
colloquial.en: Maja: Look at this little slobberer; he has wet his bib again! Sara: I will give him a clean one and wipe his chin.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：瞧这个流口水的小家伙，又把围嘴弄湿了！萨拉：我给他换个干净的，再擦擦下巴。

messages.speaker: Maja (母亲)
messages.mt_spoken: Ara dan il-beżliek żgħir; reġa' xarrab il-bavalor!
messages.mt_standard: Ara dan il-beżliek żgħir; reġa' xarrab il-bavalor!
messages.zh: 瞧这个流口水的小家伙，又把围嘴弄湿了！
messages.en: Look at this little slobberer; he has wet his bib again!

messages.speaker: Sara (姨妈)
messages.mt_spoken: Nagħtih wieħed nadif u nimsaħlu l-geddum.
messages.mt_standard: Nagħtih wieħed nadif u nimsaħlu l-geddum.
messages.zh: 我给他换个干净的，再擦擦下巴。
messages.en: I will give him a clean one and wipe his chin.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象小宝宝流口水，把围嘴弄湿；用这个人物画面记住 beżliek 指流口水的人，而不是口水本身。

gloss_zh: 爱小题大做的；喝东西时爱咂嘴或发出吸吮声的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Inclined to make a fuss; also used of someone who habitually smacks their lips or makes sucking sounds while drinking.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容人容易大惊小怪、小题大做；也可形容人在喝东西时习惯咂嘴或发出吸吮声。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu tendenza jagħmel storja fuq affarijiet żgħar; jista' wkoll jiddeskrivi lil min jagħmel ħsejjes b'xofftejh jew b'ħalqu waqt li jixrob.

sense_translations.en_definition: having a tendency to make a fuss
sense_translations.zh_definition: 爱大惊小怪、动不动就小题大做的。

sense_translations.en_definition: having a tendency to smack one's lips or make sucking sounds as one drinks
sense_translations.zh_definition: 喝东西时习惯咂嘴或发出吸吮声的。

collocations.en: a man inclined to make a fuss
collocations.zh: 一个爱小题大做的男人

collocations.en: given to making lip-smacking or sucking sounds when drinking
collocations.zh: 喝东西时爱咂嘴或发出吸吮声的

formal.mt: Fir-rakkont, il-ġar huwa deskritt bħala beżlieki għax jagħmel storja kull darba li jisma' l-iċken storbju.
formal.en: In the story, the neighbour is described as fussy because he makes a fuss whenever he hears the slightest noise.
formal.zh: 故事把这位邻居描写成爱大惊小怪的人，因为他每次听见一点点声响就要闹一番。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex qed jagħmel dawk il-ħsejjes waqt li jixrob? Tom: Hekk jagħmel dejjem; beżlieki meta jixrob.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why is he making those sounds while drinking? Tom: He always does that; he tends to smack his lips or make sucking sounds when he drinks.
colloquial.zh: Maja：他喝东西时为什么发出那些声音？Tom：他一直都这样，喝东西时爱咂嘴或发出吸吮声。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex qed jagħmel dawk il-ħsejjes waqt li jixrob?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex qed jagħmel dawk il-ħsejjes waqt li jixrob?
messages.zh: 他喝东西时为什么发出那些声音？
messages.en: Why is he making those sounds while drinking?

messages.speaker: Tom (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Hekk jagħmel dejjem; beżlieki meta jixrob.
messages.mt_standard: Hekk jagħmel dejjem; beżlieki meta jixrob.
messages.zh: 他一直都这样，喝东西时爱咂嘴或发出吸吮声。
messages.en: He always does that; he tends to smack his lips or make sucking sounds when he drinks.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把两个场景并排记：遇到小事就闹一番，喝一口水也咂嘴出声。共同抓住“习惯这样表现的人”，再靠上下文区分两义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Easily frightened or lacking courage when facing something feared.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容人容易害怕，或面对令其恐惧的事物时缺乏勇气；可表示胆小，也可带有怯懦的批评意味。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jibża' malajr jew li juri nuqqas ta' kuraġġ quddiem xi ħaġa li tbeżżgħu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 怯懦的、胆小畏缩的、容易害怕的。

formal.mt: Fil-bidu tar-rakkont, il-protagonist huwa beżżiegħi, iżda bil-mod il-mod jitgħallem jiffaċċja l-biża' tiegħu.
formal.en: At the beginning of the story, the protagonist is timid, but gradually learns to face his fear.
formal.zh: 故事开头，主人公很胆小，但他逐渐学会了面对自己的恐惧。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Trid tidħol tara l-film tal-biża'? Tom: Le, jien beżżiegħi wisq għal dawk il-films!
colloquial.en: Maja: Do you want to go in and watch the horror film? Tom: No, I'm too easily frightened for those films!
colloquial.zh: Maja：你想进去看那部恐怖片吗？Tom：不，我太胆小了，看不了那种电影！

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你想进去看那部恐怖片吗？
messages.en: Do you want to go in and watch the horror film?

messages.speaker: Tom (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, jien beżżiegħi wisq għal dawk il-films!
messages.mt_standard: Le, jien beżżiegħi wisq għal dawk il-films!
messages.zh: 不，我太胆小了，看不了那种电影！
messages.en: No, I'm too easily frightened for those films!

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象朋友邀请看恐怖片，你抱紧靠垫说“我太胆小了”。用这个完整场景记住 beżżiegħi 描述的是人的胆怯。

gloss_zh: 带来厄运的人；被认为会带来坏运气的人

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person believed to bring or cause bad luck.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指被认为会给别人带来坏运气或厄运的人，常用于表达迷信观念或玩笑式归咎。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li, skont twemmin superstizzjuż jew b'ċajta, titqies li ġġib ix-xorti ħażina.

sense_translations.en_definition: sb. who brings or causes bad luck
sense_translations.zh_definition: 带来或招致坏运气的人；可指被迷信地认为会带来厄运的人。

collocations.en: to be regarded as someone who brings bad luck
collocations.zh: 被看作会带来坏运气的人

collocations.en: to call someone a bringer of bad luck
collocations.zh: 称某人为带来厄运的人

formal.mt: Fir-rakkont, in-nies tar-raħal iqisu lill-barrani bħala beżżiel u jwaħħlu fih għal kull sfortuna.
formal.en: In the story, the villagers regard the stranger as a bringer of bad luck and blame him for every misfortune.
formal.zh: 故事中，村民把那个外来人看作会带来厄运的人，把每一次不幸都归咎于他。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Wasalt jien u t-tim tilef. Jien beżżiel? Maja: Le, tilfet il-logħba t-tim, mhux int! Kienet biss kumbinazzjoni.
colloquial.en: Mark: I arrived and the team lost. Am I someone who brings bad luck? Maja: No, the team lost the match, not you! It was just a coincidence.
colloquial.zh: Mark：我一来，球队就输了。我是带来坏运气的人吗？Maja：不是，输掉比赛的是球队，又不是你！这只是巧合。

messages.speaker: Mark (球迷)
messages.mt_spoken: Wasalt jien u t-tim tilef. Jien beżżiel?
messages.mt_standard: Wasalt jien u t-tim tilef. Jien beżżiel?
messages.zh: 我一来，球队就输了。我是带来坏运气的人吗？
messages.en: I arrived and the team lost. Am I someone who brings bad luck?

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, tilfet il-logħba t-tim, mhux int! Kienet biss kumbinazzjoni.
messages.mt_standard: Le, tilfet il-logħba t-tim, mhux int! Kienet biss kumbinazzjoni.
messages.zh: 不是，输掉比赛的是球队，又不是你！这只是巧合。
messages.en: No, the team lost the match, not you! It was just a coincidence.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象有人一到球场球队就输，朋友开玩笑称他“倒霉使者”。beżżiel 是指人的名词，记忆画面不代表真有这种因果。

gloss_zh: 招致厄运的；带来坏运气的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Described or believed to cause bad luck.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容被说成会招致厄运、带来坏运气的人或事物；通常体现说话者的迷信看法或玩笑。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jitqies li jġib ix-xorti ħażina, skont superstizzjoni jew bħala ċajta.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 招致厄运的；带来坏运气的。

collocations.en: an object believed to bring bad luck
collocations.zh: 被认为会带来厄运的物品

collocations.en: a sign believed to bring bad luck
collocations.zh: 被认为会招致厄运的征兆

formal.mt: Fl-istorja, is-sid iqis iċ-ċurkett bħala oġġett beżżieli għax jassoċjah ma' sensiela ta' ġrajjiet koroh.
formal.en: In the story, the owner regards the ring as an object that brings bad luck because he associates it with a series of distressing events.
formal.zh: 故事中，主人把那枚戒指看作会带来厄运的物品，因为他把它与一连串不幸事件联系起来。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex ma tridx tieħu dak il-kappell? Tom: Ngħid li hu beżżieli għax kull darba li nilbsu nitilfu, imma qed niċċajta!
colloquial.en: Maja: Why don't you want to take that hat? Tom: I say it brings bad luck because every time I wear it we lose, but I'm joking!
colloquial.zh: Maja：你为什么不想带那顶帽子？Tom：我说它会带来坏运气，因为每次戴它我们都会输，不过我是开玩笑的！

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex ma tridx tieħu dak il-kappell?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex ma tridx tieħu dak il-kappell?
messages.zh: 你为什么不想带那顶帽子？
messages.en: Why don't you want to take that hat?

messages.speaker: Tom (球迷)
messages.mt_spoken: Ngħid li hu beżżieli għax kull darba li nilbsu nitilfu, imma qed niċċajta!
messages.mt_standard: Ngħid li hu beżżieli għax kull darba li nilbsu nitilfu, imma qed niċċajta!
messages.zh: 我说它会带来坏运气，因为每次戴它我们都会输，不过我是开玩笑的！
messages.en: I say it brings bad luck because every time I wear it we lose, but I'm joking!

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“这顶帽子招霉运”的玩笑画面记形容词 beżżieli；再与指人的名词 beżżiel 对照，分别记作“招霉运的”和“带来霉运的人”。

gloss_zh: 惯于吐唾沫的人；爱吐口水的人

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who habitually spits.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指经常吐唾沫、把吐口水当作习惯的人，重点在于反复发生的行为。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li għandha d-drawwa tobżoq ta' spiss.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 惯于吐唾沫的人；经常吐口水的人。

collocations.en: a habitual spitter in the street
collocations.zh: 在街上经常吐口水的人

collocations.en: the habit of someone who regularly spits
collocations.zh: 经常吐口水的人的习惯

formal.mt: Fir-rakkont, ir-raġel jissejjaħ beżżieq għax għandu d-drawwa jobżoq mal-art waqt li jimxi.
formal.en: In the story, the man is called a habitual spitter because he regularly spits on the ground while walking.
formal.zh: 故事中，这个男人被称为爱吐口水的人，因为他习惯一边走路一边往地上吐唾沫。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Dak ir-raġel reġa' beżaq mal-art. Tom: Iva, huwa beżżieq; jagħmel hekk ta' spiss.
colloquial.en: Maja: That man spat on the ground again. Tom: Yes, he's a habitual spitter; he does that often.
colloquial.zh: Maja：那个男人又往地上吐口水了。Tom：是啊，他是个爱吐口水的人，经常这样。

messages.speaker: Maja (路人)
messages.zh: 那个男人又往地上吐口水了。
messages.en: That man spat on the ground again.

messages.speaker: Tom (同行朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, huwa beżżieq; jagħmel hekk ta' spiss.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, huwa beżżieq; jagħmel hekk ta' spiss.
messages.zh: 是啊，他是个爱吐口水的人，经常这样。
messages.en: Yes, he's a habitual spitter; he does that often.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象同一个人一路走、一路反复吐口水，给画面标上 beżżieq。牢记它指“有这种习惯的人”，不是一次吐口水的动作。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A breast, the part of the chest containing mammary tissue.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 乳房，位于胸部、含有乳腺组织的身体部位。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Parti tal-ġisem fuq is-sider li fiha tessut u glandoli li jistgħu jipproduċu l-ħalib.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 乳房。

formal.mt: Fid-dijagramma tal-anatomija, il-beżżula tidher fuq in-naħa ta' quddiem tas-sider.
formal.en: In the anatomy diagram, the breast is shown on the front of the chest.
formal.zh: 解剖图中，乳房显示在胸部前侧。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Din il-kelma, beżżula, tfisser breast bl-Ingliż? Sara: Iva, hawn qed nitkellmu dwar parti tal-ġisem fuq is-sider.
colloquial.en: Lara: Does this word, beżżula, mean breast in English? Sara: Yes, here we're talking about a part of the body on the chest.
colloquial.zh: Lara：beżżula 这个词对应英语的 breast 吗？Sara：对，这里说的是位于胸部的一个身体部位。

messages.speaker: Lara (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Din il-kelma, beżżula, tfisser breast bl-Ingliż?
messages.mt_standard: Din il-kelma, beżżula, tfisser breast bl-Ingliż?
messages.zh: beżżula 这个词对应英语的 breast 吗？
messages.en: Does this word, beżżula, mean breast in English?

messages.speaker: Sara (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, hawn qed nitkellmu dwar parti tal-ġisem fuq is-sider.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, hawn qed nitkellmu dwar parti tal-ġisem fuq is-sider.
messages.zh: 对，这里说的是位于胸部的一个身体部位。
messages.en: Yes, here we're talking about a part of the body on the chest.

cognitive_memory_aid: 在简明人体示意图的乳房位置贴上 beżżula，再配读“左侧乳房”这个短语，用身体位置和词组一起记忆。

gloss_zh: 呈乳房状的；圆而延长、形似动物乳房的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Having a rounded, elongated shape resembling an animal's udder.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容物体轮廓圆而延长，外形像动物的乳房。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu forma tonda u tawwalija li tixbah lill-beżżula ta' annimal.

sense_translations.en_definition: having a round, elongated form like an udder
sense_translations.zh_definition: 具有圆而延长、类似动物乳房的形状的。

collocations.en: a vase with a rounded, elongated, udder-like shape
collocations.zh: 一个圆而延长、形似动物乳房的花瓶

collocations.en: a container with a rounded, elongated, udder-like shape
collocations.zh: 一个圆而延长、形似动物乳房的容器

formal.mt: Il-vażun huwa deskritt bħala beżżuli minħabba l-forma tonda u tawwalija tiegħu, li tixbah lill-beżżula ta' annimal.
formal.en: The vase is described as udder-shaped because its rounded, elongated form resembles an animal's udder.
formal.zh: 这个花瓶被描述为乳房状，因为它的轮廓圆而延长，像动物的乳房。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Xi tfisser meta tgħid li dan il-vażun hu beżżuli? Sara: Qed niddeskrivi l-forma tiegħu: tonda u tawwalija, bħall-beżżula ta' annimal.
colloquial.en: Lara: What do you mean when you say this vase is udder-shaped? Sara: I'm describing its shape: rounded and elongated, like an animal's udder.
colloquial.zh: Lara：你说这个花瓶呈乳房状，是什么意思？Sara：我是在描述它的形状：圆而延长，像动物的乳房。

messages.speaker: Lara (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Xi tfisser meta tgħid li dan il-vażun hu beżżuli?
messages.mt_standard: Xi tfisser meta tgħid li dan il-vażun hu beżżuli?
messages.zh: 你说这个花瓶呈乳房状，是什么意思？
messages.en: What do you mean when you say this vase is udder-shaped?

messages.speaker: Sara (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Qed niddeskrivi l-forma tiegħu: tonda u tawwalija, bħall-beżżula ta' annimal.
messages.mt_standard: Qed niddeskrivi l-forma tiegħu: tonda u tawwalija, bħall-beżżula ta' annimal.
messages.zh: 我是在描述它的形状：圆而延长，像动物的乳房。
messages.en: I'm describing its shape: rounded and elongated, like an animal's udder.

cognitive_memory_aid: 画一个轮廓圆润又向下延长的容器，在旁边写 beżżuli；记住两个形状条件“圆”和“长”，再联想到动物乳房的外形。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Misfortune or bad luck, referring to unfortunate events or the experience of being unlucky.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指不幸、厄运或坏运气；既可着重说遭遇不幸，也可着重说运气不佳。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Sfortuna jew xorti ħażina, kemm bħala ġrajjiet koroh kif ukoll bħala esperjenza li l-affarijiet ma jmorrux tajjeb.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 不幸；不幸的遭遇。
坏运气；厄运。

formal.mt: Ir-rakkont juri kif il-familja tegħleb il-beżżuliżmu bl-għajnuna tal-ħbieb u b'ħafna perseveranza.
formal.en: The story shows how the family overcomes misfortune with help from friends and great perseverance.
formal.zh: 故事展示了这个家庭如何在朋友的帮助下，凭借顽强的毅力克服不幸。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Tlifna l-karozza tal-linja u mbagħad bdiet ix-xita! Tom: X'beżżuliżmu llum! Ejja nistennew ġewwa sakemm tieqaf.
colloquial.en: Maja: We missed the bus and then it started raining! Tom: What bad luck today! Let's wait inside until it stops.
colloquial.zh: Maja：我们错过了公交车，接着又下起雨来！Tom：今天真倒霉！我们到里面等雨停吧。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Tlifna l-karozza tal-linja u mbagħad bdiet ix-xita!
messages.mt_standard: Tlifna l-karozza tal-linja u mbagħad bdiet ix-xita!
messages.zh: 我们错过了公交车，接着又下起雨来！
messages.en: We missed the bus and then it started raining!

messages.speaker: Tom (同行朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: X'beżżuliżmu llum! Ejja nistennew ġewwa sakemm tieqaf.
messages.mt_standard: X'beżżuliżmu llum! Ejja nistennew ġewwa sakemm tieqaf.
messages.zh: 今天真倒霉！我们到里面等雨停吧。
messages.en: What bad luck today! Let's wait inside until it stops.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把“错过公交车，接着又淋雨”串成一幅倒霉小漫画，用 beżżuliżmu 给整段遭遇命名；分别联想“不幸遭遇”和“坏运气”两个侧重点。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of sending something to another person or place.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把某物发送或寄送给他人、送往另一地点的行为。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att li tibgħat xi ħaġa lil persuna oħra jew lejn post ieħor.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 发送或寄送这一行为。

formal.mt: Il-bgħit tad-dokumenti għandu jsir qabel il-Ġimgħa.
formal.en: The documents must be sent before Friday.
formal.zh: 文件必须在星期五之前寄出。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Kemm jiswa l-bgħit ta' dan il-pakkett? Mark: Jiswa ħames ewro.
colloquial.en: Maja: How much does sending this parcel cost? Mark: It costs five euros.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：寄这个包裹要多少钱？马克：五欧元。

messages.speaker: Maja (顾客)
messages.mt_spoken: Kemm jiswa l-bgħit ta' dan il-pakkett?
messages.mt_standard: Kemm jiswa l-bgħit ta' dan il-pakkett?
messages.zh: 寄这个包裹要多少钱？
messages.en: How much does sending this parcel cost?

messages.speaker: Mark (邮局职员)
messages.zh: 五欧元。
messages.en: It costs five euros.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 bgħit 对应到把包裹交给邮局的动作，重点记住它表示寄送这件事。

gloss_zh: 未经耕种而自然长成的；行为不当或不厚道的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Describing crops or produce that grow or are obtained without prior cultivation.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容未经事先耕种便自然长成的作物或由此获得的收成。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jikbru jew jinkisbu mingħajr kultivazzjoni minn qabel, meta jingħad dwar uċuħ tar-raba' jew prodotti simili.

sense_translations.en_definition: yield without prior cultivation (used of crops, etc)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 形容未经事先耕种便自然长成、产出的作物或收成。
比喻行为不得体、不厚道或对人不友善。

collocations.zh: 未经事先耕种便自然生长的植物
不得体或不厚道的行为

formal.mt: Il-kelma 'bgħulija' tista' tiddeskrivi ħxejjex li kibru mingħajr kultivazzjoni minn qabel.
formal.en: The word 'bgħulija' can describe plants that grew without prior cultivation.
formal.zh: bgħulija 一词可以形容未经事先耕种便自然生长的植物。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Dik kienet imġiba bgħulija. Mark: Għandek raġun; ma kienx sew li jidħak biha.
colloquial.en: Lara: That was unkind behaviour. Mark: You're right; it was wrong of him to laugh at her.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：那种行为真不厚道。马克：你说得对；他不该嘲笑她。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 那种行为真不厚道。
messages.en: That was unkind behaviour.

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandek raġun; ma kienx sew li jidħak biha.
messages.mt_standard: Għandek raġun; ma kienx sew li jidħak biha.
messages.zh: 你说得对；他不该嘲笑她。
messages.en: You're right; it was wrong of him to laugh at her.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 bgħulija 配两张记忆卡：一张画未经耕种的植物，一张画嘲笑他人的行为，分别记住两个义项。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Animals belonging to the bovine group.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 牛类动物的统称，用于指这一类动物。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Annimali li jagħmlu parti mill-grupp tal-baqar.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 牛类动物。

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi l-kura tal-bhejjem il-fart fir-razzett.
formal.en: The report describes the care of bovines on the farm.
formal.zh: 报告描述了农场里牛类动物的照料情况。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Dawk kollha bhejjem il-fart? Pawlu: Iva, huma baqar mir-razzett ta' ħdejna.
colloquial.en: Maja: Are all those animals bovines? Pawlu: Yes, they are cows from the farm next to ours.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：那些全是牛类动物吗？保罗：是的，都是我们隔壁农场的牛。

messages.speaker: Maja (访客)
messages.zh: 那些全是牛类动物吗？
messages.en: Are all those animals bovines?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (农场主)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, huma baqar mir-razzett ta' ħdejna.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, huma baqar mir-razzett ta' ħdejna.
messages.zh: 是的，都是我们隔壁农场的牛。
messages.en: Yes, they are cows from the farm next to ours.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把整个短语 bhejjem il-fart 写在牛群图片下，按完整词组记忆它表示牛类动物。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Animals belonging to the canine group.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 犬类动物的统称，用于指这一类动物。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Annimali li jagħmlu parti mill-grupp tal-klieb.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 犬类动物。

formal.mt: Il-lezzjoni tiddeskrivi l-imġiba tal-bhejjem il-kelb u l-ħtiġijiet tagħhom.
formal.en: The lesson describes the behaviour of canines and their needs.
formal.zh: 这节课介绍犬类动物的行为及其需求。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Il-klieb huma bhejjem il-kelb? Anna: Iva, il-klieb jagħmlu parti minn dak il-grupp.
colloquial.en: Lara: Are dogs canines? Anna: Yes, dogs belong to that group.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：狗属于犬类动物吗？安娜：是的，狗属于这一类。

messages.speaker: Lara (学生)
messages.zh: 狗属于犬类动物吗？
messages.en: Are dogs canines?

messages.speaker: Anna (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, il-klieb jagħmlu parti minn dak il-grupp.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, il-klieb jagħmlu parti minn dak il-grupp.
messages.zh: 是的，狗属于这一类。
messages.en: Yes, dogs belong to that group.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 bhejjem il-kelb 整体贴在犬类图片旁，再与牛类词组分开复习，记牢各自所指的动物类别。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An individual small animal.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一只体型较小的动物。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Annimal żgħir.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 一只小动物。

collocations.en: a small animal in the garden

formal.mt: It-tfal osservaw bhejma żgħira fil-ġnien mingħajr ma disturbawha.
formal.en: The children observed a little animal in the garden without disturbing it.
formal.zh: 孩子们观察了花园里的一只小动物，没有打扰它。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'inhi dik il-bhejma ħdejn il-bieb? Mark: Ma nafx, imma ejja nħalluha tgħaddi.
colloquial.en: Maja: What is that little animal near the door? Mark: I don't know, but let's let it pass.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：门边那只小动物是什么？马克：我不知道，不过让它过去吧。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 门边那只小动物是什么？
messages.en: What is that little animal near the door?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ma nafx, imma ejja nħalluha tgħaddi.
messages.mt_standard: Ma nafx, imma ejja nħalluha tgħaddi.
messages.zh: 我不知道，不过让它过去吧。
messages.en: I don't know, but let's let it pass.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一只从门边经过的小动物，把这个具体画面配给 bhejma，记住本词条的小动物义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A monster, such as a frightening creature in a story.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 怪物，例如故事中令人害怕的生物。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Mostru, bħal ħlejqa tal-biża' fi storja.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 一个怪物。

collocations.en: a monster in the fairy tale

formal.mt: Fil-ħrafa, il-bhim jgħasses id-daħla tal-għar.
formal.en: In the fairy tale, the monster guards the entrance to the cave.
formal.zh: 童话中，怪物守着洞穴的入口。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Hemm bhim f'din l-istorja? Mark: Iva, imma fl-aħħar it-tfal jaħarbu minnu.
colloquial.en: Lara: Is there a monster in this story? Mark: Yes, but the children escape from it in the end.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：这个故事里有怪物吗？马克：有，不过孩子们最后逃脱了。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 这个故事里有怪物吗？
messages.en: Is there a monster in this story?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, imma fl-aħħar it-tfal jaħarbu minnu.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, imma fl-aħħar it-tfal jaħarbu minnu.
messages.zh: 有，不过孩子们最后逃脱了。
messages.en: Yes, but the children escape from it in the end.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 bhim 配给守在洞口的童话怪物，再与 bhejma 的小动物画面对照，避免混淆两个词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act or process of an animal laying eggs.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 动物产下卵的行为或过程；说到母鸡时就是下蛋。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att jew il-proċess li bih annimal ibid il-bajd.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 产卵的行为；下蛋的过程。

collocations.en: the laying of eggs by hens

formal.mt: Il-bidwi jżomm nota tal-bidien tat-tiġieġ fir-razzett.
formal.en: The farmer keeps a record of the hens' egg laying on the farm.
formal.zh: 农场主记录农场里母鸡的下蛋情况。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Beda l-bidien tat-tiġieġ? Pawlu: Iva, illum sibt l-ewwel bajda fil-bejta.
colloquial.en: Sara: Have the hens started laying eggs? Pawlu: Yes, today I found the first egg in the nest.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：母鸡开始下蛋了吗？保罗：开始了，今天我在窝里发现了第一枚蛋。

messages.speaker: Sara (邻居)
messages.zh: 母鸡开始下蛋了吗？
messages.en: Have the hens started laying eggs?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (养鸡人)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, illum sibt l-ewwel bajda fil-bejta.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, illum sibt l-ewwel bajda fil-bejta.
messages.zh: 开始了，今天我在窝里发现了第一枚蛋。
messages.en: Yes, today I found the first egg in the nest.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象母鸡下蛋的连续画面，把 bidien 标在整个过程上；它指“产卵这件事”，记忆重点放在行为和过程。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The time when something starts, or the beginning of an activity or event.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 某事开始的时间，或活动、事件的开端。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-ħin meta tibda xi ħaġa, jew il-bidu ta' attività jew ġrajja.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 开始时间；活动或事件预定开始的时刻。
开始；某事的开端。

formal.mt: Il-programm jindika l-bidjien u t-tmiem ta' kull attività.
formal.en: The programme indicates the start and end of each activity.
formal.zh: 日程表标明每项活动的开始和结束。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Il-programm juri l-bidjien tal-laqgħa? Mark: Iva, il-laqgħa tibda fid-disgħa.
colloquial.en: Maja: Does the programme show the meeting's start time? Mark: Yes, the meeting starts at nine.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：日程表上写了会议的开始时间吗？马克：写了，会议九点开始。

messages.speaker: Maja (同事)
messages.zh: 日程表上写了会议的开始时间吗？
messages.en: Does the programme show the meeting's start time?

messages.speaker: Mark (同事)
messages.zh: 写了，会议九点开始。
messages.en: Yes, the meeting starts at nine.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 bidjien 放在时间轴的起点旁：问几点开始时记“开始时间”，讲事情进程时记“开端”。

gloss_zh: 体格健壮的；身材肥硕的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Having a robust or corpulent body; strongly built or stout.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容体格健壮、结实，或身材肥硕、粗壮。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu ġisem b'saħħtu u mibni sew, jew ġisem oħxon.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 体格健壮的；身材肥硕、粗壮的。

collocations.zh: 体格健壮或粗壮的男子

formal.mt: L-awtur jiddeskrivi lill-karattru bħala raġel bidni b'leħen qawwi.
formal.en: The author describes the character as a stout man with a powerful voice.
formal.zh: 作者把这个人物描写成一名身材粗壮、声音洪亮的男子。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Kif jidher il-karattru fil-ktieb? Mark: Huwa raġel bidni b'leħja twila.
colloquial.en: Maja: What does the character in the book look like? Mark: He is a stout man with a long beard.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：书里这个人物长什么样？马克：他是个身材粗壮、留着长胡子的男子。

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.zh: 书里这个人物长什么样？

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)

messages.en: He is a stout man with a long beard.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记 bidni 时想象小说人物的粗壮轮廓：重点是身体健壮或肥硕，不能只理解为力气大。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To give something and receive something else in return.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把某物交给对方，并换取另一物；交换。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jagħti xi ħaġa u jieħu xi ħaġa oħra minflokha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 交换；用一物换取另一物。

collocations.en: exchanged a book with a friend
exchanged a toy for another one
collocations.zh: 用一个玩具换了另一个

formal.mt: Matul l-attività, kull student biedel ktieb ma' student ieħor.

formal.zh: 活动期间，每位学生都与另一位学生交换了一本书。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Dan il-ktieb minn fejn ġie? Mark: Pawlu biedel ktieb miegħi, u tani dan.
colloquial.en: Maja: Where did this book come from? Mark: Pawlu exchanged a book with me and gave me this one.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这本书是哪儿来的？马克：保罗和我换了书，给我的就是这本。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 这本书是哪儿来的？
messages.en: Where did this book come from?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Pawlu biedel ktieb miegħi, u tani dan.
messages.mt_standard: Pawlu biedel ktieb miegħi, u tani dan.

messages.en: Pawlu exchanged a book with me and gave me this one.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两个人互递书本的画面记 biedel：一件东西给出去，另一件东西换回来，就是“交换”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The sale of goods, or the goods offered for sale.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 售卖货物这一活动，或供出售的货品。

sense_translations.zh_definition: 售卖；供出售的货物、商品。

formal.mt: L-avviż iħabbar biegħa ta' kotba fis-sala tal-iskola.
formal.en: The notice announces a sale of books in the school hall.
formal.zh: 通知宣布将在学校礼堂举行书籍售卖活动。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'hemm fil-biegħa tal-lum? Mark: Hemm kotba u ġugarelli.
colloquial.en: Maja: What's in today's sale? Mark: There are books and toys.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：今天卖些什么？马克：有书和玩具。

messages.speaker: Maja (顾客)
messages.zh: 今天卖些什么？
messages.en: What's in today's sale?

messages.speaker: Mark (售货员)

messages.en: There are books and toys.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 biegħa 连到摆着商品的售卖摊位：既记“售卖”活动，也记摊位上供出售的“货品”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The peregrine falcon, a bird of prey of the species Falco peregrinus.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 游隼，一种猛禽，学名为 Falco peregrinus。

a sighting of a peregrine falcon

formal.zh: 在观察报告中，这只鸟被鉴定为游隼，学名 Falco peregrinus。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Dan fir-ritratt huwa bies prim? Mark: Iva, ara l-isem Falco peregrinus taħtu.

colloquial.zh: 玛雅：照片里这只是游隼吗？马克：是的，看下面标着的学名 Falco peregrinus。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The lanner falcon, a bird of prey of the species Falco biarmicus.

collocations.zh: 一次地中海隼目击记录

sense_translations.zh_definition: 燕隼（Falco subbuteo）。

a sighting of a Eurasian hobby

teaching_sense.en_definition: The bird called the Barbary falcon, identified as Falco pelegrinoides.

messages.zh: 是的，这里两个名称指同一种鸟。
messages.en: Yes, here both names refer to the same bird.

messages.speaker: Lara (学生)
messages.zh: 那我把它们一起记在笔记里。
messages.en: Then I'll keep them together in my notes.

cognitive_memory_aid: 画一只巴巴里隼，再给图片贴上 bies tal-barr 和 bies ta' Barbarija 两个标签，记住“两种名称，同一种鸟”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The bird called the saker falcon, identified as Falco cherrug.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一种称为猎隼的鸟，学名为 Falco cherrug。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Għasfur magħruf bħala bies tal-Lvant, bl-isem xjentifiku Falco cherrug.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 猎隼（Falco cherrug）。

collocations.en: a picture of a saker falcon

formal.mt: Il-karta tat-tagħlim tagħti l-isem bies tal-Lvant flimkien mal-isem xjentifiku Falco cherrug.
formal.en: The teaching sheet gives the name bies tal-Lvant together with the scientific name Falco cherrug.
formal.zh: 教学资料上同时列出了马耳他语名称 bies tal-Lvant 和学名 Falco cherrug。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Liema stampa turi bies tal-Lvant? Ġorġ: Din, ħdejn l-isem Falco cherrug. Anna: Rajtha, grazzi. Issa naf liema nagħżel.
colloquial.en: Anna: Which picture shows a saker falcon? Ġorġ: This one, beside the name Falco cherrug. Anna: I see it, thanks. Now I know which one to choose.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：哪张图片上是猎隼？乔治：这张，在 Falco cherrug 这个名称旁边。安娜：看到了，谢谢。现在我知道该选哪张了。

messages.speaker: Anna (学生)
messages.zh: 哪张图片上是猎隼？
messages.en: Which picture shows a saker falcon?

messages.speaker: Ġorġ (同学)
messages.zh: 这张，在 Falco cherrug 这个名称旁边。
messages.en: This one, beside the name Falco cherrug.

messages.speaker: Anna (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Rajtha, grazzi. Issa naf liema nagħżel.
messages.mt_standard: Rajtha, grazzi. Issa naf liema nagħżel.
messages.zh: 看到了，谢谢。现在我知道该选哪张了。
messages.en: I see it, thanks. Now I know which one to choose.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给猎隼图片配上“bies tal-Lvant—saker—Falco cherrug”三行标签，遮住一行回忆另一行，练习准确对应。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The bird known in English as the goshawk.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指英语中称为 goshawk 的鸟，即苍鹰。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Għasfur magħruf bħala bies tal-ħamiem, li bl-Ingliż jissejjaħ goshawk.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 苍鹰。

formal.mt: Fit-taħriġ tat-traduzzjoni, l-istudenti għandhom jittraduċu bies tal-ħamiem bħala goshawk bl-Ingliż.
formal.en: In the translation exercise, students should translate bies tal-ħamiem as goshawk in English.
formal.zh: 在翻译练习中，学生应把 bies tal-ħamiem 译为英语 goshawk，即苍鹰。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Kif ngħid bies tal-ħamiem bl-Ingliż? Ben: Goshawk. Hekk hemm miktub fid-dizzjunarju. Nina: Sewwa, nikteb il-kelma ħdejn l-istampa.
colloquial.en: Nina: How do I say bies tal-ħamiem in English? Ben: Goshawk. That is what the dictionary says. Nina: Right, I'll write the word beside the picture.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：bies tal-ħamiem 用英语怎么说？本：Goshawk，词典里是这样写的。妮娜：好，我把这个词写在图片旁边。

messages.speaker: Nina (学生)
messages.zh: bies tal-ħamiem 用英语怎么说？
messages.en: How do I say bies tal-ħamiem in English?

messages.speaker: Ben (同学)
messages.zh: Goshawk，词典里是这样写的。
messages.en: Goshawk. That is what the dictionary says.

messages.speaker: Nina (学生)
messages.zh: 好，我把这个词写在图片旁边。
messages.en: Right, I'll write the word beside the picture.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 bies tal-ħamiem 当作完整鸟名，和“苍鹰—goshawk”一起朗读；用图片建立对应，避免拆开名称猜译。

gloss_zh: 可以这么说；姑且这么说；也用作填充语

teaching_sense.en_definition: An expression meaning 'so to speak' or 'if you will', used to qualify wording or simply to fill a pause in speech.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 表示“可以这么说”或“姑且这么说”的表达，用于缓和或限定措辞，也常用作说话时的填充语。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Espressjoni li tintuża biex turi li kliem għandu jinftiehem b'mod approssimattiv jew figurattiv, jew sempliċement biex timla pawża fid-diskors.

sense_translations.en_definition: so to speak, if you will; also often used as a mere filler
sense_translations.zh_definition: 可以这么说，姑且这么说；也常仅用作话语填充语。

collocations.mt: huwa, biex ngħidu hekk, il-qalb tal-proġett
collocations.en: it is, so to speak, the heart of the project
collocations.zh: 可以这么说，它是这个项目的核心

collocations.mt: aħna, biex ngħidu hekk, familja waħda
collocations.en: we are, so to speak, one family

formal.mt: Il-librerija hija, biex ngħidu hekk, il-qalb kulturali tal-iskola.
formal.en: The library is, so to speak, the cultural heart of the school.
formal.zh: 图书馆可以说是学校的文化心脏。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Int dejjem torganizza kollox! Toni: Jien, biex ngħidu hekk, is-segretarju tal-grupp. Maja: Mela għidilna x'ħin niltaqgħu.
colloquial.en: Maja: You always organize everything! Toni: I'm, so to speak, the group's secretary. Maja: Then tell us what time we're meeting.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：每次都是你安排所有事情！托尼：可以这么说，我就是小组的秘书。玛雅：那告诉我们几点见面吧。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 每次都是你安排所有事情！
messages.en: You always organize everything!

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Jien, biex ngħidu hekk, is-segretarju tal-grupp.
messages.mt_standard: Jien, biex ngħidu hekk, is-segretarju tal-grupp.
messages.zh: 可以这么说，我就是小组的秘书。
messages.en: I'm, so to speak, the group's secretary.

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 那告诉我们几点见面吧。
messages.en: Then tell us what time we're meeting.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象说话时先停半拍，再补一句“可以这么说”；把整段短语当作措辞缓冲垫，也记住它有时只是填充停顿。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A surname used as a family name.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一个姓氏，用作人的家族名称，书写形式为 Bigeni。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kunjom, jiġifieri isem tal-familja, miktub Bigeni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 姓氏 Bigeni。

formal.mt: Fil-formola, ikteb Bigeni fil-kaxxa tal-kunjom u l-isem personali fil-kaxxa tal-isem.
formal.en: On the form, write Bigeni in the surname box and the given name in the first-name box.
formal.zh: 在表格中，将 Bigeni 填入姓氏栏，将名字填入名字栏。

colloquial.mt: Lara: X'kunjom għandek? David: Bigeni. Lara: Tista' tispellih, jekk jogħġbok? David: Iva: B, I, G, E, N, I.
colloquial.en: Lara: What is your surname? David: Bigeni. Lara: Could you spell it, please? David: Yes: B, I, G, E, N, I.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：你姓什么？戴维：Bigeni。拉拉：请拼一下好吗？戴维：好的，B、I、G、E、N、I。

messages.speaker: Lara (接待员)
messages.zh: 你姓什么？
messages.en: What is your surname?

messages.speaker: David (访客)
messages.zh: Bigeni。
messages.en: Bigeni.

messages.speaker: Lara (接待员)
messages.zh: 请拼一下好吗？
messages.en: Could you spell it, please?

messages.speaker: David (访客)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva: B, I, G, E, N, I.
messages.mt_standard: Iva: B, I, G, E, N, I.
messages.zh: 好的，B、I、G、E、N、I。
messages.en: Yes: B, I, G, E, N, I.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象登记表的“姓氏”栏里写着 Bigeni，再逐字母拼读 B-I-G-E-N-I；把它作为专名记忆，并注意首字母大写。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of crying or shedding tears.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 哭泣或流泪这一行为。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att li wieħed jibki jew ixerred id-dmugħ.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 哭泣；流泪。

formal.mt: Fl-aħħar tar-rakkont, il-biki tat-tifel juri n-niket tiegħu.
formal.en: At the end of the story, the boy's weeping reveals his sorrow.
formal.zh: 故事结尾，男孩的哭泣表现出他的悲伤。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Qed tisma' dak il-biki? Pawlu: Iva, it-tarbija trid il-ħalib.
colloquial.en: Lara: Can you hear that crying? Pawlu: Yes, the baby wants milk.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：你听见那阵哭声了吗？保罗：听见了，宝宝想喝奶。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 你听见那阵哭声了吗？
messages.en: Can you hear that crying?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.zh: 听见了，宝宝想喝奶。
messages.en: Yes, the baby wants milk.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 biki 配上一滴眼泪的图像，记住它是表示“哭泣”这一行为的名词，也可在语境中指哭声。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To cause someone to cry.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使某人哭泣，可以由悲伤、感动或其他情绪引起。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Iġiegħel lil xi ħadd jibki.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使某人哭泣；把某人弄哭。

formal.mt: Id-diskors tal-istudent bikka lil ħafna mill-ġenituri preżenti.
formal.en: The student's speech made many of the parents present cry.
formal.zh: 这名学生的演讲使在场的许多家长落泪。

colloquial.mt: Marta: Dak il-film bikka lil ħija. Toni: Lili wkoll; it-tmiem kien imdejjaq ħafna.
colloquial.en: Marta: That film made my brother cry. Toni: Me too; the ending was very sad.
colloquial.zh: 玛尔塔：那部电影把我哥哥看哭了。托尼：我也是；结局太悲伤了。

messages.speaker: Marta (朋友)
messages.zh: 那部电影把我哥哥看哭了。
messages.en: That film made my brother cry.

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Lili wkoll; it-tmiem kien imdejjaq ħafna.
messages.mt_standard: Lili wkoll; it-tmiem kien imdejjaq ħafna.
messages.zh: 我也是；结局太悲伤了。
messages.en: Me too; the ending was very sad.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“电影→观众落泪”的箭头记 bikka：重点是某事或某人“使别人哭”，而不是单纯描述哭泣。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who leaves someone else unable to speak or respond.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使别人说不出话或无法回应的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li ġġiegħel lil ħaddieħor jibqa' bla kliem jew bla tweġiba.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使某人哑口无言、说不出话的人。

collocations.zh: 使批评者无言以对的人

formal.mt: Fir-rakkont, l-oratur huwa deskritt bħala bikkiem tal-avversarji tiegħu.
formal.en: In the story, the speaker is described as someone who leaves his opponents speechless.
formal.zh: 故事中，这位演说者被描述为一个使对手哑口无言的人。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Għaliex sejjaħtlu bikkiem? Mark: Għax bil-mistoqsija tiegħu ħalla lil kulħadd bla tweġiba.
colloquial.en: Nina: Why did you call him someone who leaves people speechless? Mark: Because his question left everyone without an answer.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：你为什么称他为使人哑口无言的人？马克：因为他的问题让大家都答不上来。

messages.speaker: Nina (同学)
messages.zh: 你为什么称他为使人哑口无言的人？
messages.en: Why did you call him someone who leaves people speechless?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax bil-mistoqsija tiegħu ħalla lil kulħadd bla tweġiba.
messages.mt_standard: Għax bil-mistoqsija tiegħu ħalla lil kulħadd bla tweġiba.
messages.zh: 因为他的问题让大家都答不上来。
messages.en: Because his question left everyone without an answer.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象辩论中一个问题让全场无言，把 bikkiem 贴在提问者身上：它指使别人说不出话的那个人。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The state of being unable to speak.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 不能说话、无法用言语表达的状态。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-kundizzjoni li fiha persuna ma tkunx tista' titkellem.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 不能说话的状态；缄默状态。

formal.mt: Fir-rumanz, il-bikma tal-karattru tagħmel il-komunikazzjoni bil-ġesti essenzjali.
formal.en: In the novel, the character's muteness makes communication through gestures essential.
formal.zh: 在小说中，这个人物不能说话，因此必须借助手势交流。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Xi tfisser bikma f'dan ir-rakkont? David: Tfisser li l-karattru ma jistax jitkellem.
colloquial.en: Sara: What does muteness mean in this story? David: It means that the character cannot speak.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：这篇故事里的 bikma 是什么意思？戴维：意思是这个人物不能说话。

messages.speaker: Sara (学生)
messages.zh: 这篇故事里的 bikma 是什么意思？
messages.en: What does muteness mean in this story?

messages.speaker: David (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Tfisser li l-karattru ma jistax jitkellem.
messages.mt_standard: Tfisser li l-karattru ma jistax jitkellem.
messages.zh: 意思是这个人物不能说话。
messages.en: It means that the character cannot speak.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 bikma 写在“无法开口、改用手势”的画面旁，记住它表示一种状态；与指人的 bikkiem 分开记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Excellent; used to describe something as very good or of very high quality.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 表示某事物非常好、质量很高或表现出色。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Eċċellenti; jintuża biex jiddeskrivi xi ħaġa tajba ħafna jew ta' kwalità għolja ħafna.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 极好的；非常出色的。

formal.mt: Fir-rapport tiegħu, l-organizzatur iddeskriva l-kunċert bħala wieħed bil-bajd.
formal.en: In his report, the organiser described the concert as excellent.
formal.zh: 组织者在报告中称这场音乐会十分精彩。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Kif kien il-kunċert ilbieraħ? Mark: Bil-bajd! Ħadt gost ħafna.
colloquial.en: Lara: How was the concert yesterday? Mark: Excellent! I really enjoyed it.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：昨天的音乐会怎么样？马克：精彩极了！我特别喜欢。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 昨天的音乐会怎么样？
messages.en: How was the concert yesterday?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 精彩极了！我特别喜欢。
messages.en: Excellent! I really enjoyed it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 bil-bajd 整块记成一句热情的好评，联想看完精彩演出后说“棒极了”，帮助记住“出色”的用法。

gloss_zh: 闷闷不乐的；烦躁不安的；恼火的

teaching_sense.en_definition: In a gloomy, nervous, or annoyed mood.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容人情绪低落、紧张烦躁或心里恼火的状态。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Fi stat ta' dwejjaq, nervożiżmu jew irritazzjoni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 闷闷不乐的、紧张烦躁的或恼火的。

collocations.en: he woke up in a bad mood
he arrived looking gloomy or annoyed
collocations.zh: 他到来时一副郁闷或恼火的样子

formal.mt: Fir-rakkont, il-karattru prinċipali jasal bil-bajda mdawra u ma jkellem lil ħadd.
formal.en: In the story, the main character arrives in a gloomy mood and speaks to no one.
formal.zh: 故事中，主人公闷闷不乐地到来，谁也不理。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex Mark ma jridx ikellimna llum? Lara: Qam bil-bajda mdawra. Ħallih ftit waħdu.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why doesn't Mark want to talk to us today? Lara: He woke up in a bad mood. Leave him alone for a little while.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：马克今天为什么不想跟我们说话？拉拉：他一起床就心情不好。让他自己待一会儿吧。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex Mark ma jridx ikellimna llum?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex Mark ma jridx ikellimna llum?
messages.zh: 马克今天为什么不想跟我们说话？
messages.en: Why doesn't Mark want to talk to us today?

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Qam bil-bajda mdawra. Ħallih ftit waħdu.
messages.mt_standard: Qam bil-bajda mdawra. Ħallih ftit waħdu.
messages.zh: 他一起床就心情不好。让他自己待一会儿吧。
messages.en: He woke up in a bad mood. Leave him alone for a little while.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把整个短语配上一个皱眉、心烦的人物表情来记；看到 bil-bajda mdawra，就想到“今天心情不太好”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: In a sulky manner, showing displeasure or resentment.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 带着不高兴或怨气，以闹别扭、赌气的态度做某事。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: B'mod li juri li wieħed hu mdejjaq jew offiż u qed jagħmel il-geddum.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 闹别扭地；赌气地；带着不悦地。

formal.mt: Fir-rakkont, it-tifel wieġeb bil-geddum meta missieru talbu jitfi t-televixin.
formal.en: In the story, the boy answered sulkily when his father asked him to turn off the television.
formal.zh: 故事中，父亲让男孩关掉电视时，男孩赌气地作了回答。

colloquial.mt: Omm: Għaliex weġibtni bil-geddum? Mark: Għax ridt nibqa' nilgħab ftit ieħor.
colloquial.en: Mother: Why did you answer me so sulkily? Mark: Because I wanted to keep playing a little longer.
colloquial.zh: 妈妈：你为什么赌气地回答我？马克：因为我还想再玩一会儿。

messages.speaker: Omm (母亲)
messages.zh: 你为什么赌气地回答我？
messages.en: Why did you answer me so sulkily?

messages.speaker: Mark (儿子)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax ridt nibqa' nilgħab ftit ieħor.
