messages.mt_standard: Għax ridt nibqa' nilgħab ftit ieħor.
messages.zh: 因为我还想再玩一会儿。
messages.en: Because I wanted to keep playing a little longer.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象孩子不高兴地回答一句话，把 bil-geddum 贴在“回答的态度”上，记住它表示“赌气地”，修饰动作。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Only just; almost not, or only to a very small extent.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 表示某事勉强发生、差一点没有发生，或程度非常小。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Biss bi ftit; kważi xejn jew kważi ma seħħitx xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 几乎不；勉强才；仅仅达到某种程度。

formal.mt: Minħabba ċ-ċpar, il-bini fuq in-naħa l-oħra tat-triq bil-kemm jidher.
formal.en: Because of the fog, the buildings on the other side of the road are barely visible.
formal.zh: 由于有雾，马路对面的建筑物几乎看不见。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Qed tismagħni sew? Mark: Le, bil-kemm nisma'. Tista' titkellem ftit aktar għoli?
colloquial.en: Maja: Can you hear me clearly? Mark: No, I can barely hear. Can you speak a little louder?
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你能听清我说话吗？马克：不能，我几乎听不见。你能说大声一点吗？

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你能听清我说话吗？
messages.en: Can you hear me clearly?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, bil-kemm nisma'. Tista' titkellem ftit aktar għoli?
messages.mt_standard: Le, bil-kemm nisma'. Tista' titkellem ftit aktar għoli?
messages.zh: 不能，我几乎听不见。你能说大声一点吗？
messages.en: No, I can barely hear. Can you speak a little louder?

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象音量只剩最后一格：还听得到，却非常勉强，用这个画面记住“几乎不、勉强才”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: At a slow pace, taking time rather than moving or acting quickly.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 以缓慢的速度移动或做事，不急着完成。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: B'pass kajman, mingħajr għaġla fil-moviment jew fl-azzjoni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 慢慢地；缓缓地；以不快的速度。

formal.mt: L-istudent qara t-test bil-lajma l-lajma sabiex jifhem kull sentenza.
formal.en: The student read the text slowly so that he could understand every sentence.
formal.zh: 这名学生慢慢阅读课文，以便理解每一个句子。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex qed timxi bil-lajma l-lajma? Mark: Għax għajjien. Nistgħu nieqfu ftit?
colloquial.en: Maja: Why are you walking so slowly? Mark: Because I'm tired. Can we stop for a moment?
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你为什么走得这么慢？马克：因为我累了。我们能停一下吗？

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你为什么走得这么慢？
messages.en: Why are you walking so slowly?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 因为我累了。我们能停一下吗？
messages.en: Because I'm tired. Can we stop for a moment?

cognitive_memory_aid: 把重复的 lajma lajma 想成一步、再一步的慢动作；这是节奏联想，帮助记住“慢慢地”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: In the opposite sense or with the meaning reversed.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 以相反的意思理解或表达，把原来的意思反过来。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: B'sens oppost jew b'tifsira maqluba.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 以相反的意思；反过来理解或表达。

collocations.en: interpret it in the opposite sense

formal.mt: Il-qarrej fehem il-kumment bil-maqlub: l-awtur kien qed ifaħħar il-proposta, mhux jikkritikaha.
formal.en: The reader understood the comment in the opposite sense: the author was praising the proposal, not criticizing it.
formal.zh: 读者把这条评论的意思理解反了：作者是在赞扬这项提议，而不是批评它。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Mela ma għoġbokx il-film? Mark: Fhimtni bil-maqlub! Għoġobni ħafna.
colloquial.en: Maja: So you didn't like the film? Mark: You got my meaning backwards! I liked it a lot.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：所以你不喜欢那部电影？马克：你把我的意思理解反了！我很喜欢。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 所以你不喜欢那部电影？
messages.en: So you didn't like the film?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 你把我的意思理解反了！我很喜欢。
messages.en: You got my meaning backwards! I liked it a lot.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象把写着“赞成”的卡片翻成“反对”：方向和意思都反过来，帮助记住 bil-maqlub。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Secretly, without other people knowing or noticing.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在不让别人知道或察觉的情况下，秘密地或偷偷地做某事。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: B'mod sigriet, mingħajr ma ħaddieħor ikun jaf jew jinduna.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 秘密地；偷偷地；暗中。

formal.mt: Fir-rumanz, iż-żewġ ħbieb iltaqgħu bil-ħabi biex jiddiskutu l-pjan tagħhom.
formal.en: In the novel, the two friends met secretly to discuss their plan.
formal.zh: 小说中，两位朋友秘密会面，讨论他们的计划。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex qed tħejju kollox bil-ħabi? Lara: Għax qed norganizzaw festa sorpriża għal Mark!
colloquial.en: Maja: Why are you preparing everything secretly? Lara: Because we're organising a surprise party for Mark!
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你们为什么偷偷地准备这一切？拉拉：因为我们在给马克筹办惊喜派对！

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你们为什么偷偷地准备这一切？
messages.en: Why are you preparing everything secretly?

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax qed norganizzaw festa sorpriża għal Mark!
messages.mt_standard: Għax qed norganizzaw festa sorpriża għal Mark!
messages.zh: 因为我们在给马克筹办惊喜派对！
messages.en: Because we're organising a surprise party for Mark!

cognitive_memory_aid: 联想朋友悄悄准备惊喜派对的场景：事情正在进行，但主角还不知道；用这个画面记 bil-ħabi 的“秘密地”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A wheel that oscillates back and forth to regulate the timekeeping of a mechanical watch or clock.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 机械钟表中来回摆动、用于调节走时的轮状部件。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Rota f'arloġġ mekkaniku li titbandal 'il quddiem u lura biex tirregola l-kejl tal-ħin.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 摆轮；机械钟表中调节走时的摆动轮。

collocations.en: the movement of the balance wheel

formal.mt: Waqt l-ispezzjoni, it-tekniku eżamina l-moviment tal-bilanċier tal-arloġġ.
formal.en: During the inspection, the technician examined the movement of the watch's balance wheel.
formal.zh: 检查过程中，技师查看了手表摆轮的运动情况。

colloquial.mt: Anna: X'inhi dik ir-rota żgħira? Ġużeppi: Dik hija l-bilanċier tal-arloġġ; ara kif timxi 'l quddiem u lura.
colloquial.en: Anna: What is that little wheel? Ġużeppi: That is the watch's balance wheel; look how it moves back and forth.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：那个小轮子是什么？朱塞佩：那是手表的摆轮；看，它在来回摆动。

messages.speaker: Anna (顾客)
messages.zh: 那个小轮子是什么？
messages.en: What is that little wheel?

messages.speaker: Ġużeppi (钟表修理师)
messages.mt_spoken: Dik hija l-bilanċier tal-arloġġ; ara kif timxi 'l quddiem u lura.
messages.mt_standard: Dik hija l-bilanċier tal-arloġġ; ara kif timxi 'l quddiem u lura.
messages.zh: 那是手表的摆轮；看，它在来回摆动。
messages.en: That is the watch's balance wheel; look how it moves back and forth.

cognitive_memory_aid: 在脑中放大机械手表，把来回摆动的小轮标为 bilanċier，用“钟表里的摆轮”这一具体画面记忆。

gloss_zh: 与平衡或结余有关的；资产负债表的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Relating to a balance, especially the financial balances shown in accounts.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 与平衡、结余有关的，尤其用于描述账目或资产负债表中的财务数据。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu x'jaqsam ma' bilanċ, speċjalment bilanċ finanzjarju fil-kontijiet.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 与平衡或结余有关的；用于财务语境时指账目或资产负债表方面的。

formal.mt: L-analiżi bilanċjali tqabbel l-assi u l-obbligazzjonijiet tal-kumpanija.
formal.en: The balance-sheet analysis compares the company's assets and liabilities.
formal.zh: 资产负债表分析比较公司的资产与负债。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Fejn insib id-data bilanċjali? Anton: Fit-tabella fl-aħħar tar-rapport.
colloquial.en: Marija: Where can I find the balance-sheet data? Anton: In the table at the end of the report.
colloquial.zh: 玛丽亚：我在哪里能找到资产负债表数据？安东：在报告末尾的表格里。

messages.speaker: Marija (同事)
messages.zh: 我在哪里能找到资产负债表数据？
messages.en: Where can I find the balance-sheet data?

messages.speaker: Anton (会计)
messages.zh: 在报告末尾的表格里。
messages.en: In the table at the end of the report.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 bilanċjali 放在“数据、分析”等名词后一起记，想象一张资产与负债并列的表，提醒自己它是形容词。

gloss_zh: 平衡器；使物体保持平衡的装置

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person or device that brings something into balance or keeps it balanced.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使某物达到或保持平衡的人或装置。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna jew apparat li jġib xi ħaġa f'bilanċ jew iżommha bbilanċjata.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 平衡器；使某物达到或保持平衡的人或装置。

formal.mt: It-tekniku uża bilanċjatur tar-roti biex jiċċekkja l-bilanċ ta' kull rota.
formal.en: The technician used a wheel balancer to check the balance of each wheel.
formal.zh: 技师使用车轮平衡机检查每个车轮的平衡情况。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Għal xiex tuża dan il-bilanċjatur? Karl: Biex niċċekkja jekk ir-rota hijiex ibbilanċjata.
colloquial.en: Rita: What do you use this balancer for? Karl: To check whether the wheel is balanced.
colloquial.zh: 丽塔：你用这台平衡机做什么？卡尔：检查车轮是否平衡。

messages.speaker: Rita (顾客)
messages.zh: 你用这台平衡机做什么？
messages.en: What do you use this balancer for?

messages.speaker: Karl (汽车修理师)
messages.mt_spoken: Biex niċċekkja jekk ir-rota hijiex ibbilanċjata.
messages.mt_standard: Biex niċċekkja jekk ir-rota hijiex ibbilanċjata.
messages.zh: 检查车轮是否平衡。
messages.en: To check whether the wheel is balanced.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象修理店把车轮放上平衡机，将机器标为 bilanċjatur；用“帮助物体达到平衡的装置”记住其功能。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Involving two sides or two parties, such as two countries.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 涉及两个方面或双方的，例如两个国家之间的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jinvolvi żewġ naħat jew żewġ partijiet, bħal żewġ pajjiżi.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 双边的；双方的；涉及两个方面的。

formal.mt: Iż-żewġ pajjiżi ffirmaw ftehim bilaterali dwar il-kooperazzjoni fl-edukazzjoni.
formal.en: The two countries signed a bilateral agreement on cooperation in education.
formal.zh: 两国签署了一项关于教育合作的双边协议。

colloquial.mt: Elena: Xi jfisser ftehim bilaterali? Samwel: Ftehim bejn żewġ partijiet, bħal żewġ pajjiżi.
colloquial.en: Elena: What does a bilateral agreement mean? Samwel: An agreement between two parties, such as two countries.
colloquial.zh: 埃莱娜：双边协议是什么意思？萨姆韦尔：就是双方之间的协议，例如两个国家之间的协议。

messages.speaker: Elena (学生)
messages.zh: 双边协议是什么意思？
messages.en: What does a bilateral agreement mean?

messages.speaker: Samwel (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Ftehim bejn żewġ partijiet, bħal żewġ pajjiżi.
messages.mt_standard: Ftehim bejn żewġ partijiet, bħal żewġ pajjiżi.
messages.zh: 就是双方之间的协议，例如两个国家之间的协议。
messages.en: An agreement between two parties, such as two countries.

cognitive_memory_aid: 画两个人隔桌握手，在两人之间写 bilaterali，看到这个词就想到“涉及双方”，再联想到双边协议。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A name for a kind of bird.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一种鸟的名称；本词条所给释义没有进一步指定鸟种。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Isem ta' tip ta' għasfur.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 一种鸟。

collocations.zh: 一只停在树枝上的 bilbel 鸟
花园里的一只 bilbel 鸟

formal.mt: Fl-istampa tal-ktieb hemm bilbel fuq fergħa ta' siġra.
formal.en: The illustration in the book shows a bilbel on a tree branch.
formal.zh: 书中的插图画着一只停在树枝上的 bilbel 鸟。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'għasfur hemm fl-istampa? Pawlu: Dak bilbel. Ara, qiegħed fuq fergħa.
colloquial.en: Maja: What bird is in the picture? Pawlu: That's a bilbel. Look, it's on a branch.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：图里是什么鸟？保罗：那是 bilbel 鸟。看，它停在树枝上。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.zh: 图里是什么鸟？
messages.en: What bird is in the picture?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (老师)
messages.mt_spoken: Dak bilbel. Ara, qiegħed fuq fergħa.
messages.mt_standard: Dak bilbel. Ara, qiegħed fuq fergħa.
messages.zh: 那是 bilbel 鸟。看，它停在树枝上。
messages.en: That's a bilbel. Look, it's on a branch.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用一张鸟停在树枝上的学习卡记 bilbel；当前只绑定“一种鸟”，不自行补上资料未给出的具体鸟种。

gloss_zh: 具有云雀特征的；似云雀的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Having characteristics associated with a lark; lark-like.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 具有云雀的特征或与云雀相似，用来描述相关的声音或其他特征。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu karatteristiċi ta' alwetta jew jixbah lil alwetta.

sense_translations.en_definition: bearing the characteristics of a lark
sense_translations.zh_definition: 具有云雀特征的；似云雀的。

formal.mt: Fir-reċensjoni, il-kritiku ddeskriva leħen il-kantant bħala bilbli.
formal.en: In the review, the critic described the singer's voice as lark-like.
formal.zh: 评论者在乐评中把这位歌手的嗓音形容为像云雀一般。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Kif tiddeskrivi leħnu? Mark: Għandu leħen bilbli, qisu l-għana ta' alwetta.
colloquial.en: Lara: How would you describe his voice? Mark: He has a lark-like voice, like the singing of a lark.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：你会怎么形容他的嗓音？马克：他的嗓音像云雀，就像云雀在歌唱。

messages.speaker: Lara (同学)
messages.zh: 你会怎么形容他的嗓音？
messages.en: How would you describe his voice?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandu leħen bilbli, qisu l-għana ta' alwetta.
messages.mt_standard: Għandu leħen bilbli, qisu l-għana ta' alwetta.
messages.zh: 他的嗓音像云雀，就像云雀在歌唱。
messages.en: He has a lark-like voice, like the singing of a lark.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 bilbli 放在“像云雀的嗓音”这张学习卡上，重点记它用于描述特征，是形容词，意思是“似云雀的”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The bird called the tawny pipit.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 鸟名，指平原鹨，英语称 tawny pipit。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Għasfur magħruf bl-Ingliż bħala tawny pipit.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 平原鹨。

collocations.en: a tawny pipit in the field
a photograph of a tawny pipit

formal.mt: Ir-rapport tal-osservazzjoni jinkludi ritratt ta' bilblun fl-għalqa.
formal.en: The observation report includes a photograph of a tawny pipit in the field.
formal.zh: 观察报告收录了一张田间平原鹨的照片。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'għasfur hemm fir-ritratt tiegħek? Pawlu: Bilblun. Rajtu fl-għalqa dalgħodu.
colloquial.en: Maja: What bird is in your photograph? Pawlu: A tawny pipit. I saw it in the field this morning.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你的照片里是什么鸟？保罗：一只平原鹨。我今天早上在田里看到了它。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你的照片里是什么鸟？
messages.en: What bird is in your photograph?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (观鸟者)
messages.zh: 一只平原鹨。我今天早上在田里看到了它。
messages.en: A tawny pipit. I saw it in the field this morning.

cognitive_memory_aid: 做一张三语鸟名卡：bilblun—tawny pipit—平原鹨；配上观察照片，记住这里指明确的鸟名。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The number one thousand million, written 1,000,000,000 or 10⁹.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 数词，表示十亿，即一千个百万，写作 1,000,000,000 或 10⁹。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: In-numru elf miljun, miktub 1,000,000,000 jew 10⁹.

formal.mt: Fl-eżempju tal-baġit, l-ispiża totali tal-proġett hija ta' biljun ewro.
formal.en: In the budget example, the total cost of the project is a billion euros.
formal.zh: 在这个预算示例中，项目总成本为十亿欧元。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Kemm hu biljun? Mark: Elf miljun, jiġifieri wieħed b'disa' żerijiet warajh.
colloquial.en: Maja: How much is a billion? Mark: A thousand million, meaning a one followed by nine zeros.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：biljun 是多少？马克：一千个百万，也就是数字一后面加九个零，即十亿。

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.zh: biljun 是多少？
messages.en: How much is a billion?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Elf miljun, jiġifieri wieħed b'disa' żerijiet warajh.
messages.mt_standard: Elf miljun, jiġifieri wieħed b'disa' żerijiet warajh.
messages.zh: 一千个百万，也就是数字一后面加九个零，即十亿。
messages.en: A thousand million, meaning a one followed by nine zeros.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 biljun 与英文 billion、中文“十亿”一起记；写出一后面九个零，再按中文四位分组读成十亿。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Introduces a reason, meaning since or because; it can also introduce a concession, meaning even though.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 引出原因时表示“因为、既然”；引出让步时表示“尽管、即使”。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tgħaqqad żewġ partijiet ta' sentenza biex tagħti raġuni, fis-sens ta' għax, jew konċessjoni, fis-sens ta' għalkemm.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 既然；由于；因为，用来引出某事成立或发生的原因。
尽管；即使，用来引出与主句结果形成让步关系的情况。

formal.mt: Billi ma hemmx biżżejjed ħin għad-diskussjoni, il-laqgħa se tkompli għada.
formal.en: Since there is not enough time for the discussion, the meeting will continue tomorrow.
formal.zh: 由于没有足够的时间进行讨论，会议将于明天继续。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Immorru nimxu? Mark: Billi qed tagħmel ix-xita, aħjar nibqgħu ġewwa.
colloquial.en: Maja: Shall we go for a walk? Mark: Since it's raining, we'd better stay inside.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：我们去散步吗？马克：既然正在下雨，我们还是待在室内吧。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 我们去散步吗？
messages.en: Shall we go for a walk?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Billi qed tagħmel ix-xita, aħjar nibqgħu ġewwa.
messages.mt_standard: Billi qed tagħmel ix-xita, aħjar nibqgħu ġewwa.
messages.zh: 既然正在下雨，我们还是待在室内吧。
messages.en: Since it's raining, we'd better stay inside.

cognitive_memory_aid: 读到 billi 时先判断前后关系：说明理由就想“因为”，出现让步关系就想“尽管”，不要只背一个中文义项。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To drink, expressed with a word used when speaking to young children.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 表示喝水或喝其他饮品，是对幼儿说话时使用的词。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tixrob ilma jew xarba oħra, b'kelma li tintuża meta wieħed jitkellem mat-tfal iż-żgħar.

sense_translations.en_definition: to drink (a word used in child-directed speech)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 喝；用于成人对幼儿说话时，指喝水或其他饮品这一动作。

collocations.en: drank a little water, in child-directed wording
collocations.zh: 喝了一点水（对幼儿说的用语）

collocations.en: drank the milk, in child-directed wording
collocations.zh: 喝了奶（对幼儿说的用语）

formal.mt: F'djalogu ma' tifel żgħir, il-frażi 'It-tifel bimba ftit ilma' tuża kelma tat-taħdit mat-tfal biex tiddeskrivi l-azzjoni tax-xorb.
formal.en: In a dialogue with a young child, the phrase 'The boy drank a little water' uses child-directed wording to describe the act of drinking.
formal.zh: 在与幼儿的对话中，例句“It-tifel bimba ftit ilma”（小男孩喝了一点水）使用了对幼儿说话的词来描述喝水这一动作。

colloquial.mt: Lara: X'għamel il-pupu? Ben: Il-pupu bimba ftit ilma!
colloquial.en: Lara: What did the doll do? Ben: The doll drank a little water!
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：娃娃做了什么呀？本：娃娃喝了一点水！

messages.speaker: Lara (母亲)
messages.zh: 娃娃做了什么呀？
messages.en: What did the doll do?

messages.speaker: Ben (幼儿)
messages.zh: 娃娃喝了一点水！
messages.en: The doll drank a little water!

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 bimba 放进给娃娃喂水的游戏画面：它表示“喝”这个动作；与表示饮品的名词 bimbi 配对记忆。

gloss_zh: 喝的；饮品（对幼儿说的用语）

teaching_sense.en_definition: A drink, referred to with a word used when speaking to young children.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指可以喝的东西，是对幼儿说话时使用的饮品称呼。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Xarba, imsemmija b'kelma li tintuża meta wieħed jitkellem mat-tfal iż-żgħar.

sense_translations.en_definition: a drink (a word used in child-directed speech)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 喝的东西；饮品；用于成人对幼儿说话时。

collocations.en: a little drink, in child-directed wording
collocations.zh: 一点喝的（对幼儿说的用语）

collocations.en: want the drink, in child-directed wording
collocations.zh: 想要那份喝的（对幼儿说的用语）

formal.mt: F'djalogu ma' tifla żgħira, il-mistoqsija 'Trid ftit bimbi?' tuża kelma tat-taħdit mat-tfal biex toffrilha xarba.
formal.en: In a dialogue with a young girl, the question 'Would you like a little drink?' uses child-directed wording to offer her a drink.
formal.zh: 在与幼儿的对话中，问句“Trid ftit bimbi?”（想喝点东西吗？）使用了对幼儿说话的词来询问她是否想要饮品。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Trid ftit bimbi? Mia: Iva, irrid l-ilma, jekk jogħġbok.
colloquial.en: Lara: Would you like a little drink? Mia: Yes, I'd like water, please.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：想喝点东西吗？米娅：想，请给我水。

messages.speaker: Lara (母亲)
messages.zh: 想喝点东西吗？
messages.en: Would you like a little drink?

messages.speaker: Mia (幼儿)
messages.zh: 想，请给我水。
messages.en: Yes, I'd like water, please.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象幼儿指着杯子要“喝的”：bimbi 是杯里那份饮品的称呼；与表示“喝”这一动作的 bimba 分开记。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Son of Man, a title used for Jesus Christ.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: “人子”，用于称呼耶稣基督的称号。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Titlu li jintuża għal Ġesù Kristu.

sense_translations.en_definition: Son of Man (title of Jesus Christ)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 人子，耶稣基督的称号。

collocations.en: Jesus as the Son of Man

formal.mt: F'dan it-test reliġjuż, it-titlu 'Bin il-Bniedem' jirreferi għal Ġesù Kristu.
formal.en: In this religious text, the title 'Son of Man' refers to Jesus Christ.
formal.zh: 在这篇宗教文本中，“人子”这一称号指耶稣基督。

colloquial.mt: Mia: Hawnhekk, min hu Bin il-Bniedem? Pawlu: It-titlu jirreferi għal Ġesù Kristu.
colloquial.en: Mia: Who is the Son of Man here? Pawlu: The title refers to Jesus Christ.
colloquial.zh: 米娅：这里的“人子”是谁？保罗：这个称号指耶稣基督。

messages.speaker: Mia (学生)
messages.zh: 这里的“人子”是谁？
messages.en: Who is the Son of Man here?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (教师)
messages.zh: 这个称号指耶稣基督。
messages.en: The title refers to Jesus Christ.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把整个表达当作一张写着“人子”的称号卡，卡片对应耶稣基督；按完整宗教称号记忆。

gloss_zh: 传记的；与生平记述有关的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Relating to an account of a person's life.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 与一个人的生平记述有关的，用来修饰传记、影片或相关资料等。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu x'jaqsam mar-rakkont tal-ħajja ta' persuna.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 传记的；记述人物生平的；与人物生平有关的。

formal.mt: Il-katalgu jinkludi tagħrif biografiku dwar kull awtur u lista tax-xogħlijiet tiegħu.
formal.en: The catalogue includes biographical information about each author and a list of their works.
formal.zh: 这份目录包含每位作者的生平资料及其作品清单。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'tip ta' film se naraw? Mark: Film biografiku dwar il-ħajja ta' mużiċist.
colloquial.en: Maja: What kind of film are we going to watch? Mark: A biographical film about a musician's life.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：我们要看什么类型的电影？马克：一部讲述音乐家生平的传记电影。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 我们要看什么类型的电影？
messages.en: What kind of film are we going to watch?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Film biografiku dwar il-ħajja ta' mużiċist.
messages.mt_standard: Film biografiku dwar il-ħajja ta' mużiċist.
messages.zh: 一部讲述音乐家生平的传记电影。
messages.en: A biographical film about a musician's life.

cognitive_memory_aid: 联想一本按人生阶段排列照片的传记相册：biografiku 修饰介绍人物生平的内容，可与英文 biographical 对照记忆。

gloss_zh: 生物的；与生命过程有关的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Related to living organisms or the processes of life.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 与生物、生命活动或生命过程有关的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Marbut mal-organiżmi ħajjin jew mal-proċessi tal-ħajja.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 生物的；与生物或生命过程有关的。

formal.mt: Dan l-istudju janalizza l-proċess bioloġiku tat-tkabbir tal-pjanti.
formal.en: This study analyses the biological process of plant growth.
formal.zh: 这项研究分析植物生长的生物过程。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għaliex il-pjanta għandha bżonn id-dawl? Pawlu: Id-dawl jgħinha tipproduċi l-ikel permezz ta' proċess bioloġiku.
colloquial.en: Sara: Why does the plant need light? Pawlu: Light helps it produce food through a biological process.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：植物为什么需要光？保罗：光帮助它通过一种生物过程制造养分。

messages.speaker: Sara (学生)
messages.zh: 植物为什么需要光？
messages.en: Why does the plant need light?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Id-dawl jgħinha tipproduċi l-ikel permezz ta' proċess bioloġiku.
messages.mt_standard: Id-dawl jgħinha tipproduċi l-ikel permezz ta' proċess bioloġiku.
messages.zh: 光帮助它通过一种生物过程制造养分。
messages.en: Light helps it produce food through a biological process.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 bioloġiku 放进“植物生长”和“生物钟”两个画面中记忆：proċess bioloġiku 是生物过程，arloġġ bioloġiku 是生物钟，核心都与生命活动有关。

teaching_sense.en_definition: On horseback; used to describe someone travelling or arriving while riding a horse.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 骑在马上；用于说明某人骑马行进或到达的方式。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Fuq żiemel; tintuża biex tiddeskrivi kif xi ħadd jivvjaġġa jew jasal waqt li jkun qed jirkeb żiemel.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 骑马；骑在马上

formal.mt: Fir-rakkont, il-messaġġier wasal bir-rikkieb u ta l-ittra lill-kap tar-raħal.
formal.en: In the story, the messenger arrived on horseback and handed the letter to the village leader.
formal.zh: 故事中，信使骑马到达，把信交给了村长。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Kif wasal il-messaġġier fl-istorja? Mark: Wasal bir-rikkieb. Kien fuq żiemel abjad.
colloquial.en: Maja: How did the messenger arrive in the story? Mark: He arrived on horseback. He was riding a white horse.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：故事里的信使是怎么到达的？马克：他骑马到达，骑的是一匹白马。

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.zh: 故事里的信使是怎么到达的？
messages.en: How did the messenger arrive in the story?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Wasal bir-rikkieb. Kien fuq żiemel abjad.
messages.mt_standard: Wasal bir-rikkieb. Kien fuq żiemel abjad.
messages.zh: 他骑马到达，骑的是一匹白马。
messages.en: He arrived on horseback. He was riding a white horse.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 bir-rikkieb 整体记成“骑马这一方式”，脑中想象信使骑着白马到达；与 jasal 连用，就记住“骑马到达”。

gloss_zh: 比尔古（马耳他港口地区的一座城市及地方议会）

teaching_sense.en_definition: The name of a city and its local council in Malta's Port Region.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 马耳他港口地区的一座城市及其地方议会的名称，中文译作“比尔古”。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Isem ta' belt u tal-kunsill lokali tagħha fir-Reġjun tal-Port f'Malta.

sense_translations.en_definition: Birgu (a city and local council of the Port Region, Malta)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 比尔古，马耳他港口地区的一座城市及地方议会。

formal.mt: Il-programm taż-żjara jinkludi mixja fil-Birgu u ħin biex il-parteċipanti jaraw il-belt.
formal.en: The visit programme includes a walk in Birgu and time for participants to explore the city.
formal.zh: 参观行程包括在比尔古步行游览，并留出时间让参与者看看这座城市。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Trid immorru l-Birgu nhar is-Sibt? Mark: Iva, nixtieq inżur il-Birgu miegħek.
colloquial.en: Marija: Do you want to go to Birgu on Saturday? Mark: Yes, I'd like to visit Birgu with you.
colloquial.zh: 玛丽娅：星期六想一起去比尔古吗？马克：想，我很想和你一起去比尔古看看。

messages.speaker: Marija (朋友)
messages.zh: 星期六想一起去比尔古吗？
messages.en: Do you want to go to Birgu on Saturday?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 想，我很想和你一起去比尔古看看。
messages.en: Yes, I'd like to visit Birgu with you.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 Birgu 当作地图上的“比尔古”地名卡片记忆，注意名称首字母大写；连着短语 żjara fil-Birgu（到比尔古参观）一起读，更容易记住实际用法。

gloss_zh: 眼睛的闪烁；闪动的眸光

teaching_sense.en_definition: A twinkling or sparkling appearance in the eyes.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 眼睛中闪动的光彩，可用于描写人物的神情。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Leħħa li tidher fl-għajnejn u li tista' tesprimi xi sentiment.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 眼睛的闪烁；眸光的闪动

formal.mt: Il-kittieb iddeskriva l-biri f'għajnejha meta semgħet l-aħbar it-tajba.
formal.en: The writer described the twinkle in her eyes when she heard the good news.
formal.zh: 作家描写了她听到好消息时眼中闪动的光彩。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Rajt il-biri f'għajnejha meta fetħet ir-rigal? Lara: Iva, kienet ferħana ħafna!
colloquial.en: Maja: Did you see the twinkle in her eyes when she opened the present? Lara: Yes, she was so happy!
colloquial.zh: Maja：你看到她拆开礼物时眼中闪动的光彩了吗？Lara：看到了，她特别高兴！

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Rajt il-biri f'għajnejha meta fetħet ir-rigal?
messages.mt_standard: Rajt il-biri f'għajnejha meta fetħet ir-rigal?
messages.zh: 你看到她拆开礼物时眼中闪动的光彩了吗？
messages.en: Did you see the twinkle in her eyes when she opened the present?

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 看到了，她特别高兴！
messages.en: Yes, she was so happy!

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 biri 配上“拆开礼物时眼睛一闪”的画面，连同 għajnejn（眼睛）一起记，记住它描写的是眸光闪动。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A horse-drawn cart or carriage, including a barouche.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 由马拉动的车辆，可指马车，也可指敞篷四轮马车。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Vettura miġbuda minn żiemel, li tintuża biex iġġorr nies jew tagħbija.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 马车；敞篷四轮马车

collocations.en: a ride in a horse-drawn carriage

formal.mt: Il-pittura turi żiemel jiġbed biroċċ tul triq fil-kampanja.
formal.en: The painting shows a horse pulling a cart along a country road.
formal.zh: 这幅画描绘了一匹马拉着马车沿乡间道路前行的情景。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Trid nagħmlu rikba bil-biroċċ? Nina: Iva! Ejja nistaqsu kemm tiswa.
colloquial.en: Mark: Shall we go for a carriage ride? Nina: Yes! Let's ask how much it costs.
colloquial.zh: Mark：我们坐马车兜一圈，好吗？Nina：好啊！我们问问多少钱吧。

messages.speaker: Mark (游客)
messages.zh: 我们坐马车兜一圈，好吗？
messages.en: Shall we go for a carriage ride?

messages.speaker: Nina (同行朋友)
messages.zh: 好啊！我们问问多少钱吧。
messages.en: Yes! Let's ask how much it costs.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 biroċċ 想成乡间路上一匹马拉着的车，再用 rikba bil-biroċċ（乘马车出游）把词放进完整场景中记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A place where beer is made.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 酿造啤酒的场所，即啤酒厂。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Post fejn issir il-birra.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 啤酒厂；酿造啤酒的场所。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Post fejn issir il-birra.

formal.mt: Matul iż-żjara fil-birrajja, il-gwida spjegat kif issir il-birra.
formal.en: During the visit to the brewery, the guide explained how beer is made.
formal.zh: 参观啤酒厂期间，导游讲解了啤酒的酿造过程。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Tixtieq iżżur il-birrajja nhar is-Sibt? Mark: Iva, nixtieq nara kif issir il-birra.
colloquial.en: Maja: Would you like to visit the brewery on Saturday? Mark: Yes, I'd like to see how beer is made.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你想星期六去参观啤酒厂吗？马克：想，我想看看啤酒是怎么酿造的。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你想星期六去参观啤酒厂吗？
messages.en: Would you like to visit the brewery on Saturday?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, nixtieq nara kif issir il-birra.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, nixtieq nara kif issir il-birra.
messages.zh: 想，我想看看啤酒是怎么酿造的。
messages.en: Yes, I'd like to see how beer is made.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 birrajja 配上装有酿造罐的厂房画面，记作“啤酒厂”；与表示酿酒师的 birrar 对照，先分清场所和人物。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who makes beer, especially as a job.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 酿造啤酒的人，尤指以酿造啤酒为职业的酿造师。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li tagħmel il-birra, speċjalment bħala xogħol.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 啤酒酿造师；酿造啤酒的人。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Persuna li tagħmel il-birra.

collocations.zh: 一位经验丰富的啤酒酿造师

formal.mt: Il-birrar jissorvelja l-produzzjoni tal-birra u jiċċekkja l-kwalità tagħha.
formal.en: The brewer oversees beer production and checks its quality.
formal.zh: 啤酒酿造师监督啤酒生产并检查其质量。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'xogħol jagħmel ħuk? Mark: Jaħdem bħala birrar. Maja: Allura jagħmel il-birra! Mark: Iva, u jħobb ħafna xogħlu.
colloquial.en: Maja: What does your brother do for work? Mark: He works as a brewer. Maja: So he makes beer! Mark: Yes, and he really enjoys his job.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你兄弟做什么工作？马克：他是啤酒酿造师。玛雅：原来他是酿啤酒的！马克：对，而且他很喜欢自己的工作。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你兄弟做什么工作？
messages.en: What does your brother do for work?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 他是啤酒酿造师。
messages.en: He works as a brewer.

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 原来他是酿啤酒的！
messages.en: So he makes beer!

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 对，而且他很喜欢自己的工作。
messages.en: Yes, and he really enjoys his job.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 birrar 写在酿酒师的人物卡上，想象他检查酿造罐；再把 birrajja 写在厂房卡上，用“人做酒、厂酿酒”的画面区分两词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The bird species called the Caspian plover, with the scientific name Charadrius asiaticus.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一种名为红胸鸻的鸟，学名为 Charadrius asiaticus。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Speċi ta' għasfur magħrufa bl-isem xjentifiku Charadrius asiaticus.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 红胸鸻（学名：Charadrius asiaticus）

collocations.en: a photograph of a Caspian plover

formal.mt: Fil-gwida tal-għasafar, il-birwin tal-Asja huwa elenkat bl-isem xjentifiku Charadrius asiaticus.
formal.en: In the bird guide, the Caspian plover is listed under the scientific name Charadrius asiaticus.
formal.zh: 鸟类指南将红胸鸻列于学名 Charadrius asiaticus 之下。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'jissejjaħ dan l-għasfur fil-ktieb? Mark: Dan huwa birwin tal-Asja. Ħares lejn l-isem taħt ir-ritratt.
colloquial.en: Maja: What is this bird in the book called? Mark: This is a Caspian plover. Look at the name below the photograph.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：书里的这只鸟叫什么？马克：这是红胸鸻。看看照片下面的名字。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.zh: 书里的这只鸟叫什么？
messages.en: What is this bird in the book called?

messages.speaker: Mark (老师)
messages.mt_spoken: Dan huwa birwin tal-Asja. Ħares lejn l-isem taħt ir-ritratt.
messages.mt_standard: Dan huwa birwin tal-Asja. Ħares lejn l-isem taħt ir-ritratt.
messages.zh: 这是红胸鸻。看看照片下面的名字。
messages.en: This is a Caspian plover. Look at the name below the photograph.

cognitive_memory_aid: 制作一张鸟类识别卡：正面写 birwin tal-Asja，背面写“红胸鸻”和 Caspian plover；三个名称配同一张图，帮助整体记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The bird species known as the greater sand plover (Charadrius leschenaultii).
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 铁嘴沙鸻，一种鸟，学名为 Charadrius leschenaultii。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Speċi ta' għasfur magħrufa bl-isem xjentifiku Charadrius leschenaultii.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 铁嘴沙鸻（Charadrius leschenaultii）。

collocations.en: a photograph of a greater sand plover
observation of the greater sand plover

formal.mt: Fir-rapport tal-ħarġa, il-grupp inkluda ritratt ta' birwin tal-lvant.
formal.en: In the field trip report, the group included a photograph of a greater sand plover.
formal.zh: 小组在实地考察报告中附上了一张铁嘴沙鸻的照片。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'għasfur hu dak fir-ritratt? Pawlu: Dak birwin tal-lvant. Ejja nfittxuh fil-gwida.
colloquial.en: Maja: What bird is that in the photograph? Pawlu: That's a greater sand plover. Let's look it up in the guide.
colloquial.zh: Maja：照片里那是什么鸟？Pawlu：那是铁嘴沙鸻。我们在图鉴里查一下吧。

messages.speaker: Maja (观鸟同伴)
messages.zh: 照片里那是什么鸟？
messages.en: What bird is that in the photograph?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (观鸟同伴)
messages.mt_spoken: Dak birwin tal-lvant. Ejja nfittxuh fil-gwida.
messages.mt_standard: Dak birwin tal-lvant. Ejja nfittxuh fil-gwida.
messages.zh: 那是铁嘴沙鸻。我们在图鉴里查一下吧。
messages.en: That's a greater sand plover. Let's look it up in the guide.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把整个鸟名与图鉴中的铁嘴沙鸻照片配对记忆，反复练习“看到照片，说出鸟名”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An exclamation used to ask a performer to perform again or give an encore.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 请求表演者再表演一次或加演时喊出的感叹语，相当于“再来一个！”或“安可！”。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Għajta biex titlob lil min qed jagħti wirja jerġa' jdoqq, ikanta jew jagħti prestazzjoni oħra.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 用于请求返场或加演：再来一个！安可！

formal.mt: Fi tmiem il-kunċert, l-udjenza għajtet 'Bis!' u talbet kanzunetta oħra.
formal.en: At the end of the concert, the audience shouted 'Encore!' and asked for another song.
formal.zh: 音乐会结束时，观众高喊“安可！”，要求再唱一首歌。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Bis! Erġa' kantaha! Mark: Tajjeb, inkantaha darba oħra.
colloquial.en: Lara: Encore! Sing it again! Mark: All right, I'll sing it one more time.
colloquial.zh: Lara：再来一个！再唱一次！Mark：好，我再唱一遍。

messages.speaker: Lara (听众)
messages.zh: 再来一个！再唱一次！
messages.en: Encore! Sing it again!

messages.speaker: Mark (歌手)
messages.zh: 好，我再唱一遍。
messages.en: All right, I'll sing it one more time.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象演出结束后边鼓掌边喊“bis！bis！”，把这个短促喊声与“再来一个”一起记住。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who can experience romantic or sexual attraction to people of more than one gender.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 双性恋者，指可能对不止一种性别的人产生浪漫或性吸引的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li tista' tħoss attrazzjoni romantika jew sesswali lejn nies ta' aktar minn ġeneru wieħed.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 双性恋者；可能对不止一种性别的人产生浪漫或性吸引的人。
双性恋的；形容可能对不止一种性别的人产生浪漫或性吸引的人。

formal.mt: Persuna bisesswali għandha tkun tista' titkellem dwar l-orjentazzjoni tagħha f'ambjent ta' rispett.
formal.en: A bisexual person should be able to talk about their orientation in a respectful environment.
formal.zh: 双性恋者应当能够在受到尊重的环境中谈论自己的性取向。

colloquial.mt: Alex: Jien bisesswali, u ridt ngħidlek. Maja: Grazzi talli qsamt dan miegħi.
colloquial.en: Alex: I'm bisexual, and I wanted to tell you. Maja: Thank you for sharing that with me.
colloquial.zh: Alex：我是双性恋，想告诉你这件事。Maja：谢谢你愿意和我分享。

messages.speaker: Alex (朋友)
messages.zh: 我是双性恋，想告诉你这件事。
messages.en: I'm bisexual, and I wanted to tell you.

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 谢谢你愿意和我分享。
messages.en: Thank you for sharing that with me.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两个位置记词性：单独指人时记“双性恋者”，放在 persuna 后描述人时记“双性恋的”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A sexual orientation involving the capacity for romantic or sexual attraction to people of more than one gender.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 双性恋性取向，指可能对不止一种性别的人产生浪漫或性吸引。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Orjentazzjoni sesswali li fiha persuna tista' tħoss attrazzjoni romantika jew sesswali lejn nies ta' aktar minn ġeneru wieħed.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 双性恋；可能对不止一种性别的人产生浪漫或性吸引的性取向。

formal.mt: L-artiklu jispjega l-bisesswalità b'lingwaġġ ċar u rispettuż.
formal.en: The article explains bisexuality in clear and respectful language.
formal.zh: 这篇文章用清晰且尊重他人的语言解释双性恋性取向。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Għandi xi mistoqsijiet dwar il-bisesswalità. Sam: Nistgħu naqraw din il-gwida flimkien.
colloquial.en: Nina: I have some questions about bisexuality. Sam: We can read this guide together.
colloquial.zh: Nina：我有一些关于双性恋的问题。Sam：我们可以一起读这份指南。

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.zh: 我有一些关于双性恋的问题。
messages.en: I have some questions about bisexuality.

messages.speaker: Sam (朋友)
messages.zh: 我们可以一起读这份指南。
messages.en: We can read this guide together.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 bisesswali 与 bisesswalità 做成对照卡：前者可指人或描述人，后者专门记作性取向这一概念。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The chemical element called bismuth.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 铋，一种化学元素，英语名称为 bismuth。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Element kimiku magħruf bl-isem bismuth bl-Ingliż.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 铋（化学元素）。

formal.mt: L-istudenti osservaw kampjun tal-bismut waqt il-lezzjoni tal-kimika.
formal.en: The students observed a sample of bismuth during the chemistry lesson.
formal.zh: 学生们在化学课上观察了一份铋样品。

colloquial.mt: Sara: X'inhu dan il-kampjun? Daniel: Dan bismut. Ħares lejn it-tikketta.
colloquial.en: Sara: What is this sample? Daniel: This is bismuth. Look at the label.
colloquial.zh: Sara：这是什么样品？Daniel：这是铋。看看标签。

messages.speaker: Sara (学生)
messages.zh: 这是什么样品？
messages.en: What is this sample?

messages.speaker: Daniel (同学)
messages.zh: 这是铋。看看标签。
messages.en: This is bismuth. Look at the label.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象化学样品瓶上的三语标签“bismut—bismuth—铋”，通过观察标签把三个名称连起来。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A large barrel or cask used to hold liquids or other contents.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 盛放液体或其他物品的大桶、木桶。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Reċipjent kbir f'għamla ta' barmil, użat biex jinżammu fih likwidi jew affarijiet oħra.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 大桶；木桶，常用来盛放液体。

formal.mt: Il-ħaddiema poġġew il-bittija tal-inbid fil-kantina.
formal.en: The workers placed the wine barrel in the cellar.
formal.zh: 工人们把葡萄酒桶放进了地窖。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Fejn inpoġġi din il-bittija? Rita: Ħdejn il-ħajt, jekk jogħġbok.
colloquial.en: Mark: Where should I put this barrel? Rita: Next to the wall, please.
colloquial.zh: Mark：这个大桶放在哪里？Rita：请放在墙边。

messages.speaker: Mark (搬运工)
messages.zh: 这个大桶放在哪里？
messages.en: Where should I put this barrel?

messages.speaker: Rita (仓库管理员)
messages.zh: 请放在墙边。
messages.en: Next to the wall, please.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 bittija 写在想象中的大木桶上，再分别装入葡萄酒或清水，记住它指容器本身。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A temporary outdoor camp, often set up for an overnight stay.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在户外临时设立、常用于过夜的营地；临时露宿。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kamp temporanju fil-beraħ, spiss biex wieħed jgħaddi l-lejl fih.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 临时露营；临时露宿营地。

formal.mt: Il-grupp waqqaf bivakk għal-lejl qabel kompla l-mixja l-għada filgħodu.
formal.en: The group set up a bivouac for the night before continuing the walk the following morning.
formal.zh: 小组搭建临时营地过夜，第二天早晨继续徒步。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Se nieqfu hawn għal-lejl? Toni: Iva, hawn inwaqqfu bivakk.
colloquial.en: Lara: Are we stopping here for the night? Toni: Yes, we'll set up a bivouac here.
colloquial.zh: Lara：我们今晚就在这里停下过夜吗？Toni：对，我们在这里搭个临时营地。

messages.speaker: Lara (徒步同伴)
messages.zh: 我们今晚就在这里停下过夜吗？
messages.en: Are we stopping here for the night?

messages.speaker: Toni (徒步领队)
messages.zh: 对，我们在这里搭个临时营地。
messages.en: Yes, we'll set up a bivouac here.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象徒步途中天黑了，大家停下搭建过夜营地；把这一整幅临时露宿场景贴上 bivakk 标签。

gloss_zh: 缠绕；编制柳条制品；使卷入难堪处境

teaching_sense.en_definition: To intertwine things or weave wickerwork; figuratively, to involve someone in a compromising situation.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使枝条等交缠，或编制柳条类制品；也可比喻使某人卷入有损声誉或令人难堪的处境。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jgħaqqad friegħi jew materjal ieħor billi jinsiġhom ma' xulxin; ukoll idaħħal lil xi ħadd f'sitwazzjoni kompromettenti.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使相互缠绕；把东西交缠在一起。
编制柳条类制品；用柔韧枝条编织。

sense_translations.en_definition: to involve sb. in a compromising situation
sense_translations.zh_definition: 使某人卷入有损声誉、令人难堪或难以自处的局面。

collocations.en: he wove the reeds to make a basket
collocations.zh: 他编织芦苇来制作篮子

collocations.en: he involved his friend in a compromising situation
collocations.zh: 他把朋友卷入了令人难堪的处境

formal.mt: L-artiġjan bixkel il-friegħi ma' xulxin biex jagħmel qoffa.
formal.en: The craftsperson entwined the branches to make a basket.
formal.zh: 手艺人把枝条交织在一起，编成一个篮子。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Għaliex semmejt ismi? Bixkiltni f'din il-gidba! Toni: Skużani, se ngħidilhom li ma kellek x'taqsam xejn.
colloquial.en: Mark: Why did you mention my name? You've dragged me into this lie! Toni: Sorry, I'll tell them you had nothing to do with it.
colloquial.zh: Mark：你为什么提我的名字？你把我牵扯进这个谎言里了！Toni：对不起，我会告诉他们你和这件事毫无关系。

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex semmejt ismi? Bixkiltni f'din il-gidba!
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex semmejt ismi? Bixkiltni f'din il-gidba!
messages.zh: 你为什么提我的名字？你把我牵扯进这个谎言里了！
messages.en: Why did you mention my name? You've dragged me into this lie!

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Skużani, se ngħidilhom li ma kellek x'taqsam xejn.
messages.mt_standard: Skużani, se ngħidilhom li ma kellek x'taqsam xejn.
messages.zh: 对不起，我会告诉他们你和这件事毫无关系。
messages.en: Sorry, I'll tell them you had nothing to do with it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“缠在一起”串起三个义项：枝条交缠、枝条编成篮子，以及人被牵扯进难堪局面；这是记忆联想，不是词源解释。

gloss_zh: 困境；一种赌博纸牌游戏

teaching_sense.en_definition: A difficult situation that is hard to deal with or get out of.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 难以应付或摆脱的困难处境。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Sitwazzjoni diffiċli li mhux faċli ssib soluzzjoni għaliha jew toħroġ minnha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 困难的处境；困境。

sense_translations.en_definition: the name of a card game played by gamblers
sense_translations.zh_definition: 赌客玩的一种纸牌游戏的名称。

collocations.en: to get into a difficult situation
to get out of a difficult situation

formal.mt: In-nuqqas ta' ftehim poġġa lit-tim f'bixkla, iżda d-diskussjoni għenitu jsib soluzzjoni.
formal.en: The lack of agreement put the team in a difficult situation, but discussion helped it find a solution.
formal.zh: 未能达成一致使团队陷入困境，但讨论帮助团队找到了解决办法。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Dħalt f'bixkla: insejt fejn ħallejt iċ-ċwievet. Mark: Ejja nfittxuhom flimkien.
colloquial.en: Maja: I'm in a difficult situation: I've forgotten where I left the keys. Mark: Let's look for them together.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：我遇到麻烦了，忘了把钥匙放在哪里。马克：我们一起找吧。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Dħalt f'bixkla: insejt fejn ħallejt iċ-ċwievet.
messages.mt_standard: Dħalt f'bixkla: insejt fejn ħallejt iċ-ċwievet.
messages.zh: 我遇到麻烦了，忘了把钥匙放在哪里。
messages.en: I'm in a difficult situation: I've forgotten where I left the keys.

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 我们一起找吧。
messages.en: Let's look for them together.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把困境想成一间难找出口的房间：进入用 tidħol f'bixkla，脱身用 toħroġ minn bixkla；另把纸牌游戏义单独记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Very strange or unusual in a way that attracts attention.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 十分奇怪或不同寻常、使人感到诧异的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Stramb jew mhux tas-soltu b'mod li jiġbed l-attenzjoni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 古怪的；奇异的；不同寻常的。

formal.mt: L-awtur jiddeskrivi każ bizzarr li fih l-arloġġi kollha jieqfu fl-istess ħin.
formal.en: The author describes a bizarre case in which all the clocks stop at the same time.
formal.zh: 作者描述了一桩离奇的事件：所有钟表都在同一时刻停了下来。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Smajt dak il-ħoss bizzarr? Mark: Iva, qisu qattus qed ikanta!
colloquial.en: Nina: Did you hear that odd sound? Mark: Yes, it sounds like a cat singing!
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：你听见那个古怪的声音了吗？马克：听见了，像是一只猫在唱歌！

messages.speaker: Nina (室友)
messages.zh: 你听见那个古怪的声音了吗？
messages.en: Did you hear that odd sound?

messages.speaker: Mark (室友)
messages.zh: 听见了，像是一只猫在唱歌！
messages.en: Yes, it sounds like a cat singing!

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 bizzarr 与英语 bizarre 的拼写和意义一起对照记忆，再想象一只唱歌的猫来固定古怪的感觉；这只是学习联想。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A two-wheeled vehicle that a rider usually moves by pushing pedals.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 通常由骑车人踩踏板驱动的两轮交通工具，即自行车。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Vettura b'żewġ roti li normalment titmexxa billi min isuqha jagħfas il-pedali.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 自行车；脚踏车。

formal.mt: L-istudenta tuża l-biċikletta biex tmur l-università kuljum.
formal.en: The student uses her bicycle to go to university every day.
formal.zh: 这名学生每天骑自行车去大学。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Trid tikri biċikletta miegħi? Luqa: Iva, nistgħu mmorru sal-baħar bir-rota.
colloquial.en: Maja: Do you want to rent a bicycle with me? Luqa: Yes, we can cycle to the sea.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你想和我一起租自行车吗？卢卡：好啊，我们可以骑到海边。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你想和我一起租自行车吗？
messages.en: Do you want to rent a bicycle with me?

messages.speaker: Luqa (朋友)
messages.zh: 好啊，我们可以骑到海边。
messages.en: Yes, we can cycle to the sea.

cognitive_memory_aid: 画出两个车轮和一副脚踏板，在车架上写 biċikletta，再配上“骑自行车”这个动作，一起记住词形和用途。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A facility where animals are slaughtered for meat.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 宰杀供食用动物的场所，即屠宰场。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Post fejn jinqatlu l-annimali għall-laħam.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 屠宰场；宰杀供食用动物的场所。
屠宰场；供动物屠宰作业使用的设施。

formal.mt: L-ispettur żar il-biċċerija biex jeżamina l-kundizzjonijiet tal-iġjene.
formal.en: The inspector visited the slaughterhouse to examine the hygiene conditions.
formal.zh: 检查员到屠宰场检查卫生状况。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Dik il-binja l-qadima kienet biċċerija? Rita: Iva, hemm kienu joqtlu l-annimali għall-laħam.
colloquial.en: Mark: Was that old building a slaughterhouse? Rita: Yes, animals used to be slaughtered there for meat.
colloquial.zh: 马克：那栋老建筑以前是屠宰场吗？丽塔：是的，以前在那里宰杀动物供食用。

messages.speaker: Mark (游客)
messages.zh: 那栋老建筑以前是屠宰场吗？
messages.en: Was that old building a slaughterhouse?

messages.speaker: Rita (当地居民)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, hemm kienu joqtlu l-annimali għall-laħam.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, hemm kienu joqtlu l-annimali għall-laħam.
messages.zh: 是的，以前在那里宰杀动物供食用。
messages.en: Yes, animals used to be slaughtered there for meat.

cognitive_memory_aid: 在学习卡上画一座标着 biċċerija 的作业建筑，旁边写“动物在这里被屠宰”，用场所画面记住这个名词。

gloss_zh: 仅用于 biċċa biċċun：严重的难题；大麻烦

teaching_sense.en_definition: An augmentative form of biċċa used exclusively in the expression biċċa biċċun, meaning a serious problem.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: biċċa 的增大形式，仅用于固定表达 biċċa biċċun，表示严重的难题或大麻烦。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Forma awmentattiva ta' biċċa li tintuża biss fl-espressjoni biċċa biċċun, li tfisser problema serja.

sense_translations.en_definition: augmentative form of 'biċċa' used exclusively in the phrase 'biċċa biċċun', meaning 'as serious problem'
sense_translations.zh_definition: biċċa 的增大形式，仅用于短语 biċċa biċċun，意思是严重的问题或大麻烦。

collocations.en: a serious problem that we need to solve
collocations.zh: 一个我们必须解决的大难题

formal.mt: It-telf tad-dokumenti ħoloq biċċa biċċun għat-tim li kien qed iħejji r-rapport.
formal.en: The loss of the documents created a serious problem for the team preparing the report.
formal.zh: 文件丢失给正在编写报告的团队造成了一个大难题。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Tlift iċ-ċavetta u l-oħra qiegħda ġewwa. Ben: Din hi biċċa biċċun! Ċempel lil xi ħadd li jista' jiftħilna.
colloquial.en: Anna: I've lost the key, and the other one is inside. Ben: That's a serious problem! Call someone who can open the door for us.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：我把钥匙弄丢了，另一把又在屋里。本：这下麻烦大了！打电话找个能帮我们开门的人吧。

messages.speaker: Anna (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Tlift iċ-ċavetta u l-oħra qiegħda ġewwa.
messages.mt_standard: Tlift iċ-ċavetta u l-oħra qiegħda ġewwa.
messages.zh: 我把钥匙弄丢了，另一把又在屋里。
messages.en: I've lost the key, and the other one is inside.

messages.speaker: Ben (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Din hi biċċa biċċun! Ċempel lil xi ħadd li jista' jiftħilna.
messages.mt_standard: Din hi biċċa biċċun! Ċempel lil xi ħadd li jista' jiftħilna.
messages.zh: 这下麻烦大了！打电话找个能帮我们开门的人吧。
messages.en: That's a serious problem! Call someone who can open the door for us.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 biċċa biċċun 整组写在一张“大麻烦”卡片上，联想钥匙全被锁在屋里的情景；学习时不要拆开单用 biċċun。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A mitigation: a reduction in the severity or harshness of something.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指某事严重程度或严厉程度的减轻、缓和。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tnaqqis fil-ħruxija jew fis-severità ta' xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 减轻；缓和，指严重程度或严厉程度的降低。

formal.mt: Fl-ittra, l-awtur talab biġla fil-piena u spjega ċ-ċirkostanzi tal-każ.
formal.en: In the letter, the writer requested a mitigation of the punishment and explained the circumstances of the case.
formal.zh: 写信人在信中请求减轻处罚，并说明了事情的具体情况。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Xi tfisser biġla f'din is-sentenza? Mark: Tfisser tnaqqis fil-ħruxija, bħal meta piena ssir inqas ħarxa. Sara: Mela hawn qed jitlob piena eħfef.
colloquial.en: Sara: What does biġla mean in this sentence? Mark: It means a reduction in harshness, as when a punishment becomes less severe. Sara: So here he is asking for a lighter punishment.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：这句话里的 biġla 是什么意思？马克：意思是严厉程度有所减轻，比如处罚变轻了。萨拉：所以这里是说他在请求减轻处罚。

messages.speaker: Sara (学生)
messages.zh: 这句话里的 biġla 是什么意思？
messages.en: What does biġla mean in this sentence?

messages.speaker: Mark (老师)
messages.mt_spoken: Tfisser tnaqqis fil-ħruxija, bħal meta piena ssir inqas ħarxa.
messages.mt_standard: Tfisser tnaqqis fil-ħruxija, bħal meta piena ssir inqas ħarxa.
messages.zh: 意思是严厉程度有所减轻，比如处罚变轻了。
messages.en: It means a reduction in harshness, as when a punishment becomes less severe.

messages.speaker: Sara (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Mela hawn qed jitlob piena eħfef.
messages.mt_standard: Mela hawn qed jitlob piena eħfef.
messages.zh: 所以这里是说他在请求减轻处罚。
messages.en: So here he is asking for a lighter punishment.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象处罚刻度从重向轻移动，把这个“减轻的变化”标成 biġla；它是名词，可用“处罚的减轻”帮助记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A feeling of fear, ranging from being afraid to terror; it can also mean awe.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 害怕或恐惧的感受，程度可强至惊恐；也可表示敬畏。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Is-sentiment li tħoss meta tibża'; jista' jfisser ukoll terrur jew sens ta' rispett profond u stagħġib.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 害怕；恐惧。
敬畏；面对庄严或令人震撼的事物时产生的惊叹与敬重。
极度恐惧；惊恐。

formal.mt: Fir-rakkont, il-ħoss tal-passi fid-dlam iqajjem sens ta' biża' fil-qarrej.
formal.en: In the story, the sound of footsteps in the dark evokes a feeling of fear in the reader.
formal.zh: 在这篇故事中，黑暗里的脚步声使读者产生恐惧感。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għandi biża' mid-dlam. Pawlu: Nixgħel id-dawl u noqgħod hawn miegħek.
colloquial.en: Lara: I'm afraid of the dark. Pawlu: I'll turn on the light and stay here with you.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：我怕黑。保罗：我会开灯，留在这里陪你。

messages.speaker: Lara (妹妹)
messages.zh: 我怕黑。
messages.en: I'm afraid of the dark.

messages.speaker: Pawlu (哥哥)
messages.mt_spoken: Nixgħel id-dawl u noqgħod hawn miegħek.
messages.mt_standard: Nixgħel id-dawl u noqgħod hawn miegħek.
messages.zh: 我会开灯，留在这里陪你。
messages.en: I'll turn on the light and stay here with you.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用情绪场景记忆：黑暗中是害怕，强烈危险中是惊恐，面对庄严事物则可能是敬畏；书写时保留词尾的撇号。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The aquatic plant known as common water plantain, with the scientific name Alisma plantago-aquatica.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一种名为泽泻的水生植物，学名为 Alisma plantago-aquatica。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Pjanta tal-ilma magħrufa bl-isem xjentifiku Alisma plantago-aquatica.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 泽泻，学名 Alisma plantago-aquatica。

collocations.en: the scientific name of common water plantain

formal.mt: Fil-lista tal-pjanti, il-biżbula tal-ilma tidher bl-isem xjentifiku Alisma plantago-aquatica.
formal.en: In the plant list, common water plantain appears under the scientific name Alisma plantago-aquatica.
formal.zh: 在植物名录中，泽泻以学名 Alisma plantago-aquatica 列出。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Din il-pjanta kif jisimha? David: Biżbula tal-ilma. Fuq it-tikketta hemm ukoll Alisma plantago-aquatica.
colloquial.en: Sara: What is this plant called? David: Common water plantain. The label also says Alisma plantago-aquatica.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：这株植物叫什么？戴维：泽泻。标签上还写着 Alisma plantago-aquatica。

messages.speaker: Sara (学生)
messages.zh: 这株植物叫什么？
messages.en: What is this plant called?

messages.speaker: David (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Biżbula tal-ilma. Fuq it-tikketta hemm ukoll Alisma plantago-aquatica.
messages.mt_standard: Biżbula tal-ilma. Fuq it-tikketta hemm ukoll Alisma plantago-aquatica.
messages.zh: 泽泻。标签上还写着 Alisma plantago-aquatica。
messages.en: Common water plantain. The label also says Alisma plantago-aquatica.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把整词当作植物标签记忆：看到 tal-ilma 就联想到水，再把 biżbula tal-ilma 与泽泻及其学名成组配对。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The aquatic plant known as lanceleaf water plantain, with the scientific name Alisma lanceolatum.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一种名为窄叶泽泻的水生植物，学名为 Alisma lanceolatum。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Pjanta tal-ilma magħrufa bl-isem xjentifiku Alisma lanceolatum, b'isem Malti li jirreferi għall-werqa dejqa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 窄叶泽泻，学名 Alisma lanceolatum。

collocations.mt: pjanta ta' biżbula tal-ilma tal-werqa dejqa
l-isem xjentifiku tal-biżbula tal-ilma tal-werqa dejqa
collocations.en: the scientific name of lanceleaf water plantain

formal.mt: Il-katalgu jagħti l-isem xjentifiku Alisma lanceolatum għall-biżbula tal-ilma tal-werqa dejqa.
formal.en: The catalogue gives Alisma lanceolatum as the scientific name of lanceleaf water plantain.
formal.zh: 目录将 Alisma lanceolatum 列为窄叶泽泻的学名。

colloquial.mt: Nina: X'nikteb taħt dan ir-ritratt? Mark: Ikteb biżbula tal-ilma tal-werqa dejqa, u żid Alisma lanceolatum.
colloquial.en: Nina: What should I write under this photograph? Mark: Write lanceleaf water plantain, and add Alisma lanceolatum.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：这张照片下面该写什么？马克：写窄叶泽泻，再加上 Alisma lanceolatum。

messages.speaker: Nina (学生)
messages.zh: 这张照片下面该写什么？
messages.en: What should I write under this photograph?

messages.speaker: Mark (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Ikteb biżbula tal-ilma tal-werqa dejqa, u żid Alisma lanceolatum.
messages.mt_standard: Ikteb biżbula tal-ilma tal-werqa dejqa, u żid Alisma lanceolatum.
messages.zh: 写窄叶泽泻，再加上 Alisma lanceolatum。
messages.en: Write lanceleaf water plantain, and add Alisma lanceolatum.

cognitive_memory_aid: 分三段记长名称：biżbula、tal-ilma、tal-werqa dejqa；末段提示窄叶，帮助把窄叶泽泻与前一条泽泻区分开。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who steals property by pillaging or plundering.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 通过劫掠或洗劫夺取他人财物的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li tisraq il-ġid ta' ħaddieħor permezz tas-serq u s-sakkeġġ.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 劫掠者；掠夺财物的人。

formal.mt: Fir-rakkont, il-biżżi jidħol fir-raħal u jisraq il-ġid tal-abitanti.
formal.en: In the story, the pillager enters the village and steals the inhabitants' possessions.
formal.zh: 在故事中，劫掠者进入村庄，夺走居民的财物。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Min hu dak il-karattru fil-ktieb? Pawlu: Hu biżżi; jidħol fl-irħula u jisraq kull ma jsib.
colloquial.en: Lara: Who is that character in the book? Pawlu: He's a plunderer; he enters villages and steals whatever he finds.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：书里的那个角色是谁？保罗：他是个劫掠者，闯进村庄，见什么就抢什么。

messages.speaker: Lara (读书会成员)
messages.zh: 书里的那个角色是谁？
messages.en: Who is that character in the book?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (读书会成员)
messages.mt_spoken: Hu biżżi; jidħol fl-irħula u jisraq kull ma jsib.
messages.mt_standard: Hu biżżi; jidħol fl-irħula u jisraq kull ma jsib.
messages.zh: 他是个劫掠者，闯进村庄，见什么就抢什么。
messages.en: He's a plunderer; he enters villages and steals whatever he finds.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象故事中闯入村庄抢走财物的角色，把 biżżi 贴在这个人身上：它指劫掠者这个人，记忆时留意双写 ż。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who encourages another person and motivates them to act or keep trying.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 鼓励他人采取行动或继续努力的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li tħeġġeġ lil ħaddieħor biex jaġixxi jew ikompli jagħmel sforz.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 激励他人的人；鼓舞者。

formal.mt: Matul il-proġett, il-kap ħa r-rwol ta' biżżiel u ħeġġeġ lill-membri biex ikomplu jaħdmu.
formal.en: During the project, the leader took on the role of a motivator and encouraged the members to keep working.
formal.zh: 项目期间，负责人担任激励者，鼓励成员继续努力工作。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Kont se nieqaf, imma David ħeġġiġni nerġa' nipprova. Mark: David hu l-biżżiel tat-tim!
colloquial.en: Sara: I was going to stop, but David encouraged me to try again. Mark: David is the team's motivator!
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：我本来想放弃，但戴维鼓励我再试一次。马克：戴维就是我们团队里的激励者！

messages.speaker: Sara (队员)
messages.mt_spoken: Kont se nieqaf, imma David ħeġġiġni nerġa' nipprova.
messages.mt_standard: Kont se nieqaf, imma David ħeġġiġni nerġa' nipprova.
messages.zh: 我本来想放弃，但戴维鼓励我再试一次。
messages.en: I was going to stop, but David encouraged me to try again.

messages.speaker: Mark (队友)
messages.zh: 戴维就是我们团队里的激励者！
messages.en: David is the team's motivator!

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 biżżiel 记成队里说再试一次的人：别人想停下时，他给人动力；用完整搭配 biżżiel tat-tim 帮助记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A cataract: clouding of the lens inside the eye that can make vision less clear.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 白内障，即眼内晶状体混浊、可能使视物变得模糊的情况。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kundizzjoni li fiha l-lenti ġewwa l-għajn titlef iċ-ċarezza tagħha u l-vista tista' tiċċajpar.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 白内障，指眼内晶状体出现混浊的情况。

formal.mt: It-test jispjega li l-bjada hija kundizzjoni tal-lenti tal-għajn li tista' ċċajpar il-vista.
formal.en: The text explains that a cataract is a condition of the eye's lens that can blur vision.
formal.zh: 这段文字说明，白内障是眼内晶状体的一种病变，可能使视物模糊。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Xi tfisser bjada f'dan it-test? David: Tfisser li l-lenti tal-għajn titlef iċ-ċarezza tagħha, u l-vista tista' tiċċajpar.
colloquial.en: Lara: What does bjada mean in this text? David: It means that the eye's lens loses its clarity, and vision can become blurred.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：这段文字里的 bjada 是什么意思？戴维：意思是眼内晶状体失去透明度，视物可能变得模糊。

messages.speaker: Lara (学生)
messages.zh: 这段文字里的 bjada 是什么意思？
messages.en: What does bjada mean in this text?

messages.speaker: David (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Tfisser li l-lenti tal-għajn titlef iċ-ċarezza tagħha, u l-vista tista' tiċċajpar.
messages.mt_standard: Tfisser li l-lenti tal-għajn titlef iċ-ċarezza tagħha, u l-vista tista' tiċċajpar.
messages.zh: 意思是眼内晶状体失去透明度，视物可能变得模糊。
messages.en: It means that the eye's lens loses its clarity, and vision can become blurred.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象眼内透明镜片蒙上一层雾，把 bjada 与白内障成对记忆，再用 bjada fl-għajn 将这个词固定在眼睛的语境中。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Blame directed at someone for a mistake or an undesirable outcome.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 因错误或不良结果而对某人作出的责备或归咎。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: It-tqegħid tar-responsabbiltà għal żball jew riżultat ħażin fuq xi ħadd.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 责备；归咎于某人的过错责任。

collocations.en: to put the blame on someone else

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jispjega l-kawżi tal-iżball mingħajr ma jitfa' l-bjażmu fuq persuna waħda.
formal.en: The report explains the causes of the mistake without putting the blame on a single person.
formal.zh: 报告解释了错误的原因，没有把过错归咎于某一个人。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Għaliex qed titfa' l-bjażmu kollu fuqi? Pawlu: Għandek raġun; jien ukoll għamilt żball.
colloquial.en: Marija: Why are you putting all the blame on me? Pawlu: You're right; I made a mistake too.
colloquial.zh: 玛丽娅：你为什么把所有过错都推给我？保罗：你说得对，我也犯了错。

messages.speaker: Marija (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex qed titfa' l-bjażmu kollu fuqi?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex qed titfa' l-bjażmu kollu fuqi?
messages.zh: 你为什么把所有过错都推给我？
messages.en: Why are you putting all the blame on me?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandek raġun; jien ukoll għamilt żball.
messages.mt_standard: Għandek raġun; jien ukoll għamilt żball.
messages.zh: 你说得对，我也犯了错。
messages.en: You're right; I made a mistake too.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 bjażmu 放进“把过错推给别人”的场景中记忆，联想责备落在谁身上。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The condition of being unable to speak.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 无法说话的状态，指不能以口语发声表达。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-kundizzjoni ta' min ma jistax jitkellem.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 哑；不能说话的状态。

collocations.en: a person who is unable to speak

formal.mt: L-iskola tipprovdi mezzi ta' komunikazzjoni miktuba għal student bil-bkuma.
formal.en: The school provides means of written communication for a student who is unable to speak.
formal.zh: 学校为一名不能说话的学生提供书面交流方式。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għaliex qed iwieġeb bil-kitba? Mark: Għandu l-bkuma; agħtih ftit ħin biex jikteb it-tweġiba.
colloquial.en: Sara: Why is he answering in writing? Mark: He is unable to speak; give him a little time to write his answer.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：他为什么用文字回答？马克：他不能说话，给他一点时间把回答写下来。

messages.speaker: Sara (同学)
messages.zh: 他为什么用文字回答？
messages.en: Why is he answering in writing?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandu l-bkuma; agħtih ftit ħin biex jikteb it-tweġiba.
messages.mt_standard: Għandu l-bkuma; agħtih ftit ħin biex jikteb it-tweġiba.
messages.zh: 他不能说话，给他一点时间把回答写下来。
messages.en: He is unable to speak; give him a little time to write his answer.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记 bkuma 时想象用纸笔回答的画面，抓住“不能说话”而非“一时安静”的含义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Describing a plant or variety that tends to bear fruit early.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容植物或品种通常较早结果、较早进入果实收获期。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu t-tendenza li jagħti l-frott kmieni.

sense_translations.en_definition: tending to produce its fruit early
sense_translations.zh_definition: 通常较早结果的；果实早熟的。

formal.mt: Il-bidwi għażel ħawħ bkuri biex ikun jista' jiġbor il-frott aktar kmieni fl-istaġun.
formal.en: The farmer chose early-bearing peach trees so that he could harvest the fruit earlier in the season.
formal.zh: 农民选择早结果的桃树，以便在当季较早的时候采收果实。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Dan il-ħawħ huwa bkuri? Ġużeppi: Iva, jagħti l-frott qabel il-ħawħ l-ieħor fil-ġnien.
colloquial.en: Lara: Is this peach tree early-bearing? Ġużeppi: Yes, it bears fruit before the other peach trees in the garden.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：这棵桃树结果早吗？朱塞佩：是的，它比园里的其他桃树更早结果。

messages.speaker: Lara (园艺学习者)
messages.zh: 这棵桃树结果早吗？
messages.en: Is this peach tree early-bearing?

messages.speaker: Ġużeppi (园丁)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, jagħti l-frott qabel il-ħawħ l-ieħor fil-ġnien.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, jagħti l-frott qabel il-ħawħ l-ieħor fil-ġnien.
messages.zh: 是的，它比园里的其他桃树更早结果。
messages.en: Yes, it bears fruit before the other peach trees in the garden.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 bkuri 贴在果园最先结果的树上，记住这里的“早”专门联系结果时间。

gloss_zh: 不知疲倦地；持续不停地

teaching_sense.en_definition: In a tireless, persistent, or continuous manner, without stopping or resting.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 不休息、不停歇地进行，强调不懈努力或持续不断。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: B'mod kontinwu jew bla waqfien, mingħajr mistrieħ.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 不知疲倦地；坚持不懈地；持续不断地。

formal.mt: Il-voluntiera ħadmu bla heda biex iqassmu l-ikel lill-familji milquta mill-għargħar.
formal.en: The volunteers worked tirelessly to distribute food to the families affected by the flooding.
formal.zh: 志愿者们不知疲倦地工作，为受洪水影响的家庭分发食物。

colloquial.mt: Marta: Ilek taħdem bla heda minn dalgħodu! David: Veru, issa nieqaf ftit u nieħu tazza ilma.
colloquial.en: Marta: You've been working nonstop since this morning! David: That's true; I'll stop for a bit now and have a glass of water.
colloquial.zh: 玛尔塔：你从今天早上起就一直忙个不停！戴维：确实，现在我停一会儿，喝杯水。

messages.speaker: Marta (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ilek taħdem bla heda minn dalgħodu!
messages.mt_standard: Ilek taħdem bla heda minn dalgħodu!
messages.zh: 你从今天早上起就一直忙个不停！
messages.en: You've been working nonstop since this morning!

messages.speaker: David (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Veru, issa nieqaf ftit u nieħu tazza ilma.
messages.mt_standard: Veru, issa nieqaf ftit u nieħu tazza ilma.
messages.zh: 确实，现在我停一会儿，喝杯水。
messages.en: That's true; I'll stop for a bit now and have a glass of water.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 bla heda 想成没有按下暂停键：人可以不停工作，雨也可以不停地下。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Forgetful or not paying attention, so that one easily overlooks or forgets things.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 因健忘或注意力不集中而容易忘事、漏事的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jinsa malajr jew ma joqgħodx attent għal dak li jkun qed jagħmel.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 健忘的；心不在焉、容易忘事的。

formal.mt: Persuna li tkun bla moħħ tista' tħalli dokument importanti d-dar qabel laqgħa.
formal.en: An absent-minded person may leave an important document at home before a meeting.
formal.zh: 心不在焉的人可能在开会前把重要文件忘在家里。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Illum jien bla moħħ; erġajt insejt iċ-ċwievet. Lara: Ħallihom ħdejn il-bieb biex tarahom qabel toħroġ.
colloquial.en: Maja: I'm so absent-minded today; I've forgotten my keys again. Lara: Leave them by the door so you see them before you go out.
colloquial.zh: Maja：我今天心不在焉的，又忘带钥匙了。Lara：把钥匙放在门边吧，这样出门前就能看见。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Illum jien bla moħħ; erġajt insejt iċ-ċwievet.
messages.mt_standard: Illum jien bla moħħ; erġajt insejt iċ-ċwievet.
messages.zh: 我今天心不在焉的，又忘带钥匙了。
messages.en: I'm so absent-minded today; I've forgotten my keys again.

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ħallihom ħdejn il-bieb biex tarahom qabel toħroġ.
messages.mt_standard: Ħallihom ħdejn il-bieb biex tarahom qabel toħroġ.
messages.zh: 把钥匙放在门边吧，这样出门前就能看见。
messages.en: Leave them by the door so you see them before you go out.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象出门时心里想着别的事，钥匙却留在桌上，用这个场景记住健忘和心不在焉。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Available or provided without requiring payment.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 无需支付费用即可获得、参加或使用的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jingħata jew ikun disponibbli mingħajr ma jkun meħtieġ pagament.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 免费的；无需付款的。

formal.mt: Il-librerija se toffri kors bla ħlas għal dawk li jixtiequ jitgħallmu jużaw il-kompjuter.
formal.en: The library will offer a free course for people who wish to learn to use a computer.
formal.zh: 图书馆将为希望学习使用电脑的人提供免费课程。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Kemm jiswa dan il-kors? Pawlu: Huwa bla ħlas; trid biss tirreġistra.
colloquial.en: Nina: How much does this course cost? Pawlu: It's free; you only need to register.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：这门课程多少钱？保罗：免费，只需要报名。

messages.speaker: Nina (学员)
messages.zh: 这门课程多少钱？
messages.en: How much does this course cost?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (课程工作人员)
messages.mt_spoken: Huwa bla ħlas; trid biss tirreġistra.
messages.mt_standard: Huwa bla ħlas; trid biss tirreġistra.
messages.zh: 免费，只需要报名。
messages.en: It's free; you only need to register.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 bla ħlas 和标着零元的课程海报一起记忆：可以参加，无需付钱。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Fear of having no coffee available.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 对没有咖啡可喝或咖啡供应耗尽感到害怕。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Biża' li ma jkollokx kafè disponibbli.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 害怕没有咖啡可喝；对缺少咖啡的恐惧。

collocations.en: my fear of having no coffee
to suffer from a fear of having no coffee
collocations.zh: 因害怕没有咖啡而苦恼

formal.mt: Fil-ġrajja, il-blakafefobija tal-karattru tidher meta jiskopri li l-kaxxa tal-kafè hija vojta.
formal.en: In the story, the character's fear of having no coffee becomes apparent when he discovers that the coffee container is empty.
formal.zh: 故事中，人物发现咖啡盒空了，这时他对没有咖啡的恐惧便显露出来。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għad baqa' kafè? Il-blakafefobija tiegħi reġgħet bdiet! Mark: Iva, hemm pakkett ġdid fl-armarju.
colloquial.en: Lara: Is there any coffee left? My fear of having no coffee is kicking in again! Mark: Yes, there's a new packet in the cupboard.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：还有咖啡吗？我又开始怕没咖啡喝了！马克：有，柜子里有一包新的。

messages.speaker: Lara (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għad baqa' kafè? Il-blakafefobija tiegħi reġgħet bdiet!
messages.mt_standard: Għad baqa' kafè? Il-blakafefobija tiegħi reġgħet bdiet!
messages.zh: 还有咖啡吗？我又开始怕没咖啡喝了！
messages.en: Is there any coffee left? My fear of having no coffee is kicking in again!

messages.speaker: Mark (室友)
messages.zh: 有，柜子里有一包新的。
messages.en: Yes, there's a new packet in the cupboard.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象早晨打开咖啡罐却发现空空如也，用那一刻的担心记住 blakafefobija。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A preparation applied to shoes to polish them and improve their appearance.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 涂在鞋面上，用于擦亮鞋子、改善外观的鞋油或擦鞋膏。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Sustanza li tintuża biex tillostra ż-żraben u ttejjeb id-dehra tagħhom.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 鞋油；用于擦亮鞋子的膏剂。

collocations.en: to polish shoes with shoe polish

formal.mt: Qabel iċ-ċerimonja, l-impjegat illostra ż-żraben bil-blakk u mbagħad għaddielhom ċarruta nadifa.
formal.en: Before the ceremony, the employee polished his shoes with shoe polish and then wiped them with a clean cloth.
formal.zh: 典礼前，这名员工用鞋油擦亮鞋子，随后用干净的布擦拭。

colloquial.mt: Karl: Fejn qiegħed il-blakk? Irrid nillostra ż-żraben. Rita: Fil-kexxun ħdejn il-bieb, maġenb ix-xkupilja.
colloquial.en: Karl: Where's the shoe polish? I want to polish my shoes. Rita: In the drawer by the door, next to the brush.
colloquial.zh: 卡尔：鞋油在哪儿？我想擦鞋。丽塔：在门边的抽屉里，刷子旁边。

messages.speaker: Karl (家人)
messages.mt_spoken: Fejn qiegħed il-blakk? Irrid nillostra ż-żraben.
messages.mt_standard: Fejn qiegħed il-blakk? Irrid nillostra ż-żraben.
messages.zh: 鞋油在哪儿？我想擦鞋。
messages.en: Where's the shoe polish? I want to polish my shoes.

messages.speaker: Rita (家人)
messages.zh: 在门边的抽屉里，刷子旁边。
messages.en: In the drawer by the door, next to the brush.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 blakk 与鞋刷、鞋油罐和擦亮的皮鞋一起记，牢牢记住它是擦鞋用品。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The activity of applying shoe polish and rubbing shoes to make them shine.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 给鞋涂上鞋油并擦拭，使鞋面光亮的活动。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ix-xogħol li tidlek iż-żraben bil-lostru u togħrokhom biex jitleqqu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 擦鞋；给鞋上油并擦亮。

formal.mt: Il-blakkatura taż-żraben għandha ssir b'ċarruta ratba u bil-lostru adattat.
formal.en: Shoe polishing should be done with a soft cloth and suitable shoe polish.
formal.zh: 擦鞋时应使用柔软的布和合适的鞋油。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Kemm tiswa l-blakkatura taż-żraben? Pawlu: Tliet ewro. Jekk trid, nagħmilhielek issa.
colloquial.en: Mark: How much does shoe polishing cost? Pawlu: Three euros. If you like, I can do it for you now.
colloquial.zh: Mark：给鞋上油擦亮要多少钱？Pawlu：三欧元。你愿意的话，我现在就帮你擦。

messages.speaker: Mark (顾客)
messages.zh: 给鞋上油擦亮要多少钱？
messages.en: How much does shoe polishing cost?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (擦鞋匠)
messages.mt_spoken: Tliet ewro. Jekk trid, nagħmilhielek issa.
messages.mt_standard: Tliet ewro. Jekk trid, nagħmilhielek issa.
messages.zh: 三欧元。你愿意的话，我现在就帮你擦。
messages.en: Three euros. If you like, I can do it for you now.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把这个词和鞋油、软布、亮鞋面连成一个画面，记住它表示擦鞋这项活动。

gloss_zh: 一阵猛烈的风；强劲阵风

teaching_sense.en_definition: A sudden, violent gust of wind.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 突然吹来的一阵猛烈的风。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Buffura riħ għal għarrieda u qawwija ħafna.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 一阵猛烈的风；强劲阵风。

formal.mt: Blast ta' riħ fetaħ it-tieqa u xerred il-karti minn fuq l-iskrivanija.
formal.en: A blast of wind pushed the window open and scattered the papers from the desk.
formal.zh: 一阵猛烈的风吹开了窗户，把书桌上的纸张吹散了。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Ħassejt dak il-blast ta' riħ? Mark: Iva, kważi tarli l-kappell!
colloquial.en: Lara: Did you feel that blast of wind? Mark: Yes, my hat almost blew away!
colloquial.zh: Lara：你感觉到刚才那阵猛风了吗？Mark：感觉到了，我的帽子差点被吹走！

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 你感觉到刚才那阵猛风了吗？
messages.en: Did you feel that blast of wind?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 感觉到了，我的帽子差点被吹走！
messages.en: Yes, my hat almost blew away!

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一阵猛风突然把帽子吹飞，记住这里表示短促而猛烈的一阵风。

gloss_zh: 喷气管；蒸汽机车喷汽管

teaching_sense.en_definition: A pipe that directs a strong jet of steam or air, such as the exhaust-steam pipe in a steam locomotive.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 引导强劲蒸汽流或气流的管道，例如蒸汽机车中喷出废汽的管道。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Pajp li jidderieġi ġett qawwi ta' fwar jew arja, bħal dak li joħroġ il-fwar użat f'lokomottiva tal-fwar.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 喷气管；尤指蒸汽机车中喷出废汽的喷汽管。

formal.mt: Waqt l-ispezzjoni tal-lokomottiva tal-fwar, it-tekniku eżamina l-blastpajp għal sinjali ta' ħsara.
formal.en: During the inspection of the steam locomotive, the technician examined the blastpipe for signs of damage.
formal.zh: 检查蒸汽机车时，技术人员查看了喷汽管是否有损坏迹象。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Dan il-pajp x'inhu? Pawlu: Dak hu l-blastpajp; minnu joħroġ il-fwar użat tal-lokomottiva.
colloquial.en: Maja: What is this pipe? Pawlu: That's the blastpipe; the locomotive's used steam comes out through it.
colloquial.zh: Maja：这是什么管子？Pawlu：那是喷汽管，机车使用过的蒸汽从那里排出。

messages.speaker: Maja (博物馆参观者)
messages.zh: 这是什么管子？
messages.en: What is this pipe?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (博物馆讲解员)
messages.mt_spoken: Dak hu l-blastpajp; minnu joħroġ il-fwar użat tal-lokomottiva.
messages.mt_standard: Dak hu l-blastpajp; minnu joħroġ il-fwar użat tal-lokomottiva.
messages.zh: 那是喷汽管，机车使用过的蒸汽从那里排出。
messages.en: That's the blastpipe; the locomotive's used steam comes out through it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把词和蒸汽机车的一根管子联系起来，想象蒸汽沿管道强劲喷出，记住喷汽管。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The hard natural material forming rock masses or exposed rocky surfaces.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 构成岩体或裸露岩面的坚硬天然物质，也指成片的岩石。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Materjal naturali iebes li jifforma mases jew uċuħ tal-ġebel.

sense_translations.en_definition: rock (material, a mass or surface of it)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 岩石这种物质；岩体；岩石表面。

formal.mt: Il-mogħdija tgħaddi minn fuq blat mikxuf qabel tasal sal-baħar.
formal.en: The path crosses exposed rock before reaching the sea.
formal.zh: 这条小路经过裸露的岩面，然后通向海边。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Nistgħu noqogħdu fuq il-blat ħdejn il-baħar? Lara: Iva, imma agħżel post niexef biex ma tiżloqx.
colloquial.en: Mark: Can we sit on the rocks by the sea? Lara: Yes, but choose a dry spot so you don't slip.
colloquial.zh: Mark：我们可以坐在海边的岩石上吗？Lara：可以，不过选个干燥的地方，免得滑倒。

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Nistgħu noqogħdu fuq il-blat ħdejn il-baħar?
messages.mt_standard: Nistgħu noqogħdu fuq il-blat ħdejn il-baħar?
messages.zh: 我们可以坐在海边的岩石上吗？
messages.en: Can we sit on the rocks by the sea?

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, imma agħżel post niexef biex ma tiżloqx.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, imma agħżel post niexef biex ma tiżloqx.
messages.zh: 可以，不过选个干燥的地方，免得滑倒。
messages.en: Yes, but choose a dry spot so you don't slip.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象海边连成一片的坚硬岩面，把这个词与岩石材料和大片岩体一起记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A cosmetic applied to the cheeks to give them colour.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 涂在脸颊上、使脸颊显出颜色的化妆品。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Prodott tal-kożmetika li jitqiegħed fuq il-ħaddejn biex jagħtihom il-kulur.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 腮红；用于给脸颊增添颜色的化妆品。

formal.mt: Applika ftit blaxer fuq il-ħaddejn b'pinzell artab biex tikseb dehra naturali.
formal.en: Apply a little blusher to the cheeks with a soft brush to achieve a natural look.
formal.zh: 用柔软的化妆刷在脸颊上涂少量腮红，打造自然的妆容。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Dan il-blaxer roża jixraqli? Lara: Iva, imma poġġi ftit biss; diġà jagħtik kulur sabiħ.
colloquial.en: Maja: Does this pink blusher suit me? Lara: Yes, but put on just a little; it already gives you a lovely colour.
colloquial.zh: Maja：这款粉色腮红适合我吗？Lara：适合，不过涂一点就好，已经很显气色了。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 这款粉色腮红适合我吗？
messages.en: Does this pink blusher suit me?

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, imma poġġi ftit biss; diġà jagħtik kulur sabiħ.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, imma poġġi ftit biss; diġà jagħtik kulur sabiħ.
messages.zh: 适合，不过涂一点就好，已经很显气色了。
messages.en: Yes, but put on just a little; it already gives you a lovely colour.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象化妆刷轻扫两边脸颊，留下淡淡粉色，用这幅画面记住腮红。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who avoids work or making an effort.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 不愿工作或付出努力的人，称呼中带有批评意味。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna għażżiena li tevita x-xogħol jew l-isforz.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 懒人；不愿做事的人。

collocations.en: to call someone a lazy person

formal.mt: Fl-istorja, il-karattru jissejjaħ blaġa għax dejjem iħalli x-xogħol f'idejn ħaddieħor.
formal.en: In the story, the character is called a lazy person because he always leaves the work to others.
formal.zh: 故事中的人物被称为懒人，因为他总是把工作留给别人做。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Tkunx blaġa; ejja għinni nnaddaf il-mejda. Karl: Tajjeb, ġej. Jien niġbor il-platti.
colloquial.en: Anna: Don't be lazy; come and help me clear the table. Karl: All right, I'm coming. I'll collect the plates.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：别当懒鬼了，来帮我收拾桌子。卡尔：好，我来了。我来收盘子。

messages.speaker: Anna (姐姐)
messages.mt_spoken: Tkunx blaġa; ejja għinni nnaddaf il-mejda.
messages.mt_standard: Tkunx blaġa; ejja għinni nnaddaf il-mejda.
messages.zh: 别当懒鬼了，来帮我收拾桌子。
messages.en: Don't be lazy; come and help me clear the table.

messages.speaker: Karl (弟弟)
messages.zh: 好，我来了。我来收盘子。
messages.en: All right, I'm coming. I'll collect the plates.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“大家收盘子，一人坐着不动”的画面记 blaġa；它是指人的名词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A small bird.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指体型小的鸟，可用于描述眼前或故事中的小鸟。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Għasfur żgħir.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 一只小鸟；体型较小的鸟。

collocations.en: a small bird on a branch
a small bird in the garden

formal.mt: L-istampa turi blejbel fuq fergħa ħdejn it-tieqa.
formal.en: The picture shows a small bird on a branch beside the window.
formal.zh: 图中，一只小鸟停在窗旁的树枝上。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Ara dak il-blejbel fuq il-ħajt! Toni: Rajtu. Ejja nibqgħu kwieti biex ma jtirx.
colloquial.en: Lara: Look at that small bird on the wall! Toni: I saw it. Let's stay quiet so it does not fly away.
colloquial.zh: Lara：看墙上那只小鸟！Toni：我看到了。我们安静一点，别让它飞走。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 看墙上那只小鸟！
messages.en: Look at that small bird on the wall!

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Rajtu. Ejja nibqgħu kwieti biex ma jtirx.
messages.mt_standard: Rajtu. Ejja nibqgħu kwieti biex ma jtirx.
messages.zh: 我看到了。我们安静一点，别让它飞走。
messages.en: I saw it. Let's stay quiet so it does not fly away.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 blejbel 和“树枝上一只小鸟”的画面绑定；先记一般的小鸟，再与专指小云雀的 blejbla 区分。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A small lark; the diminutive form of 'bilbla'.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指小云雀，是 bilbla 的指小形式，突出鸟儿小巧的形象。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Bilbla żgħira; il-forma diminuttiva ta' 'bilbla'.

sense_translations.en_definition: diminutive of 'bilbla', meaning a small lark
sense_translations.zh_definition: bilbla 的指小形式，意为小云雀。

collocations.en: a small lark in the field

formal.mt: Fil-poeżija, blejbla tkanta fl-għalqa waqt li t-tfal jisimgħuha.
formal.en: In the poem, a small lark sings in the field while the children listen to it.
formal.zh: 诗中，一只小云雀在田野里鸣唱，孩子们听着它的歌声。

colloquial.mt: Nina: X'inhi blejbla? David: Bilbla żgħira. Ara, hemm waħda fl-istampa.
colloquial.en: Nina: What is a blejbla? David: A small lark. Look, there is one in the picture.
colloquial.zh: Nina：blejbla 是什么？David：就是小云雀。看，图里有一只。

messages.speaker: Nina (学生)
messages.zh: blejbla 是什么？
messages.en: What is a blejbla?

messages.speaker: David (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Bilbla żgħira. Ara, hemm waħda fl-istampa.
messages.mt_standard: Bilbla żgħira. Ara, hemm waħda fl-istampa.
messages.zh: 就是小云雀。看，图里有一只。
messages.en: A small lark. Look, there is one in the picture.

cognitive_memory_aid: 将 bilbla 与 blejbla 成对记忆：后者表示小云雀；想象课本里那只正在田野上唱歌的小鸟。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person described as foolish, using a diminutive form of 'iblah'.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用来称呼愚笨或糊涂的人，是 iblah 的指小形式；说“小傻瓜”时，具体语气取决于上下文。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna iblah, imsejħa bil-forma diminuttiva ta' 'iblah'.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 指愚笨或糊涂的人，可译为“小傻瓜”；是 iblah 的指小形式。

formal.mt: Fir-rakkont, il-karattru jissejjaħ blejjah għax jemmen kull ħaġa li jisma'.
formal.en: In the story, the character is called a little fool because he believes everything he hears.
formal.zh: 故事中，这个人物被叫作“小傻瓜”，因为他听到什么都相信。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Ja blejjah, iċ-ċwievet qegħdin f'idek! Luqa: Veru! U jien ilni nfittixhom.
colloquial.en: Mark: You little fool, the keys are in your hand! Luqa: They are! And I have been looking for them all this time.
colloquial.zh: Mark：你这个小傻瓜，钥匙就在你手里！Luqa：还真是！我找了半天呢。

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 你这个小傻瓜，钥匙就在你手里！
messages.en: You little fool, the keys are in your hand!

messages.speaker: Luqa (朋友)
messages.zh: 还真是！我找了半天呢。
messages.en: They are! And I have been looking for them all this time.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象朋友拿着钥匙却到处寻找，被叫一声 blejjah；本条按名词记作“小傻瓜”，并留意称呼的语气。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A small city or town; the diminutive form of 'belt'.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指规模较小的城市或城镇，是 belt 的指小形式。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Belt żgħira; il-forma diminuttiva ta' 'belt'.

sense_translations.en_definition: a small city or town (the diminutive form of 'belt')
sense_translations.zh_definition: 小城或小镇；belt 的指小形式。

collocations.en: a small town by the sea

formal.mt: Ir-rumanz jibda fi blejta kwieta ħdejn il-baħar.
formal.en: The novel begins in a quiet small town by the sea.
formal.zh: 小说从一座安静的海边小镇开始。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Fejn se nqattgħu tmiem il-ġimgħa? Ben: Fi blejta ħdejn il-baħar. Nistgħu nimxu fit-toroq u nistrieħu.
colloquial.en: Sara: Where are we spending the weekend? Ben: In a small town by the sea. We can walk through the streets and relax.
colloquial.zh: Sara：我们周末去哪里过？Ben：去一座海边小镇。我们可以在街上走走，放松一下。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 我们周末去哪里过？
messages.en: Where are we spending the weekend?

messages.speaker: Ben (朋友)
