messages.mt_spoken: Fi blejta ħdejn il-baħar. Nistgħu nimxu fit-toroq u nistrieħu.
messages.mt_standard: Fi blejta ħdejn il-baħar. Nistgħu nimxu fit-toroq u nistrieħu.
messages.zh: 去一座海边小镇。我们可以在街上走走，放松一下。
messages.en: In a small town by the sea. We can walk through the streets and relax.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 belt 和 blejta 放在两张地图上比较：一张标城市，一张标小城；用海边小镇的画面记住指小意义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A bruise around the eye, usually caused by a blow or a bump.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指眼睛周围因碰撞或击打等形成的淤青，也就是常说的“乌青眼”。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tbenġila madwar l-għajn, ġeneralment wara daqqa jew ħabta.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 眼睛周围的淤青；乌青眼。

collocations.en: a black eye after a blow
collocations.zh: 受击后出现的眼周淤青

formal.mt: Wara li ħabat mal-bieb, it-tifel kellu blekajn.
formal.en: After bumping into the door, the boy had a black eye.
formal.zh: 男孩撞到门后，眼睛周围出现了淤青。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Kif ġralek dak il-blekajn? Pietru: Ilbieraħ ħbatt mal-bieb.
colloquial.en: Anna: How did you get that black eye? Pietru: I bumped into the door yesterday.
colloquial.zh: Anna：你眼睛周围那块淤青是怎么弄的？Pietru：我昨天撞到门了。

messages.speaker: Anna (同事)
messages.zh: 你眼睛周围那块淤青是怎么弄的？
messages.en: How did you get that black eye?

messages.speaker: Pietru (同事)
messages.zh: 我昨天撞到门了。
messages.en: I bumped into the door yesterday.

cognitive_memory_aid: 借英语 black eye 联想 blekajn，脑中画出眼睛周围的一圈淤青；这里记的是受伤后的乌青眼。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The quality of being simple-minded or showing little judgement; this noun is typically used with a pronominal suffix.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 头脑简单、判断欠周全的状态或特质；这个名词通常带代词后缀使用。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-kwalità ta' min ikun sempliċi wisq fil-ħsieb jew jonqsu l-għaqal; dan in-nom normalment jintuża b'suffiss pronominali.

sense_translations.en_definition: simple-mindedness (this form is typically used with pronominal suffixes)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 憨傻；头脑简单，缺乏周全判断的特质（这个形式通常带代词后缀使用）。

formal.mt: Fil-bleħenijtu, il-karattru emmen kull wegħda mingħajr ma talab spjegazzjoni.
formal.en: In his simple-mindedness, the character believed every promise without asking for an explanation.
formal.zh: 这个人物头脑简单，听到什么承诺都相信，也不要求解释。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex emmen dik l-istorja kollha? Lara: Fil-bleħenijtu, ħaseb li ħadd ma kien se jigdiblu.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why did he believe that whole story? Lara: In his simple-mindedness, he thought nobody would lie to him.
colloquial.zh: Maja：他为什么把那个故事全信了？Lara：他头脑太简单，以为谁都不会骗他。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 他为什么把那个故事全信了？
messages.en: Why did he believe that whole story?

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Fil-bleħenijtu, ħaseb li ħadd ma kien se jigdiblu.
messages.mt_standard: Fil-bleħenijtu, ħaseb li ħadd ma kien se jigdiblu.
messages.zh: 他头脑太简单，以为谁都不会骗他。
messages.en: In his simple-mindedness, he thought nobody would lie to him.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把意思记成听到承诺就全信的憨傻，并连同例句中的代词后缀形式一起练习。

gloss_zh: 头脑简单的；有些愚笨的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Simple-minded; having a limited understanding of things.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容人头脑简单，对事情的理解能力有限；用于评价别人时可能带有贬义。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jaħseb b'mod sempliċi u ma jifhimx ħafna affarijiet.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 头脑简单的；理解能力有限的；有些愚笨的。

formal.mt: Fir-rakkont, ir-raġel jidher bleħien għax ma jifhimx il-pjan tal-ġar tiegħu.
formal.en: In the story, the man seems simple-minded because he does not understand his neighbour's plan.
formal.zh: 故事中，这个男人显得有些愚笨，因为他不理解邻居的计划。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Għaliex qed tgħid li hu bleħien? Pawlu: Għax ma fehem xejn, imma forsi ma spjegajtx sew.
colloquial.en: Marija: Why are you saying he is simple-minded? Pawlu: Because he did not understand anything, but perhaps I did not explain it well.
colloquial.zh: Marija：你为什么说他头脑简单？Pawlu：因为他什么都没听懂，不过也许是我没解释清楚。

messages.speaker: Marija (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex qed tgħid li hu bleħien?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex qed tgħid li hu bleħien?
messages.zh: 你为什么说他头脑简单？
messages.en: Why are you saying he is simple-minded?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax ma fehem xejn, imma forsi ma spjegajtx sew.
messages.mt_standard: Għax ma fehem xejn, imma forsi ma spjegajtx sew.
messages.zh: 因为他什么都没听懂，不过也许是我没解释清楚。
messages.en: Because he did not understand anything, but perhaps I did not explain it well.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 bleħien 放进“他没听懂复杂计划”的画面，记住它形容人头脑简单，评价别人时要留意语气。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To act foolishly or behave in a silly manner.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 做出愚蠢或傻气的举动，表现得欠缺判断。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Iġib ruħu b'mod iblah jew jagħmel xi ħaġa bla għaqal.

sense_translations.en_definition: to behave in a foolish manner
sense_translations.zh_definition: 表现得愚蠢；做出傻气、欠缺判断的举动。

collocations.en: he behaved foolishly in front of everyone
collocations.zh: 他在众人面前做出了傻事

collocations.en: he behaved foolishly during the meeting
collocations.zh: 他在会议期间举止愚蠢

formal.mt: Waqt id-diskussjoni, il-karattru bleħħen u għamel kummenti li ma kellhom ebda rabta mas-suġġett.
formal.en: During the discussion, the character behaved foolishly and made comments that had no connection with the topic.
formal.zh: 讨论期间，这个人物表现得很愚蠢，说了些与主题毫无关系的话。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex Pawlu bleħħen hekk quddiem kulħadd? Mark: Ried idaħħaq, imma ċ-ċajta ma rnexxietx.
colloquial.en: Lara: Why did Pawlu behave so foolishly in front of everyone? Mark: He wanted to make people laugh, but the joke didn't work.
colloquial.zh: Lara：Pawlu为什么在大家面前那样犯傻？Mark：他想逗大家笑，可惜那个笑话没逗成。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex Pawlu bleħħen hekk quddiem kulħadd?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex Pawlu bleħħen hekk quddiem kulħadd?
messages.zh: Pawlu为什么在大家面前那样犯傻？
messages.en: Why did Pawlu behave so foolishly in front of everyone?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ried idaħħaq, imma ċ-ċajta ma rnexxietx.
messages.mt_standard: Ried idaħħaq, imma ċ-ċajta ma rnexxietx.
messages.zh: 他想逗大家笑，可惜那个笑话没逗成。
messages.en: He wanted to make people laugh, but the joke didn't work.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象有人在严肃讨论中突然做出傻举动，记住这个动词描述犯傻的行为。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A vehicle light that flashes to show the driver's intended direction of turning.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 车辆上通过闪烁来表示驾驶者准备向哪个方向转弯的灯。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Dawl fuq vettura li jteptep biex juri lejn liema naħa s-sewwieq ikun se jdur.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 转向灯；指示车辆准备转弯方向的闪光灯。

formal.mt: Is-sewwieq xegħel il-blinka qabel dar lejn ix-xellug.
formal.en: The driver switched on the turn signal before turning left.
formal.zh: 驾驶者在左转前打开了转向灯。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Se ddur lejn ix-xellug hawn? Mark: Iva, issa nixgħel il-blinka.
colloquial.en: Maja: Are you turning left here? Mark: Yes, I'll switch on the turn signal now.
colloquial.zh: Maja：你要在这里左转吗？Mark：对，我现在打开转向灯。

messages.speaker: Maja (乘客)
messages.zh: 你要在这里左转吗？
messages.en: Are you turning left here?

messages.speaker: Mark (司机)
messages.zh: 对，我现在打开转向灯。
messages.en: Yes, I'll switch on the turn signal now.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 blinka 和转弯前一闪一闪的车灯画面绑定，记成“先打灯，再转弯”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The change from darkness to light, as when daylight begins to appear.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 从黑暗逐渐转为光明的过程，例如天色开始变亮时的变化。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-bidla mid-dlam għad-dawl, bħal meta jibda jisbaħ.

sense_translations.en_definition: the transition from darkness to light
sense_translations.zh_definition: 从黑暗到光明的过渡；由暗转明的过程。

collocations.en: the morning transition from darkness to light
observe the transition from darkness to light

formal.mt: Il-kittieb jiddeskrivi l-bliq bħala bidla bil-mod mid-dlam għad-dawl.
formal.en: The writer describes the transition from darkness to light as a gradual change.
formal.zh: 作者将由暗转明描写为一个逐渐发生的变化。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għadu dlam barra? Pawlu: Qed jibda l-bliq; is-sema qed jiċċara.
colloquial.en: Maja: Is it still dark outside? Pawlu: It's starting to get light; the sky is brightening.
colloquial.zh: Maja：外面还黑着吗？Pawlu：开始由暗转明了，天空正在变亮。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 外面还黑着吗？
messages.en: Is it still dark outside?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Qed jibda l-bliq; is-sema qed jiċċara.
messages.mt_standard: Qed jibda l-bliq; is-sema qed jiċċara.
messages.zh: 开始由暗转明了，天空正在变亮。
messages.en: It's starting to get light; the sky is brightening.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一张从黑色渐变到亮色的图片，用 bliq 记住中间“由暗转明”的过程。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An evil supernatural being described as a devil or demon.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 被称作魔鬼或恶魔的邪恶超自然存在。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ħlejqa ħażina sopranaturali, jiġifieri xitan jew demonju.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 一个魔鬼；一个恶魔。

formal.mt: F'dan ir-rakkont, il-blis jipprova jbeżża' lil dawk li jidħlu fil-kastell.
formal.en: In this tale, the demon tries to frighten those who enter the castle.
formal.zh: 在这个故事中，恶魔试图吓唬进入城堡的人。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Min hu dak fil-ktieb? Ninu: Dak blis fl-istorja, imma ma jbeżżagħnix.
colloquial.en: Lara: Who is that in the book? Ninu: That's a demon in the story, but he doesn't scare me.
colloquial.zh: Lara：书里的那个是谁？Ninu：那是故事里的一个恶魔，不过我不怕他。

messages.speaker: Lara (姐姐)
messages.zh: 书里的那个是谁？
messages.en: Who is that in the book?

messages.speaker: Ninu (弟弟)
messages.mt_spoken: Dak blis fl-istorja, imma ma jbeżżagħnix.
messages.mt_standard: Dak blis fl-istorja, imma ma jbeżżagħnix.
messages.zh: 那是故事里的一个恶魔，不过我不怕他。
messages.en: That's a demon in the story, but he doesn't scare me.

cognitive_memory_aid: 在童话插图中的恶魔旁写上 blis，把词与故事角色配对记忆，不必另猜词源。

gloss_zh: 闪电式攻势；集中突击行动

teaching_sense.en_definition: A rapid, intensive attack or concentrated campaign carried out over a short period.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在短时间内迅速、密集展开的攻击或集中行动。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Attakk jew kampanja li jsiru b'ħeffa u b'intensità kbira f'perjodu qasir.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 闪电式攻击；短时间内密集展开的突击行动或宣传攻势。

collocations.zh: 一轮密集的闪电式攻击

formal.mt: Il-kumpanija nediet blizz ta' reklamar matul il-ġimgħa qabel il-ftuħ tal-ħanut.
formal.en: The company launched an advertising blitz during the week before the shop opened.
formal.zh: 公司在商店开业前的一周展开了密集广告攻势。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex qed nara dan ir-reklam kullimkien? Mark: Għamlu blizz ta' reklamar għall-ftuħ tal-ħanut.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why am I seeing this advert everywhere? Mark: They ran an advertising blitz for the shop's opening.
colloquial.zh: Maja：我怎么到处都能看到这个广告？Mark：他们为了商店开业展开了一轮密集广告宣传。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex qed nara dan ir-reklam kullimkien?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex qed nara dan ir-reklam kullimkien?
messages.zh: 我怎么到处都能看到这个广告？
messages.en: Why am I seeing this advert everywhere?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għamlu blizz ta' reklamar għall-ftuħ tal-ħanut.
messages.mt_standard: Għamlu blizz ta' reklamar għall-ftuħ tal-ħanut.
messages.zh: 他们为了商店开业展开了一轮密集广告宣传。
messages.en: They ran an advertising blitz for the shop's opening.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 blizz 想成短时间内广告接连出现的画面，抓住“来得快、密度高”的共同特点。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A substance used to whiten materials or remove colour and stains.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用于使材料变白，或去除颜色、污渍的漂白剂。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Sustanza li tintuża biex tbajjad jew tneħħi l-kulur u t-tbajja'.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 漂白剂；用于漂白或去除颜色、污渍的物质。

formal.mt: Il-lista tal-prodotti tinkludi bliċ għall-ħwejjeġ bojod.
formal.en: The product list includes bleach for white clothes.
formal.zh: 产品清单中包括白色衣物用漂白剂。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Għandna bliċ fil-kamra tal-ħasil? Ġużeppi: Iva, hemm flixkun fuq l-ixkaffa.
colloquial.en: Marija: Do we have bleach in the laundry room? Ġużeppi: Yes, there is a bottle on the shelf.
colloquial.zh: Marija：洗衣房里有漂白剂吗？Ġużeppi：有，架子上有一瓶。

messages.speaker: Marija (室友)
messages.zh: 洗衣房里有漂白剂吗？
messages.en: Do we have bleach in the laundry room?

messages.speaker: Ġużeppi (室友)
messages.zh: 有，架子上有一瓶。
messages.en: Yes, there is a bottle on the shelf.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 bliċ 与英语 bleach 和“白衣旁的一瓶漂白剂”连起来；再用 flixkun bliċ 整块记住“一瓶漂白剂”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A bleaching substance in powder form.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 呈粉末状、用于漂白的物质，即漂白粉。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Sustanza f'forma ta' trab li tintuża għat-tibjid.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 漂白粉；粉末状的漂白物质。

formal.mt: Fil-lista tal-ħażna hemm żewġ pakketti bliċinpawder.
formal.en: The inventory list includes two packets of bleaching powder.
formal.zh: 库存清单中列有两包漂白粉。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Dan il-pakkett fih bliċinpawder? Samwel: Iva, hekk hemm miktub fuq it-tikketta.
colloquial.en: Rita: Does this packet contain bleaching powder? Samwel: Yes, that is what the label says.
colloquial.zh: Rita：这个包装里装的是漂白粉吗？Samwel：是的，标签上是这么写的。

messages.speaker: Rita (顾客)
messages.zh: 这个包装里装的是漂白粉吗？
messages.en: Does this packet contain bleaching powder?

messages.speaker: Samwel (店员)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, hekk hemm miktub fuq it-tikketta.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, hekk hemm miktub fuq it-tikketta.
messages.zh: 是的，标签上是这么写的。
messages.en: Yes, that is what the label says.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用英语 bleaching powder 辅助联想 bliċinpawder，再想象标着“漂白粉”的纸包，抓住粉末形态来记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A group of buildings bounded by streets; also, a group of parties or organizations acting together.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 由街道围定的一组建筑，即街区；也指共同采取行动的政党或组织集团。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Grupp ta' bini mdawwar bit-toroq; ukoll grupp ta' partiti jew organizzazzjonijiet li jaġixxu flimkien.

sense_translations.en_definition: block (group of buildings demarcated by streets)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 街区；由周围街道划定的一组建筑。
集团；联盟；为共同目标联合行动的政党或组织群体。

collocations.en: a block bounded by four streets
collocations.zh: 由四条街道围成的街区

formal.mt: Il-partiti ffurmaw blokk biex jippreżentaw proposta komuni.
formal.en: The parties formed a bloc to present a joint proposal.
formal.zh: 这些政党组成联盟，以提出共同提案。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Il-kafetterija tinsab f'dan il-blokk? Pawlu: Iva, fuq in-naħa l-oħra tal-istess blokk.
colloquial.en: Maja: Is the café in this block? Pawlu: Yes, on the other side of the same block.
colloquial.zh: Maja：咖啡馆在这个街区里吗？Pawlu：对，就在同一个街区的另一侧。

messages.speaker: Maja (游客)
messages.zh: 咖啡馆在这个街区里吗？
messages.en: Is the café in this block?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (当地居民)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, fuq in-naħa l-oħra tal-istess blokk.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, fuq in-naħa l-oħra tal-istess blokk.
messages.zh: 对，就在同一个街区的另一侧。
messages.en: Yes, on the other side of the same block.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两个画面记 blokk：地图上围成一组的建筑是街区，联合行动的一组政党是联盟。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The bird called the great crested grebe, scientifically named Podiceps cristatus.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 凤头䴙䴘，学名为 Podiceps cristatus 的鸟。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Għasfur magħruf bl-isem xjentifiku Podiceps cristatus.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 凤头䴙䴘（Podiceps cristatus）。

collocations.en: a photograph of a great crested grebe
an observation of a great crested grebe

teaching_sense.en_definition: The bird called the great crested grebe, with the scientific name Podiceps cristatus.

teaching_sense.mt_definition: Għasfur li għandu l-isem xjentifiku Podiceps cristatus.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 凤头䴙䴘（Podiceps cristatus）。

identification of a great crested grebe

teaching_sense.en_definition: The bird called the black-necked grebe, with the scientific name Podiceps nigricollis.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 黑颈䴙䴘，指学名为 Podiceps nigricollis 的鸟。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Għasfur li għandu l-isem xjentifiku Podiceps nigricollis.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 黑颈䴙䴘（Podiceps nigricollis）。

collocations.en: a photograph of a black-necked grebe

formal.mt: Il-gwida tagħti l-isem blonġun sekond għall-għasfur Podiceps nigricollis.
formal.en: The guide gives the name blonġun sekond for the bird Podiceps nigricollis.
formal.zh: 指南将 Podiceps nigricollis 这种鸟的马耳他语名称列为 blonġun sekond。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A bird species called the little grebe, scientifically named Tachybaptus ruficollis.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一种名为小䴙䴘的鸟，学名为 Tachybaptus ruficollis。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Speċi ta' għasfur magħrufa bl-isem xjentifiku Tachybaptus ruficollis.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 小䴙䴘（学名：Tachybaptus ruficollis）。

collocations.en: a photograph of a little grebe

formal.mt: Il-gwida tinkludi ritratt tal-blonġun żgħir u l-isem xjentifiku tiegħu, Tachybaptus ruficollis.
formal.en: The guide includes a photograph of the little grebe and its scientific name, Tachybaptus ruficollis.
formal.zh: 这本指南收录了小䴙䴘的照片及其学名 Tachybaptus ruficollis。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'jismu dan l-għasfur fir-ritratt? Pawlu: Dan blonġun żgħir. Ejja nfittxuh fil-gwida.
colloquial.en: Maja: What is this bird in the photograph called? Pawlu: It's a little grebe. Let's look it up in the guide.
colloquial.zh: Maja：照片里的这只鸟叫什么？Pawlu：这是小䴙䴘。我们在指南里查查吧。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.zh: 照片里的这只鸟叫什么？

messages.mt_standard: Dan blonġun żgħir. Ejja nfittxuh fil-gwida.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把整个鸟名与小䴙䴘照片一起记：żgħir 表示“小”，但完整词组才是这里要学的物种名称。

gloss_zh: 一件蠢事；欠考虑的举动

teaching_sense.en_definition: A particular foolish or thoughtless action.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一次具体的愚蠢行为，或未经充分考虑就做出的举动。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Azzjoni iblah jew għemil magħmul mingħajr ħsieb biżżejjed.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 一件蠢事；一次愚蠢的行为。
一次欠考虑的举动；未经思量的行为。

formal.mt: Kienet bluhata li jintbagħat id-dokument mingħajr ma jiġi ċċekkjat l-indirizz.
formal.en: It was a thoughtless act to send the document without checking the address.
formal.zh: 没有核对地址就把文件寄出，是一次欠考虑的举动。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Ħallejt iċ-ċwievet ġewwa u għalaqt il-bieb. Sara: Dik kienet bluhata, imma ejja nċemplu lil ħuk.
colloquial.en: Mark: I left the keys inside and closed the door. Sara: That was a foolish thing to do, but let's call your brother.
colloquial.zh: Mark：我把钥匙留在屋里就关上门了。Sara：这事做得真傻，不过我们给你兄弟打个电话吧。

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ħallejt iċ-ċwievet ġewwa u għalaqt il-bieb.
messages.mt_standard: Ħallejt iċ-ċwievet ġewwa u għalaqt il-bieb.
messages.zh: 我把钥匙留在屋里就关上门了。
messages.en: I left the keys inside and closed the door.

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Dik kienet bluhata, imma ejja nċemplu lil ħuk.
messages.mt_standard: Dik kienet bluhata, imma ejja nċemplu lil ħuk.
messages.zh: 这事做得真傻，不过我们给你兄弟打个电话吧。
messages.en: That was a foolish thing to do, but let's call your brother.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“一件蠢事”来记 bluhata：脑中放一张把钥匙锁在屋里的事件卡，突出一次具体行为。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The quality of being stupid, foolish, or insufficiently thoughtful.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 愚蠢、糊涂或欠缺思考的性质与表现。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-kwalità ta' min ikun iblah jew jaġixxi mingħajr ħsieb biżżejjed.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 愚蠢；缺乏明智判断的状态或表现。
欠考虑；行事缺少必要的思量。
愚笨；糊涂；不明智的性质或表现。

formal.mt: Il-bluhija ta' dik id-deċiżjoni dehret ċara meta ġew eżaminati l-konsegwenzi tagħha.
formal.en: The foolishness of that decision became clear when its consequences were examined.
formal.zh: 审视那项决定的后果后，其愚蠢之处就显而易见了。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Għaliex ma ċċekkjajtx il-ħin qabel tlaqt? Toni: Minħabba l-bluhija tiegħi. Ħsibt li kont niftakru.
colloquial.en: Nina: Why didn't you check the time before leaving? Toni: Because of my own foolishness. I thought I remembered it.
colloquial.zh: Nina：你出发前怎么没核对时间？Toni：是我自己糊涂了。我以为我记得。

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex ma ċċekkjajtx il-ħin qabel tlaqt?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex ma ċċekkjajtx il-ħin qabel tlaqt?
messages.zh: 你出发前怎么没核对时间？
messages.en: Why didn't you check the time before leaving?

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Minħabba l-bluhija tiegħi. Ħsibt li kont niftakru.
messages.mt_standard: Minħabba l-bluhija tiegħi. Ħsibt li kont niftakru.
messages.zh: 是我自己糊涂了。我以为我记得。
messages.en: Because of my own foolishness. I thought I remembered it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 bluhija 放在“愚蠢这种性质”的抽象标签上，与 bluhata 的“一件具体蠢事”配对区分。

gloss_zh: 亵渎谩骂之人活不长（谚语）

teaching_sense.en_definition: A proverb warning that a person who blasphemes or uses foul language will not live long.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一句告诫人不要亵渎或满口污言的谚语，字面意思是这样的人活不长。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Qawl li jwissi kontra d-dagħa billi jgħid li min jidgħi ma jdumx ħaj.

sense_translations.en_definition: A blasphemous or foulmouthed person won’t live long.
sense_translations.zh_definition: 亵渎神明或满口污言的人活不长；用于劝诫的谚语说法。

collocations.en: the proverb "a blasphemous or foulmouthed person won't live long"
collocations.zh: “亵渎谩骂之人活不长”这句谚语

collocations.en: to quote "a blasphemous or foulmouthed person won't live long"
collocations.zh: 引用“亵渎谩骂之人活不长”这句谚语

formal.mt: Fit-test, il-qawl "bniedem dagħaj ftit idum ħaj" jintuża bħala twissija kontra d-dagħa, mhux bħala stqarrija xjentifika dwar it-tul tal-ħajja.
formal.en: In the text, the proverb "a blasphemous or foulmouthed person won't live long" is used as a warning against blasphemy, not as a scientific statement about lifespan.
formal.zh: 文中用“亵渎谩骂之人活不长”这句谚语来告诫人不要亵渎谩骂，并非对寿命作科学陈述。

colloquial.mt: Rita: In-nanna kienet tgħid: "Bniedem dagħaj ftit idum ħaj." Luqa: Jiġifieri kienet twissikom biex ma tidgħux? Rita: Iva, hekk kienet tużah.
colloquial.en: Rita: Grandma used to say, "A blasphemous or foulmouthed person won't live long." Luqa: So she was warning you not to blaspheme? Rita: Yes, that was how she used it.
colloquial.zh: Rita：奶奶以前常说：“亵渎谩骂之人活不长。”Luqa：也就是说，她是在告诫你们不要说亵渎的话？Rita：对，她就是这样用这句话的。

messages.speaker: Rita (朋友)

messages.mt_standard: In-nanna kienet tgħid: "Bniedem dagħaj ftit idum ħaj."
messages.zh: 奶奶以前常说：“亵渎谩骂之人活不长。”
messages.en: Grandma used to say, "A blasphemous or foulmouthed person won't live long."

messages.speaker: Luqa (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Jiġifieri kienet twissikom biex ma tidgħux?
messages.mt_standard: Jiġifieri kienet twissikom biex ma tidgħux?
messages.zh: 也就是说，她是在告诫你们不要说亵渎的话？
messages.en: So she was warning you not to blaspheme?

messages.speaker: Rita (朋友)
messages.zh: 对，她就是这样用这句话的。
messages.en: Yes, that was how she used it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 按“人—亵渎谩骂—活不长”三段记整句，留意 dagħaj 与 ħaj 的句末呼应，并记住这是劝诫谚语。

gloss_zh: 女性的；女孩的（复数名词后的同位说明语）

teaching_sense.en_definition: A noun used in apposition after a gender-neutral plural for relatives or young people to specify that the people are female.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用在性别中立的亲属或年轻人复数称呼之后，作同位说明，指出所指的人为女性。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Nom li jitqiegħed f'appożizzjoni ma' nom fil-plural għal qraba jew żgħażagħ biex jispeċifika li huma nisa jew tfajliet.

sense_translations.en_definition: used as an apposition with gender-neutral plurals referring to relatives or young people, in order to specify the feminine
sense_translations.zh_definition: 与指亲属或年轻人的性别中立复数名词同位使用，以明确所指为女性。

formal.mt: Il-lista tinkludi għaxar tfal bniet li se jieħdu sehem fil-proġett.
formal.en: The list includes ten girls who will take part in the project.
formal.zh: 名单上列有十名将参加该项目的女孩子。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Min ġej miegħek għada? Lara: Żewġ kuġini bniet. It-tnejn iħobbu jimxu.
colloquial.en: Maja: Who is coming with you tomorrow? Lara: Two female cousins. They both like walking.
colloquial.zh: Maja：明天谁跟你一起来？Lara：两位女性堂表亲。她们俩都喜欢散步。

messages.zh: 两位女性堂表亲。她们俩都喜欢散步。
messages.en: Two female cousins. They both like walking.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把这里的 bniet 想成跟在复数人称后面的“女性标签”：tfal bniet 是女孩子，kuġini bniet 是女性堂表亲。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A small piece of cloth inserted into a garment as a gusset.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 嵌入衣物中的一小块布，用作补角或增加局部空间。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Biċċa żgħira tad-drapp li tiddaħħal f'ilbies, pereżempju biex tagħti aktar wisa' f'parti minnu.

sense_translations.en_definition: gusset (small piece of cloth inserted in a garment)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 衣物嵌布；嵌入衣物中的一小块补角布。

collocations.en: to insert a gusset into the sleeves

formal.mt: Il-ħajjata daħħlet bniqa fil-kmiem biex tagħti aktar spazju għall-moviment.
formal.en: The dressmaker inserted a gusset into the sleeves to allow more room for movement.
formal.zh: 裁缝在衣袖中嵌入了补角布，以增加活动空间。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Il-komma qed tiġbidli meta ngħolli idi. Rita: Nista' ndaħħal bniqa hawn biex ikollok aktar spazju.
colloquial.en: Sara: The sleeve pulls when I raise my arm. Rita: I can insert a gusset here to give you more room.
colloquial.zh: Sara：我抬胳膊时袖子会绷住。Rita：我可以在这里嵌一块补角布，让你活动时宽松些。

messages.speaker: Sara (顾客)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-komma qed tiġbidli meta ngħolli idi.
messages.mt_standard: Il-komma qed tiġbidli meta ngħolli idi.
messages.zh: 我抬胳膊时袖子会绷住。
messages.en: The sleeve pulls when I raise my arm.

messages.speaker: Rita (裁缝)
messages.mt_spoken: Nista' ndaħħal bniqa hawn biex ikollok aktar spazju.
messages.mt_standard: Nista' ndaħħal bniqa hawn biex ikollok aktar spazju.
messages.zh: 我可以在这里嵌一块补角布，让你活动时宽松些。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The chemical element called bohrium.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 化学元素𬭛的名称，英语为 bohrium。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-element kimiku magħruf bl-Ingliż bħala bohrium.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 𬭛，一种化学元素，英语名称为 bohrium。

formal.mt: Fit-tabella tal-elementi, l-isem "bohrju" jidher ħdejn l-isem Ingliż "bohrium".
formal.en: In the table of elements, the name "bohrju" appears beside the English name "bohrium".
formal.zh: 在这张元素表中，马耳他语名称 bohrju 列在英语名称 bohrium 旁边，指的都是𬭛。

colloquial.mt: Luqa: Kif ngħidu "bohrium" bil-Malti? Maja: Bohrju. Ikteb iż-żewġ ismijiet ħdejn xulxin fin-noti.
colloquial.en: Luqa: How do we say "bohrium" in Maltese? Maja: Bohrju. Write the two names next to each other in your notes.
colloquial.zh: Luqa：𬭛的英语名称是 bohrium，马耳他语怎么说？Maja：Bohrju。把这两个名称并排写在笔记里吧。

messages.speaker: Luqa (学生)
messages.zh: 𬭛的英语名称是 bohrium，马耳他语怎么说？
messages.en: How do we say "bohrium" in Maltese?

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Bohrju. Ikteb iż-żewġ ismijiet ħdejn xulxin fin-noti.
messages.mt_standard: Bohrju. Ikteb iż-żewġ ismijiet ħdejn xulxin fin-noti.
messages.zh: Bohrju。把这两个名称并排写在笔记里吧。
messages.en: Bohrju. Write the two names next to each other in your notes.

cognitive_memory_aid: 做一张三语元素卡：“𬭛—bohrium—bohrju”，用两个外语名称共有的 bohr 字母段帮助辨认拼写。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A bruise around the eye, commonly called a black eye.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 眼睛周围的淤青，俗称乌青眼。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tbenġila madwar l-għajn.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 乌青眼；眼睛周围的淤青。

collocations.en: a black eye after a fall

formal.mt: Fir-rakkont, it-tifel kellu boks madwar għajnu wara li waqa' waqt il-logħob.
formal.en: In the story, the boy had a black eye after falling while playing.
formal.zh: 故事中，男孩玩耍时摔了一跤，眼睛周围出现了淤青。

colloquial.mt: Sara: X'ġara? Għandek boks madwar għajnek. Mark: Waqajt ilbieraħ waqt li kont qed nilgħab.
colloquial.en: Sara: What happened? You've got a black eye. Mark: I fell yesterday while I was playing.
colloquial.zh: Sara：怎么了？你眼睛周围都淤青了。Mark：我昨天玩的时候摔了一跤。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 怎么了？你眼睛周围都淤青了。
messages.en: What happened? You've got a black eye.

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Waqajt ilbieraħ waqt li kont qed nilgħab.
messages.mt_standard: Waqajt ilbieraħ waqt li kont qed nilgħab.
messages.zh: 我昨天玩的时候摔了一跤。
messages.en: I fell yesterday while I was playing.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给眼周画一圈青紫色并标上 boks，再配短句 Għandek boks，把这个词与乌青眼的具体画面一起记。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who takes part in a boxing match.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 参加拳击比赛的人；拳击手。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li tieħu sehem f'logħba tal-boksing.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 拳击手；参加拳击比赛的人。

formal.mt: Il-bokser ipprepara għall-kompetizzjoni permezz ta' taħriġ regolari.
formal.en: The boxer prepared for the competition through regular training.
formal.zh: 这位拳击手通过定期训练为比赛做准备。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Min hu dak il-bokser? Mark: Hu ħija. Illum għandu l-ewwel logħba tiegħu.
colloquial.en: Maja: Who is that boxer? Mark: He's my brother. He has his first match today.
colloquial.zh: Maja：那位拳击手是谁？Mark：他是我哥哥，今天是他的第一场比赛。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 那位拳击手是谁？
messages.en: Who is that boxer?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Hu ħija. Illum għandu l-ewwel logħba tiegħu.
messages.mt_standard: Hu ħija. Illum għandu l-ewwel logħba tiegħu.
messages.zh: 他是我哥哥，今天是他的第一场比赛。
messages.en: He's my brother. He has his first match today.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 bokser 和戴拳套上场的人联系起来，再与表示运动项目的 boksing 对照记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A sport in which two opponents fight using their fists while wearing boxing gloves.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 两名对手戴着拳击手套，以拳头进行对抗的运动。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Sport li fih żewġ avversarji jiġġieldu bil-ponn waqt li jilbsu ingwanti apposta.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 拳击；拳击运动。

formal.mt: Il-klabb joffri taħriġ tal-boksing għall-adulti kull nhar ta' Tlieta.
formal.en: The club offers boxing training for adults every Tuesday.
formal.zh: 该俱乐部每周二提供成人拳击训练。

colloquial.mt: Sara: X'se tagħmel illejla? Pawlu: Għandi t-taħriġ tal-boksing. Trid tiġi miegħi?
colloquial.en: Sara: What are you doing tonight? Pawlu: I have boxing training. Do you want to come with me?
colloquial.zh: Sara：你今晚做什么？Pawlu：我有拳击训练。你想和我一起去吗？

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 你今晚做什么？
messages.en: What are you doing tonight?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandi t-taħriġ tal-boksing. Trid tiġi miegħi?
messages.mt_standard: Għandi t-taħriġ tal-boksing. Trid tiġi miegħi?
messages.zh: 我有拳击训练。你想和我一起去吗？
messages.en: I have boxing training. Do you want to come with me?

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象课程表上写着 boksing，旁边画着一双拳套：这个词指拳击运动本身。

gloss_zh: 鸟名，可指多种不同的鸟

teaching_sense.en_definition: A name used for various kinds of birds.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用于指称多种不同鸟类的名称。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Isem użat għal diversi tipi ta' għasafar.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 多种不同的鸟；可用于指称不同鸟类的名称。

collocations.en: a bird called a bolbol on a branch
collocations.zh: 一只停在树枝上、称为 bolbol 的鸟

collocations.en: a bird called a bolbol singing
collocations.zh: 一只正在鸣唱、称为 bolbol 的鸟

formal.mt: Il-kelma 'bolbol' tintuża għal diversi tipi ta' għasafar, għalhekk il-kuntest jgħin biex nifhmu għal liema għasfur qed tirreferi.
formal.en: The word 'bolbol' is used for various kinds of birds, so context helps us understand which bird it refers to.
formal.zh: bolbol 一词可用于指称不同种类的鸟，因此需要结合语境理解它具体指哪种鸟。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Ara dak il-bolbol fuq il-fergħa! Ninu: Qed narah. Isma' kemm qed jgħanni!
colloquial.en: Lara: Look at that bird called a bolbol on the branch! Ninu: I can see it. Listen to how much it's singing!
colloquial.zh: Lara：看树枝上那只叫作 bolbol 的鸟！Ninu：我看到了。听，它叫得多欢！

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 看树枝上那只叫作 bolbol 的鸟！
messages.en: Look at that bird called a bolbol on the branch!

messages.speaker: Ninu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Qed narah. Isma' kemm qed jgħanni!
messages.mt_standard: Qed narah. Isma' kemm qed jgħanni!
messages.zh: 我看到了。听，它叫得多欢！
messages.en: I can see it. Listen to how much it's singing!

cognitive_memory_aid: 把重复的 bol-bol 想象成鸟鸣节奏来记忆，但别把这个名称固定对应成某一种鸟。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A stamp attached to mail to show that postage has been paid; also, a brand identifying a product.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 贴在邮件上、表示邮资已付的邮票；也可指识别商品的品牌。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Timbru li jitwaħħal fuq ittra biex juri li tħallas il-posta; ukoll, marka li tidentifika prodott.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 邮票；贴在邮件上表示邮资已付的票证。
品牌；用于识别商品的牌子。

formal.mt: Qabel tibgħat l-ittra, waħħal boll tal-posta fir-rokna ta' fuq tal-lemin tal-envelop.
formal.en: Before sending the letter, attach a postage stamp to the top right corner of the envelope.
formal.zh: 寄信前，请把邮票贴在信封右上角。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Ta' liema boll hu dan is-sapun? Toni: Ma nafx. Ejja naqraw it-tikketta.
colloquial.en: Rita: What brand is this soap? Toni: I don't know. Let's read the label.
colloquial.zh: Rita：这块肥皂是什么牌子的？Toni：我不知道。我们看看标签吧。

messages.speaker: Rita (顾客)
messages.mt_spoken: Ta' liema boll hu dan is-sapun?
messages.mt_standard: Ta' liema boll hu dan is-sapun?
messages.zh: 这块肥皂是什么牌子的？
messages.en: What brand is this soap?

messages.speaker: Toni (购物同伴)
messages.zh: 我不知道。我们看看标签吧。
messages.en: I don't know. Let's read the label.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 boll 配两幅学习图：信封上的邮票与商品上的品牌，靠语境区分两个名词义。

gloss_zh: 游戏中超过最高限额的分数

teaching_sense.en_definition: A quantity of points in a game that exceeds the maximum allowed limit.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 游戏中超出规则所允许最高限额的分数。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Għadd ta' punti f'logħba li jaqbeż il-limitu massimu permess.

sense_translations.en_definition: a quantity of points in a game exceeding the maximum threshold
sense_translations.zh_definition: 游戏中超过最高分数限额的一定数量的分数。

collocations.en: to score beyond the maximum limit
an over-limit score in the game

formal.mt: Meta l-għadd ta' punti ta' plejer jaqbeż il-limitu massimu permess fil-logħba, dan jissejjaħ bolqa.
formal.en: When a player's number of points exceeds the maximum limit allowed in the game, this is called a bolqa.
formal.zh: 当玩家的分数超过游戏允许的最高限额时，这种情况称为 bolqa。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Il-punti tiegħi qabżu l-limitu. Għamilt bolqa? Mark: Iva. Ejja naraw x'jgħidu r-regoli dwarha.
colloquial.en: Maja: My points went over the limit. Did I get a bolqa? Mark: Yes. Let's see what the rules say about it.
colloquial.zh: Maja：我的分数超过限额了。这算 bolqa 吗？Mark：算。我们看看规则对此怎么说。

messages.speaker: Maja (玩家)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-punti tiegħi qabżu l-limitu. Għamilt bolqa?
messages.mt_standard: Il-punti tiegħi qabżu l-limitu. Għamilt bolqa?
messages.zh: 我的分数超过限额了。这算 bolqa 吗？
messages.en: My points went over the limit. Did I get a bolqa?

messages.speaker: Mark (同桌玩家)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva. Ejja naraw x'jgħidu r-regoli dwarha.
messages.mt_standard: Iva. Ejja naraw x'jgħidu r-regoli dwarha.
messages.zh: 算。我们看看规则对此怎么说。
messages.en: Yes. Let's see what the rules say about it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象计分条冲过最高限额线，在线外写上 bolqa，记住关键是超限而非单纯高分。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A metal fastener with a threaded shaft, typically used with a nut to hold parts together.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 带螺纹的金属紧固件，通常与螺母配合，用来连接和固定部件。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Qafla tal-metall bil-kamin li normalment tintuża ma' skorfina biex iżżomm biċċiet flimkien.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 螺栓；用于固定部件的金属紧固件。

formal.mt: Daħħal il-bolt mit-toqba u ssikka l-iskorfina biex twaħħal iż-żewġ biċċiet flimkien.
formal.en: Insert the bolt through the hole and tighten the nut to fasten the two pieces together.
formal.zh: 把螺栓穿过孔，再拧紧螺母，将两个部件固定在一起。

colloquial.mt: Toni: Tista' tgħaddili dak il-bolt? Rita: Dan ta' ħdejn l-iskorfina? Hawn, ħudu.
colloquial.en: Toni: Can you pass me that bolt? Rita: This one next to the nut? Here, take it.
colloquial.zh: Toni：能把那颗螺栓递给我吗？Rita：螺母旁边这颗吗？给，拿着。

messages.speaker: Toni (维修者)
messages.zh: 能把那颗螺栓递给我吗？
messages.en: Can you pass me that bolt?

messages.speaker: Rita (帮手)
messages.mt_spoken: Dan ta' ħdejn l-iskorfina? Hawn, ħudu.
messages.mt_standard: Dan ta' ħdejn l-iskorfina? Hawn, ħudu.
messages.zh: 螺母旁边这颗吗？给，拿着。
messages.en: This one next to the nut? Here, take it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 bolt 与 skorfina 成对记忆：一根螺栓配一颗螺母，合起来固定两个部件。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A pot or pitcher used to hold and pour water.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用来盛水和倒水的罐或壶。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Reċipjent li jintuża biex jinżamm u jitferra' l-ilma.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 水罐；盛水、倒水用的壶。

formal.mt: Qabel l-ikla, imla l-bomblu bl-ilma u poġġih fuq il-mejda ħdejn it-tazzi.
formal.en: Before the meal, fill the pitcher with water and place it on the table beside the glasses.
formal.zh: 用餐前，把水壶装满水，放在餐桌上的玻璃杯旁。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Fejn hu l-bomblu tal-ilma? Pawlu: Fuq il-mejda. Trid nimliek tazza?
colloquial.en: Anna: Where is the water pitcher? Pawlu: On the table. Would you like me to fill a glass for you?
colloquial.zh: Anna：水壶在哪里？Pawlu：在桌上。要我给你倒一杯吗？

messages.speaker: Anna (家人)
messages.zh: 水壶在哪里？
messages.en: Where is the water pitcher?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (家人)
messages.zh: 在桌上。要我给你倒一杯吗？
messages.en: On the table. Would you like me to fill a glass for you?

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象餐桌中央的 bomblu 正往杯里倒水，用盛水和倒水两个动作记住这个容器名。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An evening greeting; also an exclamation expressing that a situation is hopeless.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 傍晚或晚上见面时的问候语；也可作感叹语，表示事情已经没指望了。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tislima li tingħad filgħaxija; ukoll, esklamazzjoni li tesprimi li sitwazzjoni hija bla tama.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 晚上好；傍晚或晚上见面时的问候语。
表示处境已无可挽回或事情已没指望的感叹语，如“这下完了”。
疯的；发狂的；口语中也可形容人的想法或行为疯狂。

formal.mt: Bonswa lil kulħadd. Nilqgħukom għal din il-laqgħa u nirringrazzjawkom tal-preżenza tagħkom.
formal.en: Good evening, everyone. We welcome you to this meeting and thank you for attending.
formal.zh: 大家晚上好。欢迎各位参加本次会议，感谢大家到场。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Bonswa, Mark! Għadna fil-ħin għall-aħħar xarabank? Mark: Le, għadha kemm telqet. Maja: Bonswa! Issa kif se mmorru d-dar? Mark: Nistgħu nieħdu taxi.
colloquial.en: Maja: Good evening, Mark! Are we still in time for the last bus? Mark: No, it just left. Maja: Well, that's hopeless! How are we going to get home now? Mark: We can take a taxi.
colloquial.zh: Maja：晚上好，Mark！我们还赶得上末班公交吗？Mark：赶不上了，刚开走。Maja：这下完了！现在我们怎么回家？Mark：可以坐出租车。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Bonswa, Mark! Għadna fil-ħin għall-aħħar xarabank?
messages.mt_standard: Bonswa, Mark! Għadna fil-ħin għall-aħħar xarabank?
messages.zh: 晚上好，Mark！我们还赶得上末班公交吗？
messages.en: Good evening, Mark! Are we still in time for the last bus?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 赶不上了，刚开走。
messages.en: No, it just left.

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Bonswa! Issa kif se mmorru d-dar?
messages.mt_standard: Bonswa! Issa kif se mmorru d-dar?
messages.zh: 这下完了！现在我们怎么回家？
messages.en: Well, that's hopeless! How are we going to get home now?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 可以坐出租车。
messages.en: We can take a taxi.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用三幕记 bonswa：晚上见面说问候，错过末班车时叹气，形容疯狂行为时用作形容词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The quality of being good, kind, and caring toward others.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 善良、仁厚并关心他人的品德。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-kwalità ta' min hu tajjeb, qalbu tajba u jieħu ħsieb ħaddieħor.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 善良；仁善的品德。

formal.mt: Il-bontà tagħha tidher fil-mod kif tgħin lil dawk li għandhom bżonn l-għajnuna.
formal.en: Her goodness is evident in the way she helps those who need assistance.
formal.zh: 她帮助有需要者的方式体现了她的善良。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Marija reġgħet ġabitilna l-ikel illum. | Pawlu: Kemm għandha bontà! Dejjem taħseb f'ħaddieħor.
colloquial.en: Lara: Marija brought us food again today. | Pawlu: She has such goodness in her! She always thinks of others.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：玛丽亚今天又给我们送饭了。 | 保罗：她真善良！总是想着别人。

messages.speaker: Lara (邻居)
messages.zh: 玛丽亚今天又给我们送饭了。
messages.en: Marija brought us food again today.

messages.speaker: Pawlu (邻居)
messages.mt_spoken: Kemm għandha bontà! Dejjem taħseb f'ħaddieħor.
messages.mt_standard: Kemm għandha bontà! Dejjem taħseb f'ħaddieħor.
messages.zh: 她真善良！总是想着别人。
messages.en: She has such goodness in her! She always thinks of others.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象邻居主动送来热饭的情景，把 bontà 与关心他人的善良品德联系起来记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A broad area of flat land, either a plain or an elevated plateau.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一片宽广平坦的土地，可指平原，也可指地势较高的高原。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Medda wiesgħa ta' art ċatta, li tista' tkun pjanura jew art ċatta f'għoli.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 平原；高原，指一片平坦的地形。

formal.mt: Il-boqgħa għolja toffri medda ta' art ċatta 'l fuq mill-wied.
formal.en: The elevated plateau provides a stretch of flat land above the valley.
formal.zh: 这片高原在山谷上方形成了一片平坦的土地。

colloquial.mt: Marta: Fejn se nieqfu nistrieħu? | Ġużi: Fuq dik il-boqgħa. L-art hemmhekk hija ċatta u wiesgħa.
colloquial.en: Marta: Where shall we stop to rest? | Ġużi: On that plateau. The ground there is flat and spacious.
colloquial.zh: 玛尔塔：我们在哪里停下来休息？ | 朱齐：就在那片高原上。那里的地面平坦又开阔。

messages.speaker: Marta (徒步同伴)
messages.zh: 我们在哪里停下来休息？
messages.en: Where shall we stop to rest?

messages.speaker: Ġużi (徒步同伴)
messages.mt_spoken: Fuq dik il-boqgħa. L-art hemmhekk hija ċatta u wiesgħa.
messages.mt_standard: Fuq dik il-boqgħa. L-art hemmhekk hija ċatta u wiesgħa.
messages.zh: 就在那片高原上。那里的地面平坦又开阔。
messages.en: On that plateau. The ground there is flat and spacious.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 boqgħa 想成地图上一大片平坦地形：低处可联想平原，抬高后可联想高原。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An exclamation used when someone does not know an answer or cannot decide.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 表示不知道答案、心里没把握或尚未作出决定的感叹语。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kelma ta' esklamazzjoni li tesprimi li wieħed ma jafx it-tweġiba jew għadu ma ddeċidiex.

sense_translations.en_definition: Used to express indecision or uncertainty; dunno
sense_translations.zh_definition: 用于表达犹豫或不确定；相当于口语中的“不知道”“说不准”。

formal.mt: Fid-djalogu miktub, il-karattru jesprimi l-inċertezza tiegħu bil-kliem: 'Boqq, għadni ma ddeċidejtx.'
formal.en: In the written dialogue, the character expresses his uncertainty with the words: 'Dunno, I haven't decided yet.'
formal.zh: 在这段书面对话中，角色用“不知道，我还没决定”这句话表达自己的不确定。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Trid tmur il-baħar jew iċ-ċinema? | Mark: Boqq, għadni ma ddeċidejtx. Int x'tippreferi?
colloquial.en: Nina: Do you want to go to the seaside or the cinema? | Mark: Dunno, I haven't decided yet. What would you prefer?
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：你想去海边还是电影院？ | 马克：不知道，我还没决定。你更想去哪里？

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.zh: 你想去海边还是电影院？
messages.en: Do you want to go to the seaside or the cinema?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Boqq, għadni ma ddeċidejtx. Int x'tippreferi?
messages.mt_standard: Boqq, għadni ma ddeċidejtx. Int x'tippreferi?
messages.zh: 不知道，我还没决定。你更想去哪里？
messages.en: Dunno, I haven't decided yet. What would you prefer?

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象别人让你二选一，你耸肩说 boqq；用这个动作记住“不知道、拿不定主意”的语气。

gloss_zh: 大片田地；沟渠底部或积水洼地；沼泽地

teaching_sense.en_definition: A large field; in another sense, the bottom of a duct or a place where water collects, including marshland.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 可指大片田地；另一义指沟渠底部或积水的地方，包括沼泽地。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Għalqa kbira; f'tifsira oħra, il-qiegħ ta' kanal jew post fejn jinġabar l-ilma, inkluża art mistagħdra.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 大片田地；面积较大的田野。

sense_translations.en_definition: bottom of a duct or any place where water is collected; marshland
sense_translations.zh_definition: 沟渠底部或任何汇集积水的地方；沼泽地。

collocations.en: a large field sown with wheat

formal.mt: Il-bidwi żera' l-qamħ f'boqqiegħa kbira qrib ir-razzett.
formal.en: The farmer sowed wheat in a large field near the farm.
formal.zh: 农夫在农场附近的一大片田地里播种了小麦。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Għaliex hemm daqshekk ilma f'dik il-boqqiegħa? | Toni: Wara x-xita, l-ilma jinġabar hemm. Aħjar ngħaddu minn triq oħra.
colloquial.en: Rita: Why is there so much water in that hollow? | Toni: Water collects there after the rain. We'd better take another route.
colloquial.zh: 丽塔：那片洼地里为什么有这么多水？ | 托尼：下雨后水会积在那里。我们最好换条路走。

messages.speaker: Rita (步行同伴)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex hemm daqshekk ilma f'dik il-boqqiegħa?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex hemm daqshekk ilma f'dik il-boqqiegħa?
messages.zh: 那片洼地里为什么有这么多水？
messages.en: Why is there so much water in that hollow?

messages.speaker: Toni (步行同伴)
messages.mt_spoken: Wara x-xita, l-ilma jinġabar hemm. Aħjar ngħaddu minn triq oħra.
messages.mt_standard: Wara x-xita, l-ilma jinġabar hemm. Aħjar ngħaddu minn triq oħra.
messages.zh: 下雨后水会积在那里。我们最好换条路走。
messages.en: Water collects there after the rain. We'd better take another route.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 boqqiegħa 分别配两张记忆图：一张是大片麦田，一张是雨后积水洼地；按语境选择词义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A waybill or itemized document listing goods in a shipment.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 列明一批运输货物的运单或货运明细单。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Dokument tat-trasport li jelenka l-merkanzija f'kunsinna.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 运单；逐项列明货物的清单或明细单。

formal.mt: Qabel it-tluq, l-impjegat ivverifika li l-borderò kien jelenka l-kaxxi kollha tal-kunsinna.
formal.en: Before departure, the employee checked that the waybill listed all the boxes in the shipment.
formal.zh: 启运前，工作人员核实了运单是否列出了这批货物的全部箱件。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Għandek il-borderò għal dawn il-kaxxi? | Sara: Iva, hawn hu. Hemm miktuba għaxar kaxxi.
colloquial.en: Mark: Do you have the waybill for these boxes? | Sara: Yes, here it is. It lists ten boxes.
colloquial.zh: 马克：你有这些箱子的运单吗？ | 萨拉：有，在这里。上面写着十箱。

messages.speaker: Mark (仓库管理员)
messages.zh: 你有这些箱子的运单吗？
messages.en: Do you have the waybill for these boxes?

messages.speaker: Sara (送货员)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, hawn hu. Hemm miktuba għaxar kaxxi.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, hawn hu. Hemm miktuba għaxar kaxxi.
messages.zh: 有，在这里。上面写着十箱。
messages.en: Yes, here it is. It lists ten boxes.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象发货前拿着 borderò 逐箱核对数量，把这个词与“随货核对的运单”一起记住。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The papyrus plant, Cyperus papyrus; in a separate sense, cloth with a striped design.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 可指纸莎草这种植物；另一个独立词义指带条纹图案的布料。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-pjanta Cyperus papyrus; f'tifsira separata, drapp bl-istrixxi.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 纸莎草，学名 Cyperus papyrus。
条纹布；带条纹图案的布料。

formal.mt: Fit-tikketta botanika, il-bordi huwa identifikat bl-isem xjentifiku Cyperus papyrus.
formal.en: On the botanical label, the papyrus plant is identified by the scientific name Cyperus papyrus.
formal.zh: 植物标签以学名 Cyperus papyrus 标识这种纸莎草。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Qed infittex biċċa bordi għal borża. | Marija: Ara din il-biċċa bl-istrixxi blu u bojod. Togħġbok?
colloquial.en: Anna: I'm looking for a piece of striped cloth for a bag. | Marija: Look at this piece with blue and white stripes. Do you like it?
colloquial.zh: 安娜：我想找一块条纹布做袋子。 | 玛丽亚：看看这块蓝白条纹的。你喜欢吗？

messages.speaker: Anna (顾客)
messages.mt_spoken: Qed infittex biċċa bordi għal borża.
messages.mt_standard: Qed infittex biċċa bordi għal borża.
messages.zh: 我想找一块条纹布做袋子。
messages.en: I'm looking for a piece of striped cloth for a bag.

messages.speaker: Marija (布店店员)
messages.mt_spoken: Ara din il-biċċa bl-istrixxi blu u bojod. Togħġbok?
messages.mt_standard: Ara din il-biċċa bl-istrixxi blu u bojod. Togħġbok?
messages.zh: 看看这块蓝白条纹的。你喜欢吗？
messages.en: Look at this piece with blue and white stripes. Do you like it?

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 bordi 分放进两个记忆抽屉：植物园里是纸莎草，布店里是条纹布；用场景区分两个词义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A family name used as a person's surname.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用作个人姓氏的家族名称，可音译为“博尔格”。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kunjom li jintuża bħala isem tal-familja ta' persuna.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 姓氏，音译为“博尔格”。

formal.mt: Is-Sur Borg ippreżenta r-rapport waqt il-laqgħa.
formal.en: Mr Borg presented the report during the meeting.
formal.zh: 博尔格先生在会议期间提交并介绍了报告。

colloquial.mt: Lara: X'kunjom għandek? | David: Borg. Jisimni David Borg.
colloquial.en: Lara: What's your surname? | David: Borg. My name is David Borg.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：你姓什么？ | 戴维：博尔格。我叫戴维·博尔格。

messages.speaker: Lara (新同学)
messages.zh: 你姓什么？
messages.en: What's your surname?

messages.speaker: David (新同学)
messages.zh: 博尔格。我叫戴维·博尔格。
messages.en: Borg. My name is David Borg.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 Borg 写在虚构人物 David Borg 的姓氏栏里，连同大写字母一起记，看到它就想到姓氏。

gloss_zh: 博尔姆拉的；博尔姆拉人

teaching_sense.en_definition: Of, from, or connected with Bormla.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 属于、来自博尔姆拉或与博尔姆拉有关的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li hu ta' Bormla, ġej minn Bormla jew għandu x'jaqsam ma' Bormla.

sense_translations.en_definition: of, from or relating to Bormla
sense_translations.zh_definition: 博尔姆拉的；来自博尔姆拉或与该地有关的。
博尔姆拉本地人或居民。

collocations.zh: 来自博尔姆拉的艺术家

collocations.en: a person from Bormla who lives here
collocations.zh: 住在这里的博尔姆拉人

formal.mt: Artist Bormliż ippreżenta x-xogħol tiegħu fil-wirja.
formal.en: An artist from Bormla presented his work at the exhibition.
formal.zh: 一位来自博尔姆拉的艺术家在展览上展示了自己的作品。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Int minn Bormla? | Mark: Iva, jien Bormliż. Għadni ngħix hemm.
colloquial.en: Nina: Are you from Bormla? | Mark: Yes, I'm a native of Bormla. I still live there.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：你来自博尔姆拉吗？ | 马克：是的，我是博尔姆拉人。我现在还住在那里。

messages.speaker: Nina (新朋友)
messages.zh: 你来自博尔姆拉吗？
messages.en: Are you from Bormla?

messages.speaker: Mark (博尔姆拉居民)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, jien Bormliż. Għadni ngħix hemm.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, jien Bormliż. Għadni ngħix hemm.
messages.zh: 是的，我是博尔姆拉人。我现在还住在那里。
messages.en: Yes, I'm a native of Bormla. I still live there.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把地名 Bormla 与人物标签 Bormliż 配对记忆：修饰 artist 时表示当地的，指人时表示当地人。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The chemical element boron.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 化学元素硼。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-element kimiku msejjaħ boron.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 硼，一种化学元素。

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi l-proprjetajiet tal-boron u ta' xi komposti tiegħu.
formal.en: The report describes the properties of boron and some of its compounds.
formal.zh: 报告介绍了硼及其部分化合物的性质。

colloquial.mt: Lara: X'inhu l-boron? Mark: Huwa element kimiku; illum se nitgħallmu dwaru.
colloquial.en: Lara: What is boron? Mark: It is a chemical element; we are going to learn about it today.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：硼是什么？马克：它是一种化学元素；我们今天要学习它。

messages.speaker: Lara (学生)
messages.zh: 硼是什么？
messages.en: What is boron?

messages.speaker: Mark (老师)
messages.mt_spoken: Huwa element kimiku; illum se nitgħallmu dwaru.
messages.mt_standard: Huwa element kimiku; illum se nitgħallmu dwaru.
messages.zh: 它是一种化学元素；我们今天要学习它。
messages.en: It is a chemical element; we are going to learn about it today.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 boron 放进化学元素词卡，正面写单词，背面写“硼”，再用“硼化合物”巩固记忆。

gloss_zh: 无法伤害的；无懈可击的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Unable to be hurt, damaged, or successfully attacked.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 不会受到伤害或损坏的；无法被攻破的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li ma jistax jiġi mweġġa', imħassar jew megħlub b'attakk.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 无法伤害的；不可攻破的；无懈可击的。

formal.mt: Fil-ħrafa, il-ġgant huwa borqmi u l-ebda arma ma tista' tweġġgħu.
formal.en: In the tale, the giant is invulnerable and no weapon can hurt him.
formal.zh: 在这个传说中，巨人刀枪不入，没有任何武器能够伤害他。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Dan l-eroj huwa borqmi? Pawlu: Iva, f'din l-istorja ħadd ma jista' jweġġgħu.
colloquial.en: Maja: Is this hero invulnerable? Pawlu: Yes, in this story nobody can hurt him.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这个英雄刀枪不入吗？保罗：是的，在这个故事里谁也伤不了他。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 这个英雄刀枪不入吗？
messages.en: Is this hero invulnerable?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, f'din l-istorja ħadd ma jista' jweġġgħu.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, f'din l-istorja ħadd ma jista' jweġġgħu.
messages.zh: 是的，在这个故事里谁也伤不了他。
messages.en: Yes, in this story nobody can hurt him.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象故事中的英雄毫发无伤，把 borqmi 和“刀枪不入”的画面连在一起记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Covered with trees or woodland, or woody in nature.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 覆盖着树木或树林的；也可指具有木质性质的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li fih ħafna siġar jew imsaġar, jew li għandu natura ta' njam.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 木质的；多树木的，覆盖着树林的。

formal.mt: Il-mogħdija tgħaddi minn wied boskuż qabel tasal ħdejn ix-xmara.
formal.en: The path passes through a wooded valley before reaching the river.
formal.zh: 这条小径穿过一处林木茂盛的山谷，然后到达河边。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Dan il-wied boskuż ħafna! Toni: Iva, ejja nimxu fid-dell tas-siġar.
colloquial.en: Sara: This valley is very wooded! Toni: Yes, let's walk in the shade of the trees.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：这山谷里的树真多！托尼：是啊，我们沿着树荫走吧。

messages.speaker: Sara (徒步同伴)
messages.zh: 这山谷里的树真多！
messages.en: This valley is very wooded!

messages.speaker: Toni (徒步同伴)
messages.zh: 是啊，我们沿着树荫走吧。
messages.en: Yes, let's walk in the shade of the trees.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 boskuż 配一张树木覆盖山谷的图片，先记“多林的”，再联系“木质的”这一释义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who is in charge of a workplace or directs other people's work.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 负责某个工作场所或管理他人工作的人；老板或上司。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li tmexxi post tax-xogħol jew li tagħti d-direzzjoni lill-ħaddiema.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 老板；上司；工作中的负责人。

formal.mt: Il-boss talab lill-ħaddiema jlestu r-rapport sa nhar il-Ġimgħa.
formal.en: The boss asked the employees to finish the report by Friday.
formal.zh: 上司要求员工在星期五之前完成报告。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Fejn hu l-boss? Mark: Qiegħed fl-uffiċċju; tista' tkellmu issa.
colloquial.en: Nina: Where is the boss? Mark: He is in the office; you can speak to him now.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：老板在哪里？马克：他在办公室里，你现在可以找他谈。

messages.speaker: Nina (员工)
messages.zh: 老板在哪里？
messages.en: Where is the boss?

messages.speaker: Mark (同事)
messages.zh: 他在办公室里，你现在可以找他谈。
messages.en: He is in the office; you can speak to him now.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 boss 放进办公室场景，用 il-boss tiegħi 记“我的上司”，再练习向老板汇报的情境。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A country in Southern Africa whose official name is the Republic of Botswana.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 非洲南部的国家，正式名称为博茨瓦纳共和国。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Pajjiż fin-Nofsinhar tal-Afrika bl-isem uffiċjali Repubblika tal-Botswana.

sense_translations.en_definition: Botswana (a country in Southern Africa; official name: Repubblika tal-Botswana)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 博茨瓦纳，位于非洲南部的国家；正式名称为博茨瓦纳共和国。

formal.mt: Il-Botswana hija pajjiż fin-Nofsinhar tal-Afrika, u l-isem uffiċjali tagħha huwa Repubblika tal-Botswana.
formal.en: Botswana is a country in Southern Africa, and its official name is the Republic of Botswana.
formal.zh: 博茨瓦纳是非洲南部的一个国家，正式名称为博茨瓦纳共和国。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Fejn tinsab il-Botswana? David: Fin-Nofsinhar tal-Afrika; ejja nfittxuha fuq il-mappa.
colloquial.en: Maja: Where is Botswana? David: In Southern Africa; let's find it on the map.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：博茨瓦纳在哪里？戴维：在非洲南部，我们在地图上找找吧。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.zh: 博茨瓦纳在哪里？
messages.en: Where is Botswana?

messages.speaker: David (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Fin-Nofsinhar tal-Afrika; ejja nfittxuha fuq il-mappa.
messages.mt_standard: Fin-Nofsinhar tal-Afrika; ejja nfittxuha fuq il-mappa.
messages.zh: 在非洲南部，我们在地图上找找吧。
messages.en: In Southern Africa; let's find it on the map.

cognitive_memory_aid: 在非洲南部的地图位置旁写 Botswana 和“博茨瓦纳”，把国家名与地理位置一起记住。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A cellar or storage room where wine is kept.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用来存放葡萄酒的地窖或储藏室。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kantina jew kamra fejn jinżamm l-inbid.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 酒窖；储藏葡萄酒的房间。

formal.mt: Il-fliexken tal-inbid jinżammu fil-bottiljerija sakemm ikun hemm bżonnhom.
formal.en: The bottles of wine are kept in the wine cellar until they are needed.
formal.zh: 这些瓶装葡萄酒存放在酒窖里，供需要时取用。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Fejn poġġejt il-fliexken tal-inbid? Pawlu: Fil-bottiljerija, fuq l-ixkaffa ħdejn il-bieb.
colloquial.en: Anna: Where did you put the bottles of wine? Pawlu: In the wine cellar, on the shelf near the door.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：你把那几瓶葡萄酒放在哪里了？保罗：放在酒窖里，靠近门的架子上。

messages.speaker: Anna (餐厅员工)
messages.zh: 你把那几瓶葡萄酒放在哪里了？
messages.en: Where did you put the bottles of wine?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同事)
messages.zh: 放在酒窖里，靠近门的架子上。
messages.en: In the wine cellar, on the shelf near the door.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“地点卡”记 bottiljerija：画一间摆满葡萄酒的储藏室，并标上“酒窖”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who looks after a wine cellar and the wine stored in it.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 负责照管酒窖及其中所存葡萄酒的工作人员。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li tieħu ħsieb il-kantina tal-inbid u l-inbid maħżun fiha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 酒窖管理员；负责照管酒窖和所存酒品的人。

collocations.zh: 经验丰富的酒窖管理员

formal.mt: Il-bottiljier jiċċekkja l-fliexken u jżomm rekord tal-inbid maħżun fil-kantina.
formal.en: The cellarman checks the bottles and keeps a record of the wine stored in the cellar.
formal.zh: 酒窖管理员检查酒瓶，并记录酒窖中储存的葡萄酒。

colloquial.en: Rita: Who should I give this wine list to? Mark: Give it to the cellarman; he looks after the wine in the cellar.
colloquial.zh: 丽塔：这份葡萄酒清单该交给谁？马克：交给酒窖管理员吧，他负责照管酒窖里的葡萄酒。

messages.speaker: Rita (新员工)
messages.mt_spoken: Lil min nagħti din il-lista tal-inbid?
messages.mt_standard: Lil min nagħti din il-lista tal-inbid?
messages.zh: 这份葡萄酒清单该交给谁？
messages.en: Who should I give this wine list to?

messages.speaker: Mark (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Agħtiha lill-bottiljier; hu jieħu ħsieb l-inbid fil-kantina.
messages.mt_standard: Agħtiha lill-bottiljier; hu jieħu ħsieb l-inbid fil-kantina.
messages.zh: 交给酒窖管理员吧，他负责照管酒窖里的葡萄酒。
messages.en: Give it to the cellarman; he looks after the wine in the cellar.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“人物卡”记 bottiljier：想象一位拿着酒品清单、检查酒瓶的酒窖管理员。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A large bottle used for holding or storing wine, also called a gardevin.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用于盛放或储存葡萄酒的大瓶。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Flixkun kbir li jintuża biex jinżamm jew jinħażen l-inbid.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 储酒大瓶；用于盛放葡萄酒的大型酒瓶。

collocations.zh: 一个储存葡萄酒的大瓶

collocations.en: to fill a large wine bottle

formal.mt: L-inbid tqiegħed f'bottiljun nadif, u l-flixkun ingħalaq sew.
formal.en: The wine was placed in a clean large wine bottle, and the bottle was closed securely.
formal.zh: 葡萄酒被装入一个干净的储酒大瓶，随后瓶口被封好。

colloquial.mt: Lina: Fejn inpoġġi dan il-bottiljun? Toni: Poġġih fuq il-mejda, jekk jogħġbok; għad irridu nimlewh bl-inbid.
colloquial.en: Lina: Where should I put this large wine bottle? Toni: Put it on the table, please; we still need to fill it with wine.
colloquial.zh: 莉娜：这个储酒大瓶该放在哪里？托尼：请放在桌上，我们还要往里面装葡萄酒。

messages.speaker: Lina (帮忙的朋友)
messages.zh: 这个储酒大瓶该放在哪里？
messages.en: Where should I put this large wine bottle?

messages.speaker: Toni (主人)
messages.mt_spoken: Poġġih fuq il-mejda, jekk jogħġbok; għad irridu nimlewh bl-inbid.
messages.mt_standard: Poġġih fuq il-mejda, jekk jogħġbok; għad irridu nimlewh bl-inbid.
messages.zh: 请放在桌上，我们还要往里面装葡萄酒。
messages.en: Put it on the table, please; we still need to fill it with wine.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“容器卡”记 bottiljun：画一个盛葡萄酒的大瓶，再用“装满大瓶”的动作加深记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A weather vane that turns to indicate the direction of the wind.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 随风转动、用来指示风向的装置。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Strument li jdur mar-riħ u juri d-direzzjoni tiegħu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 风向标；与 dewwiema 同义。

collocations.en: a weather vane on the roof
the direction indicated by the weather vane

formal.mt: L-istudenti osservaw il-boxxla tar-riħ u kitbu d-direzzjoni tar-riħ.
formal.en: The students observed the weather vane and wrote down the wind direction.
formal.zh: 学生们观察风向标，并记下了风向。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'inhu dak fuq il-bejt? Pawlu: Dik boxxla tar-riħ. Turina d-direzzjoni tar-riħ.
colloquial.en: Maja: What's that on the roof? Pawlu: That's a weather vane. It shows us the wind direction.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：屋顶上那个是什么？保罗：那是风向标，能告诉我们风向。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 屋顶上那个是什么？
messages.en: What's that on the roof?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Dik boxxla tar-riħ. Turina d-direzzjoni tar-riħ.
messages.mt_standard: Dik boxxla tar-riħ. Turina d-direzzjoni tar-riħ.
messages.zh: 那是风向标，能告诉我们风向。
messages.en: That's a weather vane. It shows us the wind direction.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象屋顶上的箭头随风转动，把整个词组与“看箭头辨风向”的画面一起记住。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Bosnia: either the geographic region within Bosnia and Herzegovina or a shortened name for the country.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 波斯尼亚：可指波斯尼亚和黑塞哥维那境内的波斯尼亚地区，也可作为该国的简称。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Isem li jista' jirreferi għar-reġjun tal-Bożnija jew, fil-qosor, għall-pajjiż tal-Bożnija u Ħerzegovina.

sense_translations.en_definition: Bosnia (a geographic region of Bosnia and Herzegovina, consisting of the northern three fourths of the country)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 波斯尼亚地区，位于波斯尼亚和黑塞哥维那境内，占该国北部约四分之三的面积。

sense_translations.en_definition: Bosnia (a country in southeastern Europe; in full, Il-Bożnija u Ħerzegovina)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 波斯尼亚，东南欧国家波斯尼亚和黑塞哥维那的简称；马耳他语全称为 Il-Bożnija u Ħerzegovina。

formal.mt: F'dan it-test, il-Bożnija tirreferi għar-reġjun ġeografiku, filwaqt li l-isem sħiħ tal-pajjiż huwa l-Bożnija u Ħerzegovina.
formal.en: In this text, Bosnia refers to the geographic region, while the country's full name is Bosnia and Herzegovina.
formal.zh: 在本文中，“波斯尼亚”指地理区域，而该国的全称是波斯尼亚和黑塞哥维那。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Fejn sejjer għall-vaganza? Mark: Sejjer il-Bożnija. Lara: Imbagħad urini r-ritratti!
colloquial.en: Lara: Where are you going on holiday? Mark: I'm going to Bosnia. Lara: Show me the photos afterwards!
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：你要去哪里度假？马克：我要去波斯尼亚。拉拉：回来给我看看照片！

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 你要去哪里度假？
messages.en: Where are you going on holiday?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 我要去波斯尼亚。
messages.en: I'm going to Bosnia.

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 回来给我看看照片！
messages.en: Show me the photos afterwards!

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两张地图卡记忆 Bożnija：一张标地区，一张标国家简称；读到时先判断语境。

gloss_zh: 波斯尼亚和黑塞哥维那

teaching_sense.en_definition: Bosnia and Herzegovina, a country on the Balkan Peninsula in southeastern Europe.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 波斯尼亚和黑塞哥维那，位于欧洲东南部巴尔干半岛的国家，简称波黑。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Pajjiż fix-Xlokk tal-Ewropa, fil-Peniżola Balkani.

sense_translations.en_definition: Bosnia and Herzegovina (a country on the Balkan Peninsula in Southeastern Europe)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 波斯尼亚和黑塞哥维那，位于欧洲东南部巴尔干半岛的国家。

collocations.en: a map of Bosnia and Herzegovina
collocations.zh: 波斯尼亚和黑塞哥维那地图

collocations.en: a visit to Bosnia and Herzegovina
collocations.zh: 对波斯尼亚和黑塞哥维那的访问

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi żjara fil-Bożnija-Ħerzegovina u jinkludi mappa tal-pajjiż.
formal.en: The report describes a visit to Bosnia and Herzegovina and includes a map of the country.
formal.zh: 报告介绍了对波斯尼亚和黑塞哥维那的一次访问，并附有该国地图。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Għandek mappa tal-Bożnija-Ħerzegovina? David: Iva, qiegħda fil-borża. Trid taraha?
colloquial.en: Nina: Do you have a map of Bosnia and Herzegovina? David: Yes, it's in the bag. Would you like to see it?
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：你有波斯尼亚和黑塞哥维那的地图吗？戴维：有，在包里。你想看看吗？

messages.speaker: Nina (旅伴)
messages.zh: 你有波斯尼亚和黑塞哥维那的地图吗？
messages.en: Do you have a map of Bosnia and Herzegovina?

messages.speaker: David (旅伴)
messages.zh: 有，在包里。你想看看吗？
messages.en: Yes, it's in the bag. Would you like to see it?

cognitive_memory_aid: 把连字符两侧分别对应“波斯尼亚”和“黑塞哥维那”，再把整个名称作为一个国家名朗读。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Bosnia: a geographic region of Bosnia and Herzegovina, or a shortened name for the country.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 波斯尼亚：既可指波斯尼亚和黑塞哥维那境内的地理区域，也可简称整个国家。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Isem għar-reġjun tal-Bożnja, li jintuża wkoll fil-qosor għall-pajjiż tal-Bożnja u Ħerzegovina.

sense_translations.en_definition: Bosnia (a geographic region of Bosnia and Herzegovina, consisting of the northern three fourths of the country)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 波斯尼亚地区，构成波斯尼亚和黑塞哥维那北部约四分之三面积的地理区域。

sense_translations.en_definition: Bosnia (a country in southeastern Europe; in full, Il-Bożnja u Ħerzegovina)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 波斯尼亚，东南欧国家波斯尼亚和黑塞哥维那的简称；马耳他语全称为 Il-Bożnja u Ħerzegovina。

collocations.zh: 在波斯尼亚拍摄的照片

formal.mt: Il-mappa turi r-reġjun tal-Bożnja fit-Tramuntana tal-pajjiż.
formal.en: The map shows the region of Bosnia in the northern part of the country.
formal.zh: 地图标出了位于该国北部的波斯尼亚地区。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Dawn ir-ritratti minn fejn huma? Toni: Mill-Bożnja. Ħadthom waqt il-vaganza.
colloquial.en: Sara: Where are these photos from? Toni: From Bosnia. I took them on holiday.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：这些照片是在哪里拍的？托尼：在波斯尼亚。我度假时拍的。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 这些照片是在哪里拍的？
messages.en: Where are these photos from?

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.zh: 在波斯尼亚。我度假时拍的。
messages.en: From Bosnia. I took them on holiday.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 Bożnja 与“波斯尼亚”的地图标签配对记忆，并练习区分“地区”和“国家简称”两个用法。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Spinach, a vegetable whose green leaves are eaten.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 菠菜，一种以绿色叶片供食用的蔬菜。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ħaxixa b'weraq aħdar li jittiekel.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 菠菜。

formal.mt: Aħsel il-bqajla sew qabel iżżidha mas-soppa.
formal.en: Wash the spinach thoroughly before adding it to the soup.
formal.zh: 把菠菜加入汤中之前，先将它彻底洗净。

colloquial.mt: Marija: X'se nsajru llejla? Ġanni: Soppa tal-bqajla. Għandna bqajla friska fil-friġġ.
colloquial.en: Marija: What shall we cook tonight? Ġanni: Spinach soup. We have fresh spinach in the fridge.
colloquial.zh: 玛丽亚：今晚我们做什么？詹尼：菠菜汤。冰箱里有新鲜菠菜。

messages.speaker: Marija (室友)
messages.zh: 今晚我们做什么？
messages.en: What shall we cook tonight?

messages.speaker: Ġanni (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Soppa tal-bqajla. Għandna bqajla friska fil-friġġ.
messages.mt_standard: Soppa tal-bqajla. Għandna bqajla friska fil-friġġ.
messages.zh: 菠菜汤。冰箱里有新鲜菠菜。
messages.en: Spinach soup. We have fresh spinach in the fridge.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象洗净一篮绿色菠菜、放进汤锅的过程，边看画面边读 bqajla，建立食材联想。

gloss_zh: 小母牛（baqra 的指小形式）

teaching_sense.en_definition: A small cow; the diminutive form of baqra.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 体型较小的母牛；是 baqra 的指小形式，重点在“小”，不必专指幼牛。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Baqra żgħira; forma diminuttiva ta' baqra.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 小母牛；baqra（母牛）的指小形式。

collocations.en: a small cow on the farm

formal.mt: Il-bidwi ta l-ilma lill-bqajra u mbagħad naddaf il-post fejn kienet.
formal.en: The farmer gave the small cow water and then cleaned the place where it was.
formal.zh: 农夫给小母牛喂了水，随后清理了它所在的地方。

colloquial.mt: Lina: Fejn hi l-bqajra? Pawlu: Qiegħda ħdejn iċ-ċint. Ejja narawha.
colloquial.en: Lina: Where's the small cow? Pawlu: It's beside the fence. Let's go and see it.
colloquial.zh: 莉娜：那头小母牛在哪里？保罗：在围栏旁边。我们去看看它吧。

messages.speaker: Lina (农场访客)
messages.zh: 那头小母牛在哪里？
messages.en: Where's the small cow?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (农场主)
messages.zh: 在围栏旁边。我们去看看它吧。
messages.en: It's beside the fence. Let's go and see it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 baqra 的母牛图片缩小，旁边写上 bqajra；用“一头小母牛”记住这里的指小关系。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The process of milk curdling or forming curds.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 牛奶发生凝结、形成凝块的过程。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-proċess li fih il-ħalib jagħqad.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 牛奶的凝结、结块过程。

formal.mt: Waqt l-esperiment, l-istudenti osservaw il-bqit tal-ħalib u rreġistraw il-bidliet.
formal.en: During the experiment, the students observed the curdling of milk and recorded the changes.
formal.zh: 实验中，学生们观察了牛奶的凝结过程，并记录了变化。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Għaliex qed jifforma ċ-ċapep fil-ħalib? Marija: Dak hu l-bqit tal-ħalib; qed jagħqad.
colloquial.en: Nina: Why are lumps forming in the milk? Marija: That's the milk curdling; it's forming curds.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：牛奶里为什么出现了凝块？玛丽亚：那是牛奶在凝结，正在形成凝乳。

messages.speaker: Nina (女儿)
messages.zh: 牛奶里为什么出现了凝块？
messages.en: Why are lumps forming in the milk?

messages.speaker: Marija (母亲)
messages.mt_spoken: Dak hu l-bqit tal-ħalib; qed jagħqad.
messages.mt_standard: Dak hu l-bqit tal-ħalib; qed jagħqad.
messages.zh: 那是牛奶在凝结，正在形成凝乳。
messages.en: That's the milk curdling; it's forming curds.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一杯牛奶逐渐出现凝块，把 bqit 贴在变化过程上，记住它表示“凝结这一过程”。

gloss_zh: 一小堆（borġ 的指小形式）

teaching_sense.en_definition: A small heap or pile; the diminutive form of borġ.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 少量东西堆成的一小堆；是 borġ 的指小形式。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Borġ żgħir ta' xi ħaġa; forma diminuttiva ta' borġ.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 一小堆；borġ（堆）的指小形式。

formal.mt: Ħdejn id-daħla kien hemm brajjeġ ta' ġebel li kellu jitneħħa qabel jibda x-xogħol.
formal.en: Beside the entrance there was a small heap of stones that had to be removed before work began.
formal.zh: 入口旁有一小堆石头，需要在开工之前清走。

colloquial.mt: Toni: X'hemm ħdejn il-bieb? Lara: Brajjeġ ta' ramel. Se nneħħih issa.
colloquial.en: Toni: What's beside the door? Lara: A small heap of sand. I'll clear it away now.
colloquial.zh: 托尼：门边有什么？拉拉：一小堆沙子。我现在就把它清走。

messages.speaker: Toni (室友)
messages.zh: 门边有什么？
messages.en: What's beside the door?

messages.speaker: Lara (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Brajjeġ ta' ramel. Se nneħħih issa.
messages.mt_standard: Brajjeġ ta' ramel. Se nneħħih issa.
messages.zh: 一小堆沙子。我现在就把它清走。
messages.en: A small heap of sand. I'll clear it away now.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 borġ 的大沙堆画成小沙堆，再标上 brajjeġ，用画面缩小来记住“一小堆”的意思。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A duck species called the common pochard, with the scientific name Aythya ferina.

teaching_sense.mt_definition: Speċi ta' papra magħrufa bl-isem xjentifiku Aythya ferina.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 红头潜鸭（学名：Aythya ferina）。

collocations.en: an observation of a common pochard
collocations.zh: 对一只红头潜鸭的观察

collocations.en: a photograph of a common pochard

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jinkludi ritratt ta' brajmla u jagħti l-isem xjentifiku tagħha: Aythya ferina.
formal.en: The report includes a photograph of a common pochard and gives its scientific name: Aythya ferina.
formal.zh: 报告附有一张红头潜鸭的照片，并列出了它的学名：Aythya ferina。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'jisimha din il-papra fir-ritratt? Mark: Din hija brajmla. Maja: Ħa nikteb l-isem ħdejn ir-ritratt.
colloquial.en: Maja: What is this duck in the photograph called? Mark: It's a common pochard. Maja: Let me write the name next to the photograph.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：照片里的这只鸭叫什么？马克：这是红头潜鸭。玛雅：我把名字写在照片旁边吧。

messages.speaker: Maja (观鸟初学者)
messages.zh: 照片里的这只鸭叫什么？
messages.en: What is this duck in the photograph called?

messages.speaker: Mark (观鸟伙伴)
messages.zh: 这是红头潜鸭。
messages.en: It's a common pochard.

messages.speaker: Maja (观鸟初学者)
messages.zh: 我把名字写在照片旁边吧。
messages.en: Let me write the name next to the photograph.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 brajmla、红头潜鸭和 Aythya ferina 写在同一张词卡上；看到不带后续修饰语的这个词，就练习回想这一组对应名称。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A duck species called the red-crested pochard, with the scientific name Netta rufina.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一种鸭类，中文名为赤嘴潜鸭，学名为 Netta rufina。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Speċi ta' papra magħrufa bl-isem xjentifiku Netta rufina.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 赤嘴潜鸭（学名：Netta rufina）。

collocations.en: an observation of a red-crested pochard
collocations.zh: 对一只赤嘴潜鸭的观察

collocations.en: a drawing of a red-crested pochard

formal.zh: 在介绍赤嘴潜鸭的部分，书中列出了学名 Netta rufina，并展示了该物种的图画。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Liema isem nikteb taħt din it-tpinġija? Toni: Ikteb brajmla prima. Lara: Tajjeb, u ħdejh nikteb Netta rufina.
colloquial.en: Lara: What name should I write under this drawing? Toni: Write brajmla prima, meaning red-crested pochard. Lara: All right, and I'll write Netta rufina next to it.
colloquial.zh: 劳拉：这幅图下面该写什么名字？托尼：写 brajmla prima，也就是赤嘴潜鸭。劳拉：好，我再在旁边写上 Netta rufina。

messages.speaker: Lara (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Liema isem nikteb taħt din it-tpinġija?
messages.mt_standard: Liema isem nikteb taħt din it-tpinġija?
messages.zh: 这幅图下面该写什么名字？
messages.en: What name should I write under this drawing?

messages.speaker: Toni (学习伙伴)
messages.zh: 写 brajmla prima，也就是赤嘴潜鸭。
messages.en: Write brajmla prima, meaning red-crested pochard.

messages.speaker: Lara (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Tajjeb, u ħdejh nikteb Netta rufina.
messages.mt_standard: Tajjeb, u ħdejh nikteb Netta rufina.
messages.zh: 好，我再在旁边写上 Netta rufina。
messages.en: All right, and I'll write Netta rufina next to it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 brajmla prima 作为完整鸟名记忆，配上“赤嘴潜鸭”和 Netta rufina；复习时遮住其中一栏，用另外两栏提示回想，不必猜测 prima 的命名来历。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A duck species called the white-headed duck, with the scientific name Oxyura leucocephala.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一种鸭类，中文名为白头硬尾鸭，学名为 Oxyura leucocephala。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Speċi ta' papra magħrufa bl-isem xjentifiku Oxyura leucocephala.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 白头硬尾鸭（学名：Oxyura leucocephala）。

collocations.en: a photograph of a white-headed duck
collocations.zh: 一张白头硬尾鸭的照片

collocations.en: a description of the white-headed duck

formal.mt: Il-folja ta' tagħrif tuża l-isem brajmla rasha bajda għall-ispeċi Oxyura leucocephala.
formal.en: The information sheet uses the name brajmla rasha bajda for the species Oxyura leucocephala.
formal.zh: 资料页用 brajmla rasha bajda 这一名称指称 Oxyura leucocephala，即白头硬尾鸭。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Tista' taqrali l-isem taħt ir-ritratt? David: Brajmla rasha bajda. Nina: Grazzi, issa nista' nfittixha fil-gwida.
colloquial.en: Nina: Can you read me the name under the photograph? David: White-headed duck. Nina: Thanks, now I can look it up in the guide.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：你能把照片下面的名字读给我听吗？戴维：白头硬尾鸭。妮娜：谢谢，现在我可以在指南里查找它了。

messages.speaker: Nina (参观者)
messages.zh: 你能把照片下面的名字读给我听吗？
messages.en: Can you read me the name under the photograph?

messages.speaker: David (同行朋友)
messages.zh: 白头硬尾鸭。
messages.en: White-headed duck.

messages.speaker: Nina (参观者)
messages.zh: 谢谢，现在我可以在指南里查找它了。
messages.en: Thanks, now I can look it up in the guide.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 rasha bajda 理解为“它的头是白色的”，借这个短语联想到中文鸟名里的“白头”，再把完整名称“白头硬尾鸭”一起记牢；这只是名称记忆提示。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A duck species called the greater scaup, with the scientific name Aythya marila.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一种鸭类，中文名为斑背潜鸭，学名为 Aythya marila。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Speċi ta' papra magħrufa bl-isem xjentifiku Aythya marila.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 斑背潜鸭（学名：Aythya marila）。

collocations.en: an observation of a greater scaup
collocations.zh: 对一只斑背潜鸭的观察

collocations.en: a photograph of a greater scaup

formal.mt: L-istudent kiteb brajmla rasha sewda taħt ir-ritratt u żied l-isem xjentifiku Aythya marila.
formal.en: The student wrote brajmla rasha sewda under the photograph and added the scientific name Aythya marila.
formal.zh: 学生在照片下写了 brajmla rasha sewda，即斑背潜鸭，并补上了学名 Aythya marila。

colloquial.mt: Marija: X'jisimha din fil-gwida? Ġużi: Brajmla rasha sewda. Marija: Se nikteb l-isem kollu biex ma nħalltux ma' isem ieħor.
colloquial.en: Marija: What is this one called in the guide? Ġużi: Greater scaup. Marija: I'll write the whole name so I don't confuse it with another name.
colloquial.zh: 玛丽娅：指南里把这只鸟叫什么？朱齐：斑背潜鸭。玛丽娅：我要写下完整名称，免得和别的名字混淆。

messages.speaker: Marija (观鸟初学者)
messages.zh: 指南里把这只鸟叫什么？
messages.en: What is this one called in the guide?

messages.speaker: Ġużi (观鸟伙伴)
messages.zh: 斑背潜鸭。
messages.en: Greater scaup.

messages.speaker: Marija (观鸟初学者)
messages.mt_spoken: Se nikteb l-isem kollu biex ma nħalltux ma' isem ieħor.
messages.mt_standard: Se nikteb l-isem kollu biex ma nħalltux ma' isem ieħor.
messages.zh: 我要写下完整名称，免得和别的名字混淆。
messages.en: I'll write the whole name so I don't confuse it with another name.

cognitive_memory_aid: rasha sewda 可作“它的头是黑色的”这一文字提示，整组名称对应“斑背潜鸭”；把 rasha 圈出来，提醒自己不要和较短的 brajmla sewda 混记。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A duck species called the common scoter, with the scientific name Melanitta nigra.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一种鸭类，中文名为黑海番鸭，学名为 Melanitta nigra。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Speċi ta' papra magħrufa bl-isem xjentifiku Melanitta nigra.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 黑海番鸭（学名：Melanitta nigra）。

collocations.en: a photograph of a common scoter

formal.mt: Fil-katalgu, ir-ritratt tal-brajmla sewda jidher ħdejn l-isem xjentifiku Melanitta nigra.
formal.en: In the catalogue, the photograph of the common scoter appears next to the scientific name Melanitta nigra.
formal.zh: 图录中，黑海番鸭的照片旁列有学名 Melanitta nigra。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Din brajmla sewda jew brajmla rasha sewda? Karl: Fuq din il-karta hemm miktub brajmla sewda, Melanitta nigra. Anna: Sewwa, se nżomm iż-żewġ ismijiet fuq karti separati.
colloquial.en: Anna: Is this a common scoter or a greater scaup? Karl: This card says common scoter, Melanitta nigra. Anna: Right, I'll keep the two names on separate cards.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：这是黑海番鸭还是斑背潜鸭？卡尔：这张卡上写的是黑海番鸭，Melanitta nigra。安娜：明白，我会把这两个名字分别写在不同的卡上。

messages.speaker: Anna (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Din brajmla sewda jew brajmla rasha sewda?
messages.mt_standard: Din brajmla sewda jew brajmla rasha sewda?
messages.zh: 这是黑海番鸭还是斑背潜鸭？
messages.en: Is this a common scoter or a greater scaup?

messages.speaker: Karl (学习伙伴)
messages.mt_spoken: Fuq din il-karta hemm miktub brajmla sewda, Melanitta nigra.
messages.mt_standard: Fuq din il-karta hemm miktub brajmla sewda, Melanitta nigra.
messages.zh: 这张卡上写的是黑海番鸭，Melanitta nigra。
messages.en: This card says common scoter, Melanitta nigra.

messages.speaker: Anna (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Sewwa, se nżomm iż-żewġ ismijiet fuq karti separati.
messages.mt_standard: Sewwa, se nżomm iż-żewġ ismijiet fuq karti separati.
messages.zh: 明白，我会把这两个名字分别写在不同的卡上。
messages.en: Right, I'll keep the two names on separate cards.

cognitive_memory_aid: sewda 的“黑色的”可帮助联想中文名开头的“黑”；把 brajmla sewda 和“黑海番鸭”整组配对，并记住这个词条中间没有 rasha。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A duck species called the common goldeneye, with the scientific name Bucephala clangula.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一种鸭类，中文名为鹊鸭，学名为 Bucephala clangula。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Speċi ta' papra magħrufa bl-isem xjentifiku Bucephala clangula.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 鹊鸭（学名：Bucephala clangula）。

collocations.en: an observation of a common goldeneye
a description of the common goldeneye

formal.mt: Il-paġna dwar il-brajmla tal-għajn tinkludi deskrizzjoni qasira u l-isem xjentifiku Bucephala clangula.
formal.en: The page on the common goldeneye includes a short description and the scientific name Bucephala clangula.
formal.zh: 介绍鹊鸭的页面包含一段简短描述，并列有学名 Bucephala clangula。

colloquial.mt: Emma: Fejn insib il-brajmla tal-għajn f'dan il-ktieb? Luqa: Fittex Bucephala clangula fl-indiċi. Emma: Sibtha, grazzi!
colloquial.en: Emma: Where can I find the common goldeneye in this book? Luqa: Look for Bucephala clangula in the index. Emma: Found it, thanks!
colloquial.zh: 艾玛：这本书里哪里能找到鹊鸭？卢卡：在索引里查 Bucephala clangula。艾玛：找到了，谢谢！

messages.speaker: Emma (读者)
messages.mt_spoken: Fejn insib il-brajmla tal-għajn f'dan il-ktieb?
messages.mt_standard: Fejn insib il-brajmla tal-għajn f'dan il-ktieb?
messages.zh: 这本书里哪里能找到鹊鸭？
messages.en: Where can I find the common goldeneye in this book?

messages.speaker: Luqa (学习伙伴)
messages.zh: 在索引里查 Bucephala clangula。
messages.en: Look for Bucephala clangula in the index.

messages.speaker: Emma (读者)
messages.zh: 找到了，谢谢！
messages.en: Found it, thanks!

cognitive_memory_aid: 借 għajn 的“眼睛”义，在词卡旁画一只眼睛作个人记忆符号，再把 brajmla tal-għajn、common goldeneye 和“鹊鸭”连起来背；图画只用于助记。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A duck species called the tufted duck, with the scientific name Aythya fuligula.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一种鸭类，中文名为凤头潜鸭，学名为 Aythya fuligula。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Speċi ta' papra magħrufa bl-isem xjentifiku Aythya fuligula.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 凤头潜鸭（学名：Aythya fuligula）。

collocations.en: a photograph of a tufted duck

formal.mt: Il-materjal tal-lezzjoni jinkludi ritratt tal-brajmla tat-toppu bl-isem xjentifiku Aythya fuligula miktub taħtu.
formal.en: The lesson material includes a photograph of the tufted duck with the scientific name Aythya fuligula written underneath.
formal.zh: 课程材料中有一张凤头潜鸭的照片，下面标注了学名 Aythya fuligula。

colloquial.mt: Rita: X'nikteb fuq din il-karta tal-għasafar? Ben: Brajmla tat-toppu, u taħtha Aythya fuligula. Rita: Tajjeb, imbagħad tista' tistaqsini l-isem.
colloquial.en: Rita: What should I write on this bird flashcard? Ben: Brajmla tat-toppu, meaning tufted duck, and Aythya fuligula underneath. Rita: All right, then you can quiz me on the name.
colloquial.zh: 丽塔：这张鸟类词卡上该写什么？本：写 brajmla tat-toppu，也就是凤头潜鸭，下面再写 Aythya fuligula。丽塔：好，然后你可以考考我这个名字。

messages.speaker: Rita (学生)
messages.zh: 这张鸟类词卡上该写什么？
messages.en: What should I write on this bird flashcard?

messages.speaker: Ben (学习伙伴)
messages.mt_spoken: Brajmla tat-toppu, u taħtha Aythya fuligula.
messages.mt_standard: Brajmla tat-toppu, u taħtha Aythya fuligula.
messages.zh: 写 brajmla tat-toppu，也就是凤头潜鸭，下面再写 Aythya fuligula。
messages.en: Brajmla tat-toppu, meaning tufted duck, and Aythya fuligula underneath.

messages.speaker: Rita (学生)
messages.zh: 好，然后你可以考考我这个名字。
messages.en: All right, then you can quiz me on the name.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 brajmla tat-toppu 分成 brajmla 和 tat-toppu 两个朗读节拍，边读边指向“凤头潜鸭”词卡；再用 Aythya fuligula 核对整组名称，练习双向回想。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A duck species called the ferruginous duck, with the scientific name Aythya nyroca.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一种鸭类，中文名为白眼潜鸭，学名为 Aythya nyroca。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Speċi ta' papra magħrufa bl-isem xjentifiku Aythya nyroca.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 白眼潜鸭（学名：Aythya nyroca）。

collocations.en: a photograph of a ferruginous duck

formal.mt: Il-gwida tagħti l-isem brajmla ħamra għall-ispeċi Aythya nyroca u tinkludi ritratt tagħha.
formal.en: The guide gives the name brajmla ħamra for the species Aythya nyroca and includes a photograph of it.
