messages.en: They're grazing on the uncultivated patch beside the farm.

messages.speaker: Anna (访客)
messages.zh: 现在我看到它们了。
messages.en: I can see them now.

cognitive_memory_aid: 画一小块没有耕种、上面有羊吃草的土地，标上 bura；同时记住小块、未耕、放牧三个要点。

gloss_zh: 尽兴的玩乐；喧闹的娱乐活动

teaching_sense.en_definition: Great fun or lively, noisy entertainment.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 令人十分开心、尽兴的玩乐，也可指热闹而嘈杂的娱乐活动。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Divertiment kbir jew attività ta' divertiment b'ħafna għajat u storbju.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 极大的乐趣；十分尽兴的玩乐。
喧闹的娱乐活动；伴随吵闹声的玩乐。

collocations.en: have a great time with lively fun
a whole lot of noisy fun

formal.mt: Wara l-ikla saret burdellata sħiħa, bil-mużika u l-kant tal-mistednin.
formal.en: After the meal, there was a whole lot of noisy fun, with music and singing by the guests.
formal.zh: 饭后，宾客们奏乐唱歌，热热闹闹地尽情玩乐。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Kif kienet il-festa lbieraħ? Mark: Għamilna burdellata! Dħakna u kantajna l-lejla kollha.
colloquial.en: Maja: How was the party yesterday? Mark: We had a great time! We laughed and sang all evening.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：昨天的聚会怎么样？马克：我们玩得特别尽兴！整个晚上都在笑、在唱歌。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 昨天的聚会怎么样？
messages.en: How was the party yesterday?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għamilna burdellata! Dħakna u kantajna l-lejla kollha.
messages.mt_standard: Għamilna burdellata! Dħakna u kantajna l-lejla kollha.
messages.zh: 我们玩得特别尽兴！整个晚上都在笑、在唱歌。
messages.en: We had a great time! We laughed and sang all evening.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 burdellata 配上一幅大家笑着唱歌的聚会画面，同时记住“尽兴”和“喧闹”两个义项。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Annual mercury, the plant with the scientific name Mercurialis annua.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指英语称为 annual mercury、学名为 Mercurialis annua 的一年生植物。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Pjanta annwali magħrufa bl-isem xjentifiku Mercurialis annua.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 一年生山靛，指学名为 Mercurialis annua 的植物。

formal.mt: Fir-rapport tal-osservazzjoni, l-istudenta identifikat il-burikba bl-isem xjentifiku Mercurialis annua.
formal.en: In the observation report, the student identified annual mercury by the scientific name Mercurialis annua.
formal.zh: 在观察报告中，这名学生用学名 Mercurialis annua 标明了一年生山靛。

colloquial.mt: Marta: Kif jisimha din il-pjanta? Toni: Din burikba. Fuq it-tikketta hemm miktub Mercurialis annua.
colloquial.en: Marta: What is this plant called? Toni: This is annual mercury. The label says Mercurialis annua.
colloquial.zh: 玛尔塔：这株植物叫什么？托尼：这是一年生山靛。标签上写着 Mercurialis annua。

messages.speaker: Marta (学生)
messages.zh: 这株植物叫什么？
messages.en: What is this plant called?

messages.speaker: Toni (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Din burikba. Fuq it-tikketta hemm miktub Mercurialis annua.
messages.mt_standard: Din burikba. Fuq it-tikketta hemm miktub Mercurialis annua.
messages.zh: 这是一年生山靛。标签上写着 Mercurialis annua。
messages.en: This is annual mercury. The label says Mercurialis annua.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 burikba 与学名 Mercurialis annua 写在同一张植物标签上，再加“一年生”三个字，成组记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Lemon balm, the plant with the scientific name Melissa officinalis.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 香蜂草，学名为 Melissa officinalis 的植物。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Pjanta magħrufa bl-isem xjentifiku Melissa officinalis.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 香蜂草（学名 Melissa officinalis）。

formal.mt: L-istudenti osservaw il-weraq tal-buriħa u kitbu l-isem xjentifiku Melissa officinalis ħdejn it-tpinġija.
formal.en: The students observed the lemon balm leaves and wrote the scientific name Melissa officinalis beside the drawing.
formal.zh: 学生们观察了香蜂草的叶子，并在图画旁写下学名 Melissa officinalis。

colloquial.mt: Nina: X'jisimha din il-pjanta? Rita: Din buriħa. Trid tara l-weraq tagħha mill-qrib?
colloquial.en: Nina: What is this plant called? Rita: This is lemon balm. Would you like to look at its leaves up close?
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：这株植物叫什么？丽塔：这是香蜂草。你想近距离看看它的叶子吗？

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.zh: 这株植物叫什么？
messages.en: What is this plant called?

messages.speaker: Rita (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Din buriħa. Trid tara l-weraq tagħha mill-qrib?
messages.mt_standard: Din buriħa. Trid tara l-weraq tagħha mill-qrib?
messages.zh: 这是香蜂草。你想近距离看看它的叶子吗？
messages.en: This is lemon balm. Would you like to look at its leaves up close?

cognitive_memory_aid: 制作一张植物词卡：正面写 buriħa，背面写“香蜂草”和 Melissa officinalis，配叶片图一起记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Burkina Faso, a country in West Africa formerly called Upper Volta.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 布基纳法索，位于西非的国家，旧称上沃尔特。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Pajjiż fl-Afrika tal-Punent li qabel kien jissejjaħ Upper Volta.

sense_translations.en_definition: Burkina Faso (a country in West Africa, formerly Upper Volta; official name: Burkina Faso)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 布基纳法索，位于西非的国家，旧称上沃尔特；正式国名为布基纳法索。

formal.mt: Ir-rapport tal-ġeografija jiddeskrivi l-Burkina Faso bħala pajjiż fl-Afrika tal-Punent.
formal.en: The geography report describes Burkina Faso as a country in West Africa.
formal.zh: 这份地理报告将布基纳法索介绍为一个位于西非的国家。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Fejn jinsab il-Burkina Faso? Adam: Fl-Afrika tal-Punent. Ejja nsibuh fuq il-mappa.
colloquial.en: Sara: Where is Burkina Faso? Adam: In West Africa. Let's find it on the map.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：布基纳法索在哪里？亚当：在西非。我们在地图上找找它吧。

messages.speaker: Sara (同学)
messages.zh: 布基纳法索在哪里？
messages.en: Where is Burkina Faso?

messages.speaker: Adam (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Fl-Afrika tal-Punent. Ejja nsibuh fuq il-mappa.
messages.mt_standard: Fl-Afrika tal-Punent. Ejja nsibuh fuq il-mappa.
messages.zh: 在西非。我们在地图上找找它吧。
messages.en: In West Africa. Let's find it on the map.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 Burkina Faso 分成两个书写单元，对应中文“布基纳／法索”，再在词卡旁标注“西非”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Burundi, a country in East Africa whose official name is the Republic of Burundi.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 布隆迪，位于东非的国家，正式国名为布隆迪共和国。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Pajjiż fl-Afrika tal-Lvant li l-isem uffiċjali tiegħu huwa r-Repubblika tal-Burundi.

sense_translations.en_definition: Burundi (a country in East Africa; official name: Repubblika tal-Burundi)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 布隆迪，位于东非的国家；正式国名为布隆迪共和国。

formal.mt: Fit-taqsima dwar l-Afrika tal-Lvant, l-istudenta ppreżentat il-Burundi bl-isem uffiċjali tiegħu, ir-Repubblika tal-Burundi.
formal.en: In the section on East Africa, the student presented Burundi under its official name, the Republic of Burundi.
formal.zh: 在介绍东非的部分，这名学生使用正式国名“布隆迪共和国”介绍了布隆迪。

colloquial.mt: Lina: Għażilt pajjiż għall-proġett? Ben: Iva, il-Burundi. Se nuri fejn jinsab fl-Afrika tal-Lvant.
colloquial.en: Lina: Have you chosen a country for the project? Ben: Yes, Burundi. I'll show where it is in East Africa.
colloquial.zh: 莉娜：你选好项目要介绍的国家了吗？本：选好了，布隆迪。我会展示它在东非的位置。

messages.speaker: Lina (同学)
messages.zh: 你选好项目要介绍的国家了吗？
messages.en: Have you chosen a country for the project?

messages.speaker: Ben (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, il-Burundi. Se nuri fejn jinsab fl-Afrika tal-Lvant.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, il-Burundi. Se nuri fejn jinsab fl-Afrika tal-Lvant.
messages.zh: 选好了，布隆迪。我会展示它在东非的位置。
messages.en: Yes, Burundi. I'll show where it is in East Africa.

cognitive_memory_aid: 将 Burundi、布隆迪、东非写成一行，再另写正式名称 Repubblika tal-Burundi，连同国名一起记。

gloss_zh: 装得满满、几乎要溢出的东西

teaching_sense.en_definition: Something filled so fully that it is nearly overflowing.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指装得非常满、里面的东西几乎要溢出来的事物。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Xi ħaġa mimlija tant li kważi tfur.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 装得满满、几乎要溢出来的东西。

collocations.en: a glass filled almost to overflowing
collocations.zh: 一只装得几乎要溢出的杯子

collocations.en: a plate filled almost to overflowing
collocations.zh: 一盘盛得满满、几乎要溢出的食物

formal.mt: It-tazza kienet burġata bl-ilma, u għalhekk ġiet imċaqalqa b'attenzjoni.
formal.en: The glass was filled almost to overflowing with water, so it was moved carefully.
formal.zh: 杯子里的水满得几乎要溢出来，因此移动时格外小心。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Trid iżjed ilma? Pawlu: Le, grazzi! It-tazza diġà burġata.
colloquial.en: Lara: Would you like more water? Pawlu: No, thanks! The glass is already almost overflowing.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：还要加水吗？保罗：不用，谢谢！杯子已经满得快溢出来了。

messages.speaker: Lara (主人)
messages.zh: 还要加水吗？
messages.en: Would you like more water?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (客人)
messages.zh: 不用，谢谢！杯子已经满得快溢出来了。
messages.en: No, thanks! The glass is already almost overflowing.

cognitive_memory_aid: 看到 burġata，就想象杯口已经顶着水面：重点是“满到快溢出”，不只是普通的“满”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A shrike species identified by the scientific name Lanius minor.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一种伯劳鸟，中文称灰背伯劳，学名为 Lanius minor。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Speċi ta' għasfur magħrufa bl-isem xjentifiku Lanius minor.

sense_translations.zh_definition: （鸟类学）灰背伯劳（学名 Lanius minor）。

collocations.en: a photograph of a Lanius minor shrike
an observation of a Lanius minor shrike
collocations.zh: 一次对灰背伯劳的观察

formal.mt: Fir-reġistru tal-osservazzjonijiet, il-busajjied ġie mniżżel bl-isem xjentifiku Lanius minor.
formal.en: In the observation log, the shrike was recorded under the scientific name Lanius minor.
formal.zh: 在观察记录中，这只灰背伯劳以学名 Lanius minor 登记。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'għasfur hemm f'dan ir-ritratt? David: Busajjied. Fil-ktieb issibu bl-isem Lanius minor.
colloquial.en: Maja: What bird is in this photograph? David: A Lanius minor shrike. You'll find it in the book under the name Lanius minor.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这张照片里是什么鸟？戴维：灰背伯劳。你可以在书里按 Lanius minor 这个名字找到它。

messages.speaker: Maja (观鸟初学者)
messages.zh: 这张照片里是什么鸟？
messages.en: What bird is in this photograph?

messages.speaker: David (观鸟同伴)
messages.mt_spoken: Busajjied. Fil-ktieb issibu bl-isem Lanius minor.
messages.mt_standard: Busajjied. Fil-ktieb issibu bl-isem Lanius minor.
messages.zh: 灰背伯劳。你可以在书里按 Lanius minor 这个名字找到它。
messages.en: A Lanius minor shrike. You'll find it in the book under the name Lanius minor.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用一张鸟类识别卡并排记住 busajjied、灰背伯劳和 Lanius minor，书写时特别留意中间的双写 jj。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A surname used as a person's family name.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一个姓氏，用于表示人的家族姓，而非名字。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kunjom li jintuża bħala l-isem tal-familja ta' persuna.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 一个姓氏。

formal.mt: Fuq il-formola, is-Sur Busietta kiteb il-kunjom tiegħu fil-kaxxa mmarkata 'Kunjom'.
formal.en: On the form, Mr Busietta wrote his surname in the box marked 'Surname'.
formal.zh: Busietta 先生在表格中标有“姓氏”的栏内填写了自己的姓。

colloquial.mt: Anna: X'inhu l-kunjom tiegħek, jekk jogħġbok? Mark: Busietta. Tridni niktbu għalik?
colloquial.en: Anna: What is your surname, please? Mark: Busietta. Would you like me to write it down for you?
colloquial.zh: 安娜：请问您贵姓？马克：Busietta。需要我给您写下来吗？

messages.speaker: Anna (接待员)
messages.zh: 请问您贵姓？
messages.en: What is your surname, please?

messages.speaker: Mark (访客)
messages.zh: Busietta。需要我给您写下来吗？
messages.en: Busietta. Would you like me to write it down for you?

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象在表格的“姓氏”栏填入 Busietta：记住它是姓，首字母大写，结尾的 tt 要双写。

gloss_zh: 害虫；须鳎；一根毛发；热敷用羊毛布

teaching_sense.en_definition: A pest insect found on peach, pear and citrus plants, also called the Barbary bug.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一种常见于桃树、梨树和柑橘类植物上的害虫，也称 Barbary bug。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Insett li jagħmel ħsara lill-pjanti tal-ħawħ, tal-lanġas u taċ-ċitru.

sense_translations.en_definition: (entomology) also Busufa. Pest insect common on peach, pear and citrus plants, Barbary bug
sense_translations.zh_definition: 【昆虫学】也称 Busufa，常见于桃树、梨树及柑橘类植物上的一种害虫，英语称 Barbary bug。

sense_translations.en_definition: (ichthyology) also lingwata ħarxa, lingwata piluża, Whiskered sole
sense_translations.zh_definition: 【鱼类学】须鳎，也称 lingwata ħarxa 或 lingwata piluża。
一根毛发。

sense_translations.en_definition: Heated piece of a woollen cloth used as a poultice
sense_translations.zh_definition: 加热后用于热敷的一块羊毛布。

collocations.en: a Barbary bug on a peach tree
collocations.zh: 桃树上的一只这种害虫

collocations.en: the damage caused by the Barbary bug

formal.mt: Waqt l-ispezzjoni tal-ġnien, instab busuf fuq siġra tal-lanġas.
formal.en: During the garden inspection, a Barbary bug was found on a pear tree.
formal.zh: 检查花园时，在一棵梨树上发现了一只这种害虫。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'inhu dan l-insett fuq is-siġra tal-ħawħ? Pawlu: Dan busuf. Ejja naraw jekk hemmx aktar.
colloquial.en: Maja: What's this insect on the peach tree? Pawlu: It's a Barbary bug. Let's see whether there are more.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：桃树上的这只是什么虫？保罗：这是 busuf。我们看看还有没有。

messages.speaker: Maja (园艺爱好者)
messages.mt_spoken: X'inhu dan l-insett fuq is-siġra tal-ħawħ?
messages.mt_standard: X'inhu dan l-insett fuq is-siġra tal-ħawħ?
messages.zh: 桃树上的这只是什么虫？
messages.en: What's this insect on the peach tree?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Dan busuf. Ejja naraw jekk hemmx aktar.
messages.mt_standard: Dan busuf. Ejja naraw jekk hemmx aktar.
messages.zh: 这是 busuf。我们看看还有没有。
messages.en: It's a Barbary bug. Let's see whether there are more.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 busuf 放进四张情境卡：果树上的虫、鱼摊上的鱼、衣服上的一根毛、热敷用的羊毛布；靠上下文区分四个名词义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A surname used as a person's family name.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 姓氏，表示一个人的家族姓，中文可音译为“布苏蒂尔”。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kunjom li jintuża bħala l-isem tal-familja ta' persuna.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 姓氏；可音译为“布苏蒂尔”。

formal.mt: Is-Sinjura Busuttil se tippreżenta r-rapport waqt il-laqgħa.
formal.en: Ms Busuttil will present the report during the meeting.
formal.zh: 布苏蒂尔女士将在会议期间介绍这份报告。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Għandi appuntament mas-Sinjura Busuttil. Lara: Tajjeb, jekk jogħġbok stenna hawn.
colloquial.en: Mark: I have an appointment with Ms Busuttil. Lara: All right, please wait here.
colloquial.zh: 马克：我和布苏蒂尔女士有预约。拉拉：好的，请在这里等候。

messages.speaker: Mark (访客)
messages.zh: 我和布苏蒂尔女士有预约。
messages.en: I have an appointment with Ms Busuttil.

messages.speaker: Lara (接待员)
messages.zh: 好的，请在这里等候。
messages.en: All right, please wait here.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一张写着 Busuttil 的门牌，再配上“布苏蒂尔一家”；把它作为完整姓氏记住，并注意首字母大写。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The Sardinian warbler, a bird identified in this entry as Sylvia melanocephala.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 撒丁莺，一种鸟，本词条所列学名为 Sylvia melanocephala。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Għasfur magħruf bħala s-Sardinian warbler, bl-isem xjentifiku Sylvia melanocephala.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 撒丁莺，学名 Sylvia melanocephala。

collocations.en: a Sardinian warbler among the shrubs
collocations.zh: 灌木丛中的一只撒丁莺

collocations.en: a photograph of a Sardinian warbler

formal.mt: L-istudenti osservaw buswejd u kitbu deskrizzjoni qasira tiegħu.
formal.en: The students observed a Sardinian warbler and wrote a short description of it.
formal.zh: 学生们观察了一只撒丁莺，并写下了简短描述。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Ara dak l-għasfur! Huwa buswejd? Toni: Iva, ejja nippruvaw nieħdu ritratt tiegħu.
colloquial.en: Nina: Look at that bird! Is it a Sardinian warbler? Toni: Yes, let's try to take a photograph of it.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：看那只鸟！是撒丁莺吗？托尼：是的，我们试着给它拍张照片吧。

messages.speaker: Nina (观鸟初学者)
messages.zh: 看那只鸟！是撒丁莺吗？
messages.en: Look at that bird! Is it a Sardinian warbler?

messages.speaker: Toni (观鸟伙伴)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, ejja nippruvaw nieħdu ritratt tiegħu.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, ejja nippruvaw nieħdu ritratt tiegħu.
messages.zh: 是的，我们试着给它拍张照片吧。
messages.en: Yes, let's try to take a photograph of it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给撒丁莺的图片贴上 buswejd 标签，再用“看鸟、拍照”两个场景复述；将整个拼写与鸟名配对记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A Sardinian warbler; the same word is also used as a place name for areas in Malta.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 撒丁莺；同一词形也用作马耳他地区的地名。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Għasfur magħruf bħala s-Sardinian warbler; il-kelma tintuża wkoll bħala isem ta' żoni f'Malta.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 【鸟类学】撒丁莺。

sense_translations.en_definition: (toponymy) An area in Malta in the neghbourhood of Mosta and another near St. Paul's Bay
sense_translations.zh_definition: 【地名学】马耳他莫斯塔附近一处地区的名称，也是圣保罗湾附近另一处地区的名称。

collocations.en: a Sardinian warbler on a branch

collocations.zh: 一处名叫 Buswejda 的地区

formal.mt: Fir-rapport, 'buswejda' tirreferi għall-għasfur, filwaqt li 'Buswejda' fuq il-mappa tindika żona f'Malta.
formal.en: In the report, 'buswejda' refers to the bird, while 'Buswejda' on the map indicates an area in Malta.
formal.zh: 报告中的 buswejda 指这种鸟，而地图上的 Buswejda 表示马耳他的一个地区。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Hawn miktub 'Buswejda'. Dan isem ta' post? David: Iva, hawnhekk huwa isem ta' post. Il-kelma tista' tirreferi wkoll għal għasfur.
colloquial.en: Sara: It says 'Buswejda' here. Is that a place name? David: Yes, here it's a place name. The word can also refer to a bird.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：这里写着 Buswejda。这是地名吗？戴维：是的，这里是地名。这个词也可以指一种鸟。

messages.speaker: Sara (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Hawn miktub 'Buswejda'. Dan isem ta' post?
messages.mt_standard: Hawn miktub 'Buswejda'. Dan isem ta' post?
messages.zh: 这里写着 Buswejda。这是地名吗？
messages.en: It says 'Buswejda' here. Is that a place name?

messages.speaker: David (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, hawnhekk huwa isem ta' post. Il-kelma tista' tirreferi wkoll għal għasfur.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, hawnhekk huwa isem ta' post. Il-kelma tista' tirreferi wkoll għal għasfur.
messages.zh: 是的，这里是地名。这个词也可以指一种鸟。
messages.en: Yes, here it's a place name. The word can also refer to a bird.

cognitive_memory_aid: 并排画一只鸟和一个地图标记：buswejda 对应鸟，Buswejda 对应地名；结合大小写与语境记忆两个义项。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A small purse or pocket used to hold money or other small items.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用于装钱或其他小物件的小钱袋或小口袋。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Borża żgħira jew but żgħir fejn jitqiegħdu flus jew oġġetti żgħar.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 小钱袋或小口袋。

collocations.en: the money in the small purse or pocket
collocations.zh: 小钱袋或小口袋里的钱

formal.mt: Il-muniti tqiegħdu f'buta u ngħataw lis-sid tagħhom.
formal.en: The coins were placed in a small purse and given to their owner.
formal.zh: 硬币被放进一个小钱袋，交还给了失主。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Fejn poġġejt il-muniti? Mark: Fil-buta, ħdejn iċ-ċwievet.
colloquial.en: Lara: Where did you put the coins? Mark: In the small purse, next to the keys.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：你把硬币放哪儿了？马克：在小钱袋里，就在钥匙旁边。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 你把硬币放哪儿了？
messages.en: Where did you put the coins?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 在小钱袋里，就在钥匙旁边。
messages.en: In the small purse, next to the keys.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象把几枚硬币放进掌心大小的钱袋，边放边说 buta；用“小容器装零钱”的画面同时记住钱袋和口袋义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To drink: to take water or another liquid into the mouth and swallow it.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 喝；把水或其他液体摄入口中并咽下。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tixrob: tieħu l-ilma jew likwidu ieħor f'ħalqek u tiblagħu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 喝；饮用。
女式毛皮长围巾，围在颈肩部的毛皮饰物。

formal.mt: Fl-eżerċizzju, l-istudenti għandhom jiddistingwu bejn 'buwa' bħala verb li jfisser 'tixrob' u 'buwa' bħala nom għal aċċessorju tal-pil.
formal.en: In the exercise, students should distinguish between 'buwa' as a verb meaning 'to drink' and 'buwa' as a noun for a fur accessory.
formal.zh: 在练习中，学生应区分表示“喝”的动词 buwa 和表示毛皮饰物的名词 buwa。

colloquial.mt: Nina: 'Buwa' tfisser li tixrob? Paul: Iva, bħala verb. Bħala nom, tfisser ukoll aċċessorju tal-pil għan-nisa.
colloquial.en: Nina: Does 'buwa' mean to drink? Paul: Yes, as a verb. As a noun, it also means a women's fur accessory.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：buwa 是“喝”的意思吗？保罗：是的，作动词时是。作名词时，它也表示女式毛皮饰物。

messages.speaker: Nina (学生)
messages.zh: buwa 是“喝”的意思吗？
messages.en: Does 'buwa' mean to drink?

messages.speaker: Paul (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, bħala verb. Bħala nom, tfisser ukoll aċċessorju tal-pil għan-nisa.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, bħala verb. Bħala nom, tfisser ukoll aċċessorju tal-pil għan-nisa.
messages.zh: 是的，作动词时是。作名词时，它也表示女式毛皮饰物。
messages.en: Yes, as a verb. As a noun, it also means a women's fur accessory.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 buwa 做两张词性卡：动词卡画喝水动作，名词卡画毛皮围巾；先辨动作还是物品，再选择对应中文义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A wrasse, a type of fish.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 隆头鱼，一类鱼的名称。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tip ta' ħuta magħrufa bl-Ingliż bħala wrasse.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 隆头鱼。

formal.mt: Il-gwida tinkludi ritratt ta' buxiħ biex tgħin lill-qarrejja jagħrfu l-ħuta.
formal.en: The guide includes a photograph of a wrasse to help readers identify the fish.
formal.zh: 指南中附有一张隆头鱼照片，帮助读者辨认这种鱼。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Din il-ħuta x'jisimha? Rita: Buxiħ. Trid tara ritratt ieħor tagħha?
colloquial.en: Mark: What's this fish called? Rita: A wrasse. Would you like to see another photograph of it?
colloquial.zh: 马克：这种鱼叫什么？丽塔：隆头鱼。你想再看一张它的照片吗？

messages.speaker: Mark (学生)
messages.zh: 这种鱼叫什么？
messages.en: What's this fish called?

messages.speaker: Rita (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Buxiħ. Trid tara ritratt ieħor tagħha?
messages.mt_standard: Buxiħ. Trid tara ritratt ieħor tagħha?
messages.zh: 隆头鱼。你想再看一张它的照片吗？
messages.en: A wrasse. Would you like to see another photograph of it?

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 buxiħ 写在隆头鱼图片下，再配上英文 wrasse；反复进行“看图说马耳他语、读词说中文”的双向练习。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A container or holder used to hold ice.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用来盛放冰的容器或器具。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kontenitur jew reċipjent li jintuża biex iżomm is-silġ.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 盛冰容器；用来放冰的器具。

collocations.en: an ice holder full of ice
to put ice in the ice holder

formal.mt: Qabel il-wasla tal-mistednin, il-persunal poġġa buzzun mimli silġ fuq il-mejda tax-xorb.
formal.en: Before the guests arrived, the staff placed an ice holder full of ice on the drinks table.
formal.zh: 宾客到来之前，工作人员在饮品桌上放了一个装满冰的盛冰容器。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Fejn inpoġġi s-silġ? Sara: Fil-buzzun, ħdejn it-tazzi. Mark: Sewwa, nimlieh issa.
colloquial.en: Mark: Where should I put the ice? Sara: In the ice holder, next to the glasses. Mark: All right, I'll fill it now.
colloquial.zh: Mark：冰放在哪里？Sara：放在杯子旁边的盛冰容器里。Mark：好，我现在把它装满。

messages.speaker: Mark (聚会帮手)
messages.zh: 冰放在哪里？
messages.en: Where should I put the ice?

messages.speaker: Sara (聚会主人)
messages.zh: 放在杯子旁边的盛冰容器里。
messages.en: In the ice holder, next to the glasses.

messages.speaker: Mark (聚会帮手)
messages.zh: 好，我现在把它装满。
messages.en: All right, I'll fill it now.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象聚会桌上杯子旁边专门装冰的容器，把 buzzun 标签贴在容器上，与表示冰的 silġ 配对记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A mole cricket, an insect belonging to the family Gryllotalpidae.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 蝼蛄，属于蝼蛄科的一种昆虫。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Insett tal-familja Gryllotalpidae, magħruf bl-Ingliż bħala mole cricket.

sense_translations.en_definition: a member of the Gryllotalpidae species (a mole cricket)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 蝼蛄，蝼蛄科的昆虫。

collocations.en: a photograph of a mole cricket

formal.mt: Fir-rapport, l-istudenta inkludiet ritratt ta' buħarrat u kitbet li huwa insett tal-familja Gryllotalpidae.
formal.en: In the report, the student included a photograph of a mole cricket and wrote that it is an insect belonging to the family Gryllotalpidae.
formal.zh: 这名学生在报告中放入了一张蝼蛄的照片，并写明它属于蝼蛄科。

colloquial.mt: Sara: X'inhu dan l-insett fir-ritratt? David: Dan buħarrat.
colloquial.en: Sara: What's this insect in the photograph? David: It's a mole cricket.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：照片里的这只昆虫是什么？戴维：这是蝼蛄。

messages.speaker: Sara (学生)
messages.zh: 照片里的这只昆虫是什么？
messages.en: What's this insect in the photograph?

messages.speaker: David (教师)
messages.zh: 这是蝼蛄。
messages.en: It's a mole cricket.

cognitive_memory_aid: 制作一张蝼蛄图片卡，正面写 buħarrat，背面写“蝼蛄／mole cricket”，用看图说词的方式反复记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Fennel, the plant identified by the scientific name Foeniculum vulgare.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 茴香，学名为 Foeniculum vulgare 的植物。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Pjanta magħrufa bl-Ingliż bħala fennel u bl-isem xjentifiku Foeniculum vulgare.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 茴香，学名 Foeniculum vulgare。

formal.mt: Għal din ir-riċetta, aħsel il-bużbież tal-ġidra u aqtagħha f'biċċiet żgħar.
formal.en: For this recipe, wash the fennel and cut it into small pieces.
formal.zh: 制作这道菜时，把茴香洗净，再切成小块。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'għandna bżonn għall-insalata? Toni: Bużbież tal-ġidra frisk. Inġibu ftit mis-suq?
colloquial.en: Maja: What do we need for the salad? Toni: Fresh fennel. Shall we get some from the market?
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：做沙拉需要什么？托尼：新鲜茴香。我们去市场买一些吧？

messages.speaker: Maja (室友)
messages.zh: 做沙拉需要什么？
messages.en: What do we need for the salad?

messages.speaker: Toni (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Bużbież tal-ġidra frisk. Inġibu ftit mis-suq?
messages.mt_standard: Bużbież tal-ġidra frisk. Inġibu ftit mis-suq?
messages.zh: 新鲜茴香。我们去市场买一些吧？
messages.en: Fresh fennel. Shall we get some from the market?

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 bużbież tal-ġidra 整体写进购物清单，旁边画茴香并标注 fennel；用“买来、洗净、切块”的连续画面记住完整词组。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The plant fennel, Foeniculum vulgare.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 茴香，学名为 Foeniculum vulgare 的植物。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-pjanta magħrufa bħala bużbież, bl-isem xjentifiku Foeniculum vulgare.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 茴香（Foeniculum vulgare）。

formal.mt: L-istudenti osservaw il-weraq tal-bużbież tar-roqba u kitbu deskrizzjoni tal-pjanta.
formal.en: The students observed the fennel leaves and wrote a description of the plant.
formal.zh: 学生们观察了茴香的叶子，并写下了对这种植物的描述。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'jisimha din il-pjanta? Pawlu: Bużbież tar-roqba. Maja: Mela nikteb l-isem ħdejn it-tpinġija.
colloquial.en: Maja: What's this plant called? Pawlu: Fennel. Maja: Then I'll write the name next to the drawing.
colloquial.zh: Maja：这种植物叫什么？Pawlu：茴香。Maja：那我把名字写在图画旁边。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.zh: 这种植物叫什么？
messages.en: What's this plant called?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (老师)
messages.zh: 茴香。
messages.en: Fennel.

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.zh: 那我把名字写在图画旁边。
messages.en: Then I'll write the name next to the drawing.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把整个词组写在茴香插图旁，再配上“叶子、种子”两个标签，作为完整植物名称一起记忆。

gloss_zh: 鳚鱼；石构造中的渗水部位

teaching_sense.en_definition: A blenny, a kind of fish; also a part of a stone structure from which water oozes.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一种称为鳚鱼的鱼；也指石构造中有水慢慢渗出的部位。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tip ta' ħuta; il-kelma tintuża wkoll għal parti minn struttura tal-ġebel minn fejn inixxi l-ilma.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 鳚鱼，一种鱼。

sense_translations.en_definition: part of a stone structure from which water oozes
sense_translations.zh_definition: 石构造中有水渗出的部位。

collocations.en: water oozing from the seepage point in the stone structure
collocations.zh: 从石构造渗水部位渗出的水

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi bużellieqa fil-ħajt tal-ġebel, minn fejn l-ilma jnixxi bil-mod.
formal.en: The report describes a seepage point in the stone wall from which water slowly oozes.
formal.zh: 报告描述了石墙中的一处渗水部位，水正从那里缓慢渗出。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Ara dik il-ħuta żgħira! Mark: Dik bużellieqa. Lara: Ejja narawha minn hawn.
colloquial.en: Lara: Look at that little fish! Mark: That's a blenny. Lara: Let's watch it from here.
colloquial.zh: Lara：看那条小鱼！Mark：那是鳚鱼。Lara：我们就在这里看看它吧。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 看那条小鱼！
messages.en: Look at that little fish!

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 那是鳚鱼。
messages.en: That's a blenny.

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 我们就在这里看看它吧。
messages.en: Let's watch it from here.

cognitive_memory_aid: 画两张独立词卡：一张是海里的鳚鱼，一张是慢慢渗水的石墙；同一拼写对应两个名词义。

gloss_zh: 闪烁其词的人；惯于回避的人

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who avoids giving direct answers or dealing directly with an issue.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 惯于回避问题、不肯直接回答或明确表态的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li tevita li twieġeb direttament jew li tieħu pożizzjoni ċara.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 惯于回避问题、闪烁其词的人。

collocations.en: an evasive person who does not answer directly
collocations.zh: 不直接回答问题、闪烁其词的人

collocations.en: to speak to an evasive person
collocations.zh: 与一个惯于回避问题的人交谈

formal.mt: Fil-ġrajja, il-karattru ewlieni huwa bużelliequ li jevita kull mistoqsija dwar id-deċiżjoni tiegħu.
formal.en: In the story, the main character is an evasive person who avoids every question about his decision.
formal.zh: 故事中的主人公是一个惯于回避的人，凡是涉及自己决定的问题，他都避而不答。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Staqsejtu jekk hux ġej, u beda jitkellem dwar it-temp. Lara: X'bużelliequ! Maja: Se nerġa' nistaqsih.
colloquial.en: Maja: I asked him whether he's coming, and he started talking about the weather. Lara: He's so evasive! Maja: I'll ask him again.
colloquial.zh: Maja：我问他来不来，他却开始聊天气。Lara：这人真会回避问题！Maja：我再问他一次。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Staqsejtu jekk hux ġej, u beda jitkellem dwar it-temp.
messages.mt_standard: Staqsejtu jekk hux ġej, u beda jitkellem dwar it-temp.
messages.zh: 我问他来不来，他却开始聊天气。
messages.en: I asked him whether he's coming, and he started talking about the weather.

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 这人真会回避问题！
messages.en: He's so evasive!

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 我再问他一次。
messages.en: I'll ask him again.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象你问“来不来”，对方只聊天气；把这个总把话题绕开的人与整词对应，记住它指人。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A trick performed as magic; also an idea regarded as silly.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 作为魔术表演的把戏；也可指被认为愚蠢或不合理的主意。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Logħba tal-maġija; il-kelma tista' tfisser ukoll idea iblah.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 魔术把戏。
傻主意；愚蠢的想法。

collocations.en: to perform a conjuring trick with cards
to come up with a silly idea

formal.mt: Waqt il-wirja, l-artist għamel bużullotta bil-karti quddiem l-udjenza.
formal.en: During the show, the performer did a conjuring trick with cards in front of the audience.
formal.zh: 演出期间，表演者在观众面前变了一个纸牌魔术。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Ejja nġorru l-mejda waħedna mit-taraġ. Pawlu: Dik bużullotta! Il-mejda tqila wisq. Mark: Sewwa, nitolbu l-għajnuna.
colloquial.en: Mark: Let's carry the table down the stairs by ourselves. Pawlu: That's a silly idea! The table is far too heavy. Mark: All right, let's ask for help.
colloquial.zh: Mark：我们自己把桌子搬下楼吧。Pawlu：这是什么傻主意！桌子太重了。Mark：好吧，我们找人帮忙。

messages.speaker: Mark (室友)
messages.zh: 我们自己把桌子搬下楼吧。
messages.en: Let's carry the table down the stairs by ourselves.

messages.speaker: Pawlu (室友)
messages.zh: 这是什么傻主意！桌子太重了。
messages.en: That's a silly idea! The table is far too heavy.

messages.speaker: Mark (室友)
messages.zh: 好吧，我们找人帮忙。
messages.en: All right, let's ask for help.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“舞台上的把戏”和“讨论中的傻主意”两个场景分别记忆；遇到这个词，先看是在表演还是在评价想法。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A performer who entertains an audience by doing conjuring tricks.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 通过表演魔术把戏来娱乐观众的人，即魔术师。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li tagħmel logħob tal-maġija biex tiddeverti lill-udjenza.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 魔术师；表演魔术把戏的人。

formal.mt: Il-programm tal-festa jinkludi wirja ta' bużullottist għat-tfal u l-familji tagħhom.
formal.en: The festival programme includes a conjurer's show for children and their families.
formal.zh: 节庆活动安排中包括一场供儿童及其家人观看的魔术表演。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Min se jagħmel il-wirja llum? Ben: Bużullottist. Sara: Mela ejja noqogħdu bilqiegħda ħdejn il-palk.
colloquial.en: Sara: Who's performing today? Ben: A conjurer. Sara: Then let's sit near the stage.
colloquial.zh: Sara：今天谁来表演？Ben：一位魔术师。Sara：那我们坐到舞台附近吧。

messages.speaker: Sara (观众)
messages.zh: 今天谁来表演？
messages.en: Who's performing today?

messages.speaker: Ben (朋友)
messages.zh: 一位魔术师。
messages.en: A conjurer.

messages.speaker: Sara (观众)
messages.mt_spoken: Mela ejja noqogħdu bilqiegħda ħdejn il-palk.
messages.mt_standard: Mela ejja noqogħdu bilqiegħda ħdejn il-palk.
messages.zh: 那我们坐到舞台附近吧。
messages.en: Then let's sit near the stage.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把词卡贴在舞台表演者的图像上，并与“魔术把戏”词卡并排：这个词回答“谁在表演”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A promise that offers hope but is not backed by action or fulfilment.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 听起来让人抱有希望，却没有实际行动或兑现的承诺。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Wegħda li tqajjem it-tama iżda ma titwettaqx.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 空头承诺；没有兑现的许诺。

collocations.en: to turn out to be an empty promise

formal.mt: Il-wegħda li jissewwa l-bini spiċċat bużżieqa tas-sapun, għax ix-xogħol qatt ma beda.
formal.en: The promise to repair the building turned out to be empty, as the work never began.
formal.zh: 修缮大楼的许诺最终成了空头承诺，因为工程始终没有开始。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Wegħedni li se jgħinni, imma ma ġiex. Maja: Mela l-wegħda kienet bużżieqa tas-sapun. Lara: Iva, kelli nagħmel kollox waħdi.
colloquial.en: Lara: He promised to help me, but he didn't come. Maja: So the promise was empty. Lara: Yes, I had to do everything myself.
colloquial.zh: Lara：他答应来帮我，可是没来。Maja：那就是空头承诺了。Lara：是啊，最后全得我自己做。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Wegħedni li se jgħinni, imma ma ġiex.
messages.mt_standard: Wegħedni li se jgħinni, imma ma ġiex.
messages.zh: 他答应来帮我，可是没来。
messages.en: He promised to help me, but he didn't come.

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 那就是空头承诺了。
messages.en: So the promise was empty.

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 是啊，最后全得我自己做。
messages.en: Yes, I had to do everything myself.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象写着“我一定来帮忙”的气泡突然破掉，用这个学习画面记住整个词组表示空头承诺。

gloss_zh: 海参；爱抱怨的，爱发牢骚的

teaching_sense.en_definition: A sea cucumber, an echinoderm belonging to the class Holothuroidea.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 海参，属于海参纲的棘皮动物。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Annimal tal-baħar li jappartjeni għall-klassi Holothuroidea tal-ekinodermi.

sense_translations.en_definition: sea cucumber, holothuroid (any echinoderm of the class Holothuroidea)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 海参，海参纲的任何一种棘皮动物。
爱抱怨的；易烦躁的；爱哼哼唧唧发牢骚的。

collocations.en: a sea cucumber on the seabed

collocations.zh: 爱哼哼唧唧抱怨的男孩

formal.mt: L-istudenti osservaw bużżu f'qiegħ il-baħar u identifikawh bħala ekinoderm tal-klassi Holothuroidea.
formal.en: The students observed a sea cucumber on the seabed and identified it as an echinoderm of the class Holothuroidea.
formal.zh: 学生们观察了海底的一只海参，并将其辨认为海参纲的棘皮动物。

colloquial.mt: Omm: Għaliex qed tkun bużżu llum? Ben: Għax jien għajjien u rrid immur id-dar. Omm: Sewwa, nitilqu dalwaqt.
colloquial.en: Mum: Why are you being so whiny today? Ben: Because I'm tired and want to go home. Mum: All right, we'll leave soon.
colloquial.zh: 妈妈：你今天怎么老是哼哼唧唧地抱怨？Ben：因为我累了，想回家。妈妈：好，我们很快就走。

messages.speaker: Omm (母亲)
messages.zh: 你今天怎么老是哼哼唧唧地抱怨？
messages.en: Why are you being so whiny today?

messages.speaker: Ben (儿子)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax jien għajjien u rrid immur id-dar.
messages.mt_standard: Għax jien għajjien u rrid immur id-dar.
messages.zh: 因为我累了，想回家。
messages.en: Because I'm tired and want to go home.

messages.speaker: Omm (母亲)
messages.zh: 好，我们很快就走。
messages.en: All right, we'll leave soon.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给同一拼写做两张卡：名词卡画海参，形容词卡画一个不断抱怨的人；依靠句法区分两个词性。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A small egg; the diminutive of bajda, used to emphasize its small size.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 小蛋，表示一枚体积较小的蛋，是 bajda 的指小形式。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Bajda żgħira; forma diminuttiva ta' bajda li tenfasizza ċ-ċokon tagħha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 一枚小蛋；bajda（蛋）的指小形式。

collocations.en: a small egg in the nest

formal.mt: Waqt l-osservazzjoni, it-tfal raw bwajda fil-bejta u ddeskrivew il-kulur tagħha.
formal.en: During the observation, the children saw a small egg in the nest and described its colour.
formal.zh: 观察时，孩子们看见巢里的一枚小蛋，并描述了它的颜色。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Trid bwajda mgħollija mal-ħobż? Leo: Iva, waħda biss, jekk jogħġbok.
colloquial.en: Anna: Would you like a small boiled egg with your bread? Leo: Yes, just one, please.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：你想配着面包吃一枚煮熟的小蛋吗？利奥：好的，一枚就够了，谢谢。

messages.speaker: Anna (母亲)
messages.zh: 你想配着面包吃一枚煮熟的小蛋吗？
messages.en: Would you like a small boiled egg with your bread?

messages.speaker: Leo (儿子)
messages.zh: 好的，一枚就够了，谢谢。
messages.en: Yes, just one, please.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 bajda 的“蛋”缩小成掌心里的一枚小蛋，配着 bwajda mgħollija“小水煮蛋”一起记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A small door; the diminutive of bieb, used to describe a door of reduced size.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 尺寸较小的门，是 bieb 的指小形式，用来突出门的小巧。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Bieb żgħir; forma diminuttiva ta' bieb li tindika daqs żgħir.

sense_translations.en_definition: a small door (the diminutive form of 'bieb')
sense_translations.zh_definition: 一扇小门；bieb（门）的指小形式。

formal.mt: Il-mudell tad-dar għandu bwejjeb tal-injam li jinfetaħ lejn ġewwa.
formal.en: The model house has a small wooden door that opens inward.
formal.zh: 这座房屋模型有一扇向内开启的小木门。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Minn fejn jidħol il-qattus? Ben: Minn dak il-bwejjeb ħdejn it-tieqa.
colloquial.en: Maja: Where does the cat get in? Ben: Through that small door beside the window.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：猫从哪里进来？本：从窗边的那扇小门进来。

messages.speaker: Maja (访客)
messages.zh: 猫从哪里进来？
messages.en: Where does the cat get in?

messages.speaker: Ben (屋主)
messages.zh: 从窗边的那扇小门进来。
messages.en: Through that small door beside the window.

cognitive_memory_aid: 先想一扇 bieb“门”，再把它缩成模型屋的小门；看到 bwejjeb 就联想这扇小巧的门。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A small pocket; the diminutive of but, used for a pocket with little space.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 容量或尺寸较小的口袋，是 but 的指小形式。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: But żgħir; forma diminuttiva ta' but li tindika spazju żgħir biex iżżomm xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 小口袋；but（口袋）的指小形式。

collocations.en: a small pocket in the jacket

formal.mt: Il-ġakketta għandha bwejjet biż-żipp fejn jistgħu jinżammu ċ-ċwievet.
formal.en: The jacket has a small zipped pocket where keys can be kept.
formal.zh: 这件夹克有一个带拉链的小口袋，可以用来放钥匙。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Fejn poġġejt iċ-ċavetta? Mark: Fil-bwejjet ta' ġewwa tal-ġakketta.
colloquial.en: Sara: Where did you put the key? Mark: In the small inside pocket of the jacket.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：你把钥匙放在哪里了？马克：放在夹克里面的小口袋里了。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 你把钥匙放在哪里了？
messages.en: Where did you put the key?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 放在夹克里面的小口袋里了。
messages.en: In the small inside pocket of the jacket.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 but“口袋”想成只能放一把钥匙的小口袋，用“钥匙放进 bwejjet”的画面记住词义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A small amount of urine; a diminutive form of bewl emphasizing the small quantity.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 少量尿液，是 bewl 的指小形式，强调尿液的量很少。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kwantità żgħira ta' bewl; forma diminuttiva li tenfasizza kemm l-ammont hu żgħir.

sense_translations.en_definition: a small amount of urine (diminutive form of 'bewl')
sense_translations.zh_definition: 少量尿液；bewl（尿液）的指小形式。

collocations.en: a small amount of urine in the container
only a small amount of urine

formal.mt: Fin-nota ġie rreġistrat li kien hemm bwejla biss fil-kontenitur tal-kampjun.
formal.en: The note recorded that there was only a small amount of urine in the sample container.
formal.zh: 记录中写明，样本容器里只有少量尿液。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Hemm ħafna awrina fil-kontenitur? Pawlu: Le, hemm bwejla biss.
colloquial.en: Rita: Is there much urine in the container? Pawlu: No, there is only a small amount.
colloquial.zh: 丽塔：容器里的尿液多吗？保罗：不多，只有一点。

messages.speaker: Rita (护士)
messages.zh: 容器里的尿液多吗？
messages.en: Is there much urine in the container?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (护理员)
messages.zh: 不多，只有一点。
messages.en: No, there is only a small amount.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 bewl“尿液”与 bwejla“一点尿液”成对记忆，想象容器底部只有浅浅的一小点。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A brief kiss; the diminutive of bewsa, used for a quick, light kiss.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 短暂、轻轻的一吻，是 bewsa 的指小形式。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Bewsa qasira u ħafifa; forma diminuttiva ta' bewsa.

sense_translations.en_definition: a brief kiss (the diminutive form of 'bewsa')
sense_translations.zh_definition: 短暂的一吻；bewsa（吻）的指小形式。

collocations.en: a quick kiss on the cheek

formal.mt: Qabel telqet, it-tifla tat bwejsa fuq il-ħaddejn lil ommha.
formal.en: Before leaving, the girl gave her mother a quick kiss on the cheek.
formal.zh: 离开前，女孩在母亲的脸颊上轻轻吻了一下。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Nista' nagħtik bwejsa qabel nitlaq? Anna: Mela, ejja hawn!
colloquial.en: Nina: Can I give you a quick kiss before I leave? Anna: Of course, come here!
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：我走之前可以轻轻亲你一下吗？安娜：当然，过来吧！

messages.speaker: Nina (女儿)
messages.zh: 我走之前可以轻轻亲你一下吗？
messages.en: Can I give you a quick kiss before I leave?

messages.speaker: Anna (母亲)
messages.zh: 当然，过来吧！
messages.en: Of course, come here!

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 bewsa“吻”缩成告别前轻轻的一下，用“脸颊上一触即离”的画面记住 bwejsa。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The placenta, an organ that develops during pregnancy and supports the baby before birth.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 胎盘，在妊娠期间形成、为出生前的胎儿提供支持的器官。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-plaċenta, organu li jiżviluppa waqt it-tqala u jsostni lit-tarbija qabel it-twelid.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 胎盘。

formal.mt: Fil-lezzjoni dwar it-tqala, l-għalliema użat stampa biex turi fejn tinsab il-bxima.
formal.en: In the lesson about pregnancy, the teacher used a picture to show where the placenta is located.
formal.zh: 在讲解妊娠的课堂上，老师用图片展示了胎盘的位置。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Xi tfisser il-kelma bxima? Rita: Tfisser plaċenta; tista' taraha f'din l-istampa.
colloquial.en: Maja: What does the word bxima mean? Rita: It means placenta; you can see it in this picture.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：bxima 这个词是什么意思？丽塔：意思是胎盘，你可以在这张图里看到它。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.zh: bxima 这个词是什么意思？
messages.en: What does the word bxima mean?

messages.speaker: Rita (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Tfisser plaċenta; tista' taraha f'din l-istampa.
messages.mt_standard: Tfisser plaċenta; tista' taraha f'din l-istampa.
messages.zh: 意思是胎盘，你可以在这张图里看到它。
messages.en: It means placenta; you can see it in this picture.

cognitive_memory_aid: 在妊娠示意图的胎盘位置贴上 bxima 标签，把拼写与位置一起记；这只是图像记忆法。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of announcing something or making news known to other people.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 宣布或传报某件事情、使他人知道消息的行为。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att li tħabbar xi ħaġa jew twassal aħbar lil nies oħra.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 宣布、传报消息这一行为；此处用作名词。

formal.mt: Il-programm taċ-ċerimonja jinkludi l-bxir tar-riżultati tal-kompetizzjoni.
formal.en: The ceremony programme includes the announcing of the competition results.
formal.zh: 典礼议程包括宣布比赛结果这一环节。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Meta se jkun il-bxir tar-riżultati? Ben: Wara l-aħħar logħba, fis-sala.
colloquial.en: Lara: When will the results be announced? Ben: After the last game, in the hall.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：什么时候宣布结果？本：最后一场比赛结束后，在大厅里宣布。

messages.speaker: Lara (参赛者)
messages.zh: 什么时候宣布结果？
messages.en: When will the results be announced?

messages.speaker: Ben (组织者)
messages.zh: 最后一场比赛结束后，在大厅里宣布。
messages.en: After the last game, in the hall.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象主持人拿起话筒宣布比赛结果，把 bxir 记成“宣布这一行为”，并用 il-bxir tar-riżultati 巩固名词用法。

gloss_zh: 小东西；微不足道之物；小事

teaching_sense.en_definition: A small thing, or something considered unimportant or of little value.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 体积很小的东西，也可指被认为不重要、价值不大之物或小事。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ħaġa żgħira, jew xi ħaġa meqjusa bla importanza jew ta' ftit siwi.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 一件小东西；体积很小之物
微不足道、无关紧要的东西或事情
小事；琐事；价值很小之物

formal.mt: Għalkemm l-oġġett deher biss bċejċa bla siwi, l-esperti eżaminawh bir-reqqa.
formal.en: Although the object appeared to be merely a worthless little thing, the experts examined it carefully.
formal.zh: 尽管这件物品看起来只是个不值钱的小东西，专家们仍对它进行了仔细检查。

colloquial.mt: Nina: X'inhi dik il-bċejċa fuq il-mejda? Sam: Biċċa plastik mill-kaxxa; tista' tarmiha.
colloquial.en: Nina: What's that little thing on the table? Sam: A piece of plastic from the box; you can throw it away.
colloquial.zh: Nina：桌上那个小东西是什么？Sam：是盒子上的一小块塑料，可以扔掉。

messages.speaker: Nina (室友)
messages.zh: 桌上那个小东西是什么？
messages.en: What's that little thing on the table?

messages.speaker: Sam (室友)
messages.zh: 是盒子上的一小块塑料，可以扔掉。
messages.en: A piece of plastic from the box; you can throw it away.

cognitive_memory_aid: 从桌上一粒不起眼的小东西联想：既可以说东西“小”，也可以说事情“微不足道”，把两层意思连起来记。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A body of water surrounded by land; in another sense, a field where melons are grown.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 被陆地环绕的水域，即湖泊；另一义指种植甜瓜的田地。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Medda ta' ilma mdawra bl-art; f'tifsira oħra, għalqa fejn jitkabbar il-bettieħ.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 湖；湖泊。
甜瓜田；种植甜瓜的田地。

formal.mt: Il-mappa turi bħajra żgħira mdawra bis-siġar.
formal.en: The map shows a small lake surrounded by trees.
formal.zh: 地图上标示着一个四周环绕树木的小湖。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Fejn ħawwelt il-bettieħ? Pawlu: Fil-bħajra ħdejn id-dar.
colloquial.en: Maja: Where did you plant the melons? Pawlu: In the melon field next to the house.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你把甜瓜种在哪里了？保罗：在屋子旁边的甜瓜田里。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你把甜瓜种在哪里了？
messages.en: Where did you plant the melons?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (种植者)
messages.zh: 在屋子旁边的甜瓜田里。
messages.en: In the melon field next to the house.

cognitive_memory_aid: 画两幅并排的小图：一幅湖面，一幅甜瓜田，都标上 bħajra；读句子时用水岸或种瓜的语境判断词义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of making false statements about someone that damage their reputation.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 散布关于某人的虚假说法、损害其名誉的行为，即诽谤或中伤。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att li xxerred gideb dwar persuna u tagħmel ħsara lir-reputazzjoni tagħha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 诽谤、中伤他人的行为。

formal.mt: L-artiklu jispjega kif il-bħit jista' jagħmel ħsara lir-reputazzjoni ta' persuna.
formal.en: The article explains how slander can damage a person's reputation.
formal.zh: 这篇文章说明诽谤如何损害一个人的名誉。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Xi ħadd qed ixerred gideb dwari. David: Dak hu bħit; ejja niċċaraw il-fatti.
colloquial.en: Nina: Someone is spreading lies about me. David: That's slander; let's clarify the facts.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：有人在散布关于我的谎言。戴维：那是诽谤；我们来澄清事实吧。

messages.speaker: Nina (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Xi ħadd qed ixerred gideb dwari.
messages.mt_standard: Xi ħadd qed ixerred gideb dwari.
messages.zh: 有人在散布关于我的谎言。
messages.en: Someone is spreading lies about me.

messages.speaker: David (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Dak hu bħit; ejja niċċaraw il-fatti.
messages.mt_standard: Dak hu bħit; ejja niċċaraw il-fatti.
messages.zh: 那是诽谤；我们来澄清事实吧。
messages.en: That's slander; let's clarify the facts.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象谎言像污点落在一个人的姓名上，把 bħit 记作“用虚假说法损害名誉的行为”，并注意它是名词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An exclamation used to show disgust at something unpleasant.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 遇到令人恶心或厌恶的事物时发出的感叹，相当于“呸！”或“咦，真恶心！”。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kelma ta' esklamazzjoni li tesprimi stmerrija lejn xi ħaġa li tqanqal id-disgust.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 用于表达恶心、嫌恶或厌恶的感叹语。

formal.mt: Fid-djalogu, il-kelma 'bħu' tesprimi l-istmerrija tal-karattru meta jxomm l-ikel imħassar.
formal.en: In the dialogue, the word 'bħu' expresses the character's disgust on smelling spoiled food.
formal.zh: 在这段对话中，人物闻到变质食物时用“bħu”表达恶心。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Bħu, x'riħa tinten! Toni: Naħseb li l-ħalib tħassar.
colloquial.en: Lara: Ugh, what a stink! Toni: I think the milk has gone bad.
colloquial.zh: 劳拉：咦，真臭！托尼：我想牛奶坏了。

messages.speaker: Lara (室友)
messages.zh: 咦，真臭！
messages.en: Ugh, what a stink!

messages.speaker: Toni (室友)
messages.zh: 我想牛奶坏了。
messages.en: I think the milk has gone bad.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象打开冰箱闻到坏牛奶，立刻皱眉说 bħu！把表情、气味和感叹语一起记住，表达的是嫌恶。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A small pepper berry; the diminutive of bżara, emphasizing the berry's small size.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一粒小胡椒果实，是 bżara 的指小形式，强调颗粒较小。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Bżara żgħira; forma diminuttiva ta' bżara li tenfasizza ċ-ċokon tagħha.

sense_translations.en_definition: a small pepper berry (the diminutive form of 'bżara')
sense_translations.zh_definition: 一粒小胡椒果实；bżara 的指小形式。

collocations.en: to grind a small pepper berry

formal.mt: Waqt il-lezzjoni tat-tisjir, l-għalliem poġġa bżajra fuq platt abjad biex l-istudenti josservawha.
formal.en: During the cooking lesson, the teacher placed a small pepper berry on a white plate for the students to observe.
formal.zh: 烹饪课上，老师把一粒小胡椒放在白盘子上，供学生观察。

colloquial.mt: Sara: X'inhu dak fuq il-mejda? Mark: Bżajra sewda; waqgħet mill-vażett.
colloquial.en: Sara: What is that on the table? Mark: A small black pepper berry; it fell out of the jar.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：桌上的那个是什么？马克：一粒小黑胡椒，从罐子里掉出来的。

messages.speaker: Sara (同住者)
messages.zh: 桌上的那个是什么？
messages.en: What is that on the table?

messages.speaker: Mark (同住者)
messages.zh: 一粒小黑胡椒，从罐子里掉出来的。
messages.en: A small black pepper berry; it fell out of the jar.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 bżara 与指小形式 bżajra 成对记，想象白盘子中央只有一粒小胡椒，再用 bżajra sewda 复习。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A small glob of saliva; the diminutive of 'beżqa'.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一小团唾液，是 beżqa 的指小形式。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Boċċa żgħira ta' bżieq; id-diminuttiv ta' 'beżqa'.

sense_translations.en_definition: a small gob of saliva (the diminutive form of 'beżqa')
sense_translations.zh_definition: 一小团唾液（beżqa 的指小形式）。

collocations.en: a small glob of saliva on the floor
wipe up a small glob of saliva

formal.mt: Il-ħaddiem naddaf bżejqa minn fuq il-bank qabel fetaħ il-kamra għall-pubbliku.
formal.en: The worker cleaned a small glob of saliva off the bench before opening the room to the public.
formal.zh: 工作人员擦掉长凳上的一小团唾液后，才向公众开放房间。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Hemm bżejqa fuq il-bank. Mark: Rajtha. Ħa nimsaħha b'karta.
colloquial.en: Maja: There's a small glob of saliva on the bench. Mark: I saw it. I'll wipe it up with a tissue.
colloquial.zh: Maja：长凳上有一小团唾液。Mark：我看见了，我用纸巾擦掉。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 长凳上有一小团唾液。
messages.en: There's a small glob of saliva on the bench.

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 我看见了，我用纸巾擦掉。
messages.en: I saw it. I'll wipe it up with a tissue.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 beżqa 的唾液团在脑中缩小，记住 bżejqa 是它的指小形式，表示一小团唾液。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A small breast or udder; the diminutive of 'biżla'.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 人的小乳房或动物的小乳房，是 biżla 的指小形式。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Biżla żgħira: sider żgħir jew il-parti żgħira ta' annimal li tipproduċi l-ħalib.

sense_translations.en_definition: small breast or udder (the diminutive form of 'biżla')
sense_translations.zh_definition: 小乳房或动物的小乳房（biżla 的指小形式）。

collocations.en: a sensitive small breast or udder

formal.mt: Waqt l-eżami, il-veterinarja osservat il-bżejżla tan-nagħġa għal sinjali ta' nefħa.
formal.en: During the examination, the veterinarian checked the sheep's small udder for signs of swelling.
formal.zh: 检查时，兽医查看绵羊的小乳房是否有肿胀迹象。

colloquial.mt: Lara: X'inhi din il-parti żgħira fit-tpinġija tan-nagħġa? Rita: Dik bżejżla, jiġifieri biżla żgħira.
colloquial.en: Lara: What's this little part in the drawing of the sheep? Rita: That's a small udder; bżejżla means a small biżla.
colloquial.zh: Lara：绵羊图上的这个小部位是什么？Rita：那是小乳房，bżejżla 就是小的 biżla。

messages.speaker: Lara (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: X'inhi din il-parti żgħira fit-tpinġija tan-nagħġa?
messages.mt_standard: X'inhi din il-parti żgħira fit-tpinġija tan-nagħġa?
messages.zh: 绵羊图上的这个小部位是什么？
messages.en: What's this little part in the drawing of the sheep?

messages.speaker: Rita (老师)
messages.zh: 那是小乳房，bżejżla 就是小的 biżla。
messages.en: That's a small udder; bżejżla means a small biżla.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 biżla 和 bżejżla 配成大小图片卡，后者对应小乳房；记忆时同时保留人和动物两种语境。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An arrogant person who considers themselves better than other people.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 自认为高人一等、待人傲慢的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna arroganti li tqis lilha nfisha aħjar minn ħaddieħor.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 一个傲慢、自大的人。

formal.mt: Fir-rakkont, id-direttur jidher bħala bżiequ li ma jagħtix kas l-opinjonijiet tal-ħaddiema.
formal.en: In the story, the director appears as an arrogant person who disregards the workers' opinions.
formal.zh: 在故事中，主管被描写成一个无视员工意见的傲慢之人。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex ma tridx taħdem miegħu? Mark: Għax hu bżiequ; jaħseb li jaf kollox aħjar minn kulħadd.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why don't you want to work with him? Mark: Because he's an arrogant person; he thinks he knows everything better than everyone else.
colloquial.zh: Maja：你为什么不想和他共事？Mark：因为他是个自大的人，觉得自己什么都比别人懂。

messages.speaker: Maja (同事)
messages.zh: 你为什么不想和他共事？
messages.en: Why don't you want to work with him?

messages.speaker: Mark (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax hu bżiequ; jaħseb li jaf kollox aħjar minn kulħadd.
messages.mt_standard: Għax hu bżiequ; jaħseb li jaf kollox aħjar minn kulħadd.
messages.zh: 因为他是个自大的人，觉得自己什么都比别人懂。
messages.en: Because he's an arrogant person; he thinks he knows everything better than everyone else.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一个总说自己最懂、从不听别人意见的人，把这张人物卡标成 bżiequ，记住它是指人的名词。

gloss_zh: 使化为乌有；毁掉；轻视；贬低

teaching_sense.en_definition: To destroy something, reduce it to nothing, or treat someone or something as insignificant.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使某物毁灭、失去作用或化为乌有，也可指轻视某事或贬低某人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jeqred xi ħaġa jew inaqqasha għal xejn, jew li jqis lil xi ħadd jew xi ħaġa bla importanza.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使逐渐减少，直至完全消失或归于零。
毁掉；使遭到严重破坏或失败。
认为微不足道；不把某人或某事放在眼里。
贬低某人；用言语使人感到自己不受重视。

sense_translations.en_definition: to annihilate, to reduce to nothing
sense_translations.zh_definition: 彻底消灭；使完全化为乌有。

formal.mt: In-nar xejjen l-isforzi ta' diversi snin u qered il-materjal kollu maħżun fil-bini.
formal.en: The fire undid several years of effort and destroyed all the material stored in the building.
formal.zh: 这场火灾使数年的努力付诸东流，并烧毁了楼内存放的全部材料。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għaliex Lara ma tridx titkellem fil-laqgħa? Mark: Ilbieraħ Toni xejjen l-ideat tagħha quddiem kulħadd, u issa qed tħossha skomda.
colloquial.en: Sara: Why doesn't Lara want to speak at the meeting? Mark: Yesterday Toni dismissed her ideas in front of everyone, and now she feels uncomfortable.
colloquial.zh: Sara：Lara 为什么不愿意在会上发言？Mark：昨天 Toni 当着大家的面贬低她的想法，她现在觉得很不自在。

messages.speaker: Sara (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex Lara ma tridx titkellem fil-laqgħa?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex Lara ma tridx titkellem fil-laqgħa?
messages.zh: Lara 为什么不愿意在会上发言？
messages.en: Why doesn't Lara want to speak at the meeting?

messages.speaker: Mark (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Ilbieraħ Toni xejjen l-ideat tagħha quddiem kulħadd, u issa qed tħossha skomda.
messages.mt_standard: Ilbieraħ Toni xejjen l-ideat tagħha quddiem kulħadd, u issa qed tħossha skomda.
messages.zh: 昨天 Toni 当着大家的面贬低她的想法，她现在觉得很不自在。
messages.en: Yesterday Toni dismissed her ideas in front of everyone, and now she feels uncomfortable.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把它记成把价值或成果降到零：希望可以被摧毁，努力可以被抵消，人的想法也可能被贬低。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To move a hand or an object back and forth to signal or greet, or to swing an object.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 来回挥动手或物品以示意、打招呼，也可指挥舞或抡动某物。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jċaqlaq idu jew oġġett 'l hemm u 'l hawn biex jagħmel sinjal jew isellem, jew li jbandal oġġett.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 挥动；使手或物品来回摆动。
挥手致意；以动作向人表示问候或敬意。
挥舞或抡动手中拿着的物品。

sense_translations.en_definition: to wave (sign by moving something back and forth, e.g. one's hand, a flag)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 通过来回挥动手、旗帜等来示意。

formal.mt: Fi tmiem iċ-ċerimonja, ir-rappreżentant xejjer il-bandiera biex isellem lill-parteċipanti.
formal.en: At the end of the ceremony, the representative waved the flag to salute the participants.
formal.zh: 仪式结束时，代表挥动旗帜向参加者致意。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Mark rana meta konna fuq il-karozza tal-linja? Sara: Iva, xejjer idu hekk kif għaddejna minn ħdejh.
colloquial.en: Lara: Did Mark see us when we were on the bus? Sara: Yes, he waved his hand as we went past him.
colloquial.zh: Lara：我们在公交车上时，Mark 看见我们了吗？Sara：看见了，我们经过他身边时，他挥了挥手。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Mark rana meta konna fuq il-karozza tal-linja?
messages.mt_standard: Mark rana meta konna fuq il-karozza tal-linja?
messages.zh: 我们在公交车上时，Mark 看见我们了吗？
messages.en: Did Mark see us when we were on the bus?

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, xejjer idu hekk kif għaddejna minn ħdejh.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, xejjer idu hekk kif għaddejna minn ħdejh.
messages.zh: 看见了，我们经过他身边时，他挥了挥手。
messages.en: Yes, he waved his hand as we went past him.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象同一个来回挥动的动作：手用来打招呼，旗用来示意，棍子则是挥舞；根据所挥之物判断意思。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Nothing or none; a complete absence of things or an amount of zero.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 表示完全没有任何东西、数量为零或毫无所得。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Nuqqas sħiħ ta' affarijiet jew ammont ta' żero.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 零；没有任何数量或得分。
一个也没有；毫无。
没有任何东西；空无。
零；数量为零。
零；无。
没有什么；没有任何东西，常用于否定表达。

formal.mt: L-ispezzjoni ma sabet xejn li jindika ħsara fis-sistema.
formal.en: The inspection found nothing indicating damage to the system.
formal.zh: 检查未发现任何表明系统受损的迹象。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Sibt xi ħaġa fil-kexxun? Pawlu: Le, ma sibt xejn. Il-kexxun vojt.
colloquial.en: Rita: Did you find anything in the drawer? Pawlu: No, I found nothing. The drawer is empty.
colloquial.zh: Rita：你在抽屉里找到什么了吗？Pawlu：没有，什么也没找到。抽屉是空的。

messages.speaker: Rita (室友)
messages.zh: 你在抽屉里找到什么了吗？
messages.en: Did you find anything in the drawer?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, ma sibt xejn. Il-kexxun vojt.
messages.mt_standard: Le, ma sibt xejn. Il-kexxun vojt.
messages.zh: 没有，什么也没找到。抽屉是空的。
messages.en: No, I found nothing. The drawer is empty.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用空抽屉记住这个词：问有没有东西，回答什么也没有；再把空无与数量零联系起来。

gloss_zh: 倾向；趋势；调子；市场走势

teaching_sense.en_definition: A tendency or direction of development, or the general disposition or tone of someone or something.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 事物发展的倾向或趋势，也可指人的性情倾向或言语、文字的总体调子。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tendenza jew direzzjoni ta' żvilupp, jew l-inklinazzjoni jew it-ton ġenerali ta' persuna jew ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 性情；惯常表现出的态度或倾向。
倾向；较容易出现的行为或发展方向。
调子；言语或文字表现出的总体态度和气氛。
趋势；一段时间内逐渐显现的发展方向或流行风尚。
市场趋势；市场活动或价格变化的总体走向。
趋势；倾向；事物通常朝向的发展方向。

formal.mt: Iċ-ċifri juru xejra ċara lejn tnaqqis fil-konsum tal-ilma matul l-aħħar sena.
formal.en: The figures show a clear trend towards lower water consumption over the past year.
formal.zh: 这些数字显示，过去一年用水量呈明显下降趋势。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Qed nara ħafna nies b'dawn iż-żraben. Lara: Iva, din hi x-xejra ta' bħalissa, imma jien nippreferi żraben aktar sempliċi.
colloquial.en: Mark: I'm seeing lots of people wearing these shoes. Lara: Yes, that's the current trend, but I prefer simpler shoes.
colloquial.zh: Mark：我看到很多人都穿这种鞋。Lara：对，这是现在的潮流，不过我更喜欢简单一点的鞋。

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Qed nara ħafna nies b'dawn iż-żraben.
messages.mt_standard: Qed nara ħafna nies b'dawn iż-żraben.
messages.zh: 我看到很多人都穿这种鞋。
messages.en: I'm seeing lots of people wearing these shoes.

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, din hi x-xejra ta' bħalissa, imma jien nippreferi żraben aktar sempliċi.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, din hi x-xejra ta' bħalissa, imma jien nippreferi żraben aktar sempliċi.
messages.zh: 对，这是现在的潮流，不过我更喜欢简单一点的鞋。
messages.en: Yes, that's the current trend, but I prefer simpler shoes.

cognitive_memory_aid: 画一支表示总体走向的箭头来记：数据有趋势，市场有走势，人的态度和文字也有一定倾向。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To restrict movement with a chain, or to obstruct someone or slow the progress of something.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用链子限制活动，或阻挡某人、妨碍某事顺利进行。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jorbot b'katina biex jillimita l-moviment, jew li jfixkel lil xi ħadd jew il-progress ta' xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 用链子锁住或拴住，使活动受到限制。
阻碍；使行动或进展受到影响。
妨碍；阻挠；使行动困难或进展缓慢。

formal.mt: It-temp ħażin xekkel it-trasport tal-materjal u wassal għal dewmien fix-xogħol.
formal.en: The bad weather hampered the transport of materials and caused delays in the work.
formal.zh: 恶劣天气妨碍了材料运输，导致工作延误。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Għaliex ma stajtx tidħol fil-kamra? Toni: Xi ħadd ħalla bagalja wara l-bieb, u din xekklet il-bieb milli jinfetaħ.
colloquial.en: Rita: Why couldn't you get into the room? Toni: Someone left a suitcase behind the door, and it prevented the door from opening.
colloquial.zh: Rita：你为什么进不了房间？Toni：有人把行李箱放在门后，挡得门打不开。

messages.speaker: Rita (室友)
messages.zh: 你为什么进不了房间？
messages.en: Why couldn't you get into the room?

messages.speaker: Toni (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Xi ħadd ħalla bagalja wara l-bieb, u din xekklet il-bieb milli jinfetaħ.
messages.mt_standard: Xi ħadd ħalla bagalja wara l-bieb, u din xekklet il-bieb milli jinfetaħ.
messages.zh: 有人把行李箱放在门后，挡得门打不开。
messages.en: Someone left a suitcase behind the door, and it prevented the door from opening.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把画面记成行动受到限制：链子限制活动，行李挡住门，坏天气拖慢工作，都能帮助理解阻碍义。

gloss_zh: 起诉；控告；提起刑事指控

teaching_sense.en_definition: To accuse someone of an offence or bring a legal charge or action against them.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指控某人违法或犯罪，或通过法律程序对其提出控告、起诉。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jakkuża lil xi ħadd b'reat jew iressaq akkuża jew kawża kontrih quddiem il-qorti.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 起诉；向法院对某人提起诉讼。
正式提出刑事指控；起诉某人涉嫌犯罪。
控告；指控；正式起诉某人。

collocations.mt: xela lil xi ħadd quddiem il-qorti
collocations.en: brought a case against someone in court

collocations.mt: xela lil xi ħadd bla provi
collocations.zh: 在没有证据的情况下指控某人

formal.mt: Il-prosekutur xela lir-raġel b'serq; il-qorti għadha ma tatx sentenza.
formal.en: The prosecutor charged the man with theft; the court has not yet delivered a judgment.
formal.zh: 检察官指控该男子犯有盗窃罪；法院尚未作出判决。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għaliex Pawlu mar il-qorti? Mark: Il-ġar xela lil Pawlu b'serq, iżda Pawlu jgħid li huwa innoċenti.
colloquial.en: Sara: Why did Pawlu go to court? Mark: His neighbour accused Pawlu of theft, but Pawlu says he is innocent.
colloquial.zh: Sara：Pawlu 为什么去法院了？Mark：邻居指控 Pawlu 盗窃，但 Pawlu 说自己是无辜的。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: Pawlu 为什么去法院了？
messages.en: Why did Pawlu go to court?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-ġar xela lil Pawlu b'serq, iżda Pawlu jgħid li huwa innoċenti.
messages.mt_standard: Il-ġar xela lil Pawlu b'serq, iżda Pawlu jgħid li huwa innoċenti.
messages.zh: 邻居指控 Pawlu 盗窃，但 Pawlu 说自己是无辜的。
messages.en: His neighbour accused Pawlu of theft, but Pawlu says he is innocent.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用法庭里的指控画面记忆：谁控告谁、指控什么事，分别找出控告者、被控者和指控内容。

gloss_zh: 磕缺；削去一块；降价；违背承诺；轻挑球

teaching_sense.en_definition: To chip a piece off something, reduce a price or wage, break a promise or compromise a principle, or strike a football with the edge of the foot or with a light lofting touch.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使物体缺损一块，降低价格或工资，违背承诺或损害原则；在足球中也可指用脚的边缘击球或轻触挑起球。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jaqla' biċċa minn xi ħaġa, inaqqas prezz jew paga, jikser wegħda jew jikkomprometti prinċipju; fil-futbol, li jolqot il-ballun b'tarf siequ jew b'daqqa ħafifa biex jogħla.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 磕掉一小块；使边缘出现缺口。
打折；降低价格。

sense_translations.en_definition: to hit the ball with the edge of the foot (in football)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 在足球运动中用脚的边缘击球。

sense_translations.en_definition: to chip, to hew off a piece from
sense_translations.zh_definition: 削掉、凿掉或砍掉某物的一块。

sense_translations.en_definition: to break (a promise), to compromise (a principle)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 违背承诺；损害原则或在原则上作出妥协。
降低价格或工资。

sense_translations.en_definition: to chip (strike the ball lightly such that it ascends steeply)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 轻触挑球，使球以较陡的角度向上飞起。

collocations.en: chipped the edge of the tile
collocations.zh: 把瓷砖边缘磕缺了一块

formal.mt: Meta ċċaqlaq il-mejda, il-ħaddiem xellef it-tarf tal-maduma u rrapporta l-ħsara minnufih.
formal.en: While moving the table, the worker chipped the edge of the tile and immediately reported the damage.
formal.zh: 工人搬动桌子时把瓷砖边缘磕缺了一块，并立即报告了损坏情况。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Il-bejjiegħ xellef il-prezz? Toni: Iva, xellef il-prezz b'għaxar ewro meta staqsejtu għal skont.
colloquial.en: Rita: Did the seller lower the price? Toni: Yes, he lowered the price by ten euros when I asked him for a discount.
colloquial.zh: Rita：卖家降价了吗？Toni：降了，我问他能不能打折，他就便宜了十欧元。

messages.speaker: Rita (朋友)
messages.zh: 卖家降价了吗？
messages.en: Did the seller lower the price?

messages.speaker: Toni (顾客)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, xellef il-prezz b'għaxar ewro meta staqsejtu għal skont.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, xellef il-prezz b'għaxar ewro meta staqsejtu għal skont.
messages.zh: 降了，我问他能不能打折，他就便宜了十欧元。
messages.en: Yes, he lowered the price by ten euros when I asked him for a discount.

cognitive_memory_aid: 分场景记忆：瓷砖少一角、价格少一点、承诺被打破；足球义另配脚边击球和轻挑起球的动作画面。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The left side or the direction opposite to the right.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 左边、左侧，或与右方相反的方向。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: In-naħa jew id-direzzjoni opposta għal-lemin.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 左；左方。
左边；左侧。

formal.mt: Il-kamra tal-laqgħat tinsab fuq ix-xellug tad-daħla prinċipali.
formal.en: The meeting room is on the left of the main entrance.
formal.zh: 会议室位于主入口的左侧。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Fejn hu l-istazzjon? Pawlu: Dur lejn ix-xellug fit-tarf tat-triq. L-istazzjon qiegħed ħdejn il-ħanut.
colloquial.en: Lara: Where is the station? Pawlu: Turn left at the end of the street. The station is next to the shop.
colloquial.zh: Lara：车站在哪里？Pawlu：到街道尽头向左转。车站就在商店旁边。

messages.speaker: Lara (问路的游客)
messages.zh: 车站在哪里？
messages.en: Where is the station?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (当地居民)
messages.mt_spoken: Dur lejn ix-xellug fit-tarf tat-triq. L-istazzjon qiegħed ħdejn il-ħanut.
messages.mt_standard: Dur lejn ix-xellug fit-tarf tat-triq. L-istazzjon qiegħed ħdejn il-ħanut.
messages.zh: 到街道尽头向左转。车站就在商店旁边。
messages.en: Turn left at the end of the street. The station is next to the shop.

cognitive_memory_aid: 在纸上画一个向左的箭头，旁边写 xellug；静止位置配 fuq ix-xellug，移动方向配 lejn ix-xellug。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A galley or sailing ship; this spelling also has separate senses meaning hatred and centipede.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一种桨帆船或帆船；相同拼写另有“仇恨”和“蜈蚣”等独立义项，须根据上下文辨认。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Bastiment bil-qlugħ jew bl-imqadef; l-istess kelma għandha wkoll tifsiriet separati ta' mibegħda u ċentipied.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 仇恨；憎恨。
桨帆船；以桨划行、也可配有帆的船。
帆船；利用风帆航行的船。
蜈蚣。

formal.mt: Il-mużew jesibixxi mudell ta' xini bil-qlugħ u bl-imqadef.
formal.en: The museum displays a model of a galley with sails and oars.
formal.zh: 博物馆展出了一艘配有帆和桨的桨帆船模型。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Dak mudell ta' xini? Mark: Iva, ara l-qlugħ u l-imqadef żgħar tiegħu.
colloquial.en: Lara: Is that a model of a galley? Mark: Yes, look at its sails and little oars.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：那是桨帆船模型吗？马克：是啊，看看它的帆和小桨。

messages.speaker: Lara (参观者)
messages.zh: 那是桨帆船模型吗？
messages.en: Is that a model of a galley?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, ara l-qlugħ u l-imqadef żgħar tiegħu.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, ara l-qlugħ u l-imqadef żgħar tiegħu.
messages.zh: 是啊，看看它的帆和小桨。
messages.en: Yes, look at its sails and little oars.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 xini 画三张互不混合的提示图：仇恨表情、带帆和桨的船、蜈蚣；船图下面再分别标出“桨帆船”和“帆船”。

gloss_zh: 探头向外看；探身俯视；出现

teaching_sense.en_definition: To look out or down from a window, an edge, or a high position, often by leaning forward; also to emerge.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 从窗口、边缘或高处向外或向下看，常伴有探身动作；也可表示出现或露出。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ħares 'il barra jew 'l isfel minn tieqa, xifer jew post għoli, spiss billi miel 'il quddiem; ukoll deher jew ħareġ.

sense_translations.en_definition: to look out of a window
sense_translations.zh_definition: 从窗口向外看；探头望向窗外。
从边缘探身；将上身探出边缘。

sense_translations.en_definition: to look down from a vantage point
sense_translations.zh_definition: 从视野较好的高处向下看；居高俯视。

sense_translations.en_definition: to survey, overlook, look (down) from a vantage point
sense_translations.zh_definition: 从有利观察位置眺望、俯瞰或向下察看。
出现；露出；显现。

collocations.en: he looked out of the window
he leaned over to look down

formal.mt: Il-gwida xiref mit-tieqa tat-torri biex jara l-pjazza ta' taħt.
formal.en: The guide looked out of the tower window to see the square below.
formal.zh: 导游从塔楼的窗口探头向外看，以便看清下面的广场。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Għaliex Mark xiref mit-tieqa? David: Sema' ħoss fit-triq u ried jara x'ġara.
colloquial.en: Anna: Why did Mark look out of the window? David: He heard a noise in the street and wanted to see what happened.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：马克为什么从窗口探头往外看？戴维：他听到街上有响声，想看看发生了什么。

messages.speaker: Anna (室友)
messages.zh: 马克为什么从窗口探头往外看？
messages.en: Why did Mark look out of the window?

messages.speaker: David (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Sema' ħoss fit-triq u ried jara x'ġara.
messages.mt_standard: Sema' ħoss fit-triq u ried jara x'ġara.
messages.zh: 他听到街上有响声，想看看发生了什么。
messages.en: He heard a noise in the street and wanted to see what happened.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一个人从窗口探出头，再把目光移向楼下，用这个动作记住 xiref 的“探看、俯视”；“出现”义另外配一张露面图。

gloss_zh: 成为生意合伙人；作为合伙人

teaching_sense.en_definition: To become or be a partner or associate in a business.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 成为或作为某项生意中的合伙人、合作经营者。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Sar jew kien sieħeb f'negozju ma' persuna oħra.

sense_translations.en_definition: to become an associate in a business
sense_translations.zh_definition: 成为某项生意的合伙人；加入合作经营。
作为合伙人；处于合作伙伴关系中。

collocations.en: he became a partner in a business
collocations.zh: 他成为一家企业的合伙人

collocations.en: he went into partnership with his brother

formal.mt: Pawlu xirek ma' ħuh biex imexxu n-negozju tal-familja flimkien.
formal.en: Pawlu went into partnership with his brother to run the family business together.
formal.zh: 保罗与兄弟合伙，共同经营家族生意。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Smajt li Pawlu xirek ma' ħuh. Mark: Iva, issa jmexxu l-ħanut flimkien.
colloquial.en: Rita: I heard that Pawlu went into partnership with his brother. Mark: Yes, they now run the shop together.
colloquial.zh: 丽塔：我听说保罗和他兄弟合伙了。马克：是啊，他们现在一起经营那家店。

messages.speaker: Rita (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Smajt li Pawlu xirek ma' ħuh.
messages.mt_standard: Smajt li Pawlu xirek ma' ħuh.
messages.zh: 我听说保罗和他兄弟合伙了。
messages.en: I heard that Pawlu went into partnership with his brother.

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 是啊，他们现在一起经营那家店。
messages.en: Yes, they now run the shop together.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 xirek 记成一个经营场景：两个人一起开店，成为合伙人；搭配 ma' 回答“跟谁合伙”，搭配 f' 回答“参与什么生意”。

gloss_zh: 购物；一次购买；一趟采购

teaching_sense.en_definition: An act of buying or a shopping trip, including the shopping done on that occasion.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一次购买行为或一趟购物、采购活动，也可指该次购物。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Att ta' xiri jew ħarġa biex wieħed jixtri dak li għandu bżonn.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 购物；采购。
一番尽兴购物；集中大量购物。

sense_translations.en_definition: a purchase, an instance of buying
sense_translations.zh_definition: 一次购买；一笔购置。

sense_translations.en_definition: a shopping tour or errand, an instance of shopping
sense_translations.zh_definition: 一趟购物或采购；一次外出买东西的活动。

formal.mt: Qabel ix-xirja ta' kull ġimgħa, il-familja tħejji lista tal-prodotti meħtieġa.
formal.en: Before the weekly shopping, the family prepares a list of the products they need.
formal.zh: 每周采购之前，这家人都会列出所需物品的清单。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Se nagħmel xirja wara x-xogħol. Għandna bżonn xi ħaġa? Pawlu: Iva, ħalib u ħobż, jekk jogħġbok.
colloquial.en: Marija: I'm going shopping after work. Do we need anything? Pawlu: Yes, milk and bread, please.
colloquial.zh: 玛丽亚：我下班后去采购。我们需要什么吗？保罗：需要，请买些牛奶和面包。

messages.speaker: Marija (妻子)
messages.mt_spoken: Se nagħmel xirja wara x-xogħol. Għandna bżonn xi ħaġa?
messages.mt_standard: Se nagħmel xirja wara x-xogħol. Għandna bżonn xi ħaġa?
messages.zh: 我下班后去采购。我们需要什么吗？
messages.en: I'm going shopping after work. Do we need anything?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (丈夫)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, ħalib u ħobż, jekk jogħġbok.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, ħalib u ħobż, jekk jogħġbok.
messages.zh: 需要，请买些牛奶和面包。
messages.en: Yes, milk and bread, please.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象拿着一张采购清单出门，买完一袋东西回家：把整个“一趟购物”框起来记作 xirja，也能帮助记住“一次购买”。

gloss_zh: 协会；公司；教派；兄弟会；关联；共融

teaching_sense.en_definition: An association or community whose members share an activity, purpose, or bond; also a relationship or sense of fellowship.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 由共同活动、目标或纽带联系起来的协会、团体或社群；也可表示事物之间的关联或人与人之间的共融感。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Għaqda jew komunità ta' nies marbuta b'attività, għan jew rabta komuni; ukoll relazzjoni bejn affarijiet jew sens ta' għaqda bejn in-nies.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 协会；联合组织。
公司；商业组织。
教派；宗派。
兄弟会；以成员间共同纽带组成的团体。
事物之间的关联；联系；关系。
协会、社群、善会、行会或联盟。
共融；社群归属感；成员之间相互联结的感受。

formal.mt: Il-membri tax-xirka jorganizzaw attivitajiet biex isaħħu s-sens ta' xirka fost ir-residenti.
formal.en: The association's members organize activities to strengthen the sense of community among residents.
formal.zh: 协会成员组织各类活动，以增强居民之间的社群归属感。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Int membru tax-xirka tar-raħal? Mark: Iva, niltaqgħu kull xahar u norganizzaw attivitajiet flimkien.
colloquial.en: Anna: Are you a member of the village association? Mark: Yes, we meet every month and organize activities together.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：你是村里协会的成员吗？马克：是啊，我们每个月聚一次，一起组织活动。

messages.speaker: Anna (邻居)
messages.zh: 你是村里协会的成员吗？
messages.en: Are you a member of the village association?

messages.speaker: Mark (协会成员)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, niltaqgħu kull xahar u norganizzaw attivitajiet flimkien.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, niltaqgħu kull xahar u norganizzaw attivitajiet flimkien.
messages.zh: 是啊，我们每个月聚一次，一起组织活动。
messages.en: Yes, we meet every month and organize activities together.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“一群人围成圈”记 xirka：圈内的人组成协会或社群，彼此的连线表示关联，大家在一起的感受表示共融与归属。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An evil supernatural being, such as a devil or demon; also a person described as very wicked.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 魔鬼或恶魔一类邪恶的超自然存在；也可用来形容十分邪恶的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ħlejqa sopranaturali ħażina, bħal demonju; ukoll persuna deskritta bħala ħażina ħafna.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 魔鬼。
恶魔；邪魔。
恶人；心肠邪恶的人。
一个魔鬼；一个恶魔。

sense_translations.en_definition: the Devil; Satan (lord of all demons and adversary of God)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 魔王；撒旦，即统领众恶魔、与上帝为敌者的专名。

formal.mt: Fir-rakkont, ix-xitan jipprova jqarraq bil-protagonist permezz ta' wegħdiet foloz.
formal.en: In the story, the devil tries to deceive the protagonist through false promises.
formal.zh: 故事中，魔鬼试图用虚假的承诺欺骗主人公。

colloquial.mt: Lara: X'se tilbes għall-festa tal-kostumi? Mark: Kostum ta' xitan, bil-qrun u denb aħmar.
colloquial.en: Lara: What are you going to wear to the costume party? Mark: A devil costume, with horns and a red tail.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：化装派对你准备穿什么？马克：一套魔鬼装扮，带角和红色尾巴。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 化装派对你准备穿什么？
messages.en: What are you going to wear to the costume party?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Kostum ta' xitan, bil-qrun u denb aħmar.
messages.mt_standard: Kostum ta' xitan, bil-qrun u denb aħmar.
messages.zh: 一套魔鬼装扮，带角和红色尾巴。
messages.en: A devil costume, with horns and a red tail.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用故事里的魔鬼形象记 xitan，再分出“恶魔”和比喻性的“恶人”；专指撒旦时另设专名卡，避免把普通名词与专名混为一谈。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Winter, the coldest season of the year.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 冬天；一年中最寒冷的季节。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-istaġun tas-sena li fih ikun l-aktar kiesaħ.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 冬天；冬季。
冬季，指一年四季中的冬天。

formal.mt: Fix-xitwa, il-ġranet ikunu iqsar u t-temperaturi jkunu aktar baxxi milli fis-sajf.
formal.en: In winter, the days are shorter and temperatures are lower than in summer.
formal.zh: 冬季的白昼比夏季短，气温也比夏季低。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Tħobb ix-xitwa? Pawlu: Iva, inħobb noqgħod id-dar b'tazza te meta jkun il-bard.
colloquial.en: Marija: Do you like winter? Pawlu: Yes, I like staying home with a cup of tea when it's cold.
colloquial.zh: 玛丽亚：你喜欢冬天吗？保罗：喜欢，天冷的时候我喜欢待在家里喝杯茶。

messages.speaker: Marija (朋友)
messages.zh: 你喜欢冬天吗？
messages.en: Do you like winter?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, inħobb noqgħod id-dar b'tazza te meta jkun il-bard.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, inħobb noqgħod id-dar b'tazza te meta jkun il-bard.
messages.zh: 喜欢，天冷的时候我喜欢待在家里喝杯茶。
messages.en: Yes, I like staying home with a cup of tea when it's cold.

cognitive_memory_aid: 画一杯热茶和一件厚外套，把 xitwa 写在旁边记“冬天”；再整块记住 fix-xitwa，表达“在冬天”时直接调用这个短语。

gloss_zh: 老人；长者；年老的；有智慧的

teaching_sense.en_definition: An elderly person, especially an old man; in some contexts, an elder valued for experience.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 年长的人，尤指老年男子；在某些语境中也指因经验丰富而受到重视的长者。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna ta' età avvanzata, speċjalment raġel; f'ċerti kuntesti, anzjan apprezzat għall-esperjenza tiegħu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 老人；年老的人。
长者；年长的前辈。
老年人；年长市民。
年老的；上了年纪的。
有智慧的；明智的。
老年男子；老翁。

sense_translations.en_definition: an experienced person; an expert in experience
sense_translations.zh_definition: 经验丰富的人；阅历深厚的行家。
社群中的长者；社区中受尊重的年长成员。

formal.mt: Ix-xiħ qasam l-esperjenzi tiegħu mal-istudenti waqt laqgħa fil-librerija.
formal.en: The old man shared his experiences with the students during a meeting at the library.
formal.zh: 这位老人在图书馆的一次会面中向学生们分享了自己的经历。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Min hu dak ix-xiħ ħdejn il-bieb? Pawlu: Dak in-nannu tiegħi. Qed jistennieni.
colloquial.en: Marija: Who is that old man by the door? Pawlu: That's my grandfather. He's waiting for me.
colloquial.zh: 玛丽亚：门边那位老人是谁？保罗：那是我爷爷。他在等我。

messages.speaker: Marija (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Min hu dak ix-xiħ ħdejn il-bieb?
messages.mt_standard: Min hu dak ix-xiħ ħdejn il-bieb?
messages.zh: 门边那位老人是谁？
messages.en: Who is that old man by the door?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.zh: 那是我爷爷。他在等我。
messages.en: That's my grandfather. He's waiting for me.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 xiħ 放进两张学习卡：xiħ għaqli 是“睿智的老人”，raġel xiħ 是“年老的男子”；用位置区分名词和形容词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To want something or wish for something to happen.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 想要某种事物，或希望某件事情发生。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li tkun trid xi ħaġa jew ikollok xewqa li sseħħ xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 希望；但愿
对某人怀有情欲；强烈地渴求
渴望；欲求
渴望；希望
想要；想做

formal.mt: L-istudent xtaq ikompli l-istudji tiegħu fl-università.
formal.en: The student wished to continue his studies at university.
formal.zh: 这名学生希望到大学继续深造。

colloquial.mt: Marta: Xi xtaq jagħmel Pawlu fi tmiem il-ġimgħa? Luqa: Xtaq imur il-baħar magħna.
colloquial.en: Marta: What did Pawlu want to do at the weekend? Luqa: He wanted to go to the seaside with us.
colloquial.zh: 玛尔塔：保罗周末想做什么？卢卡：他想和我们一起去海边。

messages.speaker: Marta (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Xi xtaq jagħmel Pawlu fi tmiem il-ġimgħa?
messages.mt_standard: Xi xtaq jagħmel Pawlu fi tmiem il-ġimgħa?
messages.zh: 保罗周末想做什么？
messages.en: What did Pawlu want to do at the weekend?

messages.speaker: Luqa (朋友)
messages.zh: 他想和我们一起去海边。
messages.en: He wanted to go to the seaside with us.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 xtaq 记成心里的愿望清单：想学习、想回家、想去海边，都从“想要”这个核心意思联想。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To obtain something by paying money for it.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 通过支付金钱取得某件物品，即买下或购买。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li tikseb xi ħaġa billi tħallas il-flus għaliha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 买；购买
生孩子；分娩
贿赂；收买
买；购入
购物；买东西

formal.mt: Il-kunsill xtara tagħmir ġdid għal-librerija pubblika.
formal.en: The council purchased new equipment for the public library.
formal.zh: 地方议会为公共图书馆购置了新设备。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Min xtara dan il-kejk? Mark: Pawlu xtara l-kejk għall-festa ta' għada.
colloquial.en: Sara: Who bought this cake? Mark: Pawlu bought the cake for tomorrow's party.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：这个蛋糕是谁买的？马克：保罗买的，是为明天的聚会准备的。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 这个蛋糕是谁买的？
messages.en: Who bought this cake?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Pawlu xtara l-kejk għall-festa ta' għada.
messages.mt_standard: Pawlu xtara l-kejk għall-festa ta' għada.
messages.zh: 保罗买的，是为明天的聚会准备的。
messages.en: Pawlu bought the cake for tomorrow's party.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象付款后拿到一本书，把 xtara 与“付钱买到”绑定；“生孩子”和“收买”则分别建立独立语境卡片。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To chew or ruminate, or figuratively to think something over carefully.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 咀嚼或反刍食物；也可比喻反复思考、仔细考虑某事。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li tomgħod jew terġa' tomgħod l-ikel; b'mod figurattiv, li taħseb sew dwar xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 咀嚼
沉思；仔细思量
咀嚼；反刍
考虑；斟酌

formal.mt: Qabel ma wieġeb, Pawlu xtarr bir-reqqa l-proposta tal-kumitat.
formal.en: Before replying, Pawlu carefully considered the committee's proposal.
formal.zh: 保罗在答复之前，仔细斟酌了委员会的提议。

colloquial.mt: Marta: Pawlu xtarr sew il-proposta? Luqa: Iva, u ddeċieda li jaċċettaha.
colloquial.en: Marta: Did Pawlu think the proposal over carefully? Luqa: Yes, and he decided to accept it.
colloquial.zh: 玛尔塔：保罗仔细考虑过这个提议了吗？卢卡：考虑过了，他决定接受。

messages.speaker: Marta (同事)
messages.zh: 保罗仔细考虑过这个提议了吗？
messages.en: Did Pawlu think the proposal over carefully?

messages.speaker: Luqa (同事)
messages.zh: 考虑过了，他决定接受。
messages.en: Yes, and he decided to accept it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用中文“反复咀嚼一个想法”联想 xtarr：嘴里咀嚼食物，脑里反复斟酌，把具体和比喻两种用法一起记住。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be thrown, to throw oneself somewhere, or to lie down.
