teaching_sense.zh_definition: 被抛出，主动纵身扑向某处，或使身体躺下。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li tintrema, titfa' lilek innifsek f'xi post, jew timtedd.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被扔出；被抛出
纵身扑去；使自己猛地扑向某处
躺下；卧倒

formal.mt: Wara l-vjaġġ twil, ir-raġel xteħet fuq is-sodda biex jistrieħ.
formal.en: After the long journey, the man lay down on the bed to rest.
formal.zh: 长途旅行之后，这名男子躺到床上休息。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Fejn hu Mark? Luqa: Xteħet fuq is-sufan għax kien għajjien.
colloquial.en: Sara: Where is Mark? Luqa: He lay down on the sofa because he was tired.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：马克在哪儿？卢卡：他累了，躺到沙发上去了。

messages.speaker: Sara (室友)
messages.zh: 马克在哪儿？
messages.en: Where is Mark?

messages.speaker: Luqa (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Xteħet fuq is-sufan għax kien għajjien.
messages.mt_standard: Xteħet fuq is-sufan għax kien għajjien.
messages.zh: 他累了，躺到沙发上去了。
messages.en: He lay down on the sofa because he was tired.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象累极了把自己往沙发上一放，用这个动作记住 xteħet 的“扑去、躺下”；遇到被动语境再判断为“被抛出”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person employed to drive a car for other people.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 受雇为他人驾驶汽车的人，尤其指专职司机。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna impjegata biex issuq karozza għal nies oħra.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 专职司机；受雇为他人开车的人

formal.mt: Ix-xufier wassal lill-mistednin mil-lukanda sal-ajruport.
formal.en: The chauffeur drove the guests from the hotel to the airport.
formal.zh: 司机开车把宾客从酒店送到了机场。

colloquial.mt: Marta: Ix-xufier wasal? Mark: Iva, qed jistenniena quddiem il-lukanda.
colloquial.en: Marta: Has the chauffeur arrived? Mark: Yes, he is waiting for us in front of the hotel.
colloquial.zh: 玛尔塔：司机到了吗？马克：到了，他正在酒店门口等我们。

messages.speaker: Marta (旅客)
messages.zh: 司机到了吗？
messages.en: Has the chauffeur arrived?

messages.speaker: Mark (同行旅客)
messages.zh: 到了，他正在酒店门口等我们。
messages.en: Yes, he is waiting for us in front of the hotel.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 xufier 放进“酒店门口有人开车接你”的画面，先记清它指驾驶的人，再用“私人司机”搭配巩固。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A piece of absorbent cloth used to dry the hands or body.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用于擦干双手或身体的吸水布巾，可指毛巾或浴巾。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Biċċa drapp li tassorbi l-ilma u tintuża biex tnixxef l-idejn jew il-ġisem.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 浴巾；洗澡后擦干身体用的大毛巾
毛巾；擦干用的布巾

formal.mt: Il-lukanda tipprovdi xugaman nadif għal kull mistieden.
formal.en: The hotel provides a clean towel for each guest.
formal.zh: 酒店为每位宾客提供一条干净的毛巾。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Tista' tagħtini xugaman nadif? Luqa: Iva, hemm wieħed fuq l-ixkaffa ħdejn il-bieb.
colloquial.en: Sara: Can you give me a clean towel? Luqa: Yes, there is one on the shelf beside the door.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：能给我一条干净的毛巾吗？卢卡：可以，门旁边的架子上有一条。

messages.speaker: Sara (室友)
messages.zh: 能给我一条干净的毛巾吗？
messages.en: Can you give me a clean towel?

messages.speaker: Luqa (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, hemm wieħed fuq l-ixkaffa ħdejn il-bieb.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, hemm wieħed fuq l-ixkaffa ħdejn il-bieb.
messages.zh: 可以，门旁边的架子上有一条。
messages.en: Yes, there is one on the shelf beside the door.

cognitive_memory_aid: 洗手或洗澡后，想象伸手拿 xugaman 擦干水分；把小毛巾和大浴巾放在同一幅画面里记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A reciprocal pronoun showing that two or more people act toward one another.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 表示两人或多人之间相互关系或相互动作的代词，相当于“彼此、互相”。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Pronom li juri li żewġ persuni jew aktar jagħmlu azzjoni waħda lejn l-oħra.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 彼此；互相
彼此；互相；相互

formal.mt: L-istudenti jgħinu lil xulxin biex jifhmu l-lezzjoni.
formal.en: The students help one another understand the lesson.
formal.zh: 学生们互相帮助，以理解这堂课的内容。

colloquial.mt: Marta: Int u Sara tafu lil xulxin? Luqa: Iva, nafu lil xulxin mill-iskola.
colloquial.en: Marta: Do you and Sara know each other? Luqa: Yes, we know each other from school.
colloquial.zh: 玛尔塔：你和萨拉互相认识吗？卢卡：认识，我们上学时就认识了。

messages.speaker: Marta (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Int u Sara tafu lil xulxin?
messages.mt_standard: Int u Sara tafu lil xulxin?
messages.zh: 你和萨拉互相认识吗？
messages.en: Do you and Sara know each other?

messages.speaker: Luqa (朋友)
messages.zh: 认识，我们上学时就认识了。
messages.en: Yes, we know each other from school.

cognitive_memory_aid: 画两个人之间来回的双向箭头，把 xulxin 记成“彼此”；再分别练习“互相帮助”和“彼此交谈”的完整搭配。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Affected by alcohol, from being tipsy to being drunk.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 因饮酒而处于醉酒状态的，可依语境表示微醺或明显喝醉。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jkun taħt l-effett tal-alkoħol, kemm jekk ikun xorob ftit iżżejjed kif ukoll jekk ikun fis-sakra.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 醉的；喝醉的
醉酒的；受酒精影响的
微醺的；略有醉意的
喝醉的；处于醉酒状态的

formal.mt: Skont ir-rapport, ir-raġel kien xurban meta wasal id-dar.
formal.en: According to the report, the man was drunk when he arrived home.
formal.zh: 根据报告，这名男子到家时处于醉酒状态。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Mark hu xurban? Luqa: Iva, se nieħdu d-dar b'taxi.
colloquial.en: Sara: Is Mark drunk? Luqa: Yes, I'll take him home by taxi.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：马克喝醉了吗？卢卡：是的，我会坐出租车送他回家。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 马克喝醉了吗？
messages.en: Is Mark drunk?

messages.speaker: Luqa (朋友)
messages.zh: 是的，我会坐出租车送他回家。
messages.en: Yes, I'll take him home by taxi.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 xurban 放在“他喝醉了”的人物状态卡上；从微醺到明显醉酒的程度，要结合上下文和修饰语判断。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To become famous or widely known.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 变得出名，让许多人认识或知道自己。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Isir famuż jew magħruf minn ħafna nies.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 成名；变得出名。

formal.mt: Il-kantant xxieher wara li ħareġ l-ewwel album tiegħu.
formal.en: The singer became famous after releasing his first album.
formal.zh: 这位歌手在发行首张专辑后成名了。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Dan hu l-attur li xxieher bis-serje l-ġdida? Mark: Iva, issa kulħadd jaf min hu.
colloquial.en: Maja: Is this the actor who became famous through the new series? Mark: Yes, now everyone knows who he is.
colloquial.zh: Maja：这就是凭那部新剧出名的演员吗？Mark：是啊，现在大家都认识他了。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Dan hu l-attur li xxieher bis-serje l-ġdida?
messages.mt_standard: Dan hu l-attur li xxieher bis-serje l-ġdida?
messages.zh: 这就是凭那部新剧出名的演员吗？
messages.en: Is this the actor who became famous through the new series?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, issa kulħadd jaf min hu.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, issa kulħadd jaf min hu.
messages.zh: 是啊，现在大家都认识他了。
messages.en: Yes, now everyone knows who he is.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 xxieher 和“首张专辑发行后，人人都认识他”的画面一起记，抓住从无名到成名的变化。

gloss_zh: 与人结交；加入团体；合作

teaching_sense.en_definition: To associate oneself with others, join a group or organisation, or become someone's partner.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使自己与他人建立联系，加入某个组织或团体，或与他人结为合作伙伴。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jingħaqad ma' oħrajn, jidħol fi grupp jew organizzazzjoni, jew isir sieħeb ta' xi ħadd.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使自己与他人建立联系；与他人结交。
加入某个组织或团体。
与他人结为伙伴；合伙；合作。

formal.mt: Pawlu xxierek ma' grupp ta' voluntiera biex jgħin fil-komunità.
formal.en: Pawlu joined a group of volunteers to help in the community.
formal.zh: Pawlu 加入了一个志愿者团体，为社区提供帮助。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Pawlu xxierek magħkom fil-proġett? Lara: Iva, issa qed naħdmu flimkien.
colloquial.en: Sara: Did Pawlu partner with you on the project? Lara: Yes, we're working together now.
colloquial.zh: Sara：Pawlu 加入你们一起做这个项目了吗？Lara：是啊，我们现在一起工作。

messages.speaker: Sara (同事)
messages.zh: Pawlu 加入你们一起做这个项目了吗？
messages.en: Did Pawlu partner with you on the project?

messages.speaker: Lara (同事)
messages.zh: 是啊，我们现在一起工作。
messages.en: Yes, we're working together now.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一个人走进团队，与大家握手合作：xxierek 可沿着“结交、加入、合伙”这条意义线记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A liquid or semi-liquid preparation served with food for flavour, including gravy made with meat juices.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 搭配食物以增加风味的液体或半液体调味品，也可指用肉汁制成的浇汁。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Taħlita likwida jew ħoxna li tingħata mal-ikel biex iżżid it-togħma, inkluża dik magħmula mill-meraq tal-laħam.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 酱汁；调味汁。
肉汁；用烹煮肉类所得汁液制成的浇汁。

formal.mt: Servi l-laħam mixwi ma' zalza magħmula mill-meraq tiegħu u ma' patata msajra fil-forn.
formal.en: Serve the roast meat with gravy made from its juices and with oven-roasted potatoes.
formal.zh: 将烤肉配上用其原汁制成的肉汁，并搭配烤土豆食用。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Trid aktar zalza mal-għaġin? Sara: Iva, ftit oħra, jekk jogħġbok. Din iz-zalza tat-tadam tajba ħafna!
colloquial.en: Mark: Would you like more sauce with your pasta? Sara: Yes, a little more, please. This tomato sauce is really good!
colloquial.zh: 马克：你的意大利面要再加点酱汁吗？萨拉：好，请再加一点。这番茄酱汁真好吃！

messages.speaker: Mark (主人)
messages.zh: 你的意大利面要再加点酱汁吗？
messages.en: Would you like more sauce with your pasta?

messages.speaker: Sara (客人)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, ftit oħra, jekk jogħġbok. Din iz-zalza tat-tadam tajba ħafna!
messages.mt_standard: Iva, ftit oħra, jekk jogħġbok. Din iz-zalza tat-tadam tajba ħafna!
messages.zh: 好，请再加一点。这番茄酱汁真好吃！
messages.en: Yes, a little more, please. This tomato sauce is really good!

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象把一勺 zalza 浇在食物上：浇在面上可记“酱汁”，由烤肉原汁制成时可记“肉汁”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A food made from seasoned minced meat packed into a casing.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把调味后的肉馅灌入肠衣制成的食物，即香肠。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ikel magħmul minn laħam ikkapuljat u mħawwar, magħluq f'kisja.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 香肠。
阴茎；以香肠作比喻的俚语说法。

formal.mt: Il-menu tal-ikla jinkludi zalzett mixwi bil-ħaxix.
formal.en: The lunch menu includes grilled sausage with vegetables.
formal.zh: 午餐菜单包括配蔬菜的烤香肠。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Trid zalzett mal-ħobż? Mark: Iva, jekk jogħġbok, imma mingħajr mustarda.
colloquial.en: Maja: Would you like sausage with your bread? Mark: Yes, please, but without mustard.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你想用香肠配面包吗？马克：好的，谢谢，不过不要芥末。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你想用香肠配面包吗？
messages.en: Would you like sausage with your bread?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, jekk jogħġbok, imma mingħajr mustarda.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, jekk jogħġbok, imma mingħajr mustarda.
messages.zh: 好的，谢谢，不过不要芥末。
messages.en: Yes, please, but without mustard.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 zalzett 放进“面包夹香肠”的画面中记忆；遇到身体相关语境时，再判断是否用了俚语义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To sing, especially when describing the song of certain birds.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 发出歌声，尤其用于描述某些鸟的鸣唱。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ikanta, speċjalment meta jingħad għal ċerti għasafar.

sense_translations.en_definition: to sing (used of certain types of birds)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 鸣唱，啼唱；用于某些种类的鸟。
歌唱，唱歌。

formal.mt: Waqt l-osservazzjoni, l-għasfur zamzam għal ftit minuti fuq fergħa qrib it-tieqa.
formal.en: During the observation, the bird sang for a few minutes on a branch near the window.
formal.zh: 观察期间，那只鸟在靠近窗户的树枝上鸣唱了几分钟。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Smajt l-għasfur dalgħodu? Paul: Iva, zamzam eżatt ħdejn it-tieqa tiegħi.
colloquial.en: Lara: Did you hear the bird this morning? Paul: Yes, it sang right beside my window.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：你今天早上听见那只鸟了吗？保罗：听见了，它就在我的窗边鸣唱。

messages.speaker: Lara (室友)
messages.zh: 你今天早上听见那只鸟了吗？
messages.en: Did you hear the bird this morning?

messages.speaker: Paul (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, zamzam eżatt ħdejn it-tieqa tiegħi.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, zamzam eżatt ħdejn it-tieqa tiegħi.
messages.zh: 听见了，它就在我的窗边鸣唱。
messages.en: Yes, it sang right beside my window.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 zamzam 的两个相同字母组当成两句短短的鸟歌来朗读；这是帮助记忆鸣唱义的课堂联想。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To dig or loosen soil using a hoe or a mattock.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使用锄头或鹤嘴锄挖掘、翻松土壤。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Iħaffer jew iqalleb il-ħamrija b'zappun.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 用锄头挖土或翻土。
用鹤嘴锄挖土。

collocations.en: dug the field with a hoe
dug around the trees with a hoe
collocations.zh: 用锄头翻松了树木周围的土

formal.mt: Il-bidwi zappan il-ħamrija qabel ma ħawwel il-ħxejjex.
formal.en: The farmer dug the soil with a hoe before planting the vegetables.
formal.zh: 农夫种菜之前，先用锄头翻了土。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Min zappan din il-biċċa tal-ġnien? Ġanni: Missieri. Issa nistgħu nħawlu l-fjuri.
colloquial.en: Anna: Who dug this part of the garden with a hoe? Ġanni: My father. Now we can plant the flowers.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：谁用锄头翻了花园里的这一块地？詹尼：我爸爸。现在我们可以种花了。

messages.speaker: Anna (朋友)
messages.zh: 谁用锄头翻了花园里的这一块地？
messages.en: Who dug this part of the garden with a hoe?

messages.speaker: Ġanni (朋友)
messages.zh: 我爸爸。现在我们可以种花了。
messages.en: My father. Now we can plant the flowers.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 zappan 记成“挥锄翻土”的动作，把 zappun 记成手中的工具；用动作与实物的对照区分两词。

gloss_zh: 跛行；进展不稳；不健全；致跛之物；跛行者

teaching_sense.en_definition: To walk unevenly because one leg or foot cannot move normally.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 因一条腿或一只脚不能正常活动而一瘸一拐地走路。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jimxi b'pass mhux indaqs minħabba diffikultà f'sieq jew f'riġel.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 跛行，一瘸一拐地走。
进展不稳，时进时停地艰难推进。
使人跛行或行走不稳的东西。
跛行的人，走路一瘸一拐的人。
不健全，不稳固；存在缺陷或问题。

formal.mt: Wara li weġġa' siequ, il-plejer zappap sa tarf il-grawnd.
formal.en: After injuring his foot, the player limped to the edge of the pitch.
formal.zh: 那名球员脚部受伤后，一瘸一拐地走到了球场边。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex Mark zappap sal-karozza? Lara: Weġġa' siequ waqt il-logħba.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why did Mark limp to the car? Lara: He hurt his foot during the game.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：马克为什么一瘸一拐地走到车旁？拉拉：他比赛时伤了脚。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 马克为什么一瘸一拐地走到车旁？
messages.en: Why did Mark limp to the car?

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 他比赛时伤了脚。
messages.en: He hurt his foot during the game.

cognitive_memory_aid: 先用 zappap 联想一深一浅的脚步，再把这种“不稳”联系到进展和状态；名词义另记为人或致跛之物。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A long-handled digging tool, such as a mattock or hoe, used to break up or loosen soil.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用于挖土、破土或松土的长柄工具，可指鹤嘴锄或锄头。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Għodda b'manku twil u b'ras tal-ħadid, użata biex tħaffer jew tqalleb il-ħamrija.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 鹤嘴锄，用于刨挖或破开土层的长柄工具。
锄头，用于松土、翻土或除草的农具。

collocations.en: to dig with a hoe or mattock

formal.mt: Il-ħaddiem uża zappun biex ikisser il-ħamrija iebsa qabel it-tħawwil.
formal.en: The worker used a mattock to break up the hard soil before planting.
formal.zh: 工人在种植前用鹤嘴锄刨松了坚硬的土壤。

colloquial.mt: Paul: Fejn hu ż-zappun? Anna: Fil-barrakka, ħdejn il-pala.
colloquial.en: Paul: Where is the hoe? Anna: In the shed, next to the shovel.
colloquial.zh: 保罗：锄头在哪里？安娜：在棚子里，铲子旁边。

messages.speaker: Paul (园艺伙伴)
messages.zh: 锄头在哪里？
messages.en: Where is the hoe?

messages.speaker: Anna (园艺伙伴)
messages.zh: 在棚子里，铲子旁边。
messages.en: In the shed, next to the shovel.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给工具图片标上 zappun，给挥动工具翻土的图片标上 zappan；一张记物品，一张记动作，避免混淆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To make short, high bird calls or to sing like a bird.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 发出短促而尖细的鸟叫声，或像鸟一样啁啾鸣唱。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jagħmel ħsejjes qosra u rqaq jew ikanta, bħalma jagħmlu l-għasafar.

sense_translations.en_definition: to chirp, to peep, to sing
sense_translations.zh_definition: 啁啾，发出啾啾声，鸣唱。

formal.mt: L-għasfur żgħir zejjez fil-bejta waqt li l-osservaturi baqgħu 'l bogħod.
formal.en: The little bird chirped in the nest while the observers kept their distance.
formal.zh: 小鸟在巢里啾啾鸣叫，观察者则保持着距离。

colloquial.mt: Nina: X'kien dak il-ħoss? Ġanni: Għasfur żgħir zejjez fis-siġra ta' ħdejna.
colloquial.en: Nina: What was that sound? Ġanni: A little bird chirped in the tree beside us.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：刚才那是什么声音？詹尼：一只小鸟在我们旁边的树上啾啾叫了。

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.zh: 刚才那是什么声音？
messages.en: What was that sound?

messages.speaker: Ġanni (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għasfur żgħir zejjez fis-siġra ta' ħdejna.
messages.mt_standard: Għasfur żgħir zejjez fis-siġra ta' ħdejna.
messages.zh: 一只小鸟在我们旁边的树上啾啾叫了。
messages.en: A little bird chirped in the tree beside us.

cognitive_memory_aid: 读 zejjez 时想象巢中小鸟连续发出短短的“啾、啾”声，用声音画面帮助记住啁啾和鸣唱义。

gloss_zh: 说闲话；发嘶声；啁啾；反复咂舌表示不赞同

teaching_sense.en_definition: To gossip by talking informally about other people's private affairs.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在非正式交谈中议论别人的私事，闲聊八卦。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jitkellem fuq il-ħajja privata ta' ħaddieħor u jgħid it-tpaċpiċ.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 说闲话，议论别人的私事，聊八卦。
发出嘶嘶声。
嘶叫，发嘶声。
啁啾，发出连续而轻快的鸟叫声。

sense_translations.en_definition: to utter a number of repeated [t͡s]-sounds to express disapproval
sense_translations.zh_definition: 反复发出 [t͡s] 音，以咂舌声表达不赞同或不满。

formal.mt: Fir-rakkont, il-karattru zekzek fuq il-ġirien u xerred aħbarijiet mhux ikkonfermati.
formal.en: In the story, the character gossiped about the neighbours and spread unconfirmed news.
formal.zh: 故事中的这个人物议论邻居的私事，还传播了未经证实的消息。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Pawlu reġa' zekzek fuq il-ġirien? Maja: Iva, imma jien biddilt is-suġġett.
colloquial.en: Lara: Did Pawlu gossip about the neighbours again? Maja: Yes, but I changed the subject.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：保罗又议论邻居的私事了吗？玛雅：是啊，不过我换了话题。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 保罗又议论邻居的私事了吗？
messages.en: Did Pawlu gossip about the neighbours again?

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 是啊，不过我换了话题。
messages.en: Yes, but I changed the subject.

cognitive_memory_aid: 为 zekzek 画五个提示图：聊天的人、嘶声、嘶叫、鸣鸟、咂舌的人；按语境分别取义，不把所有声音都理解成八卦。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To play cymbals, including by striking a pair together.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 演奏铙钹，包括把两片钹相互碰击以发声。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Idoqq iċ-ċimbali, fosthom billi jħabbat waħda mal-oħra.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 把两片钹相互碰击，使其发声。
演奏铙钹，敲钹。

collocations.en: played the cymbals during the march
collocations.zh: 在进行曲演奏期间敲了钹

formal.mt: Fl-aħħar tal-biċċa mużikali, il-perkussjonista zenzen biċ-ċimbali biex jenfasizza l-aħħar nota.
formal.en: At the end of the musical piece, the percussionist played the cymbals to emphasize the final note.
formal.zh: 乐曲结束时，打击乐手敲响了铙钹，以突出最后一个音。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Min zenzen biċ-ċimbali fil-kunċert? Nina: Ħija. Kien l-ewwel kunċert tiegħu mal-banda.
colloquial.en: Mark: Who played the cymbals at the concert? Nina: My brother. It was his first concert with the band.
colloquial.zh: 马克：音乐会上是谁演奏铙钹的？妮娜：我哥哥。那是他第一次随乐队参加音乐会。

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 音乐会上是谁演奏铙钹的？
messages.en: Who played the cymbals at the concert?

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ħija. Kien l-ewwel kunċert tiegħu mal-banda.
messages.mt_standard: Ħija. Kien l-ewwel kunċert tiegħu mal-banda.
messages.zh: 我哥哥。那是他第一次随乐队参加音乐会。
messages.en: My brother. It was his first concert with the band.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 zenzen 的两个相同字母组想象成左右两片钹，双手一合发出响声；用这个动作记住碰钹与演奏义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To produce a song or melody with the voice.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用嗓音唱出歌曲或旋律。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tkanta għanja jew melodija bil-leħen.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 唱；歌唱。

formal.mt: Waqt il-kunċert tal-iskola, Mark zewwaq għanja quddiem il-ġenituri.
formal.en: During the school concert, Mark sang a song in front of the parents.
formal.zh: 在学校音乐会上，马克在家长们面前唱了一首歌。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Min zewwaq fil-festa? Lara: Mark zewwaq għanja, u aħna ċapċapna.
colloquial.en: Maja: Who sang at the party? Lara: Mark sang a song, and we clapped.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：谁在聚会上唱歌了？拉拉：马克唱了一首歌，我们都鼓掌了。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 谁在聚会上唱歌了？
messages.en: Who sang at the party?

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Mark zewwaq għanja, u aħna ċapċapna.
messages.mt_standard: Mark zewwaq għanja, u aħna ċapċapna.
messages.zh: 马克唱了一首歌，我们都鼓掌了。
messages.en: Mark sang a song, and we clapped.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把这个词放进学校音乐会的画面：一人开口唱歌，朋友拍手回应，借场景记住“歌唱”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To speak offensively to or about someone in order to insult them.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 对某人或针对某人说冒犯性的话，以言语侮辱对方。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tgħid kliem offensiv lil xi ħadd jew dwaru biex tinsultah.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 说侮辱性的话；发表辱人的言论。
侮辱；辱骂。

collocations.en: made insulting remarks in front of everyone
collocations.zh: 当着大家的面说了侮辱性的话

formal.mt: Waqt il-laqgħa, ir-raġel ziek lil kollega tiegħu, u l-president tal-laqgħa talab li jitkellem b'rispett.
formal.en: During the meeting, the man insulted a colleague, and the chair asked him to speak respectfully.
formal.zh: 会议期间，那名男子辱骂了一位同事，会议主持人要求他尊重他人、注意言辞。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex Lara telqet? Mark: Pawlu ziek lil oħtha, u hi rrabjat.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why did Lara leave? Mark: Pawlu insulted her sister, and she got angry.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：拉拉为什么走了？马克：保罗辱骂了她的姐妹，她生气了。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 拉拉为什么走了？
messages.en: Why did Lara leave?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Pawlu ziek lil oħtha, u hi rrabjat.
messages.mt_standard: Pawlu ziek lil oħtha, u hi rrabjat.
messages.zh: 保罗辱骂了她的姐妹，她生气了。
messages.en: Pawlu insulted her sister, and she got angry.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象争吵时一句伤人的话让对方生气离开，把词义连到“出言侮辱”的后果来记。

gloss_zh: 姑母；姨母；伯母；婶母；舅母

teaching_sense.en_definition: A sister of one's mother or father, or the wife of one's uncle.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 父亲或母亲的姐妹，或叔伯舅等男性长辈的妻子；具体中文称谓由亲属关系决定。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Oħt ommok jew missierek, jew il-mara ta' zijuk.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 姑母、姨母，或伯母、婶母、舅母等；中文称谓须按具体亲属关系确定。

formal.mt: Iz-zija tiegħi, oħt ommi, ġiet iżżurna nhar il-Ħadd.
formal.en: My aunt, my mother's sister, came to visit us on Sunday.
formal.zh: 我的姨母，也就是我母亲的姐妹，星期日来看望了我们。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Min ġej għall-ikel? Lara: Iz-zija Rita, oħt ommi. Se ġġib kejk.
colloquial.en: Maja: Who's coming for the meal? Lara: Aunt Rita, my mother's sister. She's bringing a cake.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：谁要来吃饭？拉拉：丽塔姨母，就是我妈妈的姐妹。她会带一个蛋糕来。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 谁要来吃饭？
messages.en: Who's coming for the meal?

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iz-zija Rita, oħt ommi. Se ġġib kejk.
messages.mt_standard: Iz-zija Rita, oħt ommi. Se ġġib kejk.
messages.zh: 丽塔姨母，就是我妈妈的姐妹。她会带一个蛋糕来。
messages.en: Aunt Rita, my mother's sister. She's bringing a cake.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 zija 和 ziju 配对记：本词末尾是 a，给它配上女性亲属的照片；中文再按家谱选称谓。

gloss_zh: 伯父；叔父；舅父；姑父；姨父

teaching_sense.en_definition: A brother of one's mother or father, or the husband of one's aunt.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 父亲或母亲的兄弟，或姑母、姨母的丈夫；具体中文称谓由亲属关系决定。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ħu ommok jew missierek, jew ir-raġel ta' zijtek.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 伯父、叔父、舅父、姑父或姨父等；中文称谓须按具体亲属关系确定。

formal.mt: Iz-ziju tiegħi, ħu ommi, jaħdem bħala għalliem fi skola primarja.
formal.en: My uncle, my mother's brother, works as a teacher at a primary school.
formal.zh: 我的舅父，也就是我母亲的兄弟，在一所小学任教。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Min se jiġi jiġborek? Mark: Iz-ziju Pawlu, ħu ommi. Se jasal dalwaqt.
colloquial.en: Lara: Who's coming to pick you up? Mark: Uncle Pawlu, my mother's brother. He'll be here soon.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：谁会来接你？马克：保罗舅父，就是我妈妈的兄弟。他很快就到。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 谁会来接你？
messages.en: Who's coming to pick you up?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iz-ziju Pawlu, ħu ommi. Se jasal dalwaqt.
messages.mt_standard: Iz-ziju Pawlu, ħu ommi. Se jasal dalwaqt.
messages.zh: 保罗舅父，就是我妈妈的兄弟。他很快就到。
messages.en: Uncle Pawlu, my mother's brother. He'll be here soon.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 ziju 和 zija 放在同一张家谱上，本词末尾的 u 配男性亲属照片，再辨认叔、舅、姑父等关系。

gloss_zh: 用抵住食指的拇指把坚果弹入小洞

teaching_sense.en_definition: To flick a nut into a hole using the thumb pressed against the forefinger.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 将拇指抵住食指，再用拇指弹击坚果，使它进入小洞。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tagħti daqqa lil lewża b'sebgħek il-kbir magħfus mas-saba' l-werrej biex iddaħħalha f'ħofra.

sense_translations.en_definition: to strike a nut with one's thumb pressed against the forefinger into a hole
sense_translations.zh_definition: 用抵住食指的拇指弹击坚果，将它弹入小洞。

collocations.en: flicked a nut with the thumb
flicked a hazelnut into the hole

formal.mt: It-tifel għafas sebgħu l-kbir mas-saba' l-werrej u zikka ġellewża fil-ħofra.
formal.en: The boy pressed his thumb against his forefinger and flicked a hazelnut into the hole.
formal.zh: 男孩把拇指抵住食指，将一颗榛子弹进了小洞。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Kif daħlet il-ġellewża fil-ħofra? Mark: Pawlu zikka l-ġellewża b'sebgħu l-kbir. Ħares, se jerġa' jipprova.
colloquial.en: Maja: How did the hazelnut get into the hole? Mark: Pawlu flicked it with his thumb. Look, he's going to try again.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：榛子怎么进洞了？马克：保罗用拇指把它弹进去了。看，他又要试一次。

messages.speaker: Maja (玩伴)
messages.zh: 榛子怎么进洞了？
messages.en: How did the hazelnut get into the hole?

messages.speaker: Mark (玩伴)
messages.mt_spoken: Pawlu zikka l-ġellewża b'sebgħu l-kbir. Ħares, se jerġa' jipprova.
messages.mt_standard: Pawlu zikka l-ġellewża b'sebgħu l-kbir. Ħares, se jerġa' jipprova.
messages.zh: 保罗用拇指把它弹进去了。看，他又要试一次。
messages.en: Pawlu flicked it with his thumb. Look, he's going to try again.

cognitive_memory_aid: 按三个动作记忆：拇指抵食指、弹击坚果、坚果进洞；把整个动作画面与 zikka 绑定。

gloss_zh: 用榛子、其他坚果或珠子玩的马耳他儿童游戏

teaching_sense.en_definition: A Maltese children's game played with hazelnuts or other nuts, or with beads.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一种马耳他儿童游戏，使用榛子、其他坚果或珠子作为游戏物件。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Logħba tat-tfal f'Malta li tintlagħab bil-ġellewż, b'lewż ieħor jew biż-żibeġ.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 一种用榛子玩的儿童游戏。

sense_translations.en_definition: a Maltese children's game played with beads or nuts
sense_translations.zh_definition: 一种用珠子或坚果玩的马耳他儿童游戏。

collocations.zh: 用榛子玩的 zikketta 游戏
用珠子玩的 zikketta 游戏

formal.mt: Matul l-attività, it-tfal lagħbu ż-zikketta bil-ġellewż, filwaqt li l-għalliema osservat il-logħba.
formal.en: During the activity, the children played zikketta with hazelnuts while the teacher observed the game.
formal.zh: 活动期间，孩子们用榛子玩 zikketta 游戏，老师在一旁观察。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Trid tilgħab iż-zikketta? Mark: Iva! Għandek il-ġellewż? Maja: Le, imma għandi ż-żibeġ.
colloquial.en: Maja: Do you want to play zikketta? Mark: Yes! Do you have the hazelnuts? Maja: No, but I have beads.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：想玩 zikketta 吗？马克：想！你有榛子吗？玛雅：没有，不过我有珠子。

messages.speaker: Maja (玩伴)
messages.zh: 想玩 zikketta 吗？
messages.en: Do you want to play zikketta?

messages.speaker: Mark (玩伴)
messages.zh: 想！你有榛子吗？
messages.en: Yes! Do you have the hazelnuts?

messages.speaker: Maja (玩伴)
messages.zh: 没有，不过我有珠子。
messages.en: No, but I have beads.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象孩子拿出两袋游戏用品，一袋榛子、一袋珠子；把 zikketta 记成这场游戏的名称。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The trunk of a tree, a log, or the stem of a plant; also the stem of a word in grammar.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 可指树干、砍下的一段原木或植物的茎；在语法中也指词干。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-parti ewlenija tas-siġra, biċċa njama maqtugħa minnha, jew il-parti li ġġorr il-weraq u l-fjuri ta' pjanta; fil-grammatika, il-parti ta' kelma li magħha jiżdiedu elementi oħra.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 树干；树木主要的木质干体。
原木；砍下的一段树干或粗木段。
植物的茎；支承叶片、花等部分的主轴。
词干；词中可与其他构词或屈折成分结合的部分。
树木的干；树干。

formal.mt: L-istudenti kejlu l-ħxuna taz-zokk tas-siġra u rreġistraw ir-riżultat.
formal.en: The students measured the thickness of the tree trunk and recorded the result.
formal.zh: 学生们测量了树干的粗细，并记录了结果。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Tista' tgħinni nġorr dan iz-zokk? Mark: Iva, imma huwa tqil. Naqbduh flimkien.
colloquial.en: Maja: Can you help me carry this log? Mark: Yes, but it's heavy. Let's lift it together.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你能帮我搬这段原木吗？马克：可以，不过它很重。我们一起抬吧。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你能帮我搬这段原木吗？
messages.en: Can you help me carry this log?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, imma huwa tqil. Naqbduh flimkien.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, imma huwa tqil. Naqbduh flimkien.
messages.zh: 可以，不过它很重。我们一起抬吧。
messages.en: Yes, but it's heavy. Let's lift it together.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用四格图记忆：树上的干、砍下的木段、花的茎、词的词干；这是学习联想，不是词源解释。

gloss_zh: 糖；糖尿病；可爱讨喜的人

teaching_sense.en_definition: A sweet substance used in food and drinks; also diabetes, or, figuratively, a pleasant and lovable person.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用于食品和饮料的糖；也可指糖尿病，或比喻亲切、可爱、讨人喜欢的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Sustanza ħelwa li tintuża fl-ikel u fix-xorb; jista' jfisser ukoll id-dijabete jew, b'mod figurattiv, persuna ħelwa u simpatika.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 糖；用于食品或饮料的甜味物质。
糖尿病。
亲切讨喜的人；像糖一样甜美可爱的人。

collocations.zh: 那位女士亲切又讨人喜欢

formal.mt: Ir-riċetta titlob mitt gramma zokkor, li jitħallat mal-bajd qabel jiżdied id-dqiq.
formal.en: The recipe calls for one hundred grams of sugar, which is mixed with the eggs before the flour is added.
formal.zh: 食谱要求使用一百克糖，先将糖与鸡蛋混合，再加入面粉。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Trid iz-zokkor fil-kafè? Mark: Le, grazzi, bla zokkor. Lara: U n-nannu tiegħek kif inhu? Mark: Tajjeb, grazzi. Għandu z-zokkor, imma llum ħareġ jimxi.
colloquial.en: Lara: Do you want sugar in your coffee? Mark: No, thanks, no sugar. Lara: And how is your grandfather? Mark: He's well, thanks. He has diabetes, but he went out for a walk today.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：咖啡里要加糖吗？马克：不用，谢谢，不加糖。拉拉：你祖父怎么样？马克：他挺好的，谢谢。他有糖尿病，不过今天出门散步了。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 咖啡里要加糖吗？
messages.en: Do you want sugar in your coffee?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 不用，谢谢，不加糖。
messages.en: No, thanks, no sugar.

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 你祖父怎么样？
messages.en: And how is your grandfather?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Tajjeb, grazzi. Għandu z-zokkor, imma llum ħareġ jimxi.
messages.mt_standard: Tajjeb, grazzi. Għandu z-zokkor, imma llum ħareġ jimxi.
messages.zh: 他挺好的，谢谢。他有糖尿病，不过今天出门散步了。
messages.en: He's well, thanks. He has diabetes, but he went out for a walk today.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用三张卡分开记：糖罐对应食物，健康谈话对应糖尿病，笑脸对应讨喜的人；靠上下文选义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Unable to walk properly because of a problem with a foot or leg; figuratively, weak or unconvincing.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 因脚或腿有问题而行走不便、跛足的；也可比喻理由或论点不充分、站不住脚。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li ma jistax jimxi sew minħabba problema f'siequ jew f'riġlu; b'mod figurattiv, dgħajjef jew mhux konvinċenti.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 跛足的；行走不便的。
腿脚残疾、行动不便的。

sense_translations.en_definition: lame (unable to walk properly because of a problem with one's feet or legs)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 跛足的，即因脚或腿有问题而不能正常行走的。
不充分的；不可靠的；指论点等站不住脚的。

formal.mt: Dan huwa argument zopp, għax il-konklużjoni ma taqbilx mal-fatti ppreżentati.
formal.en: This is an unsound argument because the conclusion does not agree with the facts presented.
formal.zh: 这个论点站不住脚，因为结论与所列事实不符。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Dak il-kelb zopp? Qed jimxi bil-mod ħafna. Mark: Iva, weġġa' siequ. Ejja nagħtuh ftit spazju.
colloquial.en: Maja: Does that dog have a limp? It's walking very slowly. Mark: Yes, it hurt its leg. Let's give it some space.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：那只狗是不是跛脚了？它走得很慢。马克：是的，它伤了腿。我们给它留点空间吧。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Dak il-kelb zopp? Qed jimxi bil-mod ħafna.
messages.mt_standard: Dak il-kelb zopp? Qed jimxi bil-mod ħafna.
messages.zh: 那只狗是不是跛脚了？它走得很慢。
messages.en: Does that dog have a limp? It's walking very slowly.

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, weġġa' siequ. Ejja nagħtuh ftit spazju.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, weġġa' siequ. Ejja nagħtuh ftit spazju.
messages.zh: 是的，它伤了腿。我们给它留点空间吧。
messages.en: Yes, it hurt its leg. Let's give it some space.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 zopp 配上两幅图记忆：狗走路一瘸一拐，论点也像腿脚不稳一样站不住脚。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A carrot: a vegetable with a long, usually orange root that can be eaten raw or cooked.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 胡萝卜，一种食用根部的蔬菜，根通常呈橙色，可以生吃或煮熟食用。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ħaxixa b'għerq twil, ġeneralment oranġjo, li jittiekel nej jew imsajjar.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 胡萝卜。

formal.mt: Għall-insalata, aħsel zunnarija friska, qaxxarha u ħokkha qabel iżżidha mal-ħaxix l-ieħor.
formal.en: For the salad, wash a fresh carrot, peel it and grate it before adding it to the other vegetables.
formal.zh: 制作沙拉时，先洗净一根新鲜胡萝卜，去皮擦丝，再加入其他蔬菜中。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Trid zunnarija fl-insalata? Luqa: Iva, imma ħokkha, jekk jogħġbok. Nippreferiha hekk.
colloquial.en: Sara: Would you like a carrot in the salad? Luqa: Yes, but please grate it. I prefer it that way.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：沙拉里要放一根胡萝卜吗？卢卡：要，不过请把它擦成丝。我更喜欢那样吃。

messages.speaker: Sara (室友)
messages.zh: 沙拉里要放一根胡萝卜吗？
messages.en: Would you like a carrot in the salad?

messages.speaker: Luqa (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, imma ħokkha, jekk jogħġbok. Nippreferiha hekk.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, imma ħokkha, jekk jogħġbok. Nippreferiha hekk.
messages.zh: 要，不过请把它擦成丝。我更喜欢那样吃。
messages.en: Yes, but please grate it. I prefer it that way.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记 zunnarija 时想象一根橙色胡萝卜，按洗净、去皮、擦丝的顺序把单词和厨房动作连起来。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An open area belonging to a church, especially the paved space immediately in front of its entrance.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 属于教堂的室外庭院或空地，尤指紧邻教堂入口的铺砌前庭或广场。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Spazju miftuħ li jagħmel parti mill-knisja, speċjalment il-parti pavimentata quddiem id-daħla tagħha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 教堂庭院；教堂周围所属的空地。
教堂入口前的前庭或广场，通常为铺砌的开放空间。

collocations.en: to meet in the church forecourt

formal.mt: Il-viżitaturi huma mitluba jistennew fuq iz-zuntier tal-knisja sakemm jinfetħu l-bibien.
formal.en: Visitors are asked to wait in the church forecourt until the doors open.
formal.zh: 请访客在教堂前庭等候，直至大门开启。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Fejn niltaqgħu qabel il-kunċert? Pawlu: Fuq iz-zuntier tal-knisja, ħdejn it-taraġ.
colloquial.en: Anna: Where shall we meet before the concert? Pawlu: In the church forecourt, beside the steps.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：音乐会开始前我们在哪里碰面？保罗：在教堂前庭，台阶旁边。

messages.speaker: Anna (朋友)
messages.zh: 音乐会开始前我们在哪里碰面？
messages.en: Where shall we meet before the concert?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.zh: 在教堂前庭，台阶旁边。
messages.en: In the church forecourt, beside the steps.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 zuntier 想成约朋友等候的教堂门前空地：先到前庭，再走上台阶进入教堂。

gloss_zh: 拖着脚走；落在队伍后面

teaching_sense.en_definition: To walk slowly with dragging steps, or to fall behind others while walking.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 拖着脚步缓慢行走，或在行进时逐渐落在其他人后面。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jimxi bil-mod billi jkaxkar saqajh, jew jibqa' lura waqt li jkun miexi ma' oħrajn.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 行进时掉队；零散而缓慢地跟在后面。
拖着脚走；脚步拖沓地缓慢行进。

collocations.zh: 他拖拖拉拉地落在队伍后面

collocations.en: he dragged his feet along the road

formal.mt: Matul il-mixja, wieħed mill-parteċipanti zzakkak wara l-grupp minħabba l-għeja, u l-gwida waqfet tistennieh.
formal.en: During the walk, one participant straggled behind the group because of tiredness, and the guide stopped to wait for him.
formal.zh: 步行途中，一名参与者因疲劳而拖着脚落在队伍后面，向导停下来等他。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex Ben wasal warajkom? Mark: Kien għajjien u zzakkak wara l-grupp. Stennejnieh ħdejn il-bank.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why did Ben arrive after you? Mark: He was tired and straggled behind the group. We waited for him beside the bench.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：本怎么比你们晚到？马克：他累了，拖着脚落在队伍后面。我们在长椅旁等了他。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 本怎么比你们晚到？
messages.en: Why did Ben arrive after you?

messages.speaker: Mark (同行朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Kien għajjien u zzakkak wara l-grupp. Stennejnieh ħdejn il-bank.
messages.mt_standard: Kien għajjien u zzakkak wara l-grupp. Stennejnieh ħdejn il-bank.
messages.zh: 他累了，拖着脚落在队伍后面。我们在长椅旁等了他。
messages.en: He was tired and straggled behind the group. We waited for him beside the bench.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记 zzakkak 时想象远足者累得抬不起脚，鞋底拖地，和前面的队伍越离越远。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To hang loosely, with a part left slack or dangling instead of being held firmly in place.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 松散地悬挂或下垂，某一部分没有固定好，也没有拉紧。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jiddendel b'mod laxk, b'parti mhux marbuta sew jew mhux miġbuda.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 松松地悬挂；松垂；耷拉着。

collocations.en: the belt dangled loosely at the side

formal.mt: Wara li nħallet l-għoqda, il-ħabel zzakkar minn tarf il-mejda kważi sal-art.
formal.en: After the knot came undone, the rope hung loosely from the edge of the table almost to the floor.
formal.zh: 绳结松开后，绳子从桌边松垂下来，几乎碰到地面。

colloquial.mt: Sara: X'ġara mill-ħabel li rabatt mal-mejda? Luqa: Inħallet l-għoqda u l-ħabel zzakkar minn tarf il-mejda. Se nerġa' norbtu.
colloquial.en: Sara: What happened to the rope you tied to the table? Luqa: The knot came undone and the rope hung loosely from the table's edge. I'll tie it again.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：你绑在桌子上的绳子怎么了？卢卡：绳结松了，绳子从桌边垂了下来。我会重新绑好。

messages.speaker: Sara (室友)
messages.zh: 你绑在桌子上的绳子怎么了？
messages.en: What happened to the rope you tied to the table?

messages.speaker: Luqa (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Inħallet l-għoqda u l-ħabel zzakkar minn tarf il-mejda. Se nerġa' norbtu.
messages.mt_standard: Inħallet l-għoqda u l-ħabel zzakkar minn tarf il-mejda. Se nerġa' norbtu.
messages.zh: 绳结松了，绳子从桌边垂了下来。我会重新绑好。
messages.en: The knot came undone and the rope hung loosely from the table's edge. I'll tie it again.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 zzakkar 和松开的绳结连起来：绳子失去拉力，从桌边软软垂下，就是松垂的画面。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To annoy someone through repeated remarks or demands, or to provoke someone into reacting or acting.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用反复的话语或要求烦扰、惹恼某人，或通过刺激、激将促使对方作出反应或行动。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Idejjaq lil xi ħadd bi kliem jew talbiet ripetuti, jew jipprovokah biex jirreaġixxi jew jagħmel xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使烦躁；惹恼；使不耐烦。
刺激或激将某人，促使其作出反应或采取行动。
反复唠叨、纠缠催逼；刺激或激将。

collocations.en: he annoyed his brother with questions
collocations.zh: 他不断提问，把兄弟惹烦了

collocations.en: he goaded his friend into speaking

formal.mt: Waqt id-diskussjoni, wieħed mill-parteċipanti zzika lil sieħbu b'kummenti ripetuti sakemm dan wieġeb irrabjat.
formal.en: During the discussion, one participant goaded his companion with repeated comments until the latter replied angrily.
formal.zh: 讨论期间，一名参与者反复出言刺激同伴，直到对方愤怒地回应。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Għaliex ħuk telaq mill-kamra? Ben: Għax Mark zzika lil ħija bl-istess mistoqsija. Ħija ried ftit kwiet.
colloquial.en: Anna: Why did your brother leave the room? Ben: Because Mark annoyed him by repeating the same question. My brother wanted some quiet.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：你兄弟为什么离开房间了？本：因为马克反复问同一个问题，把他惹烦了。他想清静一下。

messages.speaker: Anna (朋友)
messages.zh: 你兄弟为什么离开房间了？
messages.en: Why did your brother leave the room?

messages.speaker: Ben (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax Mark zzika lil ħija bl-istess mistoqsija. Ħija ried ftit kwiet.
messages.mt_standard: Għax Mark zzika lil ħija bl-istess mistoqsija. Ħija ried ftit kwiet.
messages.zh: 因为马克反复问同一个问题，把他惹烦了。他想清静一下。
messages.en: Because Mark annoyed my brother by repeating the same question. My brother wanted some quiet.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记 zzika 时想象有人不停重复同一句话：听者先烦躁，再被刺激得开口，把惹烦和激将连在一起。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A very fine, thin edge, described as a feather edge.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 极细薄的边缘，称为羽状薄缘。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tarf fin u rqiq ħafna.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 羽状薄缘，即极细薄的边缘。

formal.mt: Il-ħaddiem lesta ċ-ċaffront b'attenzjoni biex it-tarf ikun irqiq u uniformi.
formal.en: The worker carefully finished the feather edge so that it was thin and even.
formal.zh: 工人仔细修整羽状薄缘，使边缘薄而均匀。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Dan it-tarf irqiq ħafna għandu isem? Pawlu: Iva, jgħidulu ċaffront.
colloquial.en: Lara: Does this very thin edge have a name? Pawlu: Yes, it's called a feather edge.
colloquial.zh: Lara：这种很薄的边缘有专门的名称吗？Pawlu：有，叫 ċaffront，也就是羽状薄缘。

messages.speaker: Lara (学徒)
messages.mt_spoken: Dan it-tarf irqiq ħafna għandu isem?
messages.mt_standard: Dan it-tarf irqiq ħafna għandu isem?
messages.zh: 这种很薄的边缘有专门的名称吗？
messages.en: Does this very thin edge have a name?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (师傅)
messages.zh: 有，叫 ċaffront，也就是羽状薄缘。
messages.en: Yes, it's called a feather edge.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把边缘想象得像羽毛一样细薄，并在图上标注 ċaffront；这只是帮助记忆薄缘形状的画面。

gloss_zh: 溅泼弄脏；表面湿泥；黏滑物

teaching_sense.en_definition: Splashing that spatters oneself or others; also, wet mud on a surface or slimy matter.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 溅泼液体而弄脏自己或他人的行为；也指表面的湿泥，或黏滑的物质。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tixrid ta' likwidu li jħammeġ lil min jagħmlu jew lil ħaddieħor; ukoll, tajn imxarrab fuq wiċċ jew materjal viskuż u jiżloq.

sense_translations.en_definition: act of splashing and bespattering oneself or others
sense_translations.zh_definition: 溅泼液体、使自己或他人沾上污点的行为。

sense_translations.en_definition: mire (on a surface, e.g. after rain)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 表面上的湿泥、泥泞，例如雨后地面上的烂泥。
黏滑物；黏糊糊、滑溜溜的物质。

formal.mt: Wara x-xita, iċ-ċaflis għatta l-mogħdija u ħammeġ iż-żraben tal-mixi.
formal.en: After the rain, mire covered the path and dirtied the walking shoes.
formal.zh: 雨后，湿泥覆盖了小路，弄脏了步行鞋。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Bil-mod biż-żebgħa! X'inhu dan iċ-ċaflis kollu? Mark: Għandek raġun, ħammeġt lili nnifsi u lilek ukoll. Ħa nnaddaf.
colloquial.en: Sara: Easy with the paint! What's all this spattering? Mark: You're right, I've got it on myself and on you too. I'll clean up.
colloquial.zh: Sara：油漆拿稳点！怎么溅得到处都是？Mark：你说得对，我把自己和你都弄脏了。我来清理。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Bil-mod biż-żebgħa! X'inhu dan iċ-ċaflis kollu?
messages.mt_standard: Bil-mod biż-żebgħa! X'inhu dan iċ-ċaflis kollu?
messages.zh: 油漆拿稳点！怎么溅得到处都是？
messages.en: Easy with the paint! What's all this spattering?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandek raġun, ħammeġt lili nnifsi u lilek ukoll. Ħa nnaddaf.
messages.mt_standard: Għandek raġun, ħammeġt lili nnifsi u lilek ukoll. Ħa nnaddaf.
messages.zh: 你说得对，我把自己和你都弄脏了。我来清理。
messages.en: You're right, I've got it on myself and on you too. I'll clean up.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 ċaflis 做三格图：油漆溅脏衣服、雨后地面湿泥、石面黏滑物，分别记住行为、泥泞和黏滑物三个义项。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To make something flat by pressing or working it.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 通过按压或加工，使某物变得平坦。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jagħmel xi ħaġa ċatta billi jagħfasha jew jaħdimha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 压平；使变平。

collocations.zh: 把一张金属薄板弄平了

formal.mt: Il-ħaddiem ċaftar il-biċċa tafal sakemm il-wiċċ tagħha sar lixx u ċatt.
formal.en: The worker flattened the piece of clay until its surface became smooth and flat.
formal.zh: 工人把那块黏土压平，直到表面变得光滑平坦。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'għamel Pawlu bit-tafal? Lara: Ċaftar it-tafal b'idejh biex jagħmel bażi ċatta.
colloquial.en: Maja: What did Pawlu do with the clay? Lara: He flattened it with his hands to make a flat base.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：保罗把黏土怎么处理了？拉拉：他用手把它压平，做一个平坦的底座。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 保罗把黏土怎么处理了？
messages.en: What did Pawlu do with the clay?

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ċaftar it-tafal b'idejh biex jagħmel bażi ċatta.
messages.mt_standard: Ċaftar it-tafal b'idejh biex jagħmel bażi ċatta.
messages.zh: 他用手把黏土压平，做一个平坦的底座。
messages.en: He flattened it with his hands to make a flat base.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象手掌把一团鼓起的黏土压成薄饼，用这个动作记住 ċaftar 的“压平”。

gloss_zh: 戏水溅水；海面的小浪起伏

teaching_sense.en_definition: Splashing about in water; also, the uneven movement of a choppy sea.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在水中活动而溅起水花的行为；也指海面小浪不断、起伏不平的状态。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tixrid u tħabbat tal-ilma waqt il-logħob jew il-moviment; ukoll, taqlib tal-wiċċ tal-baħar b'mewġ żgħir.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 在水中活动、拍打而溅起水花的行为。
海面短小波浪不断、起伏不平的状态。

formal.mt: Iċ-ċafċif tal-baħar għamel il-vjaġġ bid-dgħajsa inqas komdu.
formal.en: The choppiness of the sea made the boat trip less comfortable.
formal.zh: 海面不断的小浪起伏使这趟乘船旅程不太舒适。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'inhu dan iċ-ċafċif kollu? Mark: It-tfal qed jilagħbu fl-ilma u jxarrbu lil xulxin.
colloquial.en: Maja: What's all this splashing? Mark: The children are playing in the water and getting each other wet.
colloquial.zh: Maja：怎么溅起这么多水花？Mark：孩子们在水里玩，互相泼得湿淋淋的。

messages.speaker: Maja (母亲)
messages.zh: 怎么溅起这么多水花？
messages.en: What's all this splashing?

messages.speaker: Mark (父亲)
messages.mt_spoken: It-tfal qed jilagħbu fl-ilma u jxarrbu lil xulxin.
messages.mt_standard: It-tfal qed jilagħbu fl-ilma u jxarrbu lil xulxin.
messages.zh: 孩子们在水里玩，互相泼得湿淋淋的。
messages.en: The children are playing in the water and getting each other wet.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两幅水面图记 ċafċif：一幅是孩子戏水溅花，一幅是海上小浪起伏，分别对应行为和海况。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Small stones, especially rounded ones, considered together.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 小石子的集合，尤其指形状较圆的小卵石。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ġebel żgħir, speċjalment tond, meqjus flimkien.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 小卵石；小石子。

formal.mt: Il-mogħdija tal-ġnien kienet miksija biċ-ċagħak biex toħloq wiċċ dekorattiv.
formal.en: The garden path was covered with pebbles to create a decorative surface.
formal.zh: 花园小径铺上了小石子，形成具有装饰效果的路面。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Għaliex qed timxi daqshekk bil-mod? Nina: Hemm ħafna ċagħak hawn, u qed nidħol bih fiż-żraben.
colloquial.en: Mark: Why are you walking so slowly? Nina: There are lots of pebbles here, and I'm getting them in my shoes.
colloquial.zh: 马克：你怎么走得这么慢？妮娜：这里有很多小石子，一直往我的鞋里钻。

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 你怎么走得这么慢？
messages.en: Why are you walking so slowly?

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Hemm ħafna ċagħak hawn, u qed nidħol bih fiż-żraben.
messages.mt_standard: Hemm ħafna ċagħak hawn, u qed nidħol bih fiż-żraben.
messages.zh: 这里有很多小石子，一直往我的鞋里钻。
messages.en: There are lots of pebbles here, and I'm getting them in my shoes.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 ċagħak 和鞋底踩过一片小石子的触感联系起来，记住它表示成片的小卵石。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Small stones, often rounded and smooth, considered as a group.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 成群或成片的小石子，常指圆润光滑的小卵石。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ġebel żgħir, spiss tond u lixx, meqjus bħala grupp.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 小卵石；小石子。

formal.mt: Il-bajja hija miksija biċ-ċagħaq, u l-ilma jagħmel il-kuluri tal-ġebel aktar ċari.
formal.en: The beach is covered with pebbles, and the water makes the colours of the stones more distinct.
formal.zh: 海滩上铺满了小卵石，海水使石子的颜色更加鲜明。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Din bajja bir-ramel? Toni: Le, hija bajja taċ-ċagħaq. Ara kemm hu lixx dan il-ġebel!
colloquial.en: Sara: Is this a sandy beach? Toni: No, it's a pebble beach. Look how smooth these stones are!
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：这是沙滩吗？托尼：不是，这是卵石海滩。看，这些石子多光滑！

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 这是沙滩吗？
messages.en: Is this a sandy beach?

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, hija bajja taċ-ċagħaq. Ara kemm hu lixx dan il-ġebel!
messages.mt_standard: Le, hija bajja taċ-ċagħaq. Ara kemm hu lixx dan il-ġebel!
messages.zh: 不是，这是卵石海滩。看，这些石子多光滑！
messages.en: No, it's a pebble beach. Look how smooth these stones are!

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象海水退去后露出一片圆润石子，把 ċagħaq 与“卵石海滩”的画面一起记忆。

gloss_zh: 铺撒捕鸟网的卵石地面

teaching_sense.en_definition: A pebbly surface over which a net for catching birds is spread.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 铺有小卵石、供捕鸟网展开覆盖的一片地面。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Wiċċ miksi biċ-ċagħaq li fuqu tinfirex xibka biex jinqabdu l-għasafar.

sense_translations.en_definition: a pebbly surface over which a bird net is cast
sense_translations.zh_definition: 供捕鸟网撒开覆盖的卵石地面。

collocations.en: a net over the pebbly bird-netting surface
collocations.zh: 覆盖在捕鸟卵石地面上的网

collocations.en: the surface of the pebbly bird-netting ground

formal.mt: Fl-istampa tidher ċagħqija, jiġifieri wiċċ miksi biċ-ċagħaq li fuqu tinfirex xibka għall-għasafar.
formal.en: The picture shows a ċagħqija: a pebbly surface over which a bird-catching net is spread.
formal.zh: 图中展示了一片 ċagħqija，即供捕鸟网展开覆盖的卵石地面。

colloquial.mt: Lara: X'inhu dan il-wiċċ fl-istampa? Pawlu: Dik hi ċ-ċagħqija, il-wiċċ biċ-ċagħaq li fuqu tinfirex ix-xibka għall-għasafar.
colloquial.en: Lara: What is this surface in the picture? Pawlu: That's the ċagħqija, the pebbly surface over which the bird-catching net is spread.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：图里这片地面是什么？保罗：那叫 ċagħqija，就是供捕鸟网展开覆盖的卵石地面。

messages.speaker: Lara (学生)
messages.zh: 图里这片地面是什么？
messages.en: What is this surface in the picture?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Dik hi ċ-ċagħqija, il-wiċċ biċ-ċagħaq li fuqu tinfirex ix-xibka għall-għasafar.
messages.mt_standard: Dik hi ċ-ċagħqija, il-wiċċ biċ-ċagħaq li fuqu tinfirex ix-xibka għall-għasafar.
messages.zh: 那叫 ċagħqija，就是供捕鸟网展开覆盖的卵石地面。
messages.en: That's the ċagħqija, the pebbly surface over which the bird-catching net is spread.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把“小卵石地面”和“上方展开的捕鸟网”放进同一幅图，整体记住 ċagħqija 的专门含义。

gloss_zh: 使生雾的；使光线暗淡或模糊的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Having the quality of causing mist or fog, or of dimming or obscuring light.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 具有引起薄雾或浓雾的性质，或具有使光线变暗、受到遮蔽的性质。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu l-kwalità li jikkawża ċ-ċpar jew li jdgħajjef jew jgħatti d-dawl.

sense_translations.en_definition: the quality of causing mist or fog
sense_translations.zh_definition: 具有引起薄雾或浓雾的性质的。

sense_translations.en_definition: the quality of sth. that dims or obscures light
sense_translations.zh_definition: 具有使光线变暗或受到遮蔽的性质的。

collocations.en: a material that dims or obscures light
collocations.zh: 使光线暗淡或受到遮蔽的材料

formal.mt: Il-materjal ċajpari quddiem il-lampa jdgħajjef id-dawl li jgħaddi minnu.
formal.en: The light-obscuring material in front of the lamp weakens the light passing through it.
formal.zh: 灯前具有遮光性质的材料削弱了穿过它的光线。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Għaliex id-dawl jidher aktar dgħajjef minn wara dan il-materjal? Mark: Għax il-materjal huwa ċajpari u jgħatti parti mid-dawl.
colloquial.en: Nina: Why does the light look weaker through this material? Mark: Because the material obscures light and blocks some of it.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：为什么隔着这种材料看，光线显得更弱？马克：因为这种材料有遮光性质，会挡住一部分光线。

messages.speaker: Nina (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex id-dawl jidher aktar dgħajjef minn wara dan il-materjal?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex id-dawl jidher aktar dgħajjef minn wara dan il-materjal?
messages.zh: 为什么隔着这种材料看，光线显得更弱？
messages.en: Why does the light look weaker through this material?

messages.speaker: Mark (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax il-materjal huwa ċajpari u jgħatti parti mid-dawl.
messages.mt_standard: Għax il-materjal huwa ċajpari u jgħatti parti mid-dawl.
messages.zh: 因为这种材料有遮光性质，会挡住一部分光线。
messages.en: Because the material obscures light and blocks some of it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两个画面记 ċajpari：一边是产生雾气，一边是遮住灯光；两义都抓住让视野变朦胧的效果。

gloss_zh: 迟缓的事物；缺乏活力的东西

teaching_sense.en_definition: Something sluggish or listless, lacking energy or vigour.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 表现迟缓、无精打采或缺乏能量与活力的事物。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Xi ħaġa kajmana jew mitluqa, nieqsa mill-enerġija jew mill-ħeġġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 迟缓、懒散或无精打采的事物。
缺乏能量或活力的事物。

collocations.en: a sluggish thing with no energy
collocations.zh: 毫无活力、慢吞吞的东西

collocations.en: a sluggish thing that works slowly
collocations.zh: 运作缓慢、缺乏活力的东西

formal.mt: Fil-kitba, il-magna l-qadima hija deskritta bħala ċajpra: taħdem bil-mod u tidher bla saħħa.
formal.en: In the text, the old machine is described as a sluggish thing: it works slowly and seems to lack power.
formal.zh: 文中把那台旧机器形容为一个迟缓无力的东西：它运转缓慢，显得没有力气。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Kif sejra l-magna l-qadima? Pawlu: Ċajpra sħiħa! Taħdem bil-mod u qisha bla enerġija.
colloquial.en: Lara: How is the old machine doing? Pawlu: It's a real sluggish thing! It works slowly and seems to have no energy.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：那台旧机器运转得怎么样？保罗：真是个慢吞吞的东西！运转很慢，好像一点活力也没有。

messages.speaker: Lara (同事)
messages.zh: 那台旧机器运转得怎么样？
messages.en: How is the old machine doing?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Ċajpra sħiħa! Taħdem bil-mod u qisha bla enerġija.
messages.mt_standard: Ċajpra sħiħa! Taħdem bil-mod u qisha bla enerġija.
messages.zh: 真是个慢吞吞的东西！运转很慢，好像一点活力也没有。
messages.en: It's a real sluggish thing! It works slowly and seems to have no energy.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一台有气无力、慢慢运转的旧机器，把这里的 ċajpra 记成“迟缓而缺乏活力的东西”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To sing or chirp, used only of certain birds.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指某些鸟发出鸣唱或啁啾声，不用于人的歌唱。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kanta jew għamel għana ta' għasfur; jintuża biss għal ċerti għasafar.

sense_translations.en_definition: to sing (only used of certain birds)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 鸣唱，啁啾；仅用于某些鸟。

collocations.en: sang in the morning, of a bird
sang on a branch, of a bird

formal.mt: L-għasfur ċamċam fuq fergħa waqt li l-istudenti kienu qed josservawh.
formal.en: The bird sang on a branch while the students were observing it.
formal.zh: 学生们观察时，那只鸟在树枝上鸣唱。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Smajtu l-għasfur? Ċamċam eżatt issa. Pawlu: Iva, smajt! Għandu leħen sabiħ.
colloquial.en: Maja: Did you hear the bird? It sang just now. Pawlu: Yes, I did! It has a lovely voice.
colloquial.zh: Maja：你听见那只鸟了吗？它刚才叫了。Pawlu：听见了！它的声音真好听。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你听见那只鸟了吗？它刚才叫了。
messages.en: Did you hear the bird? It sang just now.

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.zh: 听见了！它的声音真好听。
messages.en: Yes, I did! It has a lovely voice.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记忆时把 ċamċam 配上一只枝头鸣唱的小鸟；重点记住主语是某些鸟，不能拿来表示人唱歌。

gloss_zh: 吃东西时发出响声，吧唧着吃

teaching_sense.en_definition: To eat while making noticeable chewing or mouth noises.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 进食时发出明显的咀嚼声或嘴巴声，即吃得有声响。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kiel waqt li għamel ħsejjes jomgħod jew b'ħalqu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 吃东西时发出响声；吧唧着吃。

collocations.en: ate noisily with his mouth open

formal.mt: Waqt l-ikla, it-tifel ċamċaq u ommu fakkritu biex jiekol b'ħalqu magħluq.
formal.en: During the meal, the boy ate noisily, and his mother reminded him to eat with his mouth closed.
formal.zh: 用餐时，男孩吃得吧唧作响，母亲提醒他闭着嘴咀嚼。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Ħuk ċamċaq ħafna waqt l-ikel illum. Mark: Naf, għedtlu biex jiekol b'ħalqu magħluq.
colloquial.en: Sara: Your brother ate very noisily during the meal today. Mark: I know; I told him to eat with his mouth closed.
colloquial.zh: Sara：你弟弟今天吃饭时吧唧得很响。Mark：我知道，我叫他闭着嘴吃了。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ħuk ċamċaq ħafna waqt l-ikel illum.
messages.mt_standard: Ħuk ċamċaq ħafna waqt l-ikel illum.
messages.zh: 你弟弟今天吃饭时吧唧得很响。
messages.en: Your brother ate very noisily during the meal today.

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Naf, għedtlu biex jiekol b'ħalqu magħluq.
messages.mt_standard: Naf, għedtlu biex jiekol b'ħalqu magħluq.
messages.zh: 我知道，我叫他闭着嘴吃了。
messages.en: I know; I told him to eat with his mouth closed.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 ċamċaq 配上饭桌上吧唧嘴的动作画面：它是动词，强调吃东西发出声响，而不只是普通的吃。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The singing or chirping sound made by birds.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 鸟鸣唱或啁啾时发出的声音；指声音本身。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-għana jew il-ħoss li jagħmlu l-għasafar meta jkantaw.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 鸟鸣；鸟的鸣唱声。

formal.mt: Matul il-mixja ta' filgħodu, l-istudenti waqfu biex jisimgħu ċ-ċamċim tal-għasafar.
formal.en: During the morning walk, the students stopped to listen to the birdsong.
formal.zh: 晨间散步时，学生们停下来聆听鸟鸣。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Isma' ċ-ċamċim! Ġej mill-ġnien. Toni: Iva, ejja niftħu t-tieqa biex nisimgħuh aħjar.
colloquial.en: Lara: Listen to the birdsong! It's coming from the garden. Toni: Yes, let's open the window so we can hear it better.
colloquial.zh: Lara：听这鸟鸣！是花园里传来的。Toni：是啊，我们把窗户打开，听得更清楚些。

messages.speaker: Lara (室友)
messages.zh: 听这鸟鸣！是花园里传来的。
messages.en: Listen to the birdsong! It's coming from the garden.

messages.speaker: Toni (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, ejja niftħu t-tieqa biex nisimgħuh aħjar.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, ejja niftħu t-tieqa biex nisimgħuh aħjar.
messages.zh: 是啊，我们把窗户打开，听得更清楚些。
messages.en: Yes, let's open the window so we can hear it better.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 ċamċim 想成清晨窗外的一段鸟鸣录音：这是声音的名称。与动词 ċamċam 对照，分别记作鸟鸣声和鸟鸣唱。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Munching or noisy eating, especially the audible chewing involved.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 咀嚼、嚼吃的动作，也指吃东西时发出响声的行为或声音。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att li wieħed jomgħod l-ikel, speċjalment meta jagħmel ħoss waqt li jiekol.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 咀嚼；嚼吃东西的动作。
吃东西时发出响声的行为；吧唧着吃。

formal.mt: Fil-kamra kwieta, il-ħoss taċ-ċamċiq kien jinstema' ċar waqt li t-tfal kienu jieklu t-tuffieħ.
formal.en: In the quiet room, the sound of munching could be heard clearly while the children ate their apples.
formal.zh: 安静的房间里，孩子们吃苹果时的咀嚼声清晰可闻。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Qed nisma' ħafna ċamċiq. X'qed tiekol? Ben: Gallettini. Se nipprova niekol b'inqas ħoss.
colloquial.en: Nina: I can hear a lot of munching. What are you eating? Ben: Biscuits. I'll try to eat more quietly.
colloquial.zh: Nina：我听见好响的咀嚼声。你在吃什么？Ben：饼干。我尽量吃得小声些。

messages.speaker: Nina (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Qed nisma' ħafna ċamċiq. X'qed tiekol?
messages.mt_standard: Qed nisma' ħafna ċamċiq. X'qed tiekol?
messages.zh: 我听见好响的咀嚼声。你在吃什么？
messages.en: I can hear a lot of munching. What are you eating?

messages.speaker: Ben (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Gallettini. Se nipprova niekol b'inqas ħoss.
messages.mt_standard: Gallettini. Se nipprova niekol b'inqas ħoss.
messages.zh: 饼干。我尽量吃得小声些。
messages.en: Biscuits. I'll try to eat more quietly.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 ċamċiq 贴在吃饼干的咀嚼声旁：它是名词，可记嚼吃的动作，也可记有声响的进食；对应动词 ċamċaq。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A woodworking plane used to trim and finish mitred ends for a close-fitting joint.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用于修整木件斜接端面，使接合处贴合的木工刨。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ċana użata biex tirfina t-truf tal-injam għal ġonta f'angolu li taqbel sew.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 斜接刨；用于修整木件斜接端面的刨子。

collocations.en: to finish the end with a miter plane

formal.mt: Il-mastrudaxxa uża ċana għall-inglettar biex jirfina t-truf tal-biċċiet tal-qafas qabel ma għaqqadhom.
formal.en: The carpenter used a miter plane to finish the ends of the frame pieces before joining them.
formal.zh: 木匠用斜接刨精修框架各木件的端面，然后将它们接合。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Din il-ġonta għadha ma taqbilx sew. Liema ċana nuża? Rita: Uża ċ-ċana għall-inglettar u neħħi ftit injam kull darba.
colloquial.en: Mark: This joint still doesn't fit properly. Which plane should I use? Rita: Use the miter plane and remove a little wood at a time.
colloquial.zh: Mark：这个接头还是不太贴合。我该用哪把刨子？Rita：用斜接刨，每次刨掉一点木料。

messages.speaker: Mark (木工学徒)
messages.mt_spoken: Din il-ġonta għadha ma taqbilx sew. Liema ċana nuża?
messages.mt_standard: Din il-ġonta għadha ma taqbilx sew. Liema ċana nuża?
messages.zh: 这个接头还是不太贴合。我该用哪把刨子？
messages.en: This joint still doesn't fit properly. Which plane should I use?

messages.speaker: Rita (木工师傅)
messages.mt_spoken: Uża ċ-ċana għall-inglettar u neħħi ftit injam kull darba.
messages.mt_standard: Uża ċ-ċana għall-inglettar u neħħi ftit injam kull darba.
messages.zh: 用斜接刨，每次刨掉一点木料。
messages.en: Use the miter plane and remove a little wood at a time.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把整个词组配上相框角部的斜接接头：想象用刨子细修端面，让两块木料严丝合缝，记住它是斜接刨。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A woodworking plane used to smooth curved wooden surfaces.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用于刨削和修整弯曲木面的木工刨，英语称 compass plane。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ċana użata biex twitti u tirfina uċuħ mgħawġa tal-injam.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 曲面刨；用于修整弯曲木面的圆弧刨。

collocations.en: to smooth a curved surface with a compass plane
collocations.zh: 用曲面刨刨平弯曲表面

collocations.en: to work with a compass plane

formal.mt: Biex jirfina l-wiċċ mgħawweġ tal-biċċa tal-injam, il-mastrudaxxa għażel ċana għat-tond.
formal.en: To finish the curved surface of the wooden piece, the carpenter chose a compass plane.
formal.zh: 为了精修这块木料的弯曲表面，木匠选用了一把曲面刨。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Dan il-wiċċ mgħawweġ. Liema għodda għandi nuża? Toni: Ipprova ċ-ċana għat-tond biex twittih.
colloquial.en: Lara: This surface is curved. Which tool should I use? Toni: Try the compass plane to smooth it.
colloquial.zh: Lara：这个表面是弯的。我该用什么工具？Toni：试试用曲面刨把它刨光。

messages.speaker: Lara (木工学员)
messages.mt_spoken: Dan il-wiċċ mgħawweġ. Liema għodda għandi nuża?
messages.mt_standard: Dan il-wiċċ mgħawweġ. Liema għodda għandi nuża?
messages.zh: 这个表面是弯的。我该用什么工具？
messages.en: This surface is curved. Which tool should I use?

messages.speaker: Toni (木工教师)
messages.zh: 试试用曲面刨把它刨光。
messages.en: Try the compass plane to smooth it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象刨子沿着弧形木面移动，把整个词组与修整曲面的画面相连；英语 compass plane 在这里是一种木工刨。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A woodworking plane with a rounded underside, used to shape concave profiles in wood.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 底部呈圆弧形、用于刨出或修整凹圆弧轮廓的木工刨。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ċana b'qiegħ nofs tond, użata biex tagħmel jew tirfina profili konkavi fl-injam.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 圆底刨；底部呈圆弧形、用于加工凹圆弧轮廓的刨子。

collocations.mt: tuża ċana nofs tond minn taħt
tirfina kanal b'ċana nofs tond minn taħt
collocations.en: to finish a groove with a round plane

formal.mt: Il-mastrudaxxa uża ċana nofs tond minn taħt biex jirfina l-profil konkavu fil-biċċa tal-injam.
formal.en: The carpenter used a round plane to finish the concave profile in the wooden piece.
formal.zh: 木匠用圆底刨精修木件上的凹圆弧轮廓。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Irrid nirfina dan il-kanal. Liema ċana nieħu? Pawlu: Ħu ċ-ċana nofs tond minn taħt; il-qiegħ tagħha jaqbel mal-forma tal-kanal.
colloquial.en: Nina: I want to finish this groove. Which plane should I take? Pawlu: Take the round plane; its sole matches the shape of the groove.
colloquial.zh: Nina：我想把这道槽修光。该拿哪把刨子？Pawlu：拿圆底刨，它的刨底与这道槽的形状相合。

messages.speaker: Nina (木工学徒)
messages.mt_spoken: Irrid nirfina dan il-kanal. Liema ċana nieħu?
messages.mt_standard: Irrid nirfina dan il-kanal. Liema ċana nieħu?
messages.zh: 我想把这道槽修光。该拿哪把刨子？
messages.en: I want to finish this groove. Which plane should I take?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (木工师傅)
messages.mt_spoken: Ħu ċ-ċana nofs tond minn taħt; il-qiegħ tagħha jaqbel mal-forma tal-kanal.
messages.mt_standard: Ħu ċ-ċana nofs tond minn taħt; il-qiegħ tagħha jaqbel mal-forma tal-kanal.
messages.zh: 拿圆底刨，它的刨底与这道槽的形状相合。
messages.en: Take the round plane; its sole matches the shape of the groove.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用形状记忆整个长词组：想象刨子底下凸出半圆弧，正好伸入凹圆槽中修整；圆的是刨底，不是整把工具。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A small woodworking tool with a blade between two handles, used to shape and smooth wood.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 刀刃位于两个手柄之间、用于削整和修光木料的小型木工工具，常称辐刨。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Għodda żgħira tax-xogħol tal-injam, b'xafra bejn żewġ imqabad, użata biex issawwar u twitti l-injam.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 辐刨；刀刃两侧带手柄、用于削整木料的工具。

collocations.en: to shape a handle with a spokeshave
to adjust the blade of the spokeshave

formal.mt: L-artiġjana użat ċana sikkina biex issawwar il-manku tal-injam u twitti l-wiċċ tiegħu.
formal.en: The craftswoman used a spokeshave to shape the wooden handle and smooth its surface.
formal.zh: 女工匠用辐刨削整木柄，并将其表面修光。

colloquial.mt: Ben: Dan il-manku għadu oħxon wisq. Nista' nuża ċ-ċana sikkina? Rita: Iva, żommha miż-żewġ imqabad u neħħi ftit injam kull darba.
colloquial.en: Ben: This handle is still too thick. Can I use the spokeshave? Rita: Yes, hold it by both handles and remove a little wood at a time.
colloquial.zh: Ben：这个手柄还是太粗了。我可以用辐刨吗？Rita：可以，握住两边的手柄，每次削掉一点木料。

messages.speaker: Ben (木工学徒)
messages.mt_spoken: Dan il-manku għadu oħxon wisq. Nista' nuża ċ-ċana sikkina?
messages.mt_standard: Dan il-manku għadu oħxon wisq. Nista' nuża ċ-ċana sikkina?
messages.zh: 这个手柄还是太粗了。我可以用辐刨吗？
messages.en: This handle is still too thick. Can I use the spokeshave?

messages.speaker: Rita (木工师傅)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, żommha miż-żewġ imqabad u neħħi ftit injam kull darba.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, żommha miż-żewġ imqabad u neħħi ftit injam kull darba.
messages.zh: 可以，握住两边的手柄，每次削掉一点木料。
messages.en: Yes, hold it by both handles and remove a little wood at a time.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象双手各握一个柄，中间一片刀刃轻轻削过木柄；把 ċana sikkina 整体记为这种双柄削刨，中文叫辐刨。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Light, informal talking, often continuing for some time about everyday matters.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 围绕日常琐事进行的轻松闲聊，也可指持续的叽叽喳喳声。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Taħdit ħafif u informali, spiss fuq affarijiet ta' kuljum u għal xi ħin.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 闲聊；叽叽喳喳的谈话。

formal.mt: Iċ-ċaċċir fil-kuritur naqas meta bdiet il-laqgħa.
formal.en: The chatter in the corridor subsided when the meeting began.
formal.zh: 会议开始后，走廊里的闲聊声渐渐小了。

colloquial.mt: Sara: X'inhu dan iċ-ċaċċir kollu? Pawlu: Il-ħbieb qed jirrakkuntaw x'għamlu fi tmiem il-ġimgħa.
colloquial.en: Sara: What's all this chatter? Pawlu: The friends are talking about what they did at the weekend.
colloquial.zh: Sara：怎么聊得这么热闹？Pawlu：朋友们在说周末都做了些什么。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 怎么聊得这么热闹？
messages.en: What's all this chatter?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-ħbieb qed jirrakkuntaw x'għamlu fi tmiem il-ġimgħa.
messages.mt_standard: Il-ħbieb qed jirrakkuntaw x'għamlu fi tmiem il-ġimgħa.
messages.zh: 朋友们在说周末都做了些什么。
messages.en: The friends are talking about what they did at the weekend.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 ċaċċir 配上朋友围坐闲聊的画面：话题轻松、你一句我一句，用场景记住闲聊这个名词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The frame surrounding a doorway, into which a door is fitted.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 围在门洞四周、供安装门扇的框架。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-qafas madwar il-fetħa ta' bieb, li fih jitwaħħal il-bieb.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 门框，即门洞周围供安装门扇的框架。

formal.mt: Il-mastrudaxxa kejjel iċ-ċaċċiż qabel ħejja l-bieb il-ġdid.
formal.en: The carpenter measured the door frame before preparing the new door.
formal.zh: 木匠在制作新门之前测量了门框。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Għaliex il-bieb ma jagħlaqx sew? Ġużeppi: Iċ-ċaċċiż mhuwiex dritt; irridu nirranġawh.
colloquial.en: Anna: Why doesn't the door close properly? Ġużeppi: The door frame isn't straight; we need to fix it.
colloquial.zh: Anna：门怎么关不严？Ġużeppi：门框不正，得修一下。

messages.speaker: Anna (住户)
messages.zh: 门怎么关不严？
messages.en: Why doesn't the door close properly?

messages.speaker: Ġużeppi (维修师傅)
messages.zh: 门框不正，得修一下。
messages.en: The door frame isn't straight; we need to fix it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象门扇打开后仍留在墙上的那圈框架，在它旁边贴上 ċaċċiż，借实物位置记住门框。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An act of depriving someone of something, rejecting something, or denying that something is true.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 剥夺某人所拥有或应享有之物的行为，或拒绝某事、否认某事属实的行为。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att li wieħed iċaħħad lil xi ħadd minn xi ħaġa, jirrifjuta xi ħaġa, jew jiċħad li xi ħaġa hija vera.

sense_translations.en_definition: a deprivation, a rejection, a denial
sense_translations.zh_definition: 剥夺；拒绝或驳回；否认。

formal.mt: L-ittra uffiċjali tispjega r-raġunijiet għaċ-ċaħda tat-talba.
formal.en: The official letter explains the reasons for rejecting the request.
formal.zh: 正式信函说明了拒绝该请求的理由。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Aċċettaw it-talba tiegħek? Mark: Le, irċevejt ċaħda, imma spjegawli għaliex.
colloquial.en: Maja: Did they accept your request? Mark: No, I received a rejection, but they explained why.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：他们接受你的请求了吗？马克：没有，我收到了拒绝通知，不过他们解释了原因。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 他们接受你的请求了吗？
messages.en: Did they accept your request?

messages.speaker: Mark (申请人)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, irċevejt ċaħda, imma spjegawli għaliex.
messages.mt_standard: Le, irċevejt ċaħda, imma spjegawli għaliex.
messages.zh: 没有，我收到了拒绝通知，不过他们解释了原因。
messages.en: No, I received a rejection, but they explained why.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用三张卡片记 ċaħda：拿走权利是“剥夺”，不接受请求是“拒绝”，说事情不属实是“否认”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Inclined to deny things or to respond with denial.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 容易否认事情，或习惯以否认作出回应的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu tendenza jiċħad l-affarijiet jew iwieġeb billi jiċħad.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 倾向于否认的；惯于作出否认的。

formal.mt: Id-deskrizzjoni tippreżenta lill-karattru bħala persuna b'atteġġjament ċaħħadi, li spiss tiċħad dak li jgħidu l-oħrajn.
formal.en: The description presents the character as someone with an attitude inclined towards denial, who often denies what others say.
formal.zh: 这段描写将该角色呈现为一个倾向于否认的人，经常否认别人的说法。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għaliex tgħid li għandu atteġġjament ċaħħadi? Toni: Għax kważi dejjem jiċħad dak li ngħid, anki qabel nispjega.
colloquial.en: Sara: Why do you say he has an attitude inclined towards denial? Toni: Because he almost always denies what I say, even before I explain.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：你为什么说他总倾向于否认？托尼：因为他几乎总是否认我的话，甚至不等我解释。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex tgħid li għandu atteġġjament ċaħħadi?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex tgħid li għandu atteġġjament ċaħħadi?
messages.zh: 你为什么说他总倾向于否认？
messages.en: Why do you say he has an attitude inclined towards denial?

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax kważi dejjem jiċħad dak li ngħid, anki qabel nispjega.
messages.mt_standard: Għax kważi dejjem jiċħad dak li ngħid, anki qabel nispjega.
messages.zh: 因为他几乎总是否认我的话，甚至不等我解释。
messages.en: Because he almost always denies what I say, even before I explain.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一个听到事情就先摇头否认的人，用这个习惯记住 ċaħħadi，重点是“有否认倾向”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To cut back parts of a plant, especially a vine, as part of pruning.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 剪去植物的部分枝条以进行修整，尤其用于葡萄藤的修剪。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jaqta' xi friegħi ta' pjanta biex jirranġaha, speċjalment dawk tad-dwieli.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 修剪；剪枝。
修剪植物，尤其指修剪葡萄藤。

formal.mt: Il-ġardinar żabar id-dwieli u neħħa l-friegħi niexfa.
formal.en: The gardener pruned the vines and removed the dry branches.
formal.zh: 园丁修剪了葡萄藤，并去除了干枯的枝条。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Min żabar is-siġra fil-bitħa? Toni: Il-ġardinar; neħħa l-friegħi niexfa dalgħodu.
colloquial.en: Anna: Who pruned the tree in the courtyard? Toni: The gardener; he removed the dry branches this morning.
colloquial.zh: Anna：谁给院子里的树剪枝了？Toni：园丁，他今天早上剪掉了枯枝。

messages.speaker: Anna (住户)
messages.zh: 谁给院子里的树剪枝了？
messages.en: Who pruned the tree in the courtyard?

messages.speaker: Toni (邻居)
messages.zh: 园丁，他今天早上剪掉了枯枝。
messages.en: The gardener; he removed the dry branches this morning.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 żabar 配上园丁拿剪刀剪去葡萄藤枯枝的动作画面，记住它表达“进行修剪”。

gloss_zh: 性交（粗俗）；瞎耗时间；粗俗地表示断然拒绝

teaching_sense.en_definition: A vulgar verb meaning to fornicate or waste time doing something, also used as an exclamation of absolute refusal.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 粗俗动词，可指发生性关系或瞎耗时间做某事，也可作为感叹语，表示绝不接受某项提议或绝不做某事。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Verb vulgari li jfisser jagħmel sess jew jaħli l-ħin jagħmel xi ħaġa; jintuża wkoll bħala esklamazzjoni ta' rifjut assolut.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 发生性关系；性交，属粗俗用语。

sense_translations.en_definition: verb used mostly as an exclamation suggesting that a proposal is not on
sense_translations.zh_definition: 主要用作感叹语，粗俗地表示某项提议没门、不能接受。
发生性关系；性交。
做某事时瞎耗时间；磨蹭。

sense_translations.en_definition: Used to indicate that the speaker will absolutely not do something
sense_translations.zh_definition: 用于表示说话人绝对不会做某事，语气粗俗而强烈。

collocations.zh: 没有工作，而是在瞎耗时间

collocations.en: Fuck that! I'm not doing that.
collocations.zh: 去他的！我才不干那种事。

formal.mt: F'dan id-djalogu, l-esklamazzjoni vulgari 'Żabbab!' tesprimi rifjut assolut tal-proposta.
formal.en: In this dialogue, the vulgar exclamation 'Żabbab!' expresses absolute rejection of the proposal.
formal.zh: 在这段对话中，粗俗感叹语“Żabbab!”表示对提议的断然拒绝。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Se terġa' tagħmel ix-xogħol kollu waħdek? Toni: Żabbab! Din id-darba rrid l-għajnuna.
colloquial.en: Mark: Are you going to do all the work by yourself again? Toni: Fuck that! This time I want help.
colloquial.zh: Mark：你又要一个人把所有活儿都干了吗？Toni：去他的！这次我要有人帮忙。

messages.speaker: Mark (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Se terġa' tagħmel ix-xogħol kollu waħdek?
messages.mt_standard: Se terġa' tagħmel ix-xogħol kollu waħdek?
messages.zh: 你又要一个人把所有活儿都干了吗？
messages.en: Are you going to do all the work by yourself again?

messages.speaker: Toni (同事)
messages.zh: 去他的！这次我要有人帮忙。
messages.en: Fuck that! This time I want help.

cognitive_memory_aid: 分三张情境卡记 żabbab：粗俗地谈性、瞎耗时间、强烈说“绝不干”；遇到感叹号时重点联想断然拒绝。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An act or instance of pruning a plant.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 对植物进行的一次修剪或剪枝。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Att jew darba ta' żbir ta' pjanta.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 一次修剪行为；一次剪枝。
一次修剪；一次剪枝作业。

formal.mt: Il-ġardinar għamel żabra ħafifa tas-siġra u neħħa biss il-friegħi niexfa.
formal.en: The gardener gave the tree a light pruning and removed only the dry branches.
formal.zh: 园丁给树做了一次轻度修剪，只去除了干枯的枝条。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Din is-siġra għandha bżonn żabra? Pawlu: Iva, imma żabra ħafifa biss.
colloquial.en: Lara: Does this tree need a pruning? Pawlu: Yes, but only a light pruning.
colloquial.zh: Lara：这棵树需要修剪一下吗？Pawlu：需要，不过轻轻修剪一下就行。

messages.speaker: Lara (屋主)
messages.zh: 这棵树需要修剪一下吗？
messages.en: Does this tree need a pruning?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (园丁)
messages.zh: 需要，不过轻轻修剪一下就行。
messages.en: Yes, but only a light pruning.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 年轻人；青年。

年轻的；年少的。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To produce flowers or come into bloom.

花；花朵。

gloss_zh: 喂养；用喙喂食；肚子；传统马耳他风笛；小雨云

teaching_sense.en_definition: To feed or nourish, especially when a bird feeds its young with its bill.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 喂食、供给营养，尤其指鸟用喙喂养幼鸟。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li wieħed jagħti l-ikel, speċjalment għasfur li jitma' l-frieħ bil-munqar.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使某人肚子变大；使某人长出大肚腩。

sense_translations.en_definition: to feed (especially used of birds feeding fledglings)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 喂食，尤其指鸟喂养幼鸟。
滋养；供给营养，尤其指喂养儿童。
胃；肚子。
肚子；腹部。

sense_translations.en_definition: traditional musical instrument made out of animal skin
sense_translations.zh_definition: 用动物皮制作的传统乐器。
喂食；喂养这一行为。
胃；腹部；肚子。
一种传统的马耳他风笛。
一小片带雨的云；小雨云。
用喙喂食。

formal.mt: Waqt l-osservazzjoni tal-bejta, l-istudent innota li l-għasfur żaqq il-frieħ bil-munqar.
formal.en: While observing the nest, the student noted that the bird fed its young with its bill.
formal.zh: 观察鸟巢时，这名学生注意到亲鸟用喙给幼鸟喂食。

colloquial.mt: Nina: X'għamel l-għasfur fil-bejta? Toni: Żaqq il-frieħ. Rajtu jagħtihom l-ikel bil-munqar.
colloquial.en: Nina: What did the bird do in the nest? Toni: It fed its young. I saw it giving them food with its bill.
colloquial.zh: Nina：那只鸟在巢里做了什么？Toni：它给幼鸟喂食。我看到它用喙把食物喂给它们。

messages.speaker: Nina (同学)
messages.zh: 那只鸟在巢里做了什么？
messages.en: What did the bird do in the nest?

messages.speaker: Toni (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Żaqq il-frieħ. Rajtu jagħtihom l-ikel bil-munqar.
messages.mt_standard: Żaqq il-frieħ. Rajtu jagħtihom l-ikel bil-munqar.
messages.zh: 它给幼鸟喂食。我看到它用喙把食物喂给它们。
messages.en: It fed its young. I saw it giving them food with its bill.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“亲鸟喂幼鸟”的动作图记住动词 żaqq，用指向腹部的图记住名词“肚子”。传统风笛和小雨云另配图片记忆；这些是同形词义的学习分类，不表示词源关系。

gloss_zh: 使长出大肚腩；使鼓起；频繁喂食

teaching_sense.en_definition: To cause someone to develop a pot-belly, make something bulge, or feed young birds frequently.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使某人长出大肚腩，使物体向外鼓起，或频繁给幼鸟喂食。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Iġiegħel lil xi ħadd irabbi żaqq, jagħmel xi ħaġa tintefaħ 'il barra, jew jitma' l-frieħ ta' spiss.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使腹部肥大，使出现大肚腩。

sense_translations.en_definition: to cause sb. to grow a pot-belly
sense_translations.zh_definition: 使某人长出大肚腩。

sense_translations.en_definition: to cause bulging or swelling (especially of a wall or similar structure)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 使鼓起或膨胀，尤指使墙壁等结构向外隆起。

sense_translations.en_definition: to feed frequently (especially used of birds feeding fledglings)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 频繁喂食，尤指鸟类不断给雏鸟喂食。
吹奏风笛的人；风笛手。
使某物向外鼓起。

sense_translations.en_definition: to cause someone to develop a paunch
sense_translations.zh_definition: 使某人腹部发胖，形成肚腩。

collocations.en: caused Pawlu to develop a pot-belly

formal.mt: Skont ir-rapport, l-ilma li nġabar wara l-ħajt żaqqaq il-wiċċ tiegħu.
formal.en: According to the report, water that accumulated behind the wall caused its surface to bulge.
formal.zh: 报告指出，墙后的积水使墙面向外鼓起。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'għamel l-għasfur dalgħodu? Toni: Żaqqaq il-frieħ; baqa' jġibilhom l-ikel.
colloquial.en: Maja: What did the bird do this morning? Toni: It fed the fledglings frequently; it kept bringing them food.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：那只鸟今天早上做了什么？托尼：它不断给雏鸟喂食，一直给它们叼食物来。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 那只鸟今天早上做了什么？
messages.en: What did the bird do this morning?

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.zh: 它不断给雏鸟喂食，一直给它们叼食物来。
messages.en: It fed the fledglings frequently; it kept bringing them food.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用三幅教学画面记动词：肚腩长出来、墙面鼓出来、亲鸟反复喂雏鸟；另把名词“风笛手”单独做卡片，避免混淆词性。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Greed, especially an excessive desire to eat or the habit of eating too much.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 贪得无厌的欲望，尤其指对食物过度贪求或吃得过多的行为。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Xewqa żejda li wieħed ikollu aktar milli jeħtieġ, speċjalment fil-ikel, jew id-drawwa li jiekol iżżejjed.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 贪婪；总想占有更多的欲望。
贪食；无节制地过量进食。

collocations.zh: 毫无节制的贪婪或贪食

formal.mt: L-awtur jikkritika ż-żaqqiqerija ta' dawk li jieħdu kollox għalihom u ma jħallu xejn għall-oħrajn.
formal.en: The author criticizes the greed of those who take everything for themselves and leave nothing for others.
formal.zh: 作者批评那些把一切据为己有、不给别人留下任何东西的人的贪婪。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Ħa nieħu l-aħħar tliet biċċiet kejk. Mark: Tliet biċċiet għalik biss? Dik żaqqiqerija! Ħalli waħda għal Sara.
colloquial.en: Lara: I'll take the last three pieces of cake. Mark: Three pieces just for you? That's gluttony! Leave one for Sara.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：我要拿走最后三块蛋糕。马克：三块都给你自己？这也太贪吃了！给萨拉留一块。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ħa nieħu l-aħħar tliet biċċiet kejk.
messages.mt_standard: Ħa nieħu l-aħħar tliet biċċiet kejk.
messages.zh: 我要拿走最后三块蛋糕。
messages.en: I'll take the last three pieces of cake.

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Tliet biċċiet għalik biss? Dik żaqqiqerija! Ħalli waħda għal Sara.
messages.mt_standard: Tliet biċċiet għalik biss? Dik żaqqiqerija! Ħalli waħda għal Sara.
messages.zh: 三块都给你自己？这也太贪吃了！给萨拉留一块。
messages.en: Three pieces just for you? That's gluttony! Leave one for Sara.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象有人把整盘蛋糕都揽到自己面前：强调“都要归我”时记贪婪，强调“还要继续吃”时记贪食。这是情景联想，不是词源解释。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To make a creaking or squeaking sound, often when something moves or rubs against another surface.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 发出吱呀声或尖细的吱吱声，常用于物体移动或相互摩擦时的声音。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jagħmel ħoss ta' żaqżiqa, spiss meta xi ħaġa tiċċaqlaq jew togħrok ma' wiċċ ieħor.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 吱呀作响，尤指门、木板等移动或受力时发出声音。
发出短促、尖细的吱吱声。

formal.mt: Matul l-ispezzjoni, il-bieb tal-injam żaqżaq kull darba li nfetaħ.
formal.en: During the inspection, the wooden door creaked every time it was opened.
formal.zh: 检查期间，那扇木门每次打开都会吱呀作响。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Smajt dak il-ħoss? Paul: Iva, is-siġġu żaqżaq meta qgħadt fuqu.
colloquial.en: Nina: Did you hear that sound? Paul: Yes, the chair squeaked when I sat on it.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：你听到那个声音了吗？保罗：听到了，我坐上去时椅子吱吱响了一下。

messages.speaker: Nina (室友)
messages.zh: 你听到那个声音了吗？
messages.en: Did you hear that sound?

messages.speaker: Paul (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, is-siġġu żaqżaq meta qgħadt fuqu.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, is-siġġu żaqżaq meta qgħadt fuqu.
messages.zh: 听到了，我坐上去时椅子吱吱响了一下。
messages.en: Yes, the chair squeaked when I sat on it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把重复的字形 żaq-żaq 配上两下“吱呀、吱呀”的想象声音，再分别联想旧门和椅子，帮助记住 creak 与 squeak 两种声音义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To visit a person or place, including going to a foreign country or taking a tour.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 前往看望某人或参观某地，也可指到外国游访或进行游览。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Imur jara persuna jew post, inkluż pajjiż barrani, jew jagħmel dawra biex jara l-postijiet.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 拜访；看望；参观。

sense_translations.en_definition: to go to a foreign country
sense_translations.zh_definition: 前往外国；到外国游访。
进行游览；参观游历。

formal.mt: Id-direttur żar il-mużew biex jiddiskuti programm edukattiv ġdid mal-persunal.
formal.en: The director visited the museum to discuss a new educational programme with the staff.
formal.zh: 主任到博物馆访问，与工作人员讨论一项新的教育项目。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Fejn mar David fi tmiem il-ġimgħa? Maja: Żar lil ħuh Għawdex u baqa' għandu għal-lejl.
colloquial.en: Sara: Where did David go at the weekend? Maja: He visited his brother in Gozo and stayed at his place overnight.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：戴维周末去了哪里？玛雅：他去戈佐岛看望哥哥，并在哥哥家住了一晚。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Fejn mar David fi tmiem il-ġimgħa?
messages.mt_standard: Fejn mar David fi tmiem il-ġimgħa?
messages.zh: 戴维周末去了哪里？
messages.en: Where did David go at the weekend?

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Żar lil ħuh Għawdex u baqa' għandu għal-lejl.
messages.mt_standard: Żar lil ħuh Għawdex u baqa' għandu għal-lejl.
messages.zh: 他去戈佐岛看望哥哥，并在哥哥家住了一晚。
messages.en: He visited his brother in Gozo and stayed at his place overnight.

cognitive_memory_aid: 画一条出门路线：先到朋友家，再到博物馆，最后到外国。三个目的地分别提示拜访、参观和出国游访，共同围绕“前往看看”。

gloss_zh: 播种；散播；谷物；播种行为

teaching_sense.en_definition: To sow seeds in soil, or to spread or diffuse something more widely.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把种子播入土中；也可指使某物或某种影响散布、传播开来。
