teaching_sense.mt_definition: Iqiegħed iż-żerriegħa fil-ħamrija biex tikber, jew ixerred xi ħaġa fuq firxa usa'.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 播种；将种子撒下或种入土中。
谷类；谷物作物。
播种；播撒种子的行为或过程。
散播；使扩散或传播开来。

formal.mt: Il-bidwi żara' l-qamħ wara li ħejja l-ħamrija u qabel bdiet ix-xita.
formal.en: The farmer sowed the wheat after preparing the soil and before the rain began.
formal.zh: 农民整好土壤后，在下雨前播种了小麦。

colloquial.mt: Anna: X'żara' n-nannu f'din ir-rokna? Ben: Żara' l-fażola; ħalla spazju bejn iż-żrieragħ.
colloquial.en: Anna: What did Grandpa sow in this corner? Ben: He sowed beans; he left space between the seeds.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：爷爷在这个角落种了什么？本：他播种了菜豆，还在种子之间留了间距。

messages.speaker: Anna (孙女)
messages.zh: 爷爷在这个角落种了什么？
messages.en: What did Grandpa sow in this corner?

messages.speaker: Ben (孙子)
messages.mt_spoken: Żara' l-fażola; ħalla spazju bejn iż-żrieragħ.
messages.mt_standard: Żara' l-fażola; ħalla spazju bejn iż-żrieragħ.
messages.zh: 他播种了菜豆，还在种子之间留了间距。
messages.en: He sowed beans; he left space between the seeds.

cognitive_memory_aid: 先想象手把种子撒进田里，记动词“播种”；再想象疑虑像种子一样散开，记“散播”。名词卡另列“谷物”和“播种行为”，并保留词尾撇号。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Footwear covering the foot; depending on context, the word can refer to one shoe, a pair of shoes, or shoes collectively.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 包覆脚部的鞋；根据语境，可指一只鞋、一双鞋或统称鞋类。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Dak li jintlibes biex jgħatti u jipproteġi s-sieq; skont il-kuntest, jista' jirreferi għal wieħed, għal par, jew għaż-żraben b'mod ġenerali.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 一只鞋。
一双鞋。
鞋；可按语境指单只鞋或鞋的统称。

formal.mt: Għal din l-attività, il-parteċipanti għandhom jilbsu żarbun magħluq u komdu.
formal.en: For this activity, participants should wear comfortable, closed-toe footwear.
formal.zh: 参加这项活动时，参与者应穿舒适的包头鞋。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Għandek żarbun komdu għall-mixi? Rita: Iva, ipprova dan il-par. X'daqs tilbes?
colloquial.en: Mark: Do you have comfortable shoes for walking? Rita: Yes, try this pair. What size do you wear?
colloquial.zh: 马克：你们有适合走路的舒适鞋子吗？丽塔：有，试试这双。你穿多大码？

messages.speaker: Mark (顾客)
messages.zh: 你们有适合走路的舒适鞋子吗？
messages.en: Do you have comfortable shoes for walking?

messages.speaker: Rita (店员)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, ipprova dan il-par. X'daqs tilbes?
messages.mt_standard: Iva, ipprova dan il-par. X'daqs tilbes?
messages.zh: 有，试试这双。你穿多大码？
messages.en: Yes, try this pair. What size do you wear?

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 żarbun 写在鞋柜图片上，旁边分别画单只鞋和一双鞋；提醒自己先看语境，再决定中文译成“一只鞋”“一双鞋”还是统称“鞋”。

gloss_zh: 萌芽；抽枝；变得活泼有精神

teaching_sense.en_definition: To sprout or produce small branches; also, to be lively and perky.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 植物萌芽或抽出细枝；也可形容人活泼、有精神。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Joħroġ rimjiet jew friegħi żgħar; jingħad ukoll għal min ikun ħaj u mimli enerġija.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 萌芽；长出新芽。
抽枝；长出细小枝条。
活泼有精神；显得神采奕奕。

collocations.en: put out new growth after the rain
collocations.zh: 雨后抽出了新芽或细枝

collocations.en: was lively and perky after resting

formal.mt: Wara x-xita tar-rebbiegħa, l-arbuxxell żarġan u ħarġu friegħi żgħar ġodda.
formal.en: After the spring rain, the shrub put out new growth and small new branches appeared.
formal.zh: 春雨过后，灌木抽出了新枝，长出了细小的新枝条。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Dan l-arbuxxell kien jidher niexef! Toni: Iva, imma żarġan wara x-xita. Ara kemm għandu rimjiet ġodda.
colloquial.en: Lara: This shrub looked dried out! Toni: Yes, but it sprouted after the rain. Look how many new shoots it has.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：这棵灌木之前看起来都干了！托尼：是啊，不过雨后它萌芽了。看，它长了这么多新芽。

messages.speaker: Lara (邻居)
messages.zh: 这棵灌木之前看起来都干了！
messages.en: This shrub looked dried out!

messages.speaker: Toni (园艺爱好者)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, imma żarġan wara x-xita. Ara kemm għandu rimjiet ġodda.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, imma żarġan wara x-xita. Ara kemm għandu rimjiet ġodda.
messages.zh: 是啊，不过雨后它萌芽了。看，它长了这么多新芽。
messages.en: Yes, but it sprouted after the rain. Look how many new shoots it has.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“恢复生气”的双画面记忆：植物冒出新芽和细枝，人休息后精神起来。植物画面对应萌芽、抽枝，人物画面对应活泼有精神。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A small twig or shoot, especially a shoot growing from a grapevine.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 细小的枝条或新梢，尤其指葡萄藤长出的嫩梢。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Fergħa żgħira jew rimja, speċjalment rimja li toħroġ mid-dielja.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 细枝；小枝条。
葡萄藤长出的一根新梢。
葡萄藤的新梢；葡萄藤长出的嫩枝。

collocations.zh: 一根纤细的枝条或嫩梢

formal.mt: Waqt l-ispezzjoni tad-dielja, il-ġardinar identifika żarġun ġdid u rabtu bil-mod ma' appoġġ.
formal.en: While inspecting the grapevine, the gardener identified a new shoot and gently tied it to a support.
formal.zh: 检查葡萄藤时，园丁发现了一根新梢，并轻轻地把它绑在支架上。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Din fergħa ġdida tad-dielja? Pawlu: Iva, dan żarġun. Oqgħod attenta li ma tiksrux.
colloquial.en: Maja: Is this a new branch of the grapevine? Pawlu: Yes, it's a vine shoot. Be careful not to break it.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这是葡萄藤新长的枝条吗？保罗：是的，这是一根葡萄新梢。小心别把它折断了。

messages.speaker: Maja (园艺初学者)
messages.zh: 这是葡萄藤新长的枝条吗？
messages.en: Is this a new branch of the grapevine?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (园丁)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, dan żarġun. Oqgħod attenta li ma tiksrux.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, dan żarġun. Oqgħod attenta li ma tiksrux.
messages.zh: 是的，这是一根葡萄新梢。小心别把它折断了。
messages.en: Yes, it's a vine shoot. Be careful not to break it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 żarġun 贴在葡萄藤上一根细嫩的新梢旁，记住它指“长出来的枝条”这一名词；再与上一词 żarġan 的“萌芽、抽枝”动作对照练习。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A policeman who helps maintain public order and enforce the law.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 维护公共秩序、执行法律的警察。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Pulizija li jgħin biex jinżamm l-ordni pubbliku u tiġi infurzata l-liġi.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 警察；男警员。

formal.mt: Żbirr kien preżenti fid-daħla biex iżomm l-ordni waqt il-laqgħa.
formal.en: A policeman was present at the entrance to maintain order during the meeting.
formal.zh: 会议期间，一名警察在入口处维持秩序。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Lil min nistgħu nistaqsu għat-triq? Pawlu: Hemm żbirr ħdejn il-pjazza; nistaqsu lilu.
colloquial.en: Maja: Who can we ask for directions? Pawlu: There's a policeman near the square; let's ask him.
colloquial.zh: Maja：我们可以向谁问路？Pawlu：广场旁边有一名警察，我们问问他吧。

messages.speaker: Maja (游客)
messages.zh: 我们可以向谁问路？
messages.en: Who can we ask for directions?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (旅伴)
messages.mt_spoken: Hemm żbirr ħdejn il-pjazza; nistaqsu lilu.
messages.mt_standard: Hemm żbirr ħdejn il-pjazza; nistaqsu lilu.
messages.zh: 广场旁边有一名警察，我们问问他吧。
messages.en: There's a policeman near the square; let's ask him.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 żbirr 放进“广场上向警察问路”的画面中，用人物与场景一起记住“警察”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To unlock something or remove an obstruction so that it can be accessed, used, or flow freely.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 解除锁定，或清除阻塞，使事物能够被访问、使用或顺畅流通。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jiftaħ xi ħaġa msakkra jew ineħħi ostaklu biex xi ħaġa tkun tista' tintuża jew tgħaddi liberament.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 解锁；解除锁定。
疏通；清除阻塞；解除封锁。

formal.mt: It-tekniku żblokka l-kont wara li vverifika l-identità tal-utent.
formal.en: The technician unlocked the account after verifying the user's identity.
formal.zh: 技术人员核实用户身份后解锁了账户。

colloquial.mt: Lara: L-ilma għadu ma jinżilx fis-sink? Mark: Issa jinżel sew; il-plamer żblokka l-pajp.
colloquial.en: Lara: Is the water still not draining from the sink? Mark: It drains properly now; the plumber unblocked the pipe.
colloquial.zh: Lara：水槽还是不排水吗？Mark：现在排水正常了，水管工把管道疏通了。

messages.speaker: Lara (室友)
messages.zh: 水槽还是不排水吗？
messages.en: Is the water still not draining from the sink?

messages.speaker: Mark (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Issa jinżel sew; il-plamer żblokka l-pajp.
messages.mt_standard: Issa jinżel sew; il-plamer żblokka l-pajp.
messages.zh: 现在排水正常了，水管工把管道疏通了。
messages.en: It drains properly now; the plumber unblocked the pipe.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 żblokka 记成“让原本过不去的东西通过”：手机解除锁定，水管解除堵塞。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To erupt, or to begin breaking apart and losing physical cohesion.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 喷发；或开始碎裂、松散，逐渐失去整体性。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Joħroġ b'qawwa, bħal vulkan, jew jibda jitfarrak u jitlef il-koeżjoni tiegħu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 喷发；爆发。
开始碎裂；开始崩解、散碎。

formal.mt: Il-vulkan żbroffa matul il-lejl u ħareġ ħafna rmied fl-arja.
formal.en: The volcano erupted during the night and released a large amount of ash into the air.
formal.zh: 火山在夜间喷发，向空中释放了大量火山灰。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Għaliex hemm tant trab mal-art? Toni: It-tikħil żbroffa ħdejn it-tieqa; irridu nsewwuh.
colloquial.en: Nina: Why is there so much dust on the floor? Toni: The plaster began to crumble near the window; we need to repair it.
colloquial.zh: Nina：地上怎么有这么多灰？Toni：窗边的抹灰层开始碎裂了，我们得修一修。

messages.speaker: Nina (住户)
messages.zh: 地上怎么有这么多灰？
messages.en: Why is there so much dust on the floor?

messages.speaker: Toni (家人)
messages.mt_spoken: It-tikħil żbroffa ħdejn it-tieqa; irridu nsewwuh.
messages.mt_standard: It-tikħil żbroffa ħdejn it-tieqa; irridu nsewwuh.
messages.zh: 窗边的抹灰层开始碎裂了，我们得修一修。
messages.en: The plaster began to crumble near the window; we need to repair it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两幅画面记 żbroffa：火山向外喷发，抹灰层开始碎裂；分别对应两个义项。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Resembling a penis in shape, or having a phallic form.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形状像阴茎的；呈阳具形态的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jixbah pene fil-forma jew li għandu forma ta' fallus.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 外形像阴茎的；阴茎状的。
阳具形的；呈阳具形态的。

formal.mt: Il-katalgu jiddeskrivi l-oġġett bħala simbolu żbubi minħabba l-forma tiegħu.
formal.en: The catalogue describes the object as a phallic symbol because of its shape.
formal.zh: 目录根据该物件的外形，将其描述为一个阳具形符号。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Xi jfisser żbubi f'din id-deskrizzjoni? Daniel: Ifisser li l-oġġett jixbah pene fil-forma.
colloquial.en: Maja: What does żbubi mean in this description? Daniel: It means that the object resembles a penis in shape.
colloquial.zh: Maja：这段描述里的 żbubi 是什么意思？Daniel：意思是这个物件的形状像阴茎。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.zh: 这段描述里的 żbubi 是什么意思？
messages.en: What does żbubi mean in this description?

messages.speaker: Daniel (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Ifisser li l-oġġett jixbah pene fil-forma.
messages.mt_standard: Ifisser li l-oġġett jixbah pene fil-forma.
messages.zh: 意思是这个物件的形状像阴茎。
messages.en: It means that the object resembles a penis in shape.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 żbubi 放在博物馆的形状说明里记忆：它是描述“阴茎状、阳具形”的形容词。

gloss_zh: 涂漆；涂多层漆；重新上色

teaching_sense.en_definition: To paint a surface, including applying several coats or adding colour or paint again.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 给表面涂漆或上色，包括涂多层漆以及重新上色、重涂。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Japplika ż-żebgħa fuq wiċċ, anki f'diversi saffi jew mill-ġdid.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 涂漆；刷漆；上色。

sense_translations.en_definition: to apply several coats of paint
sense_translations.zh_definition: 涂上多层油漆；反复刷漆。
重新上色；再次涂漆；重涂。

formal.mt: Il-ħaddiem żebbagħ il-bieb bi tliet saffi ta' żebgħa u ħalla kull saff jinxef.
formal.en: The worker painted the door with three coats of paint and allowed each coat to dry.
formal.zh: 工人给门涂了三层漆，并让每层漆都晾干。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Il-bieb jidher qisu ġdid! Mark: Iva, missieri żebbagħ il-bieb mill-ġdid ilbieraħ.
colloquial.en: Sara: The door looks brand new! Mark: Yes, my father repainted the door yesterday.
colloquial.zh: Sara：这扇门看起来像新的一样！Mark：是啊，我爸爸昨天重新给门刷了漆。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 这扇门看起来像新的一样！
messages.en: The door looks brand new!

messages.speaker: Mark (屋主)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, missieri żebbagħ il-bieb mill-ġdid ilbieraħ.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, missieri żebbagħ il-bieb mill-ġdid ilbieraħ.
messages.zh: 是啊，我爸爸昨天重新给门刷了漆。
messages.en: Yes, my father repainted the door yesterday.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象刷子给旧门刷漆：刷一次、刷多层、重新刷，都能帮助记住 żebbagħ 的各个义项。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To make something dirty or messy, or to apply manure to land.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把事物弄脏、弄得脏乱，或给土地施粪肥。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Iħammeġ xi ħaġa jew jagħmilha mimlija żibel, jew ipoġġi d-demel fl-art.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 弄脏；使变脏。
糟蹋；弄得脏乱不堪。

sense_translations.en_definition: to apply manure (e.g. to a field)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 施用粪肥，例如给田地施粪肥。
施粪肥；用粪肥肥田。
弄污；玷污。

collocations.en: made the room dirty and messy

formal.mt: Il-bidwi żebbel l-għalqa qabel iż-żrigħ biex itejjeb il-ħamrija.
formal.en: The farmer applied manure to the field before sowing to improve the soil.
formal.zh: 农民在播种前给田地施了粪肥，以改善土壤。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Min żebbel il-kamra b'dan il-karti kollu? Toni: Jien; kont qed nagħmel proġett, imma issa se nnaddaf.
colloquial.en: Lara: Who made the room such a mess with all this paper? Toni: I did; I was working on a project, but I'll clean up now.
colloquial.zh: Lara：谁把这么多纸弄得到处都是，把房间搞得这么乱？Toni：是我，我刚才在做一个项目，现在就收拾。

messages.speaker: Lara (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Min żebbel il-kamra b'dan il-karti kollu?
messages.mt_standard: Min żebbel il-kamra b'dan il-karti kollu?
messages.zh: 谁把这么多纸弄得到处都是，把房间搞得这么乱？
messages.en: Who made the room such a mess with all this paper?

messages.speaker: Toni (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Jien; kont qed nagħmel proġett, imma issa se nnaddaf.
messages.mt_standard: Jien; kont qed nagħmel proġett, imma issa se nnaddaf.
messages.zh: 是我，我刚才在做一个项目，现在就收拾。
messages.en: I did; I was working on a project, but I'll clean up now.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记 żebbel 时分开两个场景：屋里是“弄脏、糟蹋”，田里是“施粪肥”；根据宾语判断。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who paints surfaces as a trade; in another sense, a person who deceives others.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 以给物体表面刷漆为业的工匠；另一义指欺骗他人的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li xogħolha hu li tapplika ż-żebgħa fuq uċuħ; f'tifsira oħra, persuna li tqarraq b'ħaddieħor.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 油漆工；从事刷漆、涂装的人。
骗子；欺骗他人的人。
油漆匠；从事涂装工作的工匠。

formal.mt: L-iskola qabbdet żebbiegħ tas-sengħa biex jiżbogħ il-ħitan tal-klassijiet.
formal.en: The school hired a skilled painter to paint the classroom walls.
formal.zh: 学校聘请了一名手艺熟练的油漆工粉刷教室墙壁。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex ma tafdax lil dak ir-raġel? Pawlu: Għax hu żebbiegħ; qal li ħallas, imma ma ħallas xejn.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why don't you trust that man? Pawlu: Because he's a deceiver; he said he had paid, but he hadn't paid anything.
colloquial.zh: Maja：你为什么不信任那个男人？Pawlu：因为他是个骗子，他说付过钱了，其实一分钱也没付。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex ma tafdax lil dak ir-raġel?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex ma tafdax lil dak ir-raġel?
messages.zh: 你为什么不信任那个男人？
messages.en: Why don't you trust that man?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax hu żebbiegħ; qal li ħallas, imma ma ħallas xejn.
messages.mt_standard: Għax hu żebbiegħ; qal li ħallas, imma ma ħallas xejn.
messages.zh: 因为他是个骗子，他说付过钱了，其实一分钱也没付。
messages.en: Because he's a deceiver; he said he had paid, but he hadn't paid anything.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 żebbiegħ 做两张人物卡：“拿刷子的油漆工”和“说假话的骗子”，靠上下文选择义项。

gloss_zh: 有肥效的；具有粪肥性质的；与粪肥有关的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Having fertilising properties, having the properties of manure, or relating to manure.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 具有肥效或粪肥性质的；也可指与粪肥有关的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu l-proprjetajiet li jagħmlu l-ħamrija aktar fertili, li għandu l-proprjetajiet tad-demel, jew li għandu x'jaqsam mad-demel.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 具有肥效的；能够增加土壤肥力的。
具有粪肥性质的。
与粪肥有关的；粪肥方面的。

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi l-effett żebbieli ta' dan il-materjal fuq il-ħamrija.
formal.en: The report describes the fertilising effect of this material on the soil.
formal.zh: 报告描述了这种材料对土壤的增肥作用。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Dan il-materjal jgħin lill-ħamrija? Ġanni: Iva, għandu effett żebbieli u jgħin lill-pjanti jikbru.
colloquial.en: Rita: Does this material help the soil? Ġanni: Yes, it has a fertilising effect and helps the plants grow.
colloquial.zh: Rita：这种材料对土壤有帮助吗？Ġanni：有，它有增肥作用，能帮助植物生长。

messages.speaker: Rita (园艺初学者)
messages.zh: 这种材料对土壤有帮助吗？
messages.en: Does this material help the soil?

messages.speaker: Ġanni (园丁)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, għandu effett żebbieli u jgħin lill-pjanti jikbru.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, għandu effett żebbieli u jgħin lill-pjanti jikbru.
messages.zh: 有，它有增肥作用，能帮助植物生长。
messages.en: Yes, it has a fertilising effect and helps the plants grow.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 żebbieli 写在肥料袋旁：它描述“有肥效、像粪肥或与粪肥有关”的性质，是形容词。

gloss_zh: 来自马耳他或戈佐岛 Żebbuġ 的；橄榄色的；橄榄形的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Describing someone or something from Ħaz-Żebbuġ in Malta or Iż-Żebbuġ in Gozo; also describing an olive-like colour or shape.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容人或事物来自马耳他的 Ħaz-Żebbuġ 或戈佐岛的 Iż-Żebbuġ；也可形容颜色或形状像橄榄。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li ġej minn Ħaz-Żebbuġ f'Malta jew miż-Żebbuġ f'Għawdex; jista' wkoll jiddeskrivi kulur jew għamla li tixbah lil żebbuġa.

sense_translations.en_definition: hailing from Ħaz-Żebbuġ in Malta or Iż-Żebbuġ in Gozo
sense_translations.zh_definition: 来自马耳他的 Ħaz-Żebbuġ 或戈佐岛的 Iż-Żebbuġ 的。

sense_translations.en_definition: resembling an olive in colour or shape
sense_translations.zh_definition: 在颜色或形状上像橄榄的。
橄榄色的。
橄榄形的。

collocations.zh: 一位来自 Żebbuġ 的艺术家

formal.mt: L-artist żebbuġi ppreżenta xogħol ġdid fil-wirja.
formal.en: The artist from Żebbuġ presented a new work at the exhibition.
formal.zh: 这位来自 Żebbuġ 的艺术家在展览中展示了一件新作。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Liema kulur trid għall-bieb? Mark: Irrid lewn żebbuġi; jogħġobni ħafna.
colloquial.en: Maja: What colour do you want for the door? Mark: I'd like an olive hue; I really like it.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你想把门涂成什么颜色？马克：我想要橄榄色，我很喜欢。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你想把门涂成什么颜色？
messages.en: What colour do you want for the door?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 我想要橄榄色，我很喜欢。
messages.en: I'd like an olive hue; I really like it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 画两张记忆卡：一张写 Żebbuġ 地名并画当地人，另一张画橄榄的颜色和形状；读 żebbuġi 时按上下文选择。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A coloured substance applied to a surface to give it colour or protection.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 涂在物体表面、用来着色或保护表面的油漆或涂料。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Sustanza li titqiegħed fuq wiċċ biex tagħtih kulur jew tipproteġih.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 油漆；用于涂覆表面并使其着色的涂料。

formal.mt: Il-ħaddiema applikaw saff żebgħa bajda fuq il-ħitan tal-klassi.
formal.en: The workers applied a coat of white paint to the classroom walls.
formal.zh: 工人们在教室墙面上涂了一层白色油漆。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għad baqa' żebgħa għall-bieb? Mark: Iva, hemm bott żebgħa fil-garaxx.
colloquial.en: Maja: Is there any paint left for the door? Mark: Yes, there's a tin of paint in the garage.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：还有油漆可以刷门吗？马克：有，车库里有一罐油漆。

messages.speaker: Maja (家人)
messages.zh: 还有油漆可以刷门吗？
messages.en: Is there any paint left for the door?

messages.speaker: Mark (家人)
messages.zh: 有，车库里有一罐油漆。
messages.en: Yes, there's a tin of paint in the garage.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 żebgħa 写在油漆罐的想象标签上，再联想刷子给白墙添颜色，用具体物品记住这个名词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To attack someone or something with insulting, scornful, or defamatory words; it can also refer to blasphemous speech.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用侮辱、嘲讽或损害名誉的言语攻击某人或某事；也可指说亵渎神圣的言语。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jattakka lil xi ħadd jew lil xi ħaġa bi kliem ta' insult, disprezz jew malafama; jista' wkoll ifisser li jidgħi.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 诋毁；用恶意言辞贬损某人的名誉或形象。
大加嘲讽；以强烈轻蔑的言辞贬斥。

sense_translations.en_definition: to vilify, to abuse, to defame, to blaspheme
sense_translations.zh_definition: 诋毁、辱骂、诽谤；也可指亵渎神圣。

formal.mt: Fl-artiklu tiegħu, l-awtur żeblaħ lill-avversarju minflok ma wieġeb għall-argumenti tiegħu.
formal.en: In his article, the author vilified his opponent instead of responding to his arguments.
formal.zh: 作者在文章中诋毁对手，而没有回应对方的论点。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex Mark ħareġ irrabjat mil-laqgħa? Lara: Għax xi ħadd żeblaħ il-proposta tiegħu quddiem kulħadd.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why did Mark leave the meeting angry? Lara: Because someone poured scorn on his proposal in front of everyone.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：马克为什么气冲冲地离开会议？拉拉：因为有人当着大家的面对他的提议大加嘲讽。

messages.speaker: Maja (同事)
messages.zh: 马克为什么气冲冲地离开会议？
messages.en: Why did Mark leave the meeting angry?

messages.speaker: Lara (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax xi ħadd żeblaħ il-proposta tiegħu quddiem kulħadd.
messages.mt_standard: Għax xi ħadd żeblaħ il-proposta tiegħu quddiem kulħadd.
messages.zh: 因为有人当着大家的面对他的提议大加嘲讽。
messages.en: Because someone poured scorn on his proposal in front of everyone.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一个人拿着写有 żeblaħ 的话筒，用尖刻言辞攻击别人；把它与中性的讨论、批评区分开来记。

gloss_zh: 使人跳舞；把不感兴趣的人牵涉进来

teaching_sense.en_definition: To make someone dance, or figuratively to involve someone in a matter they are not interested in.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使某人跳舞；也可比喻把对某事不感兴趣的人牵涉进来。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jġiegħel lil xi ħadd jiżfen, jew, b'mod figurattiv, idaħħal lil xi ħadd f'xi ħaġa li ma jkunx interessat fiha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使人跳起舞来。
使某人跳舞；让某人参与舞蹈。

sense_translations.en_definition: to involve someone (without them being interested)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 把某人牵涉进其并不感兴趣的事情中。

collocations.en: dragged his brother into the matter
collocations.zh: 把自己的兄弟也牵扯了进来

formal.mt: Il-mużiċist żeffen lill-mistednin b'għażla ta' kanzunetti ferrieħa.
formal.en: The musician got the guests dancing with a selection of cheerful songs.
formal.zh: 音乐家演奏了一组欢快的歌曲，让宾客们跳起了舞。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Min żeffen lil Mark fin-nofs? Lara: Pawlu, imma Mark ma ried ikollu x'jaqsam xejn ma' din il-kwistjoni.
colloquial.en: Maja: Who dragged Mark into this? Lara: Pawlu did, but Mark wanted nothing to do with this issue.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：谁把马克牵扯进来了？拉拉：是保罗，可马克根本不想参与这件事。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 谁把马克牵扯进来了？
messages.en: Who dragged Mark into this?

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Pawlu, imma Mark ma ried ikollu x'jaqsam xejn ma' din il-kwistjoni.
messages.mt_standard: Pawlu, imma Mark ma ried ikollu x'jaqsam xejn ma' din il-kwistjoni.
messages.zh: 是保罗，可马克根本不想参与这件事。
messages.en: Pawlu did, but Mark wanted nothing to do with this issue.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两个画面记 żeffen：先把朋友拉进舞池，再把朋友拉进一场他不想参与的争论，分别对应本义和比喻义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To cover a surface with a layer of tar or pitch.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在物体表面涂覆一层焦油或沥青。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jgħatti wiċċ b'saff ta' qatran jew żift.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 涂上焦油；用焦油涂覆表面。

sense_translations.en_definition: to cover in tar or pitch
sense_translations.zh_definition: 用焦油或沥青覆盖。

collocations.en: covered the entire surface with tar

formal.mt: Il-ħaddiem żeffet is-saqaf biex jipproteġih mill-ilma tax-xita.
formal.en: The worker coated the roof with tar to protect it from rainwater.
formal.zh: 工人给屋顶涂上焦油，以防雨水渗入。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'għamel il-ħaddiem fuq is-saqaf? Mark: Żeffet is-saqaf kollu; issa rridu nistennew.
colloquial.en: Maja: What did the worker do on the roof? Mark: He coated the whole roof with tar; now we need to wait.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：工人在屋顶上做了什么？马克：他给整个屋顶涂了焦油，现在我们得等一等。

messages.speaker: Maja (住户)
messages.zh: 工人在屋顶上做了什么？
messages.en: What did the worker do on the roof?

messages.speaker: Mark (家人)
messages.mt_spoken: Żeffet is-saqaf kollu; issa rridu nistennew.
messages.mt_standard: Żeffet is-saqaf kollu; issa rridu nistennew.
messages.zh: 他给整个屋顶涂了焦油，现在我们得等一等。
messages.en: He coated the whole roof with tar; now we need to wait.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 żeffet 配上一幅工人给屋顶刷黑色焦油的图；同时注意末尾是 t，避免与使人跳舞的 żeffen 混淆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who dances, especially as a performer or as someone skilled in dancing.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 跳舞的人，尤指从事舞蹈表演或擅长舞蹈的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li tiżfen, speċjalment bħala artist jew b'ħila fiż-żfin.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 舞者；跳舞的人；舞蹈演员。

formal.mt: Iż-żeffien professjonali ppreżenta żfin ġdid fit-teatru nazzjonali.
formal.en: The professional dancer performed a new dance at the national theatre.
formal.zh: 这位职业舞者在国家剧院表演了一支新舞。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Ħuk żeffien professjonali? Mark: Iva, huwa żeffien tal-ballet u jitħarreġ kuljum.
colloquial.en: Maja: Is your brother a professional dancer? Mark: Yes, he's a ballet dancer and trains every day.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你兄弟是职业舞者吗？马克：是的，他是芭蕾舞演员，每天都训练。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你兄弟是职业舞者吗？
messages.en: Is your brother a professional dancer?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, huwa żeffien tal-ballet u jitħarreġ kuljum.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, huwa żeffien tal-ballet u jitħarreġ kuljum.
messages.zh: 是的，他是芭蕾舞演员，每天都训练。
messages.en: Yes, he's a ballet dancer and trains every day.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 żeffien 写在舞台中央的人物旁，反复问“这是谁？”并回答“舞者”；用人物形象记住它是名词。

gloss_zh: 表示恼怒或斥责荒唐提议的动词性表达

teaching_sense.en_definition: A verb used chiefly as an irritated exclamation or dismissive response to a foolish or ridiculous suggestion.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 主要用作带有恼怒语气的感叹或回应，用来斥责、驳回愚蠢或荒唐的提议。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Verb li jintuża l-aktar bħala esklamazzjoni ta' dwejjaq jew bħala tweġiba li twarrab suġġeriment iblah jew redikolu.

sense_translations.en_definition: verb used mainly as an expletive, suggesting foolishness or a ridiculous proposal
sense_translations.zh_definition: 主要用作带有恼怒或斥责语气的感叹表达，暗示某种想法愚蠢或提议荒唐。

sense_translations.en_definition: Used to express annoyance, or as a response for a foolish suggestion or proposition
sense_translations.zh_definition: 用于表达恼怒，或作为对愚蠢建议、提议的斥责性回应。

collocations.zh: 得了吧，别提你那个馊主意了！

formal.mt: Fid-djalogu, il-karattru wieġeb "Mur żeggeg!" biex jesprimi d-dwejjaq tiegħu bis-suġġeriment redikolu.
formal.en: In the dialogue, the character replied "Oh, get lost!" to express his annoyance at the ridiculous suggestion.
formal.zh: 在这段对话中，人物用“去你的！”作答，表达他对那个荒唐建议的恼怒。

colloquial.mt: Pawlu: Għaliex ma tagħmilx ix-xogħol tiegħi wkoll? Mark: Mur żeggeg! Għandi biżżejjed xogħol tiegħi.
colloquial.en: Pawlu: Why don't you do my work as well? Mark: Oh, get lost! I've got enough work of my own.
colloquial.zh: 保罗：你干脆把我的活也做了吧？马克：去你的！我自己的活已经够多了。

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex ma tagħmilx ix-xogħol tiegħi wkoll?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex ma tagħmilx ix-xogħol tiegħi wkoll?
messages.zh: 你干脆把我的活也做了吧？
messages.en: Why don't you do my work as well?

messages.speaker: Mark (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Mur żeggeg! Għandi biżżejjed xogħol tiegħi.
messages.mt_standard: Mur żeggeg! Għandi biżżejjed xogħol tiegħi.
messages.zh: 去你的！我自己的活已经够多了。
messages.en: Oh, get lost! I've got enough work of my own.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象听到荒唐要求时皱眉摆手，说出 Mur żeggeg!；把整句与恼怒、斥退的语气一起记，避免当成礼貌拒绝。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To wiggle or sway, or to cause something to become unsteady.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 来回扭动或摇摆，也指使某物摇晃、失去稳定。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jiċċaqlaq 'l hawn u 'l hemm, jew iġiegħel xi ħaġa titbandal jew titlef l-istabbiltà.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 扭动；小幅度地来回摆动。
摇摆；向两侧晃动。
使摇晃；使变得不稳。

formal.mt: Ir-riħ qawwi żegleg l-arblu, iżda l-bażi tiegħu baqgħet soda.
formal.en: The strong wind made the pole sway, but its base remained firm.
formal.zh: 强风使杆子摇摆，但它的底座仍然稳固。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Għaliex qbadna mal-ġenb tad-dgħajsa? Lara: Għax il-mewġ żegleg id-dgħajsa u bżajt li naqgħu.
colloquial.en: Mark: Why did we grab the side of the boat? Lara: Because the waves made the boat unsteady, and I was afraid we would fall.
colloquial.zh: 马克：我们为什么抓住船边？劳拉：因为海浪把船晃得不稳，我怕我们会摔倒。

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 我们为什么抓住船边？
messages.en: Why did we grab the side of the boat?

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax il-mewġ żegleg id-dgħajsa u bżajt li naqgħu.
messages.mt_standard: Għax il-mewġ żegleg id-dgħajsa u bżajt li naqgħu.
messages.zh: 因为海浪把船晃得不稳，我怕我们会摔倒。
messages.en: Because the waves made the boat unsteady, and I was afraid we would fall.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象小船左右摇晃：自身摇摆和使船不稳，都用同一个动作画面来记。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be present in great numbers or quantities, or to increase in abundance.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 大量存在、十分丰富，或数量增加而变得更加充足。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ikun hemm fi kwantità kbira, jew jiżdied u jsir aktar abbundanti.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 大量存在；十分丰富。
大量存在；增多；数量变得更加丰富。

formal.mt: Wara x-xita, il-wied żegħed bil-ħajja u dehru ħafna insetti ħdejn l-ilma.
formal.en: After the rain, the valley teemed with life, and many insects appeared near the water.
formal.zh: 雨后，山谷里生机勃勃，水边出现了许多昆虫。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Kemm hemm ħut hawn! Pawlu: Iva, dan il-post żegħed bil-ħut din is-sena.
colloquial.en: Maja: There are so many fish here! Pawlu: Yes, this place has abounded with fish this year.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这里的鱼真多！保罗：是啊，今年这个地方鱼特别多。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 这里的鱼真多！
messages.en: There are so many fish here!

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, dan il-post żegħed bil-ħut din is-sena.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, dan il-post żegħed bil-ħut din is-sena.
messages.zh: 是啊，今年这个地方鱼特别多。
messages.en: Yes, this place has abounded with fish this year.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把这个词配上满池鱼儿的画面：数量很多，还可以继续增多。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Affectionate caressing or pampering, or flattering words used to coax someone.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 亲昵的爱抚或宠爱，也指为了哄劝别人而说的奉承话。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tmellis jew attenzjoni mimlija ħlewwa; ukoll kliem ta' tifħir biex wieħed iħajjar lil xi ħadd.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 宠爱；娇宠；给予格外体贴的照顾。
爱抚；亲昵的抚摸。
动词 żiegħel 的动名词，表示爱抚、宠爱或哄劝这一行为。
爱抚与宠爱；温柔抚摸或娇宠的行为。
奉承；用好听的话哄劝别人。

formal.mt: Il-kelliem uża kliem taż-żegħil biex jipprova jikseb l-appoġġ tal-udjenza.
formal.en: The speaker used flattering words to try to gain the audience's support.
formal.zh: 演讲者用奉承的话试图赢得听众的支持。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Il-qattus reġa' ġie fuq ħoġri. Marija: Irid ftit żegħil; ara kif qed jitħokk ma' idek!
colloquial.en: Nina: The cat has climbed onto my lap again. Marija: He wants a little affection; look how he is rubbing against your hand!
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：猫又爬到我腿上来了。玛丽亚：它想让你宠一宠，你看它正蹭你的手呢！

messages.speaker: Nina (女儿)
messages.zh: 猫又爬到我腿上来了。
messages.en: The cat has climbed onto my lap again.

messages.speaker: Marija (母亲)
messages.mt_spoken: Irid ftit żegħil; ara kif qed jitħokk ma' idek!
messages.mt_standard: Irid ftit żegħil; ara kif qed jitħokk ma' idek!
messages.zh: 它想让你宠一宠，你看它正蹭你的手呢！
messages.en: He wants a little affection; look how he is rubbing against your hand!

cognitive_memory_aid: 用手温柔摸猫是爱抚，用甜言哄人是哄劝；把两种温柔讨好的场景连起来记。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To give off a foul smell, especially a smell of decay or rot.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 散发难闻的臭味，尤其指腐败、腐烂产生的气味。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Joħroġ riħa ħażina, speċjalment riħa ta' taħsir.

sense_translations.en_definition: to give off a smell of rot
sense_translations.zh_definition: 发出腐烂的气味；散发腐臭。
发臭；散发难闻的气味。

collocations.en: the rubbish gave off a foul smell

formal.mt: L-iskart li tħalla fix-xemx żehem u kkawża riħa ħażina fil-bitħa.
formal.en: The rubbish left in the sun stank and caused a foul smell in the courtyard.
formal.zh: 留在太阳底下的垃圾发臭了，使院子里弥漫着难闻的气味。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Minn fejn ġejja din ir-riħa? Toni: Il-laħam żehem għax il-friġġ ma kienx qed jaħdem.
colloquial.en: Rita: Where is this smell coming from? Toni: The meat has gone smelly because the fridge was not working.
colloquial.zh: 丽塔：这股味道是从哪里来的？托尼：冰箱之前没在运转，肉已经发臭了。

messages.speaker: Rita (室友)
messages.zh: 这股味道是从哪里来的？
messages.en: Where is this smell coming from?

messages.speaker: Toni (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-laħam żehem għax il-friġġ ma kienx qed jaħdem.
messages.mt_standard: Il-laħam żehem għax il-friġġ ma kienx qed jaħdem.
messages.zh: 冰箱之前没在运转，肉已经发臭了。
messages.en: The meat has gone smelly because the fridge was not working.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象打开坏掉的冰箱，腐臭扑鼻而来；用这个气味场景记住发臭的意思。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To neigh: to make the characteristic call of a horse.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指马嘶鸣，发出马特有的叫声。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jagħmel il-ħoss karatteristiku ta' żiemel.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 嘶鸣，专指马发出叫声。

sense_translations.en_definition: to neigh (make the sound of a horse)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 发出马的嘶鸣声。

formal.mt: Iż-żiemel żeher meta ra żiemel ieħor ħdejn il-bieb tal-istalla.
formal.en: The horse neighed when it saw another horse near the stable door.
formal.zh: 这匹马看见马厩门旁的另一匹马时，发出了嘶鸣声。

colloquial.mt: Ben: X'kien dak il-ħoss? Anna: Iż-żiemel żeher; qiegħed hemm wara ċ-ċint.
colloquial.en: Ben: What was that sound? Anna: The horse neighed; it is over there behind the fence.
colloquial.zh: 本：刚才是什么声音？安娜：是马叫了，它就在那边围栏后面。

messages.speaker: Ben (游客)
messages.zh: 刚才是什么声音？
messages.en: What was that sound?

messages.speaker: Anna (农场向导)
messages.mt_spoken: Iż-żiemel żeher; qiegħed hemm wara ċ-ċint.
messages.mt_standard: Iż-żiemel żeher; qiegħed hemm wara ċ-ċint.
messages.zh: 是马叫了，它就在那边围栏后面。
messages.en: The horse neighed; it is over there behind the fence.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把这个词和马抬头长嘶的画面绑定，专门记马的叫声这一动作。

gloss_zh: 多余部分；超出所需的量

teaching_sense.en_definition: An extra or surplus amount beyond what is needed or sufficient.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 超过需要或足够数量的部分，即多余、额外的量。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-parti jew il-kwantità li tibqa' aktar milli hemm bżonn.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 过量；超过适当限度的量。
超过足够程度的量；绰绰有余的部分。
多余部分；额外的量。
附加部分；另外增加的量。

formal.mt: Wara li jitqassam l-ikel, iż-żejjed għandu jinżamm f'kontenituri magħluqa.
formal.en: After the food is distributed, the surplus should be kept in closed containers.
formal.zh: 食物分发后，多余部分应存放在密闭容器中。

colloquial.mt: Sara: X'nagħmel biż-żejjed tal-ikel? Luqa: Żommu għal għada; nistgħu nikluh għall-ikla ta' nofsinhar.
colloquial.en: Sara: What should I do with the surplus food? Luqa: Keep it for tomorrow; we can eat it for lunch.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：多余的食物怎么办？卢卡：留到明天吧，我们可以午饭时吃。

messages.speaker: Sara (室友)
messages.zh: 多余的食物怎么办？
messages.en: What should I do with the surplus food?

messages.speaker: Luqa (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Żommu għal għada; nistgħu nikluh għall-ikla ta' nofsinhar.
messages.mt_standard: Żommu għal għada; nistgħu nikluh għall-ikla ta' nofsinhar.
messages.zh: 留到明天吧，我们可以午饭时吃。
messages.en: Keep it for tomorrow; we can eat it for lunch.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象饭已盛够，锅里还剩一份；把超过所需的那一份记作多余部分。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To decorate or embellish something, including adding extra details to a story.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 通过添加细节使某物更美观，也指给故事润色或添枝加叶。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jagħmel xi ħaġa isbaħ permezz ta' tiżjin, jew iżid dettalji ma' storja biex jagħmilha aktar interessanti.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 装饰；布置，使更美观。

sense_translations.en_definition: to add extra details to a story
sense_translations.zh_definition: 给故事添加额外细节；添枝加叶。
美化；润饰；通过添加细节使更生动或华丽。
装饰、修饰；增添细节以美化事物或润色叙述。

formal.mt: L-organizzatur żejjen is-sala bil-fjuri u bid-dwal għaċ-ċerimonja.
formal.en: The organiser decorated the hall with flowers and lights for the ceremony.
formal.zh: 组织者为典礼用鲜花和彩灯装饰了大厅。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Veru qabad ħuta daqshekk kbira? Mark: Naħseb li żejjen l-istorja ftit; il-ħuta li rajt jien kienet iżgħar.
colloquial.en: Maja: Did he really catch a fish that big? Mark: I think he embellished the story a little; the fish I saw was smaller.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：他真钓到那么大的鱼了吗？马克：我觉得他有点添枝加叶，我看到的鱼要小一些。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 他真钓到那么大的鱼了吗？
messages.en: Did he really catch a fish that big?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Naħseb li żejjen l-istorja ftit; il-ħuta li rajt jien kienet iżgħar.
messages.mt_standard: Naħseb li żejjen l-istorja ftit; il-ħuta li rajt jien kienet iżgħar.
messages.zh: 我觉得他有点添枝加叶，我看到的鱼要小一些。
messages.en: I think he embellished the story a little; the fish I saw was smaller.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给大厅添花是装饰，给故事添细节是润饰；用添加细节这条线串起两个意思。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who decorates places or objects to make them more attractive.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 为场所或物品进行装饰、布置，使其更美观的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li żżejjen postijiet jew oġġetti biex tagħmilhom isbaħ.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 装饰师；负责装饰或布置场所、物品的人。

formal.mt: Iż-żejjien għażel fjuri bojod u drapp blu biex iżejjen is-sala għaċ-ċerimonja.
formal.en: The decorator selected white flowers and blue fabric to decorate the hall for the ceremony.
formal.zh: 装饰师选用了白色鲜花和蓝色布料，为典礼布置大厅。

colloquial.mt: Elena: Min se jieħu ħsieb it-tiżjin tas-sala? David: Għada ġej iż-żejjien biex jara l-post u jagħtina xi ideat.
colloquial.en: Elena: Who will take care of decorating the hall? David: The decorator is coming tomorrow to see the place and give us some ideas.
colloquial.zh: 埃莱娜：谁来负责大厅的装饰？戴维：装饰师明天会来看看场地，给我们出些主意。

messages.speaker: Elena (活动筹备同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Min se jieħu ħsieb it-tiżjin tas-sala?
messages.mt_standard: Min se jieħu ħsieb it-tiżjin tas-sala?
messages.zh: 谁来负责大厅的装饰？
messages.en: Who will take care of decorating the hall?

messages.speaker: David (活动筹备同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Għada ġej iż-żejjien biex jara l-post u jagħtina xi ideat.
messages.mt_standard: Għada ġej iż-żejjien biex jara l-post u jagħtina xi ideat.
messages.zh: 装饰师明天会来看看场地，给我们出些主意。
messages.en: The decorator is coming tomorrow to see the place and give us some ideas.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把这个名词记成拿着鲜花和布料布置大厅的人，再与装饰这一动作配对记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Serving to decorate something or make it more attractive.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用于装饰、点缀，使事物更加美观的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jintuża biex iżejjen xi ħaġa jew jagħmilha isbaħ.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 装饰性的；起美化作用的。
装饰性的；作为点缀或饰物使用的。

formal.mt: Id-disinn jinkludi element żejjieni madwar it-titlu.
formal.en: The design includes a decorative element around the title.
formal.zh: 该设计在标题周围加入了一个装饰元素。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex hemm dan id-disinn żgħir hawn? Mark: Hu dettall żejjieni; jagħmel il-paġna isbaħ.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why is this little design here? Mark: It's an ornamental detail; it makes the page look nicer.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这里为什么有这个小图案？马克：这是一个装饰细节，让页面更好看。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex hemm dan id-disinn żgħir hawn?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex hemm dan id-disinn żgħir hawn?
messages.zh: 这里为什么有这个小图案？
messages.en: Why is this little design here?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Hu dettall żejjieni; jagħmel il-paġna isbaħ.
messages.mt_standard: Hu dettall żejjieni; jagħmel il-paġna isbaħ.
messages.zh: 这是一个装饰细节，让页面更好看。
messages.en: It's an ornamental detail; it makes the page look nicer.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把标题旁的小花纹想成装饰细节，用“为了好看而添加”记住 żejjieni。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A woman's breast.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 女性胸前的乳房。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Sider ta' mara.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 一个乳房。
女性的乳房。

formal.mt: F'dan it-test, il-kelma 'żejża' tirreferi għal sider ta' mara.
formal.en: In this text, the word 'żejża' refers to a woman's breast.
formal.zh: 在这篇文章中，żejża 一词指女性的乳房。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Xi tfisser 'żejża' f'din is-sentenza? Lara: Hawn tfisser sider ta' mara.
colloquial.en: Maja: What does 'żejża' mean in this sentence? Lara: Here it means a woman's breast.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这句话里的 żejża 是什么意思？拉拉：这里指女性的乳房。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.zh: 这句话里的 żejża 是什么意思？
messages.en: What does 'żejża' mean in this sentence?

messages.speaker: Lara (同学)
messages.zh: 这里指女性的乳房。
messages.en: Here it means a woman's breast.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用人体词汇卡记忆：正面写 żejża，背面写“乳房”，并配上“女性的乳房”这一短语。

gloss_zh: 滑倒；失误；滑溜性；湿滑表面

teaching_sense.en_definition: To slip or lose traction; also, to make a mistake, especially in speech.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 因失去摩擦力而滑动或滑倒；也指失误，尤其是说话时出错。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jiżloq jew jitlef il-qabda mal-art; ukoll, li jagħmel żball, speċjalment fil-kliem.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 滑动；滑倒。
一时疏忽；出现失误。
滑溜性；容易使人打滑的性质。
湿滑或容易打滑的表面。
打滑；失去抓地力或摩擦力而滑动。

sense_translations.en_definition: to slip, make a mistake (especially by saying something)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 失误；尤其指说错话或失言。

collocations.en: made a slip of the tongue

formal.mt: Il-ħaddiem żelaq fuq l-art imxarrba waqt li kien dieħel fil-maħżen.
formal.en: The worker slipped on the wet floor while entering the warehouse.
formal.zh: 那名工人进入仓库时，在湿地板上滑倒了。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex Mark qal l-isem ħażin? Lara: Żelaq fil-kliem; ried jgħid 'Pawlu'.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why did Mark say the wrong name? Lara: He made a slip of the tongue; he meant to say 'Pawlu'.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：马克为什么说错了名字？拉拉：他一时口误，本来想说“保罗”。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 马克为什么说错了名字？
messages.en: Why did Mark say the wrong name?

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 他一时口误，本来想说“保罗”。
messages.en: He made a slip of the tongue; he meant to say 'Pawlu'.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象“脚下一滑”和“嘴上一滑”两个画面，分别记住滑倒与口误；名词义另记为滑溜性或湿滑表面。

gloss_zh: 使滑倒；使出错；悄悄伸入或放入

teaching_sense.en_definition: To cause someone to slip or make an error; also, to slip something into a place.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使某人滑倒或出错；也指把某物轻轻或悄悄地放入某处。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jġiegħel lil xi ħadd jiżloq jew jiżbalja; ukoll, li jdaħħal xi ħaġa bil-mod jew bil-moħbi f'post.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使打滑；使滑倒。
使犯错；使判断或行动出现错误。
使某人滑动或滑倒。
轻轻或悄悄地伸入、放入。

collocations.en: slipped his hand into his pocket

formal.mt: Iż-żejt fuq l-art żellaq lill-ħaddiem waqt li kien qed iġorr kaxxa.
formal.en: The oil on the floor caused the worker to slip while he was carrying a box.
formal.zh: 工人搬着箱子时，地板上的油使他滑倒了。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Fejn poġġa l-biljett Mark? Lara: Żellaq il-biljett fil-but qabel ħareġ.
colloquial.en: Maja: Where did Mark put the ticket? Lara: He slipped the ticket into his pocket before going out.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：马克把票放在哪里了？拉拉：他出门前把票悄悄放进了口袋。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 马克把票放在哪里了？
messages.en: Where did Mark put the ticket?

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 他出门前把票悄悄放进了口袋。
messages.en: He slipped the ticket into his pocket before going out.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 żellaq 记成“让别人一滑”，再另配一幅“把票悄悄放进口袋”的画面，区分两种用法。

gloss_zh: 扭曲；打结；缠绕；扭后收缩

teaching_sense.en_definition: To become twisted, knotted or entangled, or to shrink when twisted.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 变得扭曲、打结或缠在一起；也指因扭转而收缩。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jitgħawweġ jew jitħabbel, jifforma għoqda, jew jiqsar meta jitgħawweġ.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 处于扭曲状态；发生扭曲。
打结；形成结。
缠绕在一起；变得纠结、扭曲。
因扭转而收缩或变短。

formal.mt: Il-ħajt tas-suf żellem waqt ix-xogħol, u kien meħtieġ li jinħall qabel ma jintuża mill-ġdid.
formal.en: The woollen thread became tangled during the work and had to be untangled before it could be used again.
formal.zh: 毛线在操作过程中缠结了，必须先解开才能再次使用。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Il-ħabel żellem u ma nistax nifirxu. Mark: Ġibu hawn; ejja nħolluh flimkien.
colloquial.en: Maja: The rope has become tangled, and I can't stretch it out. Mark: Bring it here; let's untangle it together.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：绳子缠结了，我没法把它展开。马克：拿过来，我们一起解开。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-ħabel żellem u ma nistax nifirxu.
messages.mt_standard: Il-ħabel żellem u ma nistax nifirxu.
messages.zh: 绳子缠结了，我没法把它展开。
messages.en: The rope has become tangled, and I can't stretch it out.

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 拿过来，我们一起解开。
messages.en: Bring it here; let's untangle it together.

cognitive_memory_aid: 拿一根想象中的绳子反复拧转，观察它扭曲、打结、缠绕并缩短，用这一动作串联各义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To daub or smear a surface, or to make it opaque.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在表面涂抹、抹上污迹，或使表面变得不透明。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jdellek jew iħammeġ wiċċ b'xi sustanza, jew jagħmlu mhux trasparenti.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 涂抹；把某种物质抹在表面上。
使不透明；使无法透过看清。
随意涂抹；抹上涂料或污迹。

formal.mt: Il-ħaddiem żelleġ il-ħġieġ biż-żebgħa, u ma baqax possibbli li wieħed jara minn ġo fih.
formal.en: The worker smeared paint over the glass, making it impossible to see through.
formal.zh: 工人把油漆涂在玻璃上，使人无法再透过玻璃看清。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Min żelleġ il-mejda biż-żebgħa? Mark: Jien, waqt li kont qed inpinġi. Se nnaddafha.
colloquial.en: Maja: Who smeared paint on the table? Mark: I did, while I was painting. I'll clean it.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：谁把油漆抹在桌子上了？马克：是我画画时弄的。我会把它擦干净。

messages.speaker: Maja (室友)
messages.zh: 谁把油漆抹在桌子上了？
messages.en: Who smeared paint on the table?

messages.speaker: Mark (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Jien, waqt li kont qed inpinġi. Se nnaddafha.
messages.mt_standard: Jien, waqt li kont qed inpinġi. Se nnaddafha.
messages.zh: 是我画画时弄的。我会把它擦干净。
messages.en: I did, while I was painting. I'll clean it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象手把颜料抹到玻璃上：先记“涂抹”，再记涂满后“看不透”的结果，两幅画面串起词义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Tending to daub or smear substances onto surfaces.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 倾向于在表面乱涂乱抹的；具有涂抹行为特点的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu t-tendenza jdellek jew iħammeġ l-uċuħ b'xi sustanza.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 容易或喜欢乱涂乱抹的。
涂抹的；具有乱涂乱抹特点的。

collocations.en: a painter who tends to daub or smear
collocations.zh: 作画时容易乱涂抹的画家

collocations.en: a boy who tends to smear things

formal.mt: Il-pittur żellieġi ħalla tbajja' taż-żebgħa fuq il-qafas waqt ix-xogħol.
formal.en: The painter, who tended to smear paint, left paint stains on the frame while working.
formal.zh: 这位容易乱涂抹的画家在作画时，把颜料污迹留在了画框上。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Dan it-tifel żellieġi; kull darba jħalli ż-żebgħa fuq il-mejda. Mark: Ejja ngħattulha qabel jerġa' jibda jpinġi.
colloquial.en: Maja: This boy tends to smear paint; he leaves it on the table every time. Mark: Let's cover the table before he starts painting again.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这个男孩爱乱涂抹，每次都把颜料弄到桌上。马克：他再开始画画之前，我们先把桌子盖好吧。

messages.speaker: Maja (家长)
messages.mt_spoken: Dan it-tifel żellieġi; kull darba jħalli ż-żebgħa fuq il-mejda.
messages.mt_standard: Dan it-tifel żellieġi; kull darba jħalli ż-żebgħa fuq il-mejda.
messages.zh: 这个男孩爱乱涂抹，每次都把颜料弄到桌上。
messages.en: This boy tends to smear paint; he leaves it on the table every time.

messages.speaker: Mark (家长)
messages.mt_spoken: Ejja ngħattulha qabel jerġa' jibda jpinġi.
messages.mt_standard: Ejja ngħattulha qabel jerġa' jibda jpinġi.
messages.zh: 他再开始画画之前，我们先把桌子盖好吧。
messages.en: Let's cover the table before he starts painting again.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 żellieġi 写在“爱把颜料抹得到处都是的人”旁边，重点记它描述涂抹的特点或倾向。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A twist, knot or entanglement, including one in a fishing net; also, a mistake or error.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 扭曲形成的结或缠结，包括渔网中的缠结；也指错误。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Għoqda, tidwira jew taħbil, inkluż f'xibka tas-sajd; ukoll, żball.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 一个扭结或结。
一个错误。
渔网中的缠结。
扭曲；扭转形成的部分。
失误；错误。

formal.mt: Is-sajjied sab żelluma fix-xibka u neħħieha bil-mod qabel tefa' x-xibka fil-baħar.
formal.en: The fisherman found a tangle in the net and carefully removed it before casting the net into the sea.
formal.zh: 渔民发现渔网中有一处缠结，便在撒网入海前小心地将它解开。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Hemm żelluma fil-ħabel; ma nistax nużah hekk. Mark: Ejja nħolluha bil-mod, imbagħad inkunu nistgħu nużawh.
colloquial.en: Maja: There's a knot in the rope; I can't use it like this. Mark: Let's undo it slowly, and then we'll be able to use the rope.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：绳子上有个结，这样没法用。马克：我们慢慢把结解开，然后就能用了。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Hemm żelluma fil-ħabel; ma nistax nużah hekk.
messages.mt_standard: Hemm żelluma fil-ħabel; ma nistax nużah hekk.
messages.zh: 绳子上有个结，这样没法用。
messages.en: There's a knot in the rope; I can't use it like this.

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ejja nħolluha bil-mod, imbagħad inkunu nistgħu nużawh.
messages.mt_standard: Ejja nħolluha bil-mod, imbagħad inkunu nistgħu nużawh.
messages.zh: 我们慢慢把结解开，然后就能用了。
messages.en: Let's undo it slowly, and then we'll be able to use the rope.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两张卡片并排记忆：一张画渔网里的结，一张圈出算式里的错误；这是词义联想，不是词源解释。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An instance of slipping, especially when someone loses their footing.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 脚下打滑、失去站稳状态的一次动作，可能导致跌倒。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Meta persuna tiżloq u titlef il-bilanċ, kultant b'waqgħa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 一次打滑或滑倒。

collocations.en: a slip on the wet floor

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi żelqa fuq l-art imxarrba li wasslet għal korriment ħafif.
formal.en: The report describes a slip on the wet floor that resulted in a minor injury.
formal.zh: 报告描述了一起因湿地板打滑而造成轻伤的事件。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'ġara? Rajtek taqa'. Mark: Ħadt żelqa fuq l-art imxarrba, imma ma weġġajtx.
colloquial.en: Maja: What happened? I saw you fall. Mark: I slipped on the wet floor, but I didn't hurt myself.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：怎么了？我看见你摔倒了。马克：我在湿地板上滑了一下，不过没受伤。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 怎么了？我看见你摔倒了。
messages.en: What happened? I saw you fall.

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ħadt żelqa fuq l-art imxarrba, imma ma weġġajtx.
messages.mt_standard: Ħadt żelqa fuq l-art imxarrba, imma ma weġġajtx.
messages.zh: 我在湿地板上滑了一下，不过没受伤。
messages.en: I slipped on the wet floor, but I didn't hurt myself.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象脚踩湿地板突然一滑，把 żelqa 记成可数的“一次打滑”，连同湿地板场景一起记。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Strong enthusiasm and eagerness to pursue an activity, purpose, or cause.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 对某项活动、目标或事业表现出的强烈热情和积极投入。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ħeġġa u entużjażmu qawwi biex wieħed jagħmel xi ħaġa jew jaħdem għal għan.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 热忱；对目标或事业的积极投入。
热情；迫切想参与或行动的积极心情。

formal.mt: Il-voluntiera ħadmu biż-żelu biex il-proġett edukattiv jirnexxi.
formal.en: The volunteers worked with zeal to make the educational project succeed.
formal.zh: 志愿者们满怀热忱地工作，努力使教育项目取得成功。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għadek taħdem fuq il-proġett? Mark: Iva, għandi ħafna żelu għalih u rrid inlestih sew.
colloquial.en: Maja: Are you still working on the project? Mark: Yes, I'm very enthusiastic about it and want to finish it properly.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你还在做那个项目吗？马克：是啊，我对它很有热情，想认真做好。

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.zh: 你还在做那个项目吗？
messages.en: Are you still working on the project?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, għandi ħafna żelu għalih u rrid inlestih sew.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, għandi ħafna żelu għalih u rrid inlestih sew.
messages.zh: 是啊，我对它很有热情，想认真做好。
messages.en: Yes, I'm very enthusiastic about it and want to finish it properly.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 żelu 放进“热情推动行动”的画面：愿意投入时间、主动把事情做好，就是这个词的核心感觉。

gloss_zh: 极久远的过去（仅用于 żmien żemżem）

teaching_sense.en_definition: A word used only in the expression 'żmien żemżem', referring to a very remote time in the past.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 仅用于固定表达 żmien żemżem，表示非常遥远的过去、很久很久以前。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kelma li tintuża biss fl-espressjoni 'żmien żemżem' biex tindika żmien imbiegħed ħafna fil-passat.

sense_translations.en_definition: a word used in 'żmien żemżem' suggesting remoteness in the past
sense_translations.zh_definition: 用于 żmien żemżem 中的词，表示过去的时间极为久远。
仅见于固定表达 żmien żemżem，意为很久很久以前。

collocations.en: since a very long time ago

formal.mt: Il-ġrajja tibda bil-kliem 'fi żmien żemżem', li jqiegħdu l-avvenimenti f'passat imbiegħed ħafna.
formal.en: The story begins with the words 'in the very distant past', placing the events in a very remote past.
formal.zh: 故事以“很久很久以前”开头，将事件置于极为遥远的过去。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Kemm ilek għandek dan ir-radju? Pawlu: Minn żmien żemżem! Lanqas niftakar meta xtrajtu.
colloquial.en: Maja: How long have you had this radio? Pawlu: Since ages ago! I can't even remember when I bought it.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这台收音机你用了多久了？保罗：很久很久了！我连什么时候买的都不记得了。

messages.speaker: Maja (孙女)
messages.zh: 这台收音机你用了多久了？
messages.en: How long have you had this radio?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (祖父)
messages.mt_spoken: Minn żmien żemżem! Lanqas niftakar meta xtrajtu.
messages.mt_standard: Minn żmien żemżem! Lanqas niftakar meta xtrajtu.
messages.zh: 很久很久了！我连什么时候买的都不记得了。
messages.en: Since ages ago! I can't even remember when I bought it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 żmien żemżem 当作整块记忆，联想故事开头的“很久很久以前”；不要把 żemżem 拆出来自由使用。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To engage in sexual relations outside marriage, or to behave as a philanderer; in religious contexts, to commit sexual sin.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 发生婚外或婚姻之外的性关系，也可指拈花惹草；在宗教语境中可泛指犯淫罪。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ikollu relazzjonijiet sesswali barra ż-żwieġ, jew ifittex relazzjonijiet ma' diversi persuni; f'kuntest reliġjuż, jagħmel dnub sesswali.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 发生非婚性关系；私通。
拈花惹草；轻率地与不同对象发展情爱或性关系。

sense_translations.en_definition: to fornicate; to commit adultery or any sexual sin
sense_translations.zh_definition: 私通；通奸，或在宗教道德语境中犯任何淫罪。

collocations.en: he had illicit sexual relations with another woman
he engaged in sexual relations outside marriage
collocations.zh: 他发生了婚姻之外的性关系

formal.mt: Fit-test reliġjuż, il-verb 'żena' jirreferi għal imġiba sesswali meqjusa bħala dnub.
formal.en: In the religious text, the verb 'żena' refers to sexual conduct regarded as sinful.
formal.zh: 在这篇宗教文本中，动词 żena 指被视为罪的性行为。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Hawn jgħid li r-raġel żena. Xi jfisser? Lara: F'din l-istorja jfisser li kellu relazzjoni sesswali barra ż-żwieġ.
colloquial.en: Maja: It says here that the man 'żena'. What does that mean? Lara: In this story, it means he had a sexual relationship outside marriage.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这里说那个男人 żena，是什么意思？拉拉：在这个故事里，就是说他发生了婚外性关系。

messages.speaker: Maja (读书会成员)
messages.mt_spoken: Hawn jgħid li r-raġel żena. Xi jfisser?
messages.mt_standard: Hawn jgħid li r-raġel żena. Xi jfisser?
messages.zh: 这里说那个男人 żena，是什么意思？
messages.en: It says here that the man 'żena'. What does that mean?

messages.speaker: Lara (读书会成员)
messages.mt_spoken: F'din l-istorja jfisser li kellu relazzjoni sesswali barra ż-żwieġ.
messages.mt_standard: F'din l-istorja jfisser li kellu relazzjoni sesswali barra ż-żwieġ.
messages.zh: 在这个故事里，就是说他发生了婚外性关系。
messages.en: In this story, it means he had a sexual relationship outside marriage.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“越出婚姻关系的性行为”这一场景记 żena，再根据上下文区分私通、拈花惹草和宗教意义的淫罪。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To move something back and forth, as when rocking a cradle, or to let something hang and swing.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使某物来回摇动，如摇摇篮；也可指让悬着的东西垂下晃动。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Iċaqlaq xi ħaġa 'l hawn u 'l hemm, bħal benniena, jew iħalli xi ħaġa mdendla titbandal.

sense_translations.en_definition: to rock (e.g. a child in a cradle)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 轻轻摇动，例如摇摇篮中的孩子。
摇动；使来回摆动。
使悬垂；让垂下的东西晃动。

formal.mt: Il-missier żengel il-benniena bil-mod sakemm it-tarbija raqdet.
formal.en: The father gently rocked the cradle until the baby fell asleep.
formal.zh: 父亲轻轻摇着摇篮，直到婴儿睡着。

colloquial.mt: Maja: It-tarbija raqdet? Mark: Iva, Pawlu żengel il-benniena bil-mod u hi raqdet malajr.
colloquial.en: Maja: Has the baby fallen asleep? Mark: Yes, Pawlu rocked the cradle gently and she fell asleep quickly.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：宝宝睡着了吗？马克：睡着了，保罗轻轻摇了摇篮，她很快就睡了。

messages.speaker: Maja (母亲)
messages.zh: 宝宝睡着了吗？
messages.en: Has the baby fallen asleep?

messages.speaker: Mark (父亲)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, Pawlu żengel il-benniena bil-mod u hi raqdet malajr.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, Pawlu żengel il-benniena bil-mod u hi raqdet malajr.
messages.zh: 睡着了，保罗轻轻摇了摇篮，她很快就睡了。
messages.en: Yes, Pawlu rocked the cradle gently and she fell asleep quickly.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 żengel 配上两个连续画面：摇篮来回摇，悬空的双脚来回晃；共同点都是往复摆动。

gloss_zh: 摇摆的；具有摇动动作的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Having or showing a back-and-forth rocking motion.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 具有来回摇动或摇摆动作的，用来描述物体或动作的摇动特征。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu jew juri moviment 'l hawn u 'l hemm, bħal meta xi ħaġa titbandal.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 具有来回摇动的动作或运动特征的。
摇摆的；来回摇动的。

formal.mt: Il-mudell juri moviment żengieli, b'ċaqliq regolari 'l quddiem u lura.
formal.en: The model demonstrates a rocking motion, moving regularly forward and backward.
formal.zh: 该模型展示了摇摆运动，有规律地前后移动。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex dan is-siġġu jiċċaqlaq 'il quddiem u lura? Pawlu: Għax hu siġġu żengieli; tista' titbandal fuqu.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why does this chair move forward and backward? Pawlu: Because it's a rocking chair; you can rock back and forth on it.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这把椅子为什么会前后动？保罗：因为它是摇椅，你可以坐在上面来回摇。

messages.speaker: Maja (孙女)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex dan is-siġġu jiċċaqlaq 'il quddiem u lura?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex dan is-siġġu jiċċaqlaq 'il quddiem u lura?
messages.zh: 这把椅子为什么会前后动？
messages.en: Why does this chair move forward and backward?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (祖父)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax hu siġġu żengieli; tista' titbandal fuqu.
messages.mt_standard: Għax hu siġġu żengieli; tista' titbandal fuqu.
messages.zh: 因为它是摇椅，你可以坐在上面来回摇。
messages.en: Because it's a rocking chair; you can rock back and forth on it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 看见 żengieli 就想象摇椅前后移动；把它贴在名词旁，提醒自己这是描述“摇摆特征”的形容词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Having an elongated or oblong shape, with a length noticeably greater than its width.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形状较长、长度明显大于宽度的，可指长形或细长的物体。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu għamla tawwalija, b'tul li jkun akbar b'mod ċar mill-wisa'.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 长形的；呈长度大于宽度的形状的。
呈延长形状的；细长的。

formal.mt: L-oġġett żengul tqiegħed fil-vetrina bit-tul tiegħu parallel mat-tarf tal-ixkaffa.
formal.en: The elongated object was placed in the display case with its length parallel to the edge of the shelf.
formal.zh: 这件长形物体被放入展示柜，其长边与搁板边缘平行。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Liema kontenitur trid, dak tond? Mark: Le, dak żengul ħdejh; il-pniezel joqogħdu aħjar fih.
colloquial.en: Maja: Which container do you want, the round one? Mark: No, the oblong one beside it; the brushes fit better in it.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你要哪个容器，圆的那个吗？马克：不是，要旁边那个长形的；画笔放在里面更合适。

messages.speaker: Maja (美术班同学)
messages.zh: 你要哪个容器，圆的那个吗？
messages.en: Which container do you want, the round one?

messages.speaker: Mark (美术班同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, dak żengul ħdejh; il-pniezel joqogħdu aħjar fih.
messages.mt_standard: Le, dak żengul ħdejh; il-pniezel joqogħdu aħjar fih.
messages.zh: 不是，要旁边那个长形的；画笔放在里面更合适。
messages.en: No, the oblong one beside it; the brushes fit better in it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象装画笔的长形盒子，长度明显大于宽度；用这个静态轮廓记住 żengul，抓住“形状细长”的意思。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To make something flintlike or as hard as flint.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使某物变得像燧石一样坚硬，或具有燧石般的性质。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jagħmel xi ħaġa tixbah liż-żnied jew iebsa bħaż-żnied.

sense_translations.en_definition: to make sth. hard, like flint
sense_translations.zh_definition: 使某物变得坚硬，如同燧石。

sense_translations.en_definition: to make something flintlike; or as hard as flint
sense_translations.zh_definition: 使某物具有燧石般的性质，或使其坚硬如燧石。

collocations.en: he made the material as hard as flint
collocations.zh: 他使材料变得坚硬如燧石

collocations.en: he made the surface as hard as flint
collocations.zh: 他使表面变得坚硬如燧石

formal.mt: Fis-sentenza ta' eżempju 'Il-proċess żenned il-materjal', il-verb jindika li l-materjal sar iebes bħaż-żnied.
formal.en: In the example sentence 'The process made the material as hard as flint', the verb indicates that the material became flint-hard.
formal.zh: 在例句“这一过程使材料变得坚硬如燧石”中，该动词表示材料变得像燧石一样坚硬。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Xi jfisser 'żenned il-wiċċ'? Mark: Ifisser li għamel il-wiċċ iebes bħaż-żnied.
colloquial.en: Maja: What does 'żenned il-wiċċ' mean? Mark: It means he made the surface as hard as flint.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：żenned il-wiċċ 是什么意思？马克：意思是他使表面变得像燧石一样坚硬。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.zh: żenned il-wiċċ 是什么意思？
messages.en: What does 'żenned il-wiċċ' mean?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Ifisser li għamel il-wiċċ iebes bħaż-żnied.
messages.mt_standard: Ifisser li għamel il-wiċċ iebes bħaż-żnied.
messages.zh: 意思是他使表面变得像燧石一样坚硬。
messages.en: It means he made the surface as hard as flint.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一块材料经过变化，表面硬得像燧石；把 żenned 记成“使某物变硬”的动作，并保留燧石这一比较标准。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A narrow path, especially a small country lane.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一条狭窄的小路，尤指乡间的小径。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Mogħdija dejqa, speċjalment waħda żgħira fil-kampanja.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 狭窄的小路。

sense_translations.en_definition: a narrow path, especially a minor country lane
sense_translations.zh_definition: 狭窄的小路，尤指乡间的小径。

formal.mt: Żenqa dejqa tgħaddi bejn l-għelieqi u twassal sal-kappella.
formal.en: A narrow lane runs between the fields and leads to the chapel.
formal.zh: 一条狭窄的小路穿过田地之间，通往小教堂。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Ngħaddu minn din iż-żenqa? Mark: Iva, twassal dritt sal-knisja.
colloquial.en: Lara: Shall we go down this lane? Mark: Yes, it leads straight to the church.
colloquial.zh: Lara：我们走这条小路吗？Mark：好，它直通教堂。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 我们走这条小路吗？
messages.en: Shall we go down this lane?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 好，它直通教堂。
messages.en: Yes, it leads straight to the church.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 żenqa 配上一幅两侧都是田地的窄路图，想象只能并排走一两个人，记住它是小径。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To begin to grow light as morning approaches.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指清晨到来时，天空开始变亮。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jibda jidher id-dawl tal-jum filgħodu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 破晓；天开始亮。

sense_translations.en_definition: to dawn (to begin to brighten with daylight)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 破晓，即天空开始因日光而变亮。

formal.mt: Meta żernaq, il-grupp beda l-mixja lejn il-kosta.
formal.en: When dawn broke, the group began the walk towards the coast.
formal.zh: 天亮时，队伍开始步行前往海岸。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Diġà żernaq? Pawlu: Iva, issa nistgħu noħorġu.
colloquial.en: Nina: Has dawn broken already? Pawlu: Yes, we can go out now.
colloquial.zh: Nina：已经天亮了吗？Pawlu：是啊，现在我们可以出门了。

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.zh: 已经天亮了吗？
messages.en: Has dawn broken already?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.zh: 是啊，现在我们可以出门了。
messages.en: Yes, we can go out now.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 żernaq 想成一段天空从黑变亮的短片：它表示天亮这个变化动作，可与表示黎明的名词 żerniq 对照记。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The early morning period when daylight first appears, especially just before sunrise.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 清晨日光初现的时段，尤指太阳升起前的黎明。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-ħin kmieni filgħodu meta jibda jidher id-dawl tal-jum, speċjalment qabel tlugħ ix-xemx.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 黎明；破晓时分。
破晓；天色开始变亮的时刻或过程。

sense_translations.en_definition: sunrise, dawn; daybreak (morning twilight period immediately before sunrise)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 日出；黎明；破晓，尤指日出前紧接着的一段晨曦时光。

formal.mt: Fiż-żerniq, id-dawl kien għadu dgħajjef u t-toroq kienu kwieti.
formal.en: At dawn, the light was still faint and the streets were quiet.
formal.zh: 黎明时分，光线仍然微弱，街道十分安静。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Meta se nitilqu għas-sajd? Toni: Fiż-żerniq, qabel ma titla' x-xemx.
colloquial.en: Sara: When are we leaving to go fishing? Toni: At dawn, before the sun rises.
colloquial.zh: Sara：我们什么时候出发去钓鱼？Toni：黎明时分，太阳升起之前。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 我们什么时候出发去钓鱼？
messages.en: When are we leaving to go fishing?

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.zh: 黎明时分，太阳升起之前。
messages.en: At dawn, before the sun rises.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 żerniq 放进清晨日程表，标在太阳升起之前；它是一个时段名词，记忆时搭配 fiż-żerniq「在黎明时分」。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who sows or scatters seeds.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把种子播入土中或撒在地里的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li tiżra' jew ixxerred iż-żrieragħ fl-art.

sense_translations.en_definition: sb. who scatters seeds or sows
sense_translations.zh_definition: 撒种或播种的人。
播种者。

formal.mt: Iż-żerriegħ xerred iż-żrieragħ b'mod indaqs fuq l-art imħejjija.
formal.en: The sower scattered the seeds evenly over the prepared soil.
formal.zh: 播种者把种子均匀地撒在准备好的土地上。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Min hu dak ir-raġel fl-għalqa? Ġanni: Dak iż-żerriegħ; qed jiżra' l-qamħ.
colloquial.en: Maja: Who is that man in the field? Ġanni: That is the sower; he is sowing wheat.
colloquial.zh: Maja：田里那个男人是谁？Ġanni：那是播种的人，他正在播小麦。

messages.speaker: Maja (参观者)
messages.zh: 田里那个男人是谁？
messages.en: Who is that man in the field?

messages.speaker: Ġanni (农民)
messages.zh: 那是播种的人，他正在播小麦。
messages.en: That is the sower; he is sowing wheat.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 żerriegħ 画一个手拿种袋、向田里撒种的人，用人物画面记住「播种者」，再与 żerriegħa「种子」对照。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A plant seed that can develop into a new plant under suitable conditions.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 植物的种子，在适宜条件下能够发育成新的植株。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Parti ta' pjanta li minnha tista' tikber pjanta ġdida f'kundizzjonijiet xierqa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 种子。
植物的种子。
精液；种子（生殖义）；精子。

formal.mt: It-tfal poġġew żerriegħa tal-fażola f'kull qasrija u saqewha.
formal.en: The children placed a bean seed in each pot and watered it.
formal.zh: 孩子们在每个花盆里放入一粒菜豆种子，并给它浇水。

colloquial.mt: Lina: Din iż-żerriegħa se ssir pjanta? Marija: Iva, jekk tieħu biżżejjed ilma u dawl.
colloquial.en: Lina: Will this seed grow into a plant? Marija: Yes, if it gets enough water and light.
colloquial.zh: Lina：这粒种子会长成植物吗？Marija：会的，只要它得到足够的水和光。

messages.speaker: Lina (女儿)
messages.zh: 这粒种子会长成植物吗？
messages.en: Will this seed grow into a plant?

messages.speaker: Marija (母亲)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, jekk tieħu biżżejjed ilma u dawl.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, jekk tieħu biżżejjed ilma u dawl.
messages.zh: 会的，只要它得到足够的水和光。
messages.en: Yes, if it gets enough water and light.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 żerriegħa 写在一粒正在发芽的种子旁，先记植物义；遇到生殖语境时，再按上下文理解为精液或精子。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To move something by making it slide along a surface.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 让某物沿着表面滑动，从而移动它。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Iċaqlaq xi ħaġa billi jġegħelha tiżżerżaq fuq wiċċ.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使某物滑动；把某物滑移。
使之滑动。
把某物滑着移动或滑入某处。

collocations.en: slide the paper under the door

formal.mt: Il-ħaddiem żerżaq il-kaxxa fuq il-mejda sakemm waslet ħdejn it-tarf.
formal.en: The worker slid the box across the table until it reached a position near the edge.
formal.zh: 工人让箱子沿桌面滑动，直到它移到靠近桌边的位置。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Żerżaq il-kaxxa ftit lejja, jekk jogħġbok. Samwel: Hekk tajjeb, jew tridha eqreb?
colloquial.en: Rita: Slide the box a little towards me, please. Samwel: Is that all right, or do you want it closer?
colloquial.zh: Rita：请把箱子朝我这边滑过来一点。Samwel：这样可以吗，还是要再近一点？

messages.speaker: Rita (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Żerżaq il-kaxxa ftit lejja, jekk jogħġbok.
messages.mt_standard: Żerżaq il-kaxxa ftit lejja, jekk jogħġbok.
messages.zh: 请把箱子朝我这边滑过来一点。
messages.en: Slide the box a little towards me, please.

messages.speaker: Samwel (同事)
messages.zh: 这样可以吗，还是要再近一点？
messages.en: Is that all right, or do you want it closer?

cognitive_memory_aid: 记 żerżaq 时想象用手把箱子沿桌面推滑过去，关注「让某物滑动」的动作，并把被移动的东西一起记入句子。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To embellish or decorate something, especially by painting it in several colours.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 美化或装饰某物，尤指用多种颜色加以涂绘。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Isebbaħ jew iżejjen xi ħaġa, speċjalment billi juża diversi kuluri.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 美化；装饰；增添修饰。
用不同颜色涂绘。
使色彩多样；使呈现杂色。

sense_translations.en_definition: to variegate, to paint or decorate in various colours
sense_translations.zh_definition: 使色彩多样；用多种颜色涂绘或装饰。

collocations.en: decorate the walls in various colours

formal.mt: L-artist żewwaq il-ħitan tas-sala b'diversi kuluri biex jagħtiha dehra ferrieħa.
formal.en: The artist decorated the hall's walls in various colours to give it a cheerful appearance.
formal.zh: 艺术家用多种颜色装饰大厅的墙壁，使大厅显得欢快明亮。

colloquial.mt: Marta: Żewwaq il-kartellun bi ftit kuluri oħra. David: Tajjeb, se nżid l-aħmar u l-isfar.
colloquial.en: Marta: Decorate the poster with a few more colours. David: All right, I will add red and yellow.
colloquial.zh: Marta：再用几种颜色装饰一下海报吧。David：好，我会加上红色和黄色。

messages.speaker: Marta (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Żewwaq il-kartellun bi ftit kuluri oħra.
messages.mt_standard: Żewwaq il-kartellun bi ftit kuluri oħra.
messages.zh: 再用几种颜色装饰一下海报吧。
messages.en: Decorate the poster with a few more colours.

messages.speaker: David (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Tajjeb, se nżid l-aħmar u l-isfar.
messages.mt_standard: Tajjeb, se nżid l-aħmar u l-isfar.
messages.zh: 好，我会加上红色和黄色。
messages.en: All right, I will add red and yellow.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 żewwaq 与一张逐渐添上红黄蓝的海报联系起来，记住它表示增添装饰、用多种颜色美化某物。

gloss_zh: 使结婚；为某人找配偶；配对

teaching_sense.en_definition: To join two people in marriage, arrange a marriage for someone, or pair things together.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使两人结为夫妻、为某人安排婚配，也可指把物品配成一对。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Għaqqad żewġ persuni fiż-żwieġ, sab sieħeb jew sieħba għal xi ħadd, jew qabbad affarijiet f'pari.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使结婚；使两人结为夫妻。
将某人嫁出或安排某人与人结婚。

sense_translations.en_definition: to find a spouse for sb.
sense_translations.zh_definition: 为某人寻找配偶。
把物品配成对。

sense_translations.en_definition: to wed; to marry (officially join two people in marriage)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 为两人主持婚礼，使其正式结为夫妻。

sense_translations.en_definition: to marry off; to find a spouse for
sense_translations.zh_definition: 为某人安排婚事；替某人找到配偶。

formal.mt: Il-qassis żewweġ lill-koppja waqt ċerimonja żgħira fil-knisja.
formal.en: The priest joined the couple in marriage during a small ceremony in the church.
formal.zh: 神父在教堂举行的一场小型仪式中为这对新人主持了婚礼。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Min żewweġ lil oħtok u lil żewġha? Pawlu: Żewwiġhom il-qassis tar-raħal tagħna.
colloquial.en: Maja: Who married your sister and her husband? Pawlu: The priest from our village married them.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：谁为你姐姐和她丈夫主持了婚礼？保罗：是我们村的神父。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Min żewweġ lil oħtok u lil żewġha?
messages.mt_standard: Min żewweġ lil oħtok u lil żewġha?
messages.zh: 谁为你姐姐和她丈夫主持了婚礼？
messages.en: Who married your sister and her husband?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.zh: 是我们村的神父为他们主持的。
messages.en: The priest from our village married them.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“把两个凑成一对”作记忆画面：人可以结成夫妻，袜子也可以配成一对。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A husband: a man considered in relation to the person he is married to.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 丈夫，即相对于其配偶而言的已婚男性。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Raġel miżżewweġ, meqjus fir-relazzjoni tiegħu mal-persuna li hu miżżewweġ magħha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 二；两个。
一对；两个组成的一组。
tnejn（“二”）用于名词前作定语的短形式，表示“两个”。
丈夫。
两个人组成的一对。
两件东西组成的一对。

formal.mt: Żewġ oħti jaħdem bħala għalliem fi skola primarja.
formal.en: My sister's husband works as a teacher in a primary school.
formal.zh: 我姐姐的丈夫在一所小学担任教师。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Min hu Pawlu? Marija: Pawlu hu żewġ oħti.
colloquial.en: Anna: Who is Pawlu? Marija: Pawlu is my sister's husband.
colloquial.zh: Anna：Pawlu 是谁？Marija：Pawlu 是我姐姐的丈夫。

messages.speaker: Anna (朋友)
messages.zh: Pawlu 是谁？
messages.en: Who is Pawlu?

messages.speaker: Marija (朋友)
messages.zh: Pawlu 是我姐姐的丈夫。
messages.en: Pawlu is my sister's husband.

cognitive_memory_aid: 做两张情境卡：żewġ kotba 配两本书，żewġ oħti 配姐姐的丈夫；用完整搭配区分数量义和亲属身份义。

gloss_zh: 滑动；闪烁；迅速掠走；轻快窜动；也指这些动作

teaching_sense.en_definition: To slide or move swiftly and energetically, to flit away, or to shine or glimmer, especially of the eyes; it can also describe fish frisking or flames licking.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 滑动、轻快而有活力地移动或迅速掠走；也可指发亮、微微闪烁，尤其形容眼睛，并可形容鱼的活跃游动或火焰的窜动。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jiżżerżaq, jiċċaqlaq malajr u b'ħeffa jew jitlaq f'daqqa; ukoll li jiddi jew ileqq, speċjalment dwar l-għajnejn, u li jiċċaqlaq b'ħajja bħall-ħut jew il-fjammi.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 滑动；沿着表面滑行。

sense_translations.en_definition: to twinkle or glimmer (used of one's eyes)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 闪烁；微微发亮，用于形容人的眼睛。
轻快地迅速离开；一闪而去。
滑动；滑行这一动作。
闪烁；主要指眼睛中闪动的光彩。
迅速掠走；轻快地一闪而去这一动作。

sense_translations.en_definition: to move (around) swiftly and energetically, to frisk (e.g. of fish), to lick (of flames)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 迅速而有活力地四处移动；如鱼欢快窜游，或火舌舔动、窜动。
发光；发亮；微微闪烁。

collocations.en: the fish darted energetically through the water
a light glimmered in his eyes
collocations.zh: 他的眼中闪过一道光彩

formal.mt: Il-ħut żeġġ fl-ilma ċar qrib il-wiċċ.
formal.en: The fish darted energetically through the clear water near the surface.
formal.zh: 鱼在清澈的水中靠近水面的地方活跃地窜游。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Rajt il-ħut ħdejn il-blat? Mark: Iva, żeġġ fl-ilma u sparixxa minn quddiemi.
colloquial.en: Maja: Did you see the fish by the rocks? Mark: Yes, they darted through the water and disappeared from my sight.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你看到岩石旁的鱼了吗？马克：看到了，它们在水里飞快地游动，转眼就从我眼前消失了。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你看到岩石旁的鱼了吗？
messages.en: Did you see the fish by the rocks?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, żeġġ fl-ilma u sparixxa minn quddiemi.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, żeġġ fl-ilma u sparixxa minn quddiemi.
messages.zh: 看到了，它们在水里飞快地游动，转眼就从我眼前消失了。
messages.en: Yes, they darted through the water and disappeared from my sight.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“滑一下、闪一下、窜一下”三个短镜头记 żeġġ；另做名词卡，把对应的滑动、闪烁和掠走分别列出，避免混淆词性。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To make a mistake or be inaccurate; also to confuse, mislead, or sing out of tune.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 犯错或出现不准确之处；也可指使人困惑、误导，或唱歌走调。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Għamel żball jew ma kienx preċiż; ukoll ħawwad, qarraq jew stona fil-leħen.

sense_translations.en_definition: 1. tfixkel, tħabbel, tħawwad,tqarraq jew żbalja. 2. stona fil-leħen.
sense_translations.zh_definition: 一、妨碍、使纠缠、弄乱、欺骗或犯错；二、唱歌走调。

sense_translations.en_definition: to make a mistake, to be inaccurate
sense_translations.zh_definition: 犯错误；表达、计算或判断不准确。

collocations.en: made a mistake in the calculation
sang the note out of tune

formal.mt: L-istudent żgarra fil-kalkolu tal-medja, iżda kkoreġa l-iżball qabel ma ppreżenta r-rapport.
formal.en: The student made a mistake when calculating the average, but corrected the error before submitting the report.
formal.zh: 该学生计算平均值时出了错，但在提交报告前纠正了错误。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għaliex it-total ma jaqbilx? Toni: Naħseb li xi ħadd żgarra fil-kalkolu. Ejja nerġgħu ngħoddu.
colloquial.en: Sara: Why doesn't the total match? Toni: I think someone made a mistake in the calculation. Let's count again.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：为什么总数对不上？托尼：我想有人算错了。我们再数一遍吧。

messages.speaker: Sara (同事)
messages.zh: 为什么总数对不上？
messages.en: Why doesn't the total match?

messages.speaker: Toni (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Naħseb li xi ħadd żgarra fil-kalkolu. Ejja nerġgħu ngħoddu.
messages.mt_standard: Naħseb li xi ħadd żgarra fil-kalkolu. Ejja nerġgħu ngħoddu.
messages.zh: 我想有人算错了。我们再数一遍吧。
messages.en: I think someone made a mistake in the calculation. Let's count again.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把算错一道题和唱偏一个音放在同一画面里，记住它可用于出错和走调。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To force something open, especially a door or another closed barrier.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用强力打开某物，尤指撬开或撞开门等封闭障碍物。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Fetaħ xi ħaġa bil-forza, speċjalment bieb jew xi ħaġa oħra magħluqa.

sense_translations.en_definition: to break open (usually used for a door, etc)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 破开、撞开或撬开，通常用于门等物体。
用强力打开；强行撬开。

formal.mt: Il-ħalliel żgassa l-bieb tal-maħżen u daħal matul il-lejl.
formal.en: The thief forced open the warehouse door and entered during the night.
formal.zh: 窃贼在夜间强行打开仓库的门并进入其中。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Għaliex il-bieb ma jagħlaqx sew? Pawlu: Xi ħadd żgassa l-bieb ilbieraħ, u issa hemm bżonn insewwuh.
colloquial.en: Nina: Why doesn't the door close properly? Pawlu: Someone forced it open yesterday, and now we need to repair it.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：门怎么关不严了？保罗：昨天有人强行打开了门，现在得修一下。

messages.speaker: Nina (住户)
messages.zh: 门怎么关不严了？
messages.en: Why doesn't the door close properly?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (邻居)
messages.mt_spoken: Xi ħadd żgassa l-bieb ilbieraħ, u issa hemm bżonn insewwuh.
messages.mt_standard: Xi ħadd żgassa l-bieb ilbieraħ, u issa hemm bżonn insewwuh.
messages.zh: 昨天有人强行打开了门，现在得修一下。
messages.en: Someone forced it open yesterday, and now we need to repair it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象原本紧闭的门被强力弄开，把“用力破开”的动作和这个词连起来。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To slip away, escape from someone, or run off quickly.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 悄然溜走、摆脱某人或迅速跑开，也可表示从抓握中滑脱。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ħarab, ħeles minn xi ħadd jew minn qabda, jew telaq jiġri malajr.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 逃脱；成功离开受限制或被追赶的处境。
甩掉某人；趁对方不注意溜走。
滑脱；滑走；溜开。
逃跑；跑走。
轻快地奔逃；迅速窜走。

collocations.en: slipped out from under the door

formal.mt: Il-ġurdien żgiċċa minn taħt il-bieb qabel ma l-ħaddiem seta' jaqbdu.
formal.en: The mouse slipped out from under the door before the worker could catch it.
formal.zh: 工人还没来得及抓住老鼠，它就从门下溜出去了。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Fejn mar il-qattus? Toni: Żgiċċa minn idejja u ġera lejn il-ġnien.
colloquial.en: Maja: Where did the cat go? Toni: It slipped out of my hands and ran towards the garden.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：猫跑哪儿去了？托尼：它从我手里挣脱，朝花园跑去了。

messages.speaker: Maja (室友)
messages.zh: 猫跑哪儿去了？
messages.en: Where did the cat go?

messages.speaker: Toni (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Żgiċċa minn idejja u ġera lejn il-ġnien.
messages.mt_standard: Żgiċċa minn idejja u ġera lejn il-ġnien.
messages.zh: 它从我手里挣脱，朝花园跑去了。
messages.en: It slipped out of my hands and ran towards the garden.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象怀里的猫一扭身就溜走，把滑脱、逃脱和迅速跑开串成一个动作。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To clear people or things out of a place, or evict someone from it.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 将人或物从某处清走，使地方腾空；也可指将某人驱逐出去。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Neħħa nies jew affarijiet minn post biex jitbattal, jew keċċa lil xi ħadd minn post.

sense_translations.en_definition: to clear a place of sth.
sense_translations.zh_definition: 清除某处的某些东西；将某处腾空。
将某人从其占用或居住的地方驱逐出去。
清空；把里面的人或物清走。

collocations.en: evicted the tenant from the apartment

formal.mt: It-tim żgombra s-sala mill-għamara qabel ma beda x-xogħol ta' tiswija.
formal.en: The team cleared the furniture out of the hall before the repair work began.
formal.zh: 团队在维修工程开始前清走了大厅里的家具。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Min żgombra l-kamra? Mark: Jien. Ħriġt il-kaxxi kollha biex nagħmlu spazju għall-mejda.
colloquial.en: Sara: Who cleared out the room? Mark: I did. I took all the boxes out to make space for the table.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：谁把房间清空了？马克：我。我把所有箱子都搬出去了，好腾地方放桌子。

messages.speaker: Sara (室友)
messages.zh: 谁把房间清空了？
messages.en: Who cleared out the room?

messages.speaker: Mark (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Jien. Ħriġt il-kaxxi kollha biex nagħmlu spazju għall-mejda.
messages.mt_standard: Jien. Ħriġt il-kaxxi kollha biex nagħmlu spazju għall-mejda.
messages.zh: 我。我把所有箱子都搬出去了，好腾地方放桌子。
messages.en: I did. I took all the boxes out to make space for the table.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“把地方腾出来”串联词义：搬走物品是清空，让住户离开则是驱逐。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Certain or confident that something is true or will happen.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 对某事属实或将会发生没有疑问的；有把握的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li ma għandu ebda dubju li xi ħaġa hija vera jew li se tiġri.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 确定的；确实的。
确信的；有把握的。
毫无疑问；肯定。
确信的；确定无疑的。

formal.mt: L-awtur huwa żgur li ċ-ċifri fir-rapport huma korretti.
formal.en: The author is certain that the figures in the report are correct.
formal.zh: 作者确信报告中的数字是正确的。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Int żgur li l-ħanut jiftaħ fid-disgħa? Pawlu: Iva, żgur. Iċċekkjajt il-ħinijiet dalgħodu.
colloquial.en: Lara: Are you sure the shop opens at nine? Pawlu: Yes, I'm sure. I checked the opening hours this morning.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：你确定商店九点开门吗？保罗：是的，确定。我今天早上查过营业时间了。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Int żgur li l-ħanut jiftaħ fid-disgħa?
messages.mt_standard: Int żgur li l-ħanut jiftaħ fid-disgħa?
messages.zh: 你确定商店九点开门吗？
messages.en: Are you sure the shop opens at nine?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.zh: 是的，确定。我今天早上查过营业时间了。
messages.en: Yes, I'm sure. I checked the opening hours this morning.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象核对时间后坚定点头说“确定”，再把 żgur li 连起来记作“确信……”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To assure someone, ensure that something happens, or make certain that something is true.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 向某人作出保证，采取措施确保某事实现，或查明确认某种情况。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ta assigurazzjoni lil xi ħadd, ħa ħsieb li xi ħaġa ssir, jew ivverifika li xi ħaġa hija hekk.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 向某人保证；使某人放心。
确保；采取措施使某事得到落实或实现。
确认；查明；确保无误。

collocations.en: made sure that everything was ready

formal.mt: Il-maniġer żgura li d-dokumenti kollha kienu lesti qabel il-laqgħa.
formal.en: The manager made sure that all the documents were ready before the meeting.
formal.zh: 经理确保所有文件都在会议前准备就绪。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Il-pakkett jasal għada? Mark: Iva, il-bejjiegħ żgura lill-klijent li jasal għada filgħodu.
colloquial.en: Maja: Will the parcel arrive tomorrow? Mark: Yes, the seller assured the customer that it would arrive tomorrow morning.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：包裹明天会到吗？马克：会的，卖家向顾客保证明天上午送到。

messages.speaker: Maja (同事)
messages.zh: 包裹明天会到吗？
messages.en: Will the parcel arrive tomorrow?

messages.speaker: Mark (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, il-bejjiegħ żgura lill-klijent li jasal għada filgħodu.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, il-bejjiegħ żgura lill-klijent li jasal għada filgħodu.
