messages.zh: 会的，卖家向顾客保证明天上午送到。
messages.en: Yes, the seller assured the customer that it would arrive tomorrow morning.

cognitive_memory_aid: 分两幅画面记忆：对人郑重点头是作出保证，逐项检查准备工作是确保无误。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To become smaller in size.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指物体的大小发生变化，变得比原来小。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Sar iżgħar fid-daqs milli kien qabel.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 变小；缩小。

formal.mt: Wara l-ewwel ħasla, il-flokk żgħar u ma baqax tal-istess daqs.
formal.en: After the first wash, the shirt shrank and was no longer the same size.
formal.zh: 第一次洗涤后，这件上衣缩水了，尺寸不再和原来一样。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Dan il-flokk żgħar wara l-ħasil! Pawlu: Iva, issa ma jiġikx.
colloquial.en: Marija: This shirt shrank after washing! Pawlu: Yes, it doesn't fit you now.
colloquial.zh: 玛丽娅：这件上衣洗后缩水了！保罗：是啊，现在你穿不下了。

messages.speaker: Marija (朋友)
messages.zh: 这件上衣洗后缩水了！
messages.en: This shirt shrank after washing!

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.zh: 是啊，现在你穿不下了。
messages.en: Yes, it doesn't fit you now.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把这条动词义配上“洗前合身、洗后缩水”的连续画面，记住它表达的是“变小”这一变化过程。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The period of a person's life when they are a child.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一个人还是孩子时的生活阶段，即童年。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-perjodu tal-ħajja meta persuna tkun għadha tifla jew tifel.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 童年；一个人年幼时的生活时期。

formal.mt: Fil-ktieb tagħha, l-awtriċi tiddeskrivi ż-żgħorija tagħha f'raħal żgħir.
formal.en: In her book, the author describes her childhood in a small village.
formal.zh: 作者在书中描述了自己在一个小村庄度过的童年。

colloquial.mt: Anna: X'tiftakar miż-żgħorija tiegħek? Mark: Niftakar il-logħob fit-triq ma' ħuti.
colloquial.en: Anna: What do you remember from your childhood? Mark: I remember playing in the street with my siblings.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：你的童年有什么让你记得的事？马克：我记得和兄弟姐妹在街上玩。

messages.speaker: Anna (朋友)
messages.zh: 你的童年有什么让你记得的事？
messages.en: What do you remember from your childhood?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 我记得和兄弟姐妹在街上玩。
messages.en: I remember playing in the street with my siblings.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 żgħorija 写在童年相册的封面上，看到它就想起小时候的游戏、家人和生活，固定记成“童年”。

gloss_zh: 青春；年轻状态；青年时期

teaching_sense.en_definition: Youth: the state of being young or the stage of life after childhood.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 青春或年轻的状态，也指童年之后的青年时期。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-istat li tkun żagħżugħ jew żagħżugħa, jew il-perjodu tal-ħajja wara t-tfulija.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 青春；青年时期。

sense_translations.en_definition: youth (quality or state of being young)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 年轻这一特质或状态；青春。
童年之后的青年时期。

formal.mt: Fiż-żgħożija tagħha, l-artista studjat il-mużika u bdiet tikteb l-ewwel kanzunetti tagħha.
formal.en: In her youth, the artist studied music and began writing her first songs.
formal.zh: 这位艺术家年轻时学习音乐，并开始创作最初的歌曲。

colloquial.mt: Lara: In-nanna kienet tiżfen ħafna fiż-żgħożija tagħha? Rita: Iva, u għadha tħobb tiżfen sal-lum!
colloquial.en: Lara: Did Grandma dance a lot in her youth? Rita: Yes, and she still loves dancing today!
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：奶奶年轻时经常跳舞吗？丽塔：是啊，她到现在还喜欢跳舞！

messages.speaker: Lara (女儿)
messages.mt_spoken: In-nanna kienet tiżfen ħafna fiż-żgħożija tagħha?
messages.mt_standard: In-nanna kienet tiżfen ħafna fiż-żgħożija tagħha?
messages.zh: 奶奶年轻时经常跳舞吗？
messages.en: Did Grandma dance a lot in her youth?

messages.speaker: Rita (母亲)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, u għadha tħobb tiżfen sal-lum!
messages.mt_standard: Iva, u għadha tħobb tiżfen sal-lum!
messages.zh: 是啊，她到现在还喜欢跳舞！
messages.en: Yes, and she still loves dancing today!

cognitive_memory_aid: 用人生时间线记忆：童年之后圈出“青年时期”，再画一个充满活力的人，分别对应它的时期义和年轻状态义。

gloss_zh: 垃圾；粪肥；烂泥污物；烂醉的；状态很差的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Waste or unwanted material that is thrown away.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 不再需要、准备丢弃的废物或垃圾。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Materjal jew affarijiet li ma jkunux għadhom meħtieġa u jintremew.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 垃圾；丢弃的废物。
垃圾；无用的废弃物。
动物粪便。
污物；烂泥；粪污。
喝醉的。
烂醉的；醉得厉害的。
处于很差状态的；状况糟糕的。
垃圾；废弃物。
动物粪便；用作肥料的粪肥。
烂醉的人；醉得厉害的人。

formal.mt: Ir-residenti għandhom ipoġġu ż-żibel fil-boroż magħluqa qabel il-ħin tal-ġbir.
formal.en: Residents should put their rubbish in closed bags before collection time.
formal.zh: 居民应在垃圾收集时间之前，将垃圾装入封好的袋子。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Tista' toħroġ il-borża taż-żibel, jekk jogħġbok? Mark: Iva, noħroġha issa.
colloquial.en: Rita: Can you take out the bag of rubbish, please? Mark: Yes, I'll take it out now.
colloquial.zh: 丽塔：请你把这袋垃圾拿出去，好吗？马克：好，我现在拿出去。

messages.speaker: Rita (母亲)
messages.mt_spoken: Tista' toħroġ il-borża taż-żibel, jekk jogħġbok?
messages.mt_standard: Tista' toħroġ il-borża taż-żibel, jekk jogħġbok?
messages.zh: 请你把这袋垃圾拿出去，好吗？
messages.en: Can you take out the bag of rubbish, please?

messages.speaker: Mark (儿子)
messages.zh: 好，我现在拿出去。
messages.en: Yes, I'll take it out now.

cognitive_memory_aid: 先用垃圾袋记住基本名词义，再分卡片记“粪污”和“醉酒、状态差”；遇到这个词时，靠上下文判断词性和意思。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Small decorative objects with holes through them, used to make necklaces, bracelets, or other decorations.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 带孔的小型装饰珠，可穿起来制作项链、手链或其他饰物。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Oġġetti żgħar għat-tiżjin, b'toqba minn fejn jgħaddi ħajt, li jintużaw biex isiru ġiżirajjen, brazzuletti jew dekorazzjonijiet oħra.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 珠子；可穿成串的装饰小珠。

formal.mt: Matul il-workshop, il-parteċipanti użaw żibeġ tal-ħġieġ biex jagħmlu brazzuletti mlewna.
formal.en: During the workshop, participants used glass beads to make colourful bracelets.
formal.zh: 在工作坊中，参与者用玻璃珠制作了色彩鲜艳的手链。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Liema żibeġ trid għall-brazzuletta, il-blu jew il-ħomor? Sara: Il-blu, jekk jogħġbok. Imorru mal-ġiżirana tiegħi.
colloquial.en: Maja: Which beads do you want for the bracelet, the blue ones or the red ones? Sara: The blue ones, please. They match my necklace.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：手链你想用哪种珠子，蓝色的还是红色的？萨拉：蓝色的，谢谢。它们和我的项链很配。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Liema żibeġ trid għall-brazzuletta, il-blu jew il-ħomor?
messages.mt_standard: Liema żibeġ trid għall-brazzuletta, il-blu jew il-ħomor?
messages.zh: 手链你想用哪种珠子，蓝色的还是红色的？
messages.en: Which beads do you want for the bracelet, the blue ones or the red ones?

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-blu, jekk jogħġbok. Imorru mal-ġiżirana tiegħi.
messages.mt_standard: Il-blu, jekk jogħġbok. Imorru mal-ġiżirana tiegħi.
messages.zh: 蓝色的，谢谢。它们和我的项链很配。
messages.en: The blue ones, please. They match my necklace.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象桌上散着一把彩色小珠，再用线把它们穿成手链；用这一整组珠子的画面记住 żibeġ。

gloss_zh: 增加；提高工资；接着说；补充说

teaching_sense.en_definition: To make an amount greater or add something further, including an additional spoken remark.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使数量增加或再添加内容，也可指在谈话中接着说、补充说。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Għamel ammont akbar jew daħħal xi ħaġa oħra; fid-diskors, kompla jew qal xi ħaġa oħra.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 增加；使数量或程度提高。
提高工资；给员工加薪。

sense_translations.en_definition: to continue (used of speech or conversation)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 接着说；继续谈话或发言。
补充说；在发言中再加上一点内容。

formal.mt: Id-direttur żied il-pagi tal-ħaddiema u żied jgħid li l-kumpanija kienet qed tikber.
formal.en: The director raised the workers' wages and went on to say that the company was growing.
formal.zh: 经理提高了工人的工资，并接着表示公司正在发展壮大。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Kemm żied zokkor fit-te? Pawlu: Kuċċarina waħda biss.
colloquial.en: Sara: How much sugar did he add to the tea? Pawlu: Just one teaspoon.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：他往茶里加了多少糖？保罗：只加了一茶匙。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 他往茶里加了多少糖？
messages.en: How much sugar did he add to the tea?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.zh: 只加了一茶匙。
messages.en: Just one teaspoon.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用一个加号串联词义：数量加一点、工资加一点、讲话再加一句；这样把“增加”和“补充说”一起记住。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A rise in an amount, number, or level, including a rise in salary.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 数量、数目或水平的增加，也可专指工资的提高。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Bidla għal ammont, numru jew livell ogħla, inkluż paga ogħla.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 增加；增长；增加的幅度或数量。
加薪；工资的增加。

collocations.en: an increase in the number of students

formal.mt: Ir-rapport juri żieda fin-numru ta' studenti li jattendu l-korsijiet ta' filgħaxija.
formal.en: The report shows an increase in the number of students attending evening courses.
formal.zh: 报告显示，参加晚间课程的学生人数有所增加。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Smajt li ħadt żieda fil-paga! Anna: Iva, u se nfaddal ftit aktar kull xahar.
colloquial.en: Mark: I heard you got a pay rise! Anna: Yes, and I'm going to save a little more each month.
colloquial.zh: 马克：听说你加薪了！安娜：是啊，我打算每个月多存一点钱。

messages.speaker: Mark (同事)
messages.zh: 听说你加薪了！
messages.en: I heard you got a pay rise!

messages.speaker: Anna (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, u se nfaddal ftit aktar kull xahar.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, u se nfaddal ftit aktar kull xahar.
messages.zh: 是啊，我打算每个月多存一点钱。
messages.en: Yes, and I'm going to save a little more each month.

cognitive_memory_aid: 在工资单和人数统计表上各画一根向上的箭头，并标上 żieda，记住它是名词“增加”，工资语境中就是“加薪”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To stop raining, so that rain is no longer falling.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指降雨停止，不再下雨。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Waqaf jagħmel ix-xita.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 停止下雨；雨停。
降雨停止；不再下雨。

collocations.en: as soon as it stopped raining

formal.mt: Wara li żief, il-ħaddiema komplew ix-xogħol fuq barra.
formal.en: After it stopped raining, the workers resumed their outdoor work.
formal.zh: 雨停之后，工人们继续进行户外工作。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Fl-aħħar żief! Noħorġu nimxu ftit? Ben: Iva, imma ħu żraben tajbin għax l-art għadha mxarrba.
colloquial.en: Lara: It finally stopped raining! Shall we go for a short walk? Ben: Yes, but wear suitable shoes because the ground is still wet.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：雨终于停了！我们出去走一会儿吧？本：好，不过要穿合适的鞋，因为地面还湿着。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 雨终于停了！我们出去走一会儿吧？
messages.en: It finally stopped raining! Shall we go for a short walk?

messages.speaker: Ben (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, imma ħu żraben tajbin għax l-art għadha mxarrba.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, imma ħu żraben tajbin għax l-art għadha mxarrba.
messages.zh: 好，不过要穿合适的鞋，因为地面还湿着。
messages.en: Yes, but wear suitable shoes because the ground is still wet.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象窗外雨点停止、你把雨伞收起的瞬间，配上一句“Fl-aħħar żief!”；记的是雨停，不必联想地面已经干了。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To show affection by caressing or pampering someone, or to use pleasing words to flatter or coax someone.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 通过轻抚或宠爱表达亲昵，也可指用讨好的话奉承或哄劝某人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Juri għożża billi jmelles jew ifissed lil xi ħadd, jew juża kliem sabiħ biex ifaħħar lil xi ħadd jew iħajru jagħmel xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 轻柔地抚摸，表示爱意。
奉承；用讨好的赞美取悦某人。
哄劝；用温和或讨好的方式劝某人做某事。
爱抚；宠爱或娇惯。
奉承、哄劝；通过讨好使某人接受劝说。

collocations.en: caressed and fussed over the baby

formal.mt: It-tifel żiegħel bil-qattus bil-mod biex ma jbeżżgħux.
formal.en: The boy gently caressed the cat so as not to frighten it.
formal.zh: 男孩轻轻地爱抚猫，以免吓到它。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex il-qattus mar ħdejn Pawlu? Rita: Għax Pawlu żiegħel bih, u issa l-qattus irid joqgħod miegħu.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why did the cat go over to Pawlu? Rita: Because Pawlu caressed him, and now the cat wants to stay with him.
colloquial.zh: Maja：猫为什么跑到Pawlu身边去了？Rita：因为Pawlu爱抚了它，现在它想待在他身边。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 猫为什么跑到Pawlu身边去了？
messages.en: Why did the cat go over to Pawlu?

messages.speaker: Rita (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax Pawlu żiegħel bih, u issa l-qattus irid joqgħod miegħu.
messages.mt_standard: Għax Pawlu żiegħel bih, u issa l-qattus irid joqgħod miegħu.
messages.zh: 因为Pawlu爱抚了它，现在它想待在他身边。
messages.en: Because Pawlu caressed him, and now the cat wants to stay with him.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把它放进两个画面记：手轻轻摸猫是爱抚，嘴说好听的话则可能是奉承或哄劝；具体含义由语境判断。

gloss_zh: 淫荡的；好色的；涉及淫乱或通奸的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Lewd or lustful, or associated with promiscuity, adultery, or sexual sin, especially in religious language.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容言行淫荡、好色，或涉及淫乱、通奸；尤其可用于宗教语境中的性方面罪行。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li juri xewqa sesswali bla rażan jew imġiba sesswali meqjusa ħażina, speċjalment f'kuntest reliġjuż.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 淫荡的；言语或行为猥亵的。
好色的；充满强烈性欲的。

sense_translations.en_definition: lewd, promiscuous, adulterous; (especially religion) given to or constituting sexual sin
sense_translations.zh_definition: 淫荡的、性关系放纵的、通奸的；尤指宗教语境中沉溺于或构成性方面罪行的。
形容有淫乱或通奸行为的人；对应中文中的淫乱者、通奸者。

formal.mt: Fl-analiżi tiegħu, l-awtur jiddeskrivi l-kliem tal-personaġġ bħala żieni.
formal.en: In his analysis, the author describes the character's language as lewd.
formal.zh: 作者在分析中把这个人物的言语描述为淫秽。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Kif kien il-kliem fil-film? Mark: Kien żieni; ma naħsibx li l-film hu adattat għat-tfal.
colloquial.en: Maja: What was the language in the film like? Mark: It was lewd; I don't think the film is suitable for children.
colloquial.zh: Maja：电影里的用语怎么样？Mark：挺淫秽的；我觉得这部电影不适合孩子看。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 电影里的用语怎么样？
messages.en: What was the language in the film like?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Kien żieni; ma naħsibx li l-film hu adattat għat-tfal.
messages.mt_standard: Kien żieni; ma naħsibx li l-film hu adattat għat-tfal.
messages.zh: 挺淫秽的；我觉得这部电影不适合孩子看。
messages.en: It was lewd; I don't think the film is suitable for children.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“言语淫秽、念头好色、行为淫乱”三个搭配记忆，并留意这个形容词通常带有负面或宗教道德评价。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To move the body rhythmically, usually to music.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 通常随着音乐有节奏地活动身体，即跳舞。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Iċaqlaq ġismu b'ritmu, ġeneralment mal-mużika.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 跳舞；随着节奏舞动身体。

formal.mt: Matul il-festa tal-iskola, Mark żifen ma' sħabu quddiem il-ġenituri.
formal.en: During the school celebration, Mark danced with his friends in front of the parents.
formal.zh: 在学校庆祝活动中，Mark和朋友们在家长面前跳了舞。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Pawlu żifen ilbieraħ? Maja: Iva, żifen magħna sa tard!
colloquial.en: Rita: Did Pawlu dance yesterday? Maja: Yes, he danced with us until late!
colloquial.zh: Rita：Pawlu昨天跳舞了吗？Maja：跳了，他跟我们一直跳到很晚！

messages.speaker: Rita (朋友)
messages.zh: Pawlu昨天跳舞了吗？
messages.en: Did Pawlu dance yesterday?

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 跳了，他跟我们一直跳到很晚！
messages.en: Yes, he danced with us until late!

cognitive_memory_aid: 看到 żifen 就想象一个人随着音乐动起来：它强调“跳舞”这个动作；与表示“一支舞”的名词 żifna 配对记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A light, gentle wind.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 轻柔吹动的风，即微风。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Riħ ħafif li jonfoħ bil-mod.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 微风；轻柔的风。

formal.mt: Filgħaxija, żiffa friska mill-baħar għamlet il-mixja aktar pjaċevoli.
formal.en: In the evening, a cool breeze from the sea made the walk more pleasant.
formal.zh: 傍晚，一阵来自海上的凉爽微风让散步更加惬意。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Niftħu t-tieqa? Mark: Iva, hemm żiffa friska barra.
colloquial.en: Maja: Shall we open the window? Mark: Yes, there's a cool breeze outside.
colloquial.zh: Maja：我们把窗户打开吧？Mark：好，外面有凉爽的微风。

messages.speaker: Maja (室友)
messages.zh: 我们把窗户打开吧？
messages.en: Shall we open the window?

messages.speaker: Mark (室友)
messages.zh: 好，外面有凉爽的微风。
messages.en: Yes, there's a cool breeze outside.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象窗帘只是轻轻晃动、脸上感到一丝凉意，把 żiffa 与“轻柔微风”的画面绑定记忆。

gloss_zh: 一支舞；一次跳舞；舞会；舞蹈方式

teaching_sense.en_definition: A particular dance or instance of dancing; also a dancing event or a way of dancing.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一支舞或一次跳舞，也可指舞会或某种跳舞方式。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Darba waħda ta' żfin, żfin b'passi partikolari, festa fejn in-nies jiżfnu, jew mod kif wieħed jiżfen.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 一支舞；一段舞蹈。
舞会；供人们聚集跳舞的社交活动。
żfin 的单次形式：一支舞或一次跳舞。
一次跳舞；一回舞蹈活动。
跳舞的方式；舞蹈风格。

formal.mt: L-istudenti ppreżentaw żifna tradizzjonali waqt il-programm kulturali.
formal.en: The students performed a traditional dance during the cultural programme.
formal.zh: 学生们在文化活动中表演了一支传统舞蹈。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Tiżfen żifna miegħi? Maja: Iva, imma agħżel waħda faċli!
colloquial.en: Mark: Will you dance a dance with me? Maja: Yes, but choose an easy one!
colloquial.zh: Mark：你愿意和我跳一支舞吗？Maja：愿意，不过选一支简单的！

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 你愿意和我跳一支舞吗？
messages.en: Will you dance a dance with me?

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 愿意，不过选一支简单的！
messages.en: Yes, but choose an easy one!

cognitive_memory_aid: 用中文量词“一支舞”抓住 żifna 的核心：把跳舞活动看成可数的一次或一支，再按语境扩展到舞会与舞蹈风格。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A thick, dark, sticky substance called tar or pitch.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一种浓稠、颜色深而黏的物质，指焦油或沥青。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Sustanza skura, ħoxna u twaħħal.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 焦油；深色、黏稠的物质。
沥青；焦油。

formal.mt: Il-ħaddiema koprew il-wiċċ b'saff ta' żift.
formal.en: The workers covered the surface with a layer of tar.
formal.zh: 工人们在表面覆盖了一层沥青。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'inhi dik ir-riħa? Mark: Riħa ta' żift; qed isewwu t-triq.
colloquial.en: Maja: What's that smell? Mark: It's the smell of tar; they're repairing the road.
colloquial.zh: Maja：那是什么气味？Mark：是沥青味，他们正在修路。

messages.speaker: Maja (路人)
messages.zh: 那是什么气味？
messages.en: What's that smell?

messages.speaker: Mark (同行朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Riħa ta' żift; qed isewwu t-triq.
messages.mt_standard: Riħa ta' żift; qed isewwu t-triq.
messages.zh: 是沥青味，他们正在修路。
messages.en: It's the smell of tar; they're repairing the road.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 żift 与修路时黑黑黏黏的一层材料和它的气味联系起来，同时记住“焦油、沥青”这组中文释义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To twist something or to be bent or curled; also to cheat or deceive someone.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 扭曲某物，或呈弯曲、卷曲状态；也可指欺骗某人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jgħawweġ xi ħaġa jew ikun mgħawweġ jew imkebbeb; ukoll iqarraq b'xi ħadd.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 扭；使某物扭曲。
欺骗；以不诚实的手段占便宜。
弯曲；卷曲；呈弯曲或卷起的状态。
欺骗；使某人相信不真实的事情。

formal.mt: Il-ħaddiem żilem il-wajer biex jagħmel ganċ żgħir.
formal.en: The worker twisted the wire to make a small hook.
formal.zh: 工人扭弯金属丝，做成了一个小钩子。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex Mark ma jridx jerġa' jixtri minn dak il-bejjiegħ? Rita: Għax il-bejjiegħ żilem lil Mark: biegħlu arloġġ imkisser u qallu li kien jaħdem.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why doesn't Mark want to buy from that seller again? Rita: Because the seller deceived Mark: he sold him a broken watch and told him it worked.
colloquial.zh: Maja：Mark为什么不愿意再向那个卖家买东西？Rita：因为卖家骗了Mark：卖给他一块坏手表，还说能正常走。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex Mark ma jridx jerġa' jixtri minn dak il-bejjiegħ?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex Mark ma jridx jerġa' jixtri minn dak il-bejjiegħ?
messages.zh: Mark为什么不愿意再向那个卖家买东西？
messages.en: Why doesn't Mark want to buy from that seller again?

messages.speaker: Rita (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax il-bejjiegħ żilem lil Mark: biegħlu arloġġ imkisser u qallu li kien jaħdem.
messages.mt_standard: Għax il-bejjiegħ żilem lil Mark: biegħlu arloġġ imkisser u qallu li kien jaħdem.
messages.zh: 因为卖家骗了Mark：卖给他一块坏手表，还说能正常走。
messages.en: Because the seller deceived Mark: he sold him a broken watch and told him it worked.

cognitive_memory_aid: 分成两组场景记忆：金属丝被扭弯对应形状变化，顾客被假话蒙骗对应欺骗；这是学习联想，不是词源解释。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To make the surface of something glossy or shiny.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使某物的表面产生光泽，变得光亮。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jagħmel il-wiċċ ta' xi ħaġa lixx u jleqq.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使某物有光泽；使表面光亮。
使某物变得光亮、有光泽。

formal.mt: Il-ħaddiem żileġ il-wiċċ tal-injam biex jagħtih dehra aktar sabiħa.
formal.en: The worker made the wooden surface glossy to give it a more attractive appearance.
formal.zh: 工人使木头表面有了光泽，让它看起来更加美观。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex il-mejda qed tleqq hekk? Pawlu: Il-ħaddiem żileġ il-wiċċ tagħha lbieraħ.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why is the table so shiny? Pawlu: The worker made its surface glossy yesterday.
colloquial.zh: Maja：桌子怎么这么亮？Pawlu：工人昨天把它的表面弄得有了光泽。

messages.speaker: Maja (顾客)
messages.zh: 桌子怎么这么亮？
messages.en: Why is the table so shiny?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (店员)
messages.zh: 工人昨天把它的表面弄得有了光泽。
messages.en: The worker made its surface glossy yesterday.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“处理前暗淡、处理后反光”的前后画面记忆 żileġ，重点记住它表示使东西变亮的动作。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An earthquake: a sudden shaking of the ground.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 地震，指地面突然发生的震动。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Theżżiża tal-art li sseħħ f'daqqa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 一声雷霆；一阵猛烈的雷声。
霹雳；伴随雷鸣的猛烈闪电。
地震；大地的震动。

formal.mt: Wara żilżla qawwija, l-iskola għalqet għal ġurnata.
formal.en: After a strong earthquake, the school closed for a day.
formal.zh: 一次强烈的地震之后，学校停课了一天。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Ħassejt dik iż-żilżla? Toni: Iva, ħassejt l-art titħarrek.
colloquial.en: Maja: Did you feel that earthquake? Toni: Yes, I felt the ground move.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你感觉到刚才那次地震了吗？托尼：感觉到了，我觉得地面在动。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你感觉到刚才那次地震了吗？
messages.en: Did you feel that earthquake?

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.zh: 感觉到了，我觉得地面在动。
messages.en: Yes, I felt the ground move.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 żilżla 和“地面突然震动”的画面绑定；再另设雷声、霹雳两张词义卡，借上下文区分。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An old horse, especially one regarded as no longer useful for work.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 老马，尤指因年老而被认为已经不能干活的马。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Żiemel xiħ, speċjalment wieħed li jitqies li m'għadux tajjeb għax-xogħol.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 一匹老马。
一匹衰弱或不中用的老马。
老而无用的马；不中用的老马。

collocations.en: to look after an old horse

formal.mt: Ir-raġel kien jieħu ħsieb żimlunazz li ma kienx għadu jintuża għax-xogħol.
formal.en: The man looked after an old horse that was no longer used for work.
formal.zh: 那名男子照顾着一匹已经不再用于劳作的老马。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Dak iż-żimlunazz għadu jaħdem? Toni: Le, issa jistrieħ u nieħdu ħsiebu.
colloquial.en: Maja: Does that old horse still work? Toni: No, now he rests and we look after him.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：那匹老马还干活吗？托尼：不干了，现在它休息，我们照顾它。

messages.speaker: Maja (访客)
messages.zh: 那匹老马还干活吗？
messages.en: Does that old horse still work?

messages.speaker: Toni (饲养员)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, issa jistrieħ u nieħdu ħsiebu.
messages.mt_standard: Le, issa jistrieħ u nieħdu ħsiebu.
messages.zh: 不干了，现在它休息，我们照顾它。
messages.en: No, now he rests and we look after him.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一匹已经退休、慢慢走动的老马，把 żimlunazz 记作“老马”；英语 nag 在这里也是马，不是唠叨的人。

gloss_zh: 色欲；非婚性行为；装饰；华美

teaching_sense.en_definition: Sexual lust, or sexual conduct regarded as sinful in a religious or moral context.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 色欲，或在宗教、道德语境中被视为有罪的性行为。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Xewqa sesswali qawwija, jew imġiba sesswali meqjusa bħala dnub f'kuntest reliġjuż jew morali.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 色欲；强烈的性欲。
非婚性行为，尤用于带有宗教或道德评判的语境。
装饰；起美化作用的饰物。
装饰；布置或装饰物。

sense_translations.en_definition: fornication, adultery, or any sexual sin
sense_translations.zh_definition: 非婚性行为、通奸，或任何被视为有罪的性行为。
美化、装饰；华丽奢美的美感。

collocations.en: the sin of illicit sexual conduct

formal.mt: Fit-test reliġjuż, iż-żina hija deskritta bħala dnub.
formal.en: In the religious text, illicit sexual conduct is described as a sin.
formal.zh: 在这篇宗教文本中，淫乱被描述为一种罪。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Iż-żina tal-festa tidher sabiħa! Toni: Iva, speċjalment id-dwal fil-pjazza.
colloquial.en: Maja: The feast decorations look lovely! Toni: Yes, especially the lights in the square.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：节庆装饰看起来真漂亮！托尼：是啊，尤其是广场上的灯。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 节庆装饰看起来真漂亮！
messages.en: The feast decorations look lovely!

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.zh: 是啊，尤其是广场上的灯。
messages.en: Yes, especially the lights in the square.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给同形词 żina 分开建卡：宗教文本旁记“色欲、性罪”，节庆灯饰旁记“装饰、华美”，不要把两组意思混用。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An individual act of fornication, described in religious or moral language.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一次非婚性行为，通常以宗教或道德评判的语言来表述。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Att ta' relazzjoni sesswali barra ż-żwieġ, deskritt f'lingwaġġ reliġjuż jew morali.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 一次非婚性行为；一次被称为淫乱的行为。
一次非婚性行为，带有宗教或道德评判色彩。

collocations.zh: 一项关于非婚性行为的指控

formal.mt: Fit-test reliġjuż, żinja waħda hija ppreżentata bħala dnub.
formal.en: In the religious text, a single act of fornication is presented as a sin.
formal.zh: 在这篇宗教文本中，一次非婚性行为被表述为一种罪。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Xi tfisser 'żinja' f'din is-sentenza? Toni: Tfisser att wieħed ta' relazzjoni sesswali barra ż-żwieġ.
colloquial.en: Maja: What does 'żinja' mean in this sentence? Toni: It means one act of sexual intercourse outside marriage.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这个句子里的 żinja 是什么意思？托尼：指一次婚姻之外的性行为。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.zh: 这个句子里的 żinja 是什么意思？
messages.en: What does 'żinja' mean in this sentence?

messages.speaker: Toni (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Tfisser att wieħed ta' relazzjoni sesswali barra ż-żwieġ.
messages.mt_standard: Tfisser att wieħed ta' relazzjoni sesswali barra ż-żwieġ.
messages.zh: 指一次婚姻之外的性行为。
messages.en: It means one act of sexual intercourse outside marriage.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 żinja 与搭配 żinja waħda 一起记，突出“一次具体行为”；同时记住它带有宗教或道德语境色彩。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The jujube plant identified as Ziziphus lotus.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 枣类植物，所给词义具体指学名为 Ziziphus lotus 的植物。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-pjanta magħrufa bl-isem xjentifiku Ziziphus lotus.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 学名为 Ziziphus lotus 的枣类植物。
枣；枣类植物。

formal.mt: Ir-rapport isemmi ż-żinżel bl-isem xjentifiku Ziziphus lotus.
formal.en: The report refers to the jujube by the scientific name Ziziphus lotus.
formal.zh: 这份报告使用学名 Ziziphus lotus 来指称这种枣类植物。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'jisimha din il-pjanta? Toni: Din il-pjanta tissejjaħ żinżel.
colloquial.en: Maja: What is this plant called? Toni: This plant is called żinżel.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这种植物叫什么？托尼：这种植物叫 żinżel。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.zh: 这种植物叫什么？
messages.en: What is this plant called?

messages.speaker: Toni (教师)
messages.zh: 这种植物叫 żinżel。
messages.en: This plant is called żinżel.

cognitive_memory_aid: 制作一张植物标签卡，把 żinżel、jujube 和 Ziziphus lotus 并排写，再配上“枣类植物”帮助对应记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An occasion when someone goes to see a person or a place.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 访问、探访或参观，指前往看望某人或到访某处的一次活动。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Meta persuna tmur tara lil xi ħadd jew iżżur xi post.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 访问；探访；参观。

formal.mt: L-iskola organizzat żjara fil-mużew għall-istudenti.
formal.en: The school organized a visit to the museum for the students.
formal.zh: 学校为学生组织了一次博物馆参观活动。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Nagħmlu żjara lin-nanna għada? Toni: Iva, immorru wara nofsinhar.
colloquial.en: Maja: Shall we visit Grandma tomorrow? Toni: Yes, let's go in the afternoon.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：我们明天去看奶奶好吗？托尼：好，下午去吧。

messages.speaker: Maja (姐姐)
messages.zh: 我们明天去看奶奶好吗？
messages.en: Shall we visit Grandma tomorrow?

messages.speaker: Toni (弟弟)
messages.zh: 好，下午去吧。
messages.en: Yes, let's go in the afternoon.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象日历上写着“一次探访”：看奶奶、去博物馆都可以是一场 żjara，用具体行程记住这个名词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act or process of making mistakes or straying from what is right.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 犯错或偏离正确道路这一行为、过程。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-għemil li wieħed jiżbalja jew jitbiegħed mit-triq it-tajba.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 犯错；偏离正确方向；误入歧途这一行为。

formal.mt: It-test jiddeskrivi ż-żliem bħala xi ħaġa li teħtieġ riflessjoni u korrezzjoni.
formal.en: The text describes erring as something that calls for reflection and correction.
formal.zh: 这篇文本将犯错描述为需要反思和纠正的事情。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Xi jfisser 'żliem' hawn? Toni: Ifisser li wieħed jiżbalja jew jitbiegħed mit-triq it-tajba.
colloquial.en: Maja: What does 'żliem' mean here? Toni: It means making mistakes or straying from the right path.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这里的 żliem 是什么意思？托尼：指犯错，或者偏离正确的道路。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.zh: 这里的 żliem 是什么意思？
messages.en: What does 'żliem' mean here?

messages.speaker: Toni (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Ifisser li wieħed jiżbalja jew jitbiegħed mit-triq it-tajba.
messages.mt_standard: Ifisser li wieħed jiżbalja jew jitbiegħed mit-triq it-tajba.
messages.zh: 指犯错，或者偏离正确的道路。
messages.en: It means making mistakes or straying from the right path.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象脚步偏离标好的路线，把 żliem 记作“犯错、走偏这一过程”；它是名词，可用中文“犯错这件事”辅助记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To move a bone out of its normal position at a joint; to dislocate.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使关节处的骨骼离开正常位置，即使其脱臼或脱位。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ċaqlaq għadma mill-pożizzjoni normali tagħha f'ġog.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使脱臼；使关节脱位。

formal.mt: L-atleta żloga spalltu waqt it-taħriġ u mar l-isptar.
formal.en: The athlete dislocated his shoulder during training and went to hospital.
formal.zh: 这名运动员在训练时肩膀脱臼，随后去了医院。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'ġara lil Pawlu waqt il-logħba? Toni: Żloga spalltu u mar l-isptar.
colloquial.en: Maja: What happened to Pawlu during the game? Toni: He dislocated his shoulder and went to hospital.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：保罗比赛时怎么了？托尼：他肩膀脱臼，去医院了。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 保罗比赛时怎么了？
messages.en: What happened to Pawlu during the game?

messages.speaker: Toni (队友)
messages.zh: 他肩膀脱臼，去医院了。
messages.en: He dislocated his shoulder and went to hospital.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用关节模型想象骨头离开原来的位置，把 żloga 与“脱臼”相连；整句记 żloga spalltu，就是“他肩膀脱臼了”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Slippery; having a surface on which a person or object can easily slide.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 表面很滑、容易让人或物体滑动或滑倒的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu wiċċ li fuqu persuna jew oġġett jista' jiżloq faċilment.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 滑的；容易使人滑倒的。

formal.mt: Il-passaġġ huwa żluqi wara x-xita, għalhekk il-viżitaturi għandhom jimxu bil-galbu.
formal.en: The passage is slippery after the rain, so visitors should walk carefully.
formal.zh: 雨后通道湿滑，因此访客应小心行走。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Oqgħod attent, dan il-paviment żluqi! Mark: Grazzi, se nimxi bil-mod.
colloquial.en: Maja: Be careful, this floor is slippery! Mark: Thanks, I'll walk slowly.
colloquial.zh: Maja：小心，这地板很滑！Mark：谢谢，我会慢慢走。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 小心，这地板很滑！
messages.en: Be careful, this floor is slippery!

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 谢谢，我会慢慢走。
messages.en: Thanks, I'll walk slowly.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象雨后通道上的防滑提示牌，把 żluqi 和“脚下一滑”的画面一起记。

gloss_zh: 出岔子；损坏；失去理智或变得糊涂

teaching_sense.en_definition: To go wrong or become damaged; also, of a person, to lose mental clarity or become mentally confused.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指事情偏离正常进程、物件损坏，也可指人失去理智、因年老而糊涂或变得疯疯癫癫。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jieħu xejra ħażina jew issirlu ħsara; dwar persuna, li titlef ir-raġuni jew titħawwad mentalment.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 出岔子；偏离原定方向或预期进程。
损坏；变坏，用于人工制成的物件。

sense_translations.en_definition: to lose one's mind or go senile
sense_translations.zh_definition: 失去理智；或因年老而变得糊涂、心智能力衰退。
变得疯疯癫癫；变得神志糊涂或行为古怪。

formal.mt: Il-pjan żmaga meta l-materjal ma wasalx fil-ħin, u x-xogħol kellu jieqaf.
formal.en: The plan went awry when the material did not arrive on time, and work had to stop.
formal.zh: 材料未能按时送达，计划因此出了岔子，工作不得不停下来。

colloquial.mt: Rita: X'ġara mill-pjan tagħna? Pawlu: Żmaga meta ħassru l-vjaġġ, imma nistgħu nagħmlu pjan ieħor.
colloquial.en: Rita: What happened to our plan? Pawlu: It went awry when they cancelled the trip, but we can make another plan.
colloquial.zh: Rita：我们的计划怎么了？Pawlu：他们取消行程后，计划就出了岔子，不过我们可以另作安排。

messages.speaker: Rita (朋友)
messages.zh: 我们的计划怎么了？
messages.en: What happened to our plan?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Żmaga meta ħassru l-vjaġġ, imma nistgħu nagħmlu pjan ieħor.
messages.mt_standard: Żmaga meta ħassru l-vjaġġ, imma nistgħu nagħmlu pjan ieħor.
messages.zh: 他们取消行程后，计划就出了岔子，不过我们可以另作安排。
messages.en: It went awry when they cancelled the trip, but we can make another plan.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用三幅教学图记 żmaga：计划走偏、物件损坏、人变糊涂；读句子时先看主语，再判断具体义项。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An emerald, a green precious stone used in jewellery.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 祖母绿，一种用于制作首饰的绿色宝石。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ġawhra ħadra prezzjuża li tintuża fil-ġojjellerija.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 祖母绿；绿宝石。
祖母绿，指这种宝石。

formal.mt: Il-katalgu jiddeskrivi ċurkett tad-deheb bi żmerald fin-nofs.
formal.en: The catalogue describes a gold ring with an emerald in the centre.
formal.zh: 目录中介绍了一枚中央镶有祖母绿的金戒指。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Din il-ġawhra ħadra hija żmerald? Marija: Iva, u tidher sabiħa ħafna f'dan iċ-ċurkett.
colloquial.en: Anna: Is this green stone an emerald? Marija: Yes, and it looks lovely in this ring.
colloquial.zh: Anna：这颗绿色宝石是祖母绿吗？Marija：是的，镶在这枚戒指上很好看。

messages.speaker: Anna (顾客)
messages.zh: 这颗绿色宝石是祖母绿吗？
messages.en: Is this green stone an emerald?

messages.speaker: Marija (珠宝店员)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, u tidher sabiħa ħafna f'dan iċ-ċurkett.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, u tidher sabiħa ħafna f'dan iċ-ċurkett.
messages.zh: 是的，镶在这枚戒指上很好看。
messages.en: Yes, and it looks lovely in this ring.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 żmerald 写在绿色宝石的图片旁，再配上戒指和项链两幅图，记住它指祖母绿这种宝石。

gloss_zh: 燧石；临时编造的话；个人杜撰

teaching_sense.en_definition: Flint; figuratively, something a person invents or makes up on the spot, often expressed with a possessive suffix.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 燧石；也可比喻某人临时编造或自行杜撰的内容，这一用法常带代词性物主后缀。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ġebel iebes li jista' jagħti xrar; b'mod figurattiv, xi ħaġa li persuna tivvinta minn jeddha, spiss b'suffiss possessiv.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 燧石；可用来打出火花的坚硬石料。

sense_translations.en_definition: also used with a pronominal possessive suffix (e.g. 'żnied-u') for things people make up off the cuff
sense_translations.zh_definition: 也可带代词性物主后缀使用，例如 żniedu，指某人即兴编造、随口杜撰的东西。
某人自行编造或杜撰的内容；自己的虚构说法。

collocations.en: a story he made up himself

formal.mt: Fir-rapport hemm deskrizzjoni ta' biċċa żnied misjuba waqt it-tħaffir.
formal.en: The report contains a description of a piece of flint found during the excavation.
formal.zh: 报告描述了挖掘过程中发现的一块燧石。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Dik l-istorja vera? Mark: Le, Pawlu qalha minn żniedu.
colloquial.en: Maja: Is that story true? Mark: No, Pawlu made it up himself.
colloquial.zh: Maja：那个故事是真的吗？Mark：不是，是 Pawlu 自己编的。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 那个故事是真的吗？
messages.en: Is that story true?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 不是，是 Pawlu 自己编的。
messages.en: No, Pawlu made it up himself.

cognitive_memory_aid: 分两张卡记忆：żnied 配燧石图片，minn żniedu 配“他自己编的”对话；这是义项联想，不是词源解释。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Resembling flint or made of flint.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在性质或外观上像燧石的，或由燧石制成的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jixbah iż-żnied jew li hu magħmul miż-żnied.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 像燧石的；具有类似燧石的性质或外观的。
由燧石制成的。
似燧石的；燧石制的。

formal.mt: Il-katalgu jiddeskrivi l-oġġett bħala żniedi u jispjega li hu magħmul miż-żnied.
formal.en: The catalogue describes the object as flint-made and explains that it is made of flint.
formal.zh: 目录将该物件描述为燧石制品，并说明其材料为燧石。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Xi jfisser żniedi hawn? Toni: Hawn ifisser magħmul miż-żnied, imma jista' jfisser ukoll li jixbah iż-żnied.
colloquial.en: Lara: What does żniedi mean here? Toni: Here it means made of flint, but it can also mean resembling flint.
colloquial.zh: Lara：这里的 żniedi 是什么意思？Toni：这里指燧石制的，不过它也可以表示像燧石的。

messages.speaker: Lara (学生)
messages.zh: 这里的 żniedi 是什么意思？
messages.en: What does żniedi mean here?

messages.speaker: Toni (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Hawn ifisser magħmul miż-żnied, imma jista' jfisser ukoll li jixbah iż-żnied.
messages.mt_standard: Hawn ifisser magħmul miż-żnied, imma jista' jfisser ukoll li jixbah iż-żnied.
messages.zh: 这里指燧石制的，不过它也可以表示像燧石的。
messages.en: Here it means made of flint, but it can also mean resembling flint.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 żniedi 放在物件图片旁，依次问“像燧石吗”和“由燧石制成吗”，用两个问题记住两个相关义项。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Fir, an evergreen tree with needlelike leaves.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 冷杉，一种长有针状叶的常绿树。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Siġra li tibqa' ħadra matul is-sena u għandha weraq bħal labar.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 冷杉。
冷杉树，指这种树木。

formal.mt: Il-gwida tal-ġnien tindika siġra taż-żnuber ħdejn id-daħla prinċipali.
formal.en: The garden guide marks a fir tree beside the main entrance.
formal.zh: 花园导览标出了主入口旁的一棵冷杉树。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Fejn se niltaqgħu fil-ġnien? Luqa: Ħdejn is-siġra taż-żnuber, qrib id-daħla.
colloquial.en: Sara: Where shall we meet in the garden? Luqa: Beside the fir tree, near the entrance.
colloquial.zh: Sara：我们在花园哪里碰面？Luqa：在入口附近的冷杉树旁。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 我们在花园哪里碰面？
messages.en: Where shall we meet in the garden?

messages.speaker: Luqa (朋友)
messages.zh: 在入口附近的冷杉树旁。
messages.en: Beside the fir tree, near the entrance.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用一张冷杉树照片记 żnuber，再用“树旁见面”和“冷杉木”两个场景巩固同一个树名。

gloss_zh: 阴茎（粗俗）；麻烦、难处；表示不满或加强语气的粗话

teaching_sense.en_definition: A vulgar word for the penis; also a difficulty or snag, or a vulgar intensifier.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指阴茎的粗俗名词；也可指麻烦或难处，或用作加强语气的粗话。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kelma vulgari għall-pene; tista' tfisser ukoll diffikultà jew tfixkil, jew tintuża biex issaħħaħ espressjoni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 阴茎；本词属于粗俗说法。
男性生殖器的粗俗称呼。
鸡巴、屌，指阴茎的粗俗说法。
难处；麻烦；使事情受阻的问题，带粗俗语气。
他妈的、该死的，用于加强语气的粗俗表达。
表示懊恼、沮丧或不满的粗俗感叹语，相当于“操！”或“妈的！”。

sense_translations.en_definition: Used as an intensifier, similar to "what the fuck"
sense_translations.zh_definition: 用来加强惊讶、质疑或不满的粗俗感叹语，近似“搞什么鬼”或“他妈的怎么回事”。

collocations.zh: 搞什么鬼；他妈的什么（粗俗）

formal.mt: F'dan id-djalogu, il-kelma żobb tintuża bħala interjezzjoni vulgari biex tesprimi n-nuqqas ta' sodisfazzjon tal-kelliem.
formal.en: In this dialogue, the word żobb is used as a vulgar interjection to express the speaker's dissatisfaction.
formal.zh: 在这段对话中，żobb 用作粗俗感叹语，表达说话人的不满。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Żobb! Tlift iċ-ċwievet. Maja: Erġa' fittex fil-but tal-ġakketta.
colloquial.en: Mark: Fuck! I've lost the keys. Maja: Check your jacket pocket again.
colloquial.zh: Mark：妈的！我把钥匙弄丢了。Maja：再找找你的夹克口袋。

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 妈的！我把钥匙弄丢了。
messages.en: Fuck! I've lost the keys.

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 再找找你的夹克口袋。
messages.en: Check your jacket pocket again.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 żobb 的学习卡标上“粗俗”，分开记身体名词、麻烦义和感叹用法；听到时结合句子判断，不把所有用法都译成身体部位。

gloss_zh: 童年；幼小时期；小的状态

teaching_sense.en_definition: Childhood, or the state or quality of being small.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 童年、幼小时期；也指体积或规模小的状态。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Iż-żmien meta persuna tkun għadha tifel jew tifla; ukoll il-qagħda jew il-kwalità ta' xi ħaġa żgħira.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 童年；幼小时期。
小；体积、尺寸或规模小的状态或性质。

formal.mt: Fl-awtobijografija tiegħu, il-kittieb jiddeskrivi ż-żogħor tiegħu u l-logħob ma' ħutu.
formal.en: In his autobiography, the writer describes his childhood and playing with his siblings.
formal.zh: 作家在自传中描述了自己的童年，以及与兄弟姐妹一起玩耍的经历。

colloquial.mt: Lara: X'tiftakar miż-żogħor tiegħek? Pawlu: Niftakar il-logħob fit-triq ma' ħuti.
colloquial.en: Lara: What do you remember from your childhood? Pawlu: I remember playing in the street with my siblings.
colloquial.zh: Lara：你记得童年的哪些事情？Pawlu：我记得和兄弟姐妹在街上玩耍。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 你记得童年的哪些事情？
messages.en: What do you remember from your childhood?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.zh: 我记得和兄弟姐妹在街上玩耍。
messages.en: I remember playing in the street with my siblings.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 żogħor 配上两幅图：儿时玩耍表示“童年”，狭小空间表示“小的状态”；用语境区分时间义和大小义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The small mark or hollow on the abdomen where the umbilical cord was attached.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 腹部上原先连接脐带的位置留下的小凹陷或痕迹，即肚脐。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-marka jew il-ħofra żgħira fuq iż-żaqq fejn kien hemm imwaħħal il-kurdun taż-żokra.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 肚脐；脐。

formal.mt: It-tpinġija turi l-pożizzjoni taż-żokra fuq iż-żaqq.
formal.en: The illustration shows the position of the navel on the abdomen.
formal.zh: 这幅插图展示了肚脐在腹部的位置。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Omm, dan il-flokk qasir wisq? Marija: Iva, tidher iż-żokra tiegħek. Ilbes wieħed itwal.
colloquial.en: Lara: Mum, is this top too short? Marija: Yes, your belly button is showing. Wear a longer one.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：妈妈，这件上衣是不是太短了？玛丽亚：是啊，你的肚脐都露出来了。穿件长一点的吧。

messages.speaker: Lara (女儿)
messages.zh: 妈妈，这件上衣是不是太短了？
messages.en: Mum, is this top too short?

messages.speaker: Marija (母亲)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, tidher iż-żokra tiegħek. Ilbes wieħed itwal.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, tidher iż-żokra tiegħek. Ilbes wieħed itwal.
messages.zh: 是啊，你的肚脐都露出来了。穿件长一点的吧。
messages.en: Yes, your belly button is showing. Wear a longer one.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 żokra 和腹部中央的小凹点一起记；想象短上衣露出肚脐，再用 ħdejn iż-żokra 练习表达“在肚脐附近”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Hard coralline limestone, used as a building stone; also hard stone more generally.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一种坚硬的珊瑚石灰岩，可用作建筑石材；也可泛指硬石。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tip ta' ġebel tal-ġir iebes li jintuża fil-bini; ukoll ġebel iebes b'mod ġenerali.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 珊瑚石灰岩；硬石。

collocations.en: a wall made of coralline limestone

formal.mt: Fir-rapport, il-perit iddeskriva l-ħajt bħala ħajt taż-żonqor.
formal.en: In the report, the architect described the wall as a wall made of coralline limestone.
formal.zh: 建筑师在报告中将这面墙描述为一面用珊瑚石灰岩砌成的墙。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Dan il-ħajt magħmul miż-żonqor? Pawlu: Iva, huwa ġebel iebes ħafna.
colloquial.en: Mark: Is this wall made of coralline limestone? Pawlu: Yes, it is very hard stone.
colloquial.zh: 马克：这面墙是用珊瑚石灰岩砌的吗？保罗：是的，这种石头很硬。

messages.speaker: Mark (屋主)
messages.zh: 这面墙是用珊瑚石灰岩砌的吗？
messages.en: Is this wall made of coralline limestone?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (泥瓦匠)
messages.zh: 是的，这种石头很硬。
messages.en: Yes, it is very hard stone.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 żonqor 配上一幅坚硬石墙的画面，连同 ħajt taż-żonqor 一起记：看到这种石墙，就回想“珊瑚石灰岩、硬石”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To develop a large, rounded belly or become paunchy.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 腹部逐渐变得圆鼓，长出明显的大肚腩。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ikollu żaqqu tikber u ssir imqabbża.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 长出圆鼓鼓的大肚子。
变得大腹便便；肚腩变得明显。

collocations.zh: 随着时间推移长出了大肚腩

formal.mt: Fir-rakkont, Pawlu żqaq maż-żmien, u l-awtur jiddeskrivi kif inbidlet id-dehra tiegħu.
formal.en: In the story, Pawlu became pot-bellied over time, and the author describes how his appearance changed.
formal.zh: 在故事中，保罗随着时间推移长出了大肚腩，作者描述了他的外貌如何变化。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Kif inbidel Pawlu fit-tieni ktieb? Mark: Żqaq ftit, imma għadu jilbes l-istess kowt.
colloquial.en: Maja: How has Pawlu changed in the second book? Mark: He's become a little paunchy, but he still wears the same coat.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：第二本书里的保罗有什么变化？马克：他长出了一点肚腩，不过还是穿着同一件外套。

messages.speaker: Maja (读书会成员)
messages.zh: 第二本书里的保罗有什么变化？
messages.en: How has Pawlu changed in the second book?

messages.speaker: Mark (读书会成员)
messages.mt_spoken: Żqaq ftit, imma għadu jilbes l-istess kowt.
messages.mt_standard: Żqaq ftit, imma għadu jilbes l-istess kowt.
messages.zh: 他长出了一点肚腩，不过还是穿着同一件外套。
messages.en: He's become a little paunchy, but he still wears the same coat.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 żqaq 记成一个变化镜头：人物的肚子逐渐鼓起。重点记住它是动词，表达“长出肚腩”的变化。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Small stones or stone chippings, such as those used to cover paths or form a surface layer.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 细小的石子或碎石，常用于铺设小路或形成地面覆盖层。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ġebel żgħir jew biċċiet żgħar tal-ġebel, bħal dawk li jintużaw biex jinksew il-mogħdijiet.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 碎石料；细小的石头碎块。
砾石；小石子。

formal.mt: Il-ħaddiema firxu saff ta' żrar fuq il-mogħdija tal-ġnien.
formal.en: The workers spread a layer of gravel over the garden path.
formal.zh: 工人们在花园小路上铺了一层碎石。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'se npoġġu fuq il-mogħdija tal-ġnien? Mark: Żrar. Irridu nixtru żewġ boroż oħra.
colloquial.en: Maja: What shall we put on the garden path? Mark: Gravel. We need to buy two more bags.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：花园小路上要铺什么？马克：碎石。我们还得再买两袋。

messages.speaker: Maja (室友)
messages.zh: 花园小路上要铺什么？
messages.en: What shall we put on the garden path?

messages.speaker: Mark (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Żrar. Irridu nixtru żewġ boroż oħra.
messages.mt_standard: Żrar. Irridu nixtru żewġ boroż oħra.
messages.zh: 碎石。我们还得再买两袋。
messages.en: Gravel. We need to buy two more bags.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象脚踩花园石子路时发出的沙沙声，把 żrar 与铺满地面的一片小石子联系起来，记住“碎石、砾石”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A small amphibian; the word can refer to a frog or a toad.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一种小型两栖动物；这个词可以指青蛙，也可以指蟾蜍。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Annimal anfibju żgħir li spiss jaqbeż u jgħix fuq l-art jew fl-ilma.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 青蛙。
蟾蜍。

formal.mt: L-istudenti osservaw żrinġ ħdejn l-għadira u kitbu dwaru.
formal.en: The students observed a frog beside the pond and wrote about it.
formal.zh: 学生们观察了池塘旁的一只青蛙，并写下了相关记录。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Ara, hemm żrinġ ħdejn l-ilma! Mark: Iva, ejja narawh minn hawn.
colloquial.en: Lara: Look, there's a frog by the water! Mark: Yes, let's watch it from here.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：看，水边有只青蛙！马克：是啊，我们就在这里看它吧。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 看，水边有只青蛙！
messages.en: Look, there's a frog by the water!

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 是啊，我们就在这里看它吧。
messages.en: Yes, let's watch it from here.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 żrinġ 和池塘边跳跃的小动物画面绑定记忆；遇到具体语境时，再判断是在说青蛙还是蟾蜍。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A place where animals are kept so that people can visit and see them.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 饲养动物、供人们参观和观察的场所，即动物园。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Post fejn jinżammu annimali biex in-nies ikunu jistgħu jżuruhom u jarawhom.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 动物园。

formal.mt: Waqt żjara f'żu, l-istudenti tgħallmu dwar il-ħtiġijiet tal-annimali.
formal.en: During a visit to a zoo, the students learned about the animals' needs.
formal.zh: 在参观动物园期间，学生们了解了动物的需求。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Trid immorru f'żu nhar il-Ħadd? Pawlu: Iva! Nixtieq nara l-ġiraffi.
colloquial.en: Maja: Do you want us to go to a zoo on Sunday? Pawlu: Yes! I'd like to see the giraffes.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：我们星期天去动物园，好吗？保罗：好啊！我想看长颈鹿。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 我们星期天去动物园，好吗？
messages.en: Do you want us to go to a zoo on Sunday?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.zh: 好啊！我想看长颈鹿。
messages.en: Yes! I'd like to see the giraffes.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用英语 zoo 的意思辅助记住 żu，再把它放进 żjara f'żu 这个短语中，联想周末参观动物园的场景。

gloss_zh: 陀螺；摇晃不稳的东西（比喻）

teaching_sense.en_definition: A toy that spins on a point; figuratively, something wobbly or unsteady.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 靠尖端支撑并旋转的玩具，即陀螺；也可比喻摇晃不稳的东西。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ġugarell li jdur fuq ponta; b'mod figurattiv, xi ħaġa li titbandal u mhix stabbli.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 陀螺，一种靠尖端支撑并旋转的玩具。
摇晃不稳的东西（比喻用法）。
陀螺。

formal.mt: Waqt il-lezzjoni tax-xjenza, l-istudenti osservaw kif iż-żugraga bdiet titbandal qabel waqfet.
formal.en: During the science lesson, the students observed how the spinning top began to wobble before it stopped.
formal.zh: 科学课上，学生们观察了陀螺在停止前如何开始摇晃。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Ara ż-żugraga kif iddur! Mark: Iva, imma issa bdiet titbandal. Dalwaqt tieqaf.
colloquial.en: Maja: Look at the top spinning! Mark: Yes, but now it's starting to wobble. It'll stop soon.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：看，陀螺转起来了！马克：是啊，不过现在开始摇晃了，很快就会停。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 看，陀螺转起来了！
messages.en: Look at the top spinning!

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, imma issa bdiet titbandal. Dalwaqt tieqaf.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, imma issa bdiet titbandal. Dalwaqt tieqaf.
messages.zh: 是啊，不过现在开始摇晃了，很快就会停。
messages.en: Yes, but now it's starting to wobble. It'll stop soon.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 żugraga 和陀螺快停时的画面一起记：先旋转，再摇晃；同一画面帮助记住“陀螺”和比喻义“摇晃不稳的东西”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A small wind instrument, such as a fife or pipe, played by blowing into it.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 通过吹气发声的小型管乐器，如小横笛或管笛。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Strument mużikali żgħir li jindaqq billi tonfoħ fih, bħal flawt żgħir.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 小横笛，一种小型的横吹管乐器。
小横笛；管笛，指通过吹气发声的笛类乐器。

collocations.en: to play the fife or pipe
the sound of the fife or pipe

formal.mt: Waqt il-lezzjoni tal-mużika, l-għalliem daqq iż-żummara biex l-istudenti jisimgħu l-ħoss tagħha.
formal.en: During the music lesson, the teacher played the fife so that the students could hear its sound.
formal.zh: 音乐课上，老师吹奏了小横笛，让学生们听听它的声音。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Din żummara? Pawlu: Iva. Tridni ndoqq ftit?
colloquial.en: Lara: Is this a fife? Pawlu: Yes. Would you like me to play a little?
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：这是小横笛吗？保罗：是啊。要我吹一小段吗？

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 这是小横笛吗？
messages.en: Is this a fife?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.zh: 是啊。要我吹一小段吗？
messages.en: Yes. Would you like me to play a little?

cognitive_memory_aid: 记 żummara 时，想象拿起一支小笛吹出旋律，并连着念 idoqq iż-żummara，把“笛子”和“吹奏”的动作一起记牢。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A flying insect with a sting, especially a wasp; some supplied senses also refer to a bee.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一种会飞、能蜇人的昆虫，主要指黄蜂；所给义项中也有“蜜蜂”之义。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Insett li jtir u jista' jniggeż, speċjalment żunżan; f'xi tifsiriet il-kelma tirreferi wkoll għal naħla.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 一只黄蜂。
一只蜜蜂。
黄蜂。

formal.mt: Waqt l-osservazzjoni fil-ġnien, l-istudenti raw żunżan fuq fjura u żammew distanza minnu.
formal.en: During the observation in the garden, the students saw a wasp on a flower and kept their distance from it.
formal.zh: 在花园开展观察时，学生们看到花上有一只黄蜂，便与它保持距离。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Hemm żunżan ħdejn it-tieqa! Mark: Rajtu. Ejja nżommu ftit distanza.
colloquial.en: Maja: There's a wasp near the window! Mark: I saw it. Let's keep a little distance.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：窗边有一只黄蜂！马克：我看见了。我们离它远一点吧。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 窗边有一只黄蜂！
messages.en: There's a wasp near the window!

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 我看见了。我们离它远一点吧。
messages.en: I saw it. Let's keep a little distance.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把重复出现的 ż 和 n 想成蜂在花边来回飞的节奏，再把整词与“黄蜂”图片配对；这是学习联想，不是词源解释。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A playground slide that children slide down; the supplied senses also include a slope and a see-saw.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 供儿童从高处滑下的游乐设施，即滑梯；所给义项也包括斜坡和跷跷板。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tagħmir tal-logħob li t-tfal jitilgħu fuqu u jiżżerżqu 'l isfel minnu; fost it-tifsiriet mogħtija hemm ukoll inklinazzjoni u tagħmir li jitla' u jinżel minn żewġ naħat.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 跷跷板，两端交替升降的游乐设施。
斜坡，倾斜的地面或表面。
滑梯，一种供人从高处滑下的游乐设施。

formal.mt: It-tfal għandhom jistennew sakemm iż-żurżieqa tkun vojta qabel jinżlu minnha.
formal.en: Children should wait until the slide is clear before going down it.
formal.zh: 儿童应等滑梯上没有人后再滑下。

colloquial.mt: Lina: Nista' ninżel miż-żurżieqa? Omm: Iva, imma stenna sakemm it-tifel ta' quddiemek jasal isfel.
colloquial.en: Lina: Can I go down the slide? Mum: Yes, but wait until the boy in front of you reaches the bottom.
colloquial.zh: 莉娜：我可以滑滑梯吗？妈妈：可以，不过要等你前面的小男孩滑到底下。

messages.speaker: Lina (女儿)
messages.zh: 我可以滑滑梯吗？
messages.en: Can I go down the slide?

messages.speaker: Omm (母亲)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, imma stenna sakemm it-tifel ta' quddiemek jasal isfel.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, imma stenna sakemm it-tifel ta' quddiemek jasal isfel.
messages.zh: 可以，不过要等你前面的小男孩滑到底下。
messages.en: Yes, but wait until the boy in front of you reaches the bottom.

cognitive_memory_aid: 画一张游乐场图，把 żurżieqa 标在滑梯旁；另用小卡记录“斜坡、跷跷板”两个义项，靠场景区别，不把三种物体混成一种。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Of, from, or relating to Sweden, its people, or its culture.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 瑞典的、来自瑞典的，或与瑞典及其人民、文化有关的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li ġej mill-Iżvezja jew għandu x'jaqsam ma' dan il-pajjiż, man-nies tiegħu jew mal-kultura tiegħu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 瑞典的；瑞典人的；瑞典语的。

sense_translations.en_definition: Swedish (of, from or relating to Sweden)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 瑞典的，指属于瑞典、来自瑞典或与瑞典有关的。
瑞典人，指瑞典本地人或居民。
瑞典语。

formal.mt: Il-kittieb Żvediż tkellem dwar ir-rumanz tiegħu waqt laqgħa mal-istudenti.
formal.en: The Swedish writer spoke about his novel during a meeting with the students.
formal.zh: 这位瑞典作家在与学生见面时谈到了自己的小说。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Dan il-kittieb Żvediż? Mark: Iva, u l-ktieb tiegħu qed naqrah bl-Ingliż.
colloquial.en: Maja: Is this writer Swedish? Mark: Yes, and I'm reading his book in English.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这位作家是瑞典人吗？马克：是的，我正在读他的书的英文版。

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.zh: 这位作家是瑞典人吗？
messages.en: Is this writer Swedish?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, u l-ktieb tiegħu qed naqrah bl-Ingliż.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, u l-ktieb tiegħu qed naqrah bl-Ingliż.
messages.zh: 是的，我正在读他的书的英文版。
messages.en: Yes, and I'm reading his book in English.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用三个位置记同一个词：放在“作家”旁表示瑞典的，指人时表示瑞典人，放在“学习”后表示瑞典语；同时留意词性变化。

gloss_zh: 使某人首次发生性行为；失去童贞

teaching_sense.en_definition: To have sexual intercourse with someone for whom it is the first time, or to have sexual intercourse oneself for the first time.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 与此前未有过性交经历的人发生性交；也可指自己首次发生性交、失去童贞。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ikollu x'jaqsam sesswalment ma' persuna għall-ewwel darba tagħha, jew ikollu x'jaqsam sesswalment għall-ewwel darba tiegħu stess.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 与某人发生其人生中的首次性交；使某人失去童贞。
首次发生性交；失去童贞。

collocations.en: to have intercourse with someone for whom it is the first time
collocations.zh: 与某人发生其人生中的首次性交

collocations.en: to lose one's virginity with a partner

formal.mt: F'din is-silta, il-verb 'żverġna' jfisser li l-persuna kellha x'taqsam sesswalment għall-ewwel darba.
formal.en: In this passage, the verb 'żverġna' means that the person had sexual intercourse for the first time.
formal.zh: 在这段文字中，动词 żverġna 表示当事人首次发生了性交。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Xi tfisser 'żverġna' f'dan il-ktieb? Mark: Hawn tfisser li l-persuna tilfet il-verġinità tagħha.
colloquial.en: Maja: What does 'żverġna' mean in this book? Mark: Here it means that the person lost their virginity.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这本书里的 żverġna 是什么意思？马克：这里是说当事人失去了童贞。

messages.speaker: Maja (成年读者)
messages.zh: 这本书里的 żverġna 是什么意思？
messages.en: What does 'żverġna' mean in this book?

messages.speaker: Mark (成年朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Hawn tfisser li l-persuna tilfet il-verġinità tagħha.
messages.mt_standard: Hawn tfisser li l-persuna tilfet il-verġinità tagħha.
messages.zh: 这里是说当事人失去了童贞。
messages.en: Here it means that the person lost their virginity.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两张人物关系卡记忆：一张标“使对方经历首次性交”，另一张标“自己首次性交”；通过句中参与者分辨两个义项。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Sweden, a country in Scandinavia in Northern Europe.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 瑞典，位于北欧斯堪的纳维亚地区的国家。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Pajjiż fl-Iskandinavja, fit-Tramuntana tal-Ewropa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 瑞典。

sense_translations.en_definition: Sweden (a country in Scandinavia in Northern Europe; official name: Renju tal-Iżvezja)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 瑞典，位于北欧斯堪的纳维亚地区的国家，正式名称为瑞典王国。

formal.mt: L-istudenti se jqattgħu semestru fl-Iżvezja bħala parti minn programm ta' skambju.
formal.en: The students will spend a semester in Sweden as part of an exchange programme.
formal.zh: 学生们将参加交流项目，在瑞典学习一个学期。

colloquial.mt: Lina: Fejn se tistudja s-sena d-dieħla? Mark: Fl-Iżvezja, għal semestru wieħed.
colloquial.en: Lina: Where will you study next year? Mark: In Sweden, for one semester.
colloquial.zh: 莉娜：你明年要去哪里学习？马克：去瑞典，学一个学期。

messages.speaker: Lina (同学)
messages.zh: 你明年要去哪里学习？
messages.en: Where will you study next year?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.zh: 去瑞典，学一个学期。
messages.en: In Sweden, for one semester.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 Żvezja 写在北欧地图的瑞典位置，再配对 fl-Iżvezja“在瑞典”和 mill-Iżvezja“来自瑞典”，连同介词短语一起记。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To develop something by improving it or bringing it into being, or to expand an activity or business.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使事物发展、完善或形成；也指扩大某项活动或业务的规模。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Itejjeb xi ħaġa jew joħloqha u jmexxiha 'l quddiem, jew ikabbar attività jew negozju.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 发展；开发；使逐步形成或完善。
扩大；扩展。
发展、开发某事物，使其形成或进一步完善。
扩大规模，例如拓展自己的业务。

formal.mt: It-tim żviluppa pjan ġdid biex itejjeb is-servizzi offruti lill-komunità.
formal.en: The team developed a new plan to improve the services offered to the community.
formal.zh: 团队制定了一个新计划，以改善向社区提供的服务。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Kif sejjer in-negozju ta' ħuk? Mark: Sejjer tajjeb. Żviluppa n-negozju tiegħu u fetaħ ħanut ieħor.
colloquial.en: Maja: How is your brother's business going? Mark: It's going well. He expanded his business and opened another shop.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你哥哥的生意怎么样？马克：挺好的。他拓展了业务，又开了一家店。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你哥哥的生意怎么样？
messages.en: How is your brother's business going?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Sejjer tajjeb. Żviluppa n-negozju tiegħu u fetaħ ħanut ieħor.
messages.mt_standard: Sejjer tajjeb. Żviluppa n-negozju tiegħu u fetaħ ħanut ieħor.
messages.zh: 挺好的。他拓展了业务，又开了一家店。
messages.en: It's going well. He expanded his business and opened another shop.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一个想法先变成完整计划，再带动一家店扩成两家店；把“逐步发展”和“扩大规模”两幅画都贴上 żviluppa。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To evaporate or escape, as a liquid passes into vapour or vapour leaves a container.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 蒸发或逸散，指液体变为蒸气，或蒸气从容器中散出。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jgħaddi minn likwidu għal fwar jew joħroġ u jinfirex fl-arja.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 蒸发，由液态变为蒸气。
蒸发；逸出、逸散。

collocations.en: the vapour escaped from the bottle

formal.mt: Wara li l-kontenitur tħalla miftuħ, parti mil-likwidu żvinta u l-livell tiegħu niżel.
formal.en: After the container was left open, some of the liquid evaporated and its level fell.
formal.zh: 容器敞开放置后，部分液体蒸发，液面随之下降。

colloquial.mt: Lina: Għaliex fadal inqas likwidu fil-flixkun? Mark: Xi ftit minnu żvinta għax il-flixkun baqa' miftuħ.
colloquial.en: Lina: Why is there less liquid left in the bottle? Mark: Some of it evaporated because the bottle was left open.
colloquial.zh: 莉娜：瓶里的液体怎么变少了？马克：瓶子一直开着，所以有一部分蒸发了。

messages.speaker: Lina (室友)
messages.zh: 瓶里的液体怎么变少了？
messages.en: Why is there less liquid left in the bottle?

messages.speaker: Mark (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Xi ftit minnu żvinta għax il-flixkun baqa' miftuħ.
messages.mt_standard: Xi ftit minnu żvinta għax il-flixkun baqa' miftuħ.
messages.zh: 瓶子一直开着，所以有一部分蒸发了。
messages.en: Some of it evaporated because the bottle was left open.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一个没盖好的瓶子，液面慢慢下降，蒸气向空气散去；把 żvinta 同时连到“蒸发”和“逸散”，用过程画面记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Switzerland, a country in Western and Central Europe.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 瑞士，位于西欧与中欧地区的国家。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Pajjiż fl-Ewropa tal-Punent u fl-Ewropa Ċentrali.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 瑞士。

sense_translations.en_definition: Switzerland (a country in Western Europe and Central Europe)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 瑞士，位于西欧与中欧地区的国家。

formal.mt: Il-konferenza se ssir fl-Iżvizzera u se tlaqqa' riċerkaturi minn diversi pajjiżi.
formal.en: The conference will take place in Switzerland and will bring together researchers from several countries.
formal.zh: 会议将在瑞士举行，届时来自多个国家的研究人员将齐聚一堂。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Fejn mort għall-vaganzi? Mark: Mort l-Iżvizzera u qattajt ġimgħa hemm.
colloquial.en: Maja: Where did you go on holiday? Mark: I went to Switzerland and spent a week there.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你去哪里度假了？马克：我去了瑞士，在那里待了一周。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你去哪里度假了？
messages.en: Where did you go on holiday?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Mort l-Iżvizzera u qattajt ġimgħa hemm.
messages.mt_standard: Mort l-Iżvizzera u qattajt ġimgħa hemm.
messages.zh: 我去了瑞士，在那里待了一周。
messages.en: I went to Switzerland and spent a week there.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 Żvizzera 与地图上的瑞士配对，再与 Żvezja“瑞典”并排做辨认卡；特别看清 Żvizzera 中的双写 zz，避免混淆两个国名。

gloss_zh: 瑞士人；瑞士产品；瑞士的

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person from Switzerland, usually a man; in some contexts, a product from Switzerland.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 来自瑞士的人，通常指男性；在某些语境中也指瑞士出产的产品。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna mill-Iżvizzera, ġeneralment raġel; f'ċerti kuntesti, prodott mill-Iżvizzera.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 瑞士人。

sense_translations.en_definition: a person or product from Switzerland
sense_translations.zh_definition: 来自瑞士的人或瑞士出产的产品。

sense_translations.en_definition: Swiss (of, from or relating to Switzerland)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 瑞士的；来自瑞士的；与瑞士有关的。

sense_translations.en_definition: Swiss (native or inhabitant of Switzerland) (usually male)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 瑞士本地人或居民，通常指男性。

formal.mt: Żvizzeru li jgħix Malta ppreżenta rapport dwar it-trasport pubbliku f'pajjiżu.
formal.en: A Swiss man living in Malta presented a report on public transport in his country.
formal.zh: 一位住在马耳他的瑞士男子提交了一份关于其本国公共交通的报告。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Minn fejn hu l-istudent il-ġdid? Mark: Hu żvizzeru, u qed jitgħallem il-Malti magħna.
colloquial.en: Maja: Where is the new student from? Mark: He's Swiss, and he's learning Maltese with us.
colloquial.zh: Maja：新来的学生是哪里人？Mark：他是瑞士人，正在和我们一起学马耳他语。

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.zh: 新来的学生是哪里人？
messages.en: Where is the new student from?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Hu żvizzeru, u qed jitgħallem il-Malti magħna.
messages.mt_standard: Hu żvizzeru, u qed jitgħallem il-Malti magħna.
messages.zh: 他是瑞士人，正在和我们一起学马耳他语。
messages.en: He's Swiss, and he's learning Maltese with us.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把瑞士男子拿着瑞士产品的画面记在一起：单独指人时记“瑞士人”，修饰产品时记“瑞士的”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To remove the contents of something, or to use up its available contents or resources.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把某物里面的东西移走或倒出，使其变空；也可指耗尽其中的物品或资源。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Neħħa dak li kien hemm f'xi ħaġa biex ħallieha vojta, jew uża r-riżorsi tagħha kollha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 倒空；使容器或空间变空。
耗尽；大量消耗，使储备或资源枯竭。
清空；把里面的东西全部移走。

formal.mt: Qabel it-tindif, il-ħaddiem żvojta l-kontenitur u ċċekkja li ma kien baqa' xejn fih.
formal.en: Before cleaning, the worker emptied the container and checked that nothing remained inside.
formal.zh: 清洁之前，工人清空了容器，并检查里面是否已经没有任何东西。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Il-kexxun għadu mimli? Mark: Le, Pawlu żvojta l-kexxun dalgħodu; issa tista' tpoġġi l-karti fih.
colloquial.en: Maja: Is the drawer still full? Mark: No, Pawlu cleared it out this morning; you can put the papers in it now.
colloquial.zh: Maja：抽屉还装满着吗？Mark：没有，Pawlu今天早上把抽屉清空了；你现在可以把文件放进去了。

messages.speaker: Maja (室友)
messages.zh: 抽屉还装满着吗？
messages.en: Is the drawer still full?

messages.speaker: Mark (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, Pawlu żvojta l-kexxun dalgħodu; issa tista' tpoġġi l-karti fih.
messages.mt_standard: Le, Pawlu żvojta l-kexxun dalgħodu; issa tista' tpoġġi l-karti fih.
messages.zh: 没有，Pawlu今天早上把抽屉清空了；你现在可以把文件放进去了。
messages.en: No, Pawlu cleared it out this morning; you can put the papers in it now.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象把满桶的水倒到一滴不剩：从“满”到“空”记住清空，再把资源用光联想到耗尽。

gloss_zh: 发展；展开；出现某种转折

teaching_sense.en_definition: To develop or unfold an argument, narrative, or affair, or for it to take a particular turn.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 展开或发展论点、叙事或事件；也指这些内容朝某个方向发展或出现某种转折。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Żviluppa argument, rakkont jew ġrajja, jew ħa direzzjoni partikolari matul l-iżvilupp tiegħu.

sense_translations.en_definition: to develop (used, e.g. of an affair, argument, narrative etc.)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 发展；展开，用于事件、论点或叙事等。

sense_translations.en_definition: to take a particular turn (used, e.g. of an affair, argument, narrative etc.)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 朝某个特定方向发展；出现某种转折，用于事件、论点或叙事等。
展开论点；逐步阐述并充实论证。

formal.mt: Fl-istudju tiegħu, l-awtur żvolġa l-argument permezz ta' tliet eżempji dettaljati.
formal.en: In his study, the author developed the argument through three detailed examples.
formal.zh: 作者在研究中通过三个详细的例子展开了论证。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Kif kien il-ktieb? Mark: Għoġobni ħafna; l-awtur żvolġa r-rakkont bil-mod u żammni kurjuż sal-aħħar.
colloquial.en: Maja: How was the book? Mark: I really liked it; the author developed the story gradually and kept me curious until the end.
colloquial.zh: Maja：那本书怎么样？Mark：我很喜欢；作者慢慢展开故事，让我一直好奇到最后。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 那本书怎么样？
messages.en: How was the book?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għoġobni ħafna; l-awtur żvolġa r-rakkont bil-mod u żammni kurjuż sal-aħħar.
messages.mt_standard: Għoġobni ħafna; l-awtur żvolġa r-rakkont bil-mod u żammni kurjuż sal-aħħar.
messages.zh: 我很喜欢；作者慢慢展开故事，让我一直好奇到最后。
messages.en: I really liked it; the author developed the story gradually and kept me curious until the end.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把论证或故事想成逐格展开的漫画：内容逐步增加就是“发展”，情节换方向就是“转折”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Decorative embellishment, or variation in colour that gives something a varied appearance.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使事物更美观的装饰或点缀；也指多种色彩交错形成的斑驳变化。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tiżjin li jsebbaħ xi ħaġa, jew taħlit u varjazzjoni ta' kuluri fid-dehra tagħha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 装饰；点缀；增添美感的修饰。
色彩斑驳；不同颜色交错呈现的变化。

collocations.zh: 多种色彩交错的斑驳效果

formal.mt: Iż-żwieq tal-ħitan jagħti lis-sala dehra festiva, filwaqt li l-għamara tibqa' sempliċi.
formal.en: The embellishment of the walls gives the hall a festive appearance, while the furniture remains simple.
formal.zh: 墙面的装饰使大厅显得喜庆，而家具仍保持简洁。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Jogħġbok dan id-drapp? Mark: Iva, iż-żwieq ta' kuluri jagħmlu sabiħ; ikun tajjeb għall-purtieri.
colloquial.en: Maja: Do you like this fabric? Mark: Yes, the variegation of colours makes it beautiful; it would be good for curtains.
colloquial.zh: Maja：你喜欢这块布吗？Mark：喜欢，交错的色彩让它很好看；用来做窗帘很合适。

messages.speaker: Maja (顾客)
messages.zh: 你喜欢这块布吗？
messages.en: Do you like this fabric?

messages.speaker: Mark (购物同伴)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, iż-żwieq ta' kuluri jagħmlu sabiħ; ikun tajjeb għall-purtieri.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, iż-żwieq ta' kuluri jagħmlu sabiħ; ikun tajjeb għall-purtieri.
messages.zh: 喜欢，交错的色彩让它很好看；用来做窗帘很合适。
messages.en: Yes, the variegation of colours makes it beautiful; it would be good for curtains.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一面原本素净的墙添上彩色花纹：添花纹记“装饰”，花纹颜色交错记“色彩斑驳”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Marriage as a relationship or union, or the wedding at which that union is celebrated.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 作为伴侣结合关系的婚姻；也指庆祝这一结合的婚礼。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ir-rabta bejn żewġ persuni miżżewġin, jew iċ-ċerimonja li fiha jiġi ċċelebrat dan l-għaqad.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 婚姻；结为伴侣后的婚姻关系。
婚礼；举行结婚仪式的活动。

formal.mt: Il-koppja għażlet żwieġ ċivili u organizzat ċerimonja żgħira għall-familja.
formal.en: The couple chose a civil marriage and organized a small ceremony for the family.
formal.zh: 这对伴侣选择了民事婚姻，并为家人安排了一场小型仪式。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Meta hu ż-żwieġ ta' oħtok? Mark: Is-Sibt li ġej; wara ċ-ċerimonja se nieklu flimkien.
colloquial.en: Maja: When is your sister's wedding? Mark: Next Saturday; after the ceremony we'll have a meal together.
colloquial.zh: Maja：你姐姐的婚礼什么时候举行？Mark：下周六；仪式结束后我们会一起吃饭。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你姐姐的婚礼什么时候举行？
messages.en: When is your sister's wedding?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Is-Sibt li ġej; wara ċ-ċerimonja se nieklu flimkien.
messages.mt_standard: Is-Sibt li ġej; wara ċ-ċerimonja se nieklu flimkien.
messages.zh: 下周六；仪式结束后我们会一起吃饭。
messages.en: Next Saturday; after the ceremony we'll have a meal together.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用同一对伴侣的两个画面记忆：长期共同生活是“婚姻”，亲友到场庆祝的那一天是“婚礼”。

gloss_zh: 玻璃般的；呈玻璃质感的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Having an appearance or surface like glass.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 外观或表面像玻璃一样的，具有玻璃般质感的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu dehra jew wiċċ bħal tal-ħġieġ.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 玻璃般的；具有玻璃一样外观或表面质感的。

formal.mt: Il-kampjun għandu wiċċ żġieġi li jirrifletti d-dawl.
formal.en: The sample has a glassy surface that reflects light.
formal.zh: 该样本具有能反射光线的玻璃般表面。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Kif jidher dan il-madum fid-dawl? Mark: Għandu wiċċ żġieġi u jleqq ħafna.
colloquial.en: Lara: What do these tiles look like in the light? Mark: They have a glassy surface and are very shiny.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：这些瓷砖在光线下看起来怎么样？马克：表面像玻璃一样，非常亮。

messages.speaker: Lara (顾客)
messages.zh: 这些瓷砖在光线下看起来怎么样？
messages.en: What do these tiles look like in the light?

messages.speaker: Mark (店员)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandu wiċċ żġieġi u jleqq ħafna.
messages.mt_standard: Għandu wiċċ żġieġi u jleqq ħafna.
messages.zh: 表面像玻璃一样，非常亮。
messages.en: They have a glassy surface and are very shiny.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象灯光照在光亮的瓷砖表面，用“看起来像玻璃”记住这个形容词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To play or romp lightheartedly, or to spend time in idle amusement.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 轻松欢快地嬉戏、蹦跳玩耍；也指把时间花在无所事事的消遣上。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Lagħab u qabeż bil-ferħ, jew għadda l-ħin f'divertiment bla skop serju.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 嬉戏；欢快地玩耍。
蹦跳嬉闹；活泼地玩耍。
表现得无所事事；闲玩或游手好闲。

sense_translations.en_definition: to frolic, disport oneself, pass time with idle amusement
sense_translations.zh_definition: 嬉戏；自娱自乐；以闲散的消遣打发时间。

formal.mt: Matul il-ħin liberu, it-tifel żżagħbel fil-bitħa ma' sħabu taħt is-superviżjoni tal-għalliem.
formal.en: During free time, the boy romped in the courtyard with his friends under the teacher's supervision.
formal.zh: 自由活动时，男孩在老师的看护下和朋友们在院子里嬉闹。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Kif qatta' waranofsinhar Pawlu? Mark: Żżagħbel fil-ġnien ma' sħabu, u issa għajjien.
colloquial.en: Maja: How did Pawlu spend the afternoon? Mark: He romped in the garden with his friends, and now he's tired.
colloquial.zh: Maja：Pawlu下午是怎么过的？Mark：他和朋友们在花园里嬉闹，现在累了。

messages.speaker: Maja (母亲)
messages.zh: Pawlu下午是怎么过的？
messages.en: How did Pawlu spend the afternoon?

messages.speaker: Mark (父亲)
messages.mt_spoken: Żżagħbel fil-ġnien ma' sħabu, u issa għajjien.
messages.mt_standard: Żżagħbel fil-ġnien ma' sħabu, u issa għajjien.
messages.zh: 他和朋友们在花园里嬉闹，现在累了。
messages.en: He romped in the garden with his friends, and now he's tired.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象孩子在花园里跑跑跳跳、玩得忘了时间：开心的一面是“嬉戏”，没有正事的一面是“闲玩”。

gloss_zh: 长出大肚子；鼓起；向外膨出

teaching_sense.en_definition: To develop a paunch, or to become swollen or bulge outward, especially of a wall or similar structure.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 人的腹部逐渐变大、长出大肚子；也指墙体等结构鼓起或向外膨出。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Sar b'żaqq kbira, jew beda jintefaħ u joħroġ 'il barra, speċjalment ħajt jew struttura simili.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 变得大腹便便；长出圆鼓鼓的大肚子。

sense_translations.en_definition: to start bulging or swelling (especially of a wall or similar structure)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 开始鼓起或膨胀，尤指墙体或类似结构向外凸出。
żaqqaq 的中间被动态形式，表示自身鼓起、膨出或变得大腹便便。
鼓起；向外凸出。
逐渐长出大肚子；腹部变得肥大突出。

collocations.zh: 那个男人长出了大肚子

formal.mt: L-ispezzjoni wriet li l-ħajt żżaqqaq fin-nofs u kien jeħtieġ tiswija.
formal.en: The inspection showed that the wall had bulged in the middle and required repair.
formal.zh: 检查显示，墙体中部已经向外鼓起，需要维修。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Dan il-ħajt dejjem kien hekk? Mark: Le, żżaqqaq ftit fin-nofs; ejja nuruh lil xi ħadd li jifhem fil-bini.
colloquial.en: Maja: Has this wall always been like this? Mark: No, it has bulged a little in the middle; let's show it to someone who knows about construction.
colloquial.zh: Maja：这面墙一直都是这样吗？Mark：不是，它中间有点鼓起来了；我们找个懂建筑的人来看看吧。

messages.speaker: Maja (住户)
messages.zh: 这面墙一直都是这样吗？
messages.en: Has this wall always been like this?

messages.speaker: Mark (同住者)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, żżaqqaq ftit fin-nofs; ejja nuruh lil xi ħadd li jifhem fil-bini.
messages.mt_standard: Le, żżaqqaq ftit fin-nofs; ejja nuruh lil xi ħadd li jifhem fil-bini.
messages.zh: 不是，它中间有点鼓起来了；我们找个懂建筑的人来看看吧。
messages.en: No, it has bulged a little in the middle; let's show it to someone who knows about construction.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把人的肚子变圆与墙面向外鼓起并排想象：共同的视觉特征都是中间凸出来，帮助联记两种用法。

gloss_zh: 萌芽；抽出新梢；振作起来

teaching_sense.en_definition: To sprout or produce new shoots; also, to become livelier or perk up.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 植物萌芽或抽出新梢；也可指人恢复精神、变得活跃起来。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ħareġ rimjiet ġodda; ukoll, reġa' ħa r-ruħ jew sar aktar ferrieħi u attiv.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 萌芽；开始长出嫩芽。
żarġan 的中间被动态形式，可表示自行萌芽、抽梢或恢复精神。
抽出新梢；发芽。
振作起来；恢复精神；变得活跃。

collocations.en: to perk up after a short rest

formal.mt: Wara x-xita, l-arbuxxell żżarġan u dehru rimjiet ġodda fuq il-friegħi.
formal.en: After the rain, the shrub sprouted, and new shoots appeared on its branches.
formal.zh: 雨后，灌木萌发了，枝条上长出了新梢。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Pawlu għadu għajjien? Mark: Le, wara ftit mistrieħ żżarġan u reġa' beda jitkellem bil-ferħ.
colloquial.en: Maja: Is Pawlu still tired? Mark: No, after a short rest he perked up and started chatting happily again.
colloquial.zh: Maja：Pawlu还累吗？Mark：不累了，稍微休息后他恢复了精神，又开始高兴地聊天了。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: Pawlu还累吗？
messages.en: Is Pawlu still tired?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, wara ftit mistrieħ żżarġan u reġa' beda jitkellem bil-ferħ.
messages.mt_standard: Le, wara ftit mistrieħ żżarġan u reġa' beda jitkellem bil-ferħ.
messages.zh: 不累了，稍微休息后他恢复了精神，又开始高兴地聊天了。
messages.en: No, after a short rest he perked up and started chatting happily again.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“重新有了生气”串联记忆：植物冒出嫩芽，人休息后精神一振；这是学习联想，不是词源解释。

gloss_zh: 被迫跳舞；不知情地卷入；被任意牵扯

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be forced to dance, or figuratively to become involved in something, often unwittingly or at another person's whim.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 被迫跳舞；也可比喻在不知情或他人任意摆布的情况下被卷入某事。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ikun imġiegħel jiżfen, jew, b'mod figurattiv, jidħol f'xi ħaġa mingħajr ma jkun jaf jew skont il-kapriċċi ta' ħaddieħor.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被迫跳舞。

sense_translations.en_definition: to be involved in sth. (usually unwittingly)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 被卷入某事，通常事先并不知情。

sense_translations.en_definition: to be involved in a capricious way
sense_translations.zh_definition: 因任性或随意的安排而被牵扯进某事。

collocations.en: was made to dance at the party

formal.mt: Il-ħaddiem żżeffen f'tilwima bejn żewġ dipartimenti mingħajr ma kien jaf x'kien ġara.
formal.en: The employee was drawn into a dispute between two departments without knowing what had happened.
formal.zh: 这名员工还不知道发生了什么，就被卷入两个部门之间的争执。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Mark żżeffen fil-festa lbieraħ, għalkemm ma riedx jiżfen. Lara: Miskin! Għaliex insistew miegħu?
colloquial.en: Maja: Mark was made to dance at the party yesterday, even though he didn't want to. Lara: Poor guy! Why did they keep insisting?
colloquial.zh: Maja：昨天聚会上，Mark明明不想跳舞，却被硬拉着跳了。Lara：真可怜！他们为什么一直逼他呀？

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Mark żżeffen fil-festa lbieraħ, għalkemm ma riedx jiżfen.
messages.mt_standard: Mark żżeffen fil-festa lbieraħ, għalkemm ma riedx jiżfen.
messages.zh: 昨天聚会上，Mark明明不想跳舞，却被硬拉着跳了。
messages.en: Mark was made to dance at the party yesterday, even though he didn't want to.

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 真可怜！他们为什么一直逼他呀？
messages.en: Poor guy! Why did they keep insisting?

cognitive_memory_aid: 把两个场景连起来记：先是被硬拉上舞池，再是被硬拉进争执；共同点是身不由己地参与。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To slide along a surface or to slip when one's footing or grip gives way.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 沿表面滑动，或因脚下、接触处失去稳固支撑而打滑、滑倒。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jimxi fuq wiċċ billi jiżloq, jew jitlef il-qabda jew il-bilanċ fuq wiċċ li jiżloq.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 沿某个表面滑动。
打滑；失足；滑倒。
滑动，或因失去稳固支撑而打滑。

formal.mt: Il-ħaddiem żżellaq fuq l-art imxarrba ħdejn id-daħla, iżda ma waqax.
formal.en: The worker slipped on the wet floor near the entrance but did not fall.
formal.zh: 这名工人在入口附近的湿地板上打了滑，但没有摔倒。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Mark żżellaq fuq it-taraġ! Lara: Rajtu. Żamm mal-poġġaman u ma waqax.
colloquial.en: Maja: Mark slipped on the stairs! Lara: I saw him. He held on to the handrail and didn't fall.
colloquial.zh: Maja：Mark在楼梯上打滑了！Lara：我看见了。他抓住了扶手，没有摔倒。

messages.speaker: Maja (同事)
messages.zh: Mark在楼梯上打滑了！
messages.en: Mark slipped on the stairs!

messages.speaker: Lara (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Rajtu. Żamm mal-poġġaman u ma waqax.
messages.mt_standard: Rajtu. Żamm mal-poġġaman u ma waqax.
messages.zh: 我看见了。他抓住了扶手，没有摔倒。
messages.en: I saw him. He held on to the handrail and didn't fall.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象鞋底踩上湿地板，突然往前滑一下；记住打滑未必摔倒，也可以只是沿表面滑动。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To become twisted, tangled, or full of knots.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 变得扭曲、相互缠绕，或出现许多结。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jitgħawweġ jew jitħabbel, jew jimtela bl-għoqiedi.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 变得扭曲；被扭绕起来。
布满绳结或纠结处。
缠结起来；变得扭绕纠缠。

collocations.en: the cord became twisted and tangled

formal.mt: Il-ħajt tal-ħjata żżellem waqt ix-xogħol, u kien meħtieġ li jinħallu l-għoqiedi qabel ma tkompliet il-ħjata.
formal.en: The sewing thread became tangled during the work, and the knots had to be undone before sewing could continue.
formal.zh: 缝纫过程中，线缠结了，必须先把结解开才能继续缝。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Il-kurdun żżellem fil-borża. Lara: Agħtih lili; nipprova nħoll l-għoqiedi bil-mod.
colloquial.en: Maja: The cord got tangled in the bag. Lara: Give it to me; I'll try to undo the knots gently.
colloquial.zh: Maja：细绳在包里缠成一团了。Lara：给我吧，我试着慢慢把结解开。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 细绳在包里缠成一团了。
messages.en: The cord got tangled in the bag.

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Agħtih lili; nipprova nħoll l-għoqiedi bil-mod.
messages.mt_standard: Agħtih lili; nipprova nħoll l-għoqiedi bil-mod.
messages.zh: 给我吧，我试着慢慢把结解开。
messages.en: Give it to me; I'll try to undo the knots gently.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把耳机线放进口袋，拿出来却扭着、缠着、打着结；用同一团乱线记住三个相近义项。

gloss_zh: 被抹脏；因触摸留下污痕；失去光泽

teaching_sense.en_definition: To become smeared or marked, especially through handling, or to become tarnished.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 变得有涂抹状污迹，尤其因拿取、触摸而留下痕迹；也指失去原有光泽。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jitħammeġ jew jimtela bil-marki, speċjalment għax jintmess jew jinqabad bl-idejn, jew jitlef it-tleqqija.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 变得沾有涂抹状的污迹。

sense_translations.en_definition: to become marked due to handling
sense_translations.zh_definition: 因被拿取或触摸而留下污痕。
被抹脏；表面沾有抹开的污迹。
失去光泽；变得暗淡。

formal.mt: Il-wiċċ tal-kaxxa żżelleġ bil-marki tas-swaba' wara li għadda minn ħafna idejn.
formal.en: The surface of the box became marked with fingerprints after being handled by many people.
formal.zh: 盒子经过多人拿取后，表面留下了手指印。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Il-mera għandha marki ġodda? Lara: Iva, il-wiċċ tagħha żżelleġ meta qbadtha b'idejja maħmuġin.
colloquial.en: Maja: Are those new marks on the mirror? Lara: Yes, its surface got smeared when I picked it up with dirty hands.
colloquial.zh: Maja：镜子上这些是新留下的印子吗？Lara：是的，我用脏手拿它时把表面弄脏了。

messages.speaker: Maja (室友)
messages.zh: 镜子上这些是新留下的印子吗？
messages.en: Are those new marks on the mirror?

messages.speaker: Lara (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, il-wiċċ tagħha żżelleġ meta qbadtha b'idejja maħmuġin.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, il-wiċċ tagħha żżelleġ meta qbadtha b'idejja maħmuġin.
messages.zh: 是的，我用脏手拿它时把表面弄脏了。
messages.en: Yes, its surface got smeared when I picked it up with dirty hands.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象刚擦亮的镜面被油手一摸：指印、抹痕让表面不再干净明亮，用这一画面串起各义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To swell or become distended, increasing in size or bulging outwards.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 体积增大、向外鼓起，呈现膨胀或胀满的状态。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jintefaħ jew jiżdied fil-volum, b'mod li joħroġ aktar 'il barra.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 膨胀；胀大。
鼓胀；因内部胀满而向外扩张。

formal.mt: Il-materjal żżembaħ wara li assorba l-ilma, u l-volum tiegħu żdied.
formal.en: The material swelled after absorbing water, and its volume increased.
formal.zh: 这种材料吸水后膨胀，体积随之增大。

colloquial.mt: Maja: L-istonku tiegħi żżembaħ wara l-ikla. Lara: Kilt aktar mis-soltu llum?
colloquial.en: Maja: My stomach feels bloated after the meal. Lara: Did you eat more than usual today?
colloquial.zh: Maja：吃完这顿饭，我肚子胀起来了。Lara：你今天吃得比平时多吗？

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 吃完这顿饭，我肚子胀起来了。
messages.en: My stomach feels bloated after the meal.

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 你今天吃得比平时多吗？
messages.en: Did you eat more than usual today?

cognitive_memory_aid: 在脑中画一个向外扩大的轮廓：材料吸水变大，肚子胀得鼓起；核心都是体积向外扩张。

gloss_zh: 变得疏忽；开始鲁莽行事

teaching_sense.en_definition: To become careless about one's responsibilities or to start behaving recklessly.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 对职责变得疏忽懈怠，或开始不顾后果地鲁莽行事。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jibda jittraskura d-dmirijiet tiegħu jew jaġixxi bla ħsieb u mingħajr ma jqis il-konsegwenzi.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 变得疏忽懈怠；开始怠于履行职责。
开始鲁莽行事，不再充分顾及后果。
变得鲁莽；行事不顾后果。

collocations.zh: 对自己的职责变得懈怠

formal.mt: L-impjegat żżemmel fid-dmirijiet tiegħu u beda jħalli dokumenti importanti mingħajr ma jiċċekkjahom.
formal.en: The employee became remiss in his duties and began leaving important documents unchecked.
formal.zh: 这名员工开始疏于履行职责，重要文件也不再认真核查。
