colloquial.mt: Maja: Pawlu żżemmel fis-sewqan; qiegħed isuq malajr wisq. Lara: Ngħidlu biex inaqqas il-veloċità.
colloquial.en: Maja: Pawlu has become reckless behind the wheel; he's driving too fast. Lara: I'll tell him to slow down.
colloquial.zh: Maja：Pawlu开车变得鲁莽了，车速太快。Lara：我会叫他开慢一点。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Pawlu żżemmel fis-sewqan; qiegħed isuq malajr wisq.
messages.mt_standard: Pawlu żżemmel fis-sewqan; qiegħed isuq malajr wisq.
messages.zh: Pawlu开车变得鲁莽了，车速太快。
messages.en: Pawlu has become reckless behind the wheel; he's driving too fast.

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 我会叫他开慢一点。
messages.en: I'll tell him to slow down.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一个原本认真检查的人逐渐松懈：工作漏查文件，开车忽略风险；用失去谨慎串起两个意思。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be rocked back and forth, or to become oblong in shape.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 被来回摇动；另一个义项是形状变得长圆。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jitbandal 'il quddiem u lura, jew jieħu forma tawwalija.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被摇动；被来回摇晃。
变成长圆形。

collocations.en: became oblong, taking on an elongated shape
collocations.zh: 变成长圆形，呈现拉长的形状

formal.mt: Il-ballun artab żżengel taħt il-pressjoni u ħa forma tawwalija.
formal.en: The soft ball became oblong under pressure, taking on an elongated shape.
formal.zh: 柔软的球受到挤压后变成长圆形，外形被拉长了。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Is-siġġu żżengel meta mbottajtu. Lara: Rajtu jitbandal. Poġġih aktar 'il bogħod mill-mejda.
colloquial.en: Maja: The chair rocked when I pushed it. Lara: I saw it rocking. Put it farther away from the table.
colloquial.zh: Maja：我推了一下，椅子就摇起来了。Lara：我看见它晃了。把它放得离桌子远一点吧。

messages.speaker: Maja (室友)
messages.zh: 我推了一下，椅子就摇起来了。
messages.en: The chair rocked when I pushed it.

messages.speaker: Lara (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Rajtu jitbandal. Poġġih aktar 'il bogħod mill-mejda.
messages.mt_standard: Rajtu jitbandal. Poġġih aktar 'il bogħod mill-mejda.
messages.zh: 我看见它晃了。把它放得离桌子远一点吧。
messages.en: I saw it rocking. Put it farther away from the table.

cognitive_memory_aid: 分成两张记忆卡：一张画椅子前后摇，另一张画圆球被压成长圆；分别记动作和形状，不强行推导词源。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To go bad or lose flavour, especially when oil becomes rancid.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指食物变质或失去原有风味，尤其指油脂变哈喇。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jitlef it-togħma tajba jew jitħassar, speċjalment meta ż-żejt jieħu riħa jew togħma ħażina.

sense_translations.en_definition: to go bad (often used of oil when it is rancid)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 变质；常指油脂变哈喇。
失去风味；原有的滋味变淡或消失。

sense_translations.en_definition: to become rancid, to lose its flavor
sense_translations.zh_definition: 变哈喇；失去原有风味。

collocations.en: it went bad and lost its flavour

formal.mt: Iż-żejt żżennaq wara li nżamm għal żmien twil f'post sħun.
formal.en: The oil went rancid after being stored in a warm place for a long time.
formal.zh: 这种油在温暖的地方存放很久后变哈喇了。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Għaliex dan iż-żejt għandu riħa ħażina? Pawlu: Żżennaq. Aħjar niftħu flixkun ieħor.
colloquial.en: Marija: Why does this oil smell bad? Pawlu: It has gone rancid. We'd better open another bottle.
colloquial.zh: 玛丽娅：这油怎么有股难闻的味道？保罗：变哈喇了。我们还是另开一瓶吧。

messages.speaker: Marija (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex dan iż-żejt għandu riħa ħażina?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex dan iż-żejt għandu riħa ħażina?
messages.zh: 这油怎么有股难闻的味道？
messages.en: Why does this oil smell bad?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (室友)
messages.zh: 变哈喇了。我们还是另开一瓶吧。
messages.en: It has gone rancid. We'd better open another bottle.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 żżennaq 和一瓶闻起来变味的油联系起来：闻到哈喇味，就想起“变质、失去风味”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To move by sliding along a surface, including sliding down from a higher position.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 沿着物体表面滑动，也可指从较高处向下滑。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jiċċaqlaq billi jiżloq fuq wiċċ, jew jinżel minn post ogħla b'dan il-mod.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 滑动；沿某个表面滑行。
滑下；沿表面向下滑。

formal.mt: Il-kaxxa żżerżqet minn fuq il-mejda u waqgħet mal-art.
formal.en: The box slid off the table and fell to the floor.
formal.zh: 箱子从桌上滑落，掉到了地板上。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Fejn mar il-ktieb? Mark: Żżerżaq minn fuq il-mejda. Qiegħed ħdejn is-siġġu.
colloquial.en: Sara: Where did the book go? Mark: It slid off the table. It's beside the chair.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：书去哪儿了？马克：从桌上滑下去了，在椅子旁边。

messages.speaker: Sara (同学)
messages.zh: 书去哪儿了？
messages.en: Where did the book go?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Żżerżaq minn fuq il-mejda. Qiegħed ħdejn is-siġġu.
messages.mt_standard: Żżerżaq minn fuq il-mejda. Qiegħed ħdejn is-siġġu.
messages.zh: 从桌上滑下去了，在椅子旁边。
messages.en: It slid off the table. It's beside the chair.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一本书沿光滑桌面滑动，再从桌边滑下：用这段连续画面记住 żżerżaq 的两个义项。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To get married or take someone as one's spouse.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 结婚，或与某人结为配偶。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jingħaqad fiż-żwieġ ma' persuna oħra.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 结婚。

sense_translations.en_definition: to marry someone; to take someone as one's spouse
sense_translations.zh_definition: 与某人结婚；与某人结为配偶。

formal.mt: Pawlu żżewweġ lil Marija f'ċerimonja żgħira quddiem il-familja u l-ħbieb.
formal.en: Pawlu married Marija in a small ceremony attended by family and friends.
formal.zh: 保罗与玛丽娅举行了小型婚礼，在亲友见证下结为夫妻。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Ħuk żżewweġ diġà? Lara: Iva, żżewweġ ix-xahar li għadda. Kienet ġurnata sabiħa.
colloquial.en: Anna: Has your brother got married already? Lara: Yes, he got married last month. It was a lovely day.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：你哥哥已经结婚了吗？拉拉：是啊，上个月结的婚。那天特别美好。

messages.speaker: Anna (朋友)
messages.zh: 你哥哥已经结婚了吗？
messages.en: Has your brother got married already?

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, żżewweġ ix-xahar li għadda. Kienet ġurnata sabiħa.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, żżewweġ ix-xahar li għadda. Kienet ġurnata sabiħa.
messages.zh: 是啊，上个月结的婚。那天特别美好。
messages.en: Yes, he got married last month. It was a lovely day.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 żżewweġ 放进婚礼画面中记忆：单独说表示“结婚”，接 lil 和人名表示“与某人结婚”。

gloss_zh: 变得玻璃般光亮；目光变得呆滞

teaching_sense.en_definition: To become glassy in appearance, including when someone's eyes take on a fixed, vacant look.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 外观变得像玻璃一样光亮；用于眼神时，指目光变得凝滞、空洞。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jieħu dehra tleqq bħal tal-ħġieġ; meta jingħad dwar il-ħars, dan isir fiss u vojt.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 变得呈玻璃般的光亮或质感。
眼神变得凝滞而空洞。
变得像玻璃一样光亮。

collocations.zh: 表面变得像玻璃般光亮

formal.mt: Wara t-trattament, il-wiċċ tal-vażun żżeġġeġ u beda jirrifletti d-dawl.
formal.en: After the treatment, the surface of the vase became glassy and began to reflect the light.
formal.zh: 经过处理后，花瓶表面变得玻璃般光亮，开始反射光线。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Il-ħars ta' Pawlu żżeġġeġ; donnu m'għadux jisma' x'qegħdin ngħidu. Lara: Ilu jistudja minn filgħodu. Forsi għandu bżonn pawża.
colloquial.en: Maja: Pawlu's gaze has gone glassy; he doesn't seem to be listening to what we're saying anymore. Lara: He's been studying since this morning. Maybe he needs a break.
colloquial.zh: Maja：Pawlu的目光都呆住了，好像已经听不进我们说话了。Lara：他从早上就一直在学习，可能需要休息一下。

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-ħars ta' Pawlu żżeġġeġ; donnu m'għadux jisma' x'qegħdin ngħidu.
messages.mt_standard: Il-ħars ta' Pawlu żżeġġeġ; donnu m'għadux jisma' x'qegħdin ngħidu.
messages.zh: Pawlu的目光都呆住了，好像已经听不进我们说话了。
messages.en: Pawlu's gaze has gone glassy; he doesn't seem to be listening to what we're saying anymore.

messages.speaker: Lara (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Ilu jistudja minn filgħodu. Forsi għandu bżonn pawża.
messages.mt_standard: Ilu jistudja minn filgħodu. Forsi għandu bżonn pawża.
messages.zh: 他从早上就一直在学习，可能需要休息一下。
messages.en: He's been studying since this morning. Maybe he needs a break.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两幅玻璃画面记忆：花瓶表面像玻璃一样发亮，人的眼神则像玻璃珠一样凝住；这是词义联想。

gloss_zh: 放纵享乐；沉溺于放荡生活

teaching_sense.en_definition: To indulge in excessive, morally disapproved pleasure or debauchery.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 沉溺于过度享乐或放荡生活，带有道德上的贬义。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jgħix bla rażan u jagħti ruħu għal pjaċiri eċċessivi u mġiba meqjusa immorali.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 纵情享乐；沉溺于放荡无度的生活。

collocations.zh: 多年来一直过着放荡生活

formal.mt: Fir-rumanz, il-protagonist żżiegħeb għal snin sħaħ u ttraskura r-responsabbiltajiet tiegħu.
formal.en: In the novel, the protagonist indulged in debauchery for years and neglected his responsibilities.
formal.zh: 小说中的主人公多年来沉溺于放荡生活，疏于履行自己的责任。

colloquial.mt: Marta: Għaliex il-karattru tilef il-flus kollha? David: Għax żżiegħeb bla rażan u nefaq kollox fuq il-pjaċiri tiegħu.
colloquial.en: Marta: Why did the character lose all his money? David: Because he indulged in unrestrained debauchery and spent everything on his pleasures.
colloquial.zh: 玛尔塔：这个人物为什么把钱都败光了？戴维：因为他毫无节制地放纵享乐，把钱全花在了自己的享受上。

messages.speaker: Marta (读书会成员)
messages.zh: 这个人物为什么把钱都败光了？
messages.en: Why did the character lose all his money?

messages.speaker: David (读书会成员)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax żżiegħeb bla rażan u nefaq kollox fuq il-pjaċiri tiegħu.
messages.mt_standard: Għax żżiegħeb bla rażan u nefaq kollox fuq il-pjaċiri tiegħu.
messages.zh: 因为他毫无节制地放纵享乐，把钱全花在了自己的享受上。
messages.en: Because he indulged in unrestrained debauchery and spent everything on his pleasures.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用小说中因放纵享乐而败光家财的人物记住 żżiegħeb；注意它含有贬义，不能随意用于普通娱乐。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To abound or become increased in quantity.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 数量丰富充裕，或数量有所增加。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ikun abbundanti jew jiżdied fil-kwantità.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 丰富充裕；大量存在。
增加；数量得到增多。

formal.mt: Il-ġid tar-raħal żżiegħed wara diversi snin ta' ħsad tajjeb.
formal.en: The village's wealth increased after several years of good harvests.
formal.zh: 连续几年丰收后，村里的财富增加了。

colloquial.mt: Rita: X'ġara fir-raħal wara dawk il-ħsadiet tajbin? Toni: Il-ġid żżiegħed, u ħafna familji setgħu jsewwu djarhom.
colloquial.en: Rita: What happened in the village after those good harvests? Toni: Wealth increased, and many families were able to repair their homes.
colloquial.zh: 丽塔：那几次丰收后，村里有什么变化？托尼：财富增加了，许多家庭都有能力修缮房屋了。

messages.speaker: Rita (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: X'ġara fir-raħal wara dawk il-ħsadiet tajbin?
messages.mt_standard: X'ġara fir-raħal wara dawk il-ħsadiet tajbin?
messages.zh: 那几次丰收后，村里有什么变化？
messages.en: What happened in the village after those good harvests?

messages.speaker: Toni (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-ġid żżiegħed, u ħafna familji setgħu jsewwu djarhom.
messages.mt_standard: Il-ġid żżiegħed, u ħafna familji setgħu jsewwu djarhom.
messages.zh: 财富增加了，许多家庭都有能力修缮房屋了。
messages.en: Wealth increased, and many families were able to repair their homes.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象丰收后粮仓越来越满，用“数量增多，物资充裕”的同一画面连接 żżiegħed 的两个义项。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To travel or take part in a sport on snow using skis.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使用滑雪板在雪上移动或进行滑雪运动。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jiċċaqlaq fuq il-borra bl-iskis bħala mezz ta' vjaġġar jew bħala sport.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 滑雪；使用滑雪板在雪上滑行。

formal.mt: Matul il-vaganza tax-xitwa, Mark żżielaq fil-muntanji taħt is-superviżjoni ta' għalliem.
formal.en: During the winter holiday, Mark skied in the mountains under an instructor's supervision.
formal.zh: 寒假期间，马克在教练指导下到山区滑雪。

colloquial.mt: Lara: X'għamel Mark fil-vaganza? Nina: Żżielaq għall-ewwel darba! Qal li ħa gost ħafna.
colloquial.en: Lara: What did Mark do on holiday? Nina: He skied for the first time! He said he really enjoyed it.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：马克假期做什么了？妮娜：他第一次去滑雪了！他说玩得特别开心。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 马克假期做什么了？
messages.en: What did Mark do on holiday?

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Żżielaq għall-ewwel darba! Qal li ħa gost ħafna.
messages.mt_standard: Żżielaq għall-ewwel darba! Qal li ħa gost ħafna.
messages.zh: 他第一次去滑雪了！他说玩得特别开心。
messages.en: He skied for the first time! He said he really enjoyed it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 看到 żżielaq 就想象双脚踩着滑雪板滑过雪坡；把滑雪板加入画面，有助于记牢具体运动。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To exert oneself strongly, or to behave recklessly.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 奋力使劲、竭力做事；也可指鲁莽行事，具体含义取决于语境。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jagħmel sforz kbir, jew iġib ruħu b'mod imprudenti mingħajr ma jqis il-konsegwenzi.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使劲；奋力；竭力做某事。

sense_translations.en_definition: to behave in an reckless manner
sense_translations.zh_definition: 鲁莽行事；行为冒失，不顾后果。

collocations.en: exerted himself to lift the box
behaved recklessly without considering the consequences
collocations.zh: 不考虑后果地鲁莽行事

formal.mt: Il-ħaddiem żżiemel biex iċaqlaq il-kaxxa tqila, iżda fl-aħħar kellu jitlob l-għajnuna.
formal.en: The worker exerted himself to move the heavy box, but eventually had to ask for help.
formal.zh: 工人奋力搬动沉重的箱子，但最后还是不得不求助。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Għaliex waqqfu lil Mark waqt il-logħba? Pawlu: Għax żżiemel u kważi weġġa' lil sieħbu.
colloquial.en: Anna: Why did they stop Mark during the game? Pawlu: Because he behaved recklessly and almost hurt his teammate.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：比赛时他们为什么叫停马克？保罗：因为他动作鲁莽，差点伤到队友。

messages.speaker: Anna (观赛朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex waqqfu lil Mark waqt il-logħba?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex waqqfu lil Mark waqt il-logħba?
messages.zh: 比赛时他们为什么叫停马克？
messages.en: Why did they stop Mark during the game?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (观赛朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax żżiemel u kważi weġġa' lil sieħbu.
messages.mt_standard: Għax żżiemel u kważi weġġa' lil sieħbu.
messages.zh: 因为他动作鲁莽，差点伤到队友。
messages.en: Because he behaved recklessly and almost hurt his teammate.

cognitive_memory_aid: 为 żżiemel 配两张记忆卡：一张是奋力搬箱子，一张是冒失冲撞队友；结合语境区分“使劲”和“鲁莽”。
